algeria_events.8.f: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstNameNoFormatting] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastNameNoFormatting] dismounts [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] horse in front of the Dey's old palace, its crumbling walls pock-marked with shot and bullet holes—some recent, some older than even [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstNameNoFormatting] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerselfHimself].\nJust past the gate, a group of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] regulars can be seen hauling captured French cannon onto carts, supervised by a dour-looking captain shouting orders in a thick Turkish accent, while a group of Kabylian warriors are rolling dice in the courtyard, playing for what seems to be an officer's pocket watch.
algeria_events.8.b: Restore the Deylik, and resubmit to the High Porte.
algeria_events.8.c: I orient my face towards Him, who created the heavens.
algeria_events.8.e: The age of Arabs is over. The time of the Berber has come.
algeria_events.8.g: Out with the old. We shall build a new Algeria.
algeria_events.8.tt.3: You formed Algeria as Ait Abbas or Touggourt
je_dreyfus_status: The current strength of the case is [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('dynamic_dreyfus_case_strength')]
je_dreyfus_affair_tt.1:
The fate of Dreyfus will depend on the thoroughness of the case built in his support.

- A case strength of #bold 10#! or above will result in a total exoneration.
- A case strength between #bold 5#! and #bold 9#! will result in a lesser sentence.
- A case strength of #bold 4#! or less will result in reincarceration.
je_dreyfus_affair_tt.3: Momemtum for a retrial is steadily growing in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag], and one is likely to be held in #bold 5 years#!, unless affected by other events.\n
je_dreyfus_affair_tt.4: The outcome of the retrial will have wider implications for French society.
je_dreyfus_affair_goal: The Goal is clear to us.
custom_dreyfus_case_weak: #bold Weak#!.\nThis would likely result in #bold reincarceration#!
custom_dreyfus_case_medium: #bold Medium#!.\nThis would likely result in a #bold lesser sentence#!
custom_dreyfus_case_strong: #bold Strong#!.\nThis would likely result in #bold exoneration#!
dreyfus.1.d: Accused of disclosing classified military information to the [SCOPE.sCountry('dreyfus_rival_country_scope').GetAdjective] ambassador in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], the [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetReligion.GetName] officer [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetFullName] has been judged guilty of treason by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dreyfus_armed_forces_scope').GetName], based off a handwriting analysis and the contents of a secret dossier.
dreyfus.1.a: Cashier him, then ship the man off to Devil's Isle.
dreyfus.1.b: Treason? If only we still had the death penalty.
dreyfus.1.c: Autoforgery? Secret dossiers? Order a discreet inquiry.
dreyfus.1.tt_1: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dreyfus_armed_forces_scope').GetName] sentence [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetLastName] to life in prison, to be served on the infamous Devil's Isle.
dreyfus.1.tt_2: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dreyfus_armed_forces_scope').GetName] sentence [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetLastName] to life in prison.
dreyfus.1.tt_3: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dreyfus_armed_forces_scope').GetName] sentence [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetLastName] to life in prison.
dreyfus.1.tt_4: A limited investigation into the [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetLastName] case is undertaken by the government.
dreyfus.2.d: Insisting that [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetFullName] has been falsely convicted, his supporters have identified [SCOPE.sCharacter('ferdinand_esterhazy_scope').GetFullName] as the likely culprit. [SCOPE.sCharacter('ferdinand_esterhazy_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] however, has now been acquitted by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dreyfus_armed_forces_scope').GetName] in a closed-door trial—subsequently shaving his mustache and fleeing the country.
dreyfus.2.b: Surely the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dreyfus_armed_forces_scope').GetName] knows what they're doing.
dreyfus.3.d: A scathing newspaper opinion has been published in the newspaper L'Aurore by [SCOPE.sCharacter('emile_zola_scope').GetFullName], accusing the French government and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dreyfus_armed_forces_scope').GetName] of antisemitism and the unlawful conviction of [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetFullName].
dreyfus.3.a: A spark lit. Now comes the blaze.
dreyfus.3.b: The truth is on the march, and nothing shall stop it.
dreyfus.3.tt_1: As the government conducted an early inquiry, [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetLastName]'s case strength increases by an additional #bold 1#!.
dreyfus.3.tt_2: The government conducted an early inquiry.
dreyfus.4.d: Servants at the home of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting]ard vanguard [SCOPE.sCharacter('zola_asphyxiation_leader').GetFullName] found their employer dead in [SCOPE.sCharacter('zola_asphyxiation_leader').GetHerHis] bedroom. A tragedy, wept one. Assassination, cried another. Natural causes, a third hoped. Whether one or the other, a blow against [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetFullName]'s case.
dreyfus.4.f: The coroner confirmed that afternoon that no foul-play was involved. A special investigation was conducted upon the request of the surviving family. Monoxide poisoning was the culprit, from an improperly swept chimney.\n\nYet, rumors persist: skulduggery and assassination abound, strangely without anyone eager to claim the kill.
dreyfus.4.c: Allow the rumors to persist. There may be truth to them.
dreyfus.5.d: Furious with what [SCOPE.sCharacter('dreyfus_armed_forces_leader_scope').GetSheHe] considers the defamation of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dreyfus_armed_forces_scope').GetName]'s good name and reputation, [SCOPE.sCharacter('dreyfus_armed_forces_leader_scope').GetFullName] has charged the author of
dreyfus.5.f: Shouts of fury, indignance, triumph and loss drowned the judge's drones. His detractors said that a harsher punishment was due. His supporters cried martyrdom, same as they had done in Dreyfus. A scandal besmirching France, from one; a pity he wasn't around for a noose, from another. The one thing they all agreed on: Émile Zola had the wrong punishment.
dreyfus.5.a: The court rules: Guilty on all charges.
dreyfus.5.b: Guilty, but only a fine will be levied.
dreyfus.5.c: Not guilty. Freedom of expression is sacrosanct.
dreyfus.5.tt_1: [SCOPE.sCharacter('emile_zola_scope').GetFullName] will attempt to flee into exile to avoid jail.
dreyfus.6.d: A well-to-do socialite associated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dreyfus_parlor_game_ig_scope').GetName] has recently produced a parlor game titled
dreyfus.6.a: It is only a game, why do you have to be mad?
dreyfus.6.b: That smells of libel. Throw the book at them.
dreyfus.7.d: Spurred on by a particularly inflamatory opinion piece in the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anti_dreyfusard_riot_ig').GetName]-affiliated newspaper the [SCOPE.sState('anti_dreyfusard_riot_state').GetCityHubName] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')], large crowds have taken to the streets, burning effigies of [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetFullName] and shouting anti-[SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetReligion.GetName] slogans.
dreyfus.7.a: The voice of the people is the voice of God.
dreyfus.7.c: Let the flics have a go at these brutes.
dreyfus.8.d_1: In what has been dubbed the
dreyfus.8.d_2: Conducted in an atmosphere of extreme tension, a [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] court has reaffirmed the guilt of [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetFullName], but with
dreyfus.8.d_3: In a widely-condemned trial, dominated almost entirely by members of the upper echelons of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dreyfus_armed_forces_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetFullName] has once again been sentenced to life in prison, marking the total defeat of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting]ard movement, and further entrenching the position of France's conservative establishment.
dreyfus.8.a: In the end, truth always prevails.
dreyfus.8.b: A triumph for the forces of the Enlightenment.
dreyfus.8.c: It seems the Dreyfusian Spectre will haunt us for some time more.
dreyfus.8.e: An unsatisfying end, to an unsatisfying affair.
dreyfus.8.h: A triumph for the forces of tradition.
dreyfus.8.tt_1: All [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] will have a higher chance to spawn conservative and reactionary [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')].
dreyfus.8.tt_2: All [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] will have a higher chance to spawn liberal and radical [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')].
dreyfus.9.d: In an interview with a local journalist, [SCOPE.sCharacter('ferdinand_esterhazy_scope').GetFullName], now living in exile in [SCOPE.sCountry('ferdinand_esterhazy_country_scope').GetNameNoFlag], and suspected by many of being the real culprit of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetLastName] Affair, has apparently admitted [SCOPE.sCharacter('ferdinand_esterhazy_scope').GetHerHis] guilt, confessing that he was the bordereau's true author.
dreyfus.9.a: A light upon the [SCOPE.sCharacter('alfred_dreyfus_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] case, indeed.
dreyfus.9.b: Nothing but [SCOPE.sCountry('ferdinand_esterhazy_country_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] lies, meant to sow discord.
slave_revolt_events.1.d: For centuries the [SCOPE.sCulture('freed_slave_culture_scope').GetName] people have toiled under the yoke of the whip, ever while yearning for freedom. With the establishment of an independent [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag], that faint hope is now a mere pen-stroke away from becoming reality, as a proposal for an emancipatory constitution have been presented to the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
slave_revolt_events.1.f:
(1) The people inhabiting [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] hereby agree to form themselves into a free state sovereign and independent of any other power in the universe.

(2) Every resident person in the territory of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] is free in full right.

(3) Slavery in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] is forever abolished.
slave_revolt_events.1.a: Freedom from slavery shall be enshrined in the constitution.
slave_revolt_events.1.b: Who then shall work the fields? I think not.
revolution_pulse2_events.1.t: In the Interest of the Nation
revolution_pulse2_events.1.d: Stressing the importance of staying up to date with recent military advancements, the government has proposed sending [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetFullName] on a military fact finding mission to [SCOPE.sCountry('fact_finding_mission_country_scope').GetName]—a thinly veiled plot to distance the quarrelsome general from [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetHerHis] increasingly insurgent supporters.
revolution_pulse2_events.1.f: At the approximate moment when the steam lifted away from the mirror, it dawned on [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetHerHim] that the government might as well have asked [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetHerHim] to find snow in a desert. Had that realisation come earlier, [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetSheHe] might have had the good sense to just say,
revolution_pulse2_events.1.a: Have [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetHerHim] pack [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetHerHis] bags. Actually, pack them for [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetHerHim].
revolution_pulse2_events.1.b: Funding [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetHerHim] to gallavant around [SCOPE.sCountry('fact_finding_mission_country_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName]? No thank you.
revolution_pulse2_events.1.tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetFullName] is sent off on a year-long fact finding mission.
revolution_pulse2_events.2.d: Returning from the fact finding mission to [SCOPE.sCountry('fact_finding_mission_country_scope').GetName] with a head full of ideas and a suitcase full of expensive liquor, [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetFullName] is once again free to pursue [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetHerHis] domestic ambitions.
revolution_pulse2_events.2.f: If one chases a wild goose for long enough, one is bound to learn a few things: firstly, that most beasts tire before a human will. And secondly, there's more than just the one thing to hunt. In this case, everything asked for and more upon a silvery platter.\n\nAnd with a splash of the right drink, any sensible leader would want to hear of these new and terrible wonders.
revolution_pulse2_events.2.a: For better or for worse, [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_lad_leader_scope').GetLastName] is back.
results_of_the_fact_finding_mission: Results of the Fact Finding Mission
revolution_pulse2_events.3.d: As the flames of revolution encroach on [SCOPE.sState('transnational_unrest_squashing_state_scope').GetName], a violent strike has engulfed the [SCOPE.sState('transnational_unrest_squashing_state_scope').GetCityHubName] [SCOPE.sBuilding('transnational_unrest_squashing_factory_scope').GetName]. Fearing escalation and a further loss of profits, a cabal of [SCOPE.sCountry('transnational_unrest_squashing_country_scope').GetAdjective] shareholders have petitioned the government for immediate aid, offering the assistance of off-duty [SCOPE.sCountry('transnational_unrest_squashing_country_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFlag] gendarmes stationed across the border.
revolution_pulse2_events.3.f: I've got two hundred men on standby.
revolution_pulse2_events.3.a: This is getting out of hand. Accept their aid.
revolution_pulse2_events.3.b: Our own law enforcement is capable of handling this.
revolution_pulse2_events.3.c: Let us avoid bloodshed. Adopt a conciliatory approach.
revolution_pulse2_events.4.d: Protesting the payment of wages in the form of scrips—credit only exchangable at a company store—workers of the major [SCOPE.sBuilding('company_store_strike_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('company_store_strike_state').GetName] have commenced a riot, torching the controversial store and marching on the company's main offices, demanding the institution of cash wages.
revolution_pulse2_events.4.a: The nature of payments is a company matter, break up the riot.
revolution_pulse2_events.4.b: Let us not fan the flames. There is merit to the workers' demands.
revolution_pulse2_events.4.tt: Enact legislation banning the substitution of cash wages with company credit.
sided_with_workers_over_scrips: Sided with Workers in Credit Matter
sided_with_capitalists_over_scrips: Sided with Industrialists in Credit Matter
revolution_pulse2_events.5.d: Ordered to violently suppress a popular riot in [SCOPE.sState('garrison_refusal_state').GetCityHubName], a battalion of the [SCOPE.sState('garrison_refusal_state').GetName] garrison have refused their orders, claiming that the execution of such a command would run contrary to the laws of men and [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('GetDivinity')] alike.
revolution_pulse2_events.5.a: Insubordination! String up the ringleaders, and jail the rest.
revolution_pulse2_events.5.b: Hush this down. We shall rotate the garrison eventually.
revolution_pulse2_events.7.d: The attempted arrest of a local [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_worker_profession')|l] in [SCOPE.sState('hatmakerfeud_state').GetName]—charged with inciting violence against the government should his demands for increased worker's rights not be met—quickly went awry as as the local populace rallied around the upstart and threw the dispatched sheriff in a local river.
revolution_pulse2_events.7.a: Send in the army, let them try that stunt again.
revolution_pulse2_events.7.b: Let the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_worker_profession')|l] be, and pray this remains a local matter.
revolution_pulse2_events.8.d: Emboldened by their earlier success against the law, the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_worker_profession')|l] and hundreds of his supporters turned up to confront the army dispatchment now arriving in [SCOPE.sState('hatmakerfeud_state').GetName] - much of their earlier enthusiasm wavering as they spy the soldiers set up two cannon facing the crowd.
revolution_pulse2_events.8.a: Open fire. Sound the charge. Disperse the rabble.
revolution_pulse2_events.8.b: Give them one day to surrender the criminal and disperse.
revolution_pulse2_events.8.tt_1: The [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_worker_profession')|l] is captured alive, leading to interrogations and mass arrests.
revolution_pulse2_events.8.tt_2: The [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_worker_profession')|l] is killed, creating a martyr for his cause.
revolution_pulse2_events.8.tt_3: The [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_worker_profession')|l] escapes, allowing him to resume his work covertly.
revolution_pulse2_events.9.t: In the Hands of the State
revolution_pulse2_events.9.d: Did he smash his head into the cell wall? Was he tortured to death? The official story that the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('jailtime_blues_ig').GetName]-affiliated revolutionary died from cholera convinces only the gullible and the willfully blind. Only one thing is for certain: his supporters are livid, and they are out for blood.
revolution_pulse2_events.9.b: Only [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('GetDivinity')] and the warden knows for sure. Let us #italic kindly#! ask the latter.
revolution_pulse2_events.10.d: A band of revolutionaries rumored to affiliate with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('arms_depot_raided_ig').GetName], have overwhelmed a minor garrison in [SCOPE.sState('arms_depot_raided_state').GetName], leaving two dozen soldiers dead, and running off with crates full of rifles and ammunition - even wheeling off a small caliber cannon.
revolution_pulse2_events.10.f:
#bold Wanted: Armory Thieves#! 

Over 30 men believed involved with theft of artillery and ordinance in [randomState]. £200 per man captured or killed; £50 for information leading to the capture or death of culprits.

Believed armed and dangerous. Collaborators will be considered equally guilty.
land_ownership_law_events.1.d: Claiming that [SCOPE.sState('homesteading_act_state_scope').GetName]'s prime lands should be settled by virtous yeomen like themselves, the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law proposal is experiencing a surge of popularity among members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rural_folks_scope').GetName] eying an opportunity in the frontiers—to the great chagrin of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_scope').GetName] currently dominating the agricultural sector.
land_ownership_law_events.1.f: Debates raged for days in the courthouse. Accusations flew as fast as declarations of this ancestral heritage or that natural right. Theft, squatting and illegal possession were the weapons of choice. Rights of blood, family names, and obscure by-laws that amounted to proving whoever spotted it first were the shields.
land_ownership_law_events.1.b: First the legislature shall be won over, then the frontier.
land_ownership_law_events.1.c: Promise the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_scope').GetName] that money still matters.
land_ownership_law_events.2.t: The Shackled Soul of the Nation
land_ownership_law_events.2.d: In a somewhat surprising move, claiming that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [GetLawType('law_serfdom').GetName] has driven a wedge between the spiritual backbone of the country, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rural_folks_scope').GetName], and an increasingly foreign-influenced upper class, a number of conservative thinkers have come out in support of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]—breaking ranks with their more traditionally inclined fellows in the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_scope').GetName] and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_scope').GetName].
land_ownership_law_events.2.a: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] society must be reunited, the common spirit rekindled.
land_ownership_law_events.2.b: Let these tired old men bicker all they want.
land_ownership_law_events.3.d: In a stormy parliamentary speech, [SCOPE.sCharacter('anti_kulak_leaders_scope').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anti_kulak_ig_scope').GetName], and a chief advocate for the enactment of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], has claimed that
land_ownership_law_events.3.a: All wealthy farmers are class traitors...
land_ownership_law_events.3.b: ...but only the most opulent shall face the judge's mallet.
land_ownership_law_events.3.c: Their fate have yet do be decided. Make no official statements.
land_ownership_law_events.4.t: The Plight of the Second Sons
land_ownership_law_events.4.d: With virgin land to award second sons becoming an increasingly rare commodity in [SCOPE.sState('commercialized_agriculture_state_scope').GetName], many farmers engaged in the local [SCOPE.sBuilding('commercialized_agriculture_building_scope').GetName] hope that a transition to [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] will yield the revenues necessary to provide for all their offspring upon death—or at the very least leave a single profitable farm that can be sold off for profit.
land_ownership_law_events.4.f: The fields are not wholly sustainable within new models. Each farmer would be left to his or her own devices regarding each field. It is assumed that each subsequent harvest would overwork the soil. Middle-management to ensure a smooth transition process is required. Appropriate training for each farmer looking to exploit the new [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] laws is also required.\n\nRecommendation: rezone land to those who can already afford to purchase it and company instruction on best practices.
land_ownership_law_events.4.a: Their concerns make for excellent talking points.
land_ownership_law_events.4.b: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_scope').GetName] would be #italic delighted#! to buy them out.
land_ownership_law_events.4.c: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_scope').GetName] and the power of capital shall step in.
for_the_nations_second_sons_modifier: For the Sake of the Second Sons
land_ownership_law_events.5.d: Seeking to eliminate the need of middlemen by bringing together [GetPopType('farmers').GetName], [GetPopType('laborers').GetName], and [GetPopType('shopkeepers').GetName] in a co-oporatively owned business, a newly formed farmers' co-operative in [SCOPE.sState('farmer_coops_state_scope').GetName]—desiring to improve the lot of their constituent members—have used their considerable local influence to push for the enactment of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
land_ownership_law_events.5.f: Each family had come together, whether they made chairs, picked fruit, or tallied who sold what. It was agreed that the best chance of a future was to wrest control of where everything went. Fruits and furniture would stay under everyone's reach. Vegetables and vanities would be sold at a fair price, with fair splits going to who stocked the shelves. It would never be
land_ownership_law_events.5.b: Laud their model of business as a vision of tomorrow's world.
land_ownership_law_events.5.c: Countryside and city, farmers and workers, unite!
land_ownership_law_events.6.d: The proposal to enact [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], effectively redistributing plots of lands from [GetPopType('farmers').GetName] to [GetPopType('aristocrats').GetName], has unsurprisingly led to massive protests among the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rural_folks_scope').GetName], being seen by many as but the first step towards the institution of [GetLawType('law_serfdom').GetName].
land_ownership_law_events.6.a: Peasants are mere sons of the soil, not its natural owners.
land_ownership_law_events.6.b: You want a Revolution? This is how we get a Revolution.
land_ownership_law_events.7.d: With the government's drive to enact [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] in full swing, a group of well-off farmers-turned-landowners from [SCOPE.sState('farmer_wealth_concentration_state_scope').GetName], owing their affluence to their close proximity to the major grain markets in [SCOPE.sState('farmer_wealth_concentration_state_scope').GetCityHubName], have offered to put their considerable political weight behind the law proposal, were they to be granted certain
land_ownership_law_events.7.f: The issue of tying land to extractive wealth is simple: whoever controls the land with valuables will have a greater voice in an amassed society. Whether this comes in the form of wheat, cotton, or opium does not matter. It invariably leads to a desire to avoid losing that greater voice. And so come the impassioned compromises: a temporary sacrifice of pride to hold on to power that bit longer.
land_ownership_law_events.7.a: I'm sure we could cough up some agricultural
land_ownership_law_events.7.b: Grant them preferential land rights in [SCOPE.sState('farmer_wealth_concentration_state_scope').GetName].
land_ownership_law_events.7.c: We can do without such skulduggery. The law looks secure as it is.
land_ownership_law_events.8.d: With the debate about the enactment of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] looming large in [SCOPE.sState('a_tragedy_in_the_commons_state_scope').GetName], a local dispute between a [SCOPE.sState('a_tragedy_in_the_commons_state_scope').GetFarmHubName] landowner and several farmers has come to bloodshed. Faced with the possibility of their common grazing lands being bought up and closed off, one particularly irate farmer responded by gunning down the landowner in a fit of rage.
land_ownership_law_events.8.f: A death is a tragedy, and a million is a statistic. The statistics in this case being acres of land, and lives displaced by an act of greed. Killing a perpetrator is a swift fix. But the mere act of murder itself has condemned one party to hardship. So then the better question is to ask what the tragedy is: someone dying a preventable death, or hundreds starving for one person's greed?
land_ownership_law_events.8.a: Barbarous. This is the face of those who oppose the reform.
land_ownership_law_events.8.b: A sick deed from a sick mind. Nothing more.
land_ownership_law_events.8.c: This act is symptomatic of a greater disease. Deal with it.
land_ownership_law_events.9.d: The government's push to introduce [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has been met with disbelief and widespread protests across [SCOPE.sState('serfdom_enactment_state_scope').GetName], with free [GetPopType('farmers').GetName], unwilling to silently enter into the bondage of [GetPopType('aristocrats').GetName], allying themselves with urban reformers who see the institution as an artifact of a bygone age.
land_ownership_law_events.9.a: As [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('GetDivinity')] guides his flock, so shall the [GetPopType('aristocrats').GetName] guide theirs.
land_ownership_law_events.9.b: Oh, but they will not become #italic serfs#!, merely
the_return_of_the_good_old_days: The Return of the Good Old Days
garibaldi_events.1.d: Judging our struggle against [SCOPE.sCountry('garibaldi_spawn_foe_scope').GetName] just, the Italian revolutionary and nationalist [SCOPE.sCharacter('garibaldi_scope').GetFullName] has decided to align with our cause, offering up his services as a general.
garibaldi_events.1.b: We have no use for this rabble-rousing wildcard.
garibaldi_events.2.d_1: With the outbreak of war between [SCOPE.sCountry('garibaldi_italian_nation_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('garibaldi_foreign_nation_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('garibaldi_scope').GetFullName] has decided to leave [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] to take up arms against the enemies of Italy.
garibaldi_events.2.d_2: With [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] at peace, and the fight against tyrants over, at least for now, [SCOPE.sCharacter('garibaldi_scope').GetFullName] has decided to leave the country in pursuit of another worthy cause.
garibaldi_events.3.d: Drawing on the Italian population of [SCOPE.sState('italian_legion_state_scope').GetName], General [SCOPE.sCharacter('garibaldi_scope').GetFullName] has organized a legion of like-minded compatriots to join the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] fight against [SCOPE.sCountry('italian_legion_foe_scope').GetAdjective] tyranny.
garibaldi_events.3.a: Their skills and zeal are sorely needed on the battlefield.
garibaldi_events.3.b: Use their expertise to train and recruit more men for the army.
garibaldi_events.4.d: While [SCOPE.sCharacter('garibaldi_scope').GetFullName]'s abilities to move the minds of commoners have proven useful in the fight against [SCOPE.sCountry('garibaldi_peasants_foe_scope').GetAdjective], his radical preachings are starting to turn some of [SCOPE.sState('garibaldi_peasants_state_scope').GetName]'s [GetPopType('farmers').GetName] against our own rule as well—with several government ministers now demanding he be gagged.
garibaldi_events.4.a: He is too important for the cause. Let us avoid antagonization.
garibaldi_events.4.b: Order him to tone down his language.
luddite_law_events.1.d: An article published in the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] has been making headways within the country's literary circles, enflaming the ongoing debate surrounding [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. Claiming that machines are a kind of mechanical life undergoing constant evolution, it warns that, unless mankind acts prudently, machines might one day supplant humans as the dominant species.
luddite_law_events.1.a: The machines shall not replace us.
luddite_law_events.1.b: Sounds like someone has sat in his dank studio for a bit too long.
luddite_law_events.2.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('simple_living_leader_scope').GetFullName], the resolutely anti-modernist leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('simple_living_ig_scope').GetName], has lauded the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] proposal, claiming it would steer the [SCOPE.sCulture('simple_living_primary_culture_scope').GetName] people away from the depraved march of modernity, and back into the tender bossom of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('GetDivinity')].
luddite_law_events.2.a: [SCOPE.sCharacter('simple_living_leader_scope').GetHerHis|U] words have merit, and our goals are alligned.
luddite_law_events.3.d: What began as a protest against the possible automation of certain work tasks in the [SCOPE.sBuilding('technophobic_fury_building_scope').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('technophobic_fury_state_scope').GetName] quickly devolved into a riot as a radicalized, mallet-wielding foreman unlocked the doors of the factory floor. Stories of broken machinery and broken bones are quickly spreading across [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag], souring the debate on [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
luddite_law_events.3.a: An unfortunate incident, at an inopportune time.
luddite_law_events.3.b: Arrest both rabble and ringleaders. They do not represent us.
yeet_agitator_events.1.d: Finding both the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] public and supposed political allies unreceptive to [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_1').GetHerHis] ideas, frustrated, [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_1').GetFullName] has decided to retire from the realm of politics, opting instead to spend the rest of [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_1').GetHerHis] days penning embittered reflections on what could have been.
yeet_agitator_events.1.a: Let [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_1').GetHerHim] peddle [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_1').GetHerHis] ideas in peace, away from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName].
yeet_agitator_events.1.b: Politely inform [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_1').GetHerHim] [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_1').GetHerHis] presence is unwanted in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting].
yeet_agitator_events.1.tt_1: [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_1').GetFullName] retires from politics and settles domestically.
yeet_agitator_events.1.tt_2: [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_1').GetFullName] retires from politics and settles abroad.
yeet_agitator_events.2.d: Satisfied with the state of politics in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag], and eyeing new opportunities for agitation abroad, [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_2').GetFullName] has declared [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_2').GetHerHis] intentions to leave the country—wishing its current custodians the best of luck in the years to come.
yeet_agitator_events.2.a: Fare well, [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_2').GetLastNameNoFormatting]. May your ideas find ready ears abroad.
yeet_agitator_events.3.d: Content with the new state of affairs in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag], and unwilling or unable to face the uncertainties that life abroad offers, [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_3').GetFullName] has officially announced [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_3').GetHerHis] retirement from political life.
yeet_agitator_events.3.a: Even firebrands cool off in the end it would seem.
yeet_agitator_events.3.b: Let us honor [SCOPE.sCharacter('yeeted_agitator_scope_3').GetHerHis] memory. A bust in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] perhaps?
commune_progress_subtract_5: The progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! will #bold decrease#! by #bold 5#!
commune_progress_add_5: The progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! will #bold increase#! by #bold 5#!
paris_commune_pulse_events.1.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetAdjective] guardsmen attached to the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('seize_church_ig_scope').GetName] have seized another prominent church. They have asked the Central Committee for direction.
paris_commune_pulse_events.1.f: The National Guard arrived to a deserted church.\n
paris_commune_pulse_events.1.a: Close the church until the commune is better established.
paris_commune_pulse_events.1.b: Find all the gold and silver.
paris_commune_pulse_events.1.c: Turn it over to [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('seize_church_ig_scope').GetName] for their meetings.
paris_commune_pulse_events.2.d: The Communards have shot General [SCOPE.sCharacter('executed_general_scope').GetLastName] multiple times outside of Paris. Though Versailles has a faint hope he survived, the Communards have claimed a moral victory.
paris_commune_pulse_events.2.f:
One by one, his men deserted him.
Two by two, the guard leveled their rifles.
Three by three, the rifles cracked.
Four by four, the holes stacked.
Five by five, nobody could have survived.
paris_commune_pulse_events.2.a: They did their duty by killing an enemy general.
paris_commune_pulse_events.2.b: Conduct a fair trial. We are not barbarians.
paris_commune_pulse_events.2.c: Put them in the Enfants Perdus for their bravery.
paris_commune_pulse_events.2.tt: General [SCOPE.sCharacter('executed_general_scope').GetLastName] is captured by the Communards, and may survive should they be defeated.
paris_commune_executes_general: General [SCOPE.sCharacter('executed_general_scope').GetLastName] is captured by the Communards, and executed.
paris_commune_pulse_events.3.d: With the promise of counter-revolution under way, Parisian arrondissements argue over who needs more fortifications.
paris_commune_pulse_events.3.a: The people know their districts best.
paris_commune_pulse_events.4.d: Public buildings, statues and homes associated with the monarchy are set ablaze. Witnesses have assigned culpability to the women in the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName].
paris_commune_pulse_events.4.f: Fires blacken the skies over Paris. Many call this a great triumph of the Commune.\nOthers, a reckless desecration of France's long history.\nThe pall of ash is incontrovertible: havoc reigns as people indulge in destruction.
paris_commune_pulse_events.4.b: Men's tempers get fiery in times like this.
paris_commune_pulse_events.4.c: The women want to vent their fury too.
paris_commune_pulse_events.5.d: The government in Versailles has allowed the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] to trial and sentence captured Communards within 24 hours. In retaliation, the Central Committee in Paris has decreed that it will execute three men for every death by a military tribunal.
paris_commune_pulse_events.5.a: Shoot to kill. They are enemy combatants.
paris_commune_pulse_events.5.b: They are traitors. Execute any who arise suspicion.
paris_commune_pulse_events.5.c: This is barely sedition. Imprison unarmed suspects.
paris_commune_pulse_events.6.d: National Guard cadres have captured a group of priests who refuse to leave Paris. They are preparing to move the clerics to prison.
paris_commune_pulse_events.6.a: Reactionaries cannot be tolerated. Seize them all!
paris_commune_pulse_events.6.b: Permit them to leave Paris with one bag.
paris_commune_pulse_events.6.c: Entomb the clerics with their church's rubble.
paris_commune_pulse_events.7.d: Skirmishes around Paris' outskirts have led to French Army forces capturing members of the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetAdjective] National Guard.
paris_commune_pulse_events.7.f: Men in navy blues and reds were taken on sight. They were clearly National Guard.\nSome had cast off most of their effects and tried to run back to the city. They were less clearly National Guard.\nThe army had a simpler rule. It didn't matter if it was a butter knife in one hand and a single shot in the other: if they had a weapon, shoot them.
paris_commune_pulse_events.7.a: They have surrendered. Begin the tribunals.
paris_commune_pulse_events.8.d: Hundreds of bronze field guns in Paris are left unclaimed. The Versailles government urges caution. General [SCOPE.sCharacter('cannon_seizing_general_scope').GetLastName] assures that [SCOPE.sCharacter('cannon_seizing_general_scope').GetSheHe] has enough men to seize the guns.
paris_commune_pulse_events.8.a: Leave now, while we have the element of surprise.
paris_commune_pulse_events.8.b: There are too few men to seize them.
paris_commune_pulse_events.8.c: We have better guns lying around.
paris_commune_pulse_events.8.tt_1: The army extracts some of the guns, but others are lost to the Communards.
paris_commune_pulse_events.8.tt_2: The Communards seize the guns and there are mass defections from our ranks
paris_commune_pulse_events.9.d: The Women's Union have rallied numbers around the city to put an end to the city's legal brothels. Many cite the strict law around them as the cause.
paris_commune_pulse_events.9.f: The purpose of legal constraints of prostitution is to limit venereal disease, avoid abusive master-servant relations, and ensure that legal consent is enforced.\nWhile sound in theory, most prostitutes are well aware of the risks of their profession.\nExcept now the laws force them through poor treatment, poor healthcare, and invite legal abuse.
paris_commune_pulse_events.9.a: A woman's body is her right.
paris_commune_pulse_events.9.b: Men's urges are best contained in those walls.
paris_commune_pulse_events.9.c: They have a point. Make dens of sin illegal in totality.
possible_feminist_agitator_spawn: A #bold Feminist#! agitator may appear in [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName]
paris_commune_pulse_events.10.d: Clashes at one of the forts surrounding Paris have led to an offer of surrender. The garrisoned Communards have agreed to vacate the fort and return to the city.
paris_commune_pulse_events.10.tt_2: The Communards let it go and commit their forces elsewhere.
paris_commune_pulse_events.11.d: A decree by the Central Committee allows employees of a business to take it over if the previous owner abandons it. Some are eager to accelerate that process.
paris_commune_pulse_events.11.a: Workers are entitled to their browsweat.
paris_commune_pulse_events.11.b: We should encourage other owners to leave.
paris_commune_pulse_events.12.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetAdjective] Central Committee has decreed that children will not be allowed to work. Divisions continue on what they should do with their newfound free time.
paris_commune_pulse_events.12.f: A cheap source of unquestioning labor was the thought behind working the young. Of course, those who thought of it were not working their children. No, who would wilfully condemn their own child to hip deformities, out-of-shape spines, and various cancers from coal dust inhalation?\n\nNaturally, when the chance came, the Commune scrapped it. Now everyone's children have a chance to grow.
paris_commune_pulse_events.12.a: Give us the child; we will return an adult.
paris_commune_pulse_events.12.b: The barricades will make men of them yet.
paris_commune_pulse_events.12.c: Perhaps a broken clock #italic is#! correct twice a day.
possible_radical_agitator_spawn: A #bold Radical#! agitator may appear in [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName]
paris_commune_pulse_events.13.d: Despite a decree from the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetAdjective] Central Committee that the death penalty has been nullified, many clerical hostages fear the rule will not apply to them.
paris_commune_pulse_events.13.f: Pray. That was what the bishop said in this time, as the clergy were thrown into flea-infested cells and handed rotten food.\nOutside were the cheers and cries: the death sentence was no more.\nInside the prison, though, were the leering eyes of men hungry to watch the priests die.
paris_commune_pulse_events.13.a: They are valuable trading chits. Leave them where they are.
paris_commune_pulse_events.13.b: We could stand to give them better conditions...
paris_commune_pulse_events.13.c: It is our duty to speed them on their way to God.
paris_commune_pulse_events.14.d: After a by-election in the Paris Commune, the National Guard organized a parade through the main boulevards.
paris_commune_pulse_events.14.f: Jean-Pierre got his boots. Jean-Pierre got his coat. Jean-Pierre got his gun. A grand revolution was on the way. And Jean-Pierre was with friends and family he had known for as long as he could remember. Paris had a fine history of glorious revolution, and his heart was giddy for it.\n\nExcept, Jean-Pierre wasn't quite sure if it dawned on anyone else yet: they use the same bullets as the French Army. And the French Army would be shooting at them soon.
paris_commune_pulse_events.14.a: Our allegiance is to the Committee and the Commune.
paris_commune_pulse_events.15.d: Elections for leadership in the arrondissements have revealed a flaw: some electees are also members of the National Assembly. [SCOPE.sCharacter('commune_leftist_leader').GetFullName] has declared that Republicanism is incompatible with the commune.
paris_commune_pulse_events.15.a: The way forward will not be determined by clerks alone.
paris_commune_pulse_events.15.b: The will of the people must be upheld.
paris_commune_pulse_events.16.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetAdjective] Committee for Public Safety has forbidden women from entering the battlefield. The Women's Union has released a manifesto asserting that many Parisian women would be glad to fight.
paris_commune_pulse_events.16.b: Keep them off the battlefield in totality.
paris_commune_pulse_events.16.c: Hand them a rifle and a bayonet.
je_haitian_debt_reason:
Declared in 1804, Haiti's independence from [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName] would not only be hard-fought, but also hard-bought. Diplomatically isolated and fearing another invasion, in 1825 the Haitian government agreed to compensate France for its lost property, human souls included, and for damages incurred during the #bold 1804 Haitian Massacre#!. In return Haiti would receive diplomatic recognition.

The massive 150 million #italic francs#! indemnity the country was saddled with necessitated the taking out of high interest loans with French private banks, and ever since Haiti has found itself in a downward spiral of increasing indemnity, debt, and interest payments.

If Haiti is to once again be known as the #bold Pearl of the Antilles#!, our financial obligations must be dealt with, one way or another.
je_haitian_debt_status_4: Our current debt level is: #bold Massive#!
je_haitian_debt_status_3: Our current debt level is: #bold Large#!
je_haitian_debt_status_2: Our current debt level is: #bold Significant#!
je_haitian_debt_status_1: Our current debt level is: #bold Small#!
je_haitian_debt_negotiation_button_desc: Should diplomatic conditions be right, we could initiate talks with [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetNameNoFlag] to lower the indemnity owed their creditors. This can only be requested #bold once#!, and, should [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] accept, will come at the cost of owing an [concept_obligation|l].
je_haitian_debt_payment_button_desc: Authorise a large payment to the [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFlag] #italic Caisse des dépôts et consignations#!.
je_haitian_cancel_debt_button_desc: Enough is enough. We would rather pay for our independence in blood than bleed our coffers dry for the damned [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFlag].
je_haitian_cancel_debt_button_tt: This decision will not be well-received in [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName], and their willingness to wage war against us can be expected to rise drastically.
je_haitian_cancel_debt_not_tt: Has #b not#! unilaterally canceled the debt
notification_haiti_stops_paying_france_d: Haiti has refused to make any further payments to our country, unilaterally cancelling any and all debts owed us.\n\nDemands for a punitive expedition are widespread, and we now possess a [concept_claim|l] on our old colony.
notification_haiti_pays_off_debt_name: Haiti Pays Off Part of Indemnity
notification_haiti_pays_off_debt_desc: Haiti has paid off part of the indemnity owed us, with the Parisian #italic Caisse des dépôts et consignations#! receiving the installment earlier this morning.
hispaniola_events.1.d: The last franc owed to [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName] for our emancipation is paid. Revelry grips the streets.
hispaniola_events.1.f: #bold To The Last Penny!#!\nThe financial fetters that chained us to our old colonial masters have been broken at last, as the final installment to our [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] creditors, with great fanfare, was deposited with the #italic Caisse des dépôts et consignations#! earlier this afternoon, marking the end of decades of financial humiliation.
hispaniola_events.1.a: For the Forefathers, for the Fatherland.
hispaniola_events.1.b: Let us be the only masters of the soil.
pearl_of_the_antilles_modifier: The Remade Pearl of the Antilles
hispaniola_events.2.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('haiti_scope').GetName] has paid its indemnity and debts in full. Per the terms of its agreement with us, it is now free of its obligations.
hispaniola_events.2.f: When the [SCOPE.sCountry('haiti_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] indemnity was imposed in 1825, in truth, few Frenchmen expected it to ever be paid off in full. But against all odds, Haiti has achieved just that, making the final payment at the #italic Caisse des dépôts et consignations#! in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] earlier this afternoon.
hispaniola_events.2.a: Issue an official congratulation to the Haitian government.
hispaniola_events.3.d: The country of [SCOPE.sCountry('haiti_scope').GetName], suffering under a massive indemnity owed us for the exchange of their freedom, has requested a renegotiation of the terms.
hispaniola_events.3.a: Granted. Influence is a currecy of its own.
hispaniola_events.3.b: Denied. The Haitians will pay their due.
hispaniola_events.4.d: Our negotiations with [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName] have borne fruit. In an official communiqué signed by [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetRuler.GetFullName] [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetRuler.GetHerselfHimself], one quarter of the owed indemnity is written off, though with certain diplomatic strings attached.
hispaniola_events.4.f: Your letter arrived to me in good faith, and I must say that I am dismayed. We had received full assurances your island nation was able to remunerate our lost costs. But rest assured that I, [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting], have seen to it personally. Parliament has come to terms with a new deal for your people.
hispaniola_events.5.d: In yet another display of colonial arrogance, [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName] has refused any and all suggestions to reduce the indemnity—the [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] representative instead launched into a tirade about financial obligations and the horrors of Saint Domingue.
je_french_natural_borders_reason: Expansionistic tendencies have once again arisen in France. The citizens, or at least some of the loudest citizens, demand that our borders extend to the banks of the Rhine and the slopes of the Alps.
natural_borders.1.d: The notion of 'natural borders' has become popular among supporters of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('borders_leader').GetLastName] regime. French patriots demand the expansion of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state into bordering regions.
natural_borders.1.a: Our borders must reach the Rhine.
dismiss_natural_borders_tt: The 'Natural Borders of France' Journal Entry will be dismissed
natural_borders.2.d: With [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] now extending to the far corners of the Rhine and Alps, we have achieved what champions of this project have termed our 'natural borders'. We must now administer our newly-acquired territories.
natural_borders.2.f: The Rhenish official greeted the newcomer. Plenty of folks were coming from further west nowadays. He pulled out his form and began writing.\n
natural_borders.2.a: They must learn to be French.
natural_borders.2.c: We are the liberators of Gaul.
natural_borders.3.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('savoy_country').GetName] has agreed to cede the states of [SCOPE.sState('savoy_state').GetName] and [SCOPE.sState('nice_state').GetName] to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
natural_borders.3.d2: [SCOPE.sCountry('savoy_country').GetName] has agreed to cede the state of [SCOPE.sState('savoy_state').GetName] to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
natural_borders.3.b: Conduct a plebiscite to assuage the people.
france_annex_savoy_desc: The province of Savoy is a natural part of the French nation, and home to many who already consider themselves French. It may be possible, through diplomatic means, to convince their occupiers to cede the territory.
obligation_for_savoy_tt: We will trade in our Obligation for Savoy and, if applicable, Nice
sell_savoy_desc: The province of Savoy has become a matter of contention between our nation and France. If we are willing to cede Savoy, France would surely consider themselves to be in our debt.
je_coup_reason: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] are planning a coup against our democratic institutions, aiming to seize control of the government and install a regime more amicable to their interests.
je_coup_goal: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] is ready to execute the coup
coup_remove_ig: If the Interest Group is removed from government while the coup is being planned, their Approval will be greatly reduced
coup_advancing: The coup is currently expected to gain progress
coup_declining: The coup is currently expected to lose progress
coup_success_tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] will immediately enact the [SCOPE.sLaw('coup_desired_law').GetName] law
coup.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetFullName] has grown discontent with the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] government's institutions. A conspiracy is forming among the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] to launch a coup against the government and establish [SCOPE.sLaw('coup_desired_law').GetName].
coup.2.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] have successfully orchestrated a coup against [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] democracy. [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetFullName] has invoked a state of national emergency, allowing [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetHerHim] to lead the country as an [SCOPE.sLaw('coup_desired_law').GetName].
coup.2.d2: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] have successfully orchestrated a coup against the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state. As a bold first act, [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetFullName] has proclaimed the establishment of a [SCOPE.sLaw('monarchy_law').GetName] under absolutist rule.
coup.2.d3: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] have successfully orchestrated a coup against the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state. [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetFullName] has proclaimed the previous government illegitimate, and declared the establishment of a [SCOPE.sLaw('coup_desired_law').GetName] under provisional absolute rule.
coup.2.d4: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] have successfully orchestrated a coup against the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state. [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetFullName] has condemned the bourgeois dictatorship of the previous government, and declared the establishment of a [SCOPE.sLaw('coup_desired_law').GetName] under provisional absolute rule.
coup.2.d5: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] have successfully orchestrated a coup against the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state. [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetFullName] has proclaimed the previous government an affront to [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('GetDivinity')], and declared the establishment of a [SCOPE.sLaw('coup_desired_law').GetName] under provisional absolute rule.
coup.2.g: Long live the dictatorship of the proletariat!
coup.3.d: In one fell swoop, [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetFullName] has been decisively removed from power before [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetSheHe] could execute [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetHerHis] coup and institute [SCOPE.sLaw('coup_desired_law').GetName]. Though democracy lives on for now, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] have not taken kindly to their political exile.
coup.5.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] have departed the government entirely. The institution of [SCOPE.sLaw('coup_desired_law').GetName] is likely to be executed on the field of battle, rather than in the halls of government.
coup.5.a: The rats scatter once the light is shone on them.
coup.5.b: Let [SCOPE.sCharacter('coup_leader').GetFullName], in defeat or not, forever be known as a turncoat.
wedding.2.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('royal_marriage_character').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('royal_marriage_character').GetFullName] seeks a match with a partner of suitably distinguished birth.
wedding.2.a: A member of the [SCOPE.sCountry('marriage_country_1').GetAdjective] house of [SCOPE.sCharacter('foreign_ruler_1').GetLastName] would be fitting.
wedding.2.b: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('foreign_ruler_2').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.sCountry('marriage_country_2').GetName] has a suitable relative.
wedding.2.c: The [SCOPE.sCountry('marriage_country_3').GetAdjective] royal family would be an excellent match.
wedding.3.d1: Outraged by political events disfavoring the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('monarch_ig').GetName] in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetFirstName] has decided to abdicate the throne to [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetHerHis] heir, [SCOPE.sCharacter('heir_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('heir_scope').GetFullName].
wedding.3.d2: Realizing that [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetHerHis] lack of [concept_popularity] may be doing for harm than good for the institution of the [SCOPE.sLawType('monarchy_law').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetFirstName] has decided to abdicate in favor of [SCOPE.sCharacter('heir_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('heir_scope').GetFullName].
wedding.3.d3: The infirmity of [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetFirstName] has made [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetHerHim] unfit to rule. In a rare moment of lucidity, [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetSheHe] has agreed to abdicate in favor of [SCOPE.sCharacter('heir_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('heir_scope').GetFullName].
je_french_foreign_legion_reason: If we are to rule in Africa, we must establish a permanent military presence on the continent. We must be prepared to accept that these forces will have to be recruited from local populations and from brave or desperate soldiers of foreign nations.
algeria_events.9.d: With the erection of a permanent Legionary [SCOPE.sBuilding('legion_barracks').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('algeria_state_scope').GetName], dubbed the Quartier Viénot, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] Foreign Legion has been established as a premier fighting force in Africa.
sway_to_bonapartism_desc: With the proper combination of bribes and persuasion, a politician might be persuaded to support the rightful candidate for the throne.
supporting_bonapartist_tt: The 'Sway to Bonapartism' Character Interaction becomes available
cannot_choose_bonapartist_twice_tt: You cannot switch to encourage Bonapartists more than once
supporting_orleanism_tt: The 'Sway to the Orleanists' Character Interaction becomes available
cannot_choose_orleanist_twice_tt: You cannot switch to encourage Orleanists more than once
supporting_legitimists_tt: The 'Sway to the Legitimists' Character Interaction becomes available
cannot_choose_legitimist_twice_tt: You cannot switch to encourage Legitimists more than once
not_already_supporting_orleanism: Is not already supporting the Orleanists
not_already_supporting_legitimist: Is not already supporting the Legitimists
sway_to_legitimism_desc: With the proper combination of bribes and persuasion, a politician might be persuaded to support the rightful candidate for the throne.
sway_to_orleanism_desc: With the proper combination of bribes and persuasion, a politician might be persuaded to support the rightful candidate for the throne.
bonapartist_button_desc: France reached the height of its glory under the Emperor Napoleon. The restoration of the House of Bonaparte is clearly what is right for our country.
orleanist_button_desc: It is trade and commerce that will finance the future of France. We need a monarch who will listen to the concerns of our wealthiest citizens.
legitimist_button_desc: France has been spoiled by the decadence of the revolution. We must return to the old way of governance in which people knew their place.
french_pretenders.5.d: Three dynasties have claims on the French throne: the [SCOPE.sCharacter('orleanist_character').GetIdeology.GetName] line backs the constitutional July Monarchy, the [SCOPE.sCharacter('legitimist_character').GetIdeology.GetName] line supports the descendants of Charles X, while the [SCOPE.sCharacter('bonapartist_character').GetIdeology.GetName] line seek to restore Napoleon's French Empire.
french_pretenders.5.f: Three lines have risen to claim one crown. Once the arch-enemy of Rome, then the jewel of Christendom, and now... heirs to an uncertain future. The days of the Revolution are fresh in French minds. Another now, so soon, could spell disaster. Blood may run in the streets before this matter is truly settled.
french_pretenders.5.b: Stand by the House of Orleans.
changed_french_monarchist_support: The progress bar will be reset
status_throne_challenged_fra: The House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetCustom('french_dynasty_name')] is being challenged by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('french_leading_dynasty_name')]
status_no_dynasty_fra: No royal pretender is ahead of anyone else
status_dynasty_cementing_fra: The ruling House of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetCustom('french_dynasty_name')] is cementing its control
exiles_events.100.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('repatriated_scope').GetFullName] has returned from exile in [SCOPE.sCountry('repatriator_country_scope').GetName] with the support of their hosts' government. It seems that the [SCOPE.sCountry('repatriator_country_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] have reason to spread [SCOPE.sCharacter('repatriated_scope').GetIdeology.GetName] ideology in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
exiles_events.100.f: Second chances come rarely. The home once denied to [SCOPE.sCharacter('repatriated_scope').GetHerHim] now opens its doors with a foreigner’s support. They cast [SCOPE.sCharacter('repatriated_scope').GetHerHim] away before, preferring a false heaven of evermore tyrannical choirs. But a second chance for [SCOPE.sCharacter('repatriated_scope').GetHerHim] meant a second chance for the dream. For true brotherhood. Perhaps [SCOPE.sCharacter('repatriated_scope').GetHerHis] great work might bear fruit yet.
exiling_dissident_radicals_factors: The amount of [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] generated depends on our Freedom of Speech [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] and the [concept_popularity] of the [concept_character]
ideology_positivist_desc: This character is an ardent technocrat and anticlericalist, disdaining both the arbitrary power of monarchs and the fickle whims of the public.
law_technocracy_desc: The nation is governed by an unelected council of men of reason and ability.
technocracy.1.d: Following a series of poor business decisions, [SCOPE.sCharacter('technocrat_leader').GetFullName] has taken to lashing out against [SCOPE.sCharacter('technocrat_leader').GetHerHis] detractors in the tabloids. These screeds have served to destroy [SCOPE.sCharacter('technocrat_leader').GetHerHis] public reputation and damaged support for [GetLawType('law_technocracy').GetName].
technocracy.1.a: A public bailout will resolve the matter.
technocracy.2.d: A group of influential $engineers$ have greatly improved productivity in the [SCOPE.sBuilding('new_machine_building').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('new_machine_state').GetName] through the application of scientific principles. They suggest that under [GetLawType('law_technocracy').GetName] they would be able to apply these principles to the mechanicisms of government.
technocracy.2.f: A salient point of intelligence is understanding one's limitations. Through this comes the recognition that one's experience is finite and subject to perspective. Without this pillar, human intelligence is prone to hubris.\n\nFor example, someone may conceive the idea that it is possible to treat bureaucracy as a machine, rather than the cluster of skills that it is. Thusly, treat humans as problems to solve, rather than independent variables with experience and intelligence of their own.
technocracy.2.a: The industrial sector needs them most.
technocracy.3.d: Debate rages between $academics$ at the [SCOPE.sBuilding('university_building').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('university_state').GetName] over the issue of popular governance versus rule by an enlightened elite. The argument has captured public attention due to the ongoing effort to establish a [GetLawType('law_technocracy').GetName].
technocracy.3.a: The people need great minds to see what is best for them.
technocracy.3.b: We can at least agree on our distaste for $aristocrats$.
natural_borders.4.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName] has announced its ambitions to extend its borders from Savoy to the Rhine. This puts [SCOPE.sState('french_claim_state').GetName] in considerable danger of invasion.
natural_borders.4.f2: Invasion after invasion into these borderlands have left the people on the right-hand banks bitter to the French. A new anthem has swept the region, a thunderous call for every German knight, of flesh and ghost, to defence against another incursion.
natural_borders.4.a: Muster every able man to defend their homes.
natural_borders.4.b: Perhaps appeasement is the best approach.
notification_fra_natural_borders_notific: [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName] has announced its intentions to expand towards its 'natural borders', spanning from the Atlantic to the Rhine.
france_annex_luxembourg_desc: Luxembourg lies within our natural borders, and should be part of France. Perhaps a generous offer would persuade their overlord to accept a sale.
natural_borders.5.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('lux_overlord').GetName] has wisely agreed to our terms for the purchase of [SCOPE.sCountry('lux_scope').GetName]. The territory has returned to its rightful place as part of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation.
natural_borders.5.f: The remarkable things one can do with money—purchase land, silence critique, hire labor—are limitless with the right mindset. With enough of it, one might purchase a country.
natural_borders.5.a: A natural extension of our borders.
je_nihilist_movement_goal: One of the following:\n[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has enacted [GetLawType('law_censorship').GetName] or [GetLawType('law_outlawed_dissent').GetName], and all Nihilist interest groups are suppressed for more than 5 years\n[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has maintained the #bold positive#! support of the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_intelligentsia',GetPlayer).GetName], or has kept them marginalized for more than 5 years
je_nihilist_movement_trigger_tt_1: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has enacted [GetLawType('law_censorship').GetName] or [GetLawType('law_outlawed_dissent').GetName], and the #b $movement_nihilist$#! has been suppressed for more than 5 years
je_nihilist_movement_trigger_tt_2: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has maintained the #bold positive#! support of the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_intelligentsia',GetPlayer).GetName], or has kept them marginalized for more than 5 years
je_nihilist_movement_reason: Claiming to desire the abolition of all things declared to be sacred, a movement of radical [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_intelligentsia',GetPlayer).GetName] has begun to spread tracts condemning divinely-appointed rule. This movement threatens the very foundations of our government with its criticism.
nihilism.2.d: The rigorous suppression of the nihilist movement has finally borne fruit, as the word
nihilism.2.a: They were more trouble than they had any right to be.
nihilism.2.b: Use this to reassert our control over the academia.
nihilism.3.d: The conflict within the nihilist movement has finally led it to burn itself out, but the spirit of radicalism is not gone. Former nihilists have flocked to other radical movements in droves.
nihilism.3.a: Only a taste of the conflict to come.
nihilism.3.b: Let them fade into the past.
nihilism.4.d: A popular member of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective]  [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] has released a novel condemning the trend of nihilistic excess amongst the youth. The main character, professing vocal nihilism, bears a resemblance to [SCOPE.sCharacter('nihilist_scope').GetFullName].
nihilism.4.a: At least one of them has some sense.
nihilism.4.b: Isn't the main character dashing, though?
nihilism.5.d: Students embracing the aesthetic and attitude of nihilism have become more and more common at [SCOPE.sState('university_nihilist_affected_state').GetName] [SCOPE.sBuilding('university_nihilist_affected_building').GetName], and numerous parties have raised concerns about radicalism in academia.
nihilism.5.a: The only education these people deserve is from the school of hard knocks!
nihilism.5.b: This is a matter for university authorities.
nihilism.6.d: A woman affiliated with the [GetPopType('aristocrats').GetName] of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_ig').GetName] has angrily reported an incident of a group of students refusing to stand aside for her on the side of the road, and teasing her as she walked by.
nihilism.6.a: How far can these nihilists' depravity go?
nihilism.6.b: Hardly a matter for the legal system.
nihilism.7.d: In visiting [SCOPE.sState('courtyard_chaos_affected_state').GetName] [SCOPE.sBuilding('courtyard_chaos_affected_building').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('nihilist_scope').GetFullName] has stirred up an impressive crowd of students, and disrupted the activities of several people affiliated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('wronged_by_nihilists_ig').GetName].
nihilism.7.f: The performer on the soapbox turned their attention to several unlucky souls in the clothing of the upper class, and stretched out an arm.\n\n
nihilism.7.a: Enough with this nonsense! Break up the demonstration.
nihilism.7.b: We cannot deny it was a good show.
nihilism.8.d: A group of nihilist students has carried out an obscene and outlandish protest in front of a church, prompting demands by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] to halt these activities by force.
nihilism.8.f: The vicar, standing outside to sweep the path to the entryway of his church, could only stare in shock as the exultant students dressed as clergy untied and flung their frocks into the air. Dark cloth formed brief clouds in the air. At the sight of their bare flesh he turned his head and shielded his vision with his hands.\n\n
nihilism.8.a: Track down everyone involved, and charge them with blasphemy!
nihilism.8.b: How do they expect us to identify the perpetrators?
nihilism.9.d: In the dead of night, a group of nihilists have committed arson against a [SCOPE.sBuilding('kissed_by_fire_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('kissed_by_fire_state').GetName], leading to it being severely damaged by fire.
nihilism.9.a: The perpetrators will rebuild what they destroyed in prison.
nihilism.9.b: The classrooms will be shuttered until that building is restored.
nihilism.10.d: With the rise in discontent amongst the academia, a new, proudly [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetLeader.GetIdeology.GetName] leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] has come to the fore.
nihilism.10.b: Perhaps [SCOPE.sCharacter('nihilist_leader').GetSheHe] is simply a product of our actions.
nihilism.11.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('nihilist_scope').GetFullName] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('communist_scope').GetFullName] have found themselves in a spontaneous public argument about the merits of their respective ideologies.
nihilism.11.a: [SCOPE.sCharacter('nihilist_scope').GetFullName] comes to a victory over his opponent!
nihilism.11.c: They have potential for something larger than the sum of its parts.
nihilism.12.d: Spurred by close ties between their respective agitators, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('communist_ig').GetName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] have begun to cooperate against the influence of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName].
nihilism.12.f: They formed an odd pairing, the bright-eyed students clearly trying to ape the ragged style of the workers, and yet they seemed to complete one another. In the flickering candlelight of the basement, the shabby clothing of the nihilists almost seemed to possess an authentic nature, for here they knew they had signed a compact to suffer equally if they were caught.
nihilism.12.a: The product of zero times two is still zero.
nihilism.12.b: Surely the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('communist_ig').GetName] cannot actually be united behind this absurdity.
nihilism.13.d: The ascendant nihilist sympathisers in the government have arranged a gambit to abolish and forcefully liquidate all property of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName], and immediately enact [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
nihilism.13.a: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] will perish, for it stands against reality itself!
nihilism.13.b: This path is doomed to fail!
coup_advance_10_tt: The #bold Coup#!'s progress will #bold advance#! by #v 10#!
coup_retreat_10_tt: The #bold Coup#!'s progress will #bold retreat#! by #v 10#!
coup_advance_15_tt: The #bold Coup#!'s progress will #bold advance#! by #v 15#!
coup_retreat_15_tt: The #bold Coup#!'s progress will #bold retreat#! by #v 15#!
coup_advance_25_tt: The #bold Coup#!'s progress will #bold advance#! by #v 25#!
coup_retreat_25_tt: The #bold Coup#!'s progress will #bold retreat#! by #v 25#!
coup_advance_50_tt: The #bold Coup#!'s progress will #bold advance#! by #v 50#!
coup_retreat_50_tt: The #bold Coup#!'s progress will #bold retreat#! by #v 50#!
coup_sponsor_tt: Upon the success of the #bold Coup#!, an #bold obligation#! will be owed to [SCOPE.sCountry('coup_sponsor_country').GetName].
coup_pulse_events.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('accused_general').GetFullName], a general associated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('accused_general_ig').GetName], has been accused of grave disloyalty. [SCOPE.sCharacter('accused_general').GetFullName] claims that this is nothing but a plot by subversive elements to remove a barrier to their rule.
coup_pulse_events.1.a: We cannot take chances with the loyalties of our generals.
coup_pulse_events.2.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('conflicted_loyalty_ig').GetName], despite being closely associated with [SCOPE.sCharacter('golpista_general').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('golpista_general').GetLastName]'s [SCOPE.sParty('conflicted_loyalty_party').GetName], object to the notion of overturning the government by force.
coup_pulse_events.2.a: Claiming good intentions can sway even the purest soul.
coup_pulse_events.2.b: Their love is unnecessary. Their compliance is all that matters.
coup_pulse_events.3.d: A group representing the usual opposition forces of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('critical_support_ig').GetName], has approached the government to propose cooperation against
coup_pulse_events.3.b: We will not embolden their own plot against us.
coup_pulse_events.4.d: With concerns about national stability in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] spreading, investors affiliated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('investor_ig').GetName] have threatened to withdraw their investments from several factories in [SCOPE.sState('investor_affected_state').GetName].
coup_pulse_events.4.f:
Terror could be seen throughout the streets, spreading through the passersby like a poisonous fog. Their walks were brisk, their eyes furtive, their conversations quiet.

The man in the top hat turned to his colleague, who was still gazing out the window of the restaurant.
coup_pulse_events.4.a: Appease the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('investor_ig').GetName] by accepting an interest rates increase.
coup_pulse_events.4.b: If they were truly concerned, they would stand for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
coup_pulse_events.5.d: Figures aligned with [SCOPE.sCharacter('golpista_general').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('golpista_general').GetLastName] and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName] have approached elements of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('approached_ig').GetName], looking for support in a hypothetical plot against the government.
coup_pulse_events.5.a: A partnership could be fruitful for both parties.
coup_pulse_events.5.b: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('approached_ig').GetName] are uninterested in these plots.
coup_pulse_events.6.d: As rumors build of a plot to overthrow the sitting administration, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('pro_government_ig').GetName] has rallied support for the elected government. Demonstrators proclaiming their support for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] have filled the streets of [SCOPE.sState('protest_state').GetCityHubName].
coup_pulse_events.6.a: They have taken a position at the fore of justice.
coup_pulse_events.6.b: A riotous morass of base humanity.
coup_pulse_events.7.d: A prominent functionary and supporter of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('assassination_ig').GetName] has been shot in broad daylight, in the streets of [SCOPE.sState('assassination_state').GetCityHubName]. The local police seem uninterested in investigating any further.
coup_pulse_events.7.f: The officer standing on the corner tried not to flinch as the shot split the air, and the screams of onlookers begun to resonate across the streets. In the end, he reassured himself, the new and hefty weight in his coin purse was more than enough to make up for any of his doubts.
coup_pulse_events.7.b: We stand above a chasm, and must not fall in.
coup_pulse_events.8.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('golpista_general').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('golpista_general').GetLastName]'s allies in the diplomatic corps have offered to reach out to the [SCOPE.sCountry('coup_sponsor_country').GetAdjective] government for support in their bid for power, in return for certain future obligations.
coup_pulse_events.8.a: This arrangement is acceptable for the moment.
coup_pulse_events.8.b: When has [SCOPE.sCountry('coup_sponsor_country').GetAdjective] meddling ever gone well?
coup_pulse_events.9.d: A member of [SCOPE.sCharacter('golpista_general').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('golpista_general').GetLastName]'s staff has fallen out of the window of a [SCOPE.sBuilding('informant_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('informant_state').GetName], being severely injured on impact. He has offered the government information in exchange for his safety.
coup_pulse_events.9.f: There was a yelp, a shriek, and the sound of something heavy hitting the cobbled road. In the hastily-opened window, one could almost see a shape turn and stalk away. Where before there had been only worn-down stones, now lay a figure in a pool of spreading crimson.
coup_pulse_events.9.a: He could be an invaluable asset.
coup_pulse_events.9.b: He will not live to tell the tale.
coup_pulse_events.10.d: [SCOPE.sBuilding('barracks_theft_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('barracks_theft_state').GetName] have been reporting a large amount of mysterious losses of firearms as of late.
coup_pulse_events.10.b: This is clearly evidence of some sort of plot.
coup_pulse_events.11.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName], in light of recent unrest, have requested to carry out a series of unscheduled military exercises in [SCOPE.sState('military_exercises_state').GetName].
coup_pulse_events.11.f: The column of soldiers wound up and down the road, four shoulders wide and so long that the traveler could not see the end of it. An officer on a horse passed by, extending a baton with clear intent.\n\n
coup_pulse_events.11.a: They have no legitimate reason to be doing this.
coup_pulse_events.11.b: The security of [SCOPE.sState('military_exercises_state').GetName] is paramount, even if this is irregular.
coup_pulse_events.12.t: State Figures Invited to Religious Service
coup_pulse_events.12.d: Numerous prominent state figures have been invited to a special religious service administered by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('golpista_ig').GetName]. This invitation has come suddenly, and disrupted several figures' schedules.
coup_pulse_events.12.a: We have our own schedule, and will be adhering to it.
coup_pulse_events.12.b: There can always be time made for worship.
