notification_paris_commune_event_10_a1_d: Following the withdrawal of besieged [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetAdjective] forces from a fortified position, [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] reinforcements were able to retake the position from our troops.
notification_paris_commune_event_10_a2_d: Following the withdrawal of besieged [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetAdjective] forces from a fortified position, our forces have been able to secure another area on the border of Paris.
notification_paris_commune_automation_pu: Versailles Government Permits Retreat from Fortress

Clashes surrounding a fortified position held by [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetAdjective] forces have led to the National Guard withdrawing to fight another day. This has been interpreted as an olive branch from Versailles by reformist elements within the Commune.\n\nThe progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! has #bold increased#! by #variable 5#!.

A fortified position held by [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetAdjective] National Guardsmen has been encircled and stormed by the forces of the Versailles government. Reports of mass executions of the surrounded National Guard have already begun to enter Paris.\n\nThe progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! has #bold decreased#! by #variable 10#!.

The Central Committee of the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] has issued a decree granting employees to jointly assume ownership of their workplaces in the case of the owner's absence.\n\nThe progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! has #bold increased#! by #variable 5#!.

The Central Committee of the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] has issued a decree granting employees to jointly assume ownership of their workplaces, spurring middle-class fears over property rights and emboldening socialist elements within the Commune.\n\nThe progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! has #bold decreased#! by #variable 5#!.
The [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] has universally outlawed child labor in Paris, encouraging school for all children and empowering reformist elements in the Commune.

The [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] has universally outlawed child labor in Paris, and expanded the range of enlistment for the National Guard. This use of children in the military has emboldened elements of the [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetAdjective] military favoring immediately crushing the Commune.\n\nThe progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! has #bold increased#! by #variable 5#!.

The [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] has issued a decree banning child labor and instituting [GetLawType('law_compulsory_primary_school').GetName] for all children in Paris. This policy has spurred agitation for social reform across [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName], even as the Commune situation remains unresolved.

The [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] has issued a decree banning child labor and instituting [GetLawType('law_compulsory_primary_school').GetName] for all children in Paris. This policy has served as an inspiration for the Commune's radical social reformers.
The most militant and tyrannical forces of the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] have stormed churches along a large arrondissement, claiming hundreds of prisoners.
The [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] has ordered Parisian clergy under house arrest, to the great fortune of the less radical elements in the Commune.

Shots ring out across Paris as dozens of [GetPopType('clergymen').GetName] are ordered executed in the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName]. The elements of the Commune most radically opposed to the Church have begun their own armed hunts.

The [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] has instituted a stricter command structure for the National Guard, with [GetPopType('officers').GetName] of military experience at the helm.
Sweeping reforms across the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] have introduced workers' militias around the Parisian arrondissements.
A fresh recruitment drive in the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] has emboldened the moderate elements in the Central Committee.

Amidst claims of conflicting interests, members of the National Assembly have been formally recused from seats on the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName]'s Central Committee. It is now a true proletarian dictatorship.\n\nThe progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! has #bold decreased#! by #variable 5#!.

Despite claims of conflicting interest, members of the National Assembly have been admitted to the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName]'s Central Committee. \n\nThe progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! has #bold increased#! by #variable 5#!.

Women in the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] have been authorized to take non-combat duties with the National Guard.\n\nThe progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! has #bold increased#! by #variable 5#!.

Reports from the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] state that the National Guard have forbidden women from any kind of military service, spurring discontent among Parisian feminists.

A new decree in the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_nation_scope').GetName] has allowed women to take combat duties with the military. Entire companies have reportedly formed overnight.\n\nThe progress of the #bold Paris Commune#! has #bold increased#! by #variable 10#!.
paris_commune.5.d: Discontent in [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName] has led to the seizure of the city of Paris by revolutionaries. France is now split between two rival governments - that of Paris, and that of Versailles.
paris_commune.5.f: It was now midday, and the whole affair wore a most strange and incomprehensible aspect to one not brought up to making barricades. Instead of a government blocking every street as was the case in the morning, a hostile cannon was now looking down every street.\n\n— Anonymous #italic Times of London#! correspondent, 1871
paris_commune.5.b: [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] could use a change in government.
paris_commune.5.c: We have no interest in this.
will_improve_commune_progress_tt: The #bold Paris Commune#! will be advantaged in its struggle against [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName]
notification_foreign_country_supports_co: The government of [SCOPE.sCountry('recogniser_scope').GetName] has recognized the government of the [SCOPE.sCountry('paris_commune_scope').GetName] as the legitimate government of all of France, citing alleged failures of the Versailles Government to properly serve its people.
agitator_legal_events.1.d: Road traffic in [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName] has been halted as [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] drew a crowd into a major avenue and rambled at nauseating length about the government's proposal for [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. The blockage has prevented the legislature from reaching quorum.
agitator_legal_events.1.a: Perhaps it is time to legalize gag laws.
agitator_legal_events.2.d: Through clever use—or plain abuse—of gag motions, sympathizers of [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName]'s cause have stalled any further discussion on the motion for [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
agitator_legal_events.2.a: Perhaps it's time to discard those gag laws.
agitator_legal_events.2.b: Order a bridle from Paris, for their pleasure.
agitator_legal_events.3.d: A lengthy speech by [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] took a wild turn after consuming a tainted drink. With [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetHerHis] incapacitation, the government has lost one of its most effective advocates for [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
agitator_legal_events.3.f: A page was dispatched shortly after the speech began, and he arrived with a sandwich and the fateful drink. Everyone in the audience could see the long-winded speech became a battle to put down a revolting stomach. Indeed, had the speech stopped, the speaker's dignity would have ended with it. Had it not stopped then, people might have demanded an assassin's head.
agitator_legal_events.3.b: Scour the vicinity for any assassins, on the double!
agitator_legal_events.4.d: Difficult points raised by supporters of [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] have led to the government searching for technical experts to give their impressions on the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
agitator_legal_events.4.b: See if [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] will walk the talk.
agitator_legal_events.4.c: Find one from our finest university.
agitator_legal_events.5.d: Thunder has struck the legislators as an article published by [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] accusing a member of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('opposing_ig').GetName] of sleeping with a mistress comes to light. Conveniently, in the middle of debates for the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
agitator_legal_events.5.a: Our government must be held to the highest standards.
agitator_legal_events.6.f: It's as simple as not raising a hand, you see. Funny thing, that wave. That little, forgotten greeting on the street, or that wide sweep to get someone's attention. It's truly amazing what can be done with but a simple flick of the wrist. And in this case... how not doing one can cripple a nation.
agitator_legal_events.6.a: As is their right. They will think better soon.
agitator_legal_events.6.b: Hand their names, their offices and their staff to the papers.
agitator_legal_events.6.c: Order intermediaries to stand in their places.
agitator_legal_events.7.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('govnas').GetName]'s members have set against each other on the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law. This infighting has been blamed on a campaign of harassment by supporters of [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName].
agitator_legal_events.7.f: It was a simple matter: don't discuss this topic in the halls, any offices, or even soirees. Out of sight, out of mind, and out of each other's interests. And yet, the matter now was out and the floor was alight. Oaths and agreements now meant nothing before this contentious issue, picked out and split by another caucus.
agitator_legal_events.7.a: Find a compromise between the factions.
agitator_legal_events.7.b: Return to the matter at hand.
agitator_legal_events.7.c: Find a weak link in their ranks and pick at their seams.
agitator_legal_events.8.d: Once on the fence with the issue, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dirty_dealers').GetName]'s views on [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] changed overnight. [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dirty_dealers').GetLeader.GetFullName] names [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] as the architect of a hidden deal.
agitator_legal_events.8.f: Backroom deals were all too common. Funding for this project, contracts to friends-of-friends, a 'special advisory committee' on that endeavor: it's all the same, really. Grease the wheels of imperium so it all runs a bit smoother. Sometimes, however, one gets the idea to profit from the greased wheels, and then the public catches on. After that, nobody gets what they want.
agitator_legal_events.8.a: Send word to the presses. Tear the corruption out, stem and root.
agitator_legal_events.8.c: Corruption is a tool like any other.
agitator_legal_events.9.d: A few pointed comments from [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] have left [SCOPE.sCharacter('da_boss').GetFullName] scrambling for a simple price: a loaf of bread. The debates on [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] have since stalled.
agitator_legal_events.9.f: A portion of milled wheat determines a meal. Three of those a day, seven days a week is the crux of a wage. Give a worker their bread and their roof, plus 10%, and it's a year's living. And yet, some will tell them to eat cake... unaware that cake is made from wheat.
agitator_legal_events.9.b: Keep the issue focused on the law.
agitator_legal_events.10.d: A ploy by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('opposing_ig').GetName] backfired, with a backbencher taking the fall for a power brokering ring. Opponents of the law inspired by [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName]'s tactics have called for immediate censure, halting debate on the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
agitator_legal_events.10.a: Join the censure motion, and pass it quickly.
agitator_legal_events.10.b: Find some skeletons in the [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetInterestGroup.GetName]'s closet.
agitator_legal_events.11.d: While debates continue over the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law, a polemic by [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] has publicized a simple and catastrophic flaw in the proceedings. A redraft is underway.
agitator_legal_events.11.a: Find an acceptable compromise, whatever that looks like.
agitator_legal_events.11.b: Let them take the bait. Push another matter.
agitator_legal_events.12.d: The proposal for [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has sat in a deadlock. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('govnas').GetName] have advocated for enlisting [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName]'s assistance in rallying the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ambivalent_ig').GetName] in favor of the government.
agitator_legal_events.12.f: There, upon the cusp of a division, everyone sees that nobody has a majority yet. One by one, it dawns on them: the loose cannons, led by the most rabid dog of the bunch, have the votes they need. But who among them would be the first to climb off their ivory tower to win their favor?
agitator_legal_events.12.c: Forge ahead without them. We can win.
agitator_legal_events.13.d: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetInterestGroup.GetName] have issued a stern ultimatum to [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] about toeing the group's line on opposing [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] is determined to resist.
agitator_legal_events.13.f: The matter wedged the caucus, and it was by their own making. Meanwhile the issue at hand has given way to this fallout. Sheer stubbornness is what fuels it, with pride wagered in this gamble. Nothing will proceed without a timely resolution to this.
agitator_legal_events.13.a: Never interrupt an opponent while they make a mistake.
agitator_legal_events.13.b: We will welcome any dissidents within the [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetInterestGroup.GetName].
agitator_legal_events.14.d: Debates have raged on the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] matter for several days. [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName]'s supporters in the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('agitator_ig').GetName] have dissidents among them, but each of them has their own views regarding this law.
agitator_legal_events.14.f: A new day of debate on the same issue, and each representative could only muster a laggard shuffle back to their seats. The air was ripe with torpid vapors. This matter had to be put to rest tonight, or it would strangle the government even further.
agitator_legal_events.14.c: Let them score points on one another.
agitator_legal_events.15.d: Printers and gazettes affiliated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('govnas').GetName] have sensationalized the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law, and the public has misconstrued it since. [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] has taken advantage of the public confusion for [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetHerHis] own agenda.
agitator_legal_events.15.f: A few misunderstood words was all it took to plant the seeds. After that, a few honest mistakes for want of a thesaurus. By the end of the week, the law had changed into something else. The public now debated a matter that was barely pertinent to the regime.
agitator_legal_events.15.a: Send a correction to the printers.
agitator_legal_events.15.c: We would be remiss not to listen to our constituents.
agitator_legal_events.16.d: As the debates around the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law stall, [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] has motioned to pass the proposal to a commission of experts to break the deadlock.
agitator_legal_events.16.f: One caucus' opinion is a token. Two is a minority. Two caucuses representing the aggregated opinion of most people is still a minority. Especially when those caucuses come with a lack of life or professional experience.
agitator_legal_events.16.a: Can the treasury bear such an expense?
agitator_legal_events.16.b: Put an open callout for any experts.
agitator_legal_events.16.c: See if our universities will provide.
agitator_legal_events.17.d: Though the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law sees agreement in principle, there are two mutually exclusive clauses. [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('opposing_ig').GetName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('quarrelling_ig').GetName] want the law to favor them, while [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] chastises both of them for opportunism.
agitator_legal_events.17.f: The essence of leadership, so they say, is compromise. An interesting paradox, then, is compromise as weakness. Not compromising is as much the failing as always compromising. This, as in all things, lies in balancing the ends.
agitator_legal_events.17.a: Strike a clause. The law needs passing.
agitator_legal_events.17.b: Time for a fresh barrel of ink...
agitator_legal_events.18.d: Regardless of the governing caucus' stance, the fiercest debates on [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] come from these two: the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('opposing_ig').GetName] and populists stirred by [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName]'s movement. The end is nowhere in sight.
agitator_legal_events.18.f: Once in a blue moon, the government sees a minor issue to appease an ally or placate an enemy. Invariably, it crosses someone else's line. Some might call, 'Enemy of my enemy,' and expect an alliance of convenience. Others, often rightly, expect a velveteen fist.
agitator_legal_events.18.b: Take advantage of the populist pressure.
agitator_legal_events.19.d: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('opposing_ig').GetName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('angry_ig').GetName] are split over the semantics of a clause regarding [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] has published articles designed to drag the public into this bickering.
agitator_legal_events.19.c: Bring [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] to account for encouraging this behavior.
agitator_legal_events.20.d: A horrendous first-draft of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has every faction clamoring to ram in their desired changes. [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] has whipped up immense public discontent in favor of a rewrite.
agitator_legal_events.20.a: Stay the course, and clear up any errors.
agitator_legal_events.21.d: Though previously opposing the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] laws, [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] has considered the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('govnas').GetName]'s political position and instead offers support.
agitator_legal_events.21.b: Keep a sharp eye. They're up to something.
agitator_legal_events.22.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName]'s arguments have been publicly defeated, forcing [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetHerHim] to turn [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetHerHis] gaze to more advantageous things. A faction in the [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetInterestGroup.GetName] have thrown their weight behind the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
agitator_legal_events.22.b: Run a line to the papers, now!
agitator_legal_events.23.d: Just as the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law looked ready to topple, the [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetInterestGroup.GetName] found itself rallying with the assistance of [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName]. It now has the support it needs to pass without compromise.
agitator_legal_events.23.f: When support was called, the unlikeliest hand in the audience rose. Another hand lifted, and a third behind them. The faction with the least to gain from its passage, yet nothing to lose either way, assents. Cheers of exuberance followed howls of defeat as the law charged on ahead.
agitator_legal_events.23.b: Tally this favor. They certainly will.
agitator_legal_events.24.d: Seeking support amongst [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetHerHis] sympathizers, [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] has organized a boycott against the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law. On the day it was to begin, there was barely any sign it had been declared at all.
agitator_legal_events.24.f: Some had taken due lessons from the Third Estate: quantity was a quality of its own. If you had enough bodies to support whatever your cause was, nobody could stop you. Unfortunately for a few, there was a lesson they hadn't learnt: people needed to either like you, or like your cause.
agitator_legal_events.24.a: Inform the printers about this blunder.
agitator_legal_events.24.b: Everyone has a price for fealty.
agitator_legal_events.25.d: Seeking to discredit [SCOPE.sCharacter('da_boss').GetFullName] during a speech on [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], a heckler inspired by [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] inquired about bread prices. [SCOPE.sCharacter('da_boss').GetFullName] asked a nearby grocer.
agitator_legal_events.25.a: Shock tactics are unbecoming of this nation.
agitator_legal_events.25.b: We should peruse the law for faults.
agitator_legal_events.26.d: Whilst the government debates the merits of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], several newspapers have published polemics by [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_agitator').GetFullName] trying to invoke an obscure law against it. Lawyers affiliated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('govnas').GetName] pointed out said law is invalid.
agitator_legal_events.26.f: An example of an obscure, debatably redundant, law is that a hat must be worn while making a point of order. This law does not specify which hat to wear, only that it be worn and the point of order made. Thus, it would be very good form to wear a dunce cap when making an invalid point of order.
agitator_legal_events.27.d: In an obscure meeting, [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] and a proxy of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('cavalry_ig').GetName] rambled at length about the positives of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. One was cognizant enough to take minutes.
agitator_legal_events.27.a: Commend them for their good work.
agitator_legal_events.27.b: Matters of governance are for government, not dens of sin.
agitator_legal_events.28.t: A Clause Is Coming to Town
agitator_legal_events.28.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('opposing_ig').GetName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('angry_ig').GetName] are jockeying for minor but favoring concessions regarding [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. Supporters of [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] are calling for a resolution without concessions.
agitator_legal_events.28.f: A pair of bickering children: the bane of swift and firm decision-making since time immemorial. Regardless of age or pretense of education, the beats rhyme every time. Two groups want something, and will make it someone else's problem until they get it. The problem then is which baby to hand the bottle to.
agitator_legal_events.28.b: Throw one a bone if it will silence them.
agitator_legal_events.29.d: In [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName]'s body of published works is a popular, new book with a vision of what [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] might look like. Lawyers affiliated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('govnas').GetName] say the contents are legally sound.
agitator_legal_events.29.f: Most of the time, fiction is merely that: something to pass the time. Sometimes, a true vision of possibility creeps through. Once in a blue moon, well-written fiction can change how people think. Every so often from there, however, it might be mistaken for divination.
agitator_legal_events.29.a: Canvass the public about this light reading.
agitator_legal_events.29.b: Procure a copy, with our compliments to the author.
agitator_legal_events.30.d: [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] was on everyone's lips in every coffeehouse. Afterwards, [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetFullName] was ready to cross the [SCOPE.sCharacter('supporting_agitator').GetInterestGroup.GetName] to help pass the law.
agitator_legal_events.30.f: Wise counsel advises against conflating the voice of the people with the voice of God. Wiser counsel calls the voice of the people mad. The wisest counsel understands that genius and madness are two sides of the same coin. It's a matter of knowing when to listen.

ai_regional_objective_recover_claims_des: This [concept_country] wishes to recover its [Concept('concept_claim', '$concept_claims$')] in the [Concept('concept_strategic_region', '$concept_strategic_region_short$')].
ai_regional_objective_subjugate_country_: This [concept_country] is looking to subjugate and [Concept('concept_vassal', '$concept_vassalize$')] a [concept_local_country] in the [Concept('concept_strategic_region', '$concept_strategic_region_short$')].
ai_regional_objective_befriend_countries: This [concept_country] wants to improve its standing and [concept_relations] with of the [Concept('concept_local_country', '$concept_local_countries$')] in the [Concept('concept_strategic_region', '$concept_strategic_region_short$')].
ai_regional_objective_protect_country_de: This [concept_country] is aiming to defend a [concept_local_country] from a threatening [Concept('concept_rivalry', '$concept_rival$')].
ai_strategy_conservative_agenda_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] has a cautious conservative political agenda, promoting a slow reform pace.
ai_strategy_reactionary_agenda_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to promote the power and reform agenda of the landed gentry and the clergy.
ai_strategy_progressive_agenda_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to promote the power and reform agenda of the intellectuals and industrial magnates.
ai_strategy_egalitarian_agenda_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to promote the power and reform agenda of populists and the labor movement.
ai_strategy_nationalist_agenda_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to promote the power and reform agenda of nationalists and the military.
ai_strategy_agricultural_expansion_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to expand their agricultural base and become a net exporter of food.
ai_strategy_placate_population_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to maintain stability by keeping taxes low and ensuring there's plenty of food for the people.
ai_strategy_plantation_economy_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to focus on the production and export of cash crops.
ai_strategy_resource_expansion_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to invest into the extraction of natural resources.
ai_strategy_industrial_expansion_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to build up its urban industrial base.
ai_strategy_montenegro_admin_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to keep its small territory supplied with essential goods.
ai_strategy_infrastructure_expansion_des: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to improve its national infrastructure.
ai_strategy_territorial_expansion_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to expand its core territories at the expense of its neighbors.
ai_strategy_colonial_expansion_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to acquire colonies and a place in the sun through any means necessary.
ai_strategy_maintain_power_balance_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to cautiously grow its own power while ensuring that none of its rivals become too strong.
ai_strategy_armed_isolationism_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to keep the world at bay through armed isolationism.
ai_strategy_maintain_mandate_of_heaven_d: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to maintain their rule by preserving the Mandate of Heaven.
ai_strategy_economic_imperialism_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to expand their [concept_market] and open up isolated [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')].
ai_strategy_unify_germany_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to unite the German nations under their banner.
ai_strategy_unify_italy_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to unite the Italian nations under their banner.
ai_strategy_unify_ethiopia_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to unite the Ethiopian princes under their banner.
ai_strategy_unify_china_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to unite the Chinese warlords under their banner.
ai_strategy_unify_south_africa_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to bring all the lands of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_south_africa').GetName] under its control.
ai_strategy_colonial_extraction_desc: As a colonial nation, [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to extract and export raw resources at the behest of their colonial overlord.
ai_strategy_socialism_in_one_country_des: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to keep capitalist powers at bay whilst it develops a mature socialist economy.
ai_strategy_world_revolution_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to spread socialist revolution across the world, converting other nations to their cause.
ai_strategy_anti_imperialism_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to support unrecognized states and contain the expansion of imperial powers.
ai_strategy_restore_natural_borders_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to expand its core territories and achieve its
ai_strategy_subject_break_free_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to become independent from their [concept_overlord]
ai_strategy_subject_strengthen_self_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to increase their [concept_autonomy] and become less dependent on their [concept_overlord]
ai_strategy_subject_maintain_autonomy_de: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants to maintain their [concept_autonomy] and relationship with their [concept_overlord] just as it is
ai_strategy_subject_overlord_compliance_: [COUNTRY.GetName] wants closer integration with their [concept_overlord] and to loyally comply with their wishes
ai_strategy_tanzimat_reforms_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to make radical but necessary reforms to their nation
ai_strategy_meiji_restoration_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to modernize and become equal in strength to the Western Powers
ai_strategy_great_reforms_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] seeks to make radical but necessary reforms to their nation
ai_attitude_human_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] is controlled by a human player, and their attitude towards [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] is entirely up to them.
ai_attitude_disinterested_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as a #bold country of little interest#! in geopolitical affairs. They are unlikely to engage in any form of diplomatic interaction with us.
ai_attitude_cautious_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as an #bold unknown factor#! in geopolitical affairs. They consider [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] relevant to their interests but has not yet decided whether they see them as a friend or enemy.
ai_attitude_cooperative_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as a #P #bold potential friend#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They may seek closer [concept_relations] with [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] and are likely to be receptive to diplomatic overtures.
ai_attitude_conciliatory_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as a #P #bold mistaken enemy#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They are likely to try and patch up [concept_relations] and end any ongoing [concept_rivalry].
ai_attitude_genial_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as a #P #bold desirable ally#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They are likely to seek closer [concept_relations] and want to form a [concept_defensive_pact] or [concept_alliance] with us.
ai_attitude_loyal_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as their #P #bold just suzerain#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They are likely to acquiesce to demands for decreased [concept_autonomy] and might even agree to be annexed by their [concept_overlord].
ai_attitude_protective_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as #P #bold in need of their protection#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They are likely to intervene on our side in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] and may offer [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] to become their [concept_subject].
ai_attitude_wary_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as a #N #bold potential threat#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They will be less receptive to diplomacy and might seek out alliances to protect themselves against us.
ai_attitude_antagonistic_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as a #N #bold threatening force#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They are likely to seek closer relations with their foes and may join [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] to oppose their expansion.
ai_attitude_belligerent_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as a #N #bold target of conquest#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They are likely to start a [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] against [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] if they feel that the odds are in their favor.
ai_attitude_domineering_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as a #N #bold natural subject#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They are likely to try and make a [concept_subject] out of us, or further integrate [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] if we are already their [concept_subject].
ai_attitude_rebellious_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as their #N #bold tyrannical oppressor#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They are likely to attempt a [concept_diplomatic_play] for independence if they believe they can win.
ai_attitude_defiant_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as their #N #bold overbearing suzerain#!#! in geopolitical affairs. They will attempt to strengthen themselves and gain greater autonomy, but will not seek full independence.
ai_attitude_aloof_desc: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as their #bold de jure suzerain#! in geopolitical affairs, but are content with the status quo. They are unlikely to actively seek increased autonomy, but equally unlikely to agree to demands for further integration.
AI_REASON_THREATENING_NEIGHBOR: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as a militarily threatening neighbor
AI_REASON_PROTECTOR: [COUNTRY.GetName] views [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] as a potential protector against [COUNTRY_THIRD_PARTY.GetName]
AI_REASON_WAR_ALLY: [COUNTRY.GetName] is on the same side in a conflict as [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName]
alert_country_default_desc:
[GetPlayer.GetName] is in [concept_default] due to not being able to pay back our loans. Until we are able to reach a positive balance, we will suffer penalties that grow increasingly harsh as time passes.

#title Current Effects:#!
[GetPlayer.GetInDefaultEffectsDesc]
alert_country_default_hint: You can improve your financial situation by increasing your income or decreasing your expenses. For increasing your income, in the short term you can raise the current tax rate, levy new consumption taxes, or increase tariffs to generate new revenue. For decreasing your expenses you can look towards reducing the wages of either your Military or Government run buildings, decreasing the prices of the goods they consume, or pausing construction until your finances recover. If none of these is enough, you also have the option to declare [concept_bankruptcy]
alert_low_war_support_effects_alert_desc:
The [concept_war_support] for [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetWar.GetName] has dropped below #n [GetDefine('NDiplomacy','WAR_SUPPORT_RADICALIZATION_THRESHOLD')]%#!

This has the following effects:
[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetWar.GetLowWarSupportEffectsDesc(GetPlayer.Self)]
Military penalties are only applied in $concept_battles$ for this specific $concept_war$
alert_low_war_support_effects_alert_hint: Win [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')] and capture [Concept('concept_war_goal', '$concept_war_goals$')] to recover [concept_war_support] or try to bring the [concept_war] to an end.
alert_has_no_research_alert_desc: We are currently not actively focusing our research on any [concept_technology]. As such, any [concept_innovation] we are generating will be put towards our passive [concept_technology_spread].
alert_has_no_research_alert_hint: You set which Technology to research in one of the three Technology trees in the Technology Panel.
alert_formable_possible_desc: We can form the new nation of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountryFormation.GetName|v].
alert_formable_possible_hint: You can form a new nation in the Diplomacy Panel
alert_can_establish_company_desc: We have only established [GetPlayer.GetNumCompanies|v]/#tooltippable #tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],TOOLTIP_MAX_COMPANIES [GetPlayer.GetMaxNumCompanies|v]#!#! $COMPANIES$ we are able to support.
alert_can_establish_company_hint: You can establish a new [concept_company] in the Companies Panel
alert_free_government_reform_desc: [LabelingHelper.GetDaysLocWithTooltip( SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRemainingDaysForFreeGovernmentReformRaw, 'FREE_REFORM_DATE_TOOLTIP')] remaining.\n\nDue to the recent [concept_election] your next [concept_government_reform] will not result in any new [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')], as long as it is done within the above time limit.
alert_free_government_reform_hint: You can Reform your Government on the Politics Panel
alert_revolution_alert_desc: A [Concept('concept_revolution', '$concept_revolutionary$')] [concept_diplomatic_play] has started and our [concept_country] is about to be in a state of [concept_civil_war].
alert_revolution_alert_hint: You can pick which side of the conflict you support in the $concept_civil_war$ and begin [Concept('concept_sway','$concept_swaying$')] other nations (if needed) to see your side to success.
alert_can_abdicate_alert_desc: Our [concept_ruler] is capable of #bold abdicating#! to placate the brewing [concept_insurrection] in our [concept_country]
alert_can_abdicate_alert_hint: You can use the #bold Character Interactions#! menu to #bold abdicate#! your [concept_ruler], and placate the [concept_insurrection] brewing in your [concept_country]
alert_can_resign_alert_desc: Our [concept_ruler] is capable of #bold resigning#! to placate the brewing [concept_insurrection] in our [concept_country]
alert_can_resign_alert_hint: You can use the #bold Character Interactions#! menu to #bold resign#! your [concept_ruler], and placate the [concept_insurrection] brewing in your [concept_country]
alert_secession_alert_desc: A [Concept('concept_secession', '$concept_secessionist$')] [concept_diplomatic_play] has started and our [concept_country] is in a state of [concept_civil_war]!
alert_secession_alert_hint: You can begin [Concept('concept_sway','$concept_swaying$')] other nations (if needed) to see your side to success.
alert_is_losing_rank_alert_desc: We have insufficient [concept_prestige] to maintain our [GetPlayer.GetRank|v] ranking and will become a [GetPlayer.GetTargetRank|v] in [GetPlayer.GetDaysUntilRankLoss|v] day(s) unless our standing recovers.\n\nWe need #P #b [GetPlayer.GetPrestigeToMaintainRank]#!#! [concept_prestige] to maintain our standing and currently have #b #N [GetPlayer.GetPrestige]#!#!.
alert_is_losing_rank_alert_hint: You can gain more [concept_prestige] by increasing the [concept_gdp] of your nation, increasing the [concept_power_projection] of your army and navy (by increasing their size or giving them more powerful equipment) or by being the leading producer of a [concept_good]. You also gain a proportion of your [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subject_possessive$')] $concept_prestige$ in this way.
alert_has_no_war_goal_alert_desc: We currently do not have any [Concept('concept_war_goal', '$concept_war_goals$')] set in one of our [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')].
alert_has_no_war_goal_alert_hint: You can add a $concept_war_goal$ on a participating member of the $concept_diplomatic_play$ in its overview screen. You can expand your $concept_war_goal$ targets as more participants join a side in the $concept_diplomatic_play$, but that will be at the cost of [Concept('concept_maneuver', '$concept_maneuvers$')] you can spend to tempt other participants to join your side.
alert_vulnerable_front_desc: We have no [Concept('concept_general', '$concept_generals$')] nor [Concept('concept_battalion', '$concept_battalions$')] defending [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetFront.GetName] and there is at least one enemy $concept_general$ assigned to it.
alert_vulnerable_front_hint: You can recruit [Concept('concept_general', '$concept_generals$')] or give them orders in the Military Panel.
alert_invasion_desc: You are currently being [Concept('concept_invasion','$concept_invaded$')] by [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetInvasion.GetInvaderCountry.GetName] in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetInvasion.GetTargetState.GetName].
alert_invasion_hint: You can send [Concept('concept_army','$concept_armies$')] to [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetInvasion.GetFront.GetName] to defend [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetInvasion.GetTargetState.GetName].
alert_naval_invasion_desc: You are currently being [Concept('concept_naval_invasion','$concept_naval_invaded$')] by [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetInvasion.GetInvaderCountry.GetName] in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetInvasion.GetTargetState.GetName].
alert_naval_invasion_hint: You can send additional [Concept('concept_fleet','$concept_fleets$')] to #v [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetInvasion.GetSeaNodeName]#! and sink enemy $concept_fleets$, and/or send [Concept('concept_mobilize_army','$concept_mobilize_army_mobilized$')] [Concept('concept_army','$concept_armies$')] to defend [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetInvasion.GetTargetState.GetName].
alert_stalled_invasion_desc: Your [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetInvasion.GetName] will be unable to progress because no invading [concept_general] has [Concept('concept_order','$concept_orders$')] that allows them to start a [concept_battle].
alert_stalled_invasion_hint: You can change the $concept_orders$ of your $concept_generals$ to ones that allow them to start battles, such as [GetCommanderOrderType('advance').GetName].
alert_stalled_naval_invasion_desc: Your [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetInvasion.GetName] will be unable to progress to landing troops because no invading [concept_general] has [Concept('concept_order','$concept_orders$')] that allows them to start a [concept_battle].
alert_stalled_naval_invasion_hint: You can change the $concept_orders$ of your $concept_generals$ to Advance, allowing them to start battles.
alert_low_organization_active_desc: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMilitaryFormation.GetName] has an [concept_organization] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMilitaryFormation.GetOrganization] which imposes heavy penalties.
alert_low_organization_active_hint: You can increase the [concept_organization] of a [concept_military_formation] by ensuring it has adequate [concept_command_limit] for all its [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')]. While a $concept_military_formation$ with sufficient $concept_command_limit$ is stationary it will regain $concept_organization$ over time. Toggling [Concept('concept_mobilization_option','$concept_mobilization_options$')] while the $concept_military_formation$ is in the field can lead to a temporary loss of $concept_organization$.
alert_low_organization_idle_desc: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMilitaryFormation.GetName] has an [concept_organization] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMilitaryFormation.GetOrganization] which imposes heavy penalties.
alert_low_organization_idle_hint: You can increase the [concept_organization] of a [concept_military_formation] by ensuring it has adequate [concept_command_limit] for all its [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')]. While a $concept_military_formation$ with sufficient $concept_command_limit$ is stationary it will regain $concept_organization$ over time. Toggling [Concept('concept_mobilization_option','$concept_mobilization_options$')] while the $concept_military_formation$ is in the field can lead to a temporary loss of $concept_organization$.
alert_high_attrition_alert_desc: Units of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMilitaryFormation.GetName] have a high risk of casualties due to attrition
alert_high_attrition_alert_hint: Reduce [concept_attrition] by giving a different order to a [concept_commander] or returning them from the [concept_front]
alert_naval_mission_invalid_area_alert_d: The naval mission area for [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMilitaryFormation.GetName] is no longer valid. The fleet will not be able to carry out the mission.
alert_naval_mission_invalid_area_alert_h: Review the fleet's assigned mission area and remove any unreachable or disconnected sea regions.
alert_invalid_naval_mission_grace_period: The naval mission for [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMilitaryFormation.GetName] [SelectLocalization(SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMilitaryFormation.HasNavalMission, 'is no longer valid', 'no longer exists')]. The fleet will return to port shortly.

[SelectLocalization(SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMilitaryFormation.HasNavalMission, 'Fix the issues with the naval mission', 'Assign a new naval mission to the fleet')] before the grace period expires to prevent the fleet from returning to port.
alert_ship_outside_max_port_distance_ale: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMilitaryFormation.GetName] has ships that are beyond their maximum distance from a friendly port, causing potential operational issues.
Move the fleet closer to a friendly port, or remove the affected ships from the fleet.
alert_active_peace_deal_alert_desc: There is a proposed peace deal in a [concept_war] you are part of and it will be #b Rejected#! or #b Accepted#! depending on the responses of all negotiating participants.\n[GetPlayer.GetActivePeaceDealDesc]
alert_active_peace_deal_alert_hint: If you are a negotiating partner of the $concept_war$ you can signal your favor with the peace deal to end the $concept_war$ or continue the conflict towards another round of negotiations.
ALERT_PEACE_PROPOSED_ENTRY: [WAR.GetName|b] - [WAR.GetDaysUntilPeaceDealFails|v] day(s) until peace deal is rejected
alert_insufficient_construction_for_inve: We do not produce enough [concept_construction] to fully utilize the funds that are coming into the [concept_investment_pool].

You can construct additional [GetBuildingType('building_construction_sector').GetName] [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')] or switch to more advanced [Concept('concept_production_method','$concept_production_methods$')] to produce more [concept_construction].
alert_naval_hostilities_alert_desc:
We are in a state of [concept_naval_hostilities] with another [concept_country] without being at [concept_war] with them. While this is ongoing, our [Concept('concept_fleet','$concept_fleets$')] will be able to carry out hostile actions (such as [Concept('concept_blockade','$concept_blockades$')]) against each other.

$concept_naval_hostilities$ with:
[GetPlayer.GetNavalHostilitiesCountriesDesc]
alert_naval_hostilities_alert_hint: [concept_naval_hostilities] are usually a temporary affair and will end on their own.
alert_insufficient_military_maintenance_: Increase [Concept('concept_ship_construction', '$concept_ship_construction$')] by building more [GetBuildingType('building_shipyard').GetName], reduce [Concept('concept_fleet', '$concept_fleet$')] size to lower maintenance costs, or change the distribution of [Concept('concept_supply_ship', '$concept_supply_ship$')] construction points to allocate more to military.
alert_insufficient_ship_crew_alert_hint: A $concept_ship$ in a port takes on more $concept_ship_crew_short$ every week. If it is not gaining any, we may be short of available [Concept('concept_sailor', '$concept_sailors$')].
alert_insufficient_sailors_alert_hint: You can increase the number of available $concept_sailors$ by constructing more [GetBuildingType('building_naval_administration').GetName] [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')], or by expanding existing ones.
alert_insufficient_supply_maintenance_al: Increase [Concept('concept_ship_construction', '$concept_ship_construction$')] by [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_building$')] more [GetBuildingType('building_shipyard').GetName], reduce the number of $concept_supply_ships$, or change the distribution of $concept_supply_ship$ construction points to allocate more to supply.
alert_unreachable_ship_construction_flee: Our newly built $concept_ships$ will be unable to reach their target $concept_fleets$, leaving them stranded at the [GetBuildingType('building_shipyard').GetName] where they are built:#indent_newline:3 [GetPlayer.GetUnreachableConstructionFleetsDesc]#!
Build a [GetBuildingType('building_shipyard').GetName] closer to the target [Concept('concept_fleet', '$concept_fleet$')], or secure passage through the straits blocking the route.
alert_port_bombardment_alert_desc: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetName] is being bombarded by a hostile [concept_fleet]. $port_bombardment$ generates [concept_devastation] and may destroy [Concept('concept_coastal_building', '$concept_coastal_buildings$')].
alert_port_bombardment_alert_hint: You can stop the $port_bombardment$ by sending a [concept_fleet] on an [GetNavalMissionType('naval_mission_type_intercept').GetName] [Concept('concept_naval_mission','$concept_naval_mission_short$')] to the relevant [concept_sea_node] to engage and defeat the hostile fleet(s), or mitigate the effects by building Naval Fortifications in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetName] to increase bombardment resistance.
alert_blockaded_state_alert_hint: You can break the $concept_blockade$ by sending a [concept_fleet] on an [GetNavalMissionType('naval_mission_type_intercept').GetName] [Concept('concept_naval_mission','$concept_naval_mission_short$')] to the relevant [concept_sea_node], if it is capable of besting the hostile fleet(s) in battle
alert_isolated_state_alert_desc: An [Concept('concept_isolated_state', '$concept_isolated_state_short$')] is unable to buy and sell goods from the larger market. [Concept('concept_pop_needs','$concept_pops$')] will have to source their needs from the local supply within the state and this may have a significant effect on a Pop's [concept_sol] due to the resulting price changes.
alert_isolated_state_alert_hint: You can connect [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetName] to the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetMarket.GetName] by increasing [concept_infrastructure], which can be done by building Buildings that provide [concept_infrastructure] like Ports or Railroads, or by using the #v $decree_road_maintenance$#! [concept_decree].
alert_state_in_turmoil_alert_desc: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetName] is in a state of [concept_turmoil] due to the presence of $RADICALS$
alert_state_in_turmoil_alert_hint: You can reduce your number of $RADICALS$ by ensuring the needs of your [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] are met. Ensuring your $concept_pops$ have jobs and can afford their [concept_expected_sol] is the main method of achieving this. Though, $concept_pop$ groups that have low [concept_acceptance] or have unfulfilled [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')] will also increase in [concept_activism] and [Concept('concept_political_movement_support', '$concept_political_movement_support_short$')].\n\nTo alleviate these issues in the short term, you can consider issuing [Concept('concept_decree', '$concept_decrees$')] like [GetDecreeType('decree_emergency_relief').GetName] or [GetDecreeType('decree_violent_suppression').GetName] in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetName] specifically while you work towards long term solutions.
alert_high_tension_alert_desc: [Concept('concept_tension', '$concept_tensions$')] are increasing due to our [Concept('concept_colony', '$concept_colonies$')] encroaching upon [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticRelations.GetSecondCountry.GetName]’s territory. If this $concept_tension$ continues it might spark a [concept_native_uprising].
alert_high_tension_alert_hint: $concept_tensions$ dissipate overtime, you can halt your $concept_colonial$ expansion temporarily to not provoke the [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_population$')] further and reduce the chance of a $concept_native_uprising$ or you can seek to station your [Concept('concept_army','$concept_armies$')] in the [concept_hq] of the $concept_colonial$ [concept_strategic_region] to prepare for the revolt.
alert_secession_growing_alert_desc: A [concept_political_movement] is attempting to secede from [GetPlayer.GetNameNoFlag]
alert_secession_growing_alert_hint: You can alleviate the risk of a $concept_secession$ by decreasing the [Concept('concept_activism', '$concept_activism_short$')] and/or [concept_political_movement_support] of the secessionist [concept_political_movement].
alert_diplomatic_pact_in_danger_desc: Will break if the following conditions are no longer true:\n$TAB$[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetAboutToBreakReasonDesc]
alert_diplomatic_pact_in_danger_hint: If this diplomatic pact is important to the functioning of your nation, consider improving relations with the other country or changing diplomatic course from whatever actions are endangering it.
alert_treaty_article_in_danger_desc: Will break if the following conditions are no longer true:\n$TAB$[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetTreatyArticle.GetAboutToBreakReasonDesc]
alert_treaty_article_in_danger_hint: If this article is important to the functioning of your nation, consider improving relations with the other country or changing diplomatic course from whatever actions are endangering it.
alert_obligation_expiring_desc: The [concept_obligation] owed to us by [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticRelations.GetCountryWhichOwesObligation.GetName] will expire in #v [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticRelations.CalcOwedObligationDaysLeft(GetPlayer.Self)]#! day(s).
alert_obligation_expiring_hint: You should make use of the [concept_obligation] before it expires by either using it to improve relations with [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticRelations.GetCountryWhichOwesObligation.GetName] or tie them into a Diplomatic Agreement or Play.
alert_overlord_can_decrease_subject_auto: It is possible to [GetDiplomaticActionType('da_decrease_autonomy').GetName] of our [concept_subject] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName].
You can use the Subjects tab in the Diplomacy Panel to perform a [GetDiplomaticActionType('da_decrease_autonomy').GetName] [concept_diplomatic_action].
alert_subject_likely_to_increase_autonom: You can use the Subjects tab in the Diplomacy Panel to perform a [concept_diplomatic_action] that affects their [concept_liberty_desire].
alert_subject_can_increase_autonomy_hint: You can use the the Diplomacy Panel to perform an [GetDiplomaticActionType('da_increase_autonomy_of_self').GetName] [concept_diplomatic_action].
alert_has_low_liberty_desire_hint: You can use the Diplomacy Panel to see which [Concept('concept_subject_action','$concept_subject_actions$')] are available in order to increase our [concept_liberty_desire].
alert_above_company_limit_desc: You have more $concept_companies$ than your limit permits. This causes all your $concept_companies$ to suffer heavy penalties to the [concept_throughput] they provide.
alert_above_company_limit_hint: You can disband a $concept_company$ from the Company Panel to get below the allowed limit again. Alternatively you can keep it and live with the penalties or research a technology that increases the limit.
HAS_CONVOYS_BEING_SUNK_HEADER: Our [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName] are being sunk by hostile [Concept('concept_admiral', '$concept_admirals$')]. We believe the attacks are happening in at least one of these Sea Zones:
alert_unhealthy_economy_alert_hint: You can improve your financial situation by increasing your income or decreasing your expenses. For increasing your income, in the short term you can raise the current tax rate, levy new consumption taxes, or increase tariffs to generate new revenue. For decreasing your expenses you can look towards reducing the wages of either your Military or Government run buildings, decreasing the prices of the goods they consume, or pausing construction until your finances recover.
alert_stockpiling_gold_alert_desc: Your [concept_treasury] is stockpiling [GetGoods('gold').GetNameNoFormatting] beyond its capacity.
alert_stockpiling_gold_alert_hint: Increase your expenditures or reduce your income to balance your budget better. Stockpiling [GetGoods('gold').GetNameNoFormatting] extracts @money![concept_money] from your economy and [concept_pop] at diminishing returns, leading to reductions in [concept_wealth] over time.
alert_low_legitimacy_alert_hint: Increase your $concept_legitimacy$ by adding or removing [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] from your $concept_government$. This can be done on the Politics Panel or on the details of an $concept_interest_group$. You can also change your [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')], which can be done from the Constitutional Laws tab in the Politics Panel.
alert_legitimacy_level_illegitimate_aler: Your [concept_government] has [GetPlayer.GetGovernmentLegitimacy|v] [concept_legitimacy], which makes it an [GetPlayer.GetGovernmentLegitimacyLevel.GetName]. This is having a severe effect on the [Concept('concept_radical', '$concept_radicalization$')] of your [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] and prevents you from enacting [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')].
alert_legitimacy_level_unacceptable_aler: Your [concept_government] has [GetPlayer.GetGovernmentLegitimacy|v] [concept_legitimacy], which makes it an [GetPlayer.GetGovernmentLegitimacyLevel.GetName]. This is having an effect on the [Concept('concept_radical', '$concept_radicalization$')] of your [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')].
alert_legitimacy_level_contested_alert_d: Your [concept_government] has [GetPlayer.GetGovernmentLegitimacy|v] [concept_legitimacy], which makes it a [GetPlayer.GetGovernmentLegitimacyLevel.GetName].
alert_market_goods_shortage_desc: There are #tooltippable #tooltip:[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetTooltipTag],alert_market_goods_shortage_affected_buildings_breakdown [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetNumBuildingsAffectedByShortage|v]#!#! buildings affected by this shortage.
alert_market_goods_shortage_hint: You can resolve the shortages by increasing the number of [concept_sell_orders] for [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetGoods.GetName] in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetMarket.GetName]. This can be done by either producing more [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetGoods.GetName], improving [concept_infrastructure] in [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] with low [concept_market_access] producing it[SelectLocalization(SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetGoods.IsTradeable, 'alert_market_goods_shortage_hint_tradable', '.')]
alert_market_goods_shortage_hint_tradabl: or increasing your trade capacity to acquire it from the [concept_world_market].
alert_market_goods_shortage_hint_data_ve: @information! There are #tooltippable #tooltip:[Goods.GetTooltipTag],alert_market_goods_shortage_affected_buildings_breakdown_data_version [Goods.GetNumBuildingsAffectedByShortageInMarket|v]#!#! buildings affected by this shortage.\n\nYou can resolve the shortages by increasing the number of [concept_sell_orders] for [Goods.GetName] in [Goods.GetMarket.GetName]. This can be done by either producing more [Goods.GetName], improving [concept_infrastructure] in [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')]  with low [concept_market_access] producing it, or increasing Trade Capacity to acquire it from the [concept_world_market].
alert_state_goods_shortage_desc: There are #tooltippable #tooltip:[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetStateGoods.GetTooltipTag],STATE_GOODS_BUILDING_SHORTAGE_BREAKDOWN [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetStateGoods.GetNumBuildingsAffectedByShortage|v]#!#! buildings affected by this shortage.
alert_state_goods_shortage_hint: You can resolve the shortages by increasing the amount of [concept_good_production] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetStateGoods.GetGoods.GetName] in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetStateGoods.GetState.GetName] or the number of [concept_sell_orders] for [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetStateGoods.GetGoods.GetName] in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetStateGoods.GetState.GetMarket.GetName]. It may also be resolved by increasing the [concept_market_access] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetStateGoods.GetState.GetName] if it is below #v 100%#!.
alert_market_goods_shortage_alert_desc: There are #tooltippable #tooltip:[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetTooltipTag],alert_market_goods_shortage_affected_buildings_breakdown [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetNumBuildingsAffectedByShortage|v]#!#! buildings affected by this shortage.
alert_market_goods_shortage_alert_hint: You can resolve the shortages by increasing the number of [concept_sell_orders] for [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetGoods.GetName] in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetMarket.GetName]. This can be done by either producing more [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetGoods.GetName], improving [concept_infrastructure] in [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] with low [concept_market_access] producing it, or increasing Trade Capacity to acquire it from the [concept_world_market].
alert_market_goods_shortage_alert_hint_d: There are #tooltippable #tooltip:[Goods.GetTooltipTag],alert_market_goods_shortage_affected_buildings_breakdown_data_version [Goods.GetNumBuildingsAffectedByShortageInMarket|v]#!#! buildings affected by this shortage.\n\n@information! You can resolve the shortages by increasing the number of [concept_sell_orders] for [Goods.GetName] in [Goods.GetMarket.GetName]. This can be done by either producing more [Goods.GetName], improving [concept_infrastructure] in [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] with low [concept_market_access] producing it, or increasing Trade Capacity to acquire it from the [concept_world_market].
alert_merchant_marine_shortage_alert_des: Your [Concept('concept_shipping_lane', '$concept_shipping_lanes$')] are #negative_value -[GetPlayer.GetMerchantMarineShortage|%0]#! less effective due to the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetGoods.GetName] shortage.\n\nThere are #tooltippable #tooltip:[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetTooltipTag],alert_market_goods_shortage_affected_buildings_breakdown [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetNumBuildingsAffectedByShortage|v]#!#! buildings affected by this shortage.
alert_merchant_marine_shortage_alert_hin: You can resolve the shortage by increasing the number of [concept_sell_orders] for [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetGoods.GetName] in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetMarket.GetName]. This can be done by either producing more [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetMarketGoods.GetGoods.GetName], improving [concept_infrastructure] in [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] with low [concept_market_access] producing it, or increasing Trade Capacity to acquire it from the [concept_world_market].
alert_famine_alert_hint:
You can improve the [concept_food_security] of the [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] living in the affected [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] by increasing the supply of [GetPopNeed('popneed_basic_food').GetName] [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')]. This can be done either by constructing [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] that produce any of the $concept_goods$ that fulfill the [GetPopNeed('popneed_basic_food').GetName] [Concept('concept_pop_needs','$concept_pop_need$')] or by [Concept('concept_trade','$concept_importing$')] it.

A low [concept_market_access] may also affect the access to [GetPopNeed('popneed_basic_food').GetName] $concept_goods$.

$concept_buildings$ and $concept_imports$ might take a while to come in full effect. The [GetDecreeType('decree_emergency_relief').GetName] [concept_decree] may work as a quicker, although temporary, solution.
alert_low_market_access_alert_hint: You can improve the [concept_market_access] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetName] by either increasing its [concept_infrastructure] (which can be done by building [GetBuildingType('building_port').GetName] or [GetBuildingType('building_railway').GetName]), by [Concept('concept_decree', '$concept_decrees$')] like [GetDecreeType('decree_road_maintenance').GetName], or ensuring that there is enough [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName] on the [concept_market] to connect [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetName] to its [concept_market_capital] overseas.
alert_insufficient_tax_capacity_alert_de: Your state's local government does not have the ability to manage the taxation policy you have set for your country, because of this they are pulling in less taxes from your pops then expected.
alert_insufficient_tax_capacity_alert_hi: You can improve the [concept_tax_capacity] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetName] by building [GetBuildingType('building_government_administration').GetName] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] in the [concept_state]. You can also further utilize production methods to increase the local taxation capacity created by these buildings.\n\n Nationwide you can look to changing your laws and research new technology to modernize your bureaucratic apparatus and increase its innate taxation capacity.
alert_expensive_goods_alert_hint_common: You can influence the price of a [concept_good] in several ways. For instance, you can increase the availability of the good by upping its production through Buildings or Production methods, or Trade for it from another nation. You can ensure that its not effected by any input shortage or high cost of materials if its an end product good. You can also alter your tariff policy or consumption taxes on its (or its composite goods to hopefully reduce the price).
alert_isolated_colony_alert_desc: An [Concept('concept_isolated_state', '$concept_isolated_state_short$')] is unable to buy and sell goods from the larger market. [Concept('concept_pop_needs','$concept_pops$')] will have to source their needs from the local supply within the state and this may have a significant effect on a Pop's [concept_sol] due to the resulting price changes.
alert_isolated_colony_alert_hint: You can connect [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetName] to the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetState.GetMarket.GetName] by building a [GetBuildingType('building_port').GetName].
alert_power_struggle_leader_hint: Increase your [concept_prestige] and make sure [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetPowerBloc.GetPowerStruggleContender.GetName] has less than a #v [Subtract_CFixedPoint(GetDefine('NPowerBlocs','POWER_STRUGGLE_PRESTIGE_THRESHOLD_FAIL'), '(CFixedPoint)1')|0%]#! $concept_prestige$ advantage over you.

alert_power_bloc_invite_available_desc: As the [Concept('concept_power_bloc_leader','$concept_power_bloc_leader_short$')] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetPowerBloc.GetName], you may invite a [concept_country] to join.

ag_insurrectionary_alerts_desc: There are Insurrectionary Interest Groups plotting a [Concept('concept_revolution','$concept_revolutions$')] in our country!

ag_state_goods_shortages_desc: There are [Concept('concept_shortage', '$concept_shortages$')] in some of our [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')].
ag_can_take_decisions_desc: We have [Concept('concept_decision', '$concept_decisions$')] that can be taken.
ag_expensive_government_goods_desc: We have expensive [Concept('concept_government_good', '$concept_government_goods$')] in at least one of our [Concept('concept_market', '$concept_markets$')].
ag_expensive_military_goods_desc: We have expensive [Concept('concept_military_good', '$concept_military_goods$')] in at least one of our [Concept('concept_market', '$concept_markets$')].
