amendment_frugal_ordinance_desc: Commoner access to luxury items, entertainment, and literature is firmly restricted and regulated by the government.
amendment_zaibatsu_oligopoly_desc: The economy has come to be dominated by a closed circle of prosperous military-industrial Zaibatsu in a symbiotic relationship with the state.
amendment_taikunate_desc: The Tokugawa clan retains special privileges within this parliamentary system, with the head of the clan possessing a permanent position as head of government.
amendment_reformed_shinsengumi_desc: The state's secret police agency has its roots in the Shinsengumi, an elite unit of swordsmen commissioned by the Bakufu to preserve order in Kyōto.
amendment_corporate_state_nominating_bod: The nominating bodies for the state's corporate assembly are systematically biased towards labor associations and trade unions.
The nominating bodies for the state's corporate assembly are systematically biased towards employers' associations and industry.
The nominating bodies for the state's corporate assembly are systematically biased towards universities and academic societies.
amendment_ragged_schools_desc: The school system is supplemented by religiously-run
amendment_religious_workhouses_desc: Responsibility for the operation of workhouses has been delegated to religious authorities who seek the moral improvement of the inmates.
amendment_veterans_pensions_desc: The welfare system provides a generous state pension to war widows and surviving veterans of the armed forces.
amendment_agricultural_communes_desc: In rural areas, state power has been replaced by networks of autonomous agrarian communes which make use of novel agricultural techniques.
amendment_cult_of_personality_desc: Through their own natural charisma and the efforts of the state propaganda apparatus, the ruler has fostered a sizable personality cult.
amendment_farmers_cooperatives_desc: Beneficiaries of land reform tend to form federations of small agricultural cooperatives, limiting the ability for large enterprises to make inroads into the agricultural sector.
amendment_vertically_integrated_agricult: The agricultural economy is characterized by certain large enterprises that maintain ownership of their entire supply chains.
amendment_sovereign_of_the_nation_desc: The monarch derives legitimacy from nationalist ideology, styling themselves as the supreme representative of a given nation.
amendment_malthusian_foundations_desc: The welfare system is founded upon the implicit assumption that uncontrolled population growth will lead to catastrophic resource shortages. It seeks to discourage population growth amongst the lower classes.
amendment_welfare_pro_employer_bias_desc: Benefits offered by the welfare system are intentionally limited, with the intention to reduce the leverage of labor and swiftly return the unemployed to work.
amendment_migration_religious_restrictio: The migration system denies long-term residence rights to those who follow certain foreign faiths.
amendment_migration_tariff_exemptions_de: To appease proponents of free trade, this law guarantees the free movement of goods—if not people.
amendment_short_term_tax_cuts_desc: To ease the burden of the reformed tax system on taxpayers, the reform is accompanied by a series of tax reductions set to expire over time.
amendment_draconian_blasphemy_laws_desc: The state maintains the death penalty for an array of religious crimes, granting religious authorities power over life and death.
amendment_degenerate_art_desc: Forms of art associated with discriminated minorities are strictly suppressed. In its place, the state promotes art with nationalistic and traditional themes.
amendment_prussian_education_desc: The education system is organized with an eye towards fostering a disciplined and compliant citizenry.
amendment_co_ed_schools_desc: Students of all genders are educated together in state schools.
amendment_single_sex_education_desc: The state maintains parallel education systems segregated by sex.
amendment_state_anti_clericalism_desc: The state engages in active efforts to remove religious influence from state affairs, bringing it into active opposition with the religious establishment.
amendment_voting_age_18_desc: The minimum age to vote in elections is set at 18.
amendment_voting_age_21_desc: The minimum age to vote in elections is set at 21.
amendment_voting_age_25_desc: The minimum age to vote in elections is set at 25.
amendment_generic_sponsor_polstr_increas: This law extends certain political concessions to interest groups which assisted in its passage.
amendment_voter_suppression_policies_des: Despite nominal universal suffrage, the electoral system presents barriers to voting which disproportionally affect the lower classes.
amendment_homestead_acts_desc: The state provides official avenues for settlers to acquire ownership of plots of public land in unincorporated territories.
amendment_extraterritoriality_rights_des: Agricultural investors based in foreign countries are granted an exemption from certain domestic laws, instead being subject to the law of their own countries.
amendment_open_legal_questions_desc: The formulation of this law presents several legal questions regarding the applicability of domestic versus foreign law, raising fears of costly legal conflicts amongst foreign investors.
amendment_industrial_socialization_desc: Certain businesses with over a hundred employees are liable to be nationalized or placed under the control of state-organized trade unions at will.
amendment_shop_councils_desc: Certain small businesses are amalgamated together under state-organized shop councils, typically made up of their former owners.
amendment_foreign_investment_seizures_de: Foreign-owned enterprises are liable to be nationalized or placed under the control of state-organized trade unions at will.
amendment_redemption_payments_desc: In return for the state compensating their former landlords, former serfs are required to pay a special tax.
amendment_individual_redemption_payments: The financial burden for the abolition of serfdom has been placed directly on individual serfs, binding them in contracts directly with their former landlord.
amendment_provided_school_supplies_desc: The education system directly purchases school supplies with tax funds, offering them as needed to students and teachers.
amendment_unfunded_school_supplies_desc: The education system requires the families of students to purchase school supplies on an individual basis.
amendment_workhouse_regulations_desc: Regulations are placed upon working conditions and hours spent in workhouses.
amendment_nativist_labour_market_desc: Labor regulations are designed to encourage the employment of native-born citizens, and limit opportunities for foreign labor.
amendment_preserved_bureaucratic_caste_d: Recent bureaucratic reforms have left the pre-reform structures largely intact. A sizable portion of high-ranking bureaucrats are holdovers from the previous system.
amendment_restricted_colonial_outsourcin: Regulations have been put in place to protect domestic workers from competition with cheap colonial labor.
amendment_church_organised_schools_desc: The public school system is largely built atop existing structures established by religious authorities. The system preserves many attributes of religious schooling.
amendment_secular_school_system_desc: The public school system has been built from the ground up as a secular institution, curtailing the influence of religious authorities in education.
amendment_american_fugitive_slaves_act_d: Slaveholders possess the legal right to recover escaped slaves, irrespective of any local laws forbidding the institution of slavery.
amendment_200_franc_suffrage_desc: Suffrage is limited to men above the age of 25 who pay yearly taxes amounting to 200 francs or more.
amendment_chamber_of_procurators_desc: Elections to the lower house of the Cortes Generales are carried out through a two-stage, indirect process. An electorate of large taxpayers and members of town councils elect 950 delegates, who then appoint representatives to a Chamber of Procurators.
amendment_chamber_of_gentleman_deputies_: Elections to the lower house of the Cortes Geraes are carried out through a two-stage, indirect process. An electorate of large taxpayers elect members to provincial assemblies, which then appoint representatives to a Chamber of Gentlemen Deputies.
amendment_haiti_polish_naturalization_de: The descendants of the Polish Legionnaires who fought alongside the Haitian revolutionaries are granted the same legal status as Black people under the constitution, able to hold property and possess citizenship.
amendment_racialized_subjecthood_desc: In the interest of preserving colonial rule, the administration has adopted a racialized means of classifying its subjects. All who share racial heritage with the ruling nationality are considered to be part of the colonial ruling class.
amendment_geheime_staatskonferenz_desc: With Kaiser Ferdinand I deemed incapable of effective rule, the will of the late Kaiser Franz I has established a Secret State Conference to serve as a collective regent and de facto ruling cabinet until Archduke Franz Josef's age of majority.
amendment_geheime_staatskonferenz_metter: With Kaiser Ferdinand I deemed incapable of effective rule, the will of the late Kaiser Franz I has established a Secret State Conference to serve as a collective regent and de facto ruling cabinet until Archduke Franz Josef's age of majority.\n\nThe Staatskonferenz has been reformed by Chancellor Klemens von Metternich, improving its functions and granting Metternich a position as its undisputed head.
amendment_geheime_staatskonferenz_kolowr: With Kaiser Ferdinand I deemed incapable of effective rule, the will of the late Kaiser Franz I has established a Secret State Conference to serve as a collective regent and de facto ruling cabinet until Archduke Franz Josef's age of majority.\n\nThe Staatskonferenz has been reformed by Minister Franz Anton von Kolowrat and the Imperial House, granting Kolowrat control of the body and banishing Chancellor Metternich to the realm of foreign affairs.
amendment_electoral_clientelism_desc: Election outcomes are controlled by a network of powerful political bosses in a symbiotic relationship with the governing political parties. Through a mix of material incentives and coercion, these bosses may mobilize their communities to guarantee a given party's victory.
amendment_tradition_of_free_elections_de: This country possesses a tradition of free and fair elections, and institutions that render nationwide electoral interference difficult.
any_government_ig_wants_dictatorship_tt: A [concept_powerful] [concept_interest_group] [concept_in_government] supports the Enactment of [GetLawType('law_autocracy').GetName], [GetLawType('law_technocracy').GetName], or [GetLawType('law_single_party_state').GetName]
amendment_reinstated_fueros_desc: The centuries-old traditional rights of the Basque Country, known as the Fueros, have been restored by royal decree.
amendment_economic_regeneration_1_desc: The success of the Regeneration has led to a surge in investor confidence. So long as the state remains on its current course, it will have capital to spare.
amendment_economic_regeneration_2_desc: The success of the Regeneration has led to a surge in investor confidence. So long as the state remains on its current course, it will have capital to spare.
formation.1.d: A unified [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture').GetName] nation has been achieved for the first time since the fall of Lan Xang.
formation.1.f: Not since the final days of Soulingna Vongsa have we known peace. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] is made whole once more. Families riven by the feuding of the old king's heirs now reunite under one banner. And with this, the [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture').GetNameNoFormatting] people stand ready to face a new, golden dawn.
formation.1.a: We will restore the glory of Lan Xang.
formation.2.d: The Baltic States have been unified into a single nation, bringing together the [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture_2').GetName], and [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture_3').GetName] peoples under one banner.
formation.2.f: The first stirrings of nationhood began in the cities, fields, and homes with numbers, songs, and history. Stirrings passed from strangers to invitations. Invitations gave way to meetings, meetings to agreements, and agreements to alliances. Sealing the alliance was but one linchpin: better to be beside equals against the world, than equals under another iron heel.
formation.3.d: With the restoration of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], our nation has laid claim to the legacy of Rome.
formation.3.f: He climbed the old curia, as the sky darkened with storm clouds. The tales of the old patricians said that the senators would climb the curia and wait for a sign of the gods' favor. He sat, but not for long. Lightning cracked the sky, and a golden eagle landed by the gutter.\n\nAnd he wept: Rome would rise once more.
formation.4.d: The victory of [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullName] brings the Age of Princes to an end, finally reunifying [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
formation.4.f: The days of wayward princes were over. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] would return to the fold of a sublime emperor, the champion of God upon this land. Stability and modernity may now follow under the eyes of God, in the duty of the emperor.
formation.5.d: The union of Portugal with all the former kingdoms of the Spains has brought about a united Iberian Peninula.
formation.5.f: The tolling of the bells often heralded tragedy in the peninsula: war, plague, fire, and death in their wake. But not today. On this auspicious day with a blazing sun overhead, the two kingdoms reunited under a shower of blossom petals. United in royal matrimony, bonded by revelry, and shouldered with the might of a golden legion, a glorious future awaited [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting].
formation.5.f2: A hundred-thousand petty delegates from across the peninsula were brought to a plaza in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName]. The leaders of the venerable kingdoms stood by a great parchment—a new constitution—and with two great quills for them to sign. With the final stroke, the separated states became one. United by contract, bonded in brotherhood, and shouldered by the masts of a grand armada, a glorious future awaited [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting].
formation.6.d: After years of disunity and turmoil, the nation of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] rises once again from the ashes.
formation.6.f1: Brazil was no stranger to internal strife. Indeed, strife will find purchase in any nation of such prodigious size. Yet, it endured. Even if it would splinter, if rot would hollow its foundations, and if opportunists would hound its failing body, it would endure. A nation was more than its constituent parts. And without breaking the spirit of the giant first, Brazil would always return stronger than when it broke.
formation.7.d: Rising from the failed Austrian Empire, the [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] is an equal union of the [SCOPE.sCulture('hungarian_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('romanian_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('czech_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('croatian_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('slovene_culture').GetName], and [SCOPE.sCulture('slovak_culture').GetName] peoples.
formation.8.d: The Arab states of the Middle East have become unified under a single [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation.
formation.8.f: Once the font of learning and the bastion of thought in the world, the Arab world was brought under the yoke of a dozen hordes. Each of them traded the leash between each other. But the history was already written, and the memory was still alive. The Arab world may see gilded domes and gleaming spires once again. Cooperation would be the first, crucial step.
formation.8.b: All Arabs should unite under us.
formation.9.d: Having broken free from the yoke of the Ottoman and Austrian empires, the Slavic peoples of the Balkans have unified into a single nation.
formation.9.f: Freedom. Not mere release from the shackles, but true freedom. No longer caught between hammer and anvil, hound and hunter, the time has come for a new union. A new pact between Slavs for all to see.
formation.10.d: In contrast to the unequal unions of past Nordic hegemonies, the newly formed [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state equally embraces its [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture_2').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture_4').GetName], and [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture_3').GetName] citizens.
formation.10.f: Cheers lined the beer halls as a fresh layer of snow dusted the ground outside. On the walls above the roaring fire were five flags: one for each constituent, and one for the nascent union. Gone were the days of one king's dominion or another's empire. Today was a day of revelry and splendor: a new bear roused in the north, and may all know his glory.
formation.10.a: The [SCOPE.sCulture('finns_scope').GetName] people should also become equal citizens.
formation.11.d: West Africa's greatest empire has at last been restored under the bold leadership of [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullName].
formation.11.f: It is no simple task to assume the mantle of the great Malian kings of yore. But in the mind of [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] only their legendary deeds have the potential to unify the diverse peoples of [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetHerHis] realm in common reverence. For in the great nation building project that lies ahead no tool of statecraft is greater than the histories that binds our peoples together.
formation.11.a: We will rise to the example of Mansa Musa.
formation.12.d: Through relentless struggles against far greater foreign powers, the nation of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has been forged in steel.
formation.12.a: We will rise to the example of Mansa Musa.
formation.13.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has emerged to unite the many peoples of the Malay world and throw off the yoke of European oppression.
formation.14.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has emerged to unite the many peoples of the subcontinent and throw off the yoke of European oppression.
formation.14.f: Silk-clad dancers and flower petals danced across the streets of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName]. Food flew out of pans by the mouthful, fast as fingers could grab them. Thousands of people squashed into whatever space they could find. A new emperor was to be crowned today: [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting]. An emperor for the Indian people, no longer a marionette bound to someone else's fingers.
formation.14.f2: The path to peace begins first by ensuring every man is heard, regardless of station. Agreement and cooperation are the cornerstones for unity to exist. Today marks the first step on the path to peace. May we continue in strength and humility onwards.
formation.14.f3: Jewels plucked from India now adorn someone else's crown. Food for Indian mouths ripped from Indian soil and sent to men with already too much on their plates. No more. India's place in this new world will not be tarnished any further. Those who plundered us so easily before will now face a truly united people.
formation.15.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has emerged from a long period of fragmentation as a stable and unified nation.
formation.16.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullName] has unified the [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture').GetName] people under one banner.
formation.17.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] has emerged as a rising power in [SCOPE.sStrategicRegion('capital_region_scope').GetName].
formation.17.f: A new day dawns, and a new nation rises to the world stage. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] glory is the inevitable future.
formation.18.d_1: Our nation has declared the restoration of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], establishing ourselves as the restored hegemon of central Europe.
formation.18.d_2: With the unification of all German lands and the declaration of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], we have established ourselves as the master of Europe - and, soon, of all the world.
formation.18.d_3: Revolution across much of central Europe has allowed for the declaration of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The international proletariat will be liberated under the Union's banner.
formation.18.d_4: With the declaration of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], we have taken the first steps towards realising the dream of a unified Europe.
formation.18.f_1: With the naked word of the Pope and the bowed head of the Emperor, the decree was writ large. Under the eyes of God and men, it was so: the Holy Roman Empire, restored to its rightful place on the world stage. Cannonades heralded the flowing of beer; cheering men heralded the advance of a glorious new dominion.
formation.18.f_2:
#bold Paneuropa Will Rise! Greatness is our destiny!#!

For the good of the fatherland, all will provide tithes in grain or gunpowder. Together, we will save Europe from its enemies within and without!

#italic The supply of undesirable bodies, weaponry, or foodstuffs will be considered infringement of military law. Offenders will be subject to court martial for sabotage.#!
formation.18.f_3: The factory whistle blew. Those workers that did not leave with the others stayed behind and washed. Once they fit their suits and dresses, they sat around a map of the Union. The word in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] was as they surmised: the world was poised to hate them for their work, but, at last, the next International would have a bastion to work from.
formation.18.b: The French proletariat cry for liberation.
formation.18.c: The time has come to bury our feuds.
formation.19.d: For the first time since the Belgian Revolution of 1830, a single state has unified the territories of the Low Countries and declared a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
formation.20.d: Opposing both Austrian and Prussian designs on their land, a confederation of German states has unified into a restored [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The Confederation stands united to assert its sovereignty in the face of its enemies.
formation.20.f: Decades after Napoleon's defeat, his influence might still be felt across Europe. This confederacy is but one of many projects from his reign of blood. Perhaps, bereft of his mailed fist, it can be turned to a nobler purpose.
formation.21.d: The mistake of 1712 has been reversed. North and South Carolina stand together once more, under the flag of a unified [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
formation.21.b: Tennessee was ours, and will be again!
notification_unification_notification_on: [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] has achieved national unification, bringing together the [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture').GetName] people under one banner.
notification_unification_notification_th: [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] has achieved national unification, bringing together the [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture_2').GetName], and [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture_3').GetName] peoples under one banner.
notification_unification_notification_by: With the restoration of [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName], the legacy of Rome has been reclaimed.
notification_unification_notification_ib: The union of Portugal with all the former kingdoms of the Spains has brought about a united Iberian Peninula.
notification_reunification_notification_: After years of disunity and turmoil, the nation of [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] rises once again from the ashes.
notification_unification_notification_ku: Rising from the failed Austrian Empire, the [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] is an equal union of the [SCOPE.sCulture('hungarian_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('romanian_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('czech_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('croatian_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('slovene_culture').GetName], and [SCOPE.sCulture('slovak_culture').GetName] peoples.
notification_unification_notification_fo: [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] has achieved national unification, bringing together the [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture_2').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture_4').GetName], and [SCOPE.sCulture('unification_culture_3').GetName] peoples under one banner.
notification_unification_notification_tr: [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] has achieved national unification, bringing together the Turkic peoples of Central Asia under one banner.
notification_unification_notification_id: [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] has achieved national unification, bringing together the Malay world to resist European rule.
notification_unification_notification_in: [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] has achieved national unification, bringing together the people of the subcontinent to resist British rule.
notification_unification_notification_hr: [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] has achieved national unification, bringing the peoples of Central Europe under one banner.
notification_unification_notification_ge: [SCOPE.sCountry('formation_country').GetName] has emerged as a rising power in [SCOPE.sStrategicRegion('capital_region_scope').GetName].
je_reunify_central_america_reason: The collapse of the United Provinces of Central America into disparate fiefdoms has left the region impoverished and vulnerable to the most avaricious exploitation. If Central America ever wishes to take full advantage of the potential of the modern era, it must stand as one.
central_america.1.d: The dissident states that so foolishly abandoned [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] unity have been brough back into the fold. The nation is once again united.
central_america.1.a: Here's to a more stable union.
BATTLE_CONDITION_EARLIEST_UPDATE: Will change on or after [DATE.GetString] ($REMAINING$ left)
battle_condition_pursuit_desc: Due to overwhelming numerical advantage the commander is ordering the enemy surrounded and pursued into retreat.
battle_condition_panicked_retreat_desc: Heavy losses and lack of competent leadership have sent the forces into disarray.
battle_condition_controlled_retreat_desc: Heavy losses have caused the commander to order a rapid retreat.
battle_condition_dug_in_desc: The commander has overseen construction of reliable field fortifications.
battle_condition_charted_terrain_desc: The commander has meticulously mapped out the local area before the battle.
battle_condition_rapid_advance_desc: The commander's has leveraged experience with the local terrain to advance more effectively.
battle_condition_camouflaged_desc: The commander's has leveraged experience with the local terrain to reduce visibility to the enemy.
battle_condition_logistics_secured_desc: The commander has secured stable supply lines and logistical support for the battle.
battle_condition_mud_desc: Muddy terrain conditions are impeding operations.
battle_condition_broken_supply_line_desc: Unexpectedly difficult terrain has caused supply lines to temporarily break down.
battle_condition_exhausted_desc: Traversing the rough terrain has exhausted the troops before the battle even begun.
battle_condition_lost_desc: Attempts to navigate the area proved difficult, with some units getting lost and failing to coordinate with others.
battle_condition_surprise_maneuver_desc: The commander's clever thinking has led to some maneuvers that took the enemy by surprise.
battle_condition_aggressive_maneuver_des: The commander's penchant for brutal, decisive action has made itself known in this battle.
battle_condition_careful_maneuver_desc: The commander's slow, deliberate approach is manifest in the strategy adopted in this battle.
battle_condition_blunder_desc: The commander has made a grave strategic mistake, completely misjudging the enemy.
battle_condition_poor_visibility_desc: Due to the environment, weather conditions and positioning, this side has a bad view of the enemy.
battle_condition_good_visibility_desc: Due to the environment, weather conditions and positioning, this side has a good view of the enemy.
battle_condition_rough_waters_desc: This commander and crew were unprepared for the rough sea state during the battle.
battle_condition_strong_winds_desc: An unexpected change in wind intensity has forced the commander to improvise.
battle_condition_death_from_below_desc: The use of submarines in this battle has caught the enemy by surprise.
battle_condition_ramming_maneuver_desc: The commander has decided to attempt ramming the enemy, a dangerous but potentially decisive maneuver.
naval_condition_strong_winds_desc: Gusts of strong wind are blowing ships off course and making navigation difficult.
naval_condition_fog_desc: A thick fog envelops the sea, degrading the ability to spot other ships.
naval_condition_ice_desc: Icebergs and loose ice sheets floating on and below these waters pose a risk to any ships passing through.
naval_condition_cyclone_desc: A massive cyclone is sweeping over the ocean, endangering sailors that find themselves caught amidst the winds.
naval_condition_tropical_storm_desc: A storm has formed above these waters, turning the skies dark in a dramatic show of force.
naval_condition_calm_waters_desc: With clear skies and good fortunes, the sea has turned peaceful here.
naval_condition_rough_waters_desc: High and unstable swells reshape the waters around any vessel passing through these waters.
add_pedropoint: The progress bar of the #Bold Magnanimous Monarch#! [concept_journal_entry] is advanced by #Bold 1#!
remove_pedropoint: The progress bar of the #Bold Magnanimous Monarch#! [concept_journal_entry] is depleted by #Bold 1#!
je_pedro_brazil_reason: The status of the #bold Progress Bar#! will be determined by various #tooltippable;tooltip:[Country.GetTooltipTag],je_pedro_special_tooltip_advance positive#! or #tooltippable;tooltip:[Country.GetTooltipTag],je_pedro_special_tooltip_deplete negative#! conditions. The #bold Progress Bar#! reaching #bold 0#! will lead to the end of the liberal Emperor's reign, and the proclamation of a conservative #bold Republic#!.\n\nEmperor [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetRuler.GetFullName], the second ruler of the Empire of [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName], has been thrust into his role at an early age following the abdication of his father. Pedro II aspires to maintaining democratic rule and protecting the civil liberties afforded by the constitution, as well as finally ending the institution of slavery which mars Brazil - despite the strength of the conservative forces arrayed against his liberal cause.
je_pedro_special_tooltip_advance:
The following conditions will #bold advance#! the #bold Progress Bar#!:
• Pedro II has been crowned as Emperor, ending the Regency period
• Princess Isabel has been confirmed as [concept_heir] to the throne
• The [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_armed_forces',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] or [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] are [concept_marginalized]
• Completed the #Bold Brazilian National Identity#! [concept_journal_entry]
• Completed the #Bold Brazilian Naval Power#! [concept_journal_entry]
• Brazil has become a [concept_great_power]
je_pedro_special_tooltip_deplete:
The following conditions will #bold deplete#! the #bold Progress Bar#!:
• Pedro II's male heirs have died
• Pedro II's health is in decline
• Rejected or failed the Republican Proposal
• Brazil has [GetLawType('law_slavery_banned').GetName]
• The [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_armed_forces',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] or [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] are [concept_powerful] and not [concept_in_government]
• Brazil does not have [GetLawType('law_tenant_farmers').GetName] or [GetLawType('law_serfdom').GetName]
• Failed the #Bold Ragamuffin War#! [concept_journal_entry]
• Failed the #Bold Integrating the Brazilian Nation#! [concept_journal_entry]
• Brazil is in [concept_default], or has declared [concept_bankruptcy]
• Any [concept_revolution] has progressed above #variable 50%#! progress
je_pedro_button_desc: It is in the interests of the people that we seek to end the uncertainty of the Regency governments and put the Emperor on his rightful throne. It may be prudent to do this even before he reaches the age of majority.
pedro_heir_empowered_tt: Emperor [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetRuler.GetFullName]'s successor, and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName], will begin their reign in a strongly advantageous position
pedro_je_royalists_more_common_tt: [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] will be more likely to choose progressive [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')] in the future
pedro.1.d: The Triumviral Regency of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] was recently overthrown and replaced by the democratically selected [SCOPE.sCharacter('feijo_regent').GetLastName] Regency. Until [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFirstName] comes of age, Brazil will likely be engulfed by political turmoil.
pedro.1.f: Chess, lauded as the game of kings for over a thousand years, stresses strategic acumen. Long strategies require sacrifice, cost calculation, and a keen sense of literacy. And as one player slips, another gains control of the board.\n\nBut the board of this game was the young emperor himself. Who knows what scars these intrigues would leave on a boy?
pedro.1.a: Will they never cease their squabbling?
pedro_regency_party_tt: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('feijo_regent').GetInterestGroup.GetName] under [SCOPE.sCharacter('feijo_regent').GetLastName] will be unwilling to join political [Concept('concept_party','$concept_parties$')] until the Regency period has concluded
pedro.2.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_scope').GetName] have suffered many grievances under the reign of [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFirstName]. Many now openly oppose the [GetLawType('law_monarchy').GetName] in favor of an [SCOPE.sIdeology('elitist_scope').GetName] [GetLawType('law_presidential_republic').GetName].
pedro.2.f: Moments earlier, Senhor [SCOPE.sCharacter('landowner_leader').GetLastNameNoFormatting] waved away the carts that took away the last of his slaves. As the sun set and the cart trundled out of sight, he slammed the door shut. Seven generations on the plantation now ruined on his watch. It seemed that the Emperor's senses had finally failed.\n\nNow, with rum in one hand and a pen in the other, he wrote to his neighbors. Perhaps the other plantation owners likewise felt a change was in order.
pedro.2.f2: Moments before, writs and invoices were scattered over Senhor [SCOPE.sCharacter('landowner_leader').GetLastNameNoFormatting]'s sprawling desk. The imperial taxes were one thing, imports and exports another, and security for the coffee plantation were a third. All of them combined were breaking the estate. The Emperor would have no hand to help, only to take. [SCOPE.sCharacter('landowner_leader').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] was sure he wasn't the only one buckling under laws.\n\nNow, with rum in one hand and a pen in the other, he wrote to his neighbors. Perhaps the other plantation owners likewise felt a change was in order.
pedro.3.d: Hoping to gain political capital, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('coronation_ig').GetName] regency has decided to crown [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFullName] as [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] significantly earlier than planned.
pedro.4.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFullName] is no longer the young, healthy man he once was. His ability to perform his functions as monarch are in decline. Speculation and scheming surrounds the matter of succession and the future of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] government.
pedro.4.f: Entropy comes for all things, great and small. Whether by sword or decay, the Emperor of Brazil was destined to meet an end. Decades of delayed stress, forced action, and dynamic industry have finally damned him. Sickness would have its dues soon, and the vultures in his court would gladly feast on such a grand carcass.
pedro.5.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('marginal_ig_scope').GetName], once a great potential threat to the [GetLawType('law_monarchy').GetName] of [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFirstName], have become politically marginalized. This is surely a positive omen for the future stability of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] government.
pedro.5.f: Generals and admirals stood at attention behind their civilian ministers. The ministers themselves were less dignified than their counterparts. The directive came: ministries closed, offices diminished, and connections severed. Whatever power they wielded now was but a whisper amidst a storm.\n\nOf course, the military would rise again. A strong arm is needed in a dangerous world. For now, they were at Dom Pedro's side rather than his throat.
pedro.6.d: The growing resentment of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('powerful_ig_scope').GetName] is becoming difficult to ignore. These powerful elites wield great sway in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], and their lack of inclusion in government further turns them against [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFirstName]'s [GetLawType('law_monarchy').GetName].
pedro.6.f: Generals wear finery, and ship officers flaunt lavish gifts beyond their stations. Enlisted troops speak so highly of the civilian ministers that one might question their true loyalties. Meanwhile, those same ministers begin overstepping their bounds. With the armed forces trained enough to look away, who would stop them from taking what they demand?
pedro.7.d: With the solemn passing of Emperor Pedro II, a week of mourning has been declared across [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]. His reign will surely be remembered as one of the greatest periods of our nation's history. Plans must now begin for the coronation of [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_brz_monarch_scope').GetFullName], who the people look to with admiration and respect to lead them onwards.
pedro.7.f: Old tales once held that Heaven weeps when a great man dies. When Dom Pedro of Bragança died, there was scarcely a moment without rain. Tens of thousands lined his funeral procession, wearing black and flying Brazilian flags. Dignitaries from as far as Japan bore witness to the event, each laying forth their own tokens of respect.\n\nThe heavy crown that once harrowed [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_brz_monarch_scope').GetHerHis]'s father now loomed over [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_brz_monarch_scope').GetHerHis]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_brz_monarch_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] would have a near impossible task ahead: to fill the shoes of Dom Pedro II the Magnanimous.
pedro.7.a: The Emperor is dead. Long live the [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_brz_monarch_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
pedro.8.d: In a bloodless coup, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_ig').GetName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_ig').GetName] have overthrown the [GetLawType('law_monarchy').GetName] of [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFullName] and proclaimed a [GetLawType('law_presidential_republic').GetName]. Though many wished to fight to defend the government and the [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle], the former monarch has urged peace and abdicated the throne.
je_pedro_republic_reason: Progressive republicans have approached the Emperor with a plan to peacefully transition [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] towards becoming a [GetLawType('law_presidential_republic').GetName], with Pedro himself acting as the nation's first President.
pedro.9.d: In a private audience with [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFullName], Minister [SCOPE.sCharacter('republican_leader').GetFullName] has suggested that the [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] could peacefully transition [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to a republican form of government. The [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] could be granted the honor of being the nation's first President after abdicating the throne.
pedro.9.f: The proposal was as intriguing as it was preposterous: dismantle the monarchy and replace it with a republic. Not any republic, but one with a head as powerful as a dictator. The constitution would be rewritten to accommodate the shift in power, but little would ultimately shift in Brazil's politics. Pedro would still be shackled to leadership, lest someone less competent took the reins.
pedro.9.b: If it is the will of the people, we shall have a Republic.
pedro.10.d: With the ratification of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s first republican constitution, [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFullName] has been confirmed as [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle], guaranteeing popular support for the new government.
pedro.11.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFullName] has become the first to ratify [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s republican constitution, at the same time announcing to the public his intention to aid this transition by serving as the nation's first President.
pedro.11.a: Soon the Republic will stand strong.
pedro.12.d: The unfortunate passing of [SCOPE.sCharacter('heir_scope').GetFullName] has left [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] without a male heir. Though Princess Isabel is by law next in line many citizens, including the conservative elite, do not relish the thought of a woman on the throne.
pedro.12.a: Women are not fit to rule.
pedro.12.b: Isabel must be groomed to take the throne.
add_2_pedropoint: The progress bar of the #Bold Magnanimous Monarch#! [concept_journal_entry] is advanced by #Bold 2#!
add_3_pedropoint: The progress bar of the #Bold Magnanimous Monarch#! [concept_journal_entry] is advanced by #Bold 3#!
pedro.13.d: Years of grooming have at last prepared [SCOPE.sCharacter('isabel_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('isabel_scope').GetFirstName] to take her father's throne. Even those most staunchly opposed have come to accept that the line of succession is secure.
je_isabel_reason: Though [SCOPE.sCharacter('isabel_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('isabel_scope').GetFullName] is the legal heir to the throne, many within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] will not accept a woman on the throne. The people will need time to see that the Princess will be a worthy successor to her father.
je_isabel_goal: [SCOPE.sCharacter('isabel_scope').GetFullName] has been heir to the throne for at least 10 years
isabel_je_tt: If completed, the progress bar of the #Bold Magnanimous Monarch#! [concept_journal_entry] will advance by #Bold 3#!
pedro.14.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullName] expects the same level of competence and meticulousness from [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetHerHis] ministers as [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetSheHe] applies to [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetHerHis] own work. Now the [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] turns [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetHerHis] attention to overseeing a particular cog in the machine of government.
pedro.14.f: Hand-picked clerks, both of them. Both impeccably dressed according to their means, though the hallmarks of their benefactors shone through. Leftover cigar smoke, a faint brandy stain on a collar corner; little vices leveraged to another's benefit.
pedro.14.a: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s decrees must be followed through.
pedro.14.b: The bureaucracy of trade could be more efficient.
pedro.14.c: The expansion of the economy must proceed more quickly.
bp1_patagonia.1.d: Several [SCOPE.sCountry('patagonia_country').GetAdjective] chiefs have accepted the Frenchman [SCOPE.sCharacter('patagonia_ruler').GetFullName] as King in the desperate hope that this will invite international recognition and an end to the colonization of their homeland.
bp1_patagonia.1.b: Recognize them in exchange for loyalty.
patagonia_button_desc: The Patagonian natives continue to resist our efforts to colonize the land. It will take the use of military force to pacify them.
bp1_misc.1.d: This year's carnaval celebration is planned to be especially splendid in [SCOPE.sState('carnaval_state').GetName]. This could be an opportunity to appease the masses.
bp1_misc.1.f: Women painted in as spirits dance down the street, as the men drum bewitching beats to throaty tunes. Children wave flags and sticks of fried food alike. The streets, once drab with the everyday bustle, exalt glory in a sea of color and glee.\nFor one, small moment, the world seemed at peace.
bp1_misc.2.d: The plummeting price of [SCOPE.sGoods('coffee_scope').GetName] has prompted [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('plantation_owners').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('coffee_state').GetName] [SCOPE.sBuilding('coffee_building').GetName] to advocate extreme action. They intend to burn surplus supply in an attempt to increase prices.
bp1_misc.2.f: The ledgers were two things: increasingly worrying, and increasingly clear. Not only were profits falling, there would be none left by the end of the year. Growing coffee would soon be a quaint hobby for the rich.\n\nOr, as he found as he looked at his fireplace, a barbaric solution to a complex problem. An espresso, purpose-made for farmers and drinkers alike.
bp1_misc.2.b: We could use the coffee as a fuel source.
bp1_misc.2.c: Trust in the invisible hand of the market.
je_brazil_navy_reason: Ever since independence the Brazilian Navy has played a crucial role in safeguarding our sovereignty. We must strive to be the foremost naval power in South America, and among the greatest in the world.
je_brazil_navy_goal: The following must be true for at least 40 years:
best_south_american_navy: No country in South America has greater naval [concept_power_projection] than Brazil
brazil_navy.1.d: On behalf of our [GetPopType('officers').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('admiral_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('admiral_scope').GetLastName] reminds the government of the importance of maintaining [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] sea power. We must strive to be the foremost naval power in South America, and among the greatest in the world.
brazil_navy.1.a: The navy protects our wealth and cares for our people.
brazil_navy.2.d: In a scathing critique of the government, [SCOPE.sCharacter('admiral_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('admiral_scope').GetLastName] has made public the Admiralty's disappointment that our navy is eclipsed by such unworthy powers as [SCOPE.sCountry('naval_rival').GetName]. This is a national humiliation for our [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('navy_scope').GetName].
brazil_navy.2.f: It's an outrage, man, an outrage! These pompous [SCOPE.sCountry('naval_rival').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] fools would mock Brazil, and debase your men. Surely our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetName] is one of respect, [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetCustom('get_dom_dona')] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting]! Take it back from them!
brazil_navy.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('admiral_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('admiral_scope').GetLastName] has appeared before the government to report that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] Navy is large and modern enough to be ranked among the greatest in the world. This has become a point of pride for our [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('navy_scope').GetName].
brazil_navy.4.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has cemented itself as one of the greatest naval powers in the world. [GetPopType('officers').GetName] credit our success to the prudent governance of [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullName].
brazil_navy.4.f: A parade greeted the [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] as [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetSheHe] rode through the city thoroughfares. Green and gold leaflets flitted down the streets, as ten thousand sailors and officers stood at attention by the road. Admiral [SCOPE.sCharacter('admiral_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] ushered them through a series of stairs to a great overlook. At the balustrade, they saw it: dozens of warships and merchantmen in the bay. Dozens more at sea, called for one mission or another.
brz_navy_loyalists: All [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] with at least level #Bold 5#! [GetBuildingType('building_naval_administration').GetName] get:

caudillo.1.d: Following [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] independence from Spain, a power vacuum was left in place of the colonial government, which was quickly filled by charismatic [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('army_scope').GetName] leaders. These
caudillo.1.f: There was, once, a decree that all colonies would submit to the rule of their mother country. That all its goods and words would pass through her doors, and that she would judge them fairly. That she alone would be all they needed.\n\nThen there was Bonaparte, and the mother country made his puppet. Perhaps time had come for the children to fly. And fly they would, under a father's mailed fist. But this tale is yet to end.
caudillo.2.d: The age of caudillo politics is, at long last, at an end in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('army_scope').GetName] have assumed their rightful place of service to the legitimate government.
caudillo.2.f: And so the father has become, like all men, too old and too tired to continue. Now, dear child, the country is ready to take its first, true steps forward. We live without our mother's eye, and without our father's switch. Everyone makes their choices today. And your grandchildren will look at us and say, 'and they lived happy and ate partridges.'
caudillo.2.a: A great day for order and discipline.
caudillo.3.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has become fully immersed in caudillo politics. The fate of the nation is governed by the whims of the most influential members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('army_scope').GetName].
caudillo.3.a: The sword is mightier than the pen.
lose_caudillo_points: The progress bar on the #bold Age of Caudillo#! [concept_journal_entry] is depleted by #bold 100 points#!
lose_large_caudillo_points: The progress bar on the #bold Age of Caudillo#! [concept_journal_entry] is depleted by #bold 200 points#!
gain_caudillo_points: The progress bar on the #bold Age of Caudillo#! [concept_journal_entry] is advanced by #bold 100 points#!
gain_large_caudillo_points: The progress bar on the #bold Age of Caudillo#! [concept_journal_entry] is advanced by #bold 200 points#!
caudillo.4.d: According to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] Constitution, [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullName]'s term is over and a new [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] must be appointed. Of course, the Constitution can always be ammended, or perhaps the role should go to [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetHerHis] protégé [SCOPE.sCharacter('president_successor_scope').GetFullName].
caudillo.4.c: A chance for [SCOPE.sCharacter('president_successor_scope').GetFullName] to show [SCOPE.sCharacter('president_successor_scope').GetHerHis] quality.
caudillo_kingmaker_effect_tt: The [concept_leader] of the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_armed_forces',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] chooses which [concept_party] to support
armed_forces_support_conservative: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('army_scope').GetName] will support the [SCOPE.sParty('conservative_party').GetName] under the leadership of [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_leader').GetFullName]
armed_forces_support_liberal: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('army_scope').GetName] will support the [SCOPE.sParty('liberal_party').GetName] under the leadership of [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_leader').GetFullName]
armed_forces_support_communist: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('army_scope').GetName] will support the [SCOPE.sParty('communist_party').GetName] under the leadership of [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_leader').GetFullName]
armed_forces_support_fascist: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('army_scope').GetName] will support the [SCOPE.sParty('fascist_party').GetName] under the leadership of [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_leader').GetFullName]
caudillo.5.desc: As leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('army_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_leader').GetFullName] must decide whether the military will back the [SCOPE.sParty('liberal_party').GetName] or the [SCOPE.sParty('conservative_party').GetName].
caudillo.5.f: Supplicants. That was the word [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_leader').GetLastNameNoFormatting] thought when the representatives addressed [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_leader').GetHerHim]. Flattery, gifts, appeals to family, veiled consequences: as much in lockstep as [SCOPE.sCharacter('army_leader').GetHerHim] parading troops. But the question was this: which served him best?
caudillo.5.a: The army protects the interests of the elites.
caudillo.5.b: Reform will come at the barrel of a gun.
caudillo.5.c: The army will struggle alongside the people.
caudillo.5.d: The military stands for order above all.
caudillo_kingmaker_button_desc: Powerful Caudillos have immense political influence, and can turn the tide of party politics by backing one party against another.
caudillo_decree_button_desc: The leader of our nation should not be burdened by bothersome governmental process, whether bureaucratic or democratic. If the nation is ordered to jump, it should ask
culture_brazil.7.d: Having failed to create a common national identity for the people of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], separatists and discontents in unintegrated regions have become emboldened. They have rallied many of their people to various anti-government causes.
culture_brazil.7.f: A fractured house upon rotten foundations: that was what was left in the wake of the hardships. Rather than one people with one voice, Brazil marched as like five squabbling brothers. A tyrant led them, himself surrounded by muddied, bloodied, baying and resentful boys eager for retribution, imagined and otherwise.
culture_brazil.7.a: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] must stand strong in the face of this adversity.
acre_dispute.1.d: While formally under the administration of [SCOPE.sCountry('acre_claimant').GetName], the region of [SCOPE.sState('acre_state').GetName] has become heavily disputed. Opportunistic [SCOPE.sCountry('acre_claimant').GetAdjective] settlers seek to claim the land for themselves, and demand action against [SCOPE.sCountry('acre_owner').GetName].
acre_dispute.3.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has emerged victorious in the dispute over [SCOPE.sState('acre_state').GetName]. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] settlers are ready to make the state their own.
acre_dispute.3.f: One pen swipe later, and it was done. Acre was now the mandated responsibility of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]. Rivals—hopeful claimants and the prior caretakers alike—seethed at the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] delegates’ naked glee.
acre_dispute.4.d: Our efforts to seize the state of [SCOPE.sState('acre_state').GetName] have failed, and the opportunity has passed. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] can no longer claim sovereignty over the state.
acre_dispute.4.f: The consul to Acre shoved open the doors to his office. Paintings rattled on the walls. A maid shrieked before scurrying out of the room. He made a note to apologize to her later; his ire was on another kind of miscreant. For now, his reprieve was a half-decanter of rum. Reporting this failure to the [SCOPE.sCharacter('acre_claimant_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] would take the second half.
je_acre_dispute_reason: The region of [SCOPE.sState('acre_state').GetName] has become heavily disputed. Opportunistic [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] settlers seek to claim the land for themselves, and demand action - we must strike while the iron is hot.
acre_dispute_button_desc: The region of Acre has become heavily disputed. Opportunistic settlers seek to claim the land for themselves, and demand action - we must strike while the iron is hot.
notification_acre_dispute_success_desc: [SCOPE.sCountry('acre_claimant').GetName] has successfully seized the state of [SCOPE.sState('acre_state').GetName].
notification_acre_dispute_failure_desc: [SCOPE.sCountry('acre_claimant').GetName] has failed to seize [SCOPE.sState('acre_state').GetName] from its owner [SCOPE.sCountry('acre_owner').GetName].
aberdeen_act_cd_tt: Has not enforced the Aberdeen Act for #bold 5#! years
brazilian_slavery.11.d: Outraged by the failure of [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName] to outlaw the [GetLawType('law_slave_trade').GetName], [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetName] has committed to enforcing the Aberdeen Act. British vessels will routinely patrol Brazilian shipping routes to disrupt trade.
brazilian_slavery.11.f: 'A man is only as good as his word,' so the old saying goes. An obligation, no matter how small or seemingly insignificant, remains a promise. The breach of trust can, therefore, invite calamity. And here, now, a broken promise has roused a dragon to cripple a giant.
aberdeen_act_pop_support_tt: [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName] are more likely to support [GetLawType('law_legacy_slavery').GetName]
notification_aberdeen_act_notification_d: [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetName] is enforcing the ban on the [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjective] [GetLawType('law_slave_trade').GetName] by aggressively disrupting shipping and trade.

southamerica_migration_button_desc: By offering generous grants of land and guarantees of work, we can promote our nation as a prime location for our European cousins to settle.

sa_migration.1.d: Tempted by generous offers of land and work, [SCOPE.sCulture('migration_culture').GetName] people from [SCOPE.sCountry('migration_country').GetName] have begun to migrate to [SCOPE.sState('migration_target_state').GetName].
sa_migration.1.f:
#Bold SILVER LININGS IN EVERY CLOUD#!

Vast tracts of fertile land!

Fields wanting workers!

Factories needing strong arms!

#italic [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] encourages all European immigrants to begin a new life. No taxes, tariffs or other financial burdens upon arrival. Enough work for everyone.#!
sa_migration.2.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is a vast and fortunate land, though it is sparsely populated. We must look beyond the seas, particularly to troubled Europe, for potential settlers to work our fields and factories.
sa_migration.2.f: The Federal Government will encourage European immigration, and it will not restrict, limit or burden with any taxes the entrance into [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] territory of foreigners who come with the goal of working the land, improving the industries and teach the sciences and the arts.
sa_migration.2.a: Give me your tired, your poor, your huddled masses.
sa_migration.2.b: We're doing fine on our own.

sa_migration.3.a: Our words are the voice of a multitude.

sa_migration.5.d: The Industrial Revolution in [SCOPE.sCountry('migration_country').GetName] has created a shortage of jobs, making migration to [SCOPE.sState('migration_target_state').GetName] a very attractive prospect for many [SCOPE.sCulture('migration_culture').GetName] people.
sa_migration.5.f: Farmers, farriers, navvies, and retiring troops alike shuffled off the latest barge. Tens of thousands had already come before them, with tens of thousands more on the way. Men were needed now more than ever in Upper Canada. Rome wasn't built in a day, and neither will be Toronto.
sa_migration.5.a: More settlers are an opportunity to grow our economy.
sa_migration.5.b: Try to limit the influx of migrants.
ragamuffin_war_minors_reason: The apathy of Brazil's imperial government towards the plight of its people can no longer be tolerated. We have elected our own government and declared ourselves an independent republic!
ragamuffin_war_minors_tt: Enforcing our demands on $BRZ$ will Trigger the Event #bold $brazilian_minors.1.t$#!
brazilian_minors.4.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has won its independence from [SCOPE.sCountry('brz_scope').GetName], though at great cost and through bloody struggle. Those still standing rejoice in victory and toast the fallen.
je_aberdeen_act_reason:
Despite the signing of the #bold British-Brazilian Treaty of 1826#!, whereby [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName] pledged itself to the abolition of the African slave trade, little effort has since been expended by [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] authorities to actually enforce it.

Instead, [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] slavers continue to ferry tens of thousands of African souls across the Atlantic in chains every year, making a mockery of Whitehall's good name and reputation.

This cannot stand. One way or another, [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetNameNoFlag] shall yield.
je_aberdeen_act_button_desc: If [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] refuses to take action, so be it. Let us show them how the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('royal_navy_loc')] deals with slavers.
brazilian_slavery.1.t: The Last Voyage of the Andorinha
brazilian_slavery.1.d: With the [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFlag] ban on the slave trade now enforced by local authorities in deed as in name, the South Atlantic Slave Trade has received its final, mortal blow—much thanks to the unceasing efforts of the [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetCustom('royal_navy_loc')].
brazilian_slavery.1.f: Crew, at attention. Dispatches arrived earlier this morning.\nThe Aberdeen Act is no longer in force. Brazil has finally capitulated on the matter of the slave trade.\nAs of now, we may return our attention to real matters. To mark the occasion, you're all receiving a double ration of rum tonight.
brazilian_slavery.1.a: Rule, Britannia! Britannia rules the waves!
brazilian_slavery.1.b: Britons never, never, never shall be slaves.
brazilian_slavery.2.d: Following a short pursuit, the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('royal_navy_loc')] warship [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('royal_navy_ship_names')] has captured the [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] slaver [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('slaver_ship_names')]. Discovered in her hold were hundreds of shackled African souls, destined for the slave markets of [SCOPE.sState('enslaved_destination_state_scope').GetCityHubName].
brazilian_slavery.2.a: Try the crew as pirates, condemn the ship, and free any slaves found.
brazilian_slavery.2.b: Free the slaves, but leave the crew and ship unmolested.
brazilian_slavery.3.d_1: A slave-carrying vessel flying the Brazilian merchant flag has been captured and seized by the [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetCustom('royal_navy_loc')] off [SCOPE.sState('slaver_coastal_state_scope').GetName], the vessel condemned, and its crew tried as pirates in a British court of law.
brazilian_slavery.3.d_2: A slave-carrying vessel flying the Brazilian merchant flag has been boarded by the [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetCustom('royal_navy_loc')] off [SCOPE.sState('slaver_coastal_state_scope').GetName], its human cargo seized and freed.
brazilian_slavery.3.f_1:
Every bulletin, gazette and tabloid in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], whether abolitionist or slaver, read the same message:

#bold [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] Strongarms Sovereign Ship!#!

Every sailor and officer was tried abroad in a court they had no chance of surviving. And now, every gilded finger in the slave trade was baying for restitutions, for resolutions, and for retribution.
brazilian_slavery.3.f_2: The crew of the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('slaver_ship_names')] filed out of the ship. While most were simply glad to be on Brazilian soil again, a handful set about towards every other public house in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName].\n\nBy the next morning, they sought new work. Their reasoning was the same: none of them wanted a confrontation with the [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting].
brazilian_slavery.3.b: They knew the risks such a voyage would entail.
brazilian_slavery.4.d: The notorious [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFlag] slaver [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('slaver_ship_names')] has been spotted by the warship [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('royal_navy_ship_names')] just as it was entering [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] territorial waters. The captain wants to continue the pursuit, but voices aboard caution against blatantly violating [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]'s home waters.
brazilian_slavery.4.a: Seize it. The waters of Brazil are the waters of a hostile power.
brazilian_slavery.4.b: Respect their waters for now. Order the captain to stand down.
brazilian_slavery.5.d: In the pursuit and capture of a [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting]-flagged slaver near [SCOPE.sState('slaver_coastal_state_scope_2').GetName], a [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetCustom('royal_navy_loc')] warship has violated the territorial integrity of [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]. Plantation owners and citizens alike are in uproar, calling for immediate action to be taken by the Brazilian government.
brazilian_slavery.5.f: #bold Britain Strongarms Sovereign Ship!#!\nIn a perverse display of power, the British Royal Navy ship, HMS [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('royal_navy_ship_names')], has seized a trade ship off the coast of Brazil. This shocking breach of imperial sovereignty cannot be left unanswered. The terms of this distasteful law, the Aberdeen Act, dictate that any British ship may arrest and trial our own citizens under British Law. Why does our... (continued, pg.2)
brazilian_slavery.5.a: First they disrespect our flag, now our waters?
brazilian_slavery.5.b: Rattle our sabers at these insolent Brits.
weakness_in_the_face_of_albion_modifier: Weakness in the Face of Albion
brazilian_slavery.6.t: The Last Voyage of the Andorinha
brazilian_slavery.6.d: With the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] slave trade banned and suppressed at last, the mandate—be it real or imagined—of the [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetCustom('royal_navy_loc')] to harass our shipping has passed, drastically improving the diplomatic relationship between our country and [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetNameNoFlag].
brazilian_slavery.6.f: Attention all seamen. Our most magnanimous [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] and the Cortes have ratified a new law forbidding the importation of new slaves.\nWe have proven today that we are every bit the equal of Britain. As such, they no longer have authority to play the schoolyard bully upon our vessels.\nTo mark this big day, every man may have double rations of rum tonight.
brazilian_slavery.6_tt: Our ships will no longer be harassed by the [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetCustom('royal_navy_loc')] in peacetime.
golden_law_button_desc: Influenced by wider international trends, many members of Brazil's high society have been gravitating towards abolitionism in recent years.\n\nShould Brazil find itself with an #bold Abolitionist#! or #bold Humanitarian#! character close to the reins of power, or should the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] be under sufficient control, the abolition of [concept_slavery] could be expedited greatly, although at a cost.
golden_law_button_tt: Instantly passes the law [GetLawType('law_slavery_banned').GetName] at the cost of infuriating any pro-slavery [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')].
brazilian_slavery.7.d: While [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag]'s 'peculiar institution' has seemed untouchable at times, the institution can now at last be considered laid to rest for good. While its impact is surely to be felt for centuries to come, this day calls for celebration, as the Pope himself has bestowed upon [SCOPE.sCharacter('golden_rose_recipient_scope').GetFullName] a golden rose in reverence of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]'s achievement.
brazilian_slavery.7.f: #bold A Golden Rose for A Golden Act#!\nThe sun rises on a new day in a now slave-free Brazil. As word has traveled to Rome and back again, the Pope himself has bestowed two golden gifts upon [SCOPE.sCharacter('golden_rose_recipient_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting]: an auspicious title, and a single, golden rose to commemorate the #italic Lei Áurea#!. With slavery now ended... (cont'd pg. 2)
brazilian_slavery.7.a: Onwards, from a golden law, to a gilded age.
brazilian_slavery.7.b: We are one nation, one people.
brazilian_slavery.8.d: Citing abysmal working conditions and mistreatment at the hands of their master, a group of slaves working in the [SCOPE.sState('slave_plantation_state_scope').GetName] [SCOPE.sBuilding('slave_plantation_scope').GetName] have fled their stations, offering to return only should guarantees of better working conditions be offered.
brazilian_slavery.8.a: Offer #italic some#! concessions, the goods must flow.
brazilian_slavery.8.b: Negotiation is a privilege reserved for the free. Denied.
brazilian_slavery.8.c: No matter, they can be replaced.
brazilian_slavery.9.d: Serious slowdowns of work have recently been plaguing the [SCOPE.sState('slowdown_slave_plantation_state_scope').GetName] [SCOPE.sBuilding('slowdown_slave_plantation_scope').GetName], its managers placing the blame on intentional sabotage committed by discontent slaves.
brazilian_slavery.9.f: Some things are beyond human control: the sun's heat, the changing of the seasons, and how much a plant can yield in its life. What can be controlled—the soil's nutrition, and how much to harvest—are never scrutinized so heavily as a slave's work.\nAnd so, when the body inevitably fails, the driver reaches for a whip as the only answer.
brazilian_slavery.9.a: Lashings will be issued until morale improves.
brazilian_slavery.9.b: They will fall in line. Eventually.
brazilian_slavery.9.c: A free labor force would be better motivated.
brazilian_slavery.10.d: More and more slaves have disappeared from the [SCOPE.sBuilding('escape_slave_plantation_scope').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('escape_slave_plantation_state_scope').GetName] as of late, suspected by overseers of fleeing inland to yet undiscovered quilombos—ex-slave settlements existing outside the reach of the law.
brazilian_slavery.10.b: Enact 'security measures' to ensure this does not happen again.
brazilian_slavery.10.c: Thank the Lord for the slave markets of [SCOPE.sState('escape_slave_plantation_state_scope').GetCityHubName].
brazilian_slavery.13.d: With the victory of the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjective] slaver lobby, the ban on the [GetLawType('law_slave_trade').GetName] is formally repealed, legally enshrining the already widespread practice in the face of international protestations.
brazilian_slavery.13.a: Once more, our position is thoroughly identified with slavery.
je_matter_of_slavery_reason:
The status of the #bold Progress Bar#! will be determined by various #tooltippable;tooltip:[Country.GetTooltipTag],je_brazilian_slavery_tooltip_advance positive#! or #tooltippable;tooltip:[Country.GetTooltipTag],je_brazilian_slavery_tooltip_deplete negative#! conditions. The #bold Progress Bar#! reaching #bold 0#! will lead to the ban on the slave trade being officially repealed, further #bold entrenching#! the institution in Brazilian cultural and political life.

Decried as a cancer threatening the very foundations of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] by its opponents, and lauded as a natural, necessary, and legitimate institution by its proponents, [concept_slavery] has defined the political landscape of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] for centuries.

#bold The South Atlantic Slave Trade#!
While Brazil officially committed itself to the ending of the [GetLawType('law_slave_trade').GetName] in the #bold British-Brazilian Treaty of 1826#!, few steps have been taken since then to actually enforce the ban, and the trade remains effectively in place.

As long as Brazil maintains the [GetLawType('law_slave_trade').GetName] [concept_law], [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetName] may feel justified in disrupting Brazilian vessels carrying slaves on the high seas.
slavery_progress_from_slavers_tt: majority of [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')] are [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant], or have the [GetIdeology('ideology_slaver').GetName] [concept_ideology]
slavery_progress_from_isabel_tt: Princess Isabel confirmed as [concept_heir] to the throne
je_slave_trade_suppression_button_desc: While the [GetLawType('law_slave_trade').GetName] is too ingrained in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] to fully suppress, certain measures may still be taken against the worst and most prominent offenders.
je_slave_trade_end_suppression_button_de: Adhering to our treaty obligations is proving more trouble than its worth. For the sake of national stability, we should allow the trade to go on unimpeded.
slave_trade_button_cooldown_tt: We may only change our stance every #variable 2#! years.
je_brazilian_slavery_informal_trade: The ban on slave trading is #bold widely ignored#!.
je_brazilian_slavery_suppressed_trade: The ban on slave trading is #bold selectively enforced#!.
je_brazilian_slavery_banned_trade: The ban on slave trading is #bold rigorously enforced#!.
je_slave_trade_suppression_button_tt: The #bold Progress Bar#! will #bold increase#! by #variable 1#! per month.
je_slave_trade_end_suppression_button_tt: The #bold Progress Bar#! will #bold deplete#! by #variable 1#! per month.

The following conditions will #bold advance#! the #bold Progress Bar#! by #variable 1#! every month:
• The [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] are [concept_marginalized].
• The [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_intelligentsia',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] are [concept_in_government].
• Brazil does #bold not#! have the [GetLawType('law_slave_trade').GetName] [concept_law]
• Brazil is actively suppressing the slave trade.
• Pedro II has been crowned as Emperor, ending the Regency period
• Princess Isabel has been confirmed as [concept_heir] to the throne.
je_brazilian_slavery_tooltip_deplete:
The following conditions will #bold deplete#! the #bold Progress Bar#! by #variable 1#! every month:
• The [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] are in [concept_government]
• The [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] are [concept_powerful]
• The Regency period is ongoing.
• The [concept_leader] of Brazil belongs to the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant], or is a [GetIdeology('ideology_slaver').GetName].
• The majority of Brazilian [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')] belong to the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant], or have the [GetIdeology('ideology_slaver').GetName] [concept_ideology].
je_matter_of_slavery_tt_1: This modifier is removed should [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] no longer have the [GetLawType('law_slave_trade').GetName] [concept_law].
je_matter_of_slavery_tt_2: Every [concept_great_power] with the [GetLawType('law_slavery_banned').GetName] [concept_law] will display hightened levels of aggression towards [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag], as long as we maintain the [GetLawType('law_slave_trade').GetName] [concept_law].
brazilian_minors.1.d: Victory! Not only have our valiant troops fought off the [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjective] 'caramurus' on the field of battle, but have also managed to free our [SCOPE.sCulture('sulista_culture_scope').GetName] brethren in the [SCOPE.sCountry('santa_catarina_scope').GetName] from the wretched yoke of [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetCapital.GetName].
brazilian_minors.1.f: Among the trophies and souvenir trinkets captured from the battle, he spotted a pair of rag dolls lying face-down in the mud. The captain knelt beside the puddle.\nTurning them over, he recognized the facsimile: the men of House Bragança. Whoever they belonged to were long gone now. He tossed them into the nearest fire, to the cheers of his men.
brazilian_minors.1.b: They have earned their freedom, as we have ours.
brazilian_minors.1.c: Unfortunately, the present situation leaves no room for idealism.
brazilian_minors.2.d: Despite the capitulation of the main Cabano government in [SCOPE.sState('para_state_scope').GetCityHubName], countless rebels continue to resist our rule upstream. Hardened by years of brutal conflict, the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] army has taken an especially harsh attitude towards the rebel bands, mainly comprised of free [SCOPE.sCulture('afro_brazilian_culture_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCulture('amazonian_culture_scope').GetName] fighters.
brazilian_minors.2.a: No mercy for traitors. Burn the rabble out.
brazilian_minors.3.d: With the defeat of the Riograndese Republic's field army, General [SCOPE.sCharacter('gaucho_amnesty_general_scope').GetFullName] has proposed the granting of amnesties and extensive concessions to bring [SCOPE.sState('rio_grande_state_scope').GetName] back into the fold, and to avoid prolonged guerrilla fighting.
brazilian_minors.3.a: Offer concessions, full amnesty, and the paying off of war debts.
brazilian_minors.3.b: If they wanted leniency they should have surrendered back in 1835.
upgrade_amazon_button_1_desc: The rich forests of the Amazon are an untapped source of wealth. It behooves us to develop these lands for the sake of the nation and our continued prosperity.
amazon_1_cooldown_tt: Has not used the #bold Develop Amazonian State#! decision in the past #bold year#!
upgrade_amazon_button_2_desc: The forests, while tamed, still hide their greatest treasures from us. To fully exploit the potential of the Amazon, we must work this land even harder.
amazon_2_cooldown_tt: Has not used the #bold Exploit Amazonian State#! decision in the past #bold year#!
amazon_border_treaty_button_1_desc: The western Amazonian borders of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] have long suffered from poor delineation, resulting in needless border friction and settlements under unclear jurisdiction.\n\nA comprehensive border treaty with our Amazonian neighbor would settle the issue. In the favor of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting], of course.
