amazon_border_treaty_button_2_desc: The northern Amazonian borders of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] are vague and open to exploitation from foreign governments and troublesome bandits alike. Clearly-delineated jurisdictions and mutual agreements with our neighbors would do much to protect our own borders and bring some law to this frontier.\n\nOne sweeping treaty would neatly resolve this issue for [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting].
je_amazonas_reason: While [SCOPE.sGoods('rubber_scope').GetName] and its properties have long been known to us, traditionally its uses have been limited, and consequently commercial demands have been low. However, with the #bold Industrial Revolution#! in full swing and new uses for [SCOPE.sGoods('rubber_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] found by the week, calls for increased production have soared.\n\nSteps must be taken to transform the Amazon from an inhospitable jungle into an intensively developed land capable of meeting the demands of commerce.
je_amazonas_tt: All rubber-producing Amazonian [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] must have their #bold state trait#! upgraded to #bold Exploited Amazon Rainforest#!.
amazonas.1.d: Currently in our possession are vast tracts of pristine, undeveloped Amazonian lands. While some laud its wild beauty, others see naught but an untamed frontier overflowing with [SCOPE.sGoods('rubber_scope').GetName]—longing for the gentle touch of progress and capital.
amazonas.2.d: After intense deliberations, an agreement has been reached between the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] and the [SCOPE.sCountry('bolivia_border_treaty_country_scope').GetAdjective] delegations, delineating the border between our two nations in [SCOPE.sState('amazonas_state_scope').GetName] and resulting in large tracts of lands being ceded to [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag].
amazonas.2.f: And with the final flourish, the treaty now stood binding and resolute. New maps were commissioned as fast as the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] and [SCOPE.sCountry('bolivia_border_treaty_country_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] governments could bark the orders. A fresh border erected along the lines of the Amazon Basin.\n\nOf course, while they agreed in theory, nobody quite knew #italic where#! the Amazon Basin began. That would be for the municipalities to decide. Surely common sense would prevail in their disputes.
amazonas.2.a: In the name of the Holy Trinity, sign.
amazonas.3.d: After intense deliberations, an agreement has been reached between the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] and the [SCOPE.sCountry('colombia_border_treaty_country_scope').GetAdjective] delegations, delineating the border between our two nations in [SCOPE.sState('amazonas_state_scope').GetName] and resulting in large tracts of lands being ceded to [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag].
amazonas.3.a: In the name of the Holy Trinity, sign.
amazonas.4.d: Fuelled by profits from the developing [SCOPE.sGoods('rubber_scope').GetName] industry, the city of [SCOPE.sState('amazonas_state_scope').GetCityHubName] in [SCOPE.sState('amazonas_state_scope').GetName] has emerged as a major commercial center, sporting facilities and amenities yet unheard of in the rainforest.
amazonas.4.f: #bold Sap Makes [SCOPE.sState('amazonas_state_scope').GetCityHubName]' World Go Round#!\nThe burgeoning rubber trade, bled from the very trees of the Amazon Rainforest, have given [SCOPE.sState('amazonas_state_scope').GetCityHubName] a stable economic crutch. While coffee and milk are the center of other parts of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting], the utility of rubber has allowed other industries to flourish. Cobblers, toolmakers and hospitals alike are performing new miracles with this sticky new substance... (cont'd pp. 68-9)
amazonas.4.a: It shall be the cornerstone of our [SCOPE.sGoods('rubber_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] Empire...
amazonas.4.b: ... and a tropical metropolis, #italic sans pareil#!.
amazonas.5.d: Teeming with fabulously wealthy rubber barons, the city of [SCOPE.sState('amazonas_state_scope').GetCityHubName], in the heart of the once inhospitable jungle, has become as grand and gaudy as any European city. New prestige works emerge by the week.
amazonas.5.f: In [SCOPE.sState('amazonas_state_scope').GetCityHubName] every luxury is present. The rubber barons are a competitive sort and any new fancy or fashion becomes an arms race of excess. When walking the streets one could almost imagine that they are in Paris, save for the heat.
amazonas.5.b: What would a tropical Paris be without lights?
amazonas.6.d: Nested within the rainforests of [SCOPE.sState('amazon_development_level_one_state_scope').GetName], the erstwhile sleepy village of [SCOPE.sState('amazon_development_level_one_state_scope').GetCityHubName] has grown into a major hub of [SCOPE.sGoods('rubber_scope').GetName] extraction and transportation.
amazonas.6.a: ... and the rubber 'barons' require more labor.
amazonas.6.b: Their business acumen shall see [SCOPE.sState('amazon_development_level_one_state_scope').GetCityHubName] thrive.
amazonas.7.d: Like pearls on a string, cities and [SCOPE.sGoods('rubber_scope').GetName] entrepots now line [SCOPE.sState('amazon_development_level_two_state_scope').GetName]'s rail and riverine networks, bringing the blazing torch of civilization to the jungle in exchange for its rich bounties.
amazonas.7.a: We are the harbingers of order...
amazonas.8.d: [SCOPE.sGoods('rubber_scope').GetName] barons, local authorities and elements of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_scope').GetName] are divided on the best direction to shape the [SCOPE.sCulture('amazonian_culture_scope').GetName] peoples of [SCOPE.sState('amazon_indian_exploitation_state').GetName]. Every argument, however, is rooted in self-interest.
amazonas.8.f: Both her husband and her son's hands were struck red. Priests and nuns had brought canes upon the boy for dancing in the halls and reciting the old stories. The patron's enforcers believed the man had adulterated the rubber he tapped. If the men of the lash did not work them to death, she thought, the men of the single god would drive their souls to death.
amazonas.8.a: Education is a distraction, their hands are for labor, not writing.
amazonas.8.b: We shall make [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting]s of them yet.
je_francocracia_reason: The eccentric and uncompromising reign of the Supreme and [SCOPE.sCharacter('francia_character_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag], Doctor [SCOPE.sCharacter('francia_character_scope').GetFullName], has dominated most of Paraguay's post-independence period. With the support of his [GetLawType('law_secret_police').GetName], the dreaded #bold Pyraguës#!, Doctor Francia has ruled the country with a firm hand, exchanging his silken glove for an iron fist whenever needed.\n\nBut the [SCOPE.sCharacter('francia_character_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s age is starting to show. And thus, in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] there are whispers. Whispers that Francia's vision of an isolationist, Rousseauian paradise, may not survive the good Doctor himself.
je_modernizing_paraguay_reason: Long did the nation of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] languish under the arbitrary rule of Francia. But where the old tyrant wanted Paraguay to retreat from the world stage, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName] instead desires for Paraguay to shine on it.\n\nConcerned about the nation's precarious military and economic situation, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastNameNoFormatting] has instigated an ambitious program to modernize and expand its armed forces. After all, only they may truly safeguard the interests of the nation, wherever they may lie.
je_paraguayan_war_reason: The [SCOPE.sCountry('paraguay_scope').GetAdjective] serpent has reared its ugly head. [SCOPE.sCountry('paraguay_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('paraguay_scope').GetRuler.GetLastName] has laid out [SCOPE.sCountry('paraguay_scope').GetRuler.GetHerHis] ambitions for the world to see, ambitions that would greatly upset the South American balance of power.\n\nThe consensus is clear, only an armed response will deter [SCOPE.sCountry('paraguay_scope').GetRuler.GetLastNameNoFormatting] now. The only question is, should we offer one?
humanita_fortress_button_desc: Our best military engineers have suggested that a major fortress be erected at a horseshoe bend near the mouth of the river Paraguay.\n\nThe proposed fortress, having a garrison of near 20,000 men, a chain boom, and some 400 cannon mounted on barbettes, casemates, and earthworks, would ensure that any hostile powers attempting to invade our lands upriver are stopped dead in their tracks.
ybycui_iron_works_button_desc: Strategically located near [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag]'s major [SCOPE.sGoods('iron_scope').GetName] ore deposits, and surrounded by [SCOPE.sGoods('wood_scope').GetName] ideal for charcoal production, the Arroyo of Ybycuí is a perfect site for the establishment of a major, modern iron foundry.\n\nBy inviting foreign experts to assist with the foundry's construction and operation, we can ensure the Paraguayan armed forces will not want for native, high quality iron in the event of war.
good_health_prg_button_desc: For centuries, the Paraguayan people have relied on traditional healers for medical ailments, with diseases like the pox wreaking havoc on the population, hitting poorer districts especially hard.\n\nIf Paraguay is to modernize and its population is to grow to meet the demands of the state, Western-educated doctors must be invited to [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] and a new medical system must be established.
army_git_good_button_desc: We find outselves surrounded on all sides by potential enemies, whose total populations outnumber ours by orders of magnitude. If Paraguay is to safeguard its independence and interests, drastic measures must be taken to expand and modernize the army.
paraguay.1.d: With the death of Doctor Francia, all of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] is in motion, with civilian and military cliques maneuvering to secure for themselves the reins of power.
paraguay.1.a: The [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] garrison secures the city for [SCOPE.sCharacter('carlos_antonio_lopez_scope').GetFullName].
paraguay.1.b: Sr. [SCOPE.sCharacter('go_policarp_go_scope').GetLastName], the unloved secretary of Francia, clings to power.
paraguay.1.tt_1: By siding with the reformers, the [SCOPE.sCharacter('go_policarp_go_scope').GetIdeology.GetName] [concept_ideology] will forever fade from [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] politics.
paraguay.1.tt_2: By continuing Dr. Francia's legacy, you will be locked out of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]'s powerful #bold modernization#! and #bold expansion#! [Concept('concept_journal_entry','$concept_journal_entries$')].
paraguay.2.d_1: [SCOPE.sCharacter('francisco_solano_lopez_scope').GetFullName], son of [SCOPE.sCharacter('carlos_antonio_lopez_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('carlos_antonio_lopez_scope').GetLastName], has enjoyed a meteoric rise through the ranks of the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] army, much thanks to his father's influence. Ambitious to a fault, the young general will stop at nothing to advance the cause of Paraguay: no matter the cost.
paraguay.2.d_2: [SCOPE.sCharacter('francisco_solano_lopez_scope').GetFullName] has enjoyed a meteoric rise through the ranks of the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] army. Ambitious to a fault, the young general will stop at nothing to advance the cause of Paraguay: no matter the cost.
paraguay.2.f_2: #bold [SCOPE.sCharacter('francisco_solano_lopez_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting]: Napoleon of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName]!#!\n\nA commander of dizzying talent has emerged in our beloved [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]. His talent with guns, big and small, has seen our borders become unconquerable walls. Modelling his very strategies on the great Napoleon Bonaparte, [SCOPE.sCharacter('francisco_solano_lopez_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('francisco_solano_lopez_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] may lead the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] army to similar greatness.
paraguay.2.a: One day, this 'Napoleon' shall lead Paraguay to greatness.
paraguay.2.b: A general should know his station, and his is the barracks alone.
paraguay.2.c: There's something #italic off#! about that man, have him dismissed.
paraguay.2.tt_1: The effects of this modifier will #bold double#! should [SCOPE.sCharacter('francisco_solano_lopez_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('francisco_solano_lopez_scope').GetLastName] become [concept_ruler] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag].
paraguay.3.d: With great fanfare, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName] has officially inaugurated the new industrial complex at Ybycuí, stressing the site's modernity and tremendous industrial potential to the assembled crowd.
paraguay.3.f:
#bold Directors Log: On the Iron Works of Ybycuí#!
The iron thus produced has proven of the best quality, and, for some time past no other iron has been used for the public works. Iron smelted with charcoal is, as is well known, much stronger and better than iron smelted with coal.

There is reason to hope that when the mines of Paraguay are properly exploited and worked on a suitable scale, she will be able to supply La Plata with the best quality of iron at a cheaper rate than is now paid for an inferior quality imported from Europe...
paraguay.3.a: Its charcoal smelters shall ensure the highest quality of [SCOPE.sGoods('iron_scope').GetName].
paraguay.3.b: Iron is all well and good, but the future belongs to [SCOPE.sGoods('steel_scope').GetName].
paraguay.3.c: Our prisons are full of purposeless men, let us 'offer' them one.
paraguay.4.d: Commanding a hairpin bend in the River Paraguay, the formidable fortress of Humaitá has been established as the well-guarded key to [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] and the upper rivers.
paraguay.5.d: For too long have diseases like the pox robbed our nation of its men and women. While it may continue to do so for decades to come, the establishment of vaccination programs led by foreign doctors will lessen the severity of future outbreaks.
paraguay.5.f: She was riddled with ringed scars. Forever-wounds and forget-me-nots left by smallpox. It claimed her two eldest, and they breathed their last, rattling gasps in her arms. Her youngest, untouched by the plague, may yet survive it's next incursion. All from just one, little needle.
paraguay.6.d: Wearing their distinctive red and white uniforms, the men of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName]'s new battalions march proudly on [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName]'s Plaza de Armas. Meanwhile, their generals bicker incessantly amongst themselves about how best to actually use them.
paraguay.7.d_1: Arrayed against impossible odds, [SCOPE.sCountry('paraguay_scope').GetName] has found itself defeated by our might. The watching world powers have already drafted fresh maps.
paraguay.7.d_2: Arrayed against impossible odds, Paraguay has found itself defeated by our might. The watching world powers have already drafted fresh maps.
paraguay.7.f_2: #bold Paraguayan Pest Put to Rest#!\nThe Paraguayan brute and his legions lie vanquished on the field of battle. Whatever upstart ambitions they had died with them, and Paraguay is returned to its natural insignificance once more. (cont'd pg. 4)
paraguay.7.f_3: The runt of the litter. The weakest link in the chain. The straw among steel. And yet, it outlasted its neighbor. Not for want of steel or soldiers or scholars, but for simple survival it succeeded. Perhaps, with time and patience, it would thrive long into the night.
paraguay.7.f_4: Paraguay crushed; an island swallowed on all sides. The tides claimed it from all sides, and the life harbored in the water devoured it amongst the myriad young. The message to the smallest nations was clear: expand and be crushed, or hide and be swallowed.
paraguay.7.a: Glory to the heroes of the fatherland!
paraguay.8.d: Personally leading the ragtag remains of the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] army, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName] has been killed in action, having refused all calls to surrender.
paraguay.8.f: It was not hard to find the wake of the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]: the path of looted villages and slaughtered cattle heads ended in a shoddy fortification. The enemy soldiers approached on all sides unhindered. The battle was over barely after it started; an inglorious end to the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting].
paraguay.8.a: And with [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] death, so dies [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] dream of a Greater Paraguay.
paraguay.9.d: Like David struck down Goliath, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has triumphed over her neighbors, with a [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] peace now enforced from the arid Chaco to the shores of the Atlantic.
paraguay.9.f: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting] sat at [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] desk, lit by a single, ensconced candle. Beside a filled inkwell and a clean pen was an untouched victory drink. Libations could wait, as could the hollering men and swooning women outside.\n\n Paraguay needed a rousing address. But where to start?
paraguay.9.a: Give salutes, to that invincible bastion of heroism...
paraguay.10.d: Our armies routed, [SCOPE.sCountry('paraguay_scope').GetName] has done what few observers initially thought possible. It has won the war. The international press is already reporting on a new South American balance of power.
paraguay.10.f: Generals and admirals reached for cues. For every man they pulled away, ten thousand men had died. For every ship they pulled away, a squadron sank with most, if not all, hands lost. Paraguay, an ant who fought the sun. Paraguay, a wolverine who fought jaguars and serpents. Paraguay, the new colossus of South America.
paraguay.11.d: Having amassed significant military might under [SCOPE.sCharacter('paraguay_leader_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('paraguay_leader_scope').GetLastName], [SCOPE.sCountry('paraguay_scope').GetName] now stands poised to strike [SCOPE.sCountry('paraguay_target_scope').GetName] in a bid for greatness. It seems only ready muskets may temper [SCOPE.sCountry('paraguay_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] ambitions now.
paraguay.12.d: Years of arduous labor has born fruit. With the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] army stronger than ever, and with the backing of native industrial might, Paraguay stands ready to seize its destiny as one of South America's principal powers.
gov_francocracia_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] ruled by a [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_PERPETUAL_DICTATOR$')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_francocracia_presidential_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] ruled by a [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_PERPETUAL_DICTATOR$')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
je_brazilian_nation_building_reason: Brazil is a colony without a motherland; a state without a nation. To forge a single identity from all the peoples who inhabit this vast land will take careful deliberations, the completion of herculean tasks, and a steady hand. Is a single, united Brazil truly possible?
je_brazilian_nation_building_ragamuffin_: The #bold Ragamuffin War#! has ended and [SCOPE.sCulture('sulista_culture').GetName] cultural turmoil in [SCOPE.sCulture('sulista_culture').GetNameNoFormatting] homelands has been reduced below to #bold 10%#!.
The #bold Ragamuffin War#! has ended and [concept_devastation] of all states with [SCOPE.sCulture('amazonic_culture').GetName] homelands have reduced to below #bold 5#!.
je_brazilian_nation_building_brazilian_n: A regional #bold [concept_brz_national_hero]#! has been proclaimed and can be used in propaganda.
je_brazilian_nation_building_integrate_n: To bring the people of the Northeast into the fold and truly reconcile them with the new national order, we must destroy one of the greatest sources of unrest in the region, an institution that provokes both cries of opprobrium and calls for its eternal preservation.
Every [SCOPE.sCulture('nordestino_culture').GetName] [concept_homeland] will be removed from our lands.
je_brazilian_nation_building_integrate_s: The gaúchos of the south have plainly felt that their interests do not align with Brazil's interests. The uprising of the Farrapos has clearly illustrated how strong this gulf currently is. Calming down Farroupilha discontent is going to call for both the carrot and the stick.
Every [SCOPE.sCulture('sulista_culture').GetName] [concept_homeland] will be removed from our lands.
je_brazilian_nation_building_integrate_p: The proud people of São Paulo follow their own way, and work with their own markets. Developing an economic role for the region that fits into the broader Brazilian market will be key in forging a common national identity with them.
The #bold River of Coffee#! Journal Entry is activated and completed
Every [SCOPE.sCulture('paulista_culture').GetName] [concept_homeland] will be removed from our lands.
je_brazilian_nation_building_integrate_a: Our northern lands are rife with discontent, and disconnected from the trade and politics of the rest of Brazil. Integrating the Amazon will require soothing fractuous Northerners and stabilizing the rebellion-torn region.
Every [SCOPE.sCulture('amazonic_culture').GetName] [concept_homeland] will be removed from our lands.
culture_brazil.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('brazilian_national_hero').GetFullName] has proven [SCOPE.sCharacter('brazilian_national_hero').GetHerselfHimself] on the battlefield, and after a stunning victory in [SCOPE.sState('state').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('brazilian_national_hero').GetSheHe] has become a rallying cry for the nation and for the [SCOPE.sCulture('brazilian_national_hero_culture').GetName] people.
culture_brazil.1.hero_clarification: [SCOPE.sCharacter('brazilian_national_hero').GetFullName] can use [SCOPE.sCharacter('brazilian_national_hero').GetHerHis] status as a [concept_brz_national_hero] to integrate the [SCOPE.sCulture('brazilian_national_hero_culture').GetName] people
culture_brazil.1.b: We would rather condemn this singular figure.
culture_brazil.2.d: Our efforts to cement a single national identity have, after much labor, succeeded. This concept of Brazilian-ness, this #italic Brasilidade#!, now stretches across the country.
culture_brazil.3.d: The [SCOPE.sCulture('paulista_culture').GetName] people, the residents of São Paulo and the Caipiras of the hinterlands, have reconciled with the central government and the growing [SCOPE.sCulture('brazilian_culture').GetName] national movement.
culture_brazil.3.a: O beloved, idolized homeland! Hail, Hail!
culture_brazil.4.d: The [SCOPE.sCulture('sulista_culture').GetName] people of the Paraná and Iguazú, and the cowboys of the south, have reconciled with the central government and the growing [SCOPE.sCulture('brazilian_culture').GetName] national movement.
culture_brazil.4.a: O beloved, idolized homeland! Hail, Hail!
culture_brazil.5.d: The [SCOPE.sCulture('amazonic_culture').GetName] people of the north and frontier settlers of the Aamazon have reconciled with the central government and the growing [SCOPE.sCulture('brazilian_culture').GetName] national movement.
culture_brazil.5.a: O beloved, idolized homeland! Hail, Hail!
culture_brazil.6.d: The [SCOPE.sCulture('nordestino_culture').GetName] people of Bahia, Pernambuco, and the whole of the Northeast have reconciled with the central government and the growing [SCOPE.sCulture('brazilian_culture').GetName] national movement.
culture_brazil.6.a: O beloved, idolized homeland! Hail, Hail!
je_south_american_national_identity_reas: Although once part of a greater continuum, sharing a common colonial government and common leadership with our neighbors, we have diverged considerably since we won our independence. It is time we fully assumed a new [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName] identity.
je_south_american_national_identity_inte: Begins a campaign to push the integration of our new national culture across the nation, granting new [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName] homelands in our [SCOPE.sCulture('old_national_culture').GetName] [Concept('concept_incorporated_state', '$concept_incorporated_states$')].
new_culture_has_25_percent_tt: The population of this state is at least #variable 25%#! [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName]
culture_south_america.1.d: A national awakening in our country has led to the emergence of a distinct [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName] identity among leading nationalists.
culture_south_america.1.a: [SCOPE.sCulture('old_south_american_culture').GetName] no more—we are now the [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName] people!
culture_south_america.1.b: We are the heirs of a greater ideal!
culture_south_america.2.d: An upsurge of people in the regions neighboring [SCOPE.sState('south_american_culture_state').GetName] have begun to embrace their new [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName] identity.
culture_south_america.3.d: From every corner of the land, people speak of their [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName] homeland. The [SCOPE.sCulture('old_national_culture').GetName] identity is no more.
culture_south_america.3.f: The flag flapped in the central square, as a procession marched around, trumpets blaring and drums beating in unison.
every_pop_converts_tt: Every [SCOPE.sCulture('old_national_culture').GetName] [concept_pop] in this country will [Concept('concept_assimilation','$concept_assimilate$')] to [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName]
south_america_culture_convert_cooldown_t: Has not used the #bold Promote National Identity#! decision in the past #bold five years#!
75_percent_of_upper_pops_assimilate_tt: #v 75%#! of [SCOPE.sCulture('old_south_american_culture').GetName] [Concept('concept_upper_strata','Upper Strata')] [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName] will assimilate into the [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName] [concept_culture]
75_percent_of_upper_pops_assimilate_glob: #v 75%#! of [SCOPE.sCulture('old_south_american_culture').GetName] [Concept('concept_upper_strata','Upper Strata')] [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in this [concept_state] will assimilate into the [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName] [concept_culture]
tooltip_unlock_railways: Allows construction of the Railway building
building_dummy: #This is a dummy building that serve no gameplay mechanical purpose but still need to be reacted to by city hub graphics. It (and this text) should never show up in the UI#!
canal_events.1.d: After having completed our survey of the Isthmus, we should now approach about the possiblity acquiring land in Sinai for constructing a canal.
canal_events.2.d: Ambassadors from [SCOPE.sCountry('suez_scope').GetName] have approached us about the possibility of them acquiring land in Sinai in order to begin construction of a canal.
canal_events.2.a: None of the cost and all of the benefit.
canal_events.2.b: We will not give away an inch of our land.
canal_events.3.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('suez_owner_scope').GetName] Government has accepted our request to acquire land in Sinai in order to start construction on a canal.
canal_events.4.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('suez_owner_scope').GetName] Government has rejected our request to acquire land in Sinai.
canal_events.4.a: Diplomacy has failed us this time.
canal_events.5.t: Request for a Land in Panama
canal_events.5.d: After having completed our survey of the Isthmus, we should now approach about the possibility of acquiring land near Panama City to build the canal.
canal_events.6.d: Ambassadors from [SCOPE.sCountry('panama_scope').GetName] have approached us about the possibility of them acquiring land near Panama City to build a canal.
canal_events.6.a: None of the cost and all of the benefit.
canal_events.6.b: We will not give away an inch of our land.
canal_events.7.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('panama_owner_scope').GetName] Government has accepted our request to acquire land near Panama City. We can now begin construction of the canal.
canal_events.8.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('panama_owner_scope').GetName] Government has rejected our request to acquire land to build a canal that can connect the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific Ocean
canal_events.8.a: Diplomacy has failed us this time.
suez_canal_construction_available: It is now possible to construct the Suez Canal in Sinai
canal_events.100.d: Our survey of the Suez Isthmus is complete: it would be possible to construct a canal linking the Mediterranean to the Red Sea. Next we must acquire the land from [SCOPE.sCountry('suez_owner').GetName].
canal_events.100.a: We will make a suitable offer.
canal_events.100.b: Coercion is the simplest form of persuasion.
je_suez_survey_reason: Our engineers believe it may be possible to construct a canal linking the Mediterranean to the Red Sea. They are currently conducting a survey of the Isthmus of Suez to determine the feasibility of the project.
je_suez_survey_goal: Await the completion of the #bold 18 month#! survey
je_suez_canal_reason: We have determined that it would be possible to construct a canal linking the Mediterranean to the Red Sea. We must now secure the region and construct the canal.
je_panama_survey_goal: Await the completion of the #bold 12 month#! survey
je_panama_survey_reason: Our engineers believe it may be possible to construct a canal linking the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. They are currently conducting a survey of the Isthmus of Panama to determine the feasibility of the project.
je_panama_canal_reason: We have determined that it would be possible to construct a canal linking the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. We must now secure the region and construct the canal.
panama_canal_construction_available: It is now possible to construct the Panama Canal in Panama
canal_events.101.d: Our survey of the Panama Isthmus is complete. We have confirmed that it would be possible to construct a canal linking the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. Next we must acquire the land from [SCOPE.sCountry('panama_owner').GetName].
stop_suez_survey_decision_desc: The Immense cost of conducting our survey of the Suez may become an unacceptable burden. Should we cancel the project, we would have to start again from scratch if we make another attempt.
stop_panama_survey_decision_desc: The Immense cost of conducting our survey of Panama may become an unacceptable burden. Should we cancel the project, we would have to start again from scratch if we make another attempt.
suez_canal_purchase_desc: Initiate talks to discuss the possiblity of acquiring land in the Sinai to begin construction of a canal.
suez_canal_purchase_happened: Land in the Sinai has been acquired.
panama_canal_purchase_desc: Begin discussions regarding the possibility of acquiring land in Panama to begin construction of a canal.
canal_decision_tt: Country has surveyed the Isthmus in order to construct a canal
canal_events.2_tt: This will give [SCOPE.sCountry('suez_scope').GetName] a claim on Sinai, and may lead to conflict in the future.
canal_events.6_tt: This will give [SCOPE.sCountry('panama_scope').GetName] a claim on Panama, and may lead to conflict in the future.
catalyst_lobbies_funded_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] funded the creation of a new [concept_political_lobby]
catalyst_diplomatic_demand_target_desc: being the target of a [concept_diplomatic_demand] from [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName]
catalyst_diplomatic_play_target_desc: being the target of a [concept_diplomatic_play] from [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName]
catalyst_joined_same_bloc_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] being part of the the same [concept_power_bloc]
catalyst_journal_entry_desc: [COUNTRY.GetAdjective] strategic ambitions towards us (usually from a [concept_journal_entry])
catalyst_autonomy_increase_denied_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] refused to increase the autonomy of [COUNTRY.GetName]
catalyst_friendly_lobby_in_government_de: a friendly [concept_political_lobby] becoming part of the [COUNTRY.GetAdjective] [concept_government]
catalyst_hostile_lobby_in_government_des: a hostile [concept_political_lobby] becoming part of the [COUNTRY.GetAdjective] [concept_government]
catalyst_declined_bloc_invite_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] declining an offer to join the [COUNTRY.GetPowerBloc.GetName]
catalyst_exiled_culture_member_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] exiling a character with one of our [concept_primary_cultures]
catalyst_invited_exile_positive_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] inviting a sympathetic [concept_exile] from our country
catalyst_invited_exile_negative_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] inviting an unsympathetic [concept_exile] from our country
catalyst_declined_military_assistance_de: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] declining an offer to provide [concept_military_assistance] to our country
catalyst_orchestrate_coup_successful_des: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] orchestrating a successful [concept_coup] in our country
catalyst_orchestrate_coup_failed_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] orchestrating a defeated [concept_coup] attempt in our country
catalyst_orchestrate_coup_fizzled_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] attempting to orchestrate a [concept_coup] attempt in our country
catalyst_strait_toll_high_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] imposing high [concept_tolls] on a [Concept('concept_strait', '$concept_strait$')] used by [COUNTRY.GetName]
catalyst_strait_toll_reduced_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] reducing the [concept_tolls] on a [Concept('concept_strait', '$concept_strait$')] used by [COUNTRY.GetName]
catalyst_strait_no_military_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] denying [COUNTRY.GetName] military vessels passage through a [Concept('concept_strait', '$concept_straits$')]
catalyst_strait_partially_opened_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] reopening a [Concept('concept_strait', '$concept_strait$')] to [COUNTRY.GetName] trade after a full closure
je_the_eastern_border_reason: Our ambitions of becoming a Pacific naval power, and our colonial agenda in Central Asia, require that we resolve our long-standing border disputes with [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetName] in a manner favorable to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
je_the_eastern_border_treaty_of_beijing_: The #bold Primorye#! region presents an opportunity to construct a warm-water Pacific port, greatly increasing our power projection potential. We could arrange a treaty to secure the territory by capitalizing on China's weakness.
obligation_for_outer_manchuria_tt: We will trade in our Obligation for #bold Primorye#!.
transfer_of_outer_manchuria_tt: We will demand the transfer of #bold Primorye#! to Russian rule.
war_with_china_not_russia_tt: Is not at war with #bold Russia#!, and is at [concept_war] with a country other than #bold Russia#!
russo_chinese.1.d: With our present leverage over the [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetAdjective] government, we have proposed a treaty to draw a formal border in Manchuria, formally transfering [SCOPE.sState('outer_manchuria_scope').GetName] to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
russo_chinese.1.f: The articles of this treaty will come into force from the day they are exchanged by the representatives of one and the other state, and must be performed for all eternity sacredly and inviolably.
russo_chinese.1.a: Open the territories to greater settlement.
russo_chinese.1.b: There must be no delay in the expansion of our ports.
je_the_eastern_border_russia_chuguchak_p: The acquisition of additional territories in Central Asia is a priority of the Russian government. With China in turmoil, an opportunity exists to expand into contested regions.
obligation_for_central_asia_tt: We will trade in our Obligation for territories in Central Asia.
russia_chuguchak_protocol_req_tt: The states of #BOLD Semireche#! and #BOLD Akmolinsk#! are controlled by Russia or a subject of Russia
transfer_of_central_asia_tt: We will demand the transfer of the contested #BOLD Kazakh and Kyrgyz#! territories to Russian rule.
russo_chinese.2.d: We have begun to negotiate with representatives of [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetName], in order to define a border between our nations in the West. There is much opportunity for territorial gains in the Central Asian region.
russo_chinese.2.f: It is our imperative to ensure that the lands of the Kyrgyz and Kazakhs, those loyal subjects of Russia, are united under a nation which is capable of providing security from the present state of banditry and petty theft within the region.
russo_chinese.2.b: The territory of [SCOPE.sState('kirghizia_scope').GetName] is also a necessary acquisition.
russo_chinese.2.c: [SCOPE.sCountry('kirgiz_scope').GetAdjective] territory will be made whole under our protectorate.
russo_chinese.3.d: By securing [SCOPE.sState('vladivostok_scope').GetName], the dream of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] naval dominion over the Pacific has come closer to reality. The city of [SCOPE.sState('vladivostok_scope').GetPortHubName] will become our new primary port in the East.
russo_chinese.3.a: Rebase the Siberian ships, with all due haste.
russo_chinese.3.b: The port of Vladivostok shall be the finest in our nation.
je_caucasian_war_reason: Our territorial ambitions in the Caucasus Mountains are being set back by fierce local resistance. We must crush all remaining resistance in order to secure our Southern border, and open the territories up for settlement.\n\nOnce the #bold Rifling#! and #bold Logistics#! technologies are researched, it will be possible to #bold escalate the war#!, and launch a full-scale invasion of the rebellious states.
caucasus_secured_tt: No independent #bold Circassian#! or #bold North Caucasian#! nation exists in the Caucasus region.
caucasus_lost_tt: The entire #bold Kuban#!, #bold North Caucasus#!, and #bold Dagestan#! state regions have fallen out of [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] control.
je_caucasian_war_circassia_reason: The imperial ambitions of [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetName] require the total destruction of our homes. To resist the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] onslaught, we must unite the tribes of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to stand together in struggle.
je_caucasian_war_imamate_reason: The imperial ambitions of [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetName] require the subjugation of the Caucasus. To combat the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] Orthodox invasion, we must unite the peoples of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], and stand together in holy struggle.
russia_escalate_caucasian_war_desc: With new and improved methods of protecting our supplies and waging war, we are finally capable of crushing the Caucasian rebels with the full force of our army.
caucasian_war_non_escalated_loc: The conflict burns at a slow pace, waged mostly through raids and incursions.
caucasian_war_escalated_loc: The conflict has escalated into a full-scale military campaign.
caucasian_war_milyutin_loc: The conflict has escalated into a full-scale campaign to utterly eradicate the rebels.
je_the_last_kazakh_khan_reason: Proclaimed by representatives of the three Zhuzes to be the Khan of a reunified [SCOPE.sCountry('khanate_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName] has openly risen against [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] rule. In order to secure the Kazakh territories once and for all, the rebel Khanate must be destroyed.
je_pacify_the_steppes_reason: Despite nominal [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] control over the Kazakh steppe since the 18th century, banditry and disloyalty plagues the territory. Kazakh rebels, led by the aristocrat [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName], have begun striking again and again against our supply convoys and fortresses in the region.\n\nOnly with the final pacification of the steppe may the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] truly be said to be the sovereign of Kazakhstan.
khanate_is_destroyed_tt: The Kazakh Khanate has been destroyed
kazakhstan_events.1.d: Rebellious representatives of the Kazakh Zhuzes have proclaimed the restoration of a unified [SCOPE.sCountry('kazakh_scope').GetName], under the Khan [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName]. The uprising threatens our interests across the entire Central Asian steppe.
kazakhstan_events.1.f: Twenty thousand men from three hundred tribes stand astride their horses in the East, prepared to ride against their invaders.\n\nAnd at their head, the Khan Kenesary, raised upon white felts by his loyalists in three Zhuzes, pledges that he shall never return to his home whilst the Tsar dares call his lands his property.
kazakhstan_events.1.a: Rally the loyal sultans, and crush this revolt!
kazakhstan_events.1.b: The Kazakh people will never submit to invaders!
kazakhstan_events.2.d: A Cossack-escorted caravan moving across the steppes of [SCOPE.sState('akmolinsk_state').GetStateRegion.GetName] has been assaulted by a large and well-trained band of Kazakh rebels, led by the aristocrat [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName].
kazakhstan_events.2.f: They came in the night, descending upon the camp from all sides, a contingent of horsemen hundreds strong and so sudden in appearance that it was as if they had been birthed from the seas of grass which surrounded the tents. They slaughtered the pickets within moments, blades clashing and gunshots exchanged between standardized muskets produced in the weapon shops of Tula, and a bewildering array of firearms sourced from half of a continent's leftovers.\n\nIt only took moments for the cacophony to fade and the riders to vanish, leaving behind only smoldering cloth, and two dozen scarred survivors.
kazakhstan_events.2.a: Place the border lines on alert.
notification_kazakhstan_ride_of_kenesary: The rebel leader [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName] has begun a protracted campaign of military actions against the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective]s, and their protectorates in the three Zhuzes.
kazakhstan_events.3.d: With the pacification of the rebel Khanate and the execution of Kenesary Khan, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state may now uncontestedly project power through the entirety of the Kazakh lands.
kazakhstan_events.3.f:
Stones, weep! Silence, dawn!
Collapse, proud cliffs!
Be still, merry song of the brook!
There is no Kenesary, the messenger of heaven-
He is dead, now.
kazakhstan_events.3.a: We must drive ever further into Turkestan.
kazakhstan_events.3.b: Consolidate our gains here, before proceeding.
kazakhstan_events.4.d: A detachment of Siberian cossacks in [SCOPE.sState('raid_state').GetName] has been ambushed and slaughtered by a band of rebel Kazakh horsemen flying the banner of [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName].
kazakhstan_events.4.a: Provide recompense to the [SCOPE.sCountry('kazakh_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] for the caravan.
kazakhstan_events.4.b: It is the responsibility of the Kazakhs to secure their own lands.
notification_kazakhstan_cossack_patrol_a: Rebels loyal to [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName] have raided a patrol of Siberian Cossacks in [SCOPE.sState('raid_state').GetName].
kazakhstan_events.5.d: One of our fortresses in the steppes of [SCOPE.sState('raid_state').GetName] has been raided by a group of Kazakh rebels under [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName]. After capturing the fortress and scattering the garrison, the rebels have mercilessly razed the nearest Russian settlements.
kazakhstan_events.5.f: As the scout's horse sidled up to what had been the gate, he beheld what was left behind. A layer of ash still covered the ruin, deposited by the fire that had charred and blackened the timbers and earthworks that formed the walls. There had been no rain since the fortress had been burned, leaving the ash to preserve what was left.\n\nWhere there had been a fortress, there was now a tomb. Where there had been a garrison, there was now only the enduring stench of smoke.
kazakhstan_events.5.a: The locals are solely responsible for this disaster.
kazakhstan_events.5.b: We must dedicate more resources to protecting our interests.
notification_kazakhstan_fortress_raid_no: A [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] border fortress has been raided and burned by [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName]'s forces in [SCOPE.sState('raid_state').GetName].
kazakhstan_events.6.d: The rebel forces of [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName] have raided a group of loyal auls in [SCOPE.sState('raid_state').GetName], spreading terror amongst those Kazakh people who remain loyal to Senior Sultan [SCOPE.sCharacter('senior_sultan_scope').GetFullName]'s administration.
kazakhstan_events.6.a: He brings desolation upon his own people.
kazakhstan_events.6.b: We must request further assistance from the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
notification_kazakhstan_auls_slaughtered: The forces of [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName] have slaughtered Kazakh auls in [SCOPE.sState('raid_state').GetName] loyal to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective]-installed senior sultan.
kazakhstan_events.7.d: The would-be Khan of the Kazakhs, [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName], has sent a correspondence to [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullName], requesting an alliance with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] against his rivals in Russia and Kazakhstan.
kazakhstan_events.7.a: The Russians and their vassals are a threat to us all.
kazakhstan_events.7.b: We will not have a part in his struggle.
kazakhstan_events.8.d: A Kazakh insurgent force loyal to [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName] has attempted to launch a raid on a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] fortress in [SCOPE.sState('raid_state').GetName], before being repelled by the local garrison.
kazakhstan_events.8.f: When the riders crested the horizon, the garrison was already in position. In disciplined rows atop the walls, a hail of musket fire met the devastating initial charge, and cossack horsemen joined the lethal dance in its wake.\n\nWhen the terror was over, men and horses alike were left screaming, the steppe grass watered with the blood of its sons.
kazakhstan_events.8.a: Commend the soldiers for their brave defense.
kazakhstan_events.8.b: General [SCOPE.sCharacter('casia_general').GetFullName] deserves the credit for his actions.
notification_kazakhstan_raid_repelled_no: The garrison of the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] fortress in [SCOPE.sState('raid_state').GetName] has repelled a raid launched by forces loyal to [SCOPE.sCharacter('kenesary_scope').GetFullName].
kenesary_recognition_tt: We will be aligned with Kenesary Khan in military matters against [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetName].
caucasuswar.1.d: An incursion we have launched from [SCOPE.sState('invasion_base_state').GetName] into the territory claimed by [SCOPE.sCountry('adversary_scope').GetName] has failed. The units dispatched have withdrawn, after suffering heavy losses amongst the rough Caucasian terrain.
caucasuswar.1.a: Cover the retreat with fire and cannon.
caucasuswar.1.b: Withdraw the forces and quietly regroup.
notification_caucasus_russian_failed_att: A [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] expedition from [SCOPE.sState('invasion_base_state').GetName] has been repelled after attempting to capture one of our controlled regions.
caucasuswar.2.d: A convoy dispatched to provide needed ammunition and supplies to our forces in [SCOPE.sState('invasion_base_state').GetName] has been ambushed by the forces of [SCOPE.sCountry('adversary_scope').GetName]. In the struggle, much of its cargo was lost.
caucasuswar.2.f: By the time the relief force had arrived, the bodies had already begun to rot. Men and horses were entangled where they had fallen, their belongings stripped and carried away by enterprising hands. As they lay there, the highway was no longer a territory of Russia, nor of any man at all - for its subjects were maggots, and its sovereign the Lord of the Flies.
caucasuswar.2.a: Seize resources from the locals to make up the deficit.
caucasuswar.2.b: Hold fast, and wait for a better-protected convoy.
notification_caucasus_russian_supply_con: We have successfully ambushed and scattered a [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] convoy intended to supply enemy forces, and seized its cargo.
caucasuswar.3.d: An incursion we have launched into the territory claimed by [SCOPE.sCountry('adversary_scope').GetName] has succeeded, with several villages controlled by the mountaineers burnt to the ground, and the enemy fleeing.
caucasuswar.3.f: In the evening, the soldiers entered a town nestled between two mountains - humble, but prosperous, surrounded by fields of hardy crops.\n\nIn the morning, they left behind nothing but charred-black skeletons, surrounded by a desolate ring of ash.
caucasuswar.3.b: We have made them inclined enough to submit.
notification_caucasus_russian_village_bu: A series of villages in [SCOPE.sState('invasion_state').GetName] have been burned by a [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] incursion, with their population and livestock slaughtered.
caucasuswar.4.d: Cowed by our forces and unwilling to fight any longer, a [SCOPE.sCulture('defector_culture').GetName] tribe formerly loyal to [SCOPE.sCountry('adversary_scope').GetName] has sworn fealty to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
caucasuswar.4.f: I, the below named, promise and swear by Almighty God, on His Holy Gospels, that I am in awe of, and bound to his Imperial Majesty, my true and innate most gracious great sovereign Emperor [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting], Autocrat of All the Russias, and to His Imperial Highness' lawful heir to the throne of All the Russias.
caucasuswar.4.a: It is a pity that they did not decide this sooner.
caucasuswar.4.b: Permit their settlement in our controlled territories.
notification_caucasus_tribe_defection_no: A [SCOPE.sCulture('defector_culture').GetName] tribe has sworn fealty to the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle], eroding our control of our own lands.
caucasuswar.5.d: The newly-promoted Lieutenant General [SCOPE.sCharacter('milyutin_scope').GetFullName] has issued a memorandum to the Tsar, speaking in favor of expelling or exterminating the entire [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture').GetName] population of the Caucasus.
caucasuswar.5.a: Endorse the memorandum, and escalate the expulsions.
caucasuswar.5.b: This measure will make the mountains forever ungovernable.
caucasuswar.6.d: The multi-national nature of [SCOPE.sCharacter('shamil_scope').GetFullName]'s imamate has proven irresistable to many of our subjects in [SCOPE.sState('invasion_base_state').GetName]. Officers and landowners alike have reported numerous defections to the Imamate.
caucasuswar.6.a: Tighten security in the region, to avert further defections.
caucasuswar.6.b: We will not build further bad will amongst the people.
notification_caucasus_russian_soldiers_d: A group of mistreated [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] soldiers has declared their conversion to Islam, and their desire to support our struggle against the invader.
caucasuswar.7.d: With full-scale invasion by the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] state becoming a near certainty, a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] national parliament has been assembled in [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetFarmHubName], in order to elect a single ruler and coordinate the unified resistance of all Circassia.
caucasuswar.7.f: Even if we lose many of our brave warriors, we have men and young boys to replace them! Worst case, we will be unable to use our rifles because we have no gunpowder and ammo. Even so, we will fight with swords and daggers in hand! We will never obey the enemies! Even if the whole world abandons us and we are cornered to the last point of our homeland, it will still be seen what the Adyghe are capable of. If necessary, we will have to mercifully take the lives of our women and children with our own hands so that they do not fall into the hands of the enemy and be met by various worse pains. And then, to avenge them, we too must perish.
caucasuswar.7.a: It is by our spirit that we will resist to the end.
caucasuswar.7.b: We must appeal to foreign powers to assist our struggle.
caucasuswar.7.c: We will forever stand alongside our Eastern brothers!
caucasuswar.8.d: The small Caucasian proto-state of [SCOPE.sCountry('circassia_scope').GetName], which has been embroiled in a long conflict with [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetName], has sent a request for military aid to our nation. Promising recognition of their struggle could assist in weakening Russian control over the region.
caucasuswar.8.f: These lands are ours, and we want to rule them with absolute justice. We strive to administer our country fairly, therefore we treat our people fairly and respect the lives and property of those who visit us.
caucasuswar.8.a: We will regard this conflict with interest.
caucasuswar.8.b: We have no reason to involve ourselves.
circassia_decision_tt: We will have a chance to offer [Concept('concept_recognized_power','Recognition')] to the [SCOPE.sCountry('circassia_scope').GetAdjective] state through a #bold Decision#!.
caucasuswar.9.d: With the death of our former [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] and on the request of many of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_scope').GetName], the [SCOPE.sCountry('imamate_scope').GetName] has dispatched a particularly distinguished naib to further ties between our nations, and lead [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] in its struggle.
caucasuswar.9.f: Upon the third month of hearing our calls to the East for a teacher to light our way, he arrived, his presence like a titan, and his will like a storm of fire.
caucasuswar.9.a: We will be honored to unite with our brothers in Islam.
caucasuswar.9.b: Our struggle is first and foremost a national one.
muhammad_amin_ruler_tt: #v Muhammad Amin Asiyalev#! will become our [concept_ruler]
caucasuswar.10.d: A detachment of largely [SCOPE.sCulture('polish_culture').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCulture('hungarian_culture').GetName] volunteers from [SCOPE.sCountry('austria_scope').GetAdjective] [SCOPE.sState('galicia_scope').GetName] have traveled to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] aboard the steamship Kangaroo, seeking to aid in our struggle as volunteer soldiers against the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] invaders.
caucasuswar.10.a: Grant their leader a role as commander, and send him to the front.
caucasuswar.10.b: We would be well served by training in [SCOPE.sCountry('austria_scope').GetAdjective] tactics.
caucasuswar_end.1.d: With the conclusion of our campaign in [SCOPE.sState('kuban_state').GetStateRegion.GetName], the entirety of the former Circassian territories have fallen under our control. The land is now available for settlement by the Don Cossacks.
caucasuswar_end.1.a: The deportations will continue until the land is clear.
caucasuswar_end.1.b: Begin the process of integrating the Circassian peoples.
caucasuswar_end.2.d: With the defeat of the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] armies on the field, we have finally achieved the dream of an independent and unified [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The inviolable sovereignty of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] in the eyes of the world has been assured by our victory.
caucasuswar_end.2.f: We have stood as one against the invader, burning with passion for the independence of our homeland, and we have returned to our homes triumphant.
caucasuswar_end.2.a: Our strength has always come from our people, and always will.
caucasuswar_end.2.b: A modern [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] will never again be threatened!
caucasuswar_end.2.c: The time has come for our benefactors to make good on their promise.
caucasuswar_end.3.d: With the occupation of [SCOPE.sState('dagestan_state').GetStateRegion.GetName] and the surrender or defection of many of the former Caucasian naibs, the leader of the Imamate has finally surrendered to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] army, upon the request of the wives and children of his last followers.
caucasuswar_end.3.a: Peace has been found in Chechnya at last.
caucasuswar_end.3.b: There will be no peace whilst Shamil is still revered.
caucasuswar_end.4.d: The collapse of our rule in the [SCOPE.sState('kuban_state').GetStateRegion.GetName] and [SCOPE.sState('dagestan_state').GetStateRegion.GetName] regions has led to the severance of the Georgian Military Highway, and the end of the ability of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state to exert power in the southern Caucasus.
caucasuswar_end.4.f: There is nothing left for us in these forsaken mountains but to be trapped between the Turks and the highlanders. Nothing is with us, any longer - God is high above, and the Tsar is far away.
caucasuswar_end.4.a: Militarize the remaining garrisons, and hold at all costs!
caucasuswar_end.4.b: Leave the region to the local warlords' mercy.
caucasuswar_end.4.c: Withdraw in the face of the nascent Caucasian states.
caucasuswar_end.4.e: Abandon the mountains to the Transcaucasian intelligentsia.
caucasuswar_end_4b_tt: The #bold Caucasus#! will be split between various claimants to the legacy of its historical kingdoms.
caucasuswar_end_4c_tt: The national aspirations of the #bold Caucasian#! peoples will be realized, as separate states.
caucasuswar_end_4e_tt: The #bold Caucasian#! peoples will seize independence from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] as a unified #bold Transcaucasian#! states.
caucasuswar_end.5.d: The defeat of the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] armies has enabled our liberation of all of [SCOPE.sState('dagestan_scope').GetStateRegion.GetName] under the rule of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName]. The road lies open for the ultimate triumph of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
caucasuswar_end.5.f: By the will of the Almighty, the Absolute Governor... the unbelievers have been scattered, the crown of their Emperor stained with the blood of his fallen hordes.
caucasuswar_end.5.a: Begin efforts to convert and integrate our new Russian neighbors.
caucasuswar_end.5.b: We must find a way to adapt to this new peace.
russia_offer_circassia_recognition_desc: The requests for international support that the fledgling Circassian nation have sent to us represent an excellent opportunity to expand our sphere of influence in the Caucasus.
circassia_recognition_tt: Circassia will be offered a chance to become a [Concept('concept_recognized_power','$concept_recognized_power$')], if it is able to #bold consolidate#! and #bold recover its territory#! from Russia.
no_country_recognised_circassia_tt: No other country has offered #v $CIR$#! recognition
imamate_dispatch_muhammad_amin_desc: The death of two Circassian Thamades in quick succession has left our Western brothers desiring a figure capable of uniting them. Dispatching our own emissary to Circassia could secure a needed alliance with our fellow fighters, and unite the tribes anew.
circassia_muhammad_amin_tt: We will dispatch a skilled naib to #bold Circassia#!, to unite the peoples of the mountains under Islam.
muhammad_amin_possible: The Thamades #bold Ismail Berzeg#! or #bold Hawduqo Mansur#! are no longer the rulers of Circassia
je_conquest_of_central_asia_reason: To secure our Southern border, counter British power in India, and open routes through which we may extend [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] influence into the Middle East, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s government has issued the prerogative to establish protectorates across Central Asia, and expand our empire into Turkestan proper.
russian_central_asia.1.d: South of the Kazakh steppe lies the khanates of Central Asia, the next set of barriers arresting [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] power projection into India and the Middle East. By any means necessary, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s government intends to bring them into our fold.
russian_central_asia.1.a: It is best to take a more honeyed approach.
russian_central_asia.1.b: Turkestan must submit to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle], by peace or by war.
central_asia_influence_tt: Central Asian nations will be more willing to submit to us.
notification_central_asia_bribes_notific: Traders and diplomats representing [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetName] within our country have begun spending money lavishly, and collecting favors from local [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] officials.
russian_central_asia.2.d: With the opening of Central Asian trade avenues to [SCOPE.sCountry('india_overlord').GetAdjective] India and the Middle East, these routes remain impeded only by the state of [SCOPE.sCountry('afghan_scope').GetName]. Several hawkish figures in the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('hawkish_ig').GetName] have proposed the state as a potential protectorate.
russian_central_asia.2.f: It is my fear that the acquisition of these vast lands will only spur more terror into the hearts of the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_overlord').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting], and that yet more wars may be ignited over those nations which cling to their status as buffers between our empires. Peace between us must be reached - but it by treaty, or by their total capitulation.
russian_central_asia.2.a: Kabul, too, will be [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] one day.
russian_central_asia.2.b: We would better be served by a more subtle approach.
russian_central_asia.3.d: Despite the general recognition of our suzerainty over Turkestan by most peoples in the region, [SCOPE.sCountry('turkmenia_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFlag] tribes to our south continue to raid our lands without fear of reprisals and refuse to submit to our authority. To rectify this injustice, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName] has announced the start of a great expedition into Turkmen lands.
russian_central_asia.3.f: Jabbing his finger at the map laid out on the table between them all, the general sneered.
russian_central_asia.3.a: Let us show these raiders Russian steel.
je_circassian_expulsions_reason: The government's ambition to settle the former territory of Circassia with loyal Cossacks has led to a ruthless campaign to evict the region's [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] population by any means necessary.\n\nWhilst this [concept_journal_entry] is active, [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] will be deported from our borders, at the cost of enormous loss of life.
will_lead_to_expulsions_tt: @warning! This will lead to drastic consequences for the [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture').GetName] population
has_halted_deportations_tt: Has halted the expulsions of [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] people
halt_circassian_deportations_tt: Efforts to continue the expulsions of [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] people will cease
russia_halt_circassian_expulsions_desc: The continued deportation of the Circassians is no longer in the interest of the government. We will order the deportations cease immediately.
halted_expulsions_tt: Has already halted the expulsion of Circassians
caucasus_expulsions.1.d: Waves of chartered refugee vessels and merchant craft holding thousands of [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] deportees have departed across the Black Sea towards their destination. Outbreaks of disease and malnourishment have decimated the crowds.
caucasus_expulsions.1.f: On the shore, thousands of people crowded together to share in the bare minimum of shelter and food. All of them were pale and hungry. The marks of pox and typhus wracked many of them. Dozens lay dying, on the brink of joining the piles of corpses which had been placed wherever there was space.\n\nOff the coast, the decks of the transport vessels overflowed with the dying and already dead.
caucasus_expulsions.1.a: Another wave will soon replace them.
caucasus_expulsions.1.b: Permit the distribution of foreign aid.
caucasus_expulsions.1.c: We have other things to focus on.
caucasus_expulsions.2.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] officials have approached the government, requesting permission to deport up to fifty thousand [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] people to our territory. Observers of [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] conduct in the Caucasus warn that the deportations may be much greater in scale.
caucasus_expulsions.2.a: They would do well to populate our East.
caucasus_expulsions.2.b: This treaty threatens to be destabilizing.
caucasus_expulsions.3.d: The flow of [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] deportees arriving on our Northern shore has spiraled into a humanitarian catastrophe. Local authorities have become overwhelmed by the number of refugees, many of whom are starving and diseased.
caucasus_expulsions.3.f: Dense masses of ragged men, women, and children covered the seashore. All looked wan and hungry. Many were all but naked. Several lay dying. Off the coast, more vessels approached, transformed into floating graveyards by the disease which had ravaged their human cargo. Occasionally, more bodies washed up ashore, rendered unrecognizable by the attention of crabs and seagulls. Some of the bodies had their hands tied.
caucasus_expulsions.3.a: Demand that the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] government cease these atrocities.
caucasus_expulsions.3.b: There is nothing we can do.
circassian_refugees_deportations_tt: [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] refugees will begin to arrive in ports in northern Anatolia
circassian_refugees_warning_tt: A much greater percentage of [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] refugees will be killed on the journey
hide_deportation_events_tt: Future deportation events will be hidden, and appear as #bold notifications#!
notification_ottoman_circassian_refugees: Ships full of [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] refugees deported from [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetName] have landed on the shores of [SCOPE.sState('expulsion_destination_state').GetName]. Many have already died of disease en route.
notification_circassians_deported_messag: Ships full of expelled [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] people have departed, bound for [SCOPE.sState('expulsion_destination_state').GetName]. Many have already died of disease on the shores of the Black Sea.
notification_ottoman_protest_notificatio: [SCOPE.sCountry('ottoman_scope').GetName] has issued a formal diplomatic protest condemning the treatment of [SCOPE.sCulture('circassian_culture_scope').GetName] deportees, and calling for an end to the expulsions.
grain_more_than_35_percent_more_expensiv: #variable Grain#! is more than #variable 70%#! more expensive than [concept_base_price]
direct_desc: This character is known for their straightforward approach to problems.
persistent_desc: This character is known for their persistence.
cautious_desc: This character is known for being careful, sometimes even too careful.
arrogant_desc: This character is known for their arrogant attitude.
bigoted_desc: This character is known for their bigoted and prejudiced views.
reckless_desc: This character is known to be reckless and foolhardy.
tactful_desc: This character is very careful in how they convey certain information.
ambitious_desc: This character has far reaching aspirations.
imperious_desc: This character is known for their arrogant and domineering nature.
wrathful_desc: This character is known for their frequent outbursts of anger.
reserved_desc: This character often holds back expressing their opinion.
cruel_desc: This character is known for having a cruel and malicious streak.
meticulous_desc: This character is extremely careful and pays extra attention to details.
charismatic_desc: This character has natural communication skills.
romantic_desc: This character has rather romantic ideals.
brave_desc: This character is fearless in the face of adversity.
innovative_desc: This character is open to new and exciting ideas.
alcoholic_desc: This character is known for their rampant drinking which has an effect on both their professional and private life.
opium_addiction_desc: This character has a particular penchant for Opium in large quantities.
cancer_desc: This character is afflicted by Cancer, and their health has suffered greatly as a result.
tuberculosis_desc: This character is afflicted by Tuberculosis, a serious illness of the lungs also known as
senile_desc: This character's old age has impaired their mental abilities.
wounded_desc: This character has suffered a serious wound.
syphilis_desc: This character has caught Syphilis, affecting their health and also their reputation.
shellshocked_desc: This character is suffering from the aftereffects of witnessing the horrors of battle firsthand.
expensive_tastes_desc: This character is known for their extravagant taste in wine, food and other luxuries.
cocaine_addiction_desc: This character is known for their addiction to cocaine.
kidney_stones_desc: This character is in constant, excruciating pain from stones that have developed in their kidney.
sickly_desc: This character generally suffers from a weaker constitution, and on top of their current troubles is more likely to gain other illnesses.
imposing_desc: This character effectively uses body language to communicate with and intimidate others.
honorable_desc: This character is well-known for maintaining a high personal standard.
trait_child_desc: This character is a child, not yet fully mature or suited for the demands of statecraft.
basic_diplomat_desc: This character is a skilled diplomat.
experienced_diplomat_desc: This character has vast experience in diplomacy.
masterful_diplomat_desc: This character is the epitome of the diplomatic ideal.
basic_colonial_administrator_desc: This character is skilled at running a colony.
experienced_colonial_administrator_desc: This character has a vast amount of experience in running a colony.
expert_colonial_administrator_desc: This character has mastered the art of colonial administration.
basic_political_operator_desc: This character has a certain knack for politics.
experienced_political_operator_desc: This character has vast experience with the workings of the political machine.
expert_political_operator_desc: This character is an expert at navigating the complex political landscape.
resupply_commander_desc: This commander has mastered the art of requisitioning supplies from their surroundings.
surveyor_desc: This commander has an expert grasp of the terrain in their own country.
forest_commander_desc: This commander has truly mastered the art of war in a woodland environment.
mountain_commander_desc: This commander has truly mastered the art of war in mountains and foothills.
basic_naval_commander_desc: This admiral is experienced in the details of naval combat.
experienced_commander_desc: This admiral has a vast range of experience in naval combat.
experienced_naval_commander_desc: This admiral has a vast range of experience in naval combat.
expert_naval_commander_desc: This admiral has mastered all there is to know about the art of naval combat.
plains_commander_desc: This commander has truly mastered the art of war on open plains.
explorer_desc: This character has successfully completed an expedition.
beetle_ear_desc: This character had a beetle crawl in their ear during an expedition. Surely its dead... unless?
bandit_desc: This character is known for being a graduate of the 'University of the Green Forest'.
social_bandit_desc: This character is widely known amongst the common people for their legendary escapades, stealing from the rich to give to the poor.
convoy_raider_commander_desc: This admiral is experienced in the details of convoy raiding.
experienced_convoy_raider_desc: This admiral has a vast range of experience in convoy raiding.
expert_convoy_raider_desc: This admiral has mastered all there is to know about the art of convoy raiding.
dockyard_master_desc: This admiral is known for being organized and has applied this skill to make sure their ships are properly supplied.
traditionalist_commander_desc: This Commander is known for their firm belief in the more traditional school of thought when it comes to military organization.
popular_commander_desc: This Commander is known for using his reputation and position to promote his Interest Group.
celebrity_commander_desc: This Commander is known for his own perceived popular opinion in the country over their regular military duties.
basic_artillery_commander_desc: This commander is knowledgeable in the effective use of artillery.
experienced_artillery_commander_desc: This commander has an expert grasp of the use of artillery in warfare.
expert_artillery_commander_desc: This commander has truly mastered the art of modern warfare with regards to artillery.
stalwart_defender_desc: This commander is known for being more defensive with regards to their tactics.
trench_rat_desc: This commander is known for their knowledge and use of defensive tactics on the battlefield.
defense_in_depth_specialist_desc: This commander has truly mastered the art of defensive warfare and their tactics reflect that.
inspirational_orator_desc: This character is known for giving speeches to inspire citizens of the nation and members of the government.
demagogue_desc: This character is known for giving speeches that are often focused around specific desires or prejudices.
firebrand_desc: This character is known for these concerns on issues that they feel extremely strongly about.
hedonist_desc: This character is known for their more lavish life style regardless if it is considered more sinful.
pious_desc: This character is known for their more spiritual beliefs that reflect a healthy body and soul.
grifter_desc: This character is known for pocketing government funds for personal use.
scarred_desc: This character has many scars that have come from previous injures and they are able to use them to gain popularity.
pillager_desc: This character maintains their armies by pillaging the countryside.
basic_offensive_planner_desc: This character is known for their clever military advances.
experienced_offensive_planner_desc: This character is renowned for their elaborate military advances.
expert_offensive_planner_desc: This character is famous around the world for their brilliant military advances.
basic_defensive_strategist_desc: This character is known for their clever defensive strategies.
experienced_defensive_strategist_desc: This character is renowned for their multi-layered defensive strategies.
expert_defensive_strategist_desc: This character is famous around the world for their brilliant defensive strategies.
erudite_desc: This character had a refined education and a love of academia.
literary_desc: This character is a master of the craft of writing, whether as an author, editor, or publisher.
engineer_desc: This character is a master of the technical arts, and understands the challenges of industrial modernity.
master_bureaucrat_desc: This character is incredible at managing people and paperwork alike.
political_appointee_desc: This character was thrust into a position of power by another authority, and does not enjoy a natural powerbase.
ruthless_desc: This character is willing to take whatever steps are necessary to achieve their goals.
compliant_desc: This character is prone to subordinating themselves to others.
aesthete_desc: This character possesses refined aesthetic sensibilities and a great interest in the fine arts.
inept_desc: The responsibilities of this character's position greatly outweigh their competence.
elder_desc: This character has experience and prestige as a local leader within a rustic community.
inexperienced_desc: This character is a neophyte in their position, and has yet to develop their skills to an advanced level.
basic_entrepreneur_desc: This character is known for their business acumen.
experienced_entrepreneur_desc: This character is renowned for their brilliant business acumen.
expert_entrepreneur_desc: This character has truly mastered the art of business.
special_character_pedro_legitimacy_desc: A sovereign who laid down his crown to serve the people, preserving unity through peaceful transformation.
special_character_napoleon_of_the_americ: A bold and brilliant commander whose dreams of glory sought to reshape a continent.
special_character_el_excelentisimo_desc: A statesman of iron will who brought stability at the price of unquestioned authority.
special_character_great_reformer_desc: An autocrat who reformed from above, balancing power and mercy to reshape an empire.
special_character_german_unifier_ruler_d: The leader under whom his people were united, forging an empire from ambition and steel.
special_character_restitutor_orbis_desc: A sovereign who restored crown and country alike, reviving a dynasty to reclaim its rightful place in history.
special_character_lenin_popularity: The Man from the River Lena
special_character_lenin_popularity_desc: Born of exile and forged in struggle, he became the voice of the masses and the architect of upheaval.
special_character_john_brown_popularity_: A righteous zealot who gave his life to strike the chains of bondage from a broken nation.
special_character_blanqui_is_free_desc: An unshakable radical who knew no rest, no retreat, and no cause but the permanent struggle.
special_character_maurras_popularity_des: A steadfast theorist who wove order, tradition, and monarchy into a vision for national rebirth.
special_character_napoleonic_return_desc: An astute exile who returned at the perfect moment, armed with a name that stirred the crowds.
special_character_mazzini_popularity_des: A determined exile who never compromised his beliefs, welcomed home by those still dreaming.
special_character_emperor_norton_popular: In a land of ambition, he asked for nothing – and was given everything by the people that made him legend.
special_character_nightingale_popularity: With unwavering resolve and a hammer in hand, she defied orders to bring mercy where it was most needed.
special_character_general_revanche_desc: He marched not for glory, but for revanche.
