special_character_passionate_academic_de: An uncompromising mind, preaching action over order and lit fires in ideologies across the political spectrum.
special_character_agent_of_the_sovereign: An eloquent agitator whose loyalty to the people came wrapped in letters to their sovereign.
special_character_curly_haired_orpheus_d: A poet of the enslaved whose pen struck deeper than any sword, forging justice from rhyme and revolt.
special_character_luxemburg_in_exile_des: A revolutionary who bent to no party, no general, and no prison—driven by a freedom that would not be tamed.
acceptance_events.1.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s heir, [SCOPE.sCharacter('romeo').GetFullName], has caused a scandal by declaring [SCOPE.sCharacter('romeo').GetHerHis] love for a young [SCOPE.sCulture('juliet').GetName] [SCOPE.sCharacter('romeo').GetCustom('getLover')].
acceptance_events.1.f: #italic It is the opinion of this author that our vivacious [SCOPE.sCharacter('romeo').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] may be truly, impossibly, uncomfortably in love. This news has undoubtedly distressed the ton’s aspiring [SCOPE.sCharacter('romeo').GetCustom('getLovers')], but I imagine it must bring a new glimmer of hope to the eyes of [SCOPE.sCulture('juliet').GetNameNoFormatting] people far and wide.#! \n\n

COMPANY_AVAILABLE_FILTER_NAME: Available [Concept('concept_company', '$concept_companies$')] meet all requirements and can be created immediately
COMPANY_POTENTIAL_FILTER_NAME: Potential [Concept('concept_company', '$concept_companies$')] require significant effort before they can be established, such as conquering required [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')]
COMPANY_ATTAINABLE_FILTER_NAME: Attainable [Concept('concept_company', '$concept_companies$')] cannot be established yet, though their requirements are generally straightforward to meet - typically by constructing certain [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')], researching required [Concept('concept_technology', '$concept_technologies$')], or gaining a free [concept_company ] slot
concept_presence_desc: The $concept_presence$ of a [concept_fleet] affects how effectively its [Concept('concept_admiral','$concept_admirals$')] carry out their [Concept('concept_order','$concept_orders$')]. $concept_presence$ builds up over time while a $concept_fleet$ is stationary in a [concept_sea_node].
concept_mission_efficiency_desc: $concept_mission_efficiency$ determines how efficiently a [concept_fleet] carries out its [concept_naval_mission]. It is based on the fleet's current [concept_presence], and on most missions also on the number of [Concept('concept_sea_node', '$concept_sea_regions_short$')] assigned to the mission area. A $naval_mission_type_project_power$ mission is the exception: it brings its full strength to bear in every [concept_strategic_region] it covers, so only [concept_presence] matters.
concept_party_whip_desc: The $concept_party_whip$ keeps the rest of their [concept_party] member's [Concept('concept_ideology','$concept_ideologies$')] in check. When [concept_in_government], the $concept_party_whip$ partially overrides the ideological [concept_law] stances on the other [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] in the $concept_party$ for the purposes of calculating [concept_ideological_incoherence]. The [concept_party_leader] acts as the $concept_party_whip_short$.
concept_economy_health_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] economy is considered $concept_economy_health_healthy_short$ if #italic either#!:\n#indent_newline:3 • its fixed incomes exceed its fixed expenses#!\n#indent_newline:3 • its [concept_principal] is less than half their total [concept_credit]
concept_bankroll_desc: One [concept_country] pays part of its income to another, based on the weekly tax revenue of the recipient. This action has a chance each month to generate an [concept_obligation] towards the bankrolling [concept_country] so long as it was not given as part of a [concept_sway] offer.
concept_fund_lobbies_desc: One [concept_country] pays part of its income to the [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of another, based on the weekly tax revenue of the recipient. This action has a chance each week to create or strengthen friendly [Concept('concept_political_lobby', '$concept_political_lobbies_short$')] in the target $concept_country$.
concept_subject_desc: A [concept_country] whose [concept_autonomy] and right to self-determination is limited to varying degree by an [concept_overlord]. $concept_subject$ relationships are a type of [concept_diplomatic_pact] that $concept_countries$ can be asked to join or forced into with a [concept_diplomatic_play]. The precise effects depends on the [concept_subject_type], but tend to include being forced into their $concept_overlord$'s [concept_market], having to give up a part of their [Concept('concept_treasury','$concept_treasury_possessive$')] income, decreased [concept_prestige], the inability to start your own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] or freely decide which side to support in them, and inheriting the $concept_overlord$'s [concept_ruler] as your [concept_head_of_state].\n\n$concept_subjects$ can be liberated with a $concept_diplomatic_play$ started by themselves or a third party. Some $concept_subject$ types can also be targeted by a $concept_diplomatic_play_short$ by their $concept_overlord$ to reduce their [concept_autonomy] further, or even become fully #b Annexed#! by them.
concept_subject_type_desc: There are a total of #v [GetDataModelSize(GetSubjectTypes)]#! different $concept_subject_types$:#indent_newline:3 \n[GetSubjectTypesList]#!\nSee the $SUBJECT_TYPES_VISUALIZATION$ on the #b Diplomacy#! panel for more in-depth details on the effects of each type.
concept_overlord_desc: The dominant [concept_country] in a [concept_subject] relationship, who derive a number of benefits from the [concept_diplomatic_pact] while (usually) having to pay [concept_influence] for it.
concept_liberty_desire_desc: The demand for [concept_autonomy] in a [concept_subject] [concept_country] is measured by its $concept_liberty_desire$. The $concept_subject$ will be loyal and stable while at low levels, while high levels of $concept_liberty_desire$ could result in calls for greater self-governance, reduced obligations, or even armed revolt for independence.
concept_great_power_desc: Those few [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] that run the world through global empires or absolute local dominance are considered to be $concept_great_power$ [concept_rank]. They are in a constant standoff with other $concept_great_powers$ for an edge, and always wary of plucky [Concept('concept_major_power','$concept_major_powers$')] trying to ascend to greatness at their expense.[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_great_power_desc_added')]
concept_major_power_desc: [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] of $concept_major_powers$ [concept_rank] have established themselves as notable through their regional presence. While they are not yet strong enough to establish a truly global empire they can be a major local force to be reckoned with, and the most powerful among them may aspire to ascend to [concept_great_power] status.[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_major_power_desc_added')]
concept_minor_power_desc: [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] of $concept_minor_power$ [concept_rank] are pawns in the imperialist games of [Concept('concept_major_power','$concept_major_power_short$')] and [Concept('concept_great_power','$concept_great_powers$')], who often use them as buffer $concept_countries$, [Concept('concept_puppet','$concept_puppets$')], or captive [Concept('concept_market','$concept_markets$')].[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_minor_power_desc_added')]
concept_insignificant_power_desc: [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] with such low [concept_prestige] they don't even qualify to be considered [Concept('concept_minor_power','$concept_minor_powers$')] are of $concept_insignificant_power_short$ [concept_rank]. They struggle for their right to self-determination while trying not to appear too inconvenient to nearby [Concept('concept_major_power','$concept_major_power_short$')] and [Concept('concept_great_power','$concept_great_powers$')].[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_insignificant_power_desc_added')]
concept_unrecognized_power_desc: $concept_unrecognized_powers$ are [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_polities$')] perceived as inferior and uncivilized by the reigning [Concept('concept_great_power','$concept_great_powers$')], who regard them as little more than potential future conquests. As a result their [concept_prestige] is penalized and they can be targeted with more severe [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')]. They are also restricted in what [Concept('concept_rank','$concept_ranks$')] they may reach, no matter how much $concept_prestige$ they acquire.[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_unrecognized_power_desc_added')]
concept_unrecognized_power_desc_added: \n\nAn $concept_unrecognized_power$ that wishes to remove these penalties must claim recognition from completing the $je_earn_recognition$ [concept_journal_entry].
concept_protectorate_desc: A $concept_protectorate$ ([concept_subject]) is an autonomous [concept_subject_type] able to start their own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')].
concept_puppet_desc: [Concept('concept_recognized_power','$concept_recognized_powers$')] may turn a weaker [concept_country] into their $concept_puppet$ ([concept_subject]). A $concept_puppet$ is a [concept_subject_type] that cannot start their own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] yet are forced to join their [Concept('concept_overlord','$concept_overlord_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')], and must also pay #v 30%#! of their [concept_treasury] income to their $concept_overlord$ each week. A $concept_puppet$'s [concept_rank] cannot increase to match or exceed their $concept_overlord$'s, and their $concept_overlord$ may target them with the #b Annexation#! $concept_diplomatic_play$.
concept_personal_union_desc: Two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] with the [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_personal_union_desc_added','Monarchy')] [concept_law] may be joined together in a $concept_personal_union$ ([concept_subject]), a [concept_subject_type] where the [Concept('concept_overlord','$concept_overlord_possessive$')] [concept_ruler] is the [concept_head_of_state] in both $concept_countries$. The subject cannot start their own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')], yet are forced to join their $concept_overlord$'s [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')]. The [concept_diplomatic_pact] will break if the $concept_overlord$ abolishes the $law_monarchy$.
concept_dominion_desc: [Concept('concept_recognized_power','$concept_recognized_powers$')] may turn a weaker [concept_country] into their $concept_dominion$ ([concept_subject]). A $concept_dominion$ is a more autonomous [concept_subject_type] that are able to start their own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] and are forced to join their [Concept('concept_overlord','$concept_overlord_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')]. They must pay #v 25%#! of their [concept_treasury] income to their $concept_overlord$ each week.
concept_colony_subject_desc: [Concept('concept_recognized_power','$concept_recognized_powers$')] may turn a weaker [concept_country] into their $concept_colony$ ([concept_subject]). A $concept_colony$ is a [concept_subject_type] that cannot start their own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] yet are forced to join their [Concept('concept_overlord','$concept_overlord_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')], and must also pay #v 30%#! of their [concept_treasury] income to their $concept_overlord$ each week. A $concept_colony$'s [concept_rank] cannot increase to match or exceed their $concept_overlord$'s, and their $concept_overlord$ may target them with the #b Annexation#! $concept_diplomatic_play$.
concept_chartered_company_desc: In special circumstances, [Concept('concept_recognized_power','$concept_recognized_powers$')] may establish a $concept_chartered_company$ ([concept_subject]). A $concept_chartered_company$ is a highly autonomous [concept_subject_type] that are able to start their own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] and are forced to join their [Concept('concept_overlord','$concept_overlord_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')]. There are also special restrictions on reducing the [concept_autonomy], and their base [concept_liberty_desire] gain is greatly reduced. They must pay #v 40%#! of their [concept_treasury] income to their $concept_overlord$ each week.
concept_tributary_desc: [Concept('concept_unrecognized_power','$concept_unrecognized_powers$')] may turn a weaker [concept_country] into their $concept_tributary$ ([concept_subject]). A $concept_tributary$ is a more autonomous [concept_subject_type] that are able to start their own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] and are not forced to join their [Concept('concept_overlord','$concept_overlord_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')]. They must pay #v 20%#! of their [concept_treasury] income to their $concept_overlord$ each week.
concept_vassal_desc: [Concept('concept_unrecognized_power','$concept_unrecognized_powers$')] may turn a weaker [concept_country] into their $concept_vassal$ ([concept_subject]). A $concept_vassal$ is a [concept_subject_type] that cannot start their own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] yet are forced to join their [Concept('concept_overlord','$concept_overlord_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')], and must also pay #v 30%#! of their [concept_treasury] income to their $concept_overlord$ each week.
concept_crown_land_subject_desc: A $concept_crown_land_subject$ is a [concept_subject_type] that cannot start their own [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] yet are forced to join their [Concept('concept_overlord','$concept_overlord_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')], and must also pay #v 40%#! of their [concept_treasury] income to their $concept_overlord$ each week. A $concept_crown_land_subject$'s [concept_rank] cannot increase to match or exceed their $concept_overlord$'s, and their $concept_overlord$ may target them with the #b Annexation#! $concept_diplomatic_play$.
concept_observer_mode_desc: An $concept_observing$ player has full access to the user interface and insight into what is happening in the game, but cannot make any gameplay changes.
concept_trade_desc: $concept_trade$ is the process of $concept_importing$ and $concept_exporting$ [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')]. Most $concept_trade$ is conducted autonomously by a [GetBuildingType('building_trade_center').GetName] via the [concept_world_market], but [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] can also set up [Concept('concept_treaty', '$concept_treaties$')] to trade $concept_goods$ between them directly. $concept_trade$ can be an effective way for $concept_countries$ to improve their economic situation.
concept_trade_revenue_desc: [concept_trade] generates revenue for the [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_trade_revenue_desc_added','Trade Center')] managing it, depending on the [concept_market_price] difference and the volume traded. [concept_tariffs] reduce the $concept_trade_revenue$ generated.
concept_trade_privilege_desc: A type of [concept_treaty] [concept_article] granted by one [concept_market_owner] to another. It affects every [concept_country] in the receiver's [concept_market], increasing their [concept_trade_advantage] relative to how much of the [concept_trade] is conducted with the giver's $concept_market$.
concept_trade_advantage_desc: $concept_trade_advantage$ is the value that determines the [concept_import_price] and [concept_export_price] for a particular [GetBuildingType('building_trade_center').GetName] and therefore also directly affects the amount of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] traded. It is influenced by factors such as the [GetBuildingType('building_trade_center').GetName] level, the [Concept('concept_market_area','$concept_market_area_possessive$')] share of global production of a $concept_good$, [Concept('concept_interest','$concept_interests$')] in relevant [Concept('concept_strategic_region','$concept_strategic_regions$')] and [Concept('concept_trade_privilege','$concept_trade_privileges$')]. $concept_trade_advantage$ is calculated per $concept_good$, per direction, so the $concept_trade_advantage$ differs for $concept_importing$ Coal and $concept_exporting$ Fabric for example.
concept_trade_potential_desc: $concept_trade_potential$ is a rough approximation for the potential to [Concept('concept_trade','$concept_import$')] or [Concept('concept_trade','$concept_export$')] a [concept_good] in a particular [concept_state]. It considers numerous factors such as the the [concept_local_price], the [concept_world_market_price], [concept_trade_advantage], the difference between [concept_good_production] and [concept_good_consumption], as well as [concept_tariffs] and [concept_subventions]. \n\n@information! $concept_trade_potential$ should #b not#! be considered an accurate predictor of trade volumes, but is useful to determine which $concept_goods$ a $concept_state$ is likely to $concept_trade$ more of if it has free $concept_trade_capacity$.
concept_trade_capacity_desc: $concept_trade_capacity$ is generated by [GetBuildingType('building_trade_center').GetName] levels and used to conduct [concept_trade] with the [concept_world_market]. The quantity of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] traded per $concept_trade_capacity$ varies per $concept_good$.
concept_market_area_desc: $concept_market_areas$ are parts of a [concept_market] that are connected via land or straits. There is always one [concept_world_market_hub] per $concept_market_area$ through which it conducts [concept_trade] with the [concept_world_market].
concept_traded_quantity_desc: The amount of a [concept_good] that is [Concept('concept_trade', '$concept_imported$')] or $concept_exported$ with each [concept_trade_capacity] used.
concept_tariffs_desc: $concept_tariffs$ are a fee that [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] can collect from a [GetBuildingType('building_trade_center').GetName] for each [Concept('concept_trade', '$concept_imported$')] or $concept_exported$ [concept_good]. Therefore, they will make it less attractive to conduct [concept_trade] of a particular [concept_good], for example to ensure critical military $concept_goods$ remain in the $concept_country$. A $concept_country_possessive$ [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] determines their maximum level of $concept_tariffs$. The level of $concept_tariffs$ for all members of a [concept_market] are determined by the [concept_market_owner].
concept_subventions_desc: $concept_subventions$ are a sum of money a [concept_country] can pay out to a [GetBuildingType('building_trade_center').GetName] for each [Concept('concept_trade', '$concept_imported$')] or $concept_exported$ [concept_good]. Therefore, they will make it more attractive to conduct [concept_trade] of a particular good, for example to weaken the competition. A $concept_country_possessive$ [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] determines their maximum level of $concept_subventions$. The level of $concept_subventions$ for all members of a [concept_market] are determined by the [concept_market_owner].
concept_building_owners_desc: A [Concept('concept_building','$concept_building_possessive$')] size is divided into [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_levels_short$')]. These $concept_building_levels_short$ can either be [concept_privately_owned] by [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')], or [concept_nationally_owned] by a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country$')]. The [Concept('concept_building_balance','$concept_building_balance_profit$')] from a $concept_building$ is shared among its owners as [concept_dividends].
concept_nationally_owned_desc:
A [concept_building_level] that is owned by the [concept_government] of a [concept_country].

$concept_nationally_owned$ Levels pay out [concept_government_dividends] to the $concept_country$ that owns them. While $concept_nationally_owned$ Levels provide [concept_money] directly to the $concept_government$, they cost [concept_bureaucracy] and have reduced benefits from [concept_economy_of_scale].

$concept_building_levels$ built by [concept_government_construction] become $concept_nationally_owned$, and all [Concept('concept_government_building', '$concept_government_buildings$')] are fully $concept_nationally_owned$.

A [concept_building] can be [Concept('concept_nationalize', '$concept_nationalized$')] to turn their $concept_building_levels$ to $concept_nationally_owned$, or become [concept_privately_owned] via [Concept('concept_privatize', '$concept_privatization$')].
concept_privately_owned_desc:
A [concept_building_level] that is owned by [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')]. These $concept_pops$ are either the [concept_workforce] of the [concept_building] itself, or the $concept_workforce$ of $MANOR_HOUSES_GC_LINK$ and $FINANCIAL_DISTRICTS_GC_LINK$ (mainly $ARISTOCRATS_GC_LINK$ and $CAPITALISTS_GC_LINK$).

$concept_privately_owned$ Levels pay out [concept_dividends] to the $concept_pops$ that own them.

$concept_building_levels$ built by [concept_private_construction] become $concept_privately_owned$.

A $concept_building$ can be [Concept('concept_nationalize', '$concept_nationalized$')] to turn their $concept_building_levels$ to [concept_nationally_owned], or become $concept_privately_owned$ via [Concept('concept_privatize', '$concept_privatization$')].
concept_nationalize_desc:
A [concept_building] that is not fully [concept_nationally_owned] can be $concept_nationalized$ by the owner of the [concept_state] the $concept_building$ is in.

$concept_nationalizing$ [concept_privately_owned] Levels may [Concept('concept_radical', '$concept_radicalize$')] the [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] that own the $concept_building$, especially if you do not offer [concept_money] as compensation.

A [concept_foreign_investment] can also be $concept_nationalized$, if the owning $concept_country$ is no longer allowed to make $concept_foreign_investments$.

The availability and cost of $concept_nationalization$ depends on your $ECONOMIC_SYSTEM_GC_LINK$.
concept_privatize_desc: A [concept_building] that is [concept_nationally_owned] can be put up for sale, allowing [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] to purchase it and make it [concept_privately_owned] through the [concept_investment_pool]. Whether $concept_privatization$ is available depends on your $ECONOMIC_SYSTEM_GC_LINK$.
concept_monopoly_desc: A $concept_monopoly$ on a [concept_building] gives its owner exclusive $concept_building$ rights of that [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_building_industry$')]. It can either be a [concept_company_monopoly] or a [concept_country_monopoly].
concept_company_monopoly_desc: A $concept_company_monopoly$ gives a [concept_company] a [concept_monopoly] on a [concept_building] with exclusive $concept_building$ rights of that [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_building_industry$')]
concept_country_monopoly_desc: A $concept_country_monopoly$ gives a [concept_country] a [concept_monopoly] on a [concept_building] with exclusive $concept_building$ rights of that [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_building_industry$')]. The [Concept('concept_good', '$concept_goods$')] produced by a $concept_monopoly$ will increase in price up to #v 20%#! proportionate to this $good$ [concept_sell_orders] share at the [concept_world_market].
concept_company_charter_desc: [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] can give their [Concept('concept_company','$concept_companies$')] a $concept_company_charter$ which grants the $concept_company$ a particular right. These rights can range from establishing a [concept_monopoly] to the rights to build a different [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_building_industry$')] or to construct a [concept_regional_company_hq] in another country. $concept_countries$ have a number of free $concept_company_charters$ they can hand out at no cost. [Concept('concept_technology','$concept_technologies$')] and [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] can increase this limit. Additional $concept_company_charters_short$ past the limit can be given to $concept_companies$, but will incur an [concept_authority] cost.
concept_company_hq_desc: $concept_company_hqs$ are [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] that represent the administration of [concept_company] assets. They own [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_levels$')] from which they receive their [concept_dividends].
concept_regional_company_hq_desc: A [concept_company] can establish a $concept_regional_company_hq$ in a foreign [concept_country] if they have been granted an Investment [concept_company_charter] by their own $concept_country$. Additionally they need access to the foreign $concept_country$ via [concept_foreign_investment_rights] and an established presence with a small number of [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_levels$')]. The $concept_regional_company_hq$ acts mostly like a [concept_company_hq], but will use the foreign $concept_country_possessive$ [concept_investment_pool] to construct additional $concept_building_levels$ and will reinvest parts of their [concept_dividends] directly into their own $concept_country_possessive$ $concept_investment_pool$.
concept_company_category_desc:
A $concept_company_category$ describes which kinds of [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] partake in the ownership of a [concept_company]. It determines which [Concept('concept_production_method','$concept_production_methods$')] are available in the [concept_company_hq], shaping which [Concept('concept_profession','$concept_professions$')] are employed there. It also determines who receive a share of the [concept_dividends], and whether the $concept_company$ pays [concept_government_dividends] or not.

concept_concept_desc: This is a tooltippable game concept with another [concept_concept] within.
concept_sol_desc: $concept_sol$ measures a [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pop_possessive$')] living conditions, with their material [concept_wealth] as the baseline. It governs [Concept('concept_pop_growth','$concept_pop_growth_birthrate_and_mortality$')], and every time it changes it can cause $concept_pops$ to become more [concept_radical] or [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyal$')]. The average $concept_sol$ in a [concept_state] affects its [concept_migration_pull].
concept_expected_sol_desc: $concept_expected_sol$ is the lowest [concept_sol] that a [concept_pop] is willing to tolerate. This number is based on whether the $concept_pop$ is [concept_lower_strata], [concept_middle_strata], or [concept_upper_strata] and adjusted by [concept_literacy], and can be modified by certain [Concept('concept_technology', '$concept_technologies$')]. If a $concept_pop$ has a lower $concept_sol$ than the $concept_expected_sol_short$ they will gradually become more [concept_radical]. $concept_pops$ with a $concept_sol$ above the $concept_expected_sol_short$ will still become more $concept_radical$ each time their $concept_sol$ is reduced.
concept_famine_desc:
A $concept_famine$ is the result of a large part of the [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')] in a [concept_state] suffering from [concept_starvation]. It is primarily a political classification meant to bring attention to the plight of the ones in need in your society.

A $concept_famine$ is declared in a $concept_state$ if all of these conditions are fulfilled:
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$at least #b #r [GetDefine('NPops', 'FAMINE_POPULATION_SHARE_IN_STARVATION')|0%]#!#! of the $concept_population$ is $concept_starving$
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$at least #b #r [GetDefine('NPops', 'FAMINE_POPULATION_SHARE_IN_SEVERE_STARVATION')|%0]#!#! is suffering from $concept_severe_starvation$.
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$the state does #b not#! belong to a [concept_decentralized_nation]
concept_food_security_desc: $concept_food_security$ measures how easy or difficult it is for a [concept_pop] to acquire all the food it requires to survive. If a $concept_pop$'s $concept_food_security$ gets too low, it will start suffering from [concept_starvation]. The lower $concept_food_security$ goes, the harsher the effects of $concept_starvation$ will be.\n\nThere are two main factors that affect $concept_food_security$. The first of them is the [concept_shortage] level for the [GetPopNeed('popneed_basic_food').GetName] [Concept('concept_pop_needs','$concept_pop_need_short$')]. The second factor is based on how much [concept_money] the $concept_pop$ is spending on [GetPopNeed('popneed_basic_food').GetNameNoFormatting] compared to the $concept_pop$'s expected expenses at base cost.
concept_starvation_desc:
A [concept_pop] is considered to be $concept_starving$ if their [concept_food_security] is too low. This can be due to the $concept_pop$'s [concept_wealth] being too low or simply because there is not enough [GetPopNeed('popneed_basic_food').GetName] the $concept_pop$ can access.

#b $concept_mild_starvation$#! begins at #b #v [GetDefine('NPops', 'FOOD_SECURITY_STARVATION_THRESHOLD')|0%]#!#! $concept_food_security$ and has reduced effects.
[GetStaticModifier('starvation_penalty').GetDesc]

#r $concept_severe_starvation$#! happens at #b #v [GetDefine('NPops', 'FOOD_SECURITY_SEVERE_STARVATION_THRESHOLD')|0%]#!#! $concept_food_security$ and has harsher effects. If not addressed this will result in the $concept_pop$ dying.
[GetStaticModifier('severe_starvation_penalty').GetDesc]

Additionally, $concept_pops$ suffering from $concept_starvation$ will also [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicalize$')] over time. How many people $concept_radicalize$ and at what rate depends on how low their $concept_food_security$ is.
concept_harvest_condition_desc:
A $concept_harvest_condition$ is an occurrence that primarily affects a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] rural sector with a variable [Concept('concept_harvest_condition_intensity','$concept_harvest_condition_intensity_short$')], duration, and range. It is generally a natural phenomenon and can have either #g positive#! or #r negative#! effects on the [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] it affects. $concept_harvest_conditions$ will mostly affect the [concept_throughput] of agricultural [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')], but they can also have an effect on your [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')] and $concept_states$ in other ways, such as reducing available [concept_infrastructure].

$concept_harvest_conditions$ will often affect $concept_states$ surrounding their #b epicenter#!. In such cases, the [concept_harvest_condition_intensity] will generally decrease as the distance to the #b epicenter#! increases.

#title Potential $concept_harvest_conditions$:#!#indent_newline:3 
[GetHarvestConditionTypesList]#!
concept_harvest_condition_intensity_desc: The $concept_harvest_condition_intensity_short$ of [concept_harvest_condition] multiplies its effects on a [concept_state]. The closer a $concept_state$ is to the epicenter [concept_state_region], the higher the $concept_harvest_condition_intensity_short$ will most likely be.
concept_pop_growth_desc: The net number of [Concept('concept_individual','$concept_individuals$')] a [concept_pop] gains or loses over time is governed by its $concept_pop_growth_birthrate_and_mortality$. Both metrics are governed by [concept_sol] and modified by factors such as disease, dangerous working conditions, beneficial [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institutions$')], and available living space.\n\n@information! External changes to a $concept_pop$'s size due to e.g. [concept_migration] or [concept_casualties] of [concept_war] are not considered $concept_pop_growth$.
concept_individual_desc: An individual is a single person within a [concept_pop], who can be either a [Concept('concept_working_adults','$concept_working_adult$')] or a [Concept('concept_dependents','$concept_dependent$')]. All [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] are made up of $concept_individuals$ with the same [concept_culture], [concept_religion], [concept_profession], and [Concept('concept_building','$concept_building_workplace$')].
concept_jobseeker_desc: A Jobseeker is a [Concept('concept_working_adults', '$concept_working_adult$')] with negative [concept_job_satisfaction] who is not working in a [concept_government_building] or in a [concept_building] being [Concept('concept_subsidies', '$concept_subsidized$')].
concept_building_desc:
$concept_buildings$ drive your [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] economy via the [concept_good_production] (and [concept_good_consumption]) of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')]. They can also produce a number of other useful effects, such as [concept_bureaucracy], [concept_infrastructure], and [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName].

To perform their functions they require a [concept_workforce] made up by [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of different [Concept('concept_profession','$concept_professions$')], who receive a [concept_building_wage] in return for their labor.

What functions a particular $concept_building$ serves is determined by its active [Concept('concept_production_method','$concept_production_methods$')], and the magnitude of its impact is determined by its [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_level_short$')].[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_building_desc_added')]
concept_building_desc_added: \n\nYou can [Concept('concept_construction','$concept_construct$')] new, or expand existing, $concept_buildings$ in each of your [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] using your [GetBuildingType('building_construction_sector').GetName].
concept_building_group_desc:
A $concept_building_group$ is a group of [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] most often used to describe similar $concept_buildings$ needed to fulfill certain conditions in, for example, [Concept('concept_journal_entry','$concept_journal_entries$')].

#title Common $concept_building_groups$ are:#!#indent_newline:3 
• [GetBuildingGroup('bg_agriculture').GetName]
• [GetBuildingGroup('bg_plantations').GetName]
• [GetBuildingGroup('bg_staple_crops').GetName]#!
concept_company_desc: $concept_companies$ are associated with one or several types of [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] in a [concept_country]. When established in said $concept_country$ they increase the [concept_throughput] and @construction![Nbsp][concept_construction] efficiency of their associated $concept_buildings$. The degree to which a $concept_company$ provides benefits depends on the relative [concept_prestige] ranking of the $concept_country$, with $concept_countries$ in the #v Top-[GetDefine('NDiplomacy','TOP_PRESTIGE_RANK_BONUS_THRESHOLD')]#! receiving even stronger bonuses.\n\n$concept_companies$ have a [concept_prosperity] score which increases from high [concept_productivity] and can provide additional bonuses for its $concept_country$.
concept_prosperity_desc: $concept_companies$ have a $concept_prosperity$ score which depends on their [concept_productivity] and number of employed [concept_building] levels, among other factors. When a $concept_company$ reaches [GetDefine('NEconomy','COMPANY_PROSPERITY_BONUS_ACTIVATION_THRESHOLD')|v0] $concept_prosperity$, it will be considered $concept_prosperous$ and activate a bonus [concept_modifier] for its [concept_country].\nIf the $concept_prosperity$ of a $concept_prosperous$ company falls below [GetDefine('NEconomy','COMPANY_PROSPERITY_BONUS_DEACTIVATION_THRESHOLD')|v0] it will no longer be considered $concept_prosperous$ and its bonus $concept_modifier$ will be deactivated.
concept_building_level_desc:
A [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_building_possessive$')] $concept_building_level_short$ scales its current [concept_good_consumption], [concept_good_production], [concept_workforce] requirements, and may apply an [concept_economy_of_scale] bonus.

Expanding a $concept_building$'s $concept_building_level_short$ usually requires [concept_construction], though some $concept_building$'s $concept_building_level_short$ is automatically adjusted based on other factors such as [concept_infrastructure], [Concept('concept_conscription_center','$concept_conscription$')] rate, or unused $concept_arable_land$.

Each $concept_building_level_short$ is either [concept_privately_owned] or [concept_nationally_owned].

The maximum $concept_building_level_short$ a $concept_building$ can be expanded to may depend on the [concept_resource_potential] or [concept_arable_land] in the [concept_state].
concept_diplomatic_play_desc: A $concept_diplomatic_play$ is a period of hostile diplomatic negotiations between two or more [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] that follows after one $concept_country$ makes a demand for a concession by another. To start a $concept_diplomatic_play$ you must have a high enough [concept_interest_tier] in the relevant [concept_strategic_region], which also entitles you to participate in $concept_diplomatic_plays_short$ as a third party in that $concept_strategic_region$.\n\nThe $concept_diplomatic_play$ will [Concept('concept_escalation', '$concept_escalate$')] through three phases: [concept_opening_moves], [concept_diplomatic_maneuvers], and [concept_countdown_to_war]. These phases set the terms for a possible [concept_peace_deal] should the $concept_diplomatic_play$ $concept_escalate$ into a [concept_war]. A $concept_war$ can be averted if either the [concept_initiator] or [concept_target] of the $concept_diplomatic_play_short$ backs down and grants the other their [Concept('concept_primary_demand','$concept_primary_demands$')].
concept_sympathy_desc: All AI-controlled [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] involved in a [concept_diplomatic_play] begin the play with a level of $concept_sympathy$ for each side, which influences how likely they are to support that side in the conflict. AI [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] tend to have higher $concept_sympathy$ for the [concept_target], for countries they have [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')] with, and for those are opposing a [concept_country] with high [concept_infamy]. $concept_sympathy$ can also increase over the course of the [concept_diplomatic_play], as a side that gains powerful backers or accrues [concept_infamy] through adding [Concept('concept_war_goal', '$concept_war_goals$')] tends to generate $concept_sympathy$ for the opposing side.
concept_neutrality_desc: All AI-controlled [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] involved in a [concept_diplomatic_play] have a level of $concept_neutrality$ based on their internal conditions and their general level of interest in the participants of the play. The higher their $concept_neutrality$, the more difficult it will be to convince that [concept_country] to get involved in the play.
concept_confidence_desc: An AI-controlled [concept_country] that is one of the main participants in a [concept_diplomatic_play] has a level of $concept_confidence$ based on their internal conditions and how likely they believe it is that they will be able to win any ensuing war. The chance that the AI [concept_country] will decide to back down is directly determined by their confidence, though this is not guaranteed even at low $concept_confidence$ levels, especially if backing down would lead to their annexation.
concept_maneuver_desc: $concept_maneuvers$ can be spent on taking actions in a [concept_diplomatic_play], including claiming additional [Concept('concept_war_goal', '$concept_war_goals$')] or [Concept('concept_sway','$concept_swaying$')] other [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] to your side. The amount of $concept_maneuvers$ you have is limited by your [concept_rank].
concept_opening_moves_desc: The $concept_opening_moves$ phase is the first phase of a [concept_diplomatic_play]. In this phase the [concept_target] gets to set their primary [concept_war_goal], and both [concept_initiator] and $concept_target$ can claim additional [Concept('concept_war_goal', '$concept_war_goals$')] using [Concept('concept_maneuver', '$concept_maneuvers$')].
concept_diplomatic_maneuvers_desc: The $concept_diplomatic_maneuvers$ phase is the second phase of a [concept_diplomatic_play]. In this phase, the [concept_initiator] and [concept_target] can attempt to [concept_sway] other [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] to their side or claim additional [Concept('concept_war_goal', '$concept_war_goals$')] for themselves, at the cost of [Concept('concept_maneuver', '$concept_maneuvers$')].
concept_countdown_to_war_desc: The $concept_countdown_to_war$ phase is the third and last phase of a [concept_diplomatic_play]. [concept_war] might now be inevitable, with both sides frantically making preparations or considering any last-minute options to back down.\n\n@information! Typical preparations for $concept_war$ includes: [Concept('concept_mobilize_army','$concept_mobilize_army_mobilization$')] of [Concept('concept_army','$concept_armies$')], giving their [Concept('concept_general','$concept_generals$')] [Concept('concept_order','$concept_orders$')] to advance or defend the [Concept('concept_front', '$concept_fronts$')], $concept_conscript_battalion_drafting$ [Concept('concept_conscript_battalion', '$concept_conscript_battalions$')], and promoting your $concept_generals$ to increase their [concept_command_limit] where necessary.
concept_war_leader_desc: One [concept_country] on each side of a [concept_war] is considered the $concept_war_leader$ for that side, usually (but not always) corresponding to the [concept_initiator] and [concept_target] of the [concept_diplomatic_play] that spawned it. They are the only ones who may propose [Concept('concept_peace_deal','$concept_peace_deals$')], though every $concept_peace_deal$ must be ratified by all negotiating members of the $concept_war$ to be accepted.
concept_homeland_desc: A [Concept('concept_culture','$concept_culture_possessive$')] $concept_homelands$ consist of those [Concept('concept_state_region','$concept_state_regions$')] that [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of that $concept_culture$ feel are historically or naturally their territory. $concept_pops$ are more prone to [Concept('concept_migration','$concept_migrate$')] to their $concept_homelands$ than other [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')], and $concept_pops$ who reside there will never consider [Concept('concept_assimilation','$concept_assimilating$')].\n\nLaunching a [concept_diplomatic_play] to conquer a $concept_state$ considered a $concept_homeland$ of one of your [concept_primary_cultures] is considered relatively legitimate, and will generate substantially less [concept_infamy] than usual.
concept_mobilization_option_desc: An [concept_army] can be configured with any number of $concept_mobilization_options$ while in peacetime. Each $concept_mobilization_option_short$ applies a cost in [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] and an effect for all [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] in the $concept_army$ while it is [Concept('concept_mobilize_army','$concept_mobilize_army_mobilized$')].
concept_mobilize_army_desc: $concept_mobilize_army_mobilizing$ an [concept_army] will immediately begin the process of $concept_mobilize_army_mobilization$ for all [Concept('concept_battalion', '$concept_battalions$')] assigned to it. A $concept_mobilize_army_mobilized$ $concept_army$ will automatically stand down once the [concept_country] is no longer at [concept_war]. Early $concept_mobilize_army_demobilization$ while in active warfare is possible, but takes time and a substantial cost.
concept_mobilize_battalion_desc: [Concept('concept_battalion', '$concept_battalions$')] in a [Concept('concept_mobilize_army', '$concept_mobilize_army_mobilized$')] [concept_army] immediately start $concept_mobilize_battalion_mobilizing$ at a rate based on the [concept_infrastructure] of their [concept_state], better $concept_infrastructure$ means more $concept_battalions$ may $concept_mobilize_army_mobilize$ at once. $concept_mobilize_battalion_mobilized$ and $concept_mobilize_battalion_mobilizing$ $concept_battalions$ consume more [Concept('concept_military_good','$concept_military_goods$')] based on their $concept_army$'s [Concept('concept_mobilization_option','$concept_mobilization_options$')], but are fully prepared to follow any of their $concept_army$'s [Concept('concept_general', '$concept_generals$')] into [concept_battle].
concept_fully_mobilized_battalions_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] fully mobilized [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] include all $concept_battalions$ in [Concept('concept_mobilize_army', '$concept_mobilize_army_mobilized$')] [Concept('concept_army', '$concept_armies$')] that have already undergone [Concept('concept_mobilize_battalion','$concept_mobilize_battalion_mobilization$')] and are fully prepared to follow any of their $concept_army$'s [Concept('concept_general', '$concept_generals$')] into [concept_battle].
concept_available_battalions_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] available [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] include all $concept_battalions$ currently raised by [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_available_battalions_desc_added','barracks')] and/or [Concept('concept_conscription_center','$concept_conscription_centers$')].
concept_potential_battalions_desc:
A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] maximum potential [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] is the sum of the its Potential Regular $concept_battalions$ and Potential [Concept('concept_conscript_battalion','$concept_conscript_battalions$')].

#b Potential Regular $concept_battalions$#!: the number of $concept_battalions$ the $concept_country$'s currently constructed [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_potential_battalions_desc_added','barracks')] are able to support

#b Potential $concept_conscript_battalions$#!: the number of $concept_conscript_battalions$ the $concept_country$'s [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_potential_battalions_desc_additional','conscription center')]s would create if [Concept('concept_conscription_center','$concept_conscription$')] had been activated across all [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')]
concept_conscription_center_desc: When a [concept_state] is $concept_conscripted$ during a [concept_diplomatic_play] or [concept_war], a [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_conscription_center_desc_added','conscription center')] appears with a [concept_building_level] depending on its #v $state_conscription_rate_add$#! and $concept_state$ [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')] size. This [concept_military_building] will recruit civilian [concept_workforce] into [Concept('concept_conscript_battalion','$concept_conscript_battalions$')] that will be automatically assigned to [Concept('concept_general','$concept_generals$')] in their [concept_hq] as they are raised.\n\nAfter the $concept_war$, all $concept_conscription_centers$ will deactivate and the $concept_conscript_battalions$ will disband. $concept_pops$ who return to civilian life are not guaranteed to return to their old [concept_profession] but must seek new employment opportunities.
concept_conscription_limit_desc: The max number of [Concept('concept_conscript_battalion', '$concept_conscript_battalions$')] a [concept_state] can recruit. The $concept_conscription_limit$ is calculated from the [concept_workforce] of a $concept_state$ multiplied by its $state_conscription_rate_add$. It cannot exceed the $state_building_conscription_center_max_level_add$ set in place by your [GetLawGroup('lawgroup_army_model').GetName] [concept_law].
concept_strategic_objective_desc: A $concept_strategic_objective$ can be assigned to an [concept_army]. If an enemy or friendly [concept_state] is assigned as an $concept_army_possessive$ $concept_strategic_objective$, any of the $concept_army_possessive$ advancing [Concept('concept_general','$concept_generals$')] will try to advance the [concept_front] towards that $concept_state$. If the $concept_state$ is under friendly control, they will prioritize expanding the defensive perimiter around the $concept_state$. While defending $concept_generals$ will focus on the defence of the $concept_state$ and surrounding areas, prioritizing defensive [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')] closest to the $concept_strategic_objective$.\n\nAn $concept_army$ can have one $concept_strategic_objective$, but several $concept_armies$ can have the same $concept_state$ as their $concept_strategic_objective_short$.
concept_conscript_battalion_desc: $concept_conscript_battalions$ are temporary [Concept('concept_battalion', '$concept_battalions$')] recruited and maintained from the civilian [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')] by [Concept('concept_conscription_center','$concept_conscription_centers$')] and activated during [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] or [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')].\n\n@information! Note that $concept_conscript_battalions$ do not count towards the [concept_command_limit] of an [concept_army] until actually being raised and employed. When raised, only the higher of your regular [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] or $concept_conscript_battalions$ is compared against the $concept_command_limit$, so raising $concept_conscript_battalions$ will only strain the limit if you have more of them than regular $concept_battalions$.
concept_front_desc: A collection of [Concept('concept_province', '$concept_provinces$')] on the border of [Concept('concept_theater','$concept_theaters$')] between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] at [concept_war] with each other. [Concept('concept_general', '$concept_generals$')] can be [Concept('concept_order','$concept_ordered$')] to advance or defend $concept_fronts$, which can result in [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')] that change the size of the $concept_theaters$ and the location of the $concept_front$.
concept_advancement_progress_desc: [Concept('concept_general','$concept_generals$')] [Concept('concept_order','$concept_ordered$')] to advance a [concept_front] accumulate $concept_advancement_progress$ daily depending on their [concept_advancement_speed]. Once the $concept_advancement_progress$ of the $concept_front$ has reached [GetDefine('NMilitary','BATTLE_PLAN_ADVANCE_PROGRESS_TO_LAUNCH')|v0] a [concept_battle] will start. While a $concept_battle$ is ongoing on the $concept_front$, $concept_advancement_progress$ on that $concept_front$ will be paused.
concept_advancement_speed_desc: How rapidly a [concept_general] can advance their [concept_front] by accumulating [concept_advancement_progress].\nA $concept_general$ with no [Concept('concept_mobilize_battalion','$concept_mobilize_battalion_mobilized$')] [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] has an effective $concept_advancement_speed$ of zero.
concept_province_desc: Subdivisions of [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')], each with its own [concept_terrain]. $concept_provinces$ are transferred between $concept_states$ during [Concept('concept_colony','$concept_colonization$')], and can be temporarily transferred between [Concept('concept_theater','$concept_theaters$')] during [concept_war] as the outcome of [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')].
concept_battle_condition_desc: During [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')] each side will be affected by a $concept_battle_condition$ that influences the outcome. Which $concept_battle_condition_short$ applies depends on a number of factors, which often includes the [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] of the [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')] in charge of that side.
concept_naval_battle_condition_desc: [Concept('concept_naval_battle','$concept_naval_battles$')] are affected by a $concept_naval_battle_condition$ that influences everyone involved in the battle. Which $concept_naval_battle_condition_short$ applies depends on a number of factors, which often includes any [concept_harvest_condition] affecting the location of the $concept_naval_battle$.
concept_army_desc:
An $concept_army$ is a land [Concept('concept_military_formation','$concept_military_formation$')] composed of $combat_unit_group_infantry$, $combat_unit_group_artillery$ and $combat_unit_group_cavalry$ [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')], led by a [concept_general] who lends bonuses from his [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] and [Concept('concept_order','$concept_orders$')] to the whole $concept_army$.

When deployed to a [Concept('concept_front','$concept_front$')], an $concept_army$ executes its $concept_order$ such as #b $advance$#! or #b $defend$#!, fighting [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')] against any enemy $concept_armies$ present on that $concept_front$. How well it fights depends on the [Concept('concept_offense','$concept_offense$')] and [Concept('concept_defense','$concept_defense$')] of its $concept_battalions$ and their [concept_morale].

An $concept_army$ must be ordered to [Concept('concept_mobilize_army','$concept_mobilize_army_mobilize$')] before its $concept_battalions$ are ready to fight, and stands down again automatically once the [concept_war] ends. Before $concept_mobilize_army_mobilizing$, the $concept_army$ can be configured with [Concept('concept_mobilization_option','$concept_mobilization_options$')] that apply effects to its $concept_battalions$ at a cost of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] while $concept_mobilize_army_mobilized$.
concept_fleet_desc:
A $concept_fleet$ is a naval [Concept('concept_military_formation','$concept_military_formation$')] composed of [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')], led by an [concept_admiral] who lends bonuses from his [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] and [Concept('concept_order','$concept_orders$')] to the whole $concept_military_formation$.

It can be sent on [Concept('concept_naval_mission','$concept_naval_missions$')] like [GetNavalMissionType('naval_mission_type_intercept').GetName], [GetNavalMissionType('naval_mission_type_blockade').GetName], and [GetNavalMissionType('naval_mission_type_port_bombardment').GetName] covering several [Concept('concept_sea_node','$concept_sea_regions$')], clashing in [Concept('concept_naval_battle','$concept_naval_battles$')] with any hostile $concept_fleets$ that they find (or that find them).

$concept_fleets$ tend to take a long time to build up, and many $concept_ships$ become obsolete over time as they cannot always be upgraded. Think carefully before investing too heavily into large $concept_fleets$.
concept_battle_desc: When two [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')] encounter each other and come into conflict during a [concept_war], they and their [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] will clash in an attempt to inflict [concept_casualties] and damage each others' [concept_morale]. The side whose [concept_manpower] has run out or become $concept_morale_demoralized$ first will withdraw, leaving the other side victorious.\n\nOn land, $concept_battles$ take place in [Concept('concept_province','$concept_provinces$')] adjacent to [Concept('concept_front','$concept_fronts$')] when one [concept_general] is advancing to take or regain $concept_province_land$. The winner will either conquer more $concept_provinces$ or prevent the enemy from doing so.
concept_naval_battle_desc: When two [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')] encounter each other and come into conflict during a [concept_war], they and their [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')] will clash in an attempt to inflict [concept_casualties] and sink each other' $concept_ships$. The side whose $concept_ships$ have all been destroyed or disengaged will withdraw, leaving the other side victorious.\n\n$concept_naval_battles$ take place in Sea Nodes when one [concept_admiral] intercepts another due to conflicting [Concept('concept_order','$concept_orders$')]. The winner leaves their opponent damaged and forces them to return to port for repairs, leaving them unable to execute their $concept_order$ for a time.
concept_timed_modifier_desc: A [concept_modifier] with an expiry date, after which it will disappear. $concept_timed_modifiers$ can either maintain its full effect up until its expiry date, or [concept_decay] gradually until the date has been reached.
concept_modifier_desc: Any adjustment of a value away from its norm is considered a $concept_modifier$. These can be indefinite or [Concept('concept_timed_modifier','$concept_timed$')], and their origin can always be sourced back to something like a [concept_law], [concept_technology], [concept_institution], [concept_building], [concept_character_trait], or even an option selected during a special event. Values adjusted by $concept_modifiers$ all have tooltips that explain the full list of sources and their values.
concept_terrain_desc: A [Concept('concept_province','$concept_province_possessive$')] $concept_terrain$ determines its [concept_combat_width] and how volatile and unpredictable [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')] in that $concept_province$ is. [Concept('concept_general','$concept_generals$')] can also be more or less versed in fighting in different types of $concept_terrain$.\n\nThe $concept_terrain$ of a given $concept_province$ can change as a result of the [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] constructed in the [concept_state].
concept_strategic_region_desc: A collection of [Concept('concept_state_region', '$concept_state_regions$')] considered a region of strategic importance. [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] have an [concept_interest] in all $concept_strategic_regions_short$ where they have generated sufficient [concept_involvement].\n\nMaintaining a high enough [concept_interest_tier] in a $concept_strategic_region$ is a prerequisite to participate in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] taking place there.
concept_regional_objective_desc: A specific goal a [concept_country] is trying to achieve within a [concept_strategic_region] dependent on the [concept_strategic_region_stance] it holds there.
concept_strategic_region_stance_desc: A $concept_strategic_region_stance_short$ is an indication of a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] foreign policy views within a specific [concept_strategic_region].\n\nThis can affect how a $concept_country$ reacts to a [concept_diplomatic_play] or whether it wants to launch one itself, as well as the [concept_attitude] that it develops towards $concept_countries$ in that $concept_strategic_region_short$.
concept_sway_desc: The [concept_initiator] or [concept_target] in a [concept_diplomatic_play] can attempt to $concept_sway$ any other [concept_country] with a high enough [concept_interest_tier] in the [concept_strategic_region] to their side, by offering a [concept_war_goal] or other promise such as an [concept_obligation]. Attempting to $concept_sway$ a $concept_country$ costs [Concept('concept_maneuver','$concept_maneuvers$')], and the chance an AI $concept_country$ will accept the offer depends on your [concept_relations] and their [concept_attitude] to you as well as your opponent.
concept_offer_support_desc: A participant in a [concept_diplomatic_play] can $concept_offer_support$ to the [concept_initiator] or [concept_target] in a [concept_diplomatic_play]. This works exactly like a [concept_sway], with the exception that it is the potential supporter that sets the terms of what they are willing to be [Concept('concept_sway','$concept_swayed$')] with, but does not cost any [Concept('concept_maneuver','$concept_maneuvers$')] for either side.
concept_diplomatic_demand_desc: A $concept_diplomatic_demand$ is a single [concept_war_goal] which one [concept_country] demands from another. If the $concept_diplomatic_demand$ is rejected, a [concept_diplomatic_play] will start with the demanded [concept_war_goal] as the [concept_primary_demand] of the [concept_initiator].
concept_diplomatic_action_desc: A broad term for interactions between two [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] that includes [Concept('concept_instant_diplomatic_action','$concept_instant_diplomatic_actions$')], [Concept('concept_ongoing_diplomatic_action','$concept_ongoing_diplomatic_actions$')], and [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')]. They differ from [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] in that no third party is allowed to have a say in its outcome, and there is no risk the action on its own might escalate into [concept_war].
concept_subject_action_desc: A type of [concept_diplomatic_action] that [Concept('concept_subject','$concept_subjects$')] can issue against their [concept_overlord].
concept_overlord_action_desc: A type of [concept_diplomatic_action] that [Concept('concept_overlord','$concept_overlords$')] can issue against their [Concept('concept_subject','$concept_subjects$')].
concept_bloc_member_action_desc: A type of [concept_diplomatic_action] that [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')] can issue against other [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')], including the [Concept('concept_power_bloc_leader','$concept_power_bloc_leader_short$')].
concept_bloc_leader_action_desc: A type of [concept_diplomatic_action] that [Concept('concept_power_bloc_leader','$concept_power_bloc_leaders_short$')] can issue against [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')].
concept_government_building_desc:
A [concept_building] owned and operated by the [concept_government] using funds from the [concept_treasury].

$concept_government_buildings$ have no [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] [concept_good_production] and therefore no [concept_revenue], but produce a number of other resources crucial to running a [concept_country] such as [concept_bureaucracy], [concept_infrastructure], [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName], and [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')].

The [concept_workforce] of non-military $concept_government_buildings$ get paid according to the [concept_government_wage], while [Concept('concept_military_building','$concept_military_buildings$')] get paid according to the [concept_military_wage].

$concept_government_buildings$ are always fully [concept_nationally_owned]
concept_military_building_desc: [Concept('concept_government_building','$concept_government_buildings$')] used to train, maintain, and supply [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] and [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')] for the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] army and navy respectively. The [concept_workforce] of $concept_military_buildings$ get paid according to the [concept_military_wage].
concept_incorporated_state_desc: [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] that are fully integrated into a [concept_country]. [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in $concept_incorporated_states$ pay taxes, gain access to benefits from [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institutions$')], and participate fully in the Country's political system. [Concept('concept_unincorporated_state','$concept_unincorporated_states$')] can be $concept_incorporated$ through a sometimes lengthy process.
concept_capacity_desc: A measure of your [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] capabilities in one of three areas: [concept_bureaucracy], [concept_authority], and [concept_influence]. $concept_capacities$ are not stored and used, but continuously generated from different sources and continually expended by the various projects you have going on. Your remaining balance in each area is displayed in the top bar. Having an excess of a $concept_capacity$ will yield a minor bonus for your $concept_country$, while having a lack of a $concept_capacity$ will inflict large penalties.
concept_bureaucracy_desc: @bur! Bureaucracy is a [concept_capacity] used to maintain your [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] administrative cohesion and day-to-day operations. The cost increases with the population across your [Concept('concept_incorporated_state', '$concept_incorporated_states$')] and with every [concept_institution] investment level, and is also used to administer [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')]. You gain @bur! from operating [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_bureaucracy_desc_added','Government Administration')] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')].
concept_authority_desc: @aut! Authority is a [concept_capacity] used to effect internal change to your [concept_country], like issuing [Concept('concept_decree', '$concept_decrees$')] or managing [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')]. You gain @aut! from [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')].
concept_influence_desc: @inf! Influence is a [concept_capacity] used for [Concept('concept_diplomatic_action', '$concept_diplomatic_actions$')], [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts_short$')] and [Concept('concept_treaty', '$concept_treaties$')] targeting another [concept_country]. You gain @inf! based on your [concept_rank].
concept_institution_desc: $concept_institutions$ provide benefits to [Concept('concept_incorporated_state', '$concept_incorporated_states$')] across your [concept_country]. They cost [concept_bureaucracy] to maintain in proportion to the number of [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] living in your $concept_incorporated_states$ and the $concept_institution$'s investment level. Higher levels increase both the cost and the effect. Adjusting investment levels take a set amount of time.
concept_law_desc: $concept_laws$ sets the ground rules for how your [concept_country] operates and is governed. The effects of a $concept_law$ are determined both by the base effects of the $concept_law$ and those of any [Concept('concept_amendment','$concept_amendments$')] attached to it. Certain $concept_laws$ enable [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institutions$')] that provide further control. $concept_enactment_of_laws_potential$
concept_amendment_desc: An $concept_amendment$ is an addition to a [concept_law] that alters its effects, sponsored by a specific [concept_interest_group]. If an $concept_interest$ will [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_endorse_or_oppose$')] an $concept_amendment$ is determined by the [concept_parent_law] of the $concept_amendment$. $concept_amendment_repeal_desc$
concept_amendment_repeal_desc: An [concept_amendment] may be $concept_repealed$ if the $concept_amendment$ is not on cooldown, and any [concept_interest_group] in [concept_government] [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_opposes$')] the $concept_amendment$'s [concept_parent_law].
concept_parent_law_desc: The $concept_parent_law$ of an [concept_amendment] determines the [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_stance$')] of an [concept_ideology] towards the $concept_amendment$. Each [concept_interest_group] will then [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_endorse_or_oppose$')] an $concept_amendment$ depending on their $concept_ideologies$.
concept_enactment_setback_desc: While [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enacting$')] a [concept_law] you may suffer $concept_enactment_setbacks_short$. This could be due to a [Concept('concept_enactment_stall','$concept_enactment_stall_short$')] result at the $concept_enactment_of_laws_enactment$ checkpoint, a consequence of a [Concept('concept_enactment_debate','$concept_enactment_debate_short$')], or that [concept_enactment_success] chance fell below #v 0#!. If you accumulate too many $concept_enactment_setbacks_short$, the $concept_enactment_of_laws_enactment$ #r fails#!.\n\n@warning! If the enactment #r fails#!, you will not be able to attempt to enact that $concept_law$ again for #v [GetDefine('NPolitics','LAW_ENACTMENT_COOLDOWN_DAYS')|0] days#!.
concept_enactment_phase_desc: To [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enact$')] a [concept_law] you must successfully guide it through [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'LAW_ENACTMENT_MAX_PHASES')|v] $concept_enactment_phases_short$ [AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_enactment_phase_ingame_added')]by achieving [Concept('concept_enactment_success','$concept_enactment_successes$')]. During this process there is a risk of getting [Concept('concept_enactment_setback','$concept_enactment_setbacks$')] that may cause the $concept_enactment_of_laws_enactment$ to #r fail#!.
concept_money_desc: $concept_money$ makes the world go 'round. It is used to pay for [Concept('concept_government_wage','$concept_government_wages$')] and [concept_bureaucracy] production, [concept_construction] materials, industry [concept_subsidies], [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName] for your [Concept('concept_shipping_lane','$concept_shipping_lanes$')], and last but probably not least, your military. You gain $concept_money$ by [Concept('concept_taxes','$concept_taxing$')] your [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] and enforcing [concept_tariffs]. Excess $concept_money$ in your [concept_treasury] balance is used to pay off your [concept_loans] or stockpile gold in your [concept_gold_reserves]. Insufficient $concept_money$ increases your $concept_loans$ towards your [Concept('concept_credit','$concept_credit_limit$')], which is determined by how much $concept_money$ is in your $concept_buildings$' [concept_cash_reserves].
concept_workforce_desc: The $concept_workforce$ of a [concept_building] consists of [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of different [Concept('concept_profession', '$concept_professions$')] depending on the currently active [Concept('concept_production_method', '$concept_production_methods$')].
concept_gold_reserves_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] weekly budget surplus is accumulated in its $concept_gold_reserves$. If the budget balance becomes negative, any [concept_money] in the $concept_gold_reserves$ will be depleted first before the $concept_country$ starts taking [concept_loans]. The $concept_gold_reserves$ can only accumulate up to a fraction of your [concept_gdp] before diminishing returns set in. Stockpiling gold will eventually lead to depleting your economic engine.
concept_cash_reserves_desc: The assets of a [concept_building] are stored in its $concept_cash_reserves$. If the $concept_building$ runs a positive weekly [concept_building_balance], some of the [concept_money] is deposited into the $concept_cash_reserves$ while the rest is paid out to the [concept_building_owners] as [concept_dividends].\n\n$concept_cash_reserves$ are considered to be owned by the $concept_building_owners$, and [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] will get angry if their $concept_cash_reserves$ are lost due to [concept_bankruptcy]. The sum of all $concept_cash_reserves$ in your [concept_country] determines your [concept_credit].
concept_obsession_desc: A [concept_culture] can be $concept_obsessed$ with specific [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')]. [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of that $concept_culture$ will spend significantly more on $concept_goods$ they are $concept_obsessed$ with compared to other $concept_goods$ in the same [concept_pop_needs] category.
concept_taboo_desc: A [concept_religion] can be have a $concept_taboo$ against specific [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')]. [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of that $concept_religion$ will spend significantly less on $concept_goods$ they consider $concept_taboo$ compared to other $concept_goods$ in the same [concept_pop_needs] category.
concept_goods_substitution_desc:
A [Concept('concept_pop_needs','$concept_pop_need$')] can be fulfilled by any of the [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] it consists of, and the availability of each $concept_good$ determines how much it is consumed.

For example, the [GetPopNeed('popneed_basic_food').GetName] $concept_pop_need$ contains both [GetGoods('grain').GetName] and [GetGoods('meat').GetName]. [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] will typically consume more [GetGoods('grain').GetName] and less [GetGoods('meat').GetName]. However, if [GetGoods('meat').GetName] becomes more available than [GetGoods('grain').GetName], they will shift towards consuming more [GetGoods('meat').GetName] and less [GetGoods('grain').GetName] instead. In some cases, $concept_pops$ may even stop consuming a $concept_good$ entirely if there is no availability for that $concept_good$.

Additionally, [Concept('concept_culture','$concept_cultural$')] [Concept('concept_obsession','$concept_obsessions$')] and [Concept('concept_religion','$concept_religious$')] [Concept('concept_taboo','$concept_taboos$')] can significantly affect the consumption of certain $concept_goods$.

$concept_goods$ with a higher $concept_base_price$ will contribute more to fulfilling a $concept_pop_need$ than those with a lower $concept_base_price$. For instance, a single unit of [GetGoods('groceries').GetName] is equivalent to several units of [GetGoods('grain').GetName].
concept_market_price_desc: The price of a [concept_good] in the [concept_market]. It is based on [concept_buy_orders] and [concept_sell_orders], and affect the [concept_local_price] of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] in all participating [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] depending on their [concept_market_access].\n\nThe degree to which the $concept_market_price$ influences the [concept_local_price] is calculated by multiplying the [concept_market_access] with the [Concept('concept_state','$concept_state_possessive$')] #v $state_market_access_price_impact$#! modifier.
concept_local_price_desc: The price of a [concept_good] in a [concept_state]. It is determined by the local [concept_good_consumption] and [concept_good_production], moderated by the [concept_market_price] depending on the [Concept('concept_state','$concept_state_possessive$')] [concept_market_access] and #v $state_market_access_price_impact$#! modifier. All transactions occur in the $concept_local_price$, with purchases and sales creating [Concept('concept_buy_orders','$concept_buy_order_short$')] and [concept_sell_orders] on the [concept_market].
concept_world_market_price_desc: The average price at which a [concept_good] is traded on the [concept_world_market]. This is dependent on the number of [Concept('concept_trade','$concept_exports$')] versus $concept_imports$ of that $concept_good$.
concept_import_price_desc: The price at which a [concept_good] is imported from the [concept_world_market] in a specific [concept_state]. This is based on both the [concept_world_market_price] and the $concept_state_possessive$ relative [concept_trade_advantage].
concept_export_price_desc: The price at which a [concept_good] is exported to the [concept_world_market] in a specific [concept_state]. This is based on both the [concept_world_market_price] and the $concept_state_possessive$ relative [concept_trade_advantage].
concept_local_good_desc: $concept_local_goods$ are certain [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] that are not available in the wider [concept_market] outside the [concept_state] where they are produced. Their price is fully determined by local [concept_good_production] and [concept_good_consumption], with [concept_market_price] not factored in at all.
concept_subsistence_building_desc: A set of [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')] that perform low-intensity, decentralized production of food and basic resource [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] suitable for mere survival. Their production is split between a small quantity of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] to be sold on the [concept_market] and [concept_subsistence_output] used to sustain the meager [concept_sol] of the [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_subsistence_building_desc_added','Peasants')] who work there. They are considerably less effective than most $concept_buildings$, but will operate on any unclaimed [concept_arable_land] and does not require manual [concept_construction].
concept_economy_of_scale_desc: Many [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] become more efficient the larger they get. Such $concept_buildings$ gain the following effects for every [concept_building_level] beyond the first:\n[GetStaticModifier('economy_of_scale').GetDesc][AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_economy_of_scale_desc_ingame_added')]
concept_economy_of_scale_desc_ingame_add: \n\nYour current national level cap for $concept_economy_of_scale$ effects is [GetPlayer.GetModifier.GetValueWithBreakdownFor('building_economy_of_scale_level_cap_add')].
concept_interest_group_desc: A political faction within your [concept_country] that share a common interest. They are supported by [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in relation to their [Concept('concept_interest_group_attraction','$concept_interest_group_attraction_short$')] to them, and the [concept_clout] they enjoy is based directly on the supporting $concept_pops$' [concept_political_strength]. $concept_interest_groups$ have a number of [Concept('concept_ideology', '$concept_ideologies$')], causing them to [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_endorse_or_oppose$')] different [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')].\n\nThey also have three [Concept('concept_interest_group_trait', '$concept_interest_group_traits$')] that are activated on different [concept_approval] levels. Their [Concept('concept_leader','$concept_leader_possessive$')] personal $concept_ideology$ also rubs off on the $concept_interest_group$.
concept_interest_group_attraction_desc: How likely [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] are to support a particular [concept_interest_group]. Influenced by the $concept_pop$'s properties, such as [concept_profession], [concept_wealth], and [concept_education_access], a high $concept_interest_group_attraction_short$ means the $concept_pop$ feels it's likely this $concept_interest_group$ represents their political interests.
