concept_politician_desc: A [concept_character] that is actively engaged in the day-to-day politics of their [concept_interest_group]. $concept_politicians$ are eligible to become its next [concept_leader] even if their [concept_prominence] is below [GetDefine('NCharacters','PROMINENCE_SIGNIFICANT_THRESHOLD')|v].
concept_leader_desc: The [concept_character] who leads an [concept_interest_group] has a set of [Concept('concept_character_trait', '$concept_character_traits$')] that affect it, and a personal [concept_ideology] that is added to the $concept_interest_group$'s $concept_ideologies$ for as long as that $concept_leader$ is in charge.
concept_interest_group_trait_desc:
All [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] have three $concept_interest_group_traits_short$ that take effect on different levels of [concept_approval] and have a considerable impact on the whole [concept_country].
A negative $concept_interest_group_trait_short$ will activate if $concept_approval$ drops below $ig_approval_unhappy$ (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics','APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_UNHAPPY')|0=+]#!)
A positive $concept_interest_group_trait_short$ will activate if $concept_approval$ exceeds $ig_approval_happy$ (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics','APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_HAPPY')|0=+]#!)
An additional positive $concept_interest_group_trait_short$ will activate if $concept_approval$ exceeds $ig_approval_loyal$ (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics','APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_LOYAL')|0=+]#!).
Once active, the $concept_interest_group_trait_short$ will not deactivate until $concept_approval$ is at least [GetDefine('NPolitics','IG_TRAIT_STICKINESS')|v] points away from the threshold.

The $concept_interest_group_traits_short$ of [concept_marginalized] $concept_interest_groups$ never activate, while the $concept_interest_group_traits_short$ of [concept_powerful] $concept_interest_groups$ have increased effect.
concept_decay_desc: A $concept_decaying$ effect will gradually decrease in intensity, starting from its initial value and decreasing linearly down to #v 0#! over the stated decay duration.
concept_character_trait_desc: Personality $concept_character_traits_short$, Skill $concept_character_traits_short$, or Conditions that impact a [Concept('concept_character','$concept_character_possessive$')] ability to carry out their current [concept_character_role]. More or different $concept_character_traits$ may develop as the $concept_character$ gains [concept_life_experience].
concept_construction_queue_desc: Any [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')] that have been set to be expanded, but are currently not using any [concept_construction], are placed in the $concept_construction_queue$. Whenever any $concept_construction$ becomes available, the first $concept_building$ in the $concept_construction_queue$ will start using that $concept_construction$ and then switch to being [concept_under_construction].
concept_government_construction_desc:
A $concept_government_construction$ is a [concept_building] that is being expanded on the direct orders of a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_government].

It can draw funds directly from the state treasury and can be reprioritized or removed from the [concept_construction_queue].

The resulting [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_levels$')] become [concept_nationally_owned]
concept_private_construction_desc:
A $concept_private_construction$ is a [concept_building] that is being expanded on the orders of private actors.

It is always funded by the [concept_investment_pool] and cannot be can be reprioritized or removed from the [concept_construction_queue].

The resulting [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_levels$')] become [concept_privately_owned]
concept_under_construction_desc: When a [concept_building] is using [concept_construction] it is considered being $concept_under_construction$.
concept_urbanization_desc: $concept_urbanization$ is generated by most [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')] constructed in a [concept_state] to varying degrees. When sufficient $concept_urbanization$ has accumulated in a $concept_state$, an [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_urbanization_desc_added','Urban Center')] will be automatically expanded.
concept_endorse_oppose_desc: An [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_group_possessive$')] $concept_endorsement$ or $concept_opposition$ of a [concept_law] is determined by their [Concept('concept_ideology','$concept_ideologies$')]. $concept_enactment_of_laws_potential$
concept_ideology_desc: An [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_group_possessive$')] $concept_ideology$ influences which [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] it [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_endorses_and_opposes$')]. Their stance on the $concept_laws$ which are currently in effect in the [concept_country] have small, permanent effects on the $concept_interest_group$'s [concept_approval]. While a $concept_country$ is trying to [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enact$')] a new $concept_law$, a larger but temporary effect applies relative to which $concept_law$ is being removed and which is coming into effect. This temporary effect will eventually [concept_decay], leaving only the permanent, objective effect on $concept_approval$.
concept_presidency_stability_desc:
$concept_presidency_stability$ is a metric for the level of unrest within one of the three [Concept('concept_presidency', '$concept_presidencies$')] of colonial India.

#title The stability of a $concept_presidency$ falls within one of four brackets:#! #indent_newline:3 
#r Critical#!: #v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('uneasy_raj_stability_critical_lower_bound')]#!-#v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('uneasy_raj_stability_critical_upper_bound')]#!
#b Low#!: #v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('uneasy_raj_stability_low_lower_bound')]#!-#v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('uneasy_raj_stability_low_upper_bound')]#!
#b Medium#!: #v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('uneasy_raj_stability_medium_lower_bound')]#!-#v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('uneasy_raj_stability_medium_upper_bound')]#!
#b High#!: #v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('uneasy_raj_stability_high_lower_bound')]#!-#v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('uneasy_raj_stability_high_upper_bound')]#!#!

#title The following conditions in a $concept_presidency$ #r decrease#! its stability:#! #indent_newline:3 
• [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] in [concept_turmoil] in the $concept_presidency$
• [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] with #bold high#! [concept_liberty_desire] in the $concept_presidency$#!

#title The following conditions in the East India Company #r decrease#! stability:#! #indent_newline:3 
• #bold Low#! [concept_approval] of [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant]
• #bold High#! [concept_taxes] in the East India Company
• #bold Low#! [Concept('concept_military_wage','$concept_military_wages$')] in the East India Company
• [GetIdeology('ideology_utilitarian_leader').GetName] leaders in [concept_government]
• #bold Not#! having the [GetLawType('law_total_separation').GetName] [concept_law]
• #bold Not#! having the [GetLawType('law_professional_army').GetName] [concept_law]
• Events and other effects #!

#title The following conditions #g increase#! the stability of a $concept_presidency$:#! #indent_newline:3 
• [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] with [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalists$')] in the $concept_presidency$
• [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] with #bold low#! [concept_liberty_desire] in the $concept_presidency$#!

#title The following conditions in the East India Company #g increase#! stability:#! #indent_newline:3 
• Native #b Indian#! [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] [concept_in_government]
• #bold High#! [concept_approval] of [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant]
• #bold Low#! [concept_taxes] in the East India Company
• #bold High#! [Concept('concept_military_wage','$concept_military_wages$')] in the East India Company
• Events and other effects#!
concept_presidency_desc:
The $concept_presidencies$ are the highest level administrative units of colonial India. There are three $concept_presidencies$, with borders delineated by [Concept('concept_georegion','$concept_georegions$')].

#bold Bengal Presidency#!
#title $concept_georegions$:#! [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_bengal_old').GetName], [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_central_india_old').GetName], and [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_punjab_old').GetName].

#bold Bombay Presidency#!
#title $concept_georegions$:#! [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_bombay_old').GetName].

#bold Madras Presidency#!
#title $concept_georegions$:#! [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_madras_old').GetName].
concept_court_intrigue_desc:
$concept_court_intrigue$ represents the progress of various plots to overthrow the $RULER_TITLE_MAHARAJA$ ([concept_ruler]). $concept_court_intrigue_short$ is tracked in the #b $je_sikh_sovereignty$#! [concept_journal_entry]. If $concept_court_intrigue_short$ reaches #v 100%#!, the $RULER_TITLE_MAHARAJA$ ($concept_ruler$) will be assassinated, [concept_empire_stability] will be #bold reset#! to #v 0#!, $concept_court_intrigue_short$ will decrease, and a new candidate will be enthroned.

#title The following conditions #g #b decrease#!#! $concept_court_intrigue$:#! #indent_newline:3 
• $RULER_TITLE_MAHARAJA$ ([concept_ruler]) is #b $Ranjit$ $Singh$#!
• [GetCharacterTrait('ruthless').GetName] [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')] [concept_in_government] with [concept_approval] above #v 5#!
• [GetCharacterTrait('compliant').GetName] [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')] [concept_in_government]
• [concept_ruler] [concept_interest_group] is [concept_powerful]
• High [concept_legitimacy]
• Events and other effects #!

#title The following conditions #r #b increase#!#! $concept_court_intrigue$:#! #indent_newline:3 
• [GetCharacterTrait('reckless').GetName] [concept_ruler]
• Low [concept_ruler] [concept_popularity]
• [GetCharacterTrait('ruthless').GetName] [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')] [concept_in_government] or [concept_in_opposition] with [concept_approval] below #v 0#!
• [GetCharacterTrait('ambitious').GetName] [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')] [concept_in_government] or [concept_in_opposition] with [concept_approval] below #v 0#!
• [concept_ruler] [concept_interest_group] is [concept_marginalized]
• Low [concept_legitimacy]
• Events and other effects#!
concept_empire_stability_desc:
$concept_empire_stability$ represents the strength of the $RULER_TITLE_MAHARAJA$ ([concept_ruler]). [Concept('concept_empire_stability','$concept_empire_stability_short$')] is tracked in the #b $je_sikh_sovereignty$#! [concept_journal_entry].

Legitimacy must be above #v 50#! for $concept_empire_stability_short$ to increase. If [concept_court_intrigue] reaches #v 100%#!, the $RULER_TITLE_MAHARAJA$ ($concept_ruler$) will be assassinated, $concept_empire_stability_short$ will be #bold reset#! to #v 0#!, $concept_court_intrigue_short$ will decrease, and a new candidate will be enthroned.

#title The following conditions #g #b increase#!#! $concept_empire_stability$:#! #indent_newline:3 
• [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_armed_forces',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] [concept_interest_group] is [concept_in_government]
• [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_armed_forces',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] [concept_interest_group] is [concept_powerful]
• [GetReligion('sikh').GetName] is the [concept_state_religion]
• [GetLawType('law_freedom_of_conscience').GetName] [concept_law] is [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enacted$')]
• Events and other conditions #!

#title The following conditions #r #b decrease#!#! $concept_empire_stability$:#! #indent_newline:3 
• [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_armed_forces',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] [concept_interest_group] is not [concept_in_government]
• [concept_court_intrigue] reaches #v 100%#!
• Events and other conditions #!
concept_ottoman_integrity_desc:
$concept_ottoman_integrity$ represents the stability of $dyn_c_ottoman_empire_adj$ in the [GetStrategicRegion('region_balkans').GetName] [concept_strategic_region] under threat of [Concept('concept_secession','$concept_secessionist$')] [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')]. [Concept('concept_ottoman_integrity','$concept_ottoman_integrity_short$')] is tracked in the #b $je_great_eastern_crisis$#! [concept_journal_entry].

[concept_activism] for all $concept_secessionist$ $concept_political_movements$ in $dyn_c_ottoman_empire$ must be #b below#! #v 75#! for $concept_ottoman_integrity_short$ to increase.

#title The following conditions #g #b increase#!#! $concept_ottoman_integrity$:#! #indent_newline:3 
• [concept_legitimacy] in $dyn_c_ottoman_empire$ is #v 50#! or #b above#!
• $dyn_c_ottoman_empire$ is #r #b not#!#! at [concept_war]
• $dyn_c_ottoman_empire$ does #r #b not#!#! have any growing [Concept('concept_secession','$concept_secessionist$')] [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')]
• $dyn_c_ottoman_empire$ has recently crushed a [concept_secession]#!
concept_subsistence_output_desc: A form of in-kind income that [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_subsistence_output_desc_added','Peasants')] generate from [Concept('concept_subsistence_building','$concept_subsistence_building_farming$')], which represents the work they perform producing [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] to cover their own [Concept('concept_pop_needs','$concept_pop_needs_short$')]. Unlike [Concept('concept_building_wage','$concept_building_wages$')], $concept_subsistence_output$ is not paid out from the $concept_building$'s [concept_revenue] and is not subject to [concept_budget_income_taxes].
concept_split_state_desc: A [concept_state_region] split into multiple smaller [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] belonging to different [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')]. When split, a portion of the [Concept('concept_resource_potential','$concept_resource_potentials$')], [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')], and [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] are redistributed between the $concept_states$. Should one $concept_country$ take control of more than one part of the $concept_split_state$, these will be combined into a single $concept_state$.
concept_unincorporated_state_desc: A [concept_state] that is within a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] domain, but considered a territorial holding or frontier beyond the reach of [Concept('concept_institution','$concept_institutions$')] and [concept_government]. [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] who live in $concept_unincorporated_states$ are disenfranchised and do not contribute much [concept_political_strength] to their [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')], nor can they [Concept('concept_votes','$concept_vote$')] in [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elections$')]. On the upside (for them) they are exempt from [Concept('concept_taxes','$concept_taxation$')].\n\n$concept_unincorporated_states$ do not cost [concept_bureaucracy] to maintain, as $concept_taxes$ are not collected and $concept_institutions$ do not provide any benefits there. $concept_unincorporated_states$ can be [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporated$')], which will put it under the direct management of the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] central authority.[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_unincorporated_state_desc_added')]
concept_decentralized_nation_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_nation$')] that share most properties of $concept_countries$ - [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')], a [concept_ruler], [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')], [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] and so on - but with a lack of centralized power (and/or will) to enforce borders. This makes them prone to [Concept('concept_colony','$concept_colonization$')] by $concept_countries$ who do not see them as equals to be properly [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_play_negotiated$')] with for land rights.\n\n$concept_decentralized_nations$ are AI controlled and are not playable by humans.
concept_arable_land_desc: The amount of land in a [concept_state] that can be used for cultivating crops or raising cattle. Unlike [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] that require certain [Concept('concept_resource_potential','$concept_resource_potentials$')] to be constructed, $concept_arable_land$ must be shared between the $concept_building$ types that require it.\n\nThe amount of $concept_arable_land$ that stands unused by other $concept_buildings$ may be used for [Concept('concept_subsistence_building','$concept_subsistence_buildings$')], letting [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] eke out a meager living even if not gainfully employed.
concept_state_region_desc: A part of the world corresponding with a certain fixed set of [Concept('concept_province', '$concept_provinces$')]. A $concept_state_region$ is usually equivalent to a [concept_state]. In certain cases a $concept_state_region$ can become a [concept_split_state], where two or more [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] each hold a $concept_state$ in the same $concept_state_region$.
concept_occupancy_desc: How fully employed a [concept_building] is, which also determines how much of its maximum [Concept('concept_good_production','Productive')] capacity is utilized. If the $concept_building$ has room to hire a larger [concept_workforce], it will always try to do so. If its hiring is limited by the [concept_building_wage] it can offer, it will increase $concept_building_wages$ for as long as its [concept_building_balance] remains positive.
concept_votes_desc: Your [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] determine whether any given [concept_pop] gets to cast a $concept_vote$, and if so, how much [concept_political_strength] that $vote$ will count for. $concept_votes$ are cast for [Concept('concept_party','$concept_parties$')] during [concept_election] periods. $concept_pops$ will tend to vote for the $concept_party$ their [concept_interest_group] belongs to, but may be won over by another $concept_party$ with greater [concept_momentum]. After the $concept_election$ date, the number of total $concept_votes$ each $concept_party$ received will be fixed until the next $concept_election$, and will increase the [concept_clout] of any $concept_interest_groups$ that are members of the $concept_party$.
concept_clout_desc: An [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_group_possessive$')] share of the total [concept_political_strength] that [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] across their [concept_country] generate. $concept_clout$ is the final word on how influential an $concept_interest_group$ is, and affects everything from [concept_legitimacy] and [concept_enactment_of_laws] if the $concept_interest_group$ is [concept_in_government], to [concept_political_movement_support] and [Concept('concept_activism','$concept_activism_short$')] if it is [concept_in_opposition]. It also affects whether the $concept_interest_group$ is considered [concept_powerful], [concept_influential], or [concept_marginalized].
concept_powerful_desc: $concept_influential_powerful_common$ A $concept_powerful$ $concept_interest_group$'s [Concept('concept_interest_group_trait','$concept_interest_group_traits$')] will have a [GetDefine('NPolitics','POWERFUL_IG_TRAIT_BONUS')|%0=+] greater effect than if they were merely $concept_influential$.\n\n$concept_interest_groups$ are considered $concept_powerful$ while their $concept_clout$ is above [GetDefine('NPolitics','POWERFUL_IG_THRESHOLD')|%0].
concept_influential_powerful_common: The amount of [concept_clout] an [concept_interest_group] has decides whether it is [concept_powerful], $concept_influential$, or [concept_marginalized].
concept_influential_desc: $concept_influential_powerful_common$ An $concept_influential$ $concept_interest_group$'s [Concept('concept_interest_group_trait','$concept_interest_group_traits$')] will have a lesser effect than if they were $concept_powerful$.\n\n$concept_interest_groups$ are considered $concept_influential$ while their $concept_clout$ is below [GetDefine('NPolitics','POWERFUL_IG_THRESHOLD')|%0v].
concept_marginalized_desc:
$concept_marginalized$ [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] have too little [concept_clout] to be politically noteworthy and cannot be included in the [concept_government]. A $concept_marginalized$ $concept_interest_group$ that is supported by at least [GetDefine('NPolitics','MARGINAL_IG_JOIN_PARTY_POPULATION_THRESHOLD')] will be able to join a [concept_party], and will cease being $concept_marginalized$ once they do so. Their [Concept('concept_interest_group_trait','$concept_interest_group_traits$')] are deactivated for as long as they remain $concept_marginalized$.

Already $concept_marginalized$ $concept_interest_groups$ remain $concept_marginalized$ for as long as their $concept_clout$ is below [GetDefine('NPolitics','MARGINAL_IG_THRESHOLD')|%0v]. Non-$concept_marginalized$ $concept_interest_groups$ that are not in a $concept_party$ will become $concept_marginalized$ once their $concept_clout$ drops below [GetDefine('NPolitics','MARGINAL_IG_CUTOFF')|%0v], unless they are already [concept_in_government] in which case they do not become $concept_marginalized$ until removed.

The [Concept('concept_interest_group_trait','$concept_interest_group_traits$')] of $concept_interest_groups$ whose $concept_clout$ is below [GetDefine('NPolitics','MARGINAL_IG_THRESHOLD')|%0v] but are not $concept_marginalized$ will have a [GetDefine('NPolitics','POWERFUL_IG_TRAIT_BONUS')|%0=+] less effect than if they were merely $concept_influential$
concept_politically_unaligned_aligned_de:
The part of a [concept_pop] that does not support an [concept_interest_group] is called #b Politically Unaligned#!. This is often due to low [concept_literacy] or [concept_sol]. $concept_politically_unaligned$ parts of $concept_pops$ do not participate in the political process and any [concept_political_strength] they possess is wasted.

The opposite of this is #b Politically Aligned#!. Which means the $concept_pop$ is part of one of your [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_country_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] and the $concept_pop$'s $concept_political_strength$ is attributed to that $concept_interest_group$.

[Concept('concept_character', '$concept_characters$')] below the age of [GetDefine('NCharacters','ADULT_AGE')|v] are usually #b $concept_politically_unaligned$.#!
concept_investment_level_desc: The current level of an [concept_institution]. Each level costs an amount of [concept_bureaucracy] depending on the [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')] size of your [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporated_states$')], and its effects scale with the level.[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_investment_level_ingame_added')]
concept_investment_level_ingame_added: \n\nYou currently pay @bur! #v [Multiply_CFixedPoint(GetPlayer.GetInstitutionInvestmentBureaucracyCost,'(CFixedPoint)-1')|0+]#! [concept_bureaucracy] for [GetPlayer.GetInstitutionInvestment|v0] $concept_investment_levels$, or @bur! #v [GetPlayer.GetInstitutionInvestmentBureaucracyFactor|+0]#! [concept_bureaucracy] per level.
concept_political_lens_desc: View [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] and [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporated_states$')], construct [Concept('concept_government_building','$concept_government_buildings$')], issue [Concept('concept_decree','$concept_decrees$')], and manage matters of domestic political importance to your [concept_country].
concept_diplomatic_lens_desc: View the [concept_attitude] of other [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] and monitor your [Concept('concept_interest','$concept_interests$')] and their [Concept('concept_strategic_region','$concept_strategic_regions$')], establish [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')] and take [Concept('concept_diplomatic_action','$concept_diplomatic_actions_short$')], and start [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')].
concept_military_lens_desc: View the progress of ongoing [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')], construct [Concept('concept_military_building','$concept_military_buildings$')], and recruit [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')].
concept_country_desc: A $concept_country$ consists of one or several parcels of [Concept('concept_province','$concept_province_land$')] organized into [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')], in which a [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')] resides under the rule of a [concept_government] and its [concept_head_of_state]. In Victoria 3, both human and AI players each control a $concept_country$.\n\nAside from the nature of their $concept_pops$, which $concept_states$ they own, and how they been developed, a $concept_country$ is defined also by their [concept_country_tier], [concept_primary_cultures], and [concept_state_religion], and whether they are [Concept('concept_recognized_power','$concept_recognized_power_short$')] or [Concept('concept_unrecognized_power','$concept_unrecognized_power_short$')]. $concept_countries$ also have different [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] and access to different [Concept('concept_technology','$concept_technologies$')].
concept_decree_desc: $concept_decrees$ are demands made by a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_ruler] to effect changes in a [concept_state] under their control. $concept_decrees$ cost [concept_authority] for as long as they are active. Once issued, the $concept_decree$ will provide a certain bonus to the $concept_state$ until it is removed.
concept_pop_needs_desc: [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] spend their income on [Concept('concept_good', '$concept_goods$')] to fulfill their $concept_pop_needs_short$. The higher their [concept_wealth] the more $concept_goods$ it will purchase. $concept_pops$ gain more diverse and luxurious $concept_pop_needs_short$ as their $concept_wealth$ increases. A given $concept_pop_need_short$ can often be satisfied by a variety of $concept_goods$ via [concept_goods_substitution]. If the $concept_pop$ has money left over after its $concept_pop_needs_short$ have been fulfilled their $concept_wealth$ will increase. The inverse is also true: if the $concept_pop$ cannot afford their $concept_pop_needs_short$ they will still purchase them, and the shortfall reduces their $concept_wealth$.
concept_combat_unit_group_desc: $concept_units$ are categorized into [Concept('concept_default_unit','$concept_default_units$')] and [Concept('concept_special_unit','$concept_special_units$')] which possess different strengths and weaknesses. #b [GetCombatUnitGroup('combat_unit_group_infantry').GetName]#! is better suited for defending territory, while #b [GetCombatUnitGroup('combat_unit_group_cavalry').GetName]#! is better at [concept_occupation] for example.
concept_combat_unit_type_desc: Within a [concept_combat_unit_group] there are different types of $concept_units_short$. Most of the time, they are unlocked by technological advances and are better at fighting than the type they replace.
concept_unit_desc: $concept_units$ are [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] assigned to a [concept_military_formation] and perform military operations under the guidance of a [concept_general]. $concept_battalions$ are sub-divided into distinct groups: [GetBattalionGroupsList]. Units in the #b Default#! group are unlimited, while having more #b Special#! units than Default ones may incur an [concept_organization] penalty.
concept_special_unit_desc:
These are [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] that are not #b [GetCombatUnitGroup('combat_unit_group_infantry').GetName]#! which are considered [Concept('concept_default_unit','$concept_default_units$')].

$concept_special_units$ for [Concept('concept_army','$concept_armies$')]:
$TAB$#b [GetCombatUnitGroup('combat_unit_group_artillery').GetName]#!
$TAB$#b [GetCombatUnitGroup('combat_unit_group_cavalry').GetName]#!
concept_kill_rate_desc: How effective a [concept_unit] is at ensuring their opponent's [concept_casualties] end up unable to come back to fight another day. Increases the ratio of [concept_casualties] that end up killed (instead of [concept_wounded]). $concept_kill_rate$ is countered by the enemy $concept_unit$'s [concept_recovery_rate].
concept_recovery_rate_desc: The percentage of [concept_casualties] a [concept_unit] takes that survive, in some cases by becoming [concept_dependents]. Can be increased with #b [Concept('concept_mobilization_option','$concept_mobilization_options$')]. $concept_recovery_rate$ is countered by the enemy $concept_unit$'s [concept_kill_rate].
concept_casualties_desc: [concept_manpower] who fall in battle or through [concept_attrition] are considered $concept_casualties$. A proportion of $concept_casualties$ are killed outright while the remainder are [concept_wounded]. This ratio is dependent on the [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_unit_possessive$')] [concept_recovery_rate] compared to their enemy's [concept_kill_rate].
concept_offense_desc: A [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_unit_possessive$')] fighting ability in [concept_battle] while advancing into enemy territory.
concept_defense_desc: A [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_unit_possessive$')] fighting ability in [concept_battle] while defending from enemy incursions.
concept_blockade_strength_desc: Determines the degree to which a [concept_fleet] is able to successfully [concept_blockade] hostile [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')].
concept_blockade_efficiency_desc: $concept_blockade_efficiency$ is the average [concept_blockade] level a [concept_fleet] achieves across all hostile ports in its [concept_naval_mission] area. It is based on [concept_blockade_strength] vs the [concept_blockade_resistance] of each target port, distributed evenly across all targeted ports.
concept_blockade_resistance_desc: $concept_blockade_resistance$ is the amount of [concept_blockade_strength] required to fully [concept_blockade] a [concept_state]. It is based on factors such as [Concept('concept_coastal_building','$concept_coastal_building$')] output and local [concept_trade] volumes.
concept_blockade_desc: $concept_blockades$ are a set up in a [concept_sea_node] via an [concept_admiral] [concept_order]. They damage [Concept('concept_supply_network','$concept_supply_networks$')] and reduce access to the [concept_world_market] in ports adjacent to the $concept_sea_node$. The $concept_blockade_level$ is determined by the respective attribute on ship [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_unit$')]. $ship_group_capital_ships$ are best suited for $concept_blockades$.
concept_coastal_building_desc:
A $concept_coastal_building$ is a [Concept('concept_building','$concept_building$')] located in the port area of a coastal [concept_state]. During a [Concept('concept_blockade','$concept_blockade$')], non-military $concept_coastal_buildings$ suffer reduced [concept_throughput]. [GetNavalMissionType('naval_mission_type_port_bombardment').GetName] can destroy levels of any $concept_coastal_building$, including military ones.

There are a total of #v [GetNumCoastalBuildingTypes]#! $concept_coastal_buildings$:#indent_newline:3 
[GetCoastalBuildingTypesList]#!
concept_naval_hostilities_desc: $concept_naval_hostilities$ is a state of hostility between two [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] that permits hostile naval actions without a formal [concept_war]. Fleets may engage in [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')] and enforce [Concept('concept_blockade','$concept_blockades$')] against countries with which they have $concept_naval_hostilities$.
concept_organization_desc:
A [concept_military_formation] with low $concept_organization$ will be less effective in [concept_battle] in a variety of ways. $concept_organization$ starts out low when a $concept_military_formation$ is first created, but will increase over time while the $concept_military_formation$ is not traveling. $concept_organization$ is limited if you have too low [concept_command_limit] for all your [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] or if your $concept_military_formation$ has more [Concept('concept_special_unit','$concept_special_units$')] than [Concept('concept_default_unit','$concept_default_units$')].

$concept_organization$ can also be impacted temporarily when switching [Concept('concept_mobilization_option','$concept_mobilization_options$')] on or off, and when transferring [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] between [Concept('concept_mobilize_army','$concept_mobilize_army_mobilized$')] $concept_armies$ with different sets of $concept_mobilization_options$.

#indent_newline:3 A $concept_military_formation$ with low $concept_organization$ will suffer increasing penalties the lower the value is.

#indent_newline:3 For an [concept_army], these penalties go up to the following effects:
[GetStaticModifier('low_organization_army').GetDesc]#!

#indent_newline:3 For a [concept_fleet], the penalties are at most the following:
[GetStaticModifier('low_organization_fleet').GetDesc]#!
concept_unit_experience_desc:
$concept_experience$ determines the [concept_veterancy_level] of [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] and of the Crew in [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')]. Once they have enough $concept_experience$, they are promoted to a higher $concept_veterancy_level_short$.

 For $concept_units$, $concept_experience$ is gained over time, more when mobilized and during battles.

For $concept_ships$, not being on a [concept_naval_mission] will cause its Crew to lose $concept_experience$ over time.
concept_veterancy_level_desc: [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] and the Crew in [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')] gain $concept_veterancy_levels$ by earning [concept_unit_experience]. Higher $concept_veterancy_levels_short$ grant increasing bonuses to the offensive and defensive capabilities of the $concept_unit$ or $concept_ship$ in question.
concept_battalion_desc: An army [concept_unit] in a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] military. They are created and maintained by [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_battalion_desc_added','Barracks')] and are commanded by [Concept('concept_general','$concept_generals$')].
concept_in_government_desc: [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] included in the [concept_government] affect which [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] can be [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enacted$')] and set the [concept_country] [concept_legitimacy]. They will never support [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')] unless their [concept_approval] drops low enough that they leave to join the [Concept('concept_in_opposition','$concept_in_opposition_short$')].
concept_change_rate_scaling_desc: As [concept_liberty_desire] nears either 0 or 100, its progress is slowed by $concept_change_rate_scaling$, reflecting a natural hesitance in the [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_population$')] to depart from the status quo and accept increased or decreased [concept_autonomy].
concept_in_opposition_desc: [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] not part of the [concept_government] are considered $concept_in_opposition$. Their only way to affect [concept_enactment_of_laws] is through [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')], but their [Concept('concept_interest_group_trait','$concept_interest_group_traits$')] apply in full as usual.
concept_legitimacy_desc: A [Concept('concept_government','$concept_government_possessive$')] $concept_legitimacy$ measures how well the composition of the [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] [concept_in_government] fits with the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')]. The lower the $concept_legitimacy$, the longer the time between attempts to [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enact$')] new $concept_laws$. $legitimacy_coup_loc$ Raising or lowering [concept_taxes] also has an impact on $concept_legitimacy$.
legitimacy_coup_loc: A $concept_government$ with high $concept_legitimacy$ is more [Concept('concept_coup_resistance','$concept_coup_resistant$')] to [Concept('concept_coup','$concept_coups$')].
concept_acceptance_desc:
A [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pop_possessive$')] $concept_acceptance$ is a value from [GetDefine('NPops', 'MIN_ACCEPTANCE_VALUE')|v] to [GetDefine('NPops', 'MAX_ACCEPTANCE_VALUE')|v], which determines which [concept_acceptance_status] the $concept_pop$ has.

$concept_acceptance$ is primarily determined by the $concept_pop_possessive$ [concept_culture] and [concept_religion], and the corresponding $CITIZENSHIP_GC_LINK$ and $CHURCH_AND_STATE_GC_LINK$ [Concept('concept_law_group', '$concept_law_groups$')] in the [concept_country] the $concept_pop$ lives in.

$concept_acceptance$ changes are not always instant; $concept_pops$ of a certain [concept_cultural_community] may have a different $concept_acceptance$, due to recent [concept_law] changes or [Concept('concept_migration', '$concept_immigration$')].
concept_acceptance_status_desc:
A [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pop_possessive$')] $concept_acceptance_status$ determines how accepted or discriminated it is in a [concept_country].

The $concept_acceptance_status_short$ a $concept_pop$ gets is determined by its [concept_acceptance] value.

The exact effects of a certain $concept_acceptance_status$ are determined by the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')].

Possible $concept_acceptance_statuses$ are, from lowest to highest:
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$$VIOLENT_HOSTILITY_GC_LINK$
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$$CULTURAL_ERASURE_GC_LINK$
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$$OPEN_PREJUDICE_GC_LINK$
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$$SECOND_RATE_CITIZEN_GC_LINK$
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$$FULL_ACCEPTANCE_GC_LINK$
concept_national_awakening_desc: A [concept_culture] which reaches [GetDefine('NPops','CULTURAL_FERVOR_NATIONAL_AWAKENING_THRESHOLD')|0v] [concept_fervor] has a chance to start a $concept_national_awakening$. $concept_cultures$ with an active $concept_national_awakening$ will gain additional $concept_fervor$ whilst it is active, and [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')] with this $concept_culture$ will have greater [concept_pop] Attraction.
concept_ideological_incoherence_desc: A [Concept('concept_government','$concept_government_possessive$')] [concept_legitimacy] is reduced if the [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] [concept_in_government] have [Concept('concept_ideology','$concept_ideologies$')] that do not match the current [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] of the [concept_country].
concept_market_capital_desc: The [concept_state] that serves as the nexus of a [concept_market], to which all other $concept_states$ in the $concept_market$ must connect lest they become [Concept('concept_isolated_state','$concept_isolated_state_short$')]. [concept_trade] with the [concept_world_market] is often, but not always, managed from the $concept_market_capital$. The $concept_market_capital$ is often the same $concept_state$ as the [Concept('concept_market_owner','$concept_market_owner_possessive$')] [concept_capital_state], but it is possible to keep these separate.[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_market_capital_desc_added')]
concept_ownership_share_desc:
Determines how the [Concept('concept_building_balance','$concept_building_balance_profit$')] of [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_levels$')] that are [concept_privately_owned] by its [concept_workforce] is distributed.

The [concept_dividends] are given to each [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] as [concept_pop_income], depending on the size of their share compared to the rest of the $concept_workforce$.

The $concept_pop$ is also considered to own that proportion of the [concept_building]'s current [concept_cash_reserves].

This is the main source of income for $ARISTOCRATS_GC_LINK$ and $CAPITALISTS_GC_LINK$, as they are considered part of the $concept_workforce$ of $MANOR_HOUSES_GC_LINK$ and $FINANCIAL_DISTRICTS_GC_LINK$, respectively.
concept_market_share_desc: The $concept_market_share$ of each [concept_country] in a [concept_market] is determined by its [concept_gdp], with a bonus if they are the [concept_market_owner]. The higher a $concept_country$'s $concept_market_share$ the more [Concept('concept_consumption_tax', '$concept_consumption_taxes$')] they collect in the [concept_market].
concept_default_desc: Once the [concept_treasury] accumulates [concept_loans] large enough that they exceed the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] total [concept_credit], the $concept_country$ is considered to be in $concept_default$. This will pause all ongoing [concept_construction] and will have a negative impact on the [concept_throughput] of [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')], growing more severe as time passes. Penalties are removed as soon as the $concept_country$'s weekly balance becomes positive again, or if [concept_bankruptcy] is declared.
concept_decision_desc: Large projects that can be undertaken by a nation will appear as #v $concept_decisions$#!, including expeditions across the globe and the construction of man-made canals. \n\n$concept_decisions$ can be found underneath [Concept('concept_journal_entry','$concept_journal_entries$')] in the #v Journal#!.
concept_bankruptcy_desc: If a [concept_country] is in [concept_default] and unable to pay back its [concept_loans], it may opt to declare $concept_bankruptcy$. This will clear the debt but wipe out all [concept_cash_reserves] the $concept_country$ had borrowed from, and will greatly anger any [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] who [Concept('concept_privately_owned','$concept_privately_owns$')] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')].[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_bankruptcy_desc_added')]
concept_bankruptcy_desc_added:
In addition, the following effects are applied for #v [GetDefine('NEconomy','DECLARE_BANKRUPTCY_PENALTY_DURATION_YEARS')|0] years#!:
[GetStaticModifier('declared_bankruptcy').GetDesc]
concept_market_owner_desc: The [concept_country] that owns the market, either because it is the only participant or the [concept_senior_partner] in a [concept_customs_union]. Only the $concept_market_owner$ may sign [Concept('concept_trade_privilege','$concept_trade_privileges$')] and issue [Concept('concept_embargo','$concept_embargoes$')].
concept_embargo_desc: An [concept_ongoing_diplomatic_action] established by one [concept_country] targeting another, which reduces the [concept_trade_advantage] of the target $concept_country$ for exporting [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] to the country enforcing the embargo via the [concept_world_market]. $concept_countries$ that are at [concept_war] will automatically Embargo each other.
concept_encourage_consumption_desc: $concept_encouraging_consumption$ of a [concept_good] will increase the tendency for [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] to buy it as part of their [concept_pop_needs], and will favor it over its [Concept('concept_goods_substitution','$concept_goods_substitutes_short$')]. $concept_encouraging_consumption$ costs [concept_authority].
concept_discourage_consumption_desc: $concept_discourage_consumption$ of a [concept_good] will decrease the tendency for [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] to buy it as part of their [concept_pop_needs], and will favor [Concept('concept_goods_substitution','$concept_goods_substitutes_short$')] instead. $concept_discouraging_consumption$ costs [concept_authority].
concept_consumption_tax_desc: A [Concept('concept_taxes','$concept_tax$')] collected on specific [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] purchased by [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pop$')] to meet their [concept_pop_needs]. Each $concept_good$ subject to $concept_consumption_taxes$ costs a certain amount of [concept_authority]. When applied to a $concept_good$, its [concept_market_price] increases by the $concept_consumption_tax$ rate at point of sale to $concept_pops$ only, with all [concept_buy_orders] generated in this manner resulting in the surcharge being collected by the [concept_treasury]. Since the surcharge is applied on the [concept_market] level, the $concept_tax$ is ineffective in [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] with low [concept_market_access].
concept_loyalist_desc:
$concept_loyalist$ [Concept('concept_individual','$concept_individuals$')] within a [concept_pop] are pleased with the state of their [concept_country] and are willing to defend it from dissident elements, both verbally and with violence if necessary. The [concept_approval] of [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] supported by $concept_loyalist$ $concept_pops$ is improved.

$concept_loyalists$ are created whenever a $concept_pop$'s [concept_sol] increases and due to decisions made during special events.

The opposite of a $concept_loyalist$ is a [concept_radical]. Whenever a $concept_radical$ would be created in a $concept_pop$ that already has $concept_loyalists$, one $concept_loyalist$ becomes [concept_neutral] instead.
concept_radical_desc:
$concept_radical$ [Concept('concept_individual','$concept_individuals$')] within a [concept_pop] are disillusioned with the state of their [concept_country]. The presence of $concept_radicals$ in a [concept_state] contributes to [concept_turmoil], and the $concept_radicalism$ of $concept_pops$ contributes to [concept_activism]. The [concept_approval] of [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] supported by $concept_radical$ $concept_pops$ will also be impacted.

$concept_radicals$ are created when a $concept_pop_possessive$ [concept_sol] falls below their [concept_expected_sol], whenever a $concept_pop_possessive$ [concept_sol] decreases, and due to decisions made during special events. $concept_pops$ suffering from a low [concept_acceptance_status] increase these negative effects further. $concept_radicals$ are also created in $concept_pops$ that support $concept_political_movements$ whose demands go unfulfilled, and when $concept_pops$ are fired from a [Concept('concept_building','$concept_building_possessive$')] [concept_workforce] (particularly if they had a large [concept_ownership_share]).

The opposite of a $concept_radical$ is a [concept_loyalist]. Whenever a $concept_loyalist$ would be created in a $concept_pop$ that already has $concept_radicals$, one $concept_radical$ becomes [concept_neutral] instead.
concept_neutral_desc: $concept_neutral$ [Concept('concept_individual','$concept_individuals$')] within a [concept_pop] are neither [concept_radical] or [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyal$')] towards their [concept_country]. However, they are only one negative or positive step away from becoming $concept_radical$ or $concept_loyal$.\n\nWhenever a $concept_radical$ would be created in a $concept_pop$ that already has $concept_loyalists$, one $concept_loyalist$ becomes $concept_neutral$ instead. All $concept_individuals$ in a $concept_pop$ needs to be either $concept_neutral$ or already $concept_radical$ for a $concept_radical$ to be created. Vice versa when a $concept_loyalist$ would be created.
concept_rivalry_desc: A [concept_diplomatic_pact] established by one [concept_country] targeting another of similar [concept_rank], and which generates @inf! [concept_influence] for the [concept_country] declaring the rivalry. The two $concept_countries$ must have overlapping [Concept('concept_interest','$concept_interests$')] to be valid rivals. The $concept_diplomatic_pact_short$ will also limit the range of [concept_relations] that can be established between the two $concept_countries$ for as long as the $concept_diplomatic_pact_short$ is active.
concept_colonial_growth_desc: A measure of how rapidly a [concept_country] can push the [Concept('concept_colony','$concept_colonial$')] frontier forward. $concept_colonial_growth$ is generated by the [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_colonial_growth_ingame_added_2','Institution Colonial Affairs')] [concept_institution] in combination with the total [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')] across [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporated_states$')]. The total amount of $concept_colonial_growth$ generated is split up across all $concept_colonies$ a $concept_country$ is actively growing, up to a maximum.[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_colonial_growth_ingame_added')]
concept_colony_desc: Settlement efforts initiated by a colonizing [concept_country] in the lands of a [concept_decentralized_nation]. A would-be colonizer must have the [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_colony_desc_added','Institution Colonial Affairs')] [concept_institution] and an [concept_interest] in the [concept_strategic_region]. At first, a single [concept_province] will be taken. Adjacent $concept_provinces$ will be $concept_colonized$ at a rate depending on the $concept_country$'s [concept_colonial_growth], generating [concept_tension] as they do.
concept_escalation_desc: Once a [concept_diplomatic_play] has been initiated, it steadily $concept_escalates$ through three distinct phases: [concept_opening_moves], [concept_diplomatic_maneuvers], and [concept_countdown_to_war]. The phase limits which actions are available to participants. If the $concept_diplomatic_play_short$ does not resolve prior to $concept_escalation$ progressing all the way through the $concept_countdown_to_war$, [concept_war] will break out.
concept_revenue_desc: After a [concept_building] has [Concept('concept_good_production','$concept_good_produced$')] [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')], they are sold at the [concept_local_price]. The amount of [concept_money] made in the sale is the $concept_building$'s $concept_revenue$, the positive factor of its [concept_building_balance].
concept_combat_width_desc: The $concept_combat_width$ of a particular [concept_terrain] type influences the potential numeric advantage the larger side can have over the smaller side in [concept_battle]. A smaller force can hold out for longer against a larger force if $concept_combat_width$ is relatively low, and vice versa.
concept_infamy_desc: $concept_infamy$ reflects the degree by which the international community, particularly the reigning [Concept('concept_great_power','$concept_great_powers$')], see you as a threat to be contained in light of your past actions. It is accrued primarily from causing [Concept('concept_diplomatic_incident','$concept_diplomatic_incidents$')] and claiming [Concept('concept_war_goal','$concept_war_goals$')] in a [concept_peace_deal]. Your $concept_infamy$ affects $concept_countries$' [concept_attitude] towards you and increases the [concept_influence] cost of [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')]. If it reaches the level of #b $infamy_pariah$#!, $concept_great_powers$ will be able to start the [GetDiplomaticPlayType('dp_contain_threat').GetName] [concept_diplomatic_play] against you.
concept_diplomatic_incident_desc: A $concept_diplomatic_incident$ is typically the result of a [concept_country] starting a [concept_diplomatic_play]. $concept_diplomatic_incidents$ generate [concept_infamy] for the $concept_country$ who started it, and will cause [concept_relations] to fall with all $concept_countries$ with an [concept_interest] in the [concept_strategic_region], particularly the target of the $concept_diplomatic_play_short$. $concept_diplomatic_incidents$ can also be the result of other actions, for example decisions made during special events.
concept_tension_desc: How strained the relationship is between a [Concept('concept_colony', '$concept_colonizing$')] [concept_country] and nearby [Concept('concept_decentralized_nation', '$concept_decentralized_nations$')]. $concept_tensions$ rise with all nearby $concept_decentralized_nations$ whenever a [concept_province] is taken over, and decreases over time as long as no new land is taken.\n\nIf the tension level rises to #b $tension_volatile$#!, continued colonization may trigger a [concept_native_uprising].
concept_relations_desc:
A mutual rating of the diplomatic stance between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')], ranging from [GetDefine('NDiplomacy','MIN_RELATIONS')|+=] to [GetDefine('NDiplomacy','MAX_RELATIONS')|+=].

Both sides can influence $concept_relations$ by spending [concept_influence] on the [GetDiplomaticActionType('increase_relations').GetName], [GetDiplomaticActionType('damage_relations').GetName], and [GetDiplomaticActionType('expel_diplomats').GetName] [Concept('concept_diplomatic_action','$concept_diplomatic_actions$')]

$concept_relations$ impact which $concept_diplomatic_actions$ and [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts_short$')] are valid for the two $concept_countries$, and also impact the likelihood they will accept diplomatic overtures or take your side in a [concept_diplomatic_play]
concept_ai_strategy_desc: AI-controlled [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] have a set of three $concept_ai_strategies$ in areas corresponding with the [Concept('concept_capacity','$concept_capacities$')] which govern their long- and short-term goals, and how they will proceed when making decisions in regards to other $concept_countries$. Which $concept_ai_strategies$ are selected is influenced by a number of factors such as the $concept_country$'s size and [concept_rank], as well as its current [concept_government].
concept_strategic_desire_desc: AI-controlled [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] will have a $concept_strategic_desire$ towards $concept_countries$ they deem geopolitically relevant. Their $concept_strategic_desire$ represents their overarching diplomatic ambitions towards a $concept_country$ and is the most important factor in determining their [concept_attitude].
concept_attitude_desc:
An indication of how another [concept_country] feels about you.

$concept_attitude$ affects what sorts of actions a $concept_country$ is likely to take towards you, and what role you play in their plans.

$concept_attitude$ may change whenever a [concept_diplomatic_catalyst] occurs, and is based on:
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[concept_relations]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[concept_infamy]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[concept_strategic_desire]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$Size of your military
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$Which $concept_countries$ you have [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')] with
concept_instant_diplomatic_action_desc: An action with an instant effect on the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] involved. They typically require a certain condition to be true in order to be taken but do not cost any [concept_influence].
concept_ongoing_diplomatic_action_desc: A type of [concept_diplomatic_pact] that can be both initiated and ended at will, with no approval required nor costs incurred by the target [concept_country].
concept_diplomatic_pact_desc: Unilateral or bilateral understandings between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')]. They may have a maintenance cost in [concept_influence] for one or both parties, and can have a wide range of effects including [concept_subject] relationships. $concept_diplomatic_pacts_short$ can break for a number of different reasons, including [concept_relations] deviating too far in either direction, one side or another explicitly breaking it, or a time limit running out.
concept_truce_desc: A $concept_truce$ is a diplomatic status where one [concept_country] is prevented from making a [concept_diplomatic_demand] or joining in an offensive [concept_diplomatic_play] against another $concept_country$. $concept_truces$ may be unilateral or bilateral, and are created in a variety of ways, such as when a [concept_peace_deal] is signed or an [concept_alliance] is broken.
concept_war_reparations_desc: A secondary [concept_war_goal] that can be added onto a [concept_diplomatic_play] by choosing a specific [concept_article] to accompany it and claimed as part of a [concept_peace_deal]. If enforced, a new [concept_treaty] will be created containing all [Concept('concept_article','$concept_articles$')] that were selected as war reparations by the other [concept_country] with a minimum binding period that lasts for the duration of the [concept_truce].
concept_colonization_rights_desc: A [concept_diplomatic_pact] that is created when a [concept_decentralized_nation] is defeated in a [concept_native_uprising]. It increases the speed at which the country granted $concept_colonization_rights$ colonizes their territory, and lasts for the duration of the truce.
concept_foreign_investment_desc:
A [concept_country] constructing and owning [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_levels$')] in another $concept_country$.

$concept_foreign_investments$ can be made by an [concept_overlord] in its [Concept('concept_subject','$concept_subjects$')], or between two sovereign $concept_countries$ by signing a [concept_foreign_investment_rights] [concept_treaty].

Both [concept_government_construction] and [concept_private_construction] are allowed via $concept_foreign_investment$.

While the foreign owner constructs the $concept_building_levels$ and gains [concept_dividends], the [concept_workforce] comes from the local [concept_state], and [concept_taxes] are paid to the $concept_country$ controlling that $concept_state$. Any [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] used by the [concept_building] remains in the local [concept_market].
concept_foreign_investment_rights_desc: Permits one [concept_country] to do [concept_foreign_investment] in another for the duration of the [concept_treaty]. Additionally the $concept_treaty$ allows [Concept('concept_company','$concept_companies$')] to construct a [concept_regional_company_hq] if they are given the $investment_charter$ [concept_company_charter].
concept_exiled_army_desc: [Concept('concept_army','$concept_armies$')] can become $concept_exiled_army_short$ when their [concept_front] cannot be reached any longer and they cannot find a valid alternative. This can happen for example when they are fully surrounded. An $concept_exiled_army$ will move to the nearest [concept_hq] before it can be sent to another $concept_front$ or be given other [Concept('concept_order','$concept_orders$')] again. While doing so, the $concept_army$ will suffer from [concept_attrition].
concept_military_access_desc: $concept_military_access$ can be used to attack an enemy through the lands of other neutral [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')]. It is secured by establishing an [concept_ongoing_diplomatic_action] with the neutral $concept_country$.
concept_military_assistance_desc: An [concept_ongoing_diplomatic_action] established by one [concept_country] targeting another, where the first $concept_country$ improves the fighting ability of the second's [Concept('concept_military_formation','$concept_military_formations$')]
concept_social_hierarchy_desc:
A $concept_social_hierarchy$ is comprised of two or more [Concept('concept_social_class','$concept_social_classes$')]. All [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] belong to a $concept_social_hierarchy$.

Any [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] not targeted by a country-specific $concept_social_hierarchy$ are organized into the $default_social_hierarchy$'s $lower_class$, $middle_class$, and $upper_class$ based on [concept_profession] and which correspond to the [concept_lower_strata], [concept_middle_strata], and [concept_upper_strata] respectively.

$concept_social_classes$ for country-specific $concept_social_hierarchies$ may be determined by factors such as [concept_profession], [concept_culture], and [concept_religion].
concept_social_class_desc: Each [concept_pop] belongs to a $concept_social_class$, and each $concept_social_class$ belongs to the [concept_lower_strata], [concept_middle_strata], or [concept_upper_strata]. A [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pop_possessive$')] $concept_social_class$ is determined by the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_social_hierarchy].
concept_open_market_desc: A [concept_war_goal] that can be claimed in a [concept_diplomatic_play] or as part of a [concept_peace_deal]. A [concept_country] forced to $concept_open_market_short$ its [concept_market] immediately changes its [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_open_market_desc_added','Trade Policy')] to [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_open_market_desc_added_2','Free Trade')] and may not change it again for #v [GetDefine('NDiplomacy','WAR_GOAL_OPEN_MARKET_MONTHS')|0] months#!. [ConcatIfNeitherEmpty('\n\n', AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_open_market_desc_added_3'))]
concept_humiliation_desc: A [concept_war_goal] that can be claimed in a [concept_diplomatic_play] or as part of a [concept_peace_deal]. A $concept_humiliated$ [concept_country] is unable to launch any $concept_diplomatic_plays$ of their own against the $concept_country$ they were $concept_humiliated$ by for a duration of #v [GetDefine('NDiplomacy','WAR_GOAL_HUMILIATION_MONTHS')|0] months#!.[ConcatIfNeitherEmpty('\n\n', AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid, 'concept_humiliation_desc_added'))]
concept_customs_union_desc: An enforced pact between a [concept_senior_partner] and one or several [Concept('concept_junior_partner','$concept_junior_partners$')] to share a single [concept_market], under the leadership of the $concept_senior_partner$. Usually enforced via a [concept_power_bloc] [concept_power_bloc_principle]. Additionally, all [concept_subject] $concept_diplomatic_pacts_short$ also act as a $concept_customs_union$.
concept_senior_partner_desc: A $concept_senior_partner$ in a [concept_customs_union] gains control of their [Concept('concept_junior_partner','$concept_junior_partners_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_market','$concept_markets$')]. While the $concept_junior_partners$ may continue to [concept_trade] with other $concept_markets$, only the $concept_senior_partner$ may issue [Concept('concept_embargo','$concept_embargoes$')] and control [Concept('concept_tariffs','$concept_tariff$')] levels. In exchange the $concept_senior_partner$ shares a minor portion of the $concept_market$'s $concept_tariff$ income, while both [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_building_industries$')] benefit from participating in a more powerful and mature $concept_market$.
concept_junior_partner_desc: A $concept_junior_partner$ in a [concept_customs_union] yields control of their [concept_market] to the [concept_senior_partner]. While the $concept_junior_partner$ may continue to [concept_trade] with other $concept_markets$, they may not issue [Concept('concept_embargo','$concept_embargoes$')] or control [Concept('concept_tariffs','$concept_tariff$')] levels. In exchange they collect a minor portion of the $concept_market$'s $concept_tariff$ income and their [Concept('concept_building','$concept_building_industries$')] benefit from participating in a more powerful and mature $concept_market$.
concept_regime_change_desc: Forces the target to change their [concept_government] to one similar to the enforcer, and to immediately enact up to #v [GetDefine('NPolitics','NUM_REVOLUTIONARY_LAW_CHANGES')]#! [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] favored by the new regime.
concept_alliance_desc: A [concept_treaty] [concept_article] between two [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')]. $concept_countries$ engaged in an $concept_alliance$ may always side with each other in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] regardless of if the other side maintains an [concept_interest] in the affected [concept_strategic_region]. This applies no matter if the other $concept_country$ is the initiator or target of the $concept_diplomatic_play_short$.
concept_defensive_pact_desc: A [concept_treaty] [concept_article] that is a limited [concept_alliance] between two [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')], which only comes into effect in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] where one of the two is the [concept_target] of the $concept_diplomatic_play_short$.
concept_guarantee_independence_desc: A [concept_treaty] [concept_article] established by one [concept_country] targeting another, where the second $concept_country$ is able to call the first to aid it in any [concept_diplomatic_play] where they are the defender.
concept_ally_desc: An $concept_ally$ is a [concept_country] which maintains an [concept_alliance] or [concept_defensive_pact] with another country and can be called to support them in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')]. For the [concept_initiator], only [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] with a full [concept_alliance] are considered to be $concept_allies$ in that [concept_diplomatic_play].
concept_supply_desc:
The $concept_supply$ of a [concept_military_formation] determines how quickly [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] regain [concept_organization].

#indent_newline:3 $concept_supply$ is usually #v 100%#!, but can be lower if an $concept_army$ is:
- Overseas and supplied by a compromised [concept_shipping_lane]
- Will be zero if the $concept_army$ is completely cut off from its $concept_hq$#!

[Concept('concept_modifier','$concept_modifiers$')] can also apply in some cases.
concept_manpower_desc: The amount of [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_manpower_desc_added','Soldiers')] and [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_manpower_desc_added_2','Officers')] in a [concept_unit]. The greater the $concept_manpower$ the more [concept_casualties] the $concept_unit$ will be able to deal and take.
concept_morale_desc: A [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_unit_possessive$')] $concept_morale$ measures how much of its remaining [concept_manpower] is ready for [concept_battle]. In each round of combat, some of the remaining $concept_manpower$ will become $concept_morale_demoralized$ for the remainder of the $concept_battle$ and unable to take offensive action. As all $concept_units$ reach a critical threshold of low $concept_morale$ the [concept_commander] will retreat, leaving the other side victorious.\n\nAfter a $concept_battle$, $concept_units$ will regain their $concept_morale$ at a steady rate depending on the [concept_supply] of their [concept_military_formation].
concept_rank_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] $concept_rank$ is determined by measuring its [concept_prestige] relative to other $concept_countries$ worldwide. It determines what sorts of international activities you are permitted to engage in, what your people and the world expects of you, and where you stand in the global pecking order.[ConcatIfNeitherEmpty('\n', AddLocalizationIf( GetPlayer.IsValid, 'concept_rank_ingame_added' ))]
concept_rank_ingame_added: #title Your current $concept_rank$ of [GetPlayer.GetRank] gives you the following benefits:#!#indent_newline:3 \n[GetPlayer.GetRankModifier.GetDesc]#!
concept_migration_desc:
The movement of [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] between [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')]. Generally, $concept_migration$ happens between [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] in the same [concept_market], but it can also happen between [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] in different $concept_markets$ in the case of [Concept('concept_mass_migration','$concept_mass_migrations$')].

$concept_migration$ flows from $concept_states$ with lower to higher [concept_migration_pull], with more people moving the higher the difference is. The $concept_migration$ rate is also affected by factors like the available [concept_infrastructure] in a $concept_state$.

Migration can only happen if there are $concept_pops$ able and willing to $concept_emigrate$. $concept_pops$ will only consider $concept_emigrating$ if they are sufficiently [Concept('concept_job_satisfaction', '$concept_job_satisfaction_dissatisfied$')]. For instance if their [concept_sol] is lower than the average in their $concept_market$ or if they are [concept_unemployed].

$concept_pops$ who arrive to a $concept_state$ with no other $concept_pops$ of the same [concept_culture], will form a [concept_cultural_community] and get a temporary penalty to their [concept_acceptance].
concept_mass_migration_pull_desc: A [concept_country]'s $concept_mass_migration_pull$ indicates how likely it is to receive a [Concept('concept_migration_target', '$concept_mass_migration$')] compared to other $concept_countries$. It is largely based on the average [concept_migration_pull] of [Concept('concept_migration_target', '$concept_mass_migration_eligible$')] [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] in the $concept_country$.\n\nIf a $concept_country$ has fewer than #b [GetDefine('NPops','MASS_MIGRATION_NUM_TARGET_STATES_FOR_NO_PENALTY')]#! $concept_mass_migration_eligible$ $concept_states$ it will receive an increasing penalty to its $concept_mass_migration_pull$ depending on how many $concept_mass_migration_eligible$ $concept_states$ it has.
concept_mass_migration_desc: A $concept_mass_migration$ is the movement of [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of a specific [concept_culture] in large numbers between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')]. A [Concept('concept_migration_target', '$concept_mass_migration_target$')] may appear if there is a [concept_trade] connection between two [Concept('concept_market', '$concept_markets$')] and the [concept_cultural_turmoil] of a specific $concept_culture$ in the origin $concept_country$ is at least [GetDefine('NPops','MASS_MIGRATION_ORIGIN_MIN_TURMOIL')|v%0]. A $concept_country$ is more likely to have one of its $concept_states$ be selected as a $concept_migration_target$ if it has a high [concept_mass_migration_pull].
concept_migration_target_desc: A [concept_state] selected as a suitable target for a [concept_mass_migration]. Surrounding $concept_states$ may also see some degree of $concept_immigration$ from a $concept_mass_migration$.\n\nTo be $concept_mass_migration_eligible$ for $concept_mass_migrations$ a state needs to be [Concept('concept_incorporated_state', '$concept_incorporated$')], have at least #b [GetDefine('NPops','MASS_MIGRATION_TARGET_MIN_ARABLE_LAND')]#! [concept_arable_land] and #b [GetDefine('NPops','MASS_MIGRATION_STATE_MIN_MARKET_ACCESS')|0%]#! [concept_market_access]. Additionally, the $concept_state$ cannot already be the target of a different $concept_mass_migration$ and the $concept_country$'s [GetLawGroup('lawgroup_migration').GetName] and [GetLawGroup('lawgroup_citizenship').GetName] [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] need to allow $concept_migration$ to happen.
concept_base_price_desc: The price of a [concept_good] when its [Concept('concept_sell_orders','$concept_sell_orders_supply$')] exactly equal its [Concept('concept_buy_orders','$concept_buy_orders_demand$')].
concept_market_impact_desc: Market Impact is how much of an effect the current balance of a [concept_good] ([concept_buy_orders] - [concept_sell_orders]) has on a [concept_market]. It is not determined solely by [concept_market_price] of a $concept_good$ (being either cheap or expensive), but also takes into consideration the volume of that $concept_good$ which circulates through the $concept_market$, affecting [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] and Industries.
concept_capital_state_desc: The site of a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] central [concept_government]. Controlling the $concept_capital_state_short$ is of great importance during wartime, and [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] who live there have a greater degree of [concept_political_strength] by which to influence politics.[ConcatIfNeitherEmpty('\n', AddLocalizationIf( GetPlayer.IsValid, 'concept_capital_state_desc_added' ))]
concept_treaty_port_desc: A coastal [concept_split_state] held under a [concept_treaty] for the purpose of opening [concept_trade] with another [concept_country]. A $concept_treaty_port$ is part of the [concept_market] of the $concept_country$ that ceded the $concept_province$, and can freely [concept_trade] with the [concept_world_market].\n\n[concept_tariffs], [concept_subventions] and [Concept('concept_embargo','$concept_embargoes$')] do not affect $concept_treaty_ports$, and the owner gets [concept_trade_advantage] when importing [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] exported by the $concept_treaty_port$ (and vice versa). If the $concept_treaty$ ceding the $concept_treaty_port$, is broken, it ceases to be a $concept_treaty_port$ and becomes a regular [concept_state].
concept_treaty_desc: A $concept_treaty$ is a type of bilateral agreement between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] and is made up of individual [Concept('concept_article', '$concept_articles$')] that define the rights, duties and @inf![concept_influence] cost of each $concept_country$. $concept_treaties$ remain in effect until either side breaks the agreement or withdraws from it after the initial [concept_binding_period] has passed.\n\n$concept_treaties$ may also be [Concept('concept_enforced_treaty', '$concept_enforced_treaty_forced_short$')] upon a $concept_country$ in the form of [concept_war_reparations] as a result of a [concept_diplomatic_play].
concept_enforced_treaty_desc: An $concept_enforced_treaty$ is a [concept_treaty] forced upon a [concept_country] from backing down in a [concept_diplomatic_play] or capitulating in a [concept_war]. Some [Concept('concept_diplomatic_demand', '$concept_diplomatic_demands$')] can also turn into an $concept_enforced_treaty$.\n\nIt is made up of [concept_war_reparations] or $concept_diplomatic_demands$ containing individual [Concept('concept_article', '$concept_articles$')] that define the rights, duties and @inf![concept_influence] cost for the capitulating $concept_country$. $concept_enforced_treaties$ remain in effect until the demanding side breaks the agreement or either side withdraws from it after the initial [concept_binding_period] has passed.
concept_article_desc:
$concept_articles$ are the components that make up a [concept_treaty] and can take many shapes.

An $concept_article$ can apply several effects upon one or both [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] involved and will usually incur an @inf![concept_influence] cost for as long as the $concept_treaty$ is upheld, alternatively an $concept_article$ may also apply specific one-time effects or impart certain duties upon the responsible $concept_country$ that may negatively affect the $concept_treaty$ if [Concept('concept_contravention', '$concept_contravened$')] where the $concept_treaty$ may eventually become [Concept('concept_non_fulfillment', '$concept_non_fulfilled$')].

Each $concept_article$ falls under one of two categories:#indent_newline:3 
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$#bold Mutual#!: Mutual $concept_articles$ extend all of their effects and duties to both $concept_countries$ equally.
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$#bold Directional#!: Directional $concept_articles$ have different effects and duties towards one or the other $concept_country$ depending one whether they are the offering or receiving side respectively.#!
concept_contravention_desc:
[Concept('concept_article', '$concept_articles$')] in [Concept('concept_treaty', '$concept_treaties$')] that have [concept_non_fulfillment] conditions can be $concept_contravened$. For an $concept_article$ to be considered $concept_contravened$, the responsible [concept_country] must have failed to meet the requirements of that $concept_article$. Whether the responsible $concept_country$ is $concept_contravening$ to an $concept_article$ is checked weekly, monthly, yearly, or any combination thereof, depending on the $concept_article$.

For example, in the [GetArticleType('law_commitment').GetName] $concept_article$, if the specified [concept_law] has not been [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enacted$')] or is not actively $concept_enactment_of_laws_enacting$ for #v 3#! consecutive weeks, the $concept_article$ is considered to be $concept_non_fulfilled$ until the $concept_law$ is being $concept_enactment_of_laws_enacted$ again.

The number of consecutive $concept_contraventions$ before $concept_non_fulfillment$ may differ between $concept_articles$.
concept_binding_period_desc: A [concept_treaty] usually has a $concept_binding_period$ where any withdrawal from the $concept_treaty$ by either [concept_country] will result in penalties for the withdrawing [concept_country]. When the $concept_binding_period$ has passed, withdrawal does not apply penalties anymore.
concept_non_fulfillment_desc:
Some [Concept('concept_article','$concept_articles$')] may come with specific duties attached that will adversely affect the [concept_treaty] if [Concept('concept_contravention', '$concept_contravened$')]. An $concept_article$ is considered $concept_non_fulfilled$ if consecutively $concept_contravened$ up to the maximum number of allowed $concept_contraventions$ for that $concept_article$.

Consequences of $concept_non_fulfillment$ may include subjecting the $concept_contravening$ [concept_country] to #bold compensation payments#!, as well as #bold freezing#! or outright #bold breaking#! the $concept_treaty$.

If a $concept_treaty$ is #b frozen#!, the $concept_contravening$ $concept_country$ still pays and fulfills whatever they can from their $concept_articles$, but receives #b nothing#! in return.
concept_prestige_desc: Your [concept_rank] is determined by comparing your $concept_prestige$ to all other [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] in the world. $concept_prestige$ originates primarily from how impressive your economy is as measured by your [concept_gdp], how much [concept_power_projection] your military forces generate, and your [concept_country_tier]. It can also be affected by other factors such as your [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_prestige_desc_gamestate','Arts Academy')] and [Concept('concept_monument','$concept_monuments$')], and if you are a world leader in the production of a certain [concept_good].
concept_power_projection_desc: A broad measure of how imposing a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] military forces are, divided into [concept_army_power_projection] and [concept_naval_power_projection].
