concept_army_power_projection_desc: The [concept_power_projection] of a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_army], derived from the average of its [concept_offense] and [concept_defense] scaled by [concept_manpower]. It contributes to [concept_prestige] and builds [concept_involvement] in the [Concept('concept_strategic_region','$concept_strategic_region_short$')] where the army is deployed.
concept_naval_power_projection_desc: The [concept_power_projection] of a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] navy. Each [concept_ship] projects an amount determined by its [concept_ship_type] and [Concept('concept_ship_modification','$concept_ship_modifications$')]. A [concept_fleet] on a $naval_mission_type_project_power$ [concept_naval_mission] generates its $concept_naval_power_projection$ in [concept_involvement] for every [Concept('concept_strategic_region','$concept_strategic_region_short$')] its mission area covers, scaled by the fleet's [concept_presence].
concept_dividends_desc:
While [concept_privately_owned] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] have a positive [concept_building_balance], some of this profit is paid out to the owning [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] as $concept_dividends$, which are subject to [concept_budget_dividends_taxes].

Depending on the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] current $ECONOMIC_SYSTEM_GC_LINK$, a portion of [concept_pop] $concept_dividends$ may be invested back into the economy through [concept_reinvestment], while the remainder goes towards [concept_pop_needs] and [concept_wealth].

If a $concept_building$ is fully or partially [concept_nationally_owned], profits can be payed out as [concept_government_dividends] instead.
concept_government_dividends_desc:
While [concept_nationally_owned] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] have a positive [concept_building_balance], some of these profits are paid directly to the [concept_treasury] as $concept_government_dividends$.

The amount paid depends on the proportion of [concept_privately_owned] to $concept_nationally_owned$ [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_levels$')].

In large economies with a high [concept_gdp], inefficiencies will also result in some of the profits being wasted. Additionally, [concept_loans] against [concept_cash_reserves] held by $concept_nationally_owned$ $concept_buildings$ will reduce the amount of $concept_government_dividends$ that [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] pay out.
concept_credit_desc: The national $concept_credit$ is the amount of [concept_money] the [concept_treasury] can borrow from its economy, equal to the sum of all domestic [concept_cash_reserves] plus a base value determined by [concept_gdp]. If the [concept_principal] exceeds the $concept_credit_limit$ the [concept_country] goes into [concept_default].
concept_principal_desc: The total size of [concept_loans] the [concept_treasury] has accrued, not including the [concept_budget_interest] it owes. If the [concept_principal] exceeds your [concept_credit] you will go into [concept_default].
concept_loans_desc:
Funds that the [concept_treasury] owes to the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_building_owners].

Whenever the $concept_treasury$ is running a negative balance, it will automatically increase its $concept_loans$ unless it has sufficient [concept_gold_reserves] to cover it.

[concept_budget_interest] is accrued on the [concept_principal] weekly. If the $concept_principal$ ever exceeds the $concept_country_possessive$ [concept_credit], it goes into [concept_default].
concept_war_support_desc: A measure of how strongly your [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] population supports its current [concept_war], from #n 0%#! to #p 100%#!. It will change over the course of a [concept_war], driven by [concept_casualties], enemy [concept_occupation], enemy-controlled [Concept('concept_war_goal','$concept_war_goals$')], and [concept_turmoil] at home. As $concept_war_support$ falls, the $concept_country$ becomes more willing to accept a [concept_peace_deal], and a sufficiently exhausted country may capitulate, allowing all $concept_war_goals$ against it to be pressed.
concept_occupation_desc: Any [Concept('concept_province','$concept_provinces$')] the [concept_country] owns that are currently part of an enemy [concept_theater] are considered $concept_occupied$. $concept_occupation$ contributes to [concept_war_support]. $concept_occupying$ a [concept_war_goal] you hold on an enemy is usually required before it can be enforced against them.
concept_theater_desc: A region of adjacent [Concept('concept_province','$concept_provinces$')] under the control of a single [concept_country]. [Concept('concept_front','$concept_fronts$')] are created on the border between two $concept_theaters$ controlled by $concept_countries$ hostile to each other in a [concept_war] or [concept_diplomatic_play].
concept_literacy_desc:
The percentage or absolute number of individuals in a [concept_pop] who can read and write. Certain [Concept('concept_profession', '$concept_professions$')] demand higher $concept_literacy$ than others, limiting the [concept_pop_qualifications] for $concept_pops$ in other $concept_professions$ unless their $concept_literacy$ is high enough. You can invest in your [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_literacy_desc_added','Education')] in order to develop higher $concept_literacy$ in your $concept_population$ over time.

$concept_pops$ will face an increasing penalty to $concept_pop_growth_birthrate$ proportional to their $concept_literacy$, up to the following:
[GetStaticModifier('literacy_penalty').GetDesc]#!
concept_turmoil_desc: [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] and [Concept('concept_culture', '$concept_cultures$')] with $concept_turmoil$ contain [Concept('concept_radical', '$concept_radicals$')] that are unhappy with their current circumstances. The amount of $concept_turmoil$ is equal to the fraction of the $concept_state$'s or $concept_culture$'s [concept_workforce] that are $concept_radical$.\n\n$concept_turmoil$ can inflict a number of negative local status effects on a $concept_state$ if it gets high enough. [concept_cultural_turmoil] can impact a whole [concept_country] in very disruptive ways.
concept_unemployed_desc:
An $concept_unemployed$ [concept_pop] does not work in any of its [Concept('concept_state','$concept_state_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] and therefore does not collect a [concept_building_wage]. They are likely to take the next best job that comes along, and will likely [Concept('concept_migration','$concept_emigrate$')] if nothing comes along.

$concept_pops$ living in a state will face an increasing penalty to $concept_pop_growth_birthrate$ proportional to the unemployement rate in that state, up to the following:
[GetStaticModifier('unemployment_birth_penalty_state').GetDesc]#!
concept_cultural_turmoil_desc: The [concept_turmoil] generated by [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] of a specific [concept_culture], generally from its proportion of [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')]. If its value in a [concept_country] is at least [GetDefine('NPops','MASS_MIGRATION_ORIGIN_MIN_TURMOIL')|v%0], it might trigger a [concept_mass_migration] of that $concept_culture$ to another $concept_country$. Alternatively, at high enough values, those $concept_pops$ may instead attempt to separate their [Concept('concept_homeland','$concept_homelands$')] in a [concept_secession].
concept_commander_rank_desc: A [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commander_possessive$')] $concept_commander_rank_short$ determines their [concept_command_limit], as well as how much [concept_clout] they confer to their [concept_interest_group]. Retiring a $concept_commander$ will cause their $concept_interest_group$'s [concept_approval] to fall by a factor depending on their $concept_commander_rank_short$.
concept_commander_desc: A [concept_character] in command of a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_military_formation]. A $concept_commander$ can be either a [concept_general] or an [concept_admiral] depending on the type of $concept_military_formation$ they are leading. Their [concept_commander_rank] contributes to the [concept_command_limit] of the $concept_military_formation$ they are in, and also impacts the amount of troops that they are able to bring with them into battle. $commander_coup_loc$
commander_coup_loc: [Concept('concept_popularity', '$concept_popular$')] $concept_commanders$ belonging to an [concept_interest_group] with low [concept_approval] may initiate a [concept_coup].
concept_general_desc: An [Concept('concept_army','$concept_army_possessive$')] [concept_commander] is called a $concept_general$ who leads the $concept_army$'s [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] into [concept_battle]. You can change any $concept_general$'s [concept_order] on the $concept_army$ [concept_military_formation] panel or by right-clicking the $concept_general$ at any time. What $concept_orders$ you may give a $concept_general$ depends on his [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')], but there will always be the basic #b Advance#! and #b Defend#! $concept_orders$. Any other military effects from a $concept_general$'s $concept_character_traits$ may affect his $concept_army$ as a whole or are applied onto $concept_battalions$ under his direct command when in a [concept_battle].
concept_admiral_desc: A naval [concept_commander] [concept_character] who leads a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')]. Effects from an $concept_admiral$'s [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] are conferred onto $concept_ships$ under their command.
concept_admiral_defeated_desc: An [concept_admiral] is $concept_admiral_defeated$ when he loses a [concept_battle] at sea. A [concept_fleet] is $concept_admiral_defeated$ when all its [Concept('concept_admiral','$concept_admirals$')] are $concept_admiral_defeated$. $concept_admirals$ and $concept_fleets$ will only repair and regroup once they are back at their home [concept_hq] and their [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')] have regained at least [GetDefine('NMilitary','MANPOWER_RATIO_REQUIRED_TO_CLEAR_DEFEATED_ADMIRALS')|v0%] of their total [concept_manpower].
concept_military_formation_desc: A $concept_military_formation$ is an [concept_army] or [concept_fleet] that is used in [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')] to achieve military objectives. They may have assigned [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] and a [concept_commander] and can be ordered to [Concept('concept_front','$concept_fronts$')] to fight the enemy forces there.
concept_political_strength_desc: The degree of power a [concept_pop], and consequently the [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] it supports, have over the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] politics. It is derived from its supporting $concept_pops$' [concept_wealth]. $concept_pops$ who live in [Concept('concept_unincorporated_state','$concept_unincorporated_states$')] have much less $concept_political_strength$, while $concept_pops$ in the [concept_capital_state] have more.\n\n$concept_pops$ distribute their $concept_political_strength$ to the $concept_interest_groups$ it supports proportionate to how many of its members support it. If an $concept_interest_group$ is a member of a [concept_party], they also gain $concept_political_strength$ from the [concept_votes] that $concept_party$ received in the last [concept_election]. An $concept_interest_group$'s [concept_clout] is equal to their share of the $concept_country$'s total $concept_political_strength$.
concept_invasion_desc: An [concept_army] attacking a [concept_state] via land or sea, the latter also being referred to as [concept_naval_invasion].
concept_naval_invasion_desc: A maritime invasion of a coastal [concept_state], coordinated between a [concept_fleet] and an [concept_army]. The $concept_fleet$ keeps the waters off the coast clear to ensure the $concept_army$ can land safely, while the $concept_army$ executes a series of land [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')] to win [concept_occupation] in the targeted $concept_state$.\n\nThe controller of the targeted $concept_state$ can defend against the $concept_naval_invasion$ by positioning their own [Concept('concept_fleet','$concept_fleets$')] in the affected [concept_sea_node] or stationing a [Concept('concept_mobilize_army','$concept_mobilize_army_mobilized$')] $concept_army$ in the invaded $concept_state$.
concept_working_adults_desc: The part of a [concept_pop] that make up the [concept_workforce] that work in [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')] for [Concept('concept_building_wage', '$concept_building_wages$')]. They are the main source of a $concept_pop$'s [Concept('concept_pop_income','$concept_pop_income_short$')] and [concept_political_strength].
concept_dependents_desc: The part of a [concept_pop] not considered part of the [concept_workforce]. They represent the families of the [concept_working_adults] and normally constitute the majority of the population. $concept_dependents$ usually generate [concept_dependent_income] that is typically smaller than the [Concept('concept_building_wage','$concept_building_wages$')] collected by $concept_working_adults$, but they also have lower [concept_pop_needs]. While they are able to support [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] their [concept_political_strength] typically count for less. They are only granted [Concept('concept_votes','$concept_voting_rights$')] under very specific [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')].\n\nEnacting different $concept_laws$ or maintaining certain [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institutions$')] may convert $concept_dependents$ into $concept_working_adults$ over time, increase their [concept_political_strength], or supplement their $concept_dependent_income$.
concept_disenfranchised_desc: A $concept_disenfranchised$ [concept_pop] is prohibited from participating in the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] politics. As a result they cannot support any [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')]. The most common reason for a $concept_pop$ to be $concept_disenfranchised$ is low [concept_acceptance].
concept_input_mult_desc: An adjustment to the amount of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] [Concept('concept_good_consumption','$concept_good_consumed$')] by a [concept_building].
concept_throughput_desc: The effectiveness of the [concept_workforce] of a [concept_building]. $concept_throughput$ increases both the [Concept('concept_good_consumption','$concept_input_goods$')] and the [Concept('concept_good_production','$concept_output_goods$')] or other effects. It can increase as a result of [concept_economy_of_scale], and might be adjusted up or down due to [Concept('concept_modifier','$concept_modifiers$')].
concept_native_uprising_desc: A type of [concept_diplomatic_play] that can occur if the [concept_tension] between a colonizer and a [concept_decentralized_nation] rises to #b $tension_volatile$#! level. In this $concept_diplomatic_play_short$, the $concept_decentralized_nation$ will mobilize its warriors and attempt to seize the [concept_colony] from the colonizer.
concept_discrimination_desc:
[Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] can be $concept_discriminated_against$ if their [concept_culture] and/or [concept_religion] have a low [concept_acceptance] value in their [concept_country]. Typically, $concept_pops$ in the lower three $concept_acceptance$ statuses are considered to be $concept_discriminated$. $concept_discriminated$ $concept_pops$:
- get paid less than their peers
- have less [concept_political_strength]
- are less likely to develop [concept_pop_qualifications] for certain [concept_profession]
- naturally become [concept_radical] over time
- and are more likely to [Concept('concept_migration','$concept_emigrate$')].

In addition, certain [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] limit or expand national acceptance of $concept_culture$ and $concept_religions$.
concept_approval_desc: An [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_group_possessive$')] $concept_approval$ depends on two main factors: how much of their [concept_political_strength] comes from [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] compared to [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalists$')], and how well the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] current [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] match with the $concept_interest_group$'s [Concept('concept_ideology','$concept_ideologies$')]. In addition, if a new $concept_law$ is currently being [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enacted$')], $concept_approval$ will be affected by a larger temporary adjustment which will linger while [Concept('concept_decay','$concept_decaying$')] for up to #v [GetDefine('NPolitics','CHANGED_LAW_APPROVAL_MONTHS')|0] months#! after it has passed.\n\nAn $concept_interest_group$'s $concept_approval$ impacts which [Concept('concept_interest_group_trait','$concept_interest_group_traits$')] they activate. [GetApprovalRatingFromValue(GetDefine('NPolitics','APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_ANGRY'))] $concept_interest_groups$ contribute to the [Concept('concept_activism','$concept_activism_short$')] of [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')], while $concept_interest_groups$ that are at least [GetApprovalRatingFromValue(GetDefine('NPolitics','APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_HAPPY'))] will refrain from joining $concept_political_movements_short$ in the first place. $ig_approval_coup_loc$
ig_approval_coup_loc: An $concept_interest_group$ with $concept_approval$ at or below [GetApprovalRatingFromValue(GetDefine('NPolitics','APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_ANGRY'))] may launch a [concept_coup] against the sitting [concept_government].
concept_insurrection_desc: An $concept_insurrection$ is either a [Concept('concept_secession', '$concept_secessionist$')] or a [Concept('concept_revolution', '$concept_revolutionary$')] [concept_political_movement]. This means the $concept_political_movement_short$ is on the brink of turning into a [concept_civil_war]. Any [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] or [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] that are part of a $concept_insurrectionary$ $concept_political_movement_short$ are also labeled #italic $concept_insurrectionary$#!.
concept_revolution_desc: Contrary to [Concept('concept_secession','$concept_secessions$')], a $concept_revolution$ will try to annex the entire [concept_country], reshaping it according to their [concept_core_movement_ideology]. A $concept_revolution$ is the result of a [concept_political_movement] that has grown too [concept_radical] with high [Concept('concept_political_movement_support', '$concept_political_movement_support_short$')] and [Concept('concept_activism','$concept_activism_short$')]. If the $concept_political_movement_short$ starts an uprising, [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] in which its $concept_political_movement_supporting$ [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] are relatively strong will separate from the rest of the $concept_country$ and start a [concept_diplomatic_play] to annex the [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalists$')].\n\nYou can lower the $concept_political_movement_possessive_short$ [Concept('concept_activism','$concept_activism_short$')] by reducing the number of [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] in the $concept_political_movement_supporting$ $concept_pops$ and increasing the [concept_approval] of their [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')]. You can also weaken and slow a $concept_revolution$ down using the [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_revolution_desc_added','Home Affairs')] [concept_institution].
concept_secession_desc: Contrary to [Concept('concept_revolution','$concept_revolutions$')], a $concept_secession$ will split the [concept_country] in two where the $concept_secessionists$ will fight to break loose and form a new nation. A $concept_secession$ is the result of a [concept_political_movement] that has grown too [concept_radical] with high [Concept('concept_political_movement_support', '$concept_political_movement_support_short$')] and [Concept('concept_activism','$concept_activism_short$')]. If the $concept_political_movement_short$ starts an uprising, [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] in which its $concept_political_movement_supporting$ [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] are relatively strong will separate from the rest of the $concept_country$ and start a [concept_diplomatic_play] to break loose.\n\nYou can lower the $concept_political_movement_possessive_short$ [Concept('concept_activism','$concept_activism_short$')] by reducing the number of [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] in the $concept_political_movement_supporting$ $concept_pops$ and increasing the [concept_approval] of their $concept_interest_groups$. You can also weaken and slow a $concept_secession$ down using the [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_revolution_desc_added','Home Affairs')] [concept_institution].
concept_civil_war_desc: A [concept_war] where a [concept_country] has split into two opposing sides. It can either be a [concept_revolution] or a [concept_secession] stemming from a [concept_political_movement].
concept_political_movement_support_desc:
The $concept_political_movement_support_short$ of a [concept_political_movement] is based on the [concept_political_strength] of its supporting [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] as well as the [concept_popularity] and [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] of any supporting [Concept('concept_agitator','$concept_agitators$')]. A $concept_political_movement$ with at least [LabelingHelper.GetLabelForRadicalism(GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MIN_RADICALISM_FOR_LAW_ENACTMENT_IMPACT'))] (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MIN_RADICALISM_FOR_LAW_ENACTMENT_IMPACT')|%0]#!) [Concept('concept_activism','$concept_activism_short$')] increases the [concept_enactment_success] chance if you pursue a [concept_law] they desire, or increases the [Concept('concept_enactment_stall','$concept_enactment_stall_short$')] chance if they oppose it. This increased chance is directly based on the $concept_political_movement_support_short$. Should the $concept_political_movement$ lead to a [concept_insurrection], $concept_political_movement_support$ will determine how many [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] it will start with.

#title $concept_political_movement_support_short$ thresholds:#! #indent_newline:3 
[GetSupportLabelsDesc]
concept_political_movement_desc:
A $concept_political_movement$ is driven by [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] [Concept('concept_political_movement_support','$concept_political_movement_supporting$')] it based on its [concept_core_movement_ideology]. Their $concept_political_movement_support_short$ comes in varying degrees of [concept_activism] dependent on how many $concept_pops$ are engaged or angry enough on the matter. [Concept('concept_agitator','$concept_agitators$')] can also join and $concept_political_movement_support_short$ a $concept_political_movement_short$, increasing the $concept_activism_short$ based on their [concept_popularity]. If enough $concept_pops$ are $concept_political_movement_supporting$ and the $concept_activism_short$ is high enough, the $concept_political_movement_short$ may become [Concept('concept_insurrection', '$concept_insurrectionary$')], depending on the [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] in the $concept_core_movement_ideology$ and the type of $concept_political_movement_short$. An [Concept('concept_insurrection', '$concept_insurrectionary$')] $concept_political_movement_short$ may in turn lead to a [concept_civil_war] breaking out.

$concept_political_movements$ will exert [concept_political_movement_pressure] on [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] based on the percentage of [concept_political_strength] from $concept_political_movement_supporting$ $concept_pops$.

$concept_political_movements_short$ both affect $concept_laws$ and vice versa. If the $concept_activism$ is at least [LabelingHelper.GetLabelForRadicalism(GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MIN_RADICALISM_FOR_LAW_ENACTMENT_IMPACT'))] (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MIN_RADICALISM_FOR_LAW_ENACTMENT_IMPACT')|%0]#!), the $concept_political_movement_short$ will increase the [concept_enactment_success] and [Concept('concept_enactment_stall','$concept_enactment_stall_short$')] chances of the [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_endorsed$')] and [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_opposed$')] $concept_laws$ in the $concept_core_movement_ideology_short$ based on the $concept_political_movement_support_short$. Similarly, if a $concept_political_movement_short$ is at least [LabelingHelper.GetLabelForRadicalism(GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MIN_RADICALISM_FOR_LAW_ENACTMENT_IMPACT'))] (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MIN_RADICALISM_FOR_LAW_ENACTMENT_IMPACT')|%0]#!) and a $concept_law$, either $concept_endorsed$ or $concept_opposed$ by the $concept_core_movement_ideology_short$, is being [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enacted$')], the $concept_activism_short$ #b cannot#! drop below [LabelingHelper.GetLabelForRadicalism(GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MIN_RADICALISM_FOR_LAW_ENACTMENT_IMPACT'))] (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MIN_RADICALISM_FOR_LAW_ENACTMENT_IMPACT')|%0]#!).
concept_activism_desc:
$concept_activism$ is the percentage of [Concept('concept_political_movement_support','$concept_political_movement_supporting$')] [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] willing to actively push for a [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movement_possessive$')] agenda. It determines how many [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] are generated by the $concept_political_movement_short$ each week and how close the $concept_political_movement_short$ is to becoming [Concept('concept_insurrection', '$concept_insurrectionary$')]. If it is already $concept_insurrectionary$, it determines the max progress the $concept_revolution$ can reach.

Luckily, we are able to predict how a $concept_political_movement_possessive$ $concept_activism_short$ will shift. If the prediction is @activism_red! $RADICALISM_PROTESTING$ (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'RADICALISM_PROTESTING_THRESHOLD')|%0]#!) or above, the $concept_political_movement_short$ has a high risk of becoming $concept_insurrectionary$. If the prediction is @activism_red! $RADICALISM_MILITANT$ (#r 100%#!) and the $concept_political_movement_support_short$ is enough, a [concept_civil_war] is imminent since the progress of the [concept_revolution] or [concept_secession] can now reach #v 100%#!.

If the $concept_activism_short$ is at least [LabelingHelper.GetLabelForRadicalism(GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MIN_RADICALISM_FOR_LAW_ENACTMENT_IMPACT'))] (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MIN_RADICALISM_FOR_LAW_ENACTMENT_IMPACT')|%0]#!), the $concept_political_movement_short$ will increase the [concept_enactment_success] and [Concept('concept_enactment_stall','$concept_enactment_stall_short$')] chances of the [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_endorsed$')] and [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_opposed$')] $concept_laws$ in the [concept_core_movement_ideology] based on the $concept_political_movement_support_short$.

If the $concept_activism_short$ is at least [LabelingHelper.GetLabelForRadicalism(GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MONTHLY_RADICALS_THRESHOLD'))] (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MOVEMENT_MONTHLY_RADICALS_THRESHOLD')|%0]#!), a number of $concept_political_movement_supporting$ $concept_pops$ will become $concept_radicalized$ each month, and certain $concept_political_movements_short$ will begin to generate [concept_obstinance] in $concept_states$ with $concept_political_movement_supporting$ $concept_pops$.

#title $concept_activism_short$ thresholds:#! #indent_newline:3 
[GetActivismLabelsDesc]
concept_political_movement_pressure_desc: [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')] will $concept_political_movement_pressure_short$ [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] based on the percentage of [concept_political_strength] from [Concept('concept_political_movement_support','$concept_political_movement_supporting$')] [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')]. The $concept_interest_group$ is considered #b $concept_political_movement_pressured_short$#! if the $concept_political_movement_pressure_short$ is above #v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'IG_INFLUENCING_MOVEMENT_MIN_SUPPORTING_CLOUT')|%0]#!. Then the $concept_political_movement_possessive$ [concept_character] [Concept('concept_ideology','$concept_ideologies$')] will become possible for new [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')] of that $concept_interest_group$.\n\nAll $concept_pops$ in an $concept_interest_group$ have varying $concept_political_strength$ which sums up to the $concept_interest_group_possessive$ total $concept_political_strength$. The percentage of this total $concept_political_strength$, represented by $concept_pops$ who are $concept_political_movement_supporting$ a $concept_political_movement$, is what defines the $concept_political_movement_pressure$. $concept_pops$ with high $concept_political_strength$ will have higher leverage to influence their $concept_interest_groups$ with their $concept_political_movement_possessive$ $concept_ideologies$ and beliefs.
concept_core_movement_ideology_desc: This [concept_ideology] is what the [Concept('concept_political_movement_support','$concept_political_movement_supporting$')] [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] and [Concept('concept_agitator','$concept_agitators$')] care about and what the [concept_political_movement] as a whole will be pushing for. Passing [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_endorsed$')] by this $concept_ideology$ will create [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalists$')] from $concept_political_movement_supporting$ $concept_pops$. If any [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] are [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure','$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')], this is guranteed to be one of the [concept_character] $concept_ideologies$ to become possible for new [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')] of those $concept_interest_groups$.
concept_peace_deal_desc: When a [concept_war_leader] wish to end a [concept_war] they may offer a $concept_peace_deal$. The deal must be agreed to by all negotiating $concept_countries$ remaining in the $concept_war$ to take effect. To increase the chance the $concept_peace_deal$ will be agreed to, the $concept_war_leader$ is allowed to include or exclude proposed [Concept('concept_war_goal','$concept_war_goals$')] from both sides.
concept_war_desc: An active armed conflict between two sides of co-belligerent [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] as a result of the failure to peacefully resolve a [concept_diplomatic_play]. During $concept_wars$, [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')] on land and at sea will follow [Concept('concept_order','$concept_orders$')] to complete certain objectives, often resulting in [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')] between the two sides.
concept_war_goal_desc: $concept_war_goals$ are the objectives a [concept_country] is fighting a [concept_war] over. They are determined during the [concept_diplomatic_play] and are fixed after the $concept_war$ has begun.\n\nThe first $concept_war_goal$ claimed as part of the $concept_diplomatic_play$ is considered your $concept_primary_demand$, and some $concept_diplomatic_plays$ require it to be included in all $concept_peace_deals$.
concept_controlled_war_goal_desc: If the holder of a [concept_war_goal], or their [Concept('concept_ally','$concept_allies$')], [Concept('concept_occupation','$concept_occupy$')] at least [GetDefine('NWar','STATE_PARTIAL_OCCUPATION_THRESHOLD')|%v] of the required [concept_state] or [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')], they are considered to have $concept_control_war_goal_short$ of this [concept_war_goal]. [concept_war_support] can only drop below #v 0#! if the opposing side $concept_controls_war_goal_short$ all their $concept_war_goals$.
concept_primary_demand_desc: $concept_primary_demands$ are [Concept('concept_war_goal','$concept_war_goals$')] that will be enforced on the opposing side of a [concept_diplomatic_play] if they decide to back down. The first [concept_war_goal] added on each side is always a $concept_primary_demand$, as are any [Concept('concept_war_goal','$concept_war_goals$')] added against the leader of the opposing side through [Concept('concept_sway','$concept_swaying$')].
concept_secondary_demand_desc: $concept_secondary_demands$ are [Concept('concept_war_goal','$concept_war_goals$')] that will NOT be enforced in a [concept_diplomatic_play] if they decide to back down, but can be taken in a [concept_peace_deal] or through capitulation if the play escalates into a [concept_war]. A $concept_secondary_demand$ that is targeting the leader of the opposing side can be turned into a $concept_primary_demand$ by spending [concept_diplomatic_maneuvers], though doing so might result in a [concept_diplomatic_incident].
concept_resource_potential_desc: A $concept_resource_potential$ grants the ability to construct and expand a specific [concept_building] type in the state, usually a resource industry such as fisheries, mines, or plantations. The maximum [concept_building_level] you can expand the $concept_building$ to is limited either to a fixed amount per resources, or by the $concept_state$'s amount of [concept_arable_land].
concept_government_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] $concept_government$ consists of one or several [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')]. If the $concept_country$ has [Concept('concept_votes','$concept_voting_rights$')] these $concept_interest_groups$ may be organized into [Concept('concept_party','$concept_parties$')]. Depending on the $concept_country$'s [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')], this mix of $concept_interest_groups$ will result in higher or lower $concept_government$ [concept_legitimacy].\n\nAny new $concept_law$ you wish to [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enact$')] must have some support among $concept_interest_groups$ that make up the $concept_government$, unless it is supported by an active [concept_political_movement]. The ability to quickly and painlessly push the $concept_law$ through the legislature depends on how unified the $concept_government$'s support of it is.
concept_interest_desc: A [concept_country] maintaining an $concept_interest$ in a [concept_strategic_region] signals to the rest of the world that they might get involved in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] taking place there. Having a high enough [concept_interest_tier] in a $concept_strategic_region$ is a requirement the ability to start or join $concept_diplomatic_plays$, and you cannot [Concept('concept_colony', '$concept_colonize$')] [Concept('concept_state_region','$concept_state_regions$')] where you do not maintain a high enough $concept_interest_tier$.
concept_involvement_desc: A [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_country_possessive$')] $concept_involvement$ in a [concept_strategic_region] measures how strong their [concept_interest] is in the region.\n\n$HOW_TO_INCREASE_INVOLVEMENT$
concept_local_country_desc:
A [concept_country] is $concept_local_country_short$ to a [concept_strategic_region] if it satisfies any of the following conditions:
$TAB$• Has its [concept_capital_state] in the $concept_strategic_region_short$
$TAB$• Has [GetDefine('NDiplomacy', 'REGION_LOCALITY_SHARE_THRESHOLD')|0v%] or more [concept_locality] in the $concept_strategic_region_short$
$TAB$• Has [GetDefine('NDiplomacy', 'REGION_LOCALITY_COUNTRY_INCORPORATED_SHARE_THRESHOLD')|0v%] or more of its [Concept('concept_incorporated_state', '$concept_incorporated_states$')] in the $concept_strategic_region_short$
concept_locality_desc: A measure of how local a country is in a [concept_strategic_region], which builds on a combination of the share of owned [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')], [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_population$')], and [concept_gdp] in a $concept_strategic_region_short$
concept_interest_tier_desc: An [concept_interest_tier] signifies the level of presence that a [concept_country] has in a [concept_strategic_region] and can be upgraded by increasing [concept_involvement] in a given $concept_strategic_region_short$.\nHigher tiers unlock new interactions and benefits.
concept_diplomatic_relevancy_desc:
Having $concept_diplomatic_relevancy$ is required for a [concept_country] to engage in certain interactions like signing [Concept('concept_treaty', '$concept_treaties$')]. A $concept_country$ is considered $concept_diplomatically_relevant$ for another if one of the following conditions is fulfilled:
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$They share a direct border
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$They share a direct border with only one [concept_sea_node] between them
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$One $concept_country$ is bordering a [concept_subject] of the other
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$One $concept_country_possessive$ $concept_subject$ is bordering the other $concept_country_possessive$ $concept_subject$
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$An existing $concept_treaty$ between the two $concept_countries$
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$Both $concept_countries$ being [Concept('concept_great_power','$concept_great_powers$')]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$One of the $concept_countries$ declaring a [concept_rivalry] towards the other
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$One of the $concept_countries$ conducting [concept_piracy] targetting the other
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$Both $concept_countries$ having overlapping [Concept('concept_interest', '$concept_interests$')]
concept_strategic_adjacency_desc:
$concept_strategic_adjacency$ is an adjacency check for two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] that is used to allow certain interactions between them if they fulfill the conditions. Two $concept_countries$ count as $concept_strategically_adjacent$ if one of these conditions is fulfilled:
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$They share a direct border
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$They share a direct border with only one [concept_sea_node] between them
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$One $concept_country$ is bordering a [concept_subject] of the other
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$One $concept_country_possessive$ $concept_subject$ is bordering the other $concept_country_possessive$ $concept_subject$
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$One $concept_country$ is bordering a third $concept_country$ that grants it [concept_military_access] and is bordering the other
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$One $concept_country$ is bordering an unpressed [concept_war_goal]
concept_obligation_desc: One [concept_country] can become $concept_obligated$ to another as a result of agreements made during [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] or when one $concept_country$ buys out another's [concept_loans]. While $concept_obligated$ to a $concept_country$ you are unable to start $concept_diplomatic_plays$ against them or even join a $concept_diplomatic_play_short$ on the other side as them. The other $concept_country$ may use an $concept_obligation$ they hold over you to force you into a [concept_diplomatic_pact] or [concept_treaty], or may absolve it to [concept_sway] you into supporting them in a $concept_diplomatic_play$ or increase [concept_relations] with you.
concept_gdp_desc: Each unit of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] [Concept('concept_good_production', '$concept_good_produced$')|l] in your [concept_country] contributes to your [concept_gdp]. The [concept_market_price] value of your national production is reduced by the value of $concept_goods$ used as inputs into the process.\n\n$concept_gdp_short$ affects [concept_prestige] and [concept_budget_minting].
concept_gdp_per_capita_desc: Your country's [concept_gdp] divided by its total [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')].
concept_gdp_ownership_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_gdp] can be both domestically owned by the $concept_country$ itself and foreignly owned by other $concept_countries$. If another $concept_country$ has [Concept('concept_foreign_investment_rights','$concept_foreign_investment_rights_short$')], they may foreignly own [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_levels$')] in the initial $concept_country$. The $concept_gdp_short$ generated from those $concept_building_levels$ then contribute to the foreign $concept_country_possessive$ $concept_gdp_short$. Only domestically owned $concept_gdp_short$ contributes to the domestic $concept_country_possessive$ [concept_prestige] and [concept_budget_minting].
concept_education_access_desc: The degree by which a [concept_pop] is able to access education for their children. As new generations are born and raised, the $concept_pop$'s [concept_literacy] will move towards its level of $concept_education_access$.
concept_isolated_state_desc: A [concept_state_region] is considered $concept_isolated_state_short$ from its [concept_market] if it is not connected by land to its [concept_market_capital], and is not connected by land to a [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_isolated_state_desc_added','Port')] that can make a [concept_port_connection] to its $concept_market_capital$. $concept_isolated_states$ do not generate any [concept_buy_orders] and [concept_sell_orders], nor is the [concept_local_price] of [Concept('concept_good', '$concept_goods$')] affected by their [concept_market_price].
concept_shortage_desc:
If the supply for a [concept_good] is less than [GetDefine('NEconomy', 'GOODS_SHORTAGE_PENALTY_THRESHOLD')|v%0] of its demand, that $concept_good$ is considered to be in $concept_shortage$. While in $concept_shortage$, different penalties might apply depending on how the $concept_good$ is used.

$concept_goods$ used as [Concept('concept_good_consumption','$concept_input_goods$')] in [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] will result in an increasing output penalty depending on the severity of the $concept_input_goods_shortage$.

In the case of the [GetPopNeed('popneed_basic_food').GetName] [Concept('concept_pop_needs','$concept_pop_need_short$')], a $concept_shortage$ will affect the [concept_food_security] in that [concept_state], potentially leading to [concept_starvation] and even [concept_famine]. [GetPopNeed('popneed_basic_food').GetName] $concept_shortages$ are based on the $concept_shortage$ level for each of the individual $concept_goods$ that fulfill it.

$concept_shortages$ are usually caused by insufficient availability of the $concept_good$ in the [concept_market] in question, but may also be a result of low [concept_market_access] in the relevant $concept_state$.
concept_market_desc: All [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] in the same $concept_market$ will trade [Concept('concept_good', '$concept_goods$')] with each other, unless they are [Concept('concept_isolated_state','$concept_isolated_state_short$')]. How well connected these $concept_states$ are with each other is measured by their [concept_market_access]. $concept_markets$ may also trade with each other through the [concept_world_market].\n\nEach [concept_country] either controls its own $concept_market$ or participates in a different one via a [concept_customs_union] or [concept_subject] relationship.
concept_world_market_desc: The $concept_world_market$ serves as the place to conduct autonomous [concept_trade]. The price of [Concept('concept_good', '$concept_goods$')] is determined by the number of $concept_imports$ and $concept_exports$. [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] need [concept_market_access] in order to conduct $concept_trade$ via their [GetBuildingType('building_trade_center').GetName]. Landlocked [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] can get Transit Rights from other $concept_countries$ to secure access to the $concept_world_market$.
concept_market_access_desc: A measure of how well-connected a [concept_state] is to the rest of its [concept_market]. It starts at 100% and is reduced proportionally whenever the $concept_state$'s [concept_infrastructure_usage] exceeds its [concept_infrastructure]. It impacts both how many [concept_sell_orders] and [concept_buy_orders] are generated due to the $concept_state$'s [concept_good_production] and [concept_good_consumption], and also how much the [concept_market_price] affects the [concept_local_price] of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')].
concept_world_market_access_desc: $concept_world_market_access$ exists if a [concept_state] is connected to the [concept_world_market] via a [concept_world_market_hub]. Its value is impacted by the $concept_state_possessive$ [concept_market_access].
concept_world_market_hub_desc: A $concept_world_market_hub$ is the place from which [concept_trade] via the [concept_world_market] is conducted. It is created if a [concept_market_area] has at least one [GetBuildingType('building_port').GetName]. The location of a $concept_world_market_hub$ can change depending on [GetBuildingType('building_port').GetName] levels and [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_state_possessive$')] [concept_gdp].
concept_infrastructure_desc: $concept_infrastructure$ is provided by [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] like [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_infrastructure_desc_added','Railway')] and [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_infrastructure_desc_added_2','Port')]. It influences how well connected a [concept_state] is to its [concept_market], and how rapidly [Concept('concept_battalion', '$concept_battalions$')] [Concept('concept_mobilize_battalion','$concept_mobilize_battalion_mobilize$')].
concept_infrastructure_usage_desc: [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] use a certain amount of [concept_infrastructure] depending on how technologically advanced or demanding they are. The total $concept_infrastructure_usage$ in the [concept_state] is compared to the $concept_infrastructure$ to determine the $concept_state$'s [concept_market_access]. $concept_infrastructure_usage$ also increases the cost of [Concept('concept_port_connection','$concept_port_connections$')].
concept_good_desc: $concept_goods$ are [Concept('concept_good_production','$concept_good_produced$')] in [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] and are [Concept('concept_good_consumption','$concept_good_consumed$')] by $concept_buildings$ and [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')]. $concept_goods$ have both a [concept_local_price] and a [concept_market_price].
concept_prestige_good_desc:
A [concept_good] that is considered prestigious and to be of superior quality. $concept_prestige_goods$ are produced by some [Concept('concept_company','$concept_companies$')] that have a high enough [concept_prosperity]. Being a top producer of $concept_prestige_goods$ grants significant [concept_prestige].

Additionally, $concept_prestige_goods$ grant the following benefits:
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$Increased [concept_good_consumption] by [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] relative to other $concept_goods$
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$Increased [concept_trade_advantage] for [Concept('concept_trade','$concept_exports$')]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$Increased [concept_throughput] for [Concept('concept_building','$concept_building_industries$')] which use them as $concept_input_goods$
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$Increased [concept_offense] and [concept_defense] for [Concept('concept_unit', '$concept_units$')] that consume them as supplies
concept_state_desc: A geographic region controlled by a [concept_country]. [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] live and work in the [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')] in the $concept_state$. Unless it is a [concept_split_state] its territory is equivalent to a [concept_state_region]. Unless it is [Concept('concept_isolated_state', '$concept_isolated_state_short$')], it will trade any [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] locally [Concept('concept_good_consumption','$concept_good_consumed$')] and [Concept('concept_good_production','$concept_good_produced$')] with other $concept_states$ in the same [concept_market] in to a degree based on its [concept_market_access].
concept_home_state_desc: A [Concept('concept_character','$concept_character_possessive$')] $concept_home_state$ is the [concept_state] that they originate from. This is usually, but not always, a part of the [concept_country] the $concept_character$ lives in. [Concept('concept_magnate','$concept_magnates$')] $concept_magnate_holding_desc$.
concept_pop_desc: The world's population are organized into $concept_pops$, groups of individuals who work in the same [concept_building] as a certain [concept_profession], and share the same [concept_culture] and [concept_religion]. They use the [Concept('concept_pop_income','$concept_pop_income_short$')] they earn to buy [Concept('concept_good', '$concept_goods$')] to satisfy their [Concept('concept_pop_needs','$concept_pop_needs_short$')], which decides their [concept_wealth] and [concept_sol]. They can support [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] and [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')], or be [Concept('concept_politically_unaligned_aligned', '$concept_politically_unaligned$')]. A $concept_pop$ has a number of [concept_working_adults] and a number of [concept_dependents]. Some number of them are [Concept('concept_literacy','$concept_literate$')], and they might have a number of either [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalists$')] or [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')].
concept_profession_desc: A [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pop_possessive$')] $concept_profession$ determines which role they perform in their [concept_building], how large of a [concept_building_wage] they collect from it, and whether or not they get [Concept('concept_ownership_share','$concept_ownership_shares$')] in it. It also impacts which [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_group$')] they're likely to support, how likely they are to remain [Concept('concept_politically_unaligned_aligned', '$concept_politically_unaligned$')], and whether they are considered [concept_lower_strata], [concept_middle_strata], or [concept_upper_strata]. To switch $concept_professions$, a $concept_pop$ must have the appropriate [concept_pop_qualifications].
concept_production_method_desc:
$concept_production_methods$ determine how [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] operate. They impact

- The [Concept('concept_good_consumption','$concept_input_goods$')] the $concept_building$ must purchase to operate
- The [Concept('concept_good_production','$concept_output_goods$')] the $concept_building$ produces and sells
- The distribution of [Concept('concept_profession','$concept_professions$')] among its [concept_workforce]

$concept_production_methods$ can also have other effects, such as the generation of [Concept('concept_modifier','$concept_modifiers$')]. $concept_production_methods$ are organized in groups, in which only one can be active at a time. You can switch which $concept_production_method$ is active in each group as long as you meet the [concept_technology] and [concept_law] requirement for it.
concept_nation_formation_desc: If a [concept_country] meets certain requirements, such as owning land in specific [Concept('concept_state_region','$concept_state_regions$')] and/or having discovered a certain $SOCIETY$ [concept_technology], they may be able to form a new $concept_country$ of a higher [concept_country_tier]. The possible $concept_countries$ are listed in the #b $NATION_FORMATION$#! tab in the #b Journal#! panel.
concept_culture_desc: All [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] have a $concept_culture$, which can only change through [concept_assimilation]. Their $concept_culture$ determines which [Concept('concept_state_region','$concept_state_regions$')] they consider their [Concept('concept_homeland','$concept_homelands$')] and affects their [concept_acceptance_status] in their [concept_country].
concept_accepted_culture_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] $concept_accepted_cultures$ consist of its [concept_primary_cultures], plus any other [Concept('concept_culture','$concept_cultures$')] considered $concept_accepted_culture_short$ due to the $concept_country$'s current [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid, 'concept_accepted_culture_desc_added','Citizenship')] [concept_law]. Usually, the two highest statuses of [concept_acceptance] are considered to be $concept_accepted_culture_short$.
concept_primary_cultures_desc: The [concept_culture] or $concept_cultures$ a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_nation_state$')] is primarily associated with. If a $concept_country$ [Concept('concept_nation_formation','forms a different')] $concept_country$ its $concept_primary_cultures$ may change, but will otherwise remain the same.[ConcatIfNeitherEmpty('\n\n', AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_primary_cultures_ingame_added'))]
concept_discrimination_trait_desc:
Aspects of a [concept_culture] or [concept_religion] that determine how [Concept('concept_acceptance_status','$concept_accepted_status_short$')] [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of that $concept_culture$ or $concept_religion$ are depending on how similar they are to the $concept_country$'s [Concept('concept_primary_cultures','$concept_primary_culture$')] and [concept_state_religion] and what [GetLawType('law_national_supremacy').GetGroup.GetName] [concept_law] the $concept_country$ currently has.

For a $concept_culture$, these aspects are its [Concept('concept_heritage_trait','$concept_heritage_trait_short$')], [Concept('concept_language_trait','$concept_language_trait_short$')] and any [Concept('concept_tradition_trait','$concept_tradition_traits_short$')] it might have. A $concept_religion$ only has a $concept_heritage_trait$.

$concept_heritage_trait_short$ and $concept_language_traits$ also belong to broader [Concept('concept_discrimination_trait_group','$concept_discrimination_trait_groups_short_short$')] of similar $concept_discrimination_traits_short$.
concept_discrimination_trait_group_desc: A $concept_discrimination_trait_group$ is a broader collection of [Concept('concept_discrimination_trait','$concept_discrimination_traits$')] that share a common origin somehow, making them more recognizable to and accepted by [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of the same $concept_discrimination_trait_group_short$.
concept_heritage_trait_desc: $concept_heritage_trait_short$ [Concept('concept_discrimination_trait','$concept_discrimination_traits_short$')] represent the ancestry or foundation of a [concept_culture] or [concept_religion]. They also belong to a [Concept('concept_discrimination_trait_group','$concept_discrimination_trait_group_short$')], a broader family of similar $concept_heritage_traits_short$.
concept_language_trait_desc: $concept_language_trait_short$ [Concept('concept_discrimination_trait','$concept_discrimination_traits_short$')] represent $concept_language_traits_short$ deeply associated with a [concept_culture]. They also belong to a [Concept('concept_discrimination_trait_group','$concept_discrimination_trait_group_short$')], a broader family of similar $concept_language_traits_short$.
concept_tradition_trait_desc: $concept_tradition_trait_short$ [Concept('concept_discrimination_trait','$concept_discrimination_traits_short$')] are rites, ideas and customs that [Concept('concept_culture','$concept_cultures$')] might hold or pick up on over time that can be recognizable despite very distinct [Concept('concept_heritage_trait','$concept_heritage_traits_short$')] or [Concept('concept_language_trait','$concept_language_traits_short$')]. Contrary to [Concept('concept_heritage_trait','$concept_heritage_trait_short$')] and [Concept('concept_language_trait','$concept_language_traits$')], $concept_tradition_traits_short$ do not belong to any [Concept('concept_discrimination_trait_group','$concept_discrimination_trait_group_short$')].
concept_religion_desc: All [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] have a $concept_religion$, which can only change through [concept_conversion]. Their $concept_religion$ affects their [concept_acceptance_status] in their [concept_country].
concept_accepted_religion_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] $concept_accepted_religions$ consist of its [concept_state_religion], plus any other [Concept('concept_religion','$concept_religions$')] considered $concept_accepted_religion_short$ due to the $concept_country$'s current [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_accepted_religion_desc_added','Church and State')] [concept_law].
concept_state_religion_desc: The [concept_religion] most associated with a [concept_country]. It is typically the dominant [concept_religion] adhered to by most of its [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')], but can sometimes be legally declared or simply the $concept_religion$ preferred by its [concept_ruler]. It does not typically change.[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid, 'concept_state_religion_ingame_added')]
concept_investment_pool_desc:
[concept_reinvestment] from [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] with [concept_privately_owned] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] is deposited into the $concept_investment_pool$, where $concept_pops$ use it for [concept_private_construction] and purchasing [Concept('concept_building_level','$concept_building_levels$')] marked for [Concept('concept_privatize', '$concept_privatization$')].

Usually, $ARISTOCRATS_GC_LINK$ and $CAPITALISTS_GC_LINK$ in $MANOR_HOUSES_GC_LINK$ and $FINANCIAL_DISTRICTS_GC_LINK$ use the $concept_investment_pool$, but depending on your $ECONOMIC_SYSTEM_GC_LINK$, the [concept_workforce] can use it to expand their own $concept_building$.

A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] $ECONOMIC_SYSTEM_GC_LINK$ restricts which $concept_buildings$ can be built using the $concept_investment_pool$.

As $concept_construction$ of such $concept_buildings$ take place, the funds required to build them are deducted from the $concept_investment_pool$ and deposited in the [concept_treasury] as an [concept_budget_investment_income].
concept_reinvestment_desc: A portion of the [concept_dividends] collected by certain [Concept('concept_profession','$concept_professions$')] is reinvested into the economy, adding [concept_money] to the [concept_investment_pool]. The amount added depends on factors such as the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] current $ECONOMIC_SYSTEM_GC_LINK$ as well as its [concept_gdp], with inefficiencies in large economies resulting in some of the investment being wasted.
concept_pop_income_desc: At the end of each week, [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] receive an $concept_pop_income_short$ based on the size of their [concept_workforce] and the current [concept_building_wage] offered to them, plus the size of their [concept_dependents] and the amount of [concept_dependent_income] they collect. This $concept_pop_income_short$ is spent on [concept_pop_needs] which impact the $concept_pop$'s [concept_wealth].
concept_dependent_income_desc: At the end of each week, [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] receive a $concept_dependent_income$ based on their number of [concept_dependents] and the amount of income they qualify for. Most $concept_dependents$ receive a base amount from odd jobs depending on the $concept_pop$'s [concept_profession], which can be supplemented by the [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_dependent_income_desc_added','Social Security')] [concept_institution].
concept_wealth_desc: A measure of a [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pop_possessive$')] material assets. To sustain a certain level of $concept_wealth$ the $concept_pop$ has a set of [Concept('concept_pop_needs','$concept_pop_needs_short$')] it must satisfy each week. If their [Concept('concept_pop_income','$concept_pop_income_short$')] does not cover the cost of these $concept_pop_needs_short$, their $concept_wealth$ will eventually decrease. If they have [concept_money] left over after purchasing the necessary $concept_goods$, $concept_wealth$ will soon increase.\n\n$concept_wealth$ is the main factor contributing to a $concept_pop$'s [concept_sol], and under certain [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] it may affect other aspects of their life such as [concept_literacy] and [Concept('concept_votes','$concept_voting_rights$')].
concept_innovation_desc: @innovation!$concept_innovation$ is produced by [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_innovation_desc_added','University')] $concept_buildings$ and contributes to active research progress for [Concept('concept_technology', '$concept_technologies$')]. Unspent @innovation!$concept_innovation$ will increase the [concept_technology_spread] you're currently benefiting from, if any.
concept_technology_spread_desc: One [concept_technology] that you have not yet acquired from each category ($PRODUCTION_NO_CONCEPT$, $MILITARY$, and $SOCIETY$) is always spreading to you from [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] that have acquired them. The progress you get in spreading $concept_technologies$ is randomized each week around a base value depending on your $concept_country$'s [concept_literacy]. If no $concept_country$ has invented a certain $concept_technology$ yet it cannot spread to you, so you are more likely to acquire early [Concept('concept_technology_era','$concept_technology_era_short$')] $concept_technologies$ from $concept_technology_spread$ than later ones.
concept_technology_era_ahead_of_time_pen: If you have not yet acquired all $concept_technologies$ from previous $concept_technology_eras_short$, the amount required will increase further.
concept_technology_era_desc:
[concept_technology] $concept_technology_eras_short$ are a rough classification of which time period a certain idea was first discovered or developed.

$concept_technology_era_short$ I inventions were well-known in many parts of the world prior to 1836.
$concept_technology_era_short$ II inventions are associated with the First Industrial Revolution (1836 to mid-19th century).
$concept_technology_era_short$ III is a period of evolution, stabilization, and standardization that runs until late 19th century.
$concept_technology_era_short$ IV corresponds with the Second Industrial Revolution around the turn of the century.
$concept_technology_era_short$ V inventions are transformative, modern ideas.

$concept_technologies$ require more [concept_innovation] to discover the later $concept_technology_era_short$ it appears in. $concept_technology_era_ahead_of_time_penalty_desc$
concept_technology_desc:
$concept_technology$ covers all innovation in the fields of $PRODUCTION_NO_CONCEPT$, $MILITARY$, and $SOCIETY$. $concept_technologies$ have nation-wide effects, which can range from changing the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] operating parameters via [Concept('concept_modifier','$concept_modifiers$')] to unlocking new [Concept('concept_production_method','$concept_production_methods$')], [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')], [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')], [Concept('concept_decree','$concept_decrees$')], and [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')].

Progress is made towards new $concept_technologies$ through [concept_innovation], which is primarily produced by [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_technology_desc_added','University')] $concept_buildings$. In addition to progress from $concept_innovation$, $concept_technologies$ may propagate from $concept_countries$ who already have them to those who do not via [concept_technology_spread].

The amount of progress required in a $concept_technology$ to acquire it depends on its [Concept('concept_technology_era','$concept_technology_era_short$')]. $concept_technology_era_ahead_of_time_penalty_desc$
concept_canal_desc: A $concept_canal$ is a [concept_building] that also includes the construction of an artificial connection between two sea nodes across a landmass. $concept_canals$ can only be constructed in particular places and typically require the completion of some sort of survey or other expedition first. $concept_canals$ can drastically shorten the distance [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName] need to travel when establishing [Concept('concept_shipping_lane','$concept_shipping_lanes$')], making trade with distant lands more affordable.
concept_monument_desc: [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] unique to a certain [concept_state] that can perform a variety of functions, often conferring [concept_prestige].
concept_productivity_desc:
$concept_productivity$ is a relative measure of how much economic value a [concept_building] generates per employee per year. It is calculated by taking the current weekly [concept_revenue] generated from [concept_good_production], subtracting the expenses incurred from [concept_good_consumption], dividing by the total [concept_workforce], and multiplying by 52 (weeks / year).

( Revenue - Material Expenses ) / Total Employees

The difference between $concept_productivity$ and [concept_average_wage] is the $concept_building$'s weekly [concept_building_balance], also known as $concept_building_balance_profit$.

$COMPANIES$ also have a $concept_productivity$ rating, which is equal to the average $concept_productivity$ of all their associated $concept_building$ levels.
concept_law_group_desc: A $concept_law_group$ contains several [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] that affect aspects of the [concept_country] in different ways. Each $concept_law_group$ can only have one $concept_law$ active at a time.
concept_government_reform_desc: During a $concept_government_reform$ you may alter the composition of your [concept_government] freely by granting or removing [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] and/or [Concept('concept_party','$concept_parties$')] from power. $concept_interest_groups$ removed from power during such a $concept_government_reform_short$ will gain [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')], unless the $concept_government_reform_short$ is performed shortly after a concluded $concept_election$.
concept_election_desc: [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] with a $concept_election_voting_franchise$ will hold $concept_elections$ every #v [GetDefine('NPolitics','ELECTION_INTERVAL_YEARS')|0] years#!. An $concept_election$ campaign period will commence #v [GetDefine('NPolitics','CAMPAIGN_PERIOD_MONTHS')|0] months#! prior to the date, during which [Concept('concept_party','$concept_parties$')] will vie for [concept_momentum] and [concept_votes].\n\nOn $concept_election$ day the final $concept_votes$ will be tallied, which will affect the [concept_political_strength] of the member [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] of each $concept_party$. Under certain [Concept('concept_government_type','$concept_government_types$')] a new [concept_head_of_state] may also be selected as a result of the $concept_election$'s outcome. Finally, a single [concept_government_reform] may be performed where any $concept_interest_groups$ may be removed from [concept_government] without generating any new [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')].
concept_budget_minting_desc: A form of income that all [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] generate through the printing or casting of new [concept_money]. The greater a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_gdp], the more $concept_money$ can be $concept_budget_minted$ without compromising the economy.
concept_budget_poll_taxes_desc: A flat [Concept('concept_taxes','$concept_tax$')] collected on every [Concept('concept_working_adults', '$concept_working_adult$')] it applies to. Since $concept_budget_poll_taxes$ do not scale with the $concept_pop$'s income it tends to impact the [concept_lower_strata] the most.
concept_budget_land_taxes_desc: A type of [Concept('concept_budget_poll_taxes', '$concept_budget_poll_tax$')] collected from [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_budget_land_taxes_desc_added','Peasants')] and [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_budget_land_taxes_desc_farmers','Farmers')] employed in agricultural [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')]. $concept_pops$ that pay $concept_budget_land_taxes$ do not pay [concept_budget_per_capita_taxes].
concept_budget_heathen_taxes_desc: A type of [Concept('concept_budget_poll_taxes', '$concept_budget_poll_tax$')] collected from all [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] whose [concept_religion] have low [concept_acceptance] ín their [concept_country].
concept_budget_per_capita_taxes_desc: A type of [Concept('concept_budget_poll_taxes', '$concept_budget_poll_tax$')] collected from all [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] except [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_budget_per_capita_taxes_desc_added','Peasants')].
concept_budget_income_taxes_desc: A [Concept('concept_taxes','$concept_tax$')] collected on the [Concept('concept_building_wage','$concept_building_wages$')] paid to the [concept_workforce].
concept_budget_investment_income_desc: When [concept_money] from the [concept_treasury] is used in the [concept_construction] of [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] that may be funded by the [concept_investment_pool] under the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] current $ECONOMIC_SYSTEM_GC_LINK$, the $concept_treasury$ is compensated by an equal transfer of funds from the $concept_investment_pool$.
concept_budget_consumption_taxes_desc: A [Concept('concept_taxes','$concept_tax$')] collected on the [Concept('concept_good_consumption','$concept_good_consumption$')] of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')]. $concept_goods$ subject to $concept_budget_consumption_taxes$ will have its [concept_market_price] increased by the $concept_budget_consumption_tax_rate$, and whenever [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] buy it this increase will be collected by the [concept_treasury]. [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] are exempt from paying $concept_budget_consumption_taxes$.
concept_budget_dividends_taxes_desc: A [Concept('concept_taxes','$concept_tax$')] applied to the [concept_dividends] earned by [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] with [concept_privately_owned] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')].
concept_taxes_desc: [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] can tap into their market economies in various ways. The most common is to tax its populace's private sector incomes, or charge duties on the sales, purchase, or trade of [Concept('concept_good', '$concept_goods$')].
concept_unrealized_taxes_desc: Unrealized Taxes is the amount of [concept_taxes] that the [concept_country] is failing to collect due to various reasons, including but not limited to insufficient [concept_tax_capacity] and [concept_tax_waste].
concept_budget_additional_income_desc: Income that doesn't fit into another category, often gained from the outcome of special events.
concept_budget_additional_expenses_desc: Expenses that don't fit into another category, often incurred due to the outcome of special events.
concept_budget_diplomatic_pacts_desc: [concept_money] collected from or remitted to the other [concept_country] in a [concept_diplomatic_pact].
concept_budget_treaties_desc: [concept_money] collected from or remitted to the other [concept_country] in a [concept_treaty].
concept_budget_power_bloc_desc: [concept_money] collected from a [concept_power_bloc_member] or remitted to the [concept_power_bloc_leader]
concept_piracy_desc: [concept_money] collected from the proactive redistribution of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] on the high seas by Piracy or Privateer [Concept('concept_naval_mission', '$concept_naval_missions$')].
concept_construction_desc: @construction! $concept_construction$ is produced by the [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_construction_desc_added','Construction Sector')] and is used to construct [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')].
concept_budget_construction_goods_desc: [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] [Concept('concept_good_consumption','$concept_good_consumed$')] by [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_budget_construction_goods_desc_added','Construction Sector')] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] in order to [Concept('concept_construction','$concept_construct$')] new $concept_buildings$.
concept_budget_government_wages_desc: [Concept('concept_building_wage','$concept_building_wages$')] paid to [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] by [Concept('concept_government_building','$concept_government_buildings$')]. The rate is based on the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_normal_wage]. You can adjust it up and down in the $BUDGET_PANEL_TITLE$ panel.
concept_budget_wages_desc: [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] in the employ of a [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_country_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_government_building','$concept_government_buildings$')] and [Concept('concept_military_building','$concept_military_buildings$')] get paid $concept_budget_wages$ from the [concept_treasury] each week, according to the [concept_government_wage] and [concept_military_wage] respectively.
concept_budget_government_slaves_desc: The upkeep of [Concept('concept_slavery','$concept_slaves$')] laboring directly for a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] government.
concept_budget_military_wages_desc: [Concept('concept_building_wage','$concept_building_wages$')] paid to [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] by [Concept('concept_military_building','$concept_military_buildings$')]. The rate is based on the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_normal_wage]. You can adjust it up and down in the $BUDGET_PANEL_TITLE$ panel.
concept_slavery_desc: A practice where one person is permitted legal ownership over another. [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_slavery_desc_added', 'Slaves')] will be substituted for other [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] in different [concept_building] types based on the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')]. $concept_laws$ also determine how existing $concept_pops$ become $concept_enslaved$ and how $concept_slaves$ are uprooted and transported to the $concept_country$.
concept_budget_military_slaves_desc: The upkeep of [Concept('concept_slavery','$concept_slaves$')] in the service of a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] military.
concept_good_production_desc: The amount of a [concept_good] produced by a [concept_building] to be sold for [concept_revenue].
concept_good_consumption_desc: The amount of a [concept_good] consumed by a [concept_building] or [concept_pop] in the process of maintaining its [concept_throughput] or [concept_wealth].
concept_subsidies_desc: A $concept_subsidized$ [concept_building] is guaranteed by the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_government] to be funded enough to always by able to pay at least the [concept_subsidized_wage]. If the building cannot pay its employees according to this rate or higher, and/or if its cost of buying [Concept('concept_good_consumption','$concept_input_goods$')] exceeds its [concept_revenue] from selling [Concept('concept_good_production','$concept_output_goods$')], the [concept_treasury] will cover the difference. This guarantees the $concept_building$ can hire as many employees as it wants in order to maximize [concept_throughput] without concern for how financially viable that is.
concept_budget_interest_desc:
The $concept_budget_interest$ paid by a [concept_country] on its [concept_loans]. It is calculated by multiplying the [concept_principal] with the annual $concept_budget_interest_rate$.

$concept_budget_interest$ is payed out to the [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] whose [concept_privately_owned] [concept_cash_reserves] are the basis for the $concept_loans$. [concept_nationally_owned] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] instead provide less [concept_government_dividends].

The $concept_budget_interest_rate$ paid is affected primarily by [concept_technology].
concept_country_tier_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] $concept_country_tier_short$ is the inherent status and [concept_prestige] it is granted based on its history and significance. Forming a new $concept_country$ is only possible if its $concept_country_tier_short$ is higher than the $concept_country$'s current one.
concept_claim_desc: A territorial $concept_claim$ that a [concept_country] has on a [concept_state_region], usually because it once belonged to them. Having a $concept_claim$ permits use of the #v $war_goal_return_state_type_name$#! [concept_war_goal] which does not generate as much [concept_infamy] as the #v $war_goal_conquer_state_type_name$#! $concept_war_goal$ does.\n\nConquering an [concept_incorporated_state] will give the previous owner a $concept_claim$ on the $concept_state_region$.
concept_pollution_impact_desc:
The $concept_pollution_impact$ on a [concept_state_region] indicates how severe the effects of the total [concept_generated_pollution] by buildings in that State Region are. The more [concept_arable_land] a State Region has, the lower the impact of the $concept_generated_pollution$.

A highly polluted $concept_state_region$ will also affect its neighboring states, although at a reduced rate. If a neighboring state already has a higher $concept_pollution_impact$ due to its own buildings or other neighboring states, only the highest $concept_pollution_impact$ has an effect.

The effects of $concept_pollution_impact$ can increase up to:
[GetStaticModifier('state_region_pollution_general').GetDesc]
[GetStaticModifier('state_region_pollution_health').GetDesc]#!
concept_generated_pollution_desc: $concept_generated_pollution$ is how much total pollution the buildings in a [concept_state_region] produce.
