How much [concept_pollution_impact] a $concept_state_region$ has is also dependent on the amount of [concept_arable_land] in that $concept_state_region$.\n\nA $concept_state_region$ with a lot of $concept_arable_land$ will see $concept_generated_pollution$ increase $concept_pollution_impact$ by a smaller amount than a $concept_state_region$ with little $concept_arable_land$.
concept_devastation_desc: $concept_devastation$ is the damage done to a [concept_state_region] as a result of war or natural disasters. It increases from [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')] and when under hostile [concept_occupation]. It will decrease over time if no part of the $concept_state_region$ is at war.\n\n$concept_devastation$ has a negative impact on [concept_infrastructure], [Concept('concept_pop_growth','$concept_pop_growth_mortality$')], [concept_throughput], and [concept_migration_pull].
concept_command_limit_desc:
$concept_command_limit$ determines how many [Concept('concept_battalion', '$concept_battalions$')] or [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')] can be effectively [Concept('concept_organization','$concept_organization_organized$')] under a [concept_military_formation]. You can increase $concept_command_limit$ by promoting your [concept_commander] to a higher [concept_commander_rank].

#indent_newline:3 For an [concept_army], whichever is higher of your regular [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] or raised [Concept('concept_conscript_battalion','$concept_conscript_battalions$')] is compared against the $concept_command_limit$. This means raising $concept_conscript_battalions$ will only strain the $concept_command_limit$ if there are more of them than your regular $concept_battalions$.

#indent_newline:3 Having more [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] in a $concept_military_formation$ than its $concept_command_limit$ reduces the maximum $concept_organization$ a $concept_military_formation$ can reach, and additionally confers the following effects:
[GetStaticModifier('low_command_limit').GetDesc]#!
concept_pop_qualifications_desc: [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] develop the $concept_pop_qualifications$ necessary to change into another [concept_profession] over time. If their current attributes match those of the $concept_profession$, or if they currently work in a related field, they will develop $concept_pop_qualifications$ for it sooner. [concept_literacy], [concept_wealth], and [concept_acceptance_status] are common deciding factors.
concept_hq_desc: An $concept_hq$ ($concept_hq_long$) is the territory owned by a [concept_country] in a particular [concept_strategic_region]. All [Concept('concept_military_formation','$concept_military_formations$')] have a home $concept_hq$ and can be stationed in $concept_hqs$.
concept_tax_waste_desc: The amount of [concept_taxes] collected that are wasted, due to inefficiencies or corruption, prior to entering the government coffers. This is often caused by a [concept_bureaucracy] deficit.
concept_tax_capacity_desc: Each point of Taxation Capacity in a [concept_state] allows for the efficient taxation of [GetDefine('NPops','INDIVIDUALS_TAXED_PER_TAX_CAPACITY')|vK] [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')]. If the population of a [concept_state] outgrows its Taxation Capacity, the efficiency of all forms of taxation will be reduced. Taxation Capacity can be increased through researching certain $SOCIETY$ $concept_technologies$ or constructing [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid, 'concept_tax_capacity_desc_added','Government Administration')] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] in the [concept_state].
concept_assimilation_desc: Foreign [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] whose [concept_culture] has high enough [concept_acceptance] in the [concept_country] they live in, and who do not live in one of their [Concept('concept_homeland','$concept_homelands$')], may $concept_assimilate$ into a more $concept_accepted$ $concept_culture$. $concept_pops$ that contain [Concept('concept_radical', '$concept_radicals$')] will assimilate at a reduced rate, and $concept_assimilation$ is much slower in [Concept('concept_unincorporated_state','$concept_unincorporated_states$')].
concept_conversion_desc: [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] whose [concept_religion] has low [concept_acceptance] in the [concept_country] they live in may instead $concept_convert$ to one with higher $concept_acceptance$. $concept_pops$ that contain [Concept('concept_radical', '$concept_radicals$')] will convert at a reduced rate, and conversion is much slower in [Concept('concept_unincorporated_state','$concept_unincorporated_states$')].
concept_life_experience_desc: [Concept('concept_character', '$concept_characters$')] gain $concept_life_experience$ over time and through special events. $concept_life_experience$ influences the possibility of acquiring new [Concept('concept_character_trait', '$concept_character_traits$')].
concept_supply_network_desc: Every seafaring [concept_country] requires [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName] on the [concept_market] to maintain the transportation needs of their [Concept('concept_shipping_lane','$concept_shipping_lanes$')]. The total strength of your $concept_supply_network$ is determined by comparing the [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName] supply to the total demand across all your $concept_shipping_lanes$. This strength is the baseline [Concept('concept_shipping_lane_effectiveness','$concept_shipping_lane_effectiveness_short$')] of all your $concept_shipping_lanes$.
concept_ship_desc: A $concept_ship$ is constructed in a shipyard using [concept_ship_construction]. They are organized by their [concept_ship_type] in [Concept('concept_ship_group','$concept_ship_groups$')]. $concept_ships$ are used to build [Concept('concept_interest','$concept_interests$')] across the globe and conduct various [Concept('concept_naval_mission','$concept_naval_missions$')] in a [concept_fleet].
concept_ship_group_desc: There are three $concept_ship_groups$ that consist of [Concept('concept_ship_type','$concept_ship_types$')] that fill a similar role. The groups are: $ship_group_capital_ships$, $ship_group_cruisers$ and $ship_group_torpedo_craft$.
concept_ship_type_desc: Every [concept_ship] has a $concept_ship_type$ that has certain attributes and functions, which make it better or worse for certain [Concept('concept_naval_mission','$concept_naval_missions$')].
concept_ship_template_desc: A [concept_ship_template] determines the strategic setup for [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')] of a certain [concept_ship_type]. [Concept('concept_ship_modification','$concept_ship_modifications$')] modify and govern what values a $ship$ ends up having.
concept_base_template_desc: The original design of a [concept_ship_type]. The $concept_base_template$ unlocks with the $concept_ship_type$ and will always be available.
concept_sailor_desc: [GetPopType('soldiers').GetName] and [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_ship_crew_desc_added','Officers')] that form the [concept_ship_crew] of a [concept_ship].\n\nBuilding or expanding [GetBuildingType('building_naval_administration').GetName] [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')] raises the available $concept_sailors$. Idle $concept_sailors$ are still paid for, so surplus capacity is wasted [concept_government_expenses].
concept_ship_construction_desc: @ship_construction! $concept_ship_construction$ is produced by [GetBuildingType('building_shipyard').GetName] and is used to build and repair ships.
concept_ship_construction_capacity_desc: The maximum amount of @ship_construction! [concept_ship_construction] that can be applied to a single ship per week.
concept_ship_construction_queue_desc: Any [Concept('concept_ship', '$concept_ships$')] that have been set to be built, but are currently not using any @ship_construction! [concept_ship_construction], are placed in the $concept_ship_construction_queue_short$. Whenever any @ship_construction! $concept_ship_construction$ becomes available, the first $concept_ship$ in the $concept_ship_construction_queue_short$ will start using that @ship_construction! $concept_ship_construction_short$ and then switch to being [concept_ship_under_construction].
concept_ship_retrofit_desc: Upgrades the [Concept('concept_ship_modification', '$concept_ship_modifications$')] of a [concept_ship] to match the latest version of it's [concept_ship_template].
concept_ship_complexity_desc: The $concept_ship_complexity$ of a [concept_ship] is determined by the amount of different [Concept('concept_ship_modification', '$concept_ship_modifications$')] it has. The more $concept_ship_modifications$ a $concept_ship$ has, the higher its $concept_ship_complexity$ and the more @ship_construction! [concept_ship_construction] it will require to be built or repaired.
concept_ship_modification_desc: A $concept_ship_modification$ is an upgrade that can be applied to a [concept_ship] to enhance its capabilities. However, adding more $concept_ship_modifications$ also increases the [concept_ship_complexity] of the $concept_ship$, which in turn requires more @ship_construction! [concept_ship_construction] to build or repair the $concept_ship$.
concept_ship_under_construction_desc: When a [concept_ship] is using @ship_construction! [concept_ship_construction] it is considered being $concept_ship_under_construction_short$.
concept_flagship_desc: A $concept_flagship$ is the lead [concept_ship] of the [concept_country]'s Navy. Only one $concept_flagship$ can exist at a time. Winning battles involving the $concept_flagship$ will provide additional [concept_prestige] to the [concept_country] that owns it, whereas losing them will harm the $concept_prestige$.
concept_ship_crew_desc:
The amount of [Concept('concept_sailor', '$concept_sailors$')] on a [concept_ship]. The greater the $concept_ship_crew_short$ the more [concept_casualties] the $concept_ship$ will be able to deal and take.

A $concept_ship$ that is not fully $concept_ship_crew_past$:
• Closer to being destroyed by $concept_casualties$
• Higher risk of withdrawing from a [Concept('concept_naval_battle', '$concept_naval_battle$')]

At #v [GetDefine('NMilitary','ACTIVE_SHIP_LIVING_CREW_PERCENTAGE')|%0]#! $concept_ship_crew_short$ or less a $concept_ship$ becomes inactive, and below #v [GetDefine('NMilitary','MINIMUM_SHIP_CREW_PERCENTAGE_TO_DEPLOY')|%0]#! its [Concept('concept_fleet', '$concept_fleet$')] cannot be deployed and a $concept_fleet$ already at sea is sent home to take on more $concept_ship_crew_short$. A $concept_ship$ left with no $concept_ship_crew_short$ outside a port is destroyed.

[Concept('concept_supply_ship', '$concept_supply_ships$')] always crew themselves and do not draw on our $concept_sailors$.
concept_ship_hit_points_desc: The total $concept_ship_hit_points_short$ of a [concept_ship] represent its durability and ability to withstand damage in naval combat.
concept_fleet_hit_points_desc: The average $concept_fleet_hit_points_short$ of all [Concept('concept_ship', '$concept_ships$')] in a [concept_fleet] represent the $concept_fleet_possessive$ average durability and ability to withstand damage in naval combat.
concept_ship_armor_desc: Reduces any damage that a [concept_ship] would receive from an opponent by this value.
concept_ship_upkeep_desc: The weekly $concept_ship_upkeep$ represents the cost of [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] required for maintaining a [concept_ship]. $concept_ship_upkeep_short$ is changed by [GetDefine('NMilitary','SHIP_UPKEEP_GOODS_DOCKED_MULT')|-1%] if the $concept_ship$ is docked at an [concept_hq].
concept_supply_efficiency_desc: How efficiently a ship uses its supplies. Higher efficiency means lower supply consumption.
concept_supply_priority_desc: A [Concept('concept_military_formation','$concept_military_formation_possessive$')] $concept_supply_priority$ determines the order in which it receives [Concept('concept_supply_ship','$concept_supply_ships$')].\n\n$concept_supply_ships$ will be distributed until all highest level $concept_supply_priority_short$ [Concept('concept_fleet','$concept_fleets$')] and [Concept('concept_army','$concept_armies$')] have their demand met, after which the distribution will continue on to lower $concept_supply_priority_short$ $concept_fleets$ and $concept_armies$.
concept_supply_ship_desc: $concept_supply_ships$ are used to deliver supplies, rations and ammo to [Concept('concept_fleet','$concept_fleets$')] that are at sea and [Concept('concept_army','$concept_armies$')] that are overseas.\n\nThey are constructed in a $building_shipyard$ much like regular [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')] and are retained in a pool unless currently needed.
concept_vulnerability_desc: Higher $concept_vulnerability$ $concept_ships$ are more likely to be chosen as a target by hostile $concept_ships$. This effect can be counteracted by [concept_screening].\n\n$concept_vulnerability_extra_damage_desc$
concept_vulnerability_extra_damage_desc: A $concept_ship$ suffers extra damage up to its own $concept_vulnerability$ in percentage units when there is less total $concept_screening$ than $concept_vulnerability$ present in battle, relative to the missing amount of $concept_screening$.
concept_screening_desc: $concept_screening$ counteracts [concept_vulnerability]. The more $concept_screening$ a [concept_fleet] has compared to its total $concept_vulnerability$, the less likely its most vulnerable $concept_ships$ are to be chosen as a target.\n\n$concept_vulnerability_extra_damage_desc$
concept_detection_desc: $ship_detection_add_desc$\n\nA $concept_fleet_possessive$ $concept_detection$ and the hostile $concept_fleet_possessive$ [concept_visibility] are used in conjunction to determine the chance to spawn a [concept_naval_battle] and how many $concept_ships$ will be involved.
concept_visibility_desc: $ship_visibility_add_desc$\n\nA $concept_fleet_possessive$ $concept_detection$ and the hostile $concept_fleet_possessive$ [concept_visibility] are used in conjunction to determine the chance to spawn a [concept_naval_battle] and how many $concept_ships$ will be involved.
concept_withdrawn_ships_desc: How many $concept_ships$ have $concept_withdrawn_ships_short$ from the battle.
concept_sunk_ships_desc: How many $concept_sunk_ships$ a [concept_fleet] has suffered in battle.
concept_crew_casualties_desc: How many $concept_crew_casualties_short$ a [concept_fleet] has taken in battle.
concept_shipping_lane_desc: A $concept_shipping_lane$ is a naval connection of [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName] between two coastal [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] that is established to either move [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] from place to place as part of a [concept_treaty] or to [concept_supply] [Concept('concept_military_formation','$concept_military_formations$')] overseas.\n\nA $concept_shipping_lane$ can be either a [concept_supply_route], a [concept_port_connection] or a [GetArticleType('goods_transfer').GetNameNoIcon] $concept_treaty$ and is reliant on its [concept_shipping_lane_effectiveness] to work, provided that its shipping cost is sufficiently covered.
concept_tolls_desc: $concept_tolls$ can be raised by [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] that [Concept('concept_strait_control', '$concept_strait_control_short$')] a [concept_strait]. They add a cost that is a share of the [concept_trade] going through them. This cost is covered by the affected [GetBuildingType('building_trade_center').GetName] and reduces their profitability, while the $concept_country$ controlling the $concept_strait$ gains additional income from this. $concept_tolls$ can be raised individually by both controllers of a $concept_strait$ and are summed up.
concept_strait_desc: A narrow water passage with two connecting [Concept('concept_province', '$concept_provinces$')], one on either side of the $concept_strait$. A [concept_country] only needs control over one of the $concept_provinces$ in order to be able to manage whose ships have [concept_strait_access] through the $concept_strait$.\n@information! The $strait_gibraltar$ requires a $concept_country$ to control both $concept_provinces$ to manage the $concept_strait_access$ rights.
concept_port_connection_desc: A [concept_shipping_lane] connecting one or several [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] otherwise unreachable overland to the [concept_market_capital], ensuring [concept_market_access] to remote regions. $concept_port_connections$ require a [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_port_connection_desc_added','Port')] in both ends. The shipping cost of a $concept_port_connection$ is dependent on the total [concept_infrastructure_usage] of the [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] it's connecting.
concept_shipping_lane_effectiveness_desc: The $concept_shipping_lane_effectiveness_short$ of a [concept_shipping_lane] is determined by the strength of a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_supply_network]. When $concept_shipping_lane_effectiveness_short$ is below #v 100%#!, the function of the $concept_shipping_lane$ is reduced to match.
concept_supply_route_desc: A [concept_shipping_lane] that supplies a [concept_general] [Concept('concept_order','$concept_ordered$')] to advance or defend a [concept_front] only accessible by sea. The $concept_general$'s [concept_supply] level is equal to the $concept_supply_route$'s [Concept('concept_shipping_lane_effectiveness','$concept_shipping_lane_effectiveness_short$')].
concept_character_desc: $concept_characters$ fulfill different [Concept('concept_character_role','$concept_character_roles$')] in your [concept_country]. Their ability to perform these duties depends on their [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')]. They always support an [concept_interest_group], and may have an [concept_ideology] that shapes their aspirations and outlook.
concept_busy_desc: A [concept_character] can be considered $concept_busy$ when occupied with a certain assignment, such as being on an expedition. When $concept_busy$, the $concept_character$ is unavailable for their regular duties. For example, a [concept_commander] would be unable to participate in [Concept('concept_battle','$concept_battles$')].
concept_popularity_desc:
The $concept_popularity$ of a [concept_character] measures the willingness of [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] to follow them. 

$concept_popularity$ affects [concept_prominence] and can have different effects depending on the $concept_character$'s [concept_character_role]: #indent_newline:3 
• [Concept('concept_agitator','$concept_agitators$')]: affects chance of [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] joining their [concept_political_movement] 
• [Concept('concept_ruler', '$concept_rulers$')]: adds or takes away [concept_authority] 
• [Concept('concept_admiral','$concept_admirals$')]/[Concept('concept_general', '$concept_generals$')]: affects chance of launching a successful [concept_coup] 
• [concept_interest_group] [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')]: affects [concept_interest_group_attraction] 
• [Concept('concept_party_leader', '$concept_party_leaders$')]: affects [concept_party] [concept_momentum] during [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elections$')] 
• [Concept('concept_executive','$concept_executives$')]: affects [concept_prosperity]
concept_prominence_desc: The $concept_prominence$ of a [concept_character] measures their level of influence in the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] political machine and affects the chance that a $concept_character$ will be selected as the next leader of their [concept_interest_group]. $concept_characters$ whose $concept_prominence$ is at least [GetDefine('NCharacters','PROMINENCE_SIGNIFICANT_THRESHOLD')|v] also contribute to the [concept_political_strength] of their [concept_interest_group] and may be selected as its next [concept_leader].
concept_loyalty_desc: The $concept_loyalty$ of a [concept_character] measures how faithful they are to the sitting [concept_government], and is affected by the [concept_approval] of their [concept_interest_group] as well as their personal [concept_ideology]. Disloyal [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')] may attempt to launch a [concept_coup].
concept_momentum_desc: The success of a [Concept('concept_party','$concept_party_possessive$')] [concept_election] campaign. $concept_momentum$ increases the number of [concept_votes] a $concept_party$ gains on $concept_election$ day, and is nullified thereafter. $concept_momentum$ can be affected by random chance, special events, and the [concept_popularity] of its [concept_party_leader].
concept_government_expenses_desc: The total weekly $concept_government_expenses_short$ accrued by the [concept_government], balanced against all its weekly revenues such as [concept_taxes], with the balance added to or removed from the [concept_treasury].
concept_sovereignty_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] right to self-govern. When one $concept_country$ violates the $concept_sovereignty$ of another they openly disrespect this right. Should the other not respond in turn with an immediate military response enforcing the integrity of their borders, they submit to the violator and permit them military access through their territory.
concept_average_wage_desc: The average [Concept('concept_building_wage', '$concept_building_wages$')] a single [concept_individual] in the [concept_workforce] would earn annually while working at this [concept_building].
concept_subsidized_wage_desc: When a [Concept('concept_subsidies','$concept_subsidized$')] [concept_building] cannot pay their [concept_workforce] at least the [concept_normal_wage], the remainder is covered by government $concept_subsidies$ through the [concept_treasury]. In return the $concept_building$ will never fire its $concept_workforce$ and aim to keep [concept_throughput] maximized at all times.
concept_government_wage_desc: All [Concept('concept_government_building','$concept_government_buildings$')] except [Concept('concept_military_building','$concept_military_buildings$')] pay their [concept_workforce] according to the same standardized $concept_government_wage$ rate. This rate is based on the [concept_normal_wage] in the [concept_country], with any adjustments set in the Budget panel.
concept_military_wage_desc: All [Concept('concept_military_building','$concept_military_buildings$')] pay their [concept_workforce] according to the same standardized $concept_military_wage$ rate. This rate is based on the [concept_normal_wage] in the [concept_country], with any adjustments set in the Budget panel.
concept_normal_wage_desc: The baseline [concept_building_wage] in a [concept_country] which many [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] take into account. [Concept('concept_government_wage','$concept_government_wages$')] and [Concept('concept_military_wage','$concept_military_wages$')] are based on the $concept_normal_wage$. It is determined from the average $concept_building_wages$ paid by [Concept('concept_building','$concept_building_industries$')] across [Concept('concept_incorporated_state', '$concept_incorporated_states$')].
concept_dead_desc: [concept_casualties] that end up $concept_dead$ due to [concept_battle] or [concept_attrition].
concept_wounded_desc: [concept_casualties] that are merely $concept_wounded$ in [concept_battle] or due to [concept_attrition]. Some $concept_wounded$ $concept_casualties$ recover and return to active service after some time, while others end up as [concept_dependents] of other [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] in your [concept_country].
concept_attrition_desc: [concept_casualties] inflicted on [concept_manpower] outside of [concept_battle] is referred to as $concept_attrition$. It is frequently experienced when [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] are [Concept('concept_mobilize_battalion','$concept_mobilize_battalion_mobilized$')] and can be the result of disease, accidents, exposure, or even desertion. $concept_attrition$ can be counteracted by using $medic_support$ [Concept('concept_mobilization_option','$concept_mobilization_options$')].
concept_ruler_desc: A $concept_ruler$ is usually the [concept_head_of_state] who represents the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] in domestic and world affairs. A $concept_ruler$'s [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] affects the $concept_country$ directly. When a $concept_ruler$ dies a new one will take their place, either an [concept_heir] if one exists or another $concept_character$ depending on [concept_government_type].
concept_heir_desc: The $concept_heir$ of a [concept_country] is a [concept_character]. They will take over the [concept_character_role] of [concept_ruler] upon the current $concept_ruler$'s death.
concept_executive_desc: $concept_executives$ are the [Concept('concept_character','$concept_characters$')] that lead a [concept_company]. Like other $concept_characters$ they can have [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] which influence how good they are at their job. They provide [concept_clout] to their [concept_interest_group] based on how well their [concept_company] is doing. $concept_executives$ can also become [concept_leader] of an $concept_interest_group$.
concept_magnate_desc: $concept_magnates$ are wealthy [Concept('concept_character','$concept_characters$')] that own numerous estates or businesses and use their fortune to wield political power. $concept_magnates$ $concept_magnate_holding_desc$.
concept_magnate_holding_desc: possess a [concept_holding] in their [concept_home_state], and gain [concept_prominence] based on its [concept_revenue]
concept_holding_desc: A $concept_holding$ is a [concept_building] (usually $MANOR_HOUSES_GC_LINK$ or $FINANCIAL_DISTRICTS_GC_LINK$) in the [concept_home_state] of a [concept_character], which the $concept_character$ is presumed to own a considerable stake in. The type of $concept_building$ that a $concept_character$ will receive as their $concept_holding$ is mainly dependent on their [concept_interest_group].
concept_character_role_desc:
$concept_character_roles$ determine what areas of your [concept_country] a particular [concept_character] has influence over. A $concept_character$ can have one or several $concept_character_roles$.

The list of $concept_character_roles$ are: 
  #indent_newline:3  • [concept_ruler] (usually also a [concept_politician])
• [concept_heir]
• [concept_politician]
• [concept_executive]
• [concept_agitator]
• [concept_general]
• [concept_admiral]
concept_treasury_desc: The $concept_treasury$ keeps track of your [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] assets. Each week your budget balance will result in the $concept_treasury$ taking out more [concept_loans] to cover a [concept_money] deficit, or depositing $concept_money$ into the [concept_gold_reserves].
concept_building_balance_desc:
A [Concept('concept_building','$concept_building_possessive$')] $concept_building_balance$ is the amount of [concept_money] that remains of its [concept_revenue] after paying [Concept('concept_building_wage','$concept_building_wages$')] and purchasing required [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods_input$')].

The $concept_building_balance$ is divided between [concept_building_owners] and the $concept_building$'s [concept_cash_reserves].

A $concept_building$'s $concept_building_balance$ can be improved either by making its $concept_goods_input$ cheaper, or by making its $concept_goods_output$ more expensive. This can be done by increasing or decreasing [Concept('concept_sell_orders','$concept_sell_orders_supply$')] and [Concept('concept_buy_orders','$concept_buy_orders_demand$')] on the [concept_market] it belongs to.
concept_building_wage_desc: $concept_building_wages$ paid to [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] by the [concept_building] they work in depends on several factors, the most prominent being the $concept_pop$'s [concept_profession] and the $concept_building$'s financial situation. If a $concept_building$'s [concept_building_balance] allows for raising $concept_building_wages$ at all, the $concept_building$ will only do so if it needs to in order to attract more $concept_pops$ to its [concept_workforce]. If a $concept_building$'s $concept_building_balance$ is negative, it will consider lowering $concept_building_wages$ to return to profitability.\n\nYou can guarantee that the $concept_workforce$ is paid a competitive $concept_building_wage$ by [Concept('concept_subsidies', '$concept_subsidizing$')] the building. This will keep it afloat with funds from the [concept_treasury] if necessary.
concept_sell_orders_desc: The number of orders to sell a [concept_good] on the central [concept_market] is used in combination with [concept_buy_orders] to determine its [concept_market_price]. $concept_sell_orders$ are generated by the production of the $concept_good$ in each of the $concept_market$'s [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')]. The higher the [concept_market_access] a $concept_state$ has, the closer the number of $concept_sell_orders$ generated will be to the total production.
concept_buy_orders_desc: The number of orders to buy a [concept_good] on the central [concept_market] is used in combination with [concept_sell_orders] to determine its [concept_market_price]. $concept_buy_orders$ are generated by the consumption of the $concept_good$ in each of the $concept_market$'s [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')]. The higher the [concept_market_access] a $concept_state$ has, the closer the number of $concept_buy_orders$ generated will be to the total consumption.
concept_head_of_state_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_ruler] or highest representative. The [concept_government_type] determines who serves as the $concept_head_of_state$ and when they are replaced.[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid, 'concept_head_of_state_ingame_added')]
concept_government_type_desc: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] $concept_government_type$ is determined by its [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] and determines its $concept_government_type_transfer_of_power$, meaning who serves as its [concept_head_of_state].[AddLocalizationIf(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_government_type_ingame_added')]
concept_transfer_of_power_desc: The Transfer of Power determines how a [Concept('concept_ruler','$concept_ruler_possessive$')] power is given to the next $concept_ruler$ and when this transfer will take place.
concept_recognized_power_desc: A $concept_recognized_power$ is considered a valid nation-state capable of self-determination by consensus of the [Concept('concept_great_power','$concept_great_powers$')], which sets them apart from [Concept('concept_unrecognized_power','$concept_unrecognized_powers$')].\n\nAn $concept_unrecognized_power$ may become a $concept_recognized_power$ by completing the #bold $je_earn_recognition$#! [concept_journal_entry].
concept_unification_supporter_desc: A $concept_unification_supporter$ is a [concept_country] that favors a particular [concept_unification_candidate]. Should the unification be successful, the $concept_unification_supporter$ will become a part of the union.
concept_unification_candidate_desc: A $concept_unification_candidate$ is a [concept_country] considered a viable candidate for unification. The conditions for who qualifies as a $concept_unification_candidate$ varies depending on which unified nation it is.
concept_unification_desc:
The act of unifying and forming a new [concept_country] out of several $concept_countries$ is called Unification. A $concept_country$ can be formed by controlling a specific number of [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] in the new $concept_country$'s region.

A #b Major Unification#! allows $concept_countries$ to become [Concept('concept_unification_candidate','$concept_unification_candidates$')] which gives them access to the Unification [concept_diplomatic_play]. This $concept_diplomatic_play$ sets the [Concept('concept_war_goal','$concept_war_goals$')] to annex all the required $concept_states$ and $concept_countries$.

While a #b Minor Unification#! do not allow any [Concept('concept_unification_candidate','$concept_unification_candidates$')] and can only form a $concept_country$ if the number of required $concept_states$ are controlled.
concept_order_desc:
[Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')] can be given $concept_orders$ that cause them to pursue different military objectives depending on their current location. All $concept_commanders$ have a few basic $concept_orders$, but their [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] may add special $concept_orders$ for that $concept_commander$ to use.

Basic [concept_general] orders are:
[GetBasicGeneralOrdersBreakdown]
concept_naval_mission_desc: [Concept('concept_fleet','$concept_fleets$')] can be assigned to $concept_naval_missions$ to determine what they should be focused on. A $concept_naval_mission_short$ takes place in a set of connected [Concept('concept_sea_node','$concept_sea_nodes$')] and has different effects depending on the type of the $concept_naval_mission_short$.
concept_naval_mission_area_limit_desc: The maximum number of [Concept('concept_sea_node', '$concept_sea_regions$')] that can be assigned to a $concept_naval_mission_short$. This limit is determined by the [concept_commander_rank] of the assigned [concept_admiral].
concept_party_desc: A $concept_party$ is a political entity that participates in [Concept('concept_election','$concept_election$')]. They consist of one or more [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] whose [Concept('concept_ideology','$concept_ideologies$')] are at least somewhat compatible. These $concept_interest_groups$ are empowered by the [concept_votes] the $concept_party$ has won proportional to their [concept_clout]. Individual $concept_interest_groups$ cannot be included in [concept_government] without the rest of their $concept_party$ members.
concept_party_leader_desc: The [concept_leader] of the [concept_interest_group] in the [concept_party] with the most [concept_clout] is considered the $concept_party_leader$. The $concept_party_leader_short$ acts as a [concept_party_whip].
concept_suppress_desc: A $concept_suppressed$ [concept_political_movement] is less attractive for [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] to support. Your base $concept_suppression$ ability is determined by your [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_suppress_desc_added','Free Speech')] [concept_law]. $concept_suppressing$ $concept_interest_groups$ cost [concept_authority].
concept_bolster_desc: A $concept_bolstered$ [concept_political_movement] is more attractive for [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] to support. Your base $concept_bolstering$ ability is determined by your [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'concept_bolster_desc_added','Free Speech')] [concept_law]. $concept_bolstering$ $concept_interest_groups$ costs [concept_authority].
concept_journal_entry_desc: $concept_journal_entries$ track ongoing events in your country. They can present opportunities or challenges, remind you of promises you have made, or warn of potential crises that may occur.\n\n$concept_journal_entries$ usually resolve and are removed from your $concept_journal$ when they are considered #bold Complete#!. Not all $concept_journal_entries$ can be #bold Completed#! - some can only #bold Fail#!, #bold Time Out#!, or will be removed under some condition.
concept_political_lobby_desc:
A $concept_political_lobby$ is a collection of [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] either opposing or endorsing a certain [concept_country].

The $concept_interest_groups$ in the $concept_political_lobby_short$ gain [concept_approval] based on the [concept_political_lobby_appeasement] of the $concept_political_lobby$.

$concept_political_lobbies_short$ make it easier or harder to perform [Concept('concept_diplomatic_action','$concept_diplomatic_actions$')] against their target $concept_country$, by affecting [concept_influence] cost, and if the $concept_country$ will accept. $concept_political_lobbies_short$ in [Concept('concept_subject','$concept_subjects$')] which target their [concept_overlord] affect [concept_liberty_desire]. These effects are scaled by the [concept_clout] of the $concept_political_lobby_short$.

[AddLocalizationIf( HasDlcFeature('lobbies'),'concept_political_lobby_desc_DEMANDS_OPPORTUNITIES')]$concept_political_lobbies_short$ may form randomly when a [concept_diplomatic_catalyst] happens, or when a $concept_country$ is [Concept('concept_fund_lobbies','$concept_funding_lobbies$')] in another.
concept_political_lobby_desc_DEMANDS_OPP: From time to time, $concept_political_lobbies_short$ present [Concept('concept_political_lobby_demand','$concept_political_lobby_demands_short$')]. If the $concept_political_lobby_short$ is supported by [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] [concept_in_government], $concept_political_lobbies_short$ also present [Concept('concept_political_lobby_opportunity','$concept_political_lobby_opportunities_short$')]\n\n
concept_political_lobby_appeasement_desc: The $concept_political_lobby_appeasement$ of a [concept_political_lobby] affects the [concept_approval] of the [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] of the $concept_political_lobby_short$.\n\n$concept_political_lobby_appeasement$ changes based on your [Concept('concept_diplomatic_action','$concept_diplomatic_actions$')] against the $concept_political_lobby_short$'s $concept_country$. $concept_political_pro_lobbies$ are appeased by friendly $concept_diplomatic_actions_short$, while $concept_political_anti_lobbies$ are appeased by hostile $concept_diplomatic_actions_short$.
concept_political_lobby_opportunity_desc: A special [concept_journal_entry] offered by a [concept_political_lobby] supported by [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] [concept_in_government].\n\nThese allow a special chance to achieve something normally not possible.
concept_political_lobby_demand_desc: A [concept_journal_entry] presented by a [concept_political_lobby].\n\nFulfilling a $concept_political_lobby_demand_short$ will increase [concept_political_lobby_appeasement] of the $concept_political_lobby_short$.
concept_diplomatic_catalyst_desc:
A $concept_diplomatic_catalyst$ is essentially any diplomatic occurence, which may create [Concept('concept_political_lobby','$concept_political_lobbies$')] or change a [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_attitude] towards you.

Catalysts can be any change on the world stage, for example:
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$[Concept('concept_diplomatic_action','$concept_diplomatic_actions$')]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$Actions taken in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$Change in [concept_relations] levels
concept_end_of_discussion_factor_desc: The presence of a $concept_end_of_discussion_factor$ represents that [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] in [concept_government] consider further discussion of the merits of the [concept_law] currently being enacted no longer useful. The lower this factor gets, the more negative pressure it puts on the possibility that the enactment may $concept_enactment_advance_short$ or $concept_enactment_stall_short$.
concept_enactment_of_laws_desc: The act of attempting to push a new [concept_law] through several [Concept('concept_enactment_phase','$concept_enactment_phases_short$')] in the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] legislature. At regular intervals the $concept_law$'s [concept_enactment_success] chance will be tested. The time between tests can vary by law, and is also dependent on the [Concept('concept_government','$concept_government_possessive$')] [concept_legitimacy]. If the $concept_law$ does not progress to the next [concept_enactment_phase], it will either [Concept('concept_enactment_advance','$concept_enactment_advance_short$')], be [Concept('concept_enactment_debate','$concept_enactment_debate_short_debated$')], or [Concept('concept_enactment_stall','$concept_enactment_stall_short$')] which affects its chances to pass the next test or introduce other consequences to your $concept_country$.n\n$concept_enactment_of_laws_potential$
concept_enactment_of_laws_potential: For a $concept_law$ to be able to be [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enacted$')] it must be [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_endorsed$')] by at least one $concept_interest_group$ [concept_in_government], supported by a current [concept_political_movement], or have a positive [concept_enactment_success] chance for some other reason.
concept_enactment_success_desc: $concept_enactment_success$ indicates the percentage chance that a [concept_law] will progress to the next [Concept('concept_enactment_phase','$concept_enactment_phase_short$')] at the next checkpoint. It is equal to the [concept_base_success_chance] plus any effects accumulated during the enactment process. The $concept_base_success_chance$ is increased by support from an [concept_interest_group] [concept_in_government], a [concept_political_movement] with at least $RADICALISM_AGITATING$ #v 25%#! [concept_activism], or [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose','$concept_endorsement$')] from the [Concept('concept_ruler','$concept_ruler_possessive$')] [concept_ideology].
concept_enactment_advance_desc: $concept_enactment_advance$ indicates the percentage chance that the enactment process of a [concept_law] will advance somehow at the next checkpoint, even if it won't complete or progress to the next [Concept('concept_enactment_phase','$concept_enactment_phase_short$')] yet. It is derived from the enactment's [concept_base_success_chance].
concept_enactment_debate_desc: $concept_enactment_debate$ indicates the percentage chance that the enactment process of a [concept_law] will meet with some kind of complication at the next checkpoint. The lower the total chances of [Concept('concept_enactment_success','$concept_enactment_success_short$')], [Concept('concept_enactment_advance','$concept_enactment_advance_short$')], and [Concept('concept_enactment_stall','$concept_enactment_stall_short$')] the greater the chance of $concept_enactment_debate_short$.
concept_enactment_stall_desc: $concept_enactment_stall$ indicates the percentage chance that the enactment process of a [concept_law] will be substantially hindered at the next checkpoint. Its base chance is equal to the total [concept_clout] of opposing [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] whose [concept_approval] is $ig_approval_unhappy$ or $ig_approval_angry$.
concept_base_success_chance_desc: $concept_base_success_chance$ is equal to the total [concept_clout] of supporting [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] in [concept_government] plus or minus [Concept('concept_political_movement_support', '$concept_political_movement_support_short$')] gained from any relevant [Concept('concept_political_movement', '$concept_political_movements$')].
concept_advance_factor_desc: $concept_advance_factor$ is a static factor used to determine [concept_enactment_advance] by scaling the [concept_base_success_chance].
concept_migration_pull_desc: $concept_migration_pull$ is a [concept_state]'s ability to attract migrants. It is based primarily on the average [concept_sol] among [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] in the $concept_state$ but can be modified by a number of other factors. Any [Concept('concept_unemployed','$concept_unemployment$')] in the $concept_state$ will depress $concept_migration_pull$. The value is compared against other $concept_states$ between which $concept_migration$ may occur to determine in which direction migrants tend to flow.\n\n$concept_migration_pull$ is also the primary factor used to determine a $concept_country$'s [concept_mass_migration_pull].
concept_cultural_community_desc: A $concept_cultural_community$ indicates a certain [concept_culture] is present in a [concept_state] and allows [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] in your [concept_market] to migrate to this $concept_state$.\n\nA newly formed $concept_cultural_community_short$ will have lower [concept_acceptance], but this will go away over time. A new [concept_law] that changes $concept_acceptance$ may also take time to implement, so $concept_pops$ of that $concept_cultural_community_short$ will temporarily have a different $concept_acceptance$ from the norm.
concept_lower_strata_desc: The $concept_lower_strata$ consist of [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] in [Concept('concept_profession','$concept_professions$')] that work with their hands or do repetitive labor which require little to no [concept_pop_qualifications] and result in low [Concept('concept_building_wage','$concept_building_wages$')].\n\n$STRATA_CONCEPTS_DEPEND_ON_SOCIAL_HIERARCHY$
concept_middle_strata_desc: The $concept_middle_strata$ consist of [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] with specialized [Concept('concept_profession','$concept_professions$')] that are harder to gain [concept_pop_qualifications] for. This provides them with more leverage on the labor market and thereby higher [Concept('concept_building_wage','$concept_building_wages$')].\n\n$STRATA_CONCEPTS_DEPEND_ON_SOCIAL_HIERARCHY$
concept_upper_strata_desc: The $concept_upper_strata$ consist of [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] with [Concept('concept_profession','$concept_professions$')] they [Concept('concept_pop_qualifications','$concept_qualify$')] for mostly on the basis of [concept_wealth]. These $concept_professions$ are typically not available to $concept_pops$ that have low [concept_acceptance] either. They tend to hold [Concept('concept_ownership_share','$concept_ownership_shares$')] in their [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] and draw [concept_dividends] and collect [concept_budget_interest] in addition to [Concept('concept_building_wage','$concept_building_wages$')].\n\n$STRATA_CONCEPTS_DEPEND_ON_SOCIAL_HIERARCHY$
concept_incoming_units_desc: Each Unit under recruitment either has a level of a [concept_military_building] in the [concept_construction_queue] or have a $concept_military_building$ that are trying to hire [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] in order to be able to create the [concept_unit].
concept_neighbors_desc: Two [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] are considered to be $concept_neighbors$ if they share a land border or if they both own coastal [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] that connect to the same [concept_sea_node].
concept_welfare_payments_desc: $concept_welfare_payments$ are a form of direct subsidy paid by by a [concept_country] to all $concept_pops$ in the [concept_workforce] that receive wages lower than the defined fraction of the [concept_normal_wage].
concept_sea_node_desc: An intersection or point along a naval [concept_shipping_lane] representing a part of the ocean. $concept_shipping_lanes$ always take the shortest travel distance route between two coastal [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')]. For each multiple of the expected travel distance (#v [GetDefine('NEconomy','SEA_DISTANCE_EXPECTED_TRAVEL_DISTANCE')]#!), #v [GetDefine('NEconomy','SHIPPING_LANE_MERCHANT_MARINE_COST_SCALING')|=-%0]#! is added to the shipping cost.
concept_agitator_desc:
A [concept_character_role] for [Concept('concept_character','$concept_characters$')] who support a [concept_political_movement], making it more attractive to [Concept('concept_individual','$concept_individuals$')] belonging to their [concept_interest_group]. Agitators may be invited with the #b Invite [concept_exile]#! character action or will appear randomly in your country, with their chance of appearance dependent upon your $concept_country$'s [concept_literacy].

Agitators can only be invited if their [concept_acceptance_status] is one of the following in your [concept_country]: $SECOND_RATE_CITIZEN_GC_LINK$ or $FULL_ACCEPTANCE_GC_LINK$.

The [concept_political_movement] they support is determined by their [concept_ideology]. Their impact on their [concept_political_movement] is determined by the Agitator's [concept_popularity] and [Concept('concept_character_trait', '$concept_character_traits$')].
concept_exile_desc:
A [concept_character] may be $concept_exiled$ using the #b Exile Dissident#! character action. The $concept_character$ becomes an [concept_agitator] and is expelled from your country.

An $concept_exiled$ $concept_character$ may be invited to any [concept_country] through the #b Invite Exile#! character action, where they will immediately start or join a [concept_political_movement] for that $concept_country$ in accordance with their [concept_ideology]. If all their [Concept('concept_endorse_oppose', '$concept_endorsed$')] [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] are already active when they arrive, the invited $concept_agitator$ will remain dormant.

An $concept_exiled$ $concept_character$ can only be invited if their [concept_acceptance_status] is one of the following in your [concept_country]: $SECOND_RATE_CITIZEN_GC_LINK$ or $FULL_ACCEPTANCE_GC_LINK$.
concept_message_settings_feed_desc: Notifications that appear in chronological order in the feed in the bottom-right corner of the screen.
concept_message_settings_toast_desc: Notifications that appear one at a time in the middle of the screen.
concept_message_settings_popup_desc: Customized Notifications that pop up in the middle of the screen and have to be manually closed. This option is only available if the Notification Type has a customized popup panel specified.
concept_message_settings_none_desc: Notifications that does not appear anywhere in the user interface.
concept_alert_settings_alert_desc: Alerts that appear as their own individual element with an icon to the right of the [Concept('concept_capacity','$concept_capacities$')] and #b Current Situation#! at the top center of the screen.
concept_alert_settings_important_action_: Alerts that appear in the list when you click the #b Current Situations#! button.
concept_alert_settings_angry_important_a: Red Alerts that appear in the list when you click the #b Current Situations#! button.
concept_alert_settings_none_desc: Alerts/important actions that does not appear anywhere in the user interface.
concept_training_rate_desc: The $concept_training_rate$ is the amount of [concept_manpower] that can be trained per week at a [concept_military_building].
concept_landing_progress_desc: The $concept_landing_progress$ is equivalent to how much [concept_occupation] the invader has gained of the invaded [concept_state]. If the $concept_landing_progress$ reaches #v 100%#!, the #b Naval Invasion#! is successful and a [concept_front] will be established.
concept_naval_invasion_support_desc: $concept_naval_invasion_support$ is a comparison of the amount of the [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')] you have assigned to naval invasion to the amount of [Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] taking part in that invasion. Each invading $concept_battalion$ requires a $concept_ship$ to avoid any negative penalties upon landing.
concept_capitulation_desire_desc: An AI-controlled [concept_country] will try to capitulate if this value reaches 0 or higher.
concept_risk_desc: The Risk of a particular [concept_terrain] type influences the amount of [concept_casualties] and [concept_wounded] a [concept_battle] would result in.
concept_terrain_labels_desc: A [concept_terrain] Label is a grouping of several $concept_terrain$ Types. [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] can have [Concept('concept_modifier','$concept_modifiers$')] affecting all $concept_terrain$ Types with a specific Terrain Label.
concept_job_satisfaction_desc: Pops can be satisfied or dissatisfied with their jobs based on a number of factors such as their [concept_sol] or [concept_building_wage]. This determines whether they are looking for new [concept_employment] or not.
concept_employment_desc: A [concept_pop] working in a [concept_building] is said to be $concept_employed$. $concept_employment$ provides the $concept_pop$ with a [concept_building_wage]. An $concept_employed$ $concept_pop$ can switch jobs if a job with a better $concept_building_wage$ appears as long as they have the [concept_pop_qualifications] for it.
concept_power_bloc_desc: Power Blocs are multinational associations, led by a [concept_great_power], [concept_major_power], or [Concept('concept_unrecognized_power', '$concept_unrecognized_major_power$')], that grant powerful effects to [Concept('concept_power_bloc_leader','$concept_power_bloc_leaders$')] and [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_members$')]. They serve the [Concept('concept_power_bloc_leader','$concept_power_bloc_leader_short$')] in building their sphere of influence by building up [concept_power_bloc_leverage_advantage] in [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] to make them join the [concept_power_bloc].
concept_power_bloc_rank_desc: A [Concept('concept_power_bloc','$concept_power_bloc_possessive$')] Rank is solely based on its [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')] total [concept_prestige] compared to all other $concept_power_blocs$.
concept_power_bloc_leader_desc: A [concept_great_power], [concept_major_power], or [Concept('concept_unrecognized_power', '$concept_unrecognized_major_power$')] that leads a [concept_power_bloc]. They tend to benefit more from [Concept('concept_power_bloc','$concept_power_blocs$')] than regular [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_members$')].
concept_power_bloc_member_desc: A member of a [concept_power_bloc], this includes the [Concept('concept_power_bloc_leader','$concept_power_bloc_leader_short$')] #b except#! when calculating [concept_power_bloc_mandate_progress]. Although, $concept_power_bloc_members_short_non_leader$ tend to benefit less from [Concept('concept_power_bloc','$concept_power_blocs$')] than their [Concept('concept_power_bloc_leader','$concept_power_bloc_leaders$')].
concept_power_bloc_identity_desc: The $concept_power_bloc_identity$ defines the core values a [concept_power_bloc] revolves around. They determine the [concept_power_bloc]'s [concept_power_bloc_cohesion] and grant special powers to the [concept_power_bloc_leader]. They can unlock certain [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle_group','$concept_power_bloc_principle_groups$')].
concept_power_bloc_principle_desc: $concept_power_bloc_principles$ belong to a [concept_power_bloc_principle_group] and are bestowing different kinds of effects on [Concept('concept_power_bloc','$concept_power_blocs$')] and [concept_power_bloc_member]. They cost [Concept('concept_power_bloc_mandate','$concept_power_bloc_mandates$')] to enact and can be upgraded.
concept_power_bloc_primary_principle_gro: A $concept_power_bloc_primary_principle_group$ is dependent on a [Concept('concept_power_bloc','$concept_power_bloc_possessive$')] selected [concept_power_bloc_identity]. A $concept_power_bloc$ must always have at least one [concept_power_bloc_principle] from a $concept_power_bloc_primary_principle_group_short$ to have a stable [concept_power_bloc_cohesion]. [Concept('concept_power_bloc_mandate','$concept_power_bloc_mandating$')] higher-tier $concept_power_bloc_principles$ from $concept_power_bloc_primary_principle_groups_short$ (tier II and III) strengthens the $concept_power_bloc_cohesion$ further.
concept_power_bloc_principle_group_desc: Groups of three tiers of [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle','$concept_power_bloc_principles$')] that support the same theme.
concept_power_bloc_mandate_desc: $concept_power_bloc_mandates$ are used to upgrade, switch or enact new [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle','$concept_power_bloc_principles$')]. [Concept('concept_power_bloc','$concept_power_blocs$')] gain [concept_power_bloc_mandate_progress] by having powerful [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_members$')] and a high [concept_power_bloc_cohesion] value. Up to three $concept_power_bloc_mandates$ can be stored.
concept_power_bloc_mandate_progress_desc: The progress towards the next [concept_power_bloc_mandate]. [Concept('concept_power_bloc','$concept_power_blocs$')] gain progress by having powerful [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_members$')] and a high [concept_power_bloc_cohesion] value.
concept_power_bloc_cohesion_desc: $concept_power_bloc_cohesion$ is the indicator for how well a [concept_power_bloc] is running. It is mostly affected by the [concept_power_bloc_identity] which informs what impacts the value. The larger the [concept_power_bloc], the lower the Cohesion will generally be.
concept_power_bloc_leverage_desc: [Concept('concept_power_bloc','$concept_power_blocs$')] build up $concept_power_bloc_leverage$ in [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] over time, by comparing their influence in the $concept_country$ to that of other $concept_power_blocs$. $concept_power_bloc_leverage$ share can be gained through different interactions, for example an active [concept_diplomatic_pact] or [concept_treaty], and current $concept_power_bloc_leverage$ will drift towards this share each week. Once enough [concept_power_bloc_leverage_advantage] has been accumulated over a $concept_country$, they can be invited to the $concept_power_bloc$.
concept_power_bloc_unclaimed_leverage_de: A [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] $concept_power_bloc_unclaimed_leverage$ is the [concept_power_bloc_leverage] that no [concept_power_bloc] has claimed on that $concept_country$. It is based on the $concept_country_possessive$ #b Leverage Resistance#! which in turn is based on a number of factors like their [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] and [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')], more people means more people to convince.
concept_power_bloc_leverage_advantage_de: The amount of [concept_power_bloc_leverage] a [concept_power_bloc] has over a [concept_country] compared to the other $concept_power_blocs$. If the value is #positive_value +positive#! this $concept_power_bloc$ has a $concept_power_bloc_leverage_advantage$ meaning the most $concept_power_bloc_leverage$ of all $concept_power_blocs$; if it is #negative_value -negative#! this $concept_power_bloc$ has a $concept_power_bloc_leverage_disadvantage$ which means that some other $concept_power_blocs$ currently has more than them, or the $concept_country_possessive$ [concept_power_bloc_unclaimed_leverage] is higher.\n\nIn order for a [concept_power_bloc_leader] to invite a $concept_country$ into their $concept_power_bloc$, $concept_power_bloc_leverage_advantage$ must be positive and have reached a necessary threshold.
concept_power_bloc_leverage_share_desc: A [Concept('concept_power_bloc','$concept_power_bloc_possessive$')] $concept_power_bloc_leverage_share$ of a [concept_country] is the total [concept_power_bloc_leverage] the $concept_power_bloc$ can have at any moment over that $concept_country$. $concept_countries$ have a finite amount of [concept_power_bloc_leverage] that [Concept('concept_power_bloc','$concept_power_blocs$')] can project on them. This $concept_power_bloc_leverage$ is divided up between all $concept_power_blocs$ with any $concept_power_bloc_leverage$ over this $concept_country$ resulting in each $concept_power_bloc_possessive$ $concept_power_bloc_leverage_share$. However, a certain amount of the $concept_power_bloc_leverage$ may become [Concept('concept_power_bloc_unclaimed_leverage','$concept_power_bloc_unclaimed_leverage_short$')] based on the $concept_country_possessive$ own #b Leverage Resistance#!.
concept_power_struggle_desc: A $concept_power_struggle$ is the attempt of a [concept_power_bloc_member] to take leadership from the current [concept_power_bloc_leader]. It automatically triggers if a [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_member_non_leader$')] has #v [Subtract_CFixedPoint(GetDefine('NPowerBlocs','POWER_STRUGGLE_PRESTIGE_THRESHOLD_START'), '(CFixedPoint)1')|0%]#! more [concept_prestige] than the [concept_power_bloc_leader]. If they uphold at least #v [Subtract_CFixedPoint(GetDefine('NPowerBlocs','POWER_STRUGGLE_PRESTIGE_THRESHOLD_FAIL'), '(CFixedPoint)1')|0%]#! more $concept_prestige$ for #v [GetDefine('NPowerBlocs','POWER_STRUGGLE_DURATION_SUCCESS_MONTHS')|0] months#!, they become the new [concept_power_bloc_leader].
concept_autonomy_desc:
Each [concept_subject] [concept_country] has its own $concept_autonomy$ level. This level will determine what kind of interaction they will have with their [concept_overlord].

A $concept_subject$ with high $concept_autonomy$ will be more independent in regards to diplomacy. They will also have lower tribute payments to their $concept_overlord$. There is a risk that a $concept_country$ that is too $concept_autonomous$ will attempt to Declare an #v $war_goal_independence_type_name$#! [concept_diplomatic_play].
$concept_subjects$ with low $concept_autonomy$ will be more reliant on their $concept_overlords$ and pay larger tributes to their $concept_overlord$. $concept_subjects$ with the lowest level of $concept_autonomy$ can be integrated with a #v $dp_annex_subject$#! [concept_diplomatic_play] into their $concept_overlord$.
concept_economic_dependence_desc:
$concept_economic_dependence$ is the amount of economic reliance two [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] have between one another. The main influence of which is the amount of [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] that are owned by the other $concept_country$. This can either be through direct ownership from a $concept_country$ or by [concept_pop] investors.

Being in a shared market will additionally take into consideration the difference in [concept_gdp] and the impact of each [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries_possessive$')] produced [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] and owned $concept_buildings$ on $concept_pops$.

If the two $concept_countries$ are not in a shared market, the $concept_economic_dependence$ is impacted by [concept_trade]. The impact of this is dependent on the amount of $concept_trade$ between the two $concept_countries$ and the impact on $concept_good$ Market Balance.
concept_electoral_confidence_desc: $concept_electoral_confidence$ is a measure in how much the electorate of a [concept_country] trusts that any elections held will be free and fair. Tampering with elections by rigging them in favor of a specific [concept_party] will lower $concept_electoral_confidence$, while allowing elections to proceed without interference will increase it. A low $concept_electoral_confidence$ will impact [concept_legitimacy] and the amount of [concept_political_strength] gained from votes, with the degree of effect varying based on your enacted [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] and [Concept('concept_amendment','$concept_amendments$')].
concept_princely_state_desc: A $concept_princely_state$ is a state under the rule of a native Indian monarch subordinate to a European colonial power. They possess greatly different degrees of prominence within the Indian imperial system, but all are generally subject to a similar diplomatic arrangement.
concept_crown_land_desc: A $concept_crown_land$ is an administrative region of a dynastic empire, retaining varying levels of regional autonomy.
concept_georegion_desc: A $concept_georegion$ is an area that corresponds to a collection of [Concept('concept_strategic_region','$concept_strategic_regions$')] and [Concept('concept_state_region','$concept_state_regions$')]. $concept_georegions$ are unchanging but may overlap and in some cases can be a part of a larger $concept_georegion$ altogether.
concept_privy_purse_desc: A Privy Purse is the personal income of a [Concept('concept_ruler','Monarch')]. In the context of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_india').GetName], it represents the pension paid to the former ruler of a [concept_princely_state] #b annexed#! by another [concept_country] using a #v The Federation of India#! [concept_journal_entry].\n\nThe $modifier_privy_purse_payments$ modifier will be added upon annexing any $concept_princely_state$ with this $concept_journal_entry$, and will be updated upon each subsequent annexation. The #b Privy Purse#! payments will add #b National Expenses#! equivalent to #v 0.01%#! [concept_gdp] times the number of #b Princely States#! annexed using this [concept_journal_entry]
concept_fervor_desc:
$concept_fervor$ is a measure of the national spirit of a [concept_culture]. [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of a $concept_culture$ with high $concept_fervor$ will [Concept('concept_assimilation','$concept_assimilate$')] more slowly, form more [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] when conquered, increase [concept_liberty_desire] and be more likely to join [Concept('concept_cultural_movement', '$concept_cultural_movements$')].

#title The following conditions #b increase#! $concept_fervor$:#! #indent_newline:3 
• Being a [Concept('concept_primary_cultures','$concept_primary_culture$')] of an independent [concept_country] with an #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],fervor_effects_from_citizenship_laws_tt applicable#! [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'CITIZENSHIP_LINK','lawgroup_citizenship')] [concept_law]
• Number of [concept_casualties] of this [concept_culture] in [concept_war]
• Having high average [concept_literacy]
• Number of [GetPopType('academics').GetName] $concept_pops$ of this $concept_culture$
• $concept_pops$ of this culture resident in $concept_countries$ with [GetTechnology('nationalism').GetName] or [GetTechnology('pan-nationalism').GetName] [Concept('concept_technology', '$concept_technologies$')]
• Being a $concept_primary_culture$ of a $concept_country$ with an applicable [GetInstitutionType('institution_schools').GetName] [concept_institution]
• Other $concept_culture$ released as independent $concept_countries$
• Experiencing a [concept_national_awakening]#!

#title The following conditions #b decrease#! $concept_fervor$:#! #indent_newline:3 
• Being a $concept_primary_culture$ of a $concept_country$ with the [GetLawType('law_multicultural').GetName] $concept_law$
• Having high average [concept_acceptance]#!
concept_cultural_movement_desc: $concept_cultural_movements$ are [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')] pursuing a better life for people of a specific [concept_culture]. If this culture is the [Concept('concept_primary_cultures','$concept_primary_culture$')] of a [concept_country], the movement will push a nationalistic agenda. Otherwise, the movement will push for [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] which give their people greater [concept_acceptance], or even attempt a [concept_secession].\n\nIf a $concept_cultural_movement$'s [concept_activism] exceeds @activism_red! $RADICALISM_PROTESTING$ (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'RADICALISM_PROTESTING_THRESHOLD')|%0]#!), it will begin to generate [concept_obstinance] in $concept_states$ with $concept_political_movement_supporting$ $concept_pops$.
concept_religious_movement_desc: $concept_religious_movements$ are [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')] pursuing a better life for people of a specific [concept_religion]. If this $religion$ is the [concept_state_religion] of a [concept_country], the movement will push a traditionalist agenda. Otherwise, the movement will push for [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] which give their people greater [concept_acceptance], or even attempt a [concept_secession].\n\nIf a $concept_religious_movement$'s [concept_activism] exceeds @activism_red! $RADICALISM_PROTESTING$ (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'RADICALISM_PROTESTING_THRESHOLD')|%0]#!), it will begin to generate [concept_obstinance] in $concept_states$ with $concept_political_movement_supporting$ $concept_pops$.
concept_dynastic_loyalty_desc:
$concept_dynastic_loyalty$ represents the Serbian population's support for keeping the ruling dynasty on the throne, as opposed to their rivals. The ruling dynasty must gain enough support to prevent the opposition from voicing a claim. Failing to do so will cause them to lose the throne, and stagnate national growth.

The following conditions will #bold advance#! $concept_dynastic_loyalty$:
• High [concept_ruler] [concept_popularity]
• Low [concept_popularity] of rival claimants
• High [concept_legitimacy] 
• High [concept_sol]
• Fraction of [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalists$')]
• Non-[concept_marginalized] [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] [concept_in_opposition] above 4 [concept_approval] by [concept_clout] 
• Has [GetLawType('law_censorship').GetName] or [GetLawType('law_outlawed_dissent').GetName] enacted
• Not being a [concept_subject]
• Each [concept_major_power] or [concept_great_power] supporting our independence
• Events or other choices

The following conditions will #bold deplete#! $concept_dynastic_loyalty$:
• Low [concept_ruler] [concept_popularity]
• High [concept_popularity] of rival claimants
• Low [concept_legitimacy]
• Low [concept_sol]
• Fraction of [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')]
• Non-[concept_marginalized] [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] [concept_in_opposition] below -4 [concept_approval] by [concept_clout] 
• Negative [concept_authority]
• Negative [concept_bureaucracy]
• Positive [concept_relations] with [concept_overlord]
• Events or other choices
concept_brz_national_hero_desc: A #bold National Hero#! is a general who has won a battle against a state that is not Brazilian, and been hailed as a hero in the event '#bold A New National Hero#!'.
concept_house_of_obrenovic_desc: The $concept_house_of_obrenovic$ is one of the two contending $SER_ADJ$ royal houses. They are descended from #b Miloš Obrenović#!, leader of the Second Serbian Uprising and founder of the autonomous Principality of Serbia. Supporters of the $concept_house_of_obrenovic_short$ typically favor improved [concept_relations] with #b Austria#!.
concept_house_of_karadjordjevic_desc: The $concept_house_of_karadjordjevic$ is one of the two contending $SER_ADJ$ royal houses. They are descended from #b Karađorđe#!, leader of the ill-fated First Serbian Uprising against the Ottoman Empire. Supporters of the $concept_house_of_karadjordjevic_short$ typically favor improved [concept_relations] with #b Russia#!.
concept_lands_of_anarchy_control: Control over the Lands of Anarchy
concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_desc:
$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$ represents the Makhzen's authority over the remote tribes of Morocco.

There is a bar for each surrounding [concept_state] to the [concept_capital_state]. A higher value indicates that the tribesfolk respect and fear the [concept_government]'s decisions more, thus enabling officials to carry out their tasks effectively. Each state's starting negative [concept_modifier] scales monthly based on its current value. Greater $concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$ results in less effective penalties, and vice versa.

By developing the chaotic state centers, creating more job opportunities, and fostering connections between urban and rural life, the tribes will gradually be influenced, reducing their isolation. Ultimately, their influence over the tribesmen will fade away.

Failing to maintain $concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$ can prepare our downfall, leaving behind long-lasting effects on these states.
concept_austrian_constitutional_pressure:
$concept_austrian_constitutional_pressure$ represents the strength and influence of the opposition to the neo-absolutist regime, and is tied to the preceived authority of the regime.

Should $concept_austrian_constitutional_pressure$ reach #v 100#!, the neo-absolutist government will fall, and a constitution will be have to be granted. 

#title The following conditions #r #b increase#!#! $concept_austrian_constitutional_pressure_short$:#! #indent_newline:3 
• Having a [concept_war_goal] enforced on you
• Declaring [concept_bankruptcy]
• Taking [concept_loans]
• [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] with [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')]
• [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] opposing [GetLawType('law_autocracy').GetName]
• [Concept('concept_activism', '$concept_activism_short$')] of #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],liberal_movements_list_tt Liberal#!, #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],socialist_movements_list_tt Socialist#!, and $movement_cultural_minority_short$ [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')]
• Having a [concept_bureaucracy] deficit
• Events and other conditions #!

#title The following conditions #g #b decrease#!#! $concept_austrian_constitutional_pressure_short$:#! #indent_newline:3 
• Having a positive budget balance
• Enforcing a [concept_war_goal] on a [concept_great_power]
• [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] with [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalists$')]
• [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] supporting [GetLawType('law_autocracy').GetName]
• [Concept('concept_political_movement_support', '$concept_political_movement_support_short$')] of $movement_royalist_absolutist_short$, $movement_religious_majority_short$, and $movement_cultural_majority_short$ [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')]
• Having a [concept_bureaucracy] surplus
• Events and other conditions #!
concept_coup_desc:
A $concept_coup$ is an attempt by a [concept_commander] with low [concept_loyalty] to overthrow the sitting [concept_government]. The risk of a $concept_coup$ increases when a [concept_country] is ruled by a $concept_government$ with low [concept_legitimacy], or if a disloyal $concept_commander$ has a high [Concept('concept_commander_rank', 'concept_commander_rank_short')] and [concept_popularity].

Once a $concept_coup$ begins, if its progress reaches #v 100%#!, the commander executing the $concept_coup$ will issue a [concept_pronunciamento]. A successful $concept_pronunciamento$ will cause the overthrow of the $concept_government$.

The progress of a $concept_coup$ is determined by the [concept_coup_strength] of the commander executing the $concept_coup$, evaluated against the [concept_coup_resistance] of the sitting government.
concept_coup_strength_desc:
$concept_coup_strength$ represents the ability for a [concept_commander] to successfully orchestrate a [concept_coup] against the sitting [concept_government]. A $concept_coup$ will #b progress#! when the $concept_commander$'s [concept_interest_group]'s [concept_approval] is #b negative#!, and the $concept_coup_strength$ of the $concept_commander$ orchestrating the $concept_coup$ is higher than the [concept_coup_resistance] of the sitting government.

Factors contributing to $concept_coup_strength$ include:
• High [concept_popularity]
• High [concept_commander_rank]
• [concept_clout] of $concept_commander$ $concept_interest_group$
• Proximity of the [concept_commander]'s [concept_military_formation] to the [concept_capital_state]
concept_coup_resistance_desc:
$concept_coup_resistance$ represents the ability for a [concept_government] to fend off a [concept_coup] by a [concept_commander]. A $concept_coup$ will #b retreat#! when the $concept_coup_resistance$ of the sitting $concept_government$ is higher than the [concept_coup_strength] of the $concept_commander$ orchestrating the $concept_coup$.

Factors contributing to $concept_coup_resistance$ include:
• High [concept_government] [concept_legitimacy]
• Level of [GetInstitutionType('institution_home_affairs').GetName] investment under [GetLawType('law_secret_police').GetName] or [GetLawType('law_national_guard').GetName] [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')]
concept_pronunciamento_desc:
A $concept_pronunciamento$ is the final stage of a [concept_coup], in which a [concept_commander] declares opposition to the sitting [concept_government] and rallies their forces to support them. When a $concept_pronunciamento$ occurs, the [concept_coup_resistance] of the sitting $concept_government$ is compared to the [concept_coup_strength] of $concept_commander$ executing the $concept_coup$.

If the $concept_coup_strength$ of the $concept_commander$ is less than the $concept_coup_resistance$ of the $concept_government$, or if the $concept_coup$ is triggered by a Character Interaction, the $concept_government$ will have a chance to defend itself against the $concept_coup$. The $government$'s chance of successfully defending itself is determined by the ratio of [concept_coup_resistance] to the aforementioned factors.

A successful $concept_pronunciamento$ will cause the overthrow of the $concept_government$. A failed $concept_pronunciamento$ will result in increased [Concept('concept_radical', '$concept_radicalism$')], and negative repercussions for the coupist $concept_commander$.
concept_guerilla_war_desc:
A $concept_guerilla_war$ is a special kind of [concept_war] subject to a set of rules distinct from regular warfare, the details of which can differ from one $concept_guerilla_war$ to another.

The following general rules are applied during a $concept_guerilla_war$:
#indent_newline:2 $EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$ [Concept('concept_battle', '$concept_battles$')] are much smaller in size and created at a lower pace#! 
#indent_newline:2 $EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$ The [GetBattleCondition('battle_condition_guerilla_skirmish').GetName], [GetBattleCondition('battle_condition_guerilla_ambush').GetName] and [GetBattleCondition('battle_condition_guerilla_disarray').GetName] [Concept('concept_battle_condition', '$concept_battle_conditions$')] can occur#!
#indent_newline:2 $EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$ Victories do not grant [concept_occupation] Score#!
#indent_newline:2 $EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$ A $concept_guerilla_war$ may escalate into a regular $concept_war$ if conflict specific conditions are met
concept_amenability_desc:
How willing an [concept_interest_group] is to [Concept('concept_negotiation', '$concept_negotiate$')] during the [concept_enactment_of_laws], higher value means more willing.

#b 0 - [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MIN_AMENABILITY_TENSE_NEGOTIATION')]#!:     Will #r refuse#! to $concept_negotiate$
#b [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MIN_AMENABILITY_TENSE_NEGOTIATION')] - [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MIN_AMENABILITY_NORMAL_NEGOTIATION')]#!:   #v #r $negotiation_tier_3$#!#!
#b [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MIN_AMENABILITY_NORMAL_NEGOTIATION')] - [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MIN_AMENABILITY_FRIENDLY_NEGOTIATION')]#!:   #v $negotiation_tier_2$#!
#b [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'MIN_AMENABILITY_FRIENDLY_NEGOTIATION')] - 100#!: #v #g $negotiation_tier_1$#!#!
