concept_obstinance_desc: $concept_obstinance$ represents [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] supporting a [concept_cultural_movement] or [concept_religious_movement] within a [concept_state] passively refusing to comply with a [concept_country]'s [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institutions$')]. $concept_obstinance$ is caused by the [concept_activism] of an applicable [Concept('concept_political_movement', '$concept_political_movement_short$')] exceeding @activism_red! $RADICALISM_PROTESTING$ (#v [GetDefine('NPolitics', 'RADICALISM_PROTESTING_THRESHOLD')|%0]#!). The amount of $concept_obstinance$ is equal to the fraction of the $concept_state$'s [concept_workforce] that are members of an $concept_obstinate$ $concept_political_movement$.\n\nThe presence of $concept_obstinance$ in a state inflicts a number of negative local status effects on a $concept_state$, such as reduced [concept_assimilation], [Concept('concept_taxes','$state_tax_collection_mult$')], [Concept('concept_conscription_center','$concept_conscription$')], and $concept_institution$ impact.
concept_bavarocratic_ire_desc:
$concept_bavarocratic_ire_short$ represents the Greek population's opposition to the rule of the Bavarian clique in Greece. High $concept_bavarocratic_ire_short$ may result in the ousting of King Otto and his Bavarian supporters.

The following conditions will #bold advance#! $concept_bavarocratic_ire_short$:
• [GetCulture('south_german').GetName] [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')] or [Concept('concept_character', '$concept_characters$')] in [concept_in_government]
• #bold Not#! having an [GetReligion('orthodox').GetName] [concept_ruler]
• The [concept_ruler] #bold Not#! having an [concept_heir]
• The [concept_ruler] being unmarried 
• #bold Not#! having [Concept('concept_votes','$concept_voting_rights$')]
• Fielding less than #v 10#! [Concept('concept_battalion', '$concept_battalions$')]
• [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] in owned [GetCulture('greek').GetName] [concept_homeland] [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')]
• Having recently #r lost#! a [concept_war]
• Event or button choices

The following conditions will #bold deplete#! $concept_bavarocratic_ire_short$:
• Owning [GetCulture('greek').GetName] [concept_homeland] [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')]
• [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalists$')] in owned [GetCulture('greek').GetName] [concept_homeland] [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')]
• Having recently #g won#! a [concept_war]
• Having at least one [GetBuildingType('building_university').GetName] in a [GetCulture('greek').GetName] [concept_homeland] [concept_state]
• Fielding more than #v 20#! [Concept('concept_battalion', '$concept_battalions$')]
• Event or button choices
concept_disqualified_culture_desc: A [concept_culture] is $concept_disqualified_culture_short$ for the purposes of organizing the #b $dyn_c_usga$#! if its demands are refused. Typically, this occurs as a result of [Concept('concept_integrated_culture','$concept_integrated_culture_present_verb$')] a different $concept_culture$ with which the culture to be $concept_disqualified_culture_short$ shares [concept_homeland] [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')]. $concept_disqualified_culture_short$ $concept_cultures$ may not be negotiated with further, or $concept_integrated_culture_short$ under any circumstances.
concept_integrated_culture_desc: An $concept_integrated_culture$ is a [concept_culture] whose demands have been satisfactorily addressed during the process of organizing the #b $dyn_c_usga$#!. When a $concept_culture$ is $concept_integrated_culture_short$, it becomes a [Concept('concept_primary_cultures','$concept_primary_culture$')], and contributes to the progress of the #b $je_danubian_federation$#! [concept_journal_entry]. $concept_integrated_culture_short$ $concept_cultures$ may become [Concept('concept_disqualified_culture','$concept_disqualified_culture_short$')] if their demands are contradicted following their $concept_integrated_culture_process$. $concept_disqualified_culture_present_verb$ a $concept_culture$ that has already been $concept_integrated_culture_short$ will lead to heavy penalties.
concept_radicalized_interest_group_desc: When an [concept_interest_group]'s [concept_approval] is below [GetApprovalRatingFromValue(GetDefine('NPolitics','APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_ANGRY'))], it is said to be $concept_radicalized$. A $concept_radicalized$ $concept_interest_group$ is likely to become [Concept('concept_insurrection','$concept_insurrectionary$')], or stage a [concept_coup] against the sitting [concept_government].
concept_strait_access_desc:
$concept_strait_access$ determines what [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')] can pass through a [concept_strait]. It can be changed by the [Concept('concept_strait_control','$concept_strait_controller$')] of either side of the $concept_strait$ by setting restrictions. [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] can also secure a [concept_treaty] to be guaranteed $concept_strait_access$ when they would normally be forbidden to pass.

#title A $concept_strait$ can be:#!#indent_newline:3 
#b Open#! - All $concept_ships$ may pass
#b No Military#! - Only [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName] $concept_ships$ & [Concept('concept_supply_ship','$concept_supply_ships$')] may pass
#b Closed#! - No $concept_ships$ may pass, potentially restricting access to the [concept_world_market]#!

Which [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] are affected by this restriction is determined by the [concept_strait_allowed_countries]. In the case where the two $concept_states$ have set different $concept_strait_accesses$, the most severe $concept_strait_access_short$ restriction will take precedence.
concept_strait_allowed_countries_desc:
Determines which [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] are affected by the [concept_strait_access] restrictions if it is set to #b No Military#! or #b Closed#!

#title The $concept_strait_allowed_countries$ can be set to:#!#indent_newline:3 
#b No enemies#!#indent_newline:3 
$concept_strait_access_short$ restrictions only affects $concept_ships$ from enemies of the [Concept('concept_strait_control','$concept_strait_controller$')]#!

#b Only allies#!#indent_newline:3 
Only $concept_ships$ of allies to the $concept_strait_controller$ are exempt from the restrictions#!

#b Only $concept_strait_controller_short$#!#indent_newline:3 
Only $concept_ships$ from the $concept_strait_controller$ & its [Concept('concept_subject','$concept_subjects$')] are exempt from the restrictions#!#!
concept_strait_control_desc: $concept_strait_control$ is determined by control of the two [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] on each side of a [concept_strait]. In all cases each [concept_country] with control over one of the $concept_states$ becomes a $concept_strait_controller$ that can change the [concept_strait_access] through the $concept_strait$, with the exception of #b $strait_gibraltar$#! which requires control of both $concept_states$ to be able to set the [concept_strait_access] to #b Closed#!.\n\nIn the case where the two $concept_states$ have set different $concept_strait_accesses$, the most severe $concept_strait_access_short$ restriction will take precedence.
concept_japanese_emperor_desc: The Emperor, or Tennō, is the traditional ruler of #b Japan#!, as well as the head of the #b Shinto#! [concept_religion]. Throughout the Tokugawa period, the Emperor has remained secluded within the Imperial Palace in Kyōto, with their affairs tightly regulated by the Shogunate.
concept_zaibatsu_desc:
A #b #italic $concept_zaibatsu$#!#! is a family-owned and vertically-integrated industrial and financial conglomerate.

A typical $concept_zaibatsu$ is organized around a holding company and a bank, which hold ownership shares in several, typically industrial, subsidiary companies. The $concept_zaibatsu$ emerged from family merchant congolomerates of the late Edo period, which made use of their pre-existing wealth and ties to the state to consolidate control of much of Japan's industrial base.

[Concept('concept_company','$concept_companies$')] regarded as Zaibatsu include #v $company_mitsui$#!, #v $company_mitsubishi$#!, #v $company_yasuda$#!, and #v $company_sumitomo$#!.
concept_raiding_desc: Raiding is income derived from the theft, pillage and plunder of neighboring lands over time. With little arable land, $MON$ must rely on $concept_raiding$ and [concept_russian_aid] to survive. \n\nOur income from raiding is dependent on our [concept_raiding_frequency] multiplied by our army's [concept_power_projection]. #g @money!+[GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('max_raiding_income')]#! is the most we can possibly earn from raiding.
concept_raiding_frequency_desc:
$concept_raiding_frequency$ represents how often the tribes are permitted to [Concept('concept_raiding', 'raid')].

In addition to increasing our income from [concept_raiding], each #v 1%#! of $concept_raiding_frequency$ will also have the following effects:
[GetStaticModifier('modifier_montenegrin_disobedience').GetDesc]
concept_russian_aid_desc:
$concept_russian_aid$ is support from #v $RUS$#! to our tribes, as fellow brethren of the Orthodox Church. 

The base amount we receive depends on our [concept_relations] with #v $RUS$#!: 

• #v Neutral Relations#! (or worse): @money!200 
• #v Cordial Relations#! : @money!400 
• #v Amicable Relations#! : @money!700 
• #v Friendly Relations#! : @money!1000
technology_events.1.d: Due to a spate of accidents, there have been calls to regulate automobiles.
technology_events.1.c: Automobiles should have the right of way.
custom_automobile_accident_type_crash: two automobiles crashed into each other at high speed, severely injuring the occupants.
custom_automobile_accident_type_wall_cra: an out-of-control automobile crashed into a wall at high speeds, killing the driver.
custom_automobile_accident_type_wall_per: an automobile struck a man who was crossing the street, killing him.
custom_automobile_accident_type_river: an automobile veered off the road and into a nearby river.
technology_events.10.d: It has been suggested that by establishing a cross border telephone exchange with [SCOPE.sC('telephone_neighbour').GetName], we could improve relations more easily.
technology_events.20.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('radio_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('radio_ruler').GetFullName] has decided to use the new and exciting radio technology to connect more directly with the people.
technology_events.20.b: It should make us look good.
technology_events.20.c: Let me tell you about this new wonder drug.
technology_events.30.d: An article has been published by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] about some of the weapons which our country uses in the ongoing [SCOPE.sWar('ongoing_war').GetName] war.
technology_events.30.f: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('war_weapons_article')] Members of the public are calling for the use of such weapons to be restricted.\n\n
custom_weapon_article_machine_gun: The article focuses on the machine gun, a terrifying weapon which tears through flesh and bone at an almost inhuman rate.
custom_weapon_article_chemical_weapons: The article focuses on the use of chlorine gas, a terrifying weapon.
technology_events.40.d: It has been suggested that we take and distribute some pictures of our country's most famous landmarks.
technology_events.50.d: Soldiers are complaining that they have no way to open their canned food.
technology_events.50.a: Spend some money to develop a way.
expedition_events.501.d: Despite hundreds of years of searching, the source of the Nile still eludes us. Shall we send an expedition to attempt to plot the course of the river?
expedition_events.501.a: I know the person for the job.
expedition_events.504.d: After a few weeks of preparation and travel, the expedition led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has arrived in Zanzibar. From here they will begin their journey to discover the elusive source of the Nile river.
expedition_events.511.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has returned triumphantly, the source of the Nile River has been discovered. It turns out that the source is the great lakes of Africa.
expedition_events.512.d: After not receiving any reports for many months, it has become clear that the expedition to the heart of Africa has failed and [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has been lost along with it.
central_africa_expedition: Expedition to Find the Source of the Nile
central_africa_expedition_desc: The center of the African continent holds the secret to the source of the Nile.
modifier_central_africa_expedition_compl: Found the Source of the Nile
expedition_events.520.d: A local ruler has requested that you pay an extra 'Hongo', a type of tax, for passing through their land.
expedition_events.530.d: One of the pack mules we brought has wandered off into the undergrowth. We could spend some time tracking it down or simply move on.
expedition_events.530.a: Spend some time looking for the mule.
expedition_events.530.b: It's just one mule, leave it.
expedition_events.540.d: A rhinoceros has been sighted nearby, we could stop the expedition for a short while to try and claim its horn as a prize.
expedition_events.541.d: We successfully hunted the rhinoceros, bringing back its horn as a trophy.
expedition_events.542.d: A member of the expedition was hurt in the failed rhinoceros hunt and some time will need to be spent getting them back to good health.
expedition_events.550.t: A Beetle in Hand Is Worth Two in the Ear
expedition_events.550.d: A beetle has crawled into the ear of [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName]. Without immediate medical help this could impede the expedition's progress.
expedition_events.550.a: We shall stop and get proper help.
expedition_events.550.b: We cannot stop, give [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetHerHim] the knife.
expedition_events.560.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] is demanding that we halt the expedition and wait for more supplies of [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetCustom('drug_type')] to come in.
expedition_events.560.a: We will stop and wait for more to arrive.
expedition_events.560.b: We will go on without it
expedition_events.570.d: It has been suggested that we stop and undertake a geographical study of the area to increase our local knowledge.
modifier_expedition_geographic_study_des: Whilst trying to determine the source of the Nile river, some time was taken to study the geographical area.
expedition_event_peril_tt: This could #tooltippable;negative_value;TOOLTIP:expedition_peril_explanation_tt negatively #!affect the outcome of the expedition.
expedition_peril_explanation_tt: As you take more risks on an expedition it becomes increasingly perilous, leading to a greater chance of failure.
crime_events.1.d: A spate of train robberies have been committed by daring gangs all across [SCOPE.sState('train_robbery_state').GetName], threatening law, order, and the purses of the wealthy all across the state.
crime_events.1.a: Our marshals will make short work of them.
crime_events.1.b: Who cares about a train or two?
crime_events.2.d: Criminal organizations have begun operating in [SCOPE.sState('organised_crime_state').GetName].
crime_events.2.a: Put some funds into stamping out the organizations.
crime_events.2.b: I'm sure the authorities can handle it.
crime_events.10.d: The [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] newspaper reports a series of horrific murders in [SCOPE.sState('serial_killer_state').GetName]. According to the article, the police are powerless to stop the murderer who they dub the [SCOPE.sState('serial_killer_state').GetCityHubName] Ripper.
crime_events.10.f: The ragged old market is full of police lights and pickpockets. The corpse lays face down on the street. There's a long, dark stain that has been following it like a patient hunter all night. The inspector moves closer. Long dried. The red becomes lighter near the head.\n\n
crime_events.10.a: We must bring the killer to justice.
crime_events.11.d: The killer known as the [SCOPE.sState('serial_killer_state_scope').GetCityHubName] Ripper, who has long plagued the state of [SCOPE.sState('serial_killer_state_scope').GetName], has finally been arrested.
crime_events.11.d2: The killer known as the [SCOPE.sState('serial_killer_state_scope').GetCityHubName] Ripper, who has long plagued the state of [SCOPE.sState('serial_killer_state_scope').GetName], has finally been arrested. Shockingly, these horrific crimes were committed by none other than [SCOPE.sCharacter('important_killer').GetFullName]!
crime_events.11.f: The inspector grips his walking stick fiercely; he hardly smiles. The face of the culprit is dimly lit by the cell light. From this distance, he resembles one of the inspector's childhood friends, his cousin, every other police man.\n\nHe doesn't even lift his head when they serve him some bland porridge.
crime_events.11.b: This secret must go to our graves.
crime_events.12.d: Police in [SCOPE.sState('serial_killer_state_scope').GetName] have received a letter allegedly written by the [SCOPE.sState('serial_killer_state_scope').GetCityHubName] Ripper. This cryptic note might hold the key to uncovering his identity.
crime_events.13.d: Several more corpses in [SCOPE.sState('serial_killer_state_scope').GetName] have been identified as victims of the [SCOPE.sState('serial_killer_state_scope').GetCityHubName] Ripper. Careful and committed investigation may yield clues as to the killer's identity.
crime_events.13.f: The corpse is laying face down again. There's a long, dark stain that has dried up overnight. The inspector moves closer. The insides of the victim are scattered around the place like a meat salad.\n\n
custom_disembowled: the killer disembowels them, removing some organs and placing them in a circle around the body.
custom_face_removed: the killer takes their face clean off, it is not a pretty sight.
custom_surgical: the killer makes clear and precise cuts, we're sure they must have some surgical training.
custom_crocodile: large inhuman bites taken out of them. It can't be an animal though because we found footprints.
custom_strangled: the killer strangles each of them as they sleep, then they're discovered the next morning.
custom_stabbed: stabbed hundreds of times, until they're almost unrecognizable.
natural_disaster_events.1.d: An earthquake has hit the state of [SCOPE.sState('earthquake_state').GetName], destroying buildings, injuring people and even taking some lives.
natural_disaster_events.1.a: The state will have to figure it out on their own.
natural_disaster_events.1.b: We should put some more money into relief.
natural_disaster_events.2.d: The local river banks have burst in [SCOPE.sState('flood_state').GetName] destroying homes and taking lives.
natural_disaster_events.2.a: The state will have to figure it out on their own.
natural_disaster_events.2.b: We should put some more money into relief.
natural_disaster_events.3.d: The river banks have burst all across the state of [SCOPE.sState('mega_flood_state').GetName], destroying homes and taking lives on an unprecedented scale.
natural_disaster_events.3.a: The state will have to deal with it on their own.
natural_disaster_events.3.b: We should put some more money into relief.
natural_disaster_events.4.d: The state of [SCOPE.sState('mega_earthquake_state').GetName] has been reduced to ruins by an earthquake of unprecedented scale. Countless buildings have been destroyed and the amount of lives lost is impossible to tell.
natural_disaster_events.4.a: The state will have to deal with it on their own.
natural_disaster_events.4.b: We should put some more money into relief.
natural_disaster_events.5.d: The state of [SCOPE.sState('crop_fail_state').GetName] has been struck by a blight. Crops are dying left and right and the harvest is sure to be less than expected this year.
natural_disaster_events.5.b: We will help how we can.
natural_disaster_events.6.d: A cyclone has hit the state of [SCOPE.sState('cyclone_state').GetName] from the sea, tearing through homes and people alike.
natural_disaster_events.6.a: A tragedy, but what can be done?
natural_disaster_events.6.b: We should put some more money into relief.
historical_events.1.d: The first heavier-than-air flight has been achieved! This technology will pave the way for the future of aviation.
notification_first_flight_desc: The first heavier-than-air flight has taken place.
warlord_china_events.100.d: The fall of the Qing dynasty has ended China's long standing period of imperial rule and ushered in a new age of warlordism.
warlord_china_events.110.d: It is at risk of becoming public knowledge that [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_killing_warlord').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_killing_warlord').GetFullName] entertains [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_killing_warlord')GetHerselfHimself] by smashing in the skulls of prisoners with a sword.
notification_ig_leader_steps_down_desc: [SCOPE.sCharacter('stepping_down_leader').GetFullName], the leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('stepping_down_leader_ig').GetName], has stepped down [SCOPE.sCharacter('stepping_down_leader').GetCustom('stepping_down_reason')]
custom_loc_family: to spend more time with family.
assassination_events.5.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetFullName] has been assassinated by an individual associated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('suspicious_ig').GetName]. Authorities were aware of a plot but unable to stop it.
travelling_verb_wrong_turn: took a wrong turn on the way to the
travelling_verb_speech: was giving a speech at the
travelling_verb_stopped: was stopped on the way to the
assassin_description_mkc: a wild eyed Michigan born man
assassin_movement_shadows: stepped out of the shadows and
fatal_injury_gunshot_heart: shot the [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_target').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] straight through the heart,
fatal_injury_gunshot_dead_guard: fired several shots, killing a guard and hitting the [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_target').GetPrimaryRoleTitle],
fatal_injury_bomb_thrown: threw a bomb, which detonated right next to the [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_target').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]
assassination_aftermath_caught: Luckily the assassin was quickly detained.
assassination_aftermath_cyanide_fail: The assassin tried to take a cyanide pill but failed.
assassination_aftermath_cyanide_success: The assassin took their own life with a cyanide pill.
assassination_aftermath_escape: The assassin managed to escape in the chaos.
assassination_aftermath_shout: It is reported the assassin shouted something but exactly what they shouted is not clear.
assassination_aftermath_film: The whole assassination was caught on film.
assassination_aftermath_river: The assassin tried to dive into the nearby river but found it was only a few feet deep.
assassination_aftermath_shot: The assassin was shot to death shortly after.
assassination_aftermath_helpers: The assassin was rumored to have had inside help.
assassination_sewer_escape: The assassin managed to escape through the sewers.
central_america.2.d: The remaining states of the union have declared their independence. It has become clear that the union of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is over, and that [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetName] must fend for itself.
central_america.2.b: We will not abandon the union so lightly.
congo_free_state_events.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetFullName] has declared that this land will now be a free state under [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetHerHis] control in a personal union with our country.
congo_free_state_events.1.f: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetHerHis] face paralyzed in a static smile, like a marble statue. [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetSheHe|U] talks with a velvet voice that makes the walls turn red and cozy:
congo_free_state_events.1.a: We should keep an eye on this.
congo_free_state_events.2.d: There has been talk in governmental circles that the [SCOPE.sCountry('free_state').GetNameNoFlag] owned by [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetFullName] has not been treating its people very well.
congo_free_state_events.3.d: Both missionaries and laymen have expressed their deepest concern about the increasing number of deaths in the [SCOPE.sCountry('free_state').GetNameNoFlag].
congo_free_state_events.3.a: We cannot go against the rule of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
congo_free_state_events.3.b: This is a massacre! The world must know!
je_free_state_status: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] has declared the creation of the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] in a personal union with our country. We should keep an eye on this situation and see how it develops.
je_free_state_goal: Escalate the Free State conflict to request the aid of the international community.
integrate_free_state_desc: The Free State should be reintegrated into the country. However we need a good reason to do so.
integrate_free_state_international_opini: International Opinion of Free State is poor.
modifier_denied_monarch_colony_country_d: The Monarch was denied a Free State they claimed.
modifier_denied_monarch_colony_ig_desc: The Monarch was denied a Free State they claimed.
congo_free_state_events.4.d: A damning article has been written in the [SCOPE.sCountry('newspaper_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] '[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')]' about atrocities being committed in the [SCOPE.sCountry('free_state').GetNameNoFlag].
congo_free_state_events.4.a: Unfortunate, but it belongs to the [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
congo_free_state_events.5.d: After the disappearance of the monarchy, it has become clear that the [SCOPE.sCountry('free_state').GetNameNoFlag] is a relic of the past. We could reintegrate the state now following a new direction under the [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
congo_free_state_events.5.d2: International opinion of the [SCOPE.sCountry('free_state').GetNameNoFlag] has turned very sour after its atrocities have been revealed. We could reintegrate the state now with very little push back from the [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
congo_free_state_events.5.f2: That all of this has happened under the approval of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] is blatantly ridiculous. To think that a [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetWomanMan] can own a whole nation like [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetSheHe] owns a house in the countryside is our deepest and most ludicrous error.\n\nDeaths and massacres and famines. All in the name of personal profit—and morbid joy.
congo_free_state_events.5.b: Perhaps it is time for it to be a truly 'Free' state.
congo_free_state_events.6.d: A report has been released by the [SCOPE.sCountry('report_country').GetAdjective] government about the [SCOPE.sCountry('free_state').GetNameNoFlag], unveiling the terrible acts that have been carried out by the local administration.
congo_free_state_events.6.b: Unfortunate, but it belongs to the [SCOPE.sCharacter('free_state_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
free_state_international_opinion_tooltip: International Opinion is against the free state.
free_state_monarch_dead_tooltip: The monarch who created the Free State is no longer reigning.
free_state_immediate_tooltip: Triggers the Event #bold The Free State#!.
abolish_tangena_ordeal_desc: The Tangena Ordeal consists of consuming poison to prove one's innocence. Regardless of the veracity of the practice, it claims a significant number of lives every year and should be abolished.
stop_paying_france_desc: Following the 1825 French military expedition to Haiti, the Senate made a deal with France to pay compensation for recognition of our independence. However, if we stop paying, what could they possibly do about it?
character_events.2.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('university_benefactor').GetFullName] has offered to spend some of their personal wealth to fund the creation of a University in [SCOPE.sState('university_state').GetName]. Though this will likely give the [SCOPE.sCharacter('university_benefactor').GetInterestGroup.GetName] some influence.
character_events.2.b: No, we can't give them a platform.
character_events.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('duel_participant_1').GetFullName] has challenged [SCOPE.sCharacter('duel_participant_2').GetFullName] to a duel to the death.
character_events.3.f: The aura surrounding their two figures is like something out of a romantic novel. [SCOPE.sCharacter('duel_participant_2').GetFullNameNoFormatting] smiles. [SCOPE.sCharacter('duel_participant_2').GetSheHe|U] has been rehearsing this moment before falling asleep.\n\n
opium_insult_custom: you are an opium obsessed addict.
banned_duels_tt: Duels will be banned in your country.
character_events.4.d: It has been revealed that [SCOPE.sCharacter('devout_scandal').GetFullName] of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('devout_scandal').GetInterestGroup.GetName] has been having a secret affair with a member of the clergy. [SCOPE.sCharacter('devout_scandal').GetHerHis|U] resignation is being demanded.
character_events.5.d: A statue of [SCOPE.sCharacter('statue_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('statue_ruler').GetFullName] was commissioned and it has been suggested that it be displayed proudly in [SCOPE.sState('statue_state').GetName].
character_events.5.b: Perhaps not everyone wishes to be reminded of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('statue_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
modifier_ig_disapprove_of_no_statue: Disapproves of Monarch Statue Not Being Raised
modifier_ig_approve_of_no_statue: Approves of Monarch Statue Not Being Raised
modifier_ig_approve_statue_removal: Approves of Monarch Statue Being Removed
modifier_ig_approve_no_statue_removal: Approves of Not Removing Monarch Statue
character_events.6.d: A statue of the old monarch stands in [SCOPE.sState('statue_state').GetName]. Some are suggesting it should be torn down.
character_events.6.a: Tear down the symbols of the old world.
character_events.6.b: It is important we don't forget our history.
character_events.6.c: We shall relocate it to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] to keep an eye on it.
MULTIPLAYER_GUI_CLICK_TO_SELECT: Click on a country to select it.
diplomatic_friction.1.d: We will support the workers in [SCOPE.sCountry('rival_scope').GetName], boosting the power of their trade unions.
diplomatic_friction.2.d: Our soldiers regularly perform maneuvers near the border of [SCOPE.sCountry('rival_scope').GetName]. Having our troops parade all over the border as it were nothing to them could be a useful display of power, especially if we frame it as an 'accident'.
diplomatic_friction.2.a.tt: One of the following will happen:
diplomatic_friction.3.d: Soldiers from [SCOPE.sCountry('rival_scope').GetName] have crossed our borders. When confronted they claimed that they got lost. If we don't respond it could be seen as weakness.
diplomatic_friction.20.d: Our rival [SCOPE.sCountry('rival_scope').GetName] continues to practice slavery. We could easily condemn them on the world stage for this.
diplomatic_friction.20.b: We don't want to upset them.
je_plastics_reason: The applications of plastic go far beyond just glass, who knows what the next application we will discover is.
production_tech_events.200.d: The switch to plastic in our Glassworks is set to revolutionize the industry.
production_tech_events.1.c: Some of lads have found a 'different' application for it.
je_radio_reason: Giving people mass access to Radio allows for information to be spread far and wide without any of the difficulty or peculiarities of a newspaper.
production_tech_events.210.d: The production of radios in our factories has led to a boom in employment and profit.
ig_suppression_events.1000.d: We have hired unscrupulous journalists to write damning articles about the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('negative_article_ig').GetName], harming their reputation.
ig_suppression_events.1000.f: The reporter for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] twiddled his thumbs nervously,
ig_suppression_events.1000.a.1: The pen #BOLD is#! mightier than the lord.
ig_suppression_events.1000.a.2: The pen #BOLD is#! mightier than the gourd.
ig_suppression_events.1000.a.3: The pen #BOLD is#! mightier than the sword.
ig_suppression_events.1000.a.4: The pen #BOLD is#! mightier than the board.
ig_suppression_events.1000.c: Why pay when we own the newspaper?
ig_suppression_events.1001.d: By intimidating the members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('suppressed_ig').GetName] we can make actively supporting them a much less appealing prospect.
ig_suppression_events.1001.a: If he can't walk how will he get to the polling station?
ig_suppression_events.1001.c: We're well equipped for this sort of thing.
ig_suppression_events.1003.d: By eliminating [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_ig_leader').GetFullName], the leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName], we could stop their momentum in its tracks.
notification_ig_leader_assassination_des: [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_ig_leader').GetFullName] the leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName] was successfully assassinated
notification_ig_leader_assassination_fai: The attempt to assassinate the leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName] has failed.
je_central_archives_reason: By making a change as simple as how we store documents it is possible to revolutionize our entire organizational system.
dan_society_tech_events.1.d: The use of filing cabinets in the [SCOPE.sBuilding('government_building').GetName] has drastically increased the effectiveness of state bureaucracy.
je_war_nursing_reason: Disease is running rampant amongst the war wounded in the [SCOPE.sWar('ongoing_journal_war').GetName] war. The facilities to deal with the wounded are overwhelmed. We need to reduce the levels of disease somehow or more will die.
nursing_events.1.d: The deaths from disease amongst the wounded soldiers has skyrocketed.
nursing_events.1.b: Offload some of the strain to the civilian medical sector.
for_duration_of_war_tt: For the duration of the war...
nursing_events.2.d: It has been suggested by some of the nurses working on the frontlines of the [SCOPE.sWar('ongoing_war').GetName] war, that by adopting new cleanliness procedures we could reduce the number of deaths.
nursing_events.3.d: It has been suggested that a prefabricated hospital be constructed and then transported to just behind the frontlines of the [SCOPE.sWar('ongoing_war').GetName] war to help treat the wounded.
nursing_events.3.b: These resources are better put into research.
nursing_events.4.d: A group of experienced nurses has reformed the practices at the [SCOPE.sWar('complete_nursing_war').GetName] war front resulting in markedly less deaths.
nursing_events.4.a: What a revolution for the medical profession.
free_speech_laws.1.d: A pamphlet in favor of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has been circulated illegally across most of our major cities.
free_speech_laws.1.b: We could use this to push a stronger message
free_speech_laws.2.d: Members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('book_burning_ig').GetName] have organized book burnings of material deemed anti-[ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting]. This is normalizing support for the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
free_speech_laws.2.b: What if we organized state run book burnings?
free_speech_laws.3.d: The [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law is having trouble gaining popular support as references to it are being suppressed by the current censorship apparatus.
free_speech_laws.3.b: Maybe we can skirt the laws a bit.
free_speech_laws.4.d: We are having trouble drumming up support for the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('free_speech_ig').GetName] are using the current lax laws to print and circulate thousands of propaganda leaflets and newspapers.
free_speech_laws.4.a: This is out of our hands.
free_speech_laws.4.b: We could censor some of it... illegally
free_speech_laws.5.d: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has been caught reading a controversial censored book, sparking further questions over the debate about the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
free_speech_laws.5.a: Embarrassing, but this supports our cause!
free_speech_laws.5.b: We should make this go away as quickly as possible.
free_speech_laws.6.d: A rude drawing of [SCOPE.sCharacter('ig_leader_scope').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('free_speech_ig').GetName] has been distributed around the country.
rights_of_women_laws.1.d: In a legal case that has grabbed the attention of the whole country a judge has ruled that domestic violence is grounds for divorce.
rights_of_women_laws.1.b: Let us not celebrate too loudly in case we upset the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anti_women_ig').GetName].
rights_of_women_laws.2.d: A popular set of travel writings by a female author have been published, lending support for the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
rights_of_women_laws.2.a: What a great boon for our cause.
rights_of_women_laws.2.b: Maybe we could get a bigger publisher.
rights_of_women_laws.3.d: A recently published paper on 'Hysteria in Women' has been gaining traction in the medical community. The paper is being used as anti-women's rights propaganda against the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
rights_of_women_laws.3.b: Maybe we can do our own research?
rights_of_women_laws.3.c: Take the time to release a comprehensive rebuttal.
rights_of_women_laws.4.d: The editor of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] has come forward and offered to support the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law if we help them out with some funding.
rights_of_women_laws.5.d: Rallies in support of the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law have been taking place around the country, but some of them have been turning violent.
rights_of_women_laws.5.b: We will risk a little violence.
rights_of_women_laws.6.d: Violence by a small group within the suffragist movement is threatening to turn the general population against it.
rights_of_women_laws.6.b: We need to shut this down.
womens_rights_fringe_group_violence_stop: Fringe Women Rights Group Violence Stopped
rights_of_women_laws.7.d: A grand suffrage protest is meant to take place at factories across the country. It will increase the popularity of the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law but would likely upset many workers.
create_peru_bolivia_confederation_desc: There is growing support in Bolivia for a reunited Bolivia and Peru. We could reach out to Peru and see if they would be interested in such an arrangement.
south_america.4.d: The Peruvians have accepted our suggestion to combine our nations and we are now in a confederation with them.
south_america.4.a.tt: Bolivia and Peru enter a confederation together.
central_america_falls_apart_reason: The Central American States are crying out for independence. Will we give it to them? Soon, they will give us an ultimatum.
ragamuffin_war_reason: Rebels in Rio Grande do Sul are demanding independence, and are willing to pay for it with their blood.
south_america.5.d: Despite the overwhelming odds, Piratini has managed to win the Ragamuffin war, and with it their independence.
south_america.6.d: As expected, the Ragamuffin Rebellion has been crushed. How shall we treat the remaining survivors?
free_state_status_new: The Free State was recently established, only time will tell how it will develop.
free_state_status_suspected: Rumors of foul treatment hang above the Free State like a bad odour. International journalists have threatened to release articles about its conditions.
free_state_status_known: The atrocities committed in the Free State are known by the world at large. It is only a matter of time that an international report will be issued.
je_free_state_reason: The Free State is a colony personally owned by the Monarch.
free_state_journal_complete_tt: The Free State does not exist, or is not your subject.
council_republic_law_events.1.d: A particularly charismatic political science intellectual has given a speech on the benefits of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], which has been met with great enthusiasm.
council_republic_law_events.1.b: Maybe their natural charisma can inspire some loyalty.
council_republic_law_events.2.d: A group of workers are said to have revolted against their bosses and taken control of a factory in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName].
council_republic_law_events.2.a: Let's see how this plays out.
council_republic_law_events.2.b: We need to shut this down.
council_republic_law_events.2.c: This is the beginning of an authentic revolution!
council_republic_law_events.3.d: The headquarters of the communist party has burnt down. The organizational loss from this has seriously set them back.
council_republic_law_events.3.b: I'm sure we could put them up somewhere.
council_republic_law_events.3.c: This is a valid casus belli against the reactionaries.
oscar_wilde_events.1.t: Each Man Kills the Thing He Loves
oscar_wilde_events.1.wilde: The infamous dandy playwright [SCOPE.sCharacter('oscar_wilde').GetFullName] has been sentenced to two years of hard labor on a charge of homosexuality. If [SCOPE.sCharacter('oscar_wilde').GetSheHe] doesn't receive a pardon, we may as well have sentenced the arts in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] along with [SCOPE.sCharacter('oscar_wilde').GetHerHim].
oscar_wilde_events.1.flavor_quote: The books that the world calls immoral are books that show the world its own shame.
oscar_wilde_events.1.b: We cannot be seen undermining our judges' verdicts.
oscar_wilde_events.1.c: It is barbaric for this to be a criminal act at all...
congo_river_expedition_desc: The heart of the African continent remains a mystery for many. We shall launch an expedition to plot the course of the Congo River.
modifier_congo_river_expedition_complete: Mapped the Course of the Congo River
expedition_events.601.d: An expedition has been set to explore the Lualaba and Congo Rivers.
expedition_events.601.f: A number of experts in different fields has been gathered to take part in the expedition to the very heart of nature. Their youthful enthusiasm is quietly blended with the prudent fear that our most veteran explorers feel towards the uncharted continent.
expedition_events.603.d: How much money would you like to assign to the expedition budget?
expedition_events.604.d: After a few weeks of preparations and travel, the expedition led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has arrived at the mouth of the Congo. From here they will begin their journey to plot the course of this elusive river.
expedition_events.611.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has returned triumphantly, the course and source of the Congo River have been plotted.
expedition_events.612.d: After not receiving any reports for many months, it has become clear that the expedition to plot the course of the Congo River has failed and [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has been lost along with it.
expedition_events.612.d2: After not receiving any reports for many months, the fate of the expedition seemed clear; however, a letter from [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] finally arrived this morning, confessing that the only way to live was to come back.
expedition_events.620.d: Our boat has been damaged by an unnoticed boulder while trying to navigate one of the river's most slender meanders in [SCOPE.sState('current_expedition_location').GetName].
expedition_events.620.a: We need to stop and take care of it.
expedition_events.620.b: We cannot afford to lose any time.
expedition_events.620.c: We can easily manage to repair it in a couple of days.
expedition_events.630.d: At dawn, the expedition wakes up to find a dense white fog surrounding them, greatly impairing their vision.
expedition_events.630.a: We should ignore it and continue our journey.
expedition_events.630.b: It is not safe to set sail in these conditions.
expedition_events.640.d: While navigating the river, one of our men is irremediably dragged down while checking the conditions of the hull.
expedition_events.641.d: After an interminable minute of fighting, our man manages to block the crocodile's jaws with a wooden plank and rapidly get back on board.
expedition_events.642.d: After an interminable minute of fighting, nature proves inescapable.
expedition_events.650.d: We arrived at a missionary camp, finding there the food and rest we had been craving. The lack of aliments during our journey has tempted a man to request the division of the expedition.
expedition_events.650.a: We cannot ensure the feeding of our all men.
expedition_events.651.d: Letters have been sent to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] by the few honorable men that are still left alive behind us. The Rear Column has turned into the gloomy circle of some Inferno.
expedition_events.651.a: The name of the expedition has been stained.
expedition_events.652.d: A mutiny has been raised by the men that had demanded the division of the expedition.
expedition_events.660.d: The expedition has reached an Arabian outpost of trading merchants, who have offered to exchange their food for part of our ammunition and weapons.
expedition_event_decreasing_peril_tt: This will #tooltippable;TOOLTIP:expedition_peril_explanation_tt reduce #!the current peril of the expedition.
expedition_events.670.d: Our estimations had not taken into account the difficulties that the [SCOPE.sState('current_expedition_location').GetName] forest would cause to our expedition. The two months that we had devoted to this region of the Congo are most likely to be doubled.
expedition_events.670.a: It is necessary that we ration our food.
expedition_events.670.b: We are closer to the end.
expedition_events.680.d: While walking through the forest of [SCOPE.sState('current_expedition_location').GetName], the expedition follows the rumor of water currents until reaching uncharted waterfalls.
expedition_events.680.a: From now on, they shall be known as the [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetLastName] Falls.
expedition_events.690.d: The expedition has stopped their journey through [SCOPE.sState('current_expedition_location').GetName] at a local village, where [SCOPE.sCharacter('local_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('local_ruler').GetFullName] has kindly offered a gift exchange as a token of peace.
expedition_events.690.a: We shall correspond this considerate gift.
expedition_events.690.b: We have no time to lose fraternizing with locals.
urbanization_events.1.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialist_ig').GetName] have expressed their satisfaction with the direction being taken by the country and its newly built factories.
urbanization_events.1.a: We've done this for our people.
urbanization_events.1.b: And we shall support that train.
je_urbanization_events_1_reason: A nation of peasants is a nation of the past. How can we expect progress to arrive at our homes if those homes are no more than farms?
je_urbanization_events_2_reason: The future is not white or black, like the old tales say—it's gray! The color of the train that lets us visit foreign lands! The color of the factory that lets us pay for such a travel! The color, my friend, of progress.
urbanization_events.2.d: The most prominent members of [SCOPE.sState('urbanization_state').GetName] high society have been seen organizing luxurious parties in the new and lavish urban buildings.
urbanization_events.4.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('opposing_ig').GetName] have expressed their concerns about government decisions clearly favoring the interests of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialist_ig').GetName].
urbanization_events.4.b: They need to accept that we cannot always please everyone.
urbanization_events.5.d: [SCOPE.sState('urbanization_state').GetName] has come a long way since our attention was first brought to it, going from small houses and scattered farmlands to being on its way to become a blooming metropolis.
urbanization_events.5.f: The woman sighs, her old hands stop crocheting for a second.
urbanization_events.6.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialist_ig').GetName] have started complaining about the wasteful inefficiency of Subsistence Farms in [SCOPE.sState('subsistence_state').GetName].
urbanization_events.6.a: It won't matter if everyone comes to the city.
urbanization_events.6.b: Then we should modernise the farms.
urbanization_events.6.c: Looks like the perfect ground for an army base.
marx_events.1.d: The increasing wealth disparity among our society has become as injurious and clear as a scythe's edge. A pamphlet named
marx_events.1.a: Our people could benefit from these teachings.
marx_events.1.b: Unite, indeed! We have nothing to lose but our chains!
marx_events.1.c: We want nothing to do with this insurgent individual.
je_sol_goal_desc: Improve the [concept_sol] in your country by 3.
je_sol_1_reason: The lower classes have raised their concerns about not being able to afford a dignified life.
je_sol_invalid_desc: Has dismissed the poverty protests in the $Signs of the Times$ event.
sol_events.1.d: A woman has started a protest in the center of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], stating that her children have nothing to eat but rats. People have gathered around her, joining her desperate pleas.
sol_events.1.a: No one deserves a life like that.
sol_events.1.b: Poverty is just a fact of life.
sol_events.2.desc: The living conditions of our people have been steadily increasing during these past times, bringing hope to the most dispirited parts of our cities—even so, we still have a long way to go.
sol_events.2.a: Our people shall never forget what we've done for them.
sol_events.2.b: This will help us advance even further!
sol_events.2.c: The satisfaction of their welfare is enough for us.
sol_events.3.d: Members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_devout').GetName] have been seen walking around the slums of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], offering some charity food to the poor. However, they now request state funding for their efforts.
sol_events.3.a: It is a good cause to support.
sol_events.3.b: We do not need them holding any more power.
sol_events.4.d: Housing in the slums of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] has reached such a miserable state that whole families have been reported to live on the stairs of several buildings
sol_events.5.d: A [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] article about the living conditions in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName]'s slums has been released to the public. The consequent outrage, of course, did not take long to spread.
sol_events.5.a: This place needs to be sanitized as soon as possible.
sol_events.6.d: The shortage of food supplies and the low—if not nonexistent—wages in the slums have led to a series of riots among the women in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], where they have vandalized several storefronts.
sol_events.6.a: We can surely find something to give them.
sol_events.6.b: They shall pay for their own food like everyone else.
je_telephone: Expand the Applications of the Telephone
je_telephone_reason: With the invention of the telephone we must build up the industrial capacity to mass-produce this new electric innovation.
production_tech_events.300.d: The invention of the telephone has opened the door to great improvements in our communications... or in our electricity industry.
production_tech_events.300.b: Just write a letter! Electricity is for the industry!
je_whaling_reason: Whale oil is our past and will be our future! Soap, fuel for oil lamps, even the important lubrication of our machines—this polyvalent substance covers all of these needs.
production_tech_events.301.d: The efficiency of our [SCOPE.sBuilding('whaling_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('whaling_state').GetName] has proved to have a dangerous counterpart and death has become common to almost every voyage. It is a high price to pay, but the profit is equally high.
production_tech_events.301.f: The body of the whale lies as wide as the sky. Its head has been emptied and the barrels of oil are stained with blood.\n\nA voice resounds throughout the wharf,
production_tech_events.301.a: We need to ensure the safety of the sailors.
je_ig_suppression_1_reason: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName] has become too powerful for their own good, given the opinion they hold of us, and are threatening our peaceful government.
je_ig_suppression_1_invalidad_desc: Has dismissed the help offered in the $With Friends Like These...$ event.
je_ig_suppression_status_1: Rumors have been spread about the immoral acts of the leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName], undermining their reputation.
je_ig_suppression_status_2: The leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName] has decided to step down after the rumors about immoral acts.
je_ig_suppression_status_3: The leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName] has been imprisoned due to their resistance to peacefully step down.
ig_suppression_events.1.d: The powerful clout that the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('suppressed_ig').GetName] hold has become a menacing presence over our government. One of our agents has approached us suggesting a... less conventional solution.
ig_suppression_tt: This will lead to events about diminishing the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('suppressed_ig').GetName]'s power.
dismissed_ig_suppression_tt: The opportunity is dismissed and we will suppress the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('suppressed_ig').GetName] through conventional means.
ig_suppression_events.2.d: Rumors about the sinful life of [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_leader').GetFullName], of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName], have been fabricated and are ready to be spread among the masses like wildfire.
ig_suppression_events.2.a: The best rumor can never be traced.
ig_suppression_events.2.b: This will feed more than one high-society ball.
ig_suppression_events.2.c: People in the suburbs are avid for some social ammunition.
ig_suppression_events.3.d: With the rumors about [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_leader').GetHerHis] way of life reaching all social strata and [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_leader').GetHerHis] reputation undermined, we can certainly persuade [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_leader').GetFullName] to step down from [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_leader').GetHerHis] position as the leader of [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName].
ig_suppression_events.3.a: A little blackmailing never killed nobody.
ig_suppression_events.3.b: Maybe we just need to make the scandal even bigger.
ig_suppression_events.4.d: Even after the tenacious efforts to undermine [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_leader').GetFullName]'s reputation, [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_leader').GetSheHe] has proved reluctant to step down. Harder measures need to be taken.
ig_suppression_events.4.f: The door is open again, this time there's no wind to alert you, no sound, no disturbance of life can be perceived in this safe room. But there he is again. The same soothing voice approaches you,
ig_suppression_events.4.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_leader').GetSheHe|U] just needs a little more convincing...
ig_suppression_events.4.c: This has indeed gone too far!
ig_suppression_events.7.d: Our efforts to undermine the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName]'s reputation have been extremely successful. With their influence now weakened it is time for us to attend to more important matters.
ig_suppression_events.7.a: People will know who to respect.
ig_suppression_events.7.b: We shall never let them forget who achieved this.
ig_suppression_events.7.c: A good moment to remind them about our laws.
je_famine_reason: A great crop failure has brought immeasurable suffering to our people, who beg for our government to take special measures in this matter.
je_famine_goal: Wait for the Famine to expire or raise the [concept_sol] in your nation by 3 points.
je_major_famines_success: Wait for the Famine to expire or raise the [concept_sol] in your nation by 3 points.
natural_disaster_events.7.d: A violent eruption has shaken the state of [SCOPE.sState('volcanic_state').GetName]. Fragments of tephra and volcanic ash have destroyed buildings and crops, taking some of the lives of our people.
natural_disaster_events.8.d: An eruption of unprecedented records has utterly destroyed the lives of many in the state of [SCOPE.sState('mega_volcanic_state').GetName]. The explosion could be heard from hundreds of miles away and anything that had the ill fate of surrounding the mountain was immediately devastated.
natural_disaster_events.8.a: Unfortunately, we have no funds to allocate.
natural_disaster_events.8.b: We absolutely need to help these people.
natural_disaster_variable_tt: There is a chance that a famine will occur in the upcoming months.
famine_events.1.d: Hunger has become a dangerous problem for our nation, as people from the state of [SCOPE.sState('famine_state').GetName] report that they have absolutely nothing to eat. An Emergency Relief measure has been requested.
famine_events.1.b: An Emergency Relief focus will be raised in [SCOPE.sState('famine_state').GetName].
emergency_relief_promise_tt: We will have to establish an Emergency Relief decree in [SCOPE.sState('famine_state').GetName].
famine_events.2.d: The lack of provisions has spread to the neighboring state of [SCOPE.sState('famine_2_state').GetName], where the failing of the crops has increased casualties among our people.
famine_events.2.a: Our Emergency Relief measures have toned down the number of victims.
famine_events.2.b: These are the consequences that we must face.
famine_events.2.c: We should activate the Emergency Relief in the original [SCOPE.sState('famine_state').GetName] now.
no_emergency_relief_tt: Famine spreads due to the lack of Emergency Relief.
famine_events.3.t: In Search of a Better Life
famine_events.3.d: People from the state of [SCOPE.sState('famine_state').GetName] have started massively migrating across the country, in the hopes of finding a better place to settle and escape the great famine that has been devastating their lives.
famine_events.3.a: Our Emergency Relief measures have toned down the number of victims.
famine_events.3.b: These are the consequences that we must face.
famine_events.3.c: We should activate the Emergency Relief in the original [SCOPE.sState('famine_state').GetName] now.
no_emergency_relief_migration_tt: People migrate more due to the lack of Emergency Relief.
famine_events.4.d: After receiving notice of the horrors that the citizens of [SCOPE.sState('famine_state').GetName] have been enduring, solidarity among the nations has been raised, and there are many who want to donate to the cause.
famine_events.4.a: We should accept the donations of [SCOPE.sC('neighbor_country_1').GetName].
famine_events.4.b: We should accept the donations of [SCOPE.sC('neighbor_country_2').GetName].
famine_events.4.c: We shall rely on internal donations.
ig_suppression_events.5.d: We have heard that the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName] have been holding some very interesting meetings in their headquarters, which we happen to know extremely well. We could certainly pay them a visit.
ig_suppression_events.5.a: Our agents will discreetly deal with this.
ig_suppression_events.5.c: Alas, if only they had a right of assembly...
ig_suppression_events.5.e: We don't need a reason to just disperse it.
ig_suppression_events.6.d: Rumors about the weak will of [SCOPE.sCharacter('suppressed_leader').GetFullName], of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('target').GetName], are more a fact than a suspicion. There are many ways in which one can take advantage of a weak opponent.
ig_suppression_events.6.a: Toss a coin to your leader.
je_airships_reason: New applications continue to be found for our latest technology, and dreams about navigable balloons could soon enough stop being dreams.
society_tech_events.301.d: The [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName] airship has been selected as the very special venue for an upper class ball. The most distinct members of the nation have expressed their opinions on this grandiose machine.
society_tech_events.301.a: Such a shameful eccentricity. This is a scouting war machine!
society_tech_events.301.b: Look at those velvet cushions! And the painted silk walls!
society_tech_events.301.c: If only all this space was used for goods instead of passengers...
je_romanticism_reason: The Romantic artistic movement advocates for the glorious past: knights, castles, pirates, forbidden nature and lost heroes. Its appealing nature must be swiftly spread.
society_tech_events.302.d: The [SCOPE.sBuilding('academy_building').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('academy_state').GetName] has experienced an increasing interest in the Romantic movement, with some of our greatest artists producing genuine masterpieces.
society_tech_events.302.a: We will show the world how Romanticism is done!
society_tech_events.302.b: These promising young men deserve every last penny.
society_tech_events.302.c: But could you make it a bit more... realistic?
je_fascism_1_reason: Whether it stems from foreign powers or from malcontents within our borders, the threat of socialism threatens to destroy the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation. We must all march under the same banner. We cannot forget who our leaders are, and how their strength represents our only defense against this threat.\n\nWhilst this [concept_journal_entry] is active, the rate at which #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],fascist_ideologies_list_tt Fascist#! characters appear will be increased.
fascism_1_tt: Has a #bold Fascist#! leader or agitator
fascist_characters_return_to_normal_tt: The rate at which #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],fascist_ideologies_list_tt Fascist#! characters appear will return to normal
fascist_characters_stays_increased_tt: The rate at which #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],fascist_ideologies_list_tt Fascist#! characters appear will remain elevated
fascism_events.1.d: Suspicions about an internal threat within our own generals and leaders have been on the rise, reaching [SCOPE.sCharacter('fascist_leader').GetFullName]'s ears, and the necessity of exterminating threats against the fascist regime is palpable. Hasty words, elusive looks, they are everywhere. Everywhere.
fascism_events.1.a: We must handle this with extreme caution.
night_of_the_long_knives.tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('fascist_ig').GetName] will only get $Fascist$ or $Integralist$ leaders.
fascism_to_jail_tt: Traitors to the regime will be sent to jail.
fascism_events.2.d: The fiery nationalistic speeches of [SCOPE.sCharacter('fascist_leader').GetFullName], an outspoken [SCOPE.sCharacter('fascist_leader').GetIdeology.GetName], seem to have captivated certain segments of our populace. More and more people have adopted the symbols and slogans of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('fascist_leader').GetIdeology.GetNameNoFormatting] movement.
je_fascism_2_reason: A safe country must be safe from within. Traitors and plotters can be everywhere, and we must be able to take care of them.
fascism_2_tt: Every Interest Group with a #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],socialist_ideologies_list_tt Socialist#! or [GetIdeology('ideology_radical').GetName] [concept_leader] is [concept_marginalized]
fascism_3_tt: Every #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],socialist_movements_list_tt Socialist#! or [GetIdeology('ideology_radical_movement').GetName] [concept_political_movement] is either #bold marginalized#! or being #bold suppressed#!
fascism_events.3.d: Our streets are a safe haven for our people, with security officers ensuring their safety night and day, and seditionists marginalized from our fascist government.
fascism_events.3.a: We need to focus on the security.
fascism_events.4.d: With fascist ideals taking root among other groups and discontent rising from the masses, members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('fascist_ig').GetName] have sought to influence the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('new_fascist_ig').GetName] into choosing more regime-aligned leaders.
fascism_events.4.a: Indeed, there is only one way.
fascism_events.4.c: Capitulation is death of a different kind.
fascism_leaders.tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('new_fascist_ig').GetName] will be much more likely to select Fascist leaders when [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure', '$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')] by an applicable [concept_political_movement].
conservative_leaders.tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('new_fascist_ig').GetName] will be much more likely to select Fascist, Traditionalist or Ethno-Nationalist leaders when [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure', '$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')] by an applicable [concept_political_movement].
generate_fascist_leader_tt: A [GetIdeology('ideology_fascist').GetName] [concept_politician] will assume leadership of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('new_fascist_ig').GetName]
generate_integralist_leader_tt: An [GetIdeology('ideology_integralist').GetName] [concept_politician] will assume leadership of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('new_fascist_ig').GetName]
generate_generically_chudded_leader_tt: A [GetIdeology('ideology_fascist').GetName], [GetIdeology('ideology_traditionalist').GetName], or [GetIdeology('ideology_ethno_nationalist').GetName] [concept_politician] will assume leadership of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('new_fascist_ig').GetName]
generate_brazilian_generically_chudded_l: An [GetIdeology('ideology_integralist').GetName], [GetIdeology('ideology_traditionalist').GetName], or [GetIdeology('ideology_ethno_nationalist').GetName] [concept_politician] will assume leadership of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('new_fascist_ig').GetName]
je_modernization_program_reason: A powerful country is powerful from the very pillars that sustain it. We must expand our infrastructure in order to expand our wealth.
je_modernization_program_tt: Infrastructure in the #bold capital#! is greater or equal to 150
fascism_events.5.d: The expansion of our nation's infrastructure has led to a more efficient and productive industry. Let this technological advancement be the first of many to come!
fascism_events.5.a: Our shipyards will ensure us a place in the sun.
fascism_events.5.b: We should use it to increase our construction speed.
fascism_events.6.d: A union among our people is not only possible, but a reality. All the citizens of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] are now united under the same banner, the same flag.
fascism_events.6.b: We shouldn't let this victory disperse us.
ethno_nationalist_leaders.tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ethno_nationalist_ig').GetName] will be much more likely to select Ethno-Nationalist leaders when [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure', '$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')] by an applicable [concept_political_movement].
ethno_conservative_leaders.tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ethno_nationalist_ig').GetName] will be much more likely to select Ethno-Nationalist, Fascist, or Traditionalist leaders when [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure', '$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')] by an applicable [concept_political_movement].
je_ethno_nationalist_reason: The homeland of our ancestors belongs to us, and to us it shall return.
ethnonationalist_tt: Has a #bold Ethno-Nationalist or Fascist#! leader
je_ethno_nationalist_tt: You own #bold all#! of your cultural homelands
fascism_events.8.d: A group of respectable musical composers teaching at the [SCOPE.sBuilding('anthem_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('anthem_state').GetName] have approached us. They have drawn attention to the alarming lack of a proper national anthem fit to invigorate our peoples' spirits.
second_line_rhyme_a_2: May all of our enemies shiver!\n
second_line_rhyme_b_1: Of this nation the proud defenders\n
third_line_rhyme_a_1: Born from the night and blessed by day,\n
third_line_rhyme_a_2: Hence our steps lead the way,\n
fourth_line_rhyme_a_1: To drive all our enemies away.
fourth_line_rhyme_a_2: Our fate will be completed today!
fourth_line_rhyme_b_1: Through the fire of the blade.
fascism_events.9.d: The departure of the previous leader of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_fascist_leader_scope').GetInterestGroup.GetName] has left a power vacuum in its leadership. It appears as if it will be filled by [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_fascist_leader_scope').GetFullName], an open [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_fascist_leader_scope').GetIdeology.GetName].
fascism_events.9.a: There is no reason to interfere.
fascism_events.9.b: This [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_fascist_leader_scope').GetWomanMan] must not be allowed near government.
fascism_government_remains_tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_fascist_leader_scope').GetFullName] will be allowed to take [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_fascist_leader_scope').GetHerHis] seat in government
fascism_government_expelled_tt: A [GetIdeology('ideology_moderate').GetName] [concept_politician] will assume leadership of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_fascist_leader_scope').GetInterestGroup.GetName]
no_relevant_reactionary_igs_tt: #bold no#! non-marginal [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] with #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],fascist_ideologies_list_tt Fascist#! [Concept('concept_leader', '$concept_leaders$')] or the [GetIdeology('ideology_reactionary').GetName] [concept_ideology]
fascism_events.10.d: The once-meteoric rise of the [GetIdeology('ideology_fascist').GetName] movement seems to have plateaued. Whilst the ideology is certain to remain, it will face a less receptive public, and a much more seasoned opposition.
fascism_events.10.f: There were those who had welcomed the rise of the fascist movement. It could be whatever they wished - laissez-faire, interventionist, paternalistic, libertarian, pious, secular. None of them had truly thought that its leaders believed in anything beyond dogged opposition to the communists, and every drop of blood spilled by a fascist truncheon was a drop that they would not need to shed themselves.\n\nPerhaps they still did welcome it, and its millenarian promises of clean streets and no Reds. But it was too serious, now, too familiar - and it had become too unpopular. Those who cared about credibility had learned to stay silent, and to offer their token condemnations of the violence when they needed to. It was a peculiar aberration from the mean, they said, one that that had run its course. And that was all there was to it.
fascism_events.11.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('fascist_leader').GetFullName] has declared [SCOPE.sCharacter('fascist_leader').GetHerHis] intention to march on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], in the name of seizing power over [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('fascist_leader').GetHerHis|U] supporters are amassing at the outskirts of the city.
fascism_events.11.b: We have every right to halt this coup.
existent_fascist_character_tt: The #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],fascist_ideologies_list_tt Fascist#! movement has a [concept_character] to rally behind
decree_events.1.d: The excellent state of our road networks has attracted engineers from all over our nation that now want to work with us in various interesting ways.
decree_events.1.a: A better drainage system should be our priority.
decree_events.1.b: This promising young man offers us a cheaper alternative.
decree_events.1.c: Stone foundations you say? Risky, but great!
decree_events.1.e: We don't need to listen to these fraudsters.
decree_events.2.d: Better road networks have led to an increase in the [SCOPE.sState('decree_state').GetName]'s traffic, followed by a consequential increase in pollution.
decree_events.2.a: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ecology_ig').GetName] has suggested that immediate measures must be taken.
decree_events.2.b: Nothing that a mountain trip cannot solve.
decree_events.3.d: A lowborn man has risen as the popular leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_intelligentsia').GetName], with some not so pleased by such social mobility.
decree_events.3.b: A touching story, indeed, but he doesn't deserve special treatment.
decree_events.4.t: From the Heart of the Sea
decree_events.4.d: A new admiral has presented himself at the ports of [SCOPE.sState('decree_state').GetName], cheerfully acclaimed by his peers. However, the nephew of [SCOPE.sCharacter('noble_character').GetFullName] has also postulated that he has a most profound interest in the same title.
decree_events.5.d: A commission has been sent to the prestigious [SCOPE.sBuilding('decree_building').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('decree_state').GetName] to get one of their finest composers to write a national opera that captures the grandeur of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
decree_events.5.b: A great idea... that someone else could make for a cheaper cost.
decree_events.5.c: Shouldn't this be a free service for the nation?
decree_events.6.d: A well acclaimed troupe of wandering artists has arrived at [SCOPE.sState('decree_state').GetName], followed by hundreds of requests about our generous government funding one of their concerts.
rubber_events.1.d: Rubber has been successfully grown in [ROOT.GetState.GetName]. The fragile nature of these trees and their difficult to meet conditions make this achievement exceptionally important.
rubber_events.1.f: The Amazonian rubber monopoly is finally over! Those beautiful trees have decided to grow elsewhere after multiple unsuccessful attempts, those stubborn little things, and now it is our duty to end those greedy tycoons' empires.
rubber_events.1.a: Bring everyone to [SCOPE.sState('rubber_state').GetName] and get to work.
rubber_events.1.b: A reason for our existing [SCOPE.sBuilding('rubber_plantation').GetName] to work harder.
rubber_events.1.c: Let rubber always drive new growth.
rubber_events.1.e: Always concentrate on our existing plantations.
rubber_always_spread_tt: This event will be hidden in the future, and the above effects will be applied automatically whenever there is a rubber rush.
rubber_always_concentrate_tt: This event will be hidden in the future, and the above effects will be applied automatically to the [concept_state] with the most [SCOPE.sBuilding('rubber_plantation').GetName] whenever there is a potential rubber rush.
children_rights_events.1.d: Due to the inhuman conditions that children face in their workplaces, many families in [SCOPE.sState('child_labor_state').GetName] have chosen to hide their offspring in the hopes of them not being sent to work.
children_rights_events.1.b: It'd be a shame if they were to hide in these abandoned houses...
children_rights_events.2.d: Given the low wages that workers in [SCOPE.sState('child_labor_state').GetName] are receiving, more and more parents are pushed to send their children to work to help sustain their families.
children_rights_events.2.b: They do what they need to do.
children_rights_events.3.d: With the government push for [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], adult men have been pressed to cover the gap they would leave behind. However, their bodies are too large and their fingers too wide for it and industrial accidents have been increasing.
children_rights_events.3.a: No one should be doing this kind of work.
children_rights_events.3.b: Children aren't coming back, so they better get used to it.
antarctica_expedition_desc: Through the wonders of technology and the heroism of our explorers, the interior of the Antarctic Continent may finally be accessible. The race is on, and we must be first to the Pole!
cold.101.d: The Antarctic Continent remains almost entirely unexplored. An expedition to this vast frozen waste would be expensive and fraught with peril, but the glory of being first to the Pole would be immense.
cold.101.f: Murmurs and whispers soon fill the halls of the world's most prestigious science academies, as the prospect of reaching the final geographical discovery becomes much more than a fever dream.
cold.101.a: I know just the man for the job.
cold.101.b: Can the treasury bear such an expense?
cold.102.d: We must choose a leader for the upcoming expedition to the Antarctic Continent. A few promising candidates have distinguished themselves.
cold.102.f: Few people are capable of rightly appreciating this heroic deed, this brilliant proof of human courage and energy. These men will sail right into the heart of the pack ice, which all previous explorers have regarded as certain death. These men are heroes—heroes in the highest sense of the word.
cold.102.c: [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader_3').GetFullName] has never let us down before.
cold.1.d: The expedition spots the twin volcanic peaks of Erebus and Terror on the horizon. When they were first discovered by James Clark Ross, Erebus was observed to be in eruption. Thankfully we find the mountains at peace.
cold.1.c: Ascend Mount Erebus. We will be the first to reach the crater!
cold.2.d: The expedition disembarks upon the frozen shore of the Antarctic continent. At a relatively accessible location, a crewman suggests constructing a durable hut where we could rest and leave supplies for the return journey, and perhaps even for future explorers.
cold.2.d2: The expedition disembarks upon the frozen shore of the Antarctic continent, and is welcomed by the reassuring sight of a wooden hut. Only slightly snowed-in, it is easily made habitable and the crew discover ample supplies of food within.
cold.2.a: This hut shall stand the test of time.
cold.2.b: The hut need only last until our return.
cold.2.c: We should rest and resupply before moving on.
discovery_hut_tt: Future explorers will gain #tooltippable;positive_value;TOOLTIP:expedition_progress_explanation_tt progress#! when visiting the hut.
cold.3.d: The expedition has realized that they have overshot on their route towards the next supply depot.
cold.3.a: We need those supplies. Turn back.
cold.3.b: Push on, we can do without the supplies.
cold.4.d: The expedition is doomed. Utterly exhausted, frostbitten, and out of supplies, all that is left to do is await the cold embrace of death.
cold.4.a: I am just going outside and may be some time.
cold.5.d: The expedition has reached its destination: the South Pole! [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] proudly erects a tent bearing the [SCOPE.sCountry('expedition_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] flag, and the crew drink a celebratory mug of cocoa.
cold.5.d2: The expedition reaches the South Pole only to find a tent bearing the [SCOPE.sCountry('pole_winner_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] flag. We have been beaten to our goal!
cold.5.a: Success! But now the hard journey north begins...
