cold.5.b: Damnation! And now the hard journey north begins...
cold.6.d: Supplies are running low for the Antarctic explorers. The crew debates the merits of killing some of the sled dogs, and dividing the meat between the men and the remaining dogs to increase their odds of survival.
cold.6.a: It is the practical thing to do.
cold.6.b: We will not stoop to such barbarism!
pet_dog.tt: You pet the dogs and continue the journey.
cold.7.d: The crew of the Antarctic expedition have finally returned home. Though they did not succeed in their goal, their efforts have advanced scientific progress and paved the way for future explorers.
cold.7.d2: The crew of the Antarctic expedition have finally returned home. As the first men ever to reach the South Pole, they are lauded as [SCOPE.sCountry('expedition_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] heroes.
cold.7.b: They are a credit to their nation.
cold.8.d: Broken pieces of sea ice start to cover the surface of the water as the expedition approaches its destination. The ship's hull tries to make its way through the cold mass by ramming and crushing, but the ice becomes stronger as they advance.
cold.9.d: A series of pressure waves struck the expedition's ship, causing the ice around it to separate into large pieces. A moment of victory is quickly followed by two floes being pinched on her starboard side, one at her bow and one at her stern. The crew gathers as they make a plan to free her.
cold.9.d2: Blasting a path through the pack ice proved to be a Sisyphean task. Worse, the encroaching ice is crushing the ship. Even if it were possible to free her from the ice, she is no longer seaworthy. The only remaining option is to abandon ship and hope to find a whaling outpost on foot.
cold.10.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has successfully led the expeditionary crew to a whaling station on South Georgia, braving the journey from Elephant Island in an uncovered lifeboat with meager supplies. Tales of [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFirstName]'s heroism resound throughout the nation despite the failure of the expedition.
cold.11.d: As the expedition's ship turns to the side, the crew witnesses in awe a high, perpendicular face of ice; their only entrance to the continent.
cold.11.b: We should make a detour around the fissures.
cold.12.d: The expedition has advanced through eternal days of snow marching until finding the impenetrable sight of the Transantarctic Mountains. A new challenge awaits, as their routes have been scarcely documented.
cold.12.b: We'll be taking a known approach.
cold.13.d: During the expedition's advances through the snow a strange rock with unknown marks has been discovered, partly buried under their feet.
je_expedition_fail: The expedition reaches a peril of 8 or above.
je_expedition_success: Will complete if the expedition reaches a progress of 8 or above.
je_antarctica_reason: The mysteries of our planet are slowly coming to an end. Being the first to map the South Pole would give us invaluable scientific knowledge.
first_to_the_pole: First to Reach the South Pole
children_rights_events.4.d: In our progress towards the enactment of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], ragged schools have been avidly suggested throughout the country. These charitable organizations would provide food and education to our society's most destitute children.
children_rights_events.4.a: Such a pious matter must be handled by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_scope').GetName].
children_rights_events.4.b: A wonderful initiative that should be handled by teachers.
children_rights_events.5.d: The enactment of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has come to a halt due to some public protests. Many are the families that lack the purchasing power to meet the expenses that buying new school supplies imply, thus preventing their children from scholarization.
children_rights_events.5.a: Wealth cannot be a prohibiting factor.
children_rights_events.5.b: We cannot devote even more public funds.
children_rights_events.6.d: Some members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('gatekeeper_ig').GetName] have raised their concerns about the enactment of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], since they believe that it would affect employment and promote agitation among the lower classes.
children_rights_events.6.b: Tell the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('gatekeeper_ig').GetName] that they're right. Then continue with our plan.
children_rights_events.6.c: They should consider it an act of charity.
jump_river_tt: 99% chance to gain #tooltippable;negative_value;TOOLTIP:expedition_peril_explanation_tt major peril #!.\n1% chance to gain #tooltippable;positive_value;TOOLTIP:expedition_progress_explanation_tt monumental progress #!.
je_congo_expedition_reason: The heart of the African continent remains a mystery for many. We shall launch an expedition to plot the course of the Congo River.
je_niger_river_expedition_reason: An expedition shall be launched to plot the course of the Niger River.
je_west_america_expedition_reason: An expedition to map out the unknown regions and geography of the North American Western Frontier.
je_central_africa_expedition_reason: The center of the African continent holds the secret to the source of the Nile.
expedition_events.290.d: With the low temperatures of the mountains, the expedition finds a perfect meadow to take shelter, near the river and far enough from any other village to not disturb their land. An encampment using cottonwood lumber cut from the riverbanks is suggested by [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName].
expedition_events.290.d2: With the low temperatures of the mountains, the expedition finds a perfect meadow to take shelter, near the river and far enough from any other village to not disturb their land. A fort built by previous explorers stands proudly as a haven.
expedition_events.290.a: The perfect place to build a fort.
built_fort_tt: Someone has already built a fort in a previous expedition.
expedition_events.291.d: The expedition is waken up in the middle of the night. Inhuman screams come from one of the tents, and a female voice cries:
expedition_events.291.a: We will take care of the baby.
expedition_events.291.b: It's best for both of them to go back to a village.
expedition_events.292.d: An insurgent group has emerged within the expedition and two of the men have sneaked out in the middle of the night to go to a liquor store.
expedition_events.292.d2: The same two explorers who had been already warned about their disobedience have disappeared in the night again, only to be found drunk on the floor the next morning.
expedition_events.293.d: As the expedition advances, the prioritization of tasks increases in importance, and [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has started a log in which he keeps track of what every man must do.
expedition_events.293.d2: As the expedition advances, the prioritization of tasks increases in importance, and [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] keeps track of what every man must do. However, the disobedient explorers have already stated their non agreement with this decision.
expedition_events.293.b: It's imperative that we find a settlement.
expedition_events.294.d: A few days after being sent on a reconnaissance mission, members of the expedition come back announcing that they have found a native village, in which the group can find aid.
expedition_events.294.d2: A few days after being sent on a reconnaissance mission, members of the expedition come back announcing that they have found a native village, in which the group can find aid, using the newborn baby as a symbol of their peaceful intentions.
expedition_events.294.a: We should try to barter with them.
expedition_events.294.b: Is there anyone here who can guide us?
expedition_events.294.c: They have offered us some provisions for the baby and its mother.
expedition_baby_tt: The expedition is traveling with a baby.
expedition_events.295.d: The expedition men who had been sent hunting have found an area by the riverbank, filled with every animal that they had encountered during their travel. The question is: which one to hunt?
expedition_events.295.a: We cannot afford any risks. Go for a small animal.
expedition_events.295.b: We need the food. Go for the big game.
expedition_events.296.t: When the Earth Opened Its Mouth
expedition_events.296.d: Making their way through the mountains, the expedition finds a dangerous gorge. Their guide advises them to take a longer, more secure route instead of crossing it.
expedition_events.296.d2: Making their way through the mountains, the expedition finds a dangerous gorge. Their native guide suggests a different path, where she used to cross with her tribe.
expedition_events.296.b: We have no time to waste.
native_guide_tt: The expedition is traveling with a native guide.
expedition_events.297.d: The expedition finds a small hut in the mountains. Half-ruined, it appears to have been used by Spanish missionaries and is now empty.
expedition_events.297.a: We still need to stay the night somewhere.
expedition_events.297.b: We can't give them this opportunity.
expedition_events.120.d: At their arrival to a village by the riverside, one of its habitants quickly runs to the expedition, mumbling something about
expedition_events.120.c: Taking him with us would be a risk to our expedition.
expedition_events.130.d: As the expedition encounters a group of suspicious traders, one of the men claims to be a [SCOPE.sC('ambassador_country').GetAdjectiveNoFlag] ambassador, kidnapped by these
expedition_events.130.a: We need to get this man to safety.
expedition_events.130.b: How do we know he's not lying?
expedition_events.140.d: When reaching one of the enclaves, a letter was waiting for [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName], stating that his fiancee back in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has married another man.
expedition_events.150.d: One of the expedition members has been caught stealing more provisions than needed under the excuse that he's ill and needs more food.
expedition_events.150.b: A thief is of no use to us.
expedition_events.160.d: After hearing about the many perils that the expedition was facing, and its little progress, word has been sent from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] that the mission must immediately return.
expedition_events.160.a: This is a waste of time.
internal_security_events.1.d: The disappearance of [SCOPE.sCharacter('anti_secret_police_leader').GetFullName], of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anti_secret_police_ig').GetName], has raised serious concerns among the elites, given [SCOPE.sCharacter('anti_secret_police_leader').GetHerHis] recent opposition to the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
internal_security_events.1.b: We cannot pass the law at the cost of our people's trust.
internal_security_events.2.d: While the government prepares to pass the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law, our agents have captured a [SCOPE.sC('spy_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] spy, damaging our already feeble trust in them.
internal_security_events.2.b: This is very useful information that should remain... private.
internal_security_events.3.d: As the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law gains traction, many of our people have expressed concerns about their privacy.
internal_security_events.3.b: They have nothing to worry about!
internal_security_events.4.d: A protest advocating for the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law was called in order to silence the detractors. However, the police force decided to take the law in their own hands and violently repressed the protesters.
internal_security_events.4.a: Both parties need to calm down.
internal_security_events.4.b: The police will have to publicly apologize for this.
internal_security_events.5.d: With the proposal to pass the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law, members of the government have voiced their concerns about it compromising the nation's internal security.
internal_security_events.5.a: That information is crucial for our administration.
internal_security_events.5.b: We'll switch to other, less intrusive, methods.
internal_security_events.6.d: Members of the police force have been discovered organizing systematic attacks against supporters of the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law, vandalizing their business and meeting places.
internal_security_events.6.a: We shall make a public speech and make it clear that this is unacceptable.
internal_security_events.6.b: The police force has become corrupted and immoral. It must be purged.
psychology_events.1.d: There have been reports of [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_leader').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('mentally_ill_ig').GetName], not attending meetings or fulfilling his obligations. We can no longer ignore [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_leader').GetHerHis] absence.
psychology_events.1.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_leader').GetSheHe|U] can get the help [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_leader').GetSheHe] needs in an asylum.
psychology_events.1.c: Psychoanalysis has become a very promising trend.
psychology_events.1.tt: The character will be sent to an asylum.
psychology_events.2.d: Concerns about the wellbeing of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] have been increasing throughout the country after [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] lack of public appearances. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] spouse has tearfully confessed that no doctor seems to be able to cure [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim].
psychology_events.2.a: Nonsense! A real doctor should treat [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] with proper hypnosis.
psychology_events.2.c: An experimental treatment has been offered by the Philosophy Department.
psychology_events.3.d: After his return from duty, [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_character').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_character').GetFullName] has not been the same. [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_character').GetSheHe|U] avoids the barracks like the plague, refuses to use a weapon and [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_character').GetSheHe] has stated damn clearly that [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_character').GetSheHe] doesn't want to hear a damn word about war.
psychology_events.3.a: Those memories would wreck any man. This needs to be treated.
psychology_events.3.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_character').GetSheHe|U] would get the appropriate treatment in an asylum. Far from the public eye.
psychology_events.3.c: This is just another instance of cowardice. Send [SCOPE.sCharacter('mentally_ill_character').GetHerHim] back to service.
psychology_events.4.d: Released patients from the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] Asylum have steadily denounced the practices involved in their, supposedly, medical treatments. Mistreatment of the sick, withholding of personal letters, and disproportionate punishments were among the charges.
psychology_events.4.b: We need to entirely revise how asylums work.
psychology_events.4.c: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('healthcare_ig').GetName] can take over the asylum administration.
psychology_events.5.d: A respectable doctor from the [SCOPE.sBuilding('university_building').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('university_state').GetName] has been conducting newfangled investigations in the camp of psychiatry, emphasizing the role that the unconscious mind and buried childhood memories play in psychological pathologies.
psychology_events.5.a: He may continue his investigations at university.
psychology_events.5.b: A mind this brilliant deserves a prominent role!
sigmun_freud_tt: Sigmund Freud will become the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] leader, with a high popularity.
sigmun_freud_else_tt: A researcher with high popularity will become the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] leader.
psychology_events.6.d: Members of the philosophy department from the [SCOPE.sBuilding('university_building').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('university_state').GetName] have signed a formal petition for governmental funding of their next project: a scientific journal.
psychology_events.6.a: We have no resources for this.
psychological_affliction_desc: This character suffers from an illness of the mind, poorly understood and difficult to treat effectively.
je_grand_exhibition_reason: Countries all across the world wait impatient to see what we have to show.
je_grand_exhibition_bad_points: We have nothing to show off.
je_grand_exhibition_medium_points: We have a modest number of items to show.
je_grand_exhibition_good_points: We are in a comfortable position to hold an exhibition.
je_grand_exhibition_great_points: This will be the greatest exhibition of them all!
grand_exhibition_complete_tt: Increase your $Exhibition Points$ by gathering treasures on expeditions, researching technologies and increasing your country rank.\nLose points by increasing your infamy.
invalid_grand_exhibition_tt: Will remove the Grand Exhibition Journal Entry.
exhibition_events.1.d: After months of preparation the exhibition is finally finished, and by all accounts, rather disappointing.
exhibition_events.2.d: After months of preparation the exhibition is finally finished, and has been very well received.
exhibition_events.3.d: After months of preparation the exhibition is finally finished, and is being heralded as one of the greatest exhibitions of the age.
exhibition_events.4.d: The planning of the Exhibition causes controversy as its opening approaches. Members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('conservative_ig').GetName] have expressed their concerns about a mass of visitors becoming a potential revolutionary mob.
exhibition_events.4.b: The big influx of visitors may cause some problems.
exhibition_events.5.d: Members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anti_toilet_ig').GetName] have explicitly stated that installing public restrooms in the Exhibition will harm its good odor and reputation.
exhibition_events.5.a: Its good odor and reputation would be worse if we don't install them.
exhibition_events.5.b: We should not compromise the Exhibition for this.
exhibition_events.6.d: With the imminent opening of the Exhibition, we must prepare ourselves for visitors wanting to return with a small piece of it.
exhibition_events.6.f: A perfume-soaked woman wanders around the Exhibition with pompous motion.
exhibition_events.6.a: Stereoscope cards will let them see the Exhibition once again.
exhibition_events.6.b: A paper souvenir would be easily affordable for anyone.
exhibition_events.7.d: Suspicious gentlemen have been reported charging an extra fee for special items inside the Exhibition hall.
exhibition_events.7.f: There's a man with a tall hat—a very, very tall hat. He's pointing at one of the telescopes, this one looks specially important.
exhibition_events.7.a: We cannot let these men tarnish the good name of the Exhibition.
exhibition_events.7.b: We can all use one or two extra pennies...
titanic.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('titanic_leader').GetFullName], of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('titanic_ig').GetName], has determined to sponsor the construction of a memorable ocean liner in the shipyards of [SCOPE.sState('titanic_state').GetName]. It will be like nothing ever seen before.
titanic.1.a: People will talk about the luxury of this ship!
titanic.1.b: We should make its construction more efficient.
titanic.1.c: We have no time to follow a maniac's delusions.
no_titanic_modifier: Did Not Build an Ocean Liner
rival_titanic_modifier: Opposed the Construction of an Ocean Liner
titanic.2.d: After the monumental Titanic left the shipyards of [SCOPE.sState('titanic_state').GetName], it wasn't long until tragedy reached her, as part of her hull collided with an equally imposing iceberg.
titanic.2.d2: After the monumental [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('dynamic_titanic')] left the shipyards of [SCOPE.sState('titanic_state').GetName], it wasn't long until tragedy awaited her, as part of her hulk collided with an equally imposing iceberg.
titanic.3.d: After the monumental Titanic left the shipyards of [SCOPE.sState('titanic_state').GetName], it wasn't long until her maiden voyage was proven to be an absolute success. Crowds wave at the passengers at the arriving port, cheering.
titanic.3.d2: After the monumental [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('dynamic_titanic')] left the shipyards of [SCOPE.sState('titanic_state').GetName], it wasn't long until her maiden voyage was proven to be an absolute success. Crowds wave at the passengers at the arriving port, cheering.
titanic.3.a: It was the ship of dreams.
je_krakatoa_reason: The aftermath of the volcanic eruption in [GetStateRegion('STATE_WEST_JAVA').GetName] is still affecting the world's climate, increasing the frequency and severity of [GetHarvestConditionType('frost').GetName], [GetHarvestConditionType('hailstorm').GetName], [GetHarvestConditionType('disease_outbreak').GetName] and [GetHarvestConditionType('torrential_rains').GetName] [Concept('concept_harvest_condition', '$concept_harvest_conditions$')] until temperature levels have recovered.\n$TSUNAMI_LIST_HEADER$$TSUNAMI_LIST_CONTENT$\n$TSUNAMI_LIST_AFTER$
TSUNAMI_LIST_HEADER: $TOOLTIP_DELIMITER$\nYour [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] that are currently affected by the [concept_devastation] of the [GetHarvestConditionType('tsunami').GetName]:
TSUNAMI_LIST_EMPTY_STATE: No [concept_state] is currently affected by the [GetHarvestConditionType('tsunami').GetNameNoFormatting|b]
TSUNAMI_LIST_AFTER: @information! Using the [GetDecreeType('decree_emergency_relief').GetName] [concept_decree] on affected $concept_states$ adds a #v [SCOPE.ScriptValue('krakatoa_decree_emergency_relief_devastation_recovery_chance')|0]%#! chance to reduce $concept_devastation$ by #v;P [SCOPE.ScriptValue('krakatoa_decree_emergency_relief_devastation_recovery_amount')|0]%#! each month!
krakatoa.1.d: An eruption of unprecedented records has utterly destroyed the lives of many of our people in the state of [SCOPE.sState('krakatoa_state').GetName]. The explosion of the Krakatoa could be heard from hundreds of miles away and anything that had the ill fate of surrounding the island was immediately devastated.
krakatoa.1.a: We shall help with all we have.
krakatoa.5.d: An eruption of unprecedented records has utterly destroyed the lives of many [SCOPE.sCountry('krakatoa_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] in the state of [SCOPE.sState('krakatoa_state').GetName]. The explosion of the Krakatoa could be heard from hundreds of miles away and anything that had the ill fate of surrounding the island was immediately devastated.
krakatoa.5.a: We shall help with all we have.
krakatoa.2.d: Waves taller than chimneys have ravaged the state of [SCOPE.sState('tsunami_state').GetName], a terrible consequence of the volcanic eruption.
krakatoa.2.a: There are no words to describe this tragedy.
krakatoa.3.d: Due to the drop of temperature caused by the volcanic eruption all the crops of [SCOPE.sState('farm_state').GetName] have been destroyed in the subsequent [GetHarvestConditionType('disease_outbreak').GetName] and now the farmers have come begging for help.
krakatoa.3.a: We can send them some food.
krakatoa_crop_failure_tt: The crop failure will also affect the rest of the world.
krakatoa_crop_failure_small_modifier_tt: Our states with farms or plantations will experience minor crop failures.
krakatoa_crop_failure_medium_modifier_tt: Our states with farms or plantations will experience major crop failures.
krakatoa_crop_failure_big_modifier_tt: Our states with farms or plantations will experience crippling crop failures.
krakatoa.4.d: Vivid red sunsets were reported for several months across the country. Fire engines were even called out in [SCOPE.sState('art_state').GetName] to quench the apparent conflagration. Many artists and academics have expressed their interest in this phenomenon.
krakatoa.4.a: Only a painting could capture such beauty.
krakatoa.4.b: Academics must ensure that we're prepared for the next eruption.
krakatoa_uni.tt: Volcanic eruptions will be less damaging in the future.
je_prohibition_reason: Although their stances come from very different premises, both the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] have agreed that alcohol is a poison to the mind. Only a government ban will end this evil.
je_prohibition_goal: The following conditions must be true for a total of 10 years (can be interrupted):
prohibition_fail.tt: Rejected the Temperance Movement in the Prohibition event.
prohibition_success.tt: The liquor [concept_obsession] will be removed from any primary culture.
prohibition.1.d: Both the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] have expressed their desire to stop the alarming consumption of liquor present in our nation, petitioning the government to ban it.
prohibition.1.a: Alcohol is a poison to the mind.
prohibition.1.b: Nothing makes a man smile more than a glass of whiskey before bed!
rejected_prohibition_tt: This will remove the Temperance Movement Journal Entry.
prohibition.2.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('alcoholic_leader').GetFullName], of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('alcoholic_ig').GetName], has been discovered to have established an illegal distillery in his own house. During the apparently innocent party of [SCOPE.sCharacter('alcoholic_leader').GetHerHis] son, guests opened the wrong shed.
prohibition.2.a: Excuses! Send the men to that damned party!
prohibition.2.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('alcoholic_leader').GetSheHe|U] has always had a troublesome character.
prohibition.3.d: Members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_ig').GetName] have expressed dissatisfaction with the recent Temperance Movement, complaining about the liquor industry being an important part of their income.
prohibition.3.b: They can still use the vineyards.
prohibition.4.t: The Best Damn Pet Shop in Town
prohibition.4.d: Reports of unusual sounds and suspicious behavior have been raised in [SCOPE.sState('temperance_state').GetCityHubName]. A local pet shop—recently opened—has been attracting lots of clients.
prohibition.4.a: It's probably just those loud pet shop boys.
prohibition.4.b: Well, then we shall see those pet shop papers.
prohibition.4.c: Who do they think they're fooling!? Officers!
prohibition.5.d: Members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('alcoholic_ig').GetName] have been caught using the [SCOPE.sBuilding('temperance_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('temperance_state').GetName] to produce a surplus of alcoholic beverages that they've been illegally selling for their own profit.
prohibition.6.d: Members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] have declared that there is no use in banning liquor, if people can still access wine.
prohibition.6.b: There is only so much that our people can handle.
prohibition.7.d: Members of two rival gangs have been murdered in broad daylight during a liquor related altercation. One of their leaders has been finally identified and citizens demand protection.
prohibition.7.a: This is over. We're taking him to court.
prohibition.7.b: People hate him. People love him. There's a deal to be made here.
prohibition.7.c: We shall teach him and his gang a lesson.
prohibition.8.d: After the government's efforts to ban alcoholic beverages, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is now clear of liquor.
prohibition.8.a: Finally, our people are free of evil.
prohibition_laws_pm.tt: This will greatly increase the progress in the Temperance Movement Journal Entry.
prohibition_laws_weak_pm.tt: This will increase the progress in the Temperance Movement Journal Entry.
prohibition_laws_bad_pm.tt: This will decrease the progress in the Temperance Movement Journal Entry.
expedition_events.695.d: As the expedition advances, the lush jungle reveals an unlikely sight: members of the lost [SCOPE.sCountry('lost_expedition_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] expedition lay sickly in improvised hammocks.
expedition_events.695.a: We shall guide these men to a safe haven.
expedition_events.695.b: Join us! Two expeditions are better than one.
expedition_events.695.e: We could never trust a band of [SCOPE.sCountry('lost_expedition_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] men. Sharpen your knives.
expedition_events.696.d: Soon after their triumphant return, the expedition led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has been denounced by [SCOPE.sCountry('lost_expedition_country').GetNameNoFormatting] as rumors escalate about their participation in their lost expedition's fate.
expedition_events.696.b: They have no way of proving it.
je_assassination_reason: Find out who the plotters are and stop the assassination before it's too late.\n\nIncrease your #bold Police Institution#! level, pass the #bold Outlawed Dissent#!, #bold Dedicated Police#! or #bold Secret Police#! laws, and research #bold $identification_documents$#! or #bold $mass_surveillance$#! to raise your chances of stalling the traitors.
je_assassination_low: Progress towards discovering the assassination plotters is low.
je_assassination_middle: There's been some progress towards discovering the assassination plotters.
je_assassination_high: We're almost certain about who the assassination plotters are.
je_assassination_tt: The threatened ruler is no longer in power.
je_assassination_timeout_tt: The plotters manage to assassinate our ruler.
je_assassination_caught_em_tt: We discover who the plotters are.
assassination_events.1.d: Reliable sources inform about an internal plot to end the life of [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetFullNameWithTitle]. If we don't act in time, the stability of the nation will not be guaranteed.
assassination_events.1.f: Maybe it's their tone, perhaps the inevitable anxiety that comes with power. A dark, sweet kindness so disingenuous that makes even traitors dread a last supper.\n\n
assassination_events.1.a: We shall find and hang them!
advance_assassination_progress_tt: This will advance our progress to determine who is plotting against our ruler.
assassination_events.2.t: The Invisible Men: An Empty Seat
assassination_events.2.d: A clandestine meeting organized by members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('suspicious_ig').GetName] has been discovered. While they swear that the purpose was purely financial, many are those who suspect their connection to the assassination plotters.
assassination_events.2.f: The voices reach the street remarkably clear, considering their intentions. The sound of glass can only be heard from the interior, however. Their faces lose clarity when reflected on the wine.\n\n
assassination_events.2.a: It just looks like a party.
assassination_events.2.c: Worse things have been said about [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('second_suspicious_ig').GetName].
assassination_events.3.t: The Invisible Men: An Inside Tip
assassination_events.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('snitch_leader').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('snitch_ig').GetName], has come to us with an alarming warning. [SCOPE.sCharacter('snitch_leader').GetSheHe|U] is accusing the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('snitched_ig').GetName] of being the ones planning the assassination of [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetFullName].
assassination_events.3.b: Can we really trust a rival?
assassination_events.3.c: Curious... because we've also been hearing rumors about [SCOPE.sCharacter('snitch_leader').GetHerHim].
assassination_events.4.d: The most illustrious members of society spend now their days accusing each other of being part of the assassination plot, and this time all the eyes are on the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('suspicious_ig').GetName].
assassination_events.4.c: If the information got so easily spread, we have worse problems.
assassination_events.6.d: The assassination plot has come to an unexpected end. With [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetFullName] not being the head of the nation anymore, their efforts have been completely stopped.
assassination_events.6.a: Well, at least there was no assassination.
assassination_events.7.d: The treacherous intentions of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('suspicious_ig').GetName] have finally been unveiled. Members of the authorities have found enough evidence to prevent the assassination plot.
assassination_events.7.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] gets [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetHerHis] breakfast at 8:00 from Monday to Friday, and at 8:30 on the weekends. After lunch, [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetSheHe] likes to take a walk in the gardens, rarely is [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetSheHe] escorted.\n\nA list of names follows after, listing all the men that [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetSheHe] invites over to play cards with. [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetHerHis|U] cook, the maidens, a couple of government employees.
assassination_events.7.a: A day to be proud of!
assassination_events.8.d: The assassination plot has come to an unexpected end. With [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassination_ruler_scope').GetFullName] having died of unrelated causes, their efforts have come to a stop.
assassination_events.8.f: And so, evermore, after death there comes a resurrection. Out of the passion of this present hour, there comes joy. And let us trust the nation shall never more know death!
election_other_parties_events.1.d: Members of the [SCOPE.sParty('agrarian_party').GetName] have expressed their concerns about technology replacing the independence and dignity of manual labor.
election_other_parties_events.1.a: We shouldn't compromise the work of our people.
election_other_parties_events.2.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('religious_leader').GetFullName], of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_devout').GetName], has been seen preaching in favor of the [SCOPE.sParty('religious_party').GetName], convinced that their victory has been foreseen in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('GetDivinity')]'s plans.
election_other_parties_events.2.a: And who are we to stand against [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('GetDivinity')]'s will?
election_other_parties_events.2.b: Such a shame the nation is not ruled by [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('GetDivinity')], then.
election_other_parties_events.2.c: But [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('GetDivinity')] surely wants the [SCOPE.sParty('other_party').GetName] to win!
election_other_parties_events.3.d: Members of the [SCOPE.sParty('military_party').GetName] have loudly stated that the only way to lead us out of the [SCOPE.sWar('ongoing_war').GetName] war is to leave the government of our nation in their capable hands.
election_other_parties_events.3.a: They are truly our most capable people.
election_other_parties_events.4.d: Members of the [SCOPE.sParty('social_democrat_party').GetName] have drawn attention to the rise of the [SCOPE.sParty('leftist_party').GetName], expressing their willingness to offer a more moderate solution to their political extremism.
election_other_parties_events.4.b: Sounds a bit far-fetched, but the [SCOPE.sParty('social_democrat_party').GetName] is still the sensible option.
election_other_parties_events.5.d: The ideas of the [SCOPE.sParty('radical_party').GetName] have been raising interest throughout the country, leading to potential turmoil.
election_other_parties_events.5.a: And they should expand even further.
election_other_parties_events.5.b: They are compromising the unity of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]!
election_other_parties_events.5.c: Someone should convince them to stop.
je_belle_epoque_goal: Lead [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] through #BOLD 10 years#! as a cultural and technological capital of the world.
je_belle_epoque_reason: Having reached such a high artistic and social progress, it is time for us to relax and enjoy our achievements.
belle_epoque_sol_trigger: More than 50% of our $concept_incorporated_state$s have a $concept_sol$ over #BOLD 15#!.
belle_epoque_events.1.d: With the construction of the Eiffel Tower, the Parisian public is divided. While some argue that the building shall become their most notorious landmark, others refer to it as
belle_epoque_events.1.a: They're wrong! This building is Paris itself!
belle_epoque_events.1.c: It'll be demolished in less than ten years anyways.
belle_epoque_events.2.d: The spread of a new artistic style inspired by nature, imitating the sinuous curves of plants through robust iron and glass to convey the contradictions of progress, has reached [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName]'s higher spheres.
belle_epoque_events.2.a: This new style is truly mesmerizing.
belle_epoque_events.2.b: And they say they paint without a design. Well, it shows.
belle_epoque_events.3.d: After the successful publications of the Symbolist movement, [SCOPE.sCharacter('symbolist_leader').GetFullName] has decided to follow his path and embark in a literary journey of [SCOPE.sCharacter('symbolist_leader').GetHerHis] own, a source of concern for the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('symbolist_ig').GetName].
belle_epoque_events.3.a: They deserve to have a private life.
belle_epoque_events.3.b: This is unheard of! A poet politician!
belle_epoque_events.4.d: The opening of a luxurious cabaret at the foot of the Montmartre hill has made the nightlife of Paris considerably lively. Attracting, of course, the attention and suspicions of the conservatives.
belle_epoque_events.4.f: The woman sighs throughout the report in a smoke induced room. Incense and cigarettes are indistinguishable—so is vapor, even though it's impossible to know where it's coming from. The music is muffled here, thick as syrup.\n\n
belle_epoque_events.4.b: This immoral joint shall be shut down at once.
belle_epoque_events.5.d: Louis Pasteur, a scientist known for his work on silkworm diseases, sterilization, and disease transmission, has concluded human trials of a rabies vaccine created from dried infected rabbit nerve tissue.
belle_epoque_events.5.d2: For the first time, a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] laboratory has concluded human trials of a practical rabies vaccine created from dried infected rabbit nerve tissue.
belle_epoque_events.5.f2: To ensure success, a daily administration of immunizations for a period of fourteen to twenty-one days, near the end of the working period, is to be carried out beginning as quickly as possible following exposure to the afflicted animal.
belle_epoque_events.5.a: Humanity earns another triumph over pestilence.
belle_epoque_events.6.d: Louis and Auguste Lumière, the inventors of the Cinématographe, have released a forty-five second
belle_epoque_events.6.d2: A short film displaying workers at a camera factory in [SCOPE.sState('lumiere_state').GetCityHubName] has raised public attention to the technology of moving pictures. Audiences in [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetName] have flocked to see the film and ones like it at salons and theaters alike.
belle_epoque_events.6.f: The audience, investors and entrepreneurs all, watched in fascination as the images unfolded on the screen. The executives exited first, followed by the women employed at the factory, and the common laborers following after. Forty-five seconds felt like far longer as the tableau expanded across the cloth screen, dust particles in the rays of light from the projector hovering in the air in equal anticipation to the audience.
belle_epoque_events.6.a: The twentieth century will be shown on film!

belle_epoque_events.7.f: The poster fluttered as a breeze ran over it, further disturbing the partially loosened tack holding it in place. Before it rose the great dome that had been constructed for the event, a vast crowd surrounding it.\n\n
belle_epoque_events.7.b: Limitless potential, perhaps, but also limitless risk of a fire.
belle_epoque_events.8.d: The Peugeot enterprise, in collaboration with the engineer Léon Serpollet, has created an experimental steam tricycle design using the Serpollet
belle_epoque_events.8.d2: With government regulations on mechanically propelled vehicles loosening, and more efficient steam engines being developed, steam-powered transport buses have begun to roam [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetName] with greater frequency.
belle_epoque_events.8.a: These machines will drive the growth of our cities.
belle_epoque_events.8.b: Taxing mechanical vehicles will provide needed revenue.
belle_epoque_events.9.d: The development of vehicles propelled by the internal combustion engine has inspired various [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] automobile producers to hold an exhibition in the form of the Paris-Rouen Horseless Carriages Contest.
belle_epoque_events.9.f: The vehicles lined up in groups of five, each one different in form, propelled by petrol and steam.\n\nAt the wave of a flag, their engines released a cacophony of rattling and hissing as they set forth down the street, traveling at a pace that far exceeded that of the onlookers on foot. Before long, the course curved out of the sight of the starting line, and cheers replaced the sound of engines.
belle_epoque_events.10.d: The prosperity of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] society has given rise to a new generation of wealthy entrepreneurs. The most fashionable den of these 'noveaux-riches' is Maxim's, an exclusive restaurant decorated in Art Noveau, and catering to the most wealthy and fashionable citizens of [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName].
belle_epoque_events.10.d2: Those members of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] society who have been made wealthy by the recent boom in technological progress have begun establishing fashions of their own, attending more and more extravagant high society functions and exclusive restaurants decorated in the style of Art Noveau.
belle_epoque_events.10.a: A place to take ladies; but never one's wife.
belle_epoque_events.10.b: A new world; material without being real.
belle_epoque_events.11.d: A roller-skating palace has opened in a fashionable neighborhood of [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName], exploding in popularity as soon as it was unveiled to the public.
belle_epoque_events.11.d2: A roller-skating rink has opened in [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName], presenting a new, exciting form of entertainment for the urban classes.
belle_epoque_events.11.f: As inside the building those fortunate enough to arrive early laughed as they made their circles on the wooden floor, those late arrivals outside clashed with police as they clamored to take their turns.
belle_epoque_events.11.b: An easy way to forget one's demons.
belle_epoque_events.12.d: A network of underground train stations, complete with entrances designed by Hector Guimard in Art Noveau style, has been inaugurated in [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName]. The sinuous designs of the Métro entrances, with their red lights and embellished lettering, have rapidly become a symbol of [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName].
belle_epoque_events.12.d2: A new network of underground train stations has been inaugurated in [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName], providing iconic and cheap transportation within city limits to commuters.
belle_epoque_events.12.f2: The streets were so much more civilized, these days, he thought, as he made his way to the metro station. Whereas once they had been flooded by the dreary march of multitudes shuffling to and from work, now those unsightly herds had been coralled underground, pressed into their tubes, hurtling through the tunnels.\n\nAnd what was progress, if not speeding through the dark?
belle_epoque_events.12.a: Another step towards a city of tomorrow.
belle_epoque_events.12.b: A new symbol of our nation's progress.
belle_epoque_events.13.d: An exhibition displaying the wealth of our colonies across the world has been held in [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetName], drawing in visitors with displays of exotic animals, natural resources, and ethnological expositions of [SCOPE.sCulture('colonial_culture').GetName] peoples in a simulated native village.
belle_epoque_events.13.f: The poster for the exhibition was a lurid red, entitled
belle_epoque_events.13.b: Perhaps these human displays are excessive.
belle_epoque_events.14.d: Entranced by the popular images of flawless silk dresses and fashionable jewelry produced by the Parisian artisans, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] women have begun to journey to [SCOPE.sCountry('haute_couture_country').GetName] to purchase fine garments from Parisian boutiques.
belle_epoque_events.14.d2: Entranced by the popular images of flawless silk dresses and fashionable jewelry created by [SCOPE.sCountry('haute_couture_country').GetAdjective] designers, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] women have begun to cross the border to commission fine garments.
belle_epoque_events.14.a: Regardless of borders, both of our nations celebrate beauty as equals.
belle_epoque_events.15.d: Entranced by the popular images of flawless silk dresses and fashionable jewelry produced by Parisian artisans, women hailing from as far as [SCOPE.sCountry('haute_couture_buyer_scope').GetName] have begun to journey to [SCOPE.sCountry('haute_couture_country').GetName] to purchase fine garments from Parisian boutiques.
belle_epoque_events.15.d2: Entranced by the popular images of flawless silk dresses and fashionable jewelry produced by our artisans, women hailing from as far as [SCOPE.sCountry('haute_couture_buyer_scope').GetName] have begun to journey to [SCOPE.sCountry('haute_couture_country').GetName] to purchase our designers' garments.
belle_epoque_events.15.f: The process that had become common in recent days brought no lack of amusement to the conductors of the [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName] station. Women with anxious eyes and full pocketbooks would arrive from trains hailing from [SCOPE.sCountry('haute_couture_buyer_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] stations, and depart several weeks later in magnificent gowns and purses several pounds lighter.\n\nOn the platforms, both groups mingled, apathetic husbands averting their eyes whilst their wives complimented one another's good sense, and pledged to meet again.
belle_epoque_events.15.a: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] shall be the fashion capital of the world.
belle_epoque_events.15.b: It is the designers and workers who make such things possible.
belle_epoque_events.16.d: To celebrate the end of the Nineteenth century and the beginning of the Twentieth, a massive Ferris wheel has been constructed in [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName]. From its pods, the fireworks of the New Years can be seen all across the grand city of [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName].
belle_epoque_events.16.d2: To celebrate the end of the Nineteenth century and the beginning of the Twentieth, a massive Ferris wheel has been constructed in [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName]. From its pods, the fireworks of the New Years can be seen all across the grand city of [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetCityHubName].
belle_epoque_events.16.f: All of Paris was awash in lights, from the boats streaming down the Seine to the reflections of fireworks on snow-bleached rooftops. As the pod crested the top of the wheel, Marie imagined that she could see her modest house, its own lights extinguished to save another coin for her husband's liquid indulgences.\n\nPerhaps, she thought, in a world so vast and bright, there was a future for her outside of it after all.
belle_epoque_events.16.f2: The greatest aspiration of Humanity is to look down upon everyone else, even if just for the briefest moment.
belle_epoque_events.17.d: With the coming end of the century, a literary and artistic movement expressing pessimism and fear of societal degeneration has swept through [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
belle_epoque_events.17.a: The world is getting better - have they not seen our GDP figures?
belle_epoque_events.17.b: There is a seed of pessimism inside all our hearts.

belle_epoque_events.19.d: Following in the footsteps the Decadent movement, the poet Jean Moréas has published an artistic manifesto detailing an artistic tendency which focuses on attempting to express exotic ideals through extravagant analogy and oblique references.
belle_epoque_events.20.d: The Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes in [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetName] has begun to expand its exhibits, with the surge in [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetAdjective] prosperity and leisure time.
belle_epoque_events.20.d2: The zoo in [SCOPE.sState('belle_epoque_state').GetName] has begun to expand its exhibits, with the surge in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] prosperity and leisure time.
belle_epoque_events.20.a: The bold rooster, the enduring symbol of [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName].
belle_epoque_events.20.b: The majestic lion, symbol of strength the world over.

pm_events.1.b: We cannot pull the brakes on the engines of progress!
pm_events.2.d: Children working in the [SCOPE.sBuilding('industrialized_pm_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('industrialized_pm_state').GetName] have suffered injuries trying to operate the machinery used in production.
pm_events.2.f: After examining the boy's hand, the doctor sat back down, turned to the mother and sighed deeply.\n\n
pm_events.2.a: Keep children off the factory floor!
pm_events.2.b: These new industries need all the employees they can get.
pm_events.3.d: Protesters from the Temperance movement are objecting to the production of liquor in [SCOPE.sState('liquor_making_state').GetName].
pm_events.3.a: We must stop distilling this poison!
pm_events.3.b: Let us cease production of the strongest spirits.
pm_events.3.c: [SCOPE.sState('liquor_making_state').GetName] should take pride in its liquors!
pm_events.4.d: Pacifists led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('pacifist_leader').GetFullName] are protesting against the weapons manufacturing in [SCOPE.sState('arms_making_state').GetName]
pm_events.4.a: Halt production of the rifles until this settles down.
pm_events.4.b: Significantly reduce weapon production as a compromise.
pm_events.4.c: We shall not be shamed for our good craftsmanship!
pm_events.5.d: The wine produced in [SCOPE.sState('vinyard_state').GetName] has been lauded by sommeliers as outstanding.
pm_events.5.a: Make this an exclusive product for export.
pm_events.5.b: Increase production to meet the booming demands.
obligation_events.1.d: [SCOPE.sC('obligation_request_target').GetName] owing us a obligation could be used to pressure them to include the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('obligation_request_ig').GetName] in their government.
obligation_events.1.a: They just need a small push in the right direction!
obligation_events.1.b: We should stay out of their internal politics.
obligation_events.2.d: The obligation we owe to [SCOPE.sC('obligation_request_sender').GetName] is being used as pretext for a request to include their friends in the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('obligation_request_ig').GetName] in our government.
obligation_events.2.a: [SCOPE.sC('obligation_request_sender').GetName] helped us once. We will take their advice.
obligation_events.2.b: The mere suggestion is an outrage!
obligation_events.3.d: [SCOPE.sC('obligation_request_target').GetName] owing us a obligation could be used to request a propaganda campaign making the world see our nation in a more pleasant light.
obligation_events.3.a: Everyone should remember how we came to their aid.
obligation_events.3.b: Why, when we are a nation to be feared?
obligation_events.4.d: The obligation we owe to [SCOPE.sC('obligation_request_sender').GetName] is being used as pretext for a request to portray their country as less of a threat to the world.
obligation_events.4.a: A misunderstood country. They deserve a second chance!
obligation_events.4.b: They are a threat. We will not lie to our people.
obligation_events.5.d: We see an opportunity to call in the obligation [SCOPE.sC('obligation_request_target').GetName] owes us by requesting the service of their commanders, [SCOPE.sCharacter('obligation_request_character').GetFullName].
obligation_events.5.b: The obligation is worth more than the skills of one [SCOPE.sCharacter('obligation_request_character').GetWomanMan].
obligation_events.6.d: [SCOPE.sC('obligation_request_sender').GetName] is calling in the obligation we owe them by requesting our commander [SCOPE.sCharacter('obligation_request_character').GetFullName] be sent to serve in their military.
obligation_events.6.a: A small price for what they did to earn it!
obligation_events.6.b: They may have our military aid, but not our military leaders.
obligation_events.tt.no: No message will be sent to [SCOPE.sC('obligation_request_target').GetName].
trade_route_events.1.d: The $ig_armed_forces$ are questioning the wisdom of relying on weapon imports from [SCOPE.sC('arms_seller_threat').GetName], an acknowledged threat to our nation.
trade_route_events.1.a: We will set up a domestic arms industry in case of a betrayal.
trade_route_events.2.d: The more advanced weapons we import from [SCOPE.sC('arms_seller_gun_tech').GetName] could provide valuable insights into our current military research project.
trade_route_events.2.a: Take them apart and find out how to put them together!
trade_route_events.2.b: We will carve our own path to the future of weaponry.
trade_route_events.3.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('angry_luxury_import_ig').GetName] has questioned the morality of importing luxuries to our capital while the high price of $grain$ is a cause of concern for many poor citizens.
trade_route_events.3.f: He put down the crate with more force than necessary, to emphasize the point.\n\n
trade_route_events.3.a: We shall endeavor to import this basic good as well.
trade_route_events.4.d: The $ig_industrialists$ find the high price of $steel$ in the capital an impediment to their ambitions and would like us to prioritize importing it.
trade_route_events.4.a: We will find a source of this vital material for the modern age.
trade_route_events.4.b: Their ambitions should first be to make steel, not use it.
trade_route_events.5.d: The $ig_intelligentsia$ find it difficult to find the cheap $paper$ they need to immortalize their thoughts.
trade_route_events.5.a: We will secure the pages of tomorrow's classics!
je_build_local_arms_industry_reason: At the request of the $ig_armed_forces$, we have promised to reduce our dependence on foreign arms imports by funding our own industrial production of weaponry.
je_set_up_grain_import_status: Reduce the price of $grain$ within our [concept_market].
je_set_up_grain_import_reason: At the request of the [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetInterestGroup.GetName], we have promised to import $grain$ to reduce food prices for the poor.
je_set_up_steel_import_status: Reduce the price of $steel$ within our [concept_market].
je_set_up_steel_import_reason: At the request of the $ig_industrialists$, we have promised to import $steel$ to reduce steel prices for industrial purposes.
je_set_up_paper_import_status: Reduce the price of $paper$ within our [concept_market].
je_set_up_paper_import_reason: At the request of the $ig_intelligentsia$, we have promised to import $paper$ to reduce material costs for their literary ambitions.
manifest_destiny_desc: Our great nation is fated to spread across the continent.
peoples_springtime.1.d: The revolutionary events in [SCOPE.sCountry('revolutionary_country').GetName] are inspiring [GetIdeology('ideology_radical').GetName] sentiments across Europe.
peoples_springtime.1.d_france: The fall of the monarchy and declaration of the [SCOPE.sCountry('revolutionary_country').GetName] has spurred a tidal wave of [GetIdeology('ideology_radical').GetName] sentiments across Europe.
peoples_springtime.1.a: Who will lead [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to the future?
peoples_springtime.1.b: We will not let these ideals divide us!
peoples_springtime.2.d: A current of radical liberal thought is spreading internationally and has recently reached [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
peoples_springtime.2.a: Let's hear what they have to say.
peoples_springtime.3.d: A voice for the liberalism currently on the rise has resonated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('radical_ig').GetName].
peoples_springtime.3.a.tt: A #bold Radical#! character will assume leadership of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('radical_ig').GetName].
peoples_springtime.3.b: This is far too extreme for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] politics.
peoples_springtime.4.t: The Good Word of the Revolution
peoples_springtime.4.d: Proponents of liberal reforms are looking to spread their ideas to our neighboring countries.
peoples_springtime.4.a: What we are, they will be!
peoples_springtime.5.d: The radical liberal currents in parts of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] are causing local revolutionary activity.
peoples_springtime.5.b: It resides at the heart of our nation.
peoples_springtime.6.d: The international trend of radical thought and revolutionary sentiments is coming to an end.
peoples_springtime.7.d: The Revolution has brought an end to monarchial power, and crushed the counter-revolution before it could arise. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] people shall have their Republic.
peoples_springtime.7.a: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('radical_ig').GetLeader.GetLastName] cabinet will bring greater liberties yet!
peoples_springtime.7.tt: Radical leaders will be more likely to appear in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
peoples_springtime.8.d: The effort at a liberal revolution led by Radical leaders in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has been suppressed by the powers that be reasserting their power and pushing the Radicals into obscurity.
peoples_springtime.8.b: The people will not be swept up in such rabble-rousing!
peoples_springtime.8.tt: Radical leaders will be less likely to appear in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
je_springtime_of_the_peoples_reason:
Discontent with the post-Napoleonic reactionary order has exploded into a tidal wave of [GetIdeology('ideology_radical').GetName] sentiment across #b Europe#!. Liberal revolutionaries hoist tricolor flags, and cry out for liberty, equality, and fraternity.

#b To the Barricades!:#!
If a #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],liberal_movements_list_tt Liberal#! or #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],socialist_movements_list_tt Socialist#! [concept_political_movement] becomes [Concept('concept_insurrection', '$concept_insurrectionary$')] in our [Concept('concept_capital_state','$concept_capital_state_short$')] whilst this [concept_journal_entry] is active, revolutionary forces may attempt to seize power over our country.
je_springtime_of_the_peoples_tt_1: To complete with a #ITALIC Revolutionary Victory:#!
je_springtime_of_the_peoples_tt_2: To complete with a #ITALIC Reactionary Victory:#!
je_springtime_of_the_peoples_tt_3: If completed with a #ITALIC Revolutionary Victory:#!\nTriggers the event #variable $peoples_springtime.7.t$#!
je_springtime_of_the_peoples_tt_4: If completed with a #ITALIC Reactionary Victory:#!\nTriggers the event #variable $peoples_springtime.8.t$#!
springtime_of_the_peoples_timer_tt: The following has been true for #b 12#! consecutive months (currently #v [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('springtime_timer_var').GetValue]#!):
springtime_of_the_peoples_timer_dummy_tt: The following has been true for #b 12#! consecutive months:
je_suffragists_reason: The rise of the Suffragist movement, calling for the voting franchise to be extended to eligible female citizens, has become a prominent feature of the contemporary political landscape.
suffragist_events.9.d: Women in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] have begun organizing to campaign for their right to vote in general elections. [SCOPE.sCharacter('suffragette_agitator_scope').GetFullName] of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('suffragist_ig').GetName] has emerged as a leading figure of this movement.
suffragist_events.10.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is holding its first election since the voting franchise was extended to women, marking the beginning of a new era in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] democracy.
suffragist_events.10.f: Dropping her vote into the ballot box was, in a way, an anticlimactic moment. Getting there had felt like a real political struggle. It had been loud, disobedient, sometimes violent. The reward was this quiet, orderly exercise of power. Once again, she was a loyal citizen; only the expectations had changed.\n\nThen again, perhaps this was what power felt like. Perhaps that was what made it insidious. She wondered if this had been how those who had denied her this up until now had felt. For a fleeting moment, she hoped she would not get used to it.
suffragist_events.10.a: The worker's movement must continue to fight for equality!
suffragist_events.10.b: Equality is part of our intellectual tradition.
suffragist_events.10.c: Everyone must change with the times.
suffragist_events.10.e: A great victory for the suffragists!
suffragist_events.1.d: Activists led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('suffragist_leader').GetFullName] have gathered to protest the lack of voting rights for women in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
suffragist_events.1.b: Round up and arrest these troublemakers.
suffragist_events.2.d: Proponents of women’s suffrage have come to speak before [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('country_legislature_name')] to argue for their cause, prompting ridicule from [SCOPE.sCharacter('anti_feminist_leader').GetFullName], who argues women have no place in the halls of governance.
suffragist_events.2.f: Realizing that waiting for the room to go quiet would be a fruitless exercise in patience, [SCOPE.sCharacter('suffragist_leader').GetFullNameNoFormatting] spoke forcefully:\n\n
suffragist_events.2.a: Who could deny these brave souls the chance to set our country right?
suffragist_events.2.b: Such a hostile tone is a sign that the fairer sex is not ready for political discourse.
suffragist_events.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('anti_feminist_leader').GetFullName], a prominent opponent of voting rights for women, has been the target of an act of arson by proponents of this cause.
suffragist_events.3.a: Arrest the leader behind this dangerous movement!
suffragist_events.3.a.tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('militant_suffragist_leader').GetFullName] will be imprisoned for three years.
suffragist_events.3.b: Prosecute those directly responsible for the attack.
suffragist_events.4.d: An activist seeking to bring attention to the cause of women’s suffrage has died in an incident at a derby, killed by a race horse belonging to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName].
suffragist_events.4.a: No one would have had to die for this cause if these basic rights had been granted!
suffragist_events.4.b: We won't extend political sympathy to such reckless behavior.
suffragist_events.5.d: Many suffragists who have been arrested during their political activities have gone on hunger strike to protest their imprisonment.
suffragist_events.5.a: Implement a policy of force feeding hunger strikers.
suffragist_events.5.b: Release prisoners until they return to better health, then return them.
suffragist_events.6.d: The practice of releasing prisoners who go on hunger strike and arresting them again when their health improves is being criticized as cruel and absurd.
suffragist_events.7.t: Declaration of the Rights of Woman
suffragist_events.7.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('suffragist_philosopher').GetFullName] has written a work arguing for the political and civic rights of women, presenting a vision for equality between the sexes in the political sphere.
suffragist_events.7.a: This tract should be widely disseminated.
suffragist_events.7.c: Other political leaders should study this.
suffragist_events.8.d: A convention on the rights of women is being held in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName]. The organizers are determined to pursue extended property and social rights for women, but are debating whether to extend their ambitions to the political arena.
suffragist_events.8.a: Voting is a fundamental right which must be pursued!
suffragist_events.8.b: Incremental change is a safer path to progress.
treatise_on_the_rights_of_women: Treatise on The Rights of Women
secession_events.1.d: A manifesto laying out the arguments for [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] independence has started to spread in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
secession_events.1.a: Start a propaganda campaign to counter these arguments.
secession_events.2.d: The government has received requests from the [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] to provide translations of some official documents to their language.
secession_events.2.a: It is important that these documents are accessible to all.
secession_events.2.b: They should learn the official language.
secession_events.3.d: A [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] politician with secessionist sympathies has risen to prominence in the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('secessionist_ig').GetName].
secessionist_leader_tt: A [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] [concept_politician] will assume leadership of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('secessionist_ig').GetName]
secession_events.4.d: Proponents of the [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] secession movement have gathered for a public protest.
secession_events.4.f: As the crowd began to gather, a tension seemed apparent among onlookers and passers-by, more than that which would usually be expected at the sight of a political rally. Perhaps the agenda of national independence stirred up thoughts about civil war, or perhaps—more likely—it was simply the unfamiliar feeling of finding themselves outnumbered even momentarily by [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetNameNoFormatting] people.
secession_events.5.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('secessionist_leader').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('secessionist_ig').GetName], one of our nation's most prominent [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] figures, has spoken out in favor of an independent [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] nation.
secession_events.5.a: Tell the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('secessionist_ig').GetName] to keep this traitor in check!
secession_events.5.c: Perhaps it's time that this movement is heard.
secession_events.6.d: Pointing to the discrimination [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] people suffer under [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] laws, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('secessionist_ig').GetName] argue they should have the right to self-determination.
secession_events.6.a: Treasonous slander of our justice system!
secession_events.6.b: It's undeniable that they are not treated equally.
secession_events.7.d: The performance of an opera with nationalist revolutionary themes at an upcoming festival is being openly associated with the [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] secession movement by its proponents.
secession_events.8.d: The militant wing of the [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] secession movement have claimed responsibility for an explosion at a government building, announcing that the time for open war is rapidly approaching.
secession_events.8.a: Our very nation is threatened by the [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetNameNoFormatting] menace.
secession_events.8.b: We will not let this loathsome act ruin the fragile peace we have.
secession_events.9.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('secessionist_leader').GetFullName], a prominent [SCOPE.sCulture('secessionist_culture').GetName] political leader, has become a symbol for their independence movement. Senior intelligence officials have devised a plan for dealing with [SCOPE.sCharacter('secessionist_leader').GetLastName] quietly to set back their cause.
secession_events.9.a: A convenient end to an inconvenient [SCOPE.sCharacter('secessionist_leader').GetWomanMan].
secession_events.9.b: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is not in the business of murdering its citizens.
oil_rush.1.d: The discovery of oil in [ROOT.GetState.GetName] is causing people to flock to the state, hoping to find jobs in this booming industry.
oil_rush.1.a: Encourage this trend. Oil is the future!
oil_rush.1.b: Progress is best tempered with caution.
oil_rush.1.c: Always! Always encourage an oil rush, wherever it is found.
oil_rush.1.e: Caution is always wise, no matter the time or place.
always_oil_rush_tt: This event will be hidden in the future, and the above effects will be applied automatically whenever there is an oil rush in a [concept_state].
always_oil_caution_tt: This event will be hidden in the future, and the above effects will be applied automatically whenever there is an oil rush in a  [concept_state].
oil_rush.2.d: With the groundwork of the [SCOPE.sState('oil_state').GetName] oil industry complete, its appeal and promise is waning among those seeking to carve out their own fortune.
oil_rush.3.d: Blowouts, oil fires and other lethal accidents are becoming more common as the hunt for oil in [ROOT.GetState.GetName] grows more ruthless.
oil_rush.3.a: Where there is oil, there will be blood.
oil_rush.3.b: Pressure the owners to take a more careful approach.
oil_rush.4.d: Oil companies operating in [ROOT.GetState.GetName] have requesting government assistance in funding a pipeline, promising that its construction will be accompanied by other infrastructure improvements.
oil_rush.4.a: We will contribute to the funding of this project.
oil_rush.4.b: This is not in budget for [ROOT.GetState.GetOwner.GetName]
oil_rush.5.d: An inquiry has revealed that government politician [SCOPE.sCharacter('bribed_politician').GetFullName]'s recent wealth has been accumulated through bribes from oil companies, allowing them to lease land without bidding.
oil_rush.5.a: We must make an example of all parties in this scandal.
oil_rush.5.tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('bribed_politician').GetFullName] receives a harsh sentence and is forced to resign.
oil_rush.5.b: An elected official abusing [SCOPE.sCharacter('bribed_politician').GetHerHis] position is a severe crime.
oil_rush.5.c: Corporate leaders undermining our government cannot be allowed to walk free.
oil_rush.5.e: Even great people make mistakes. This can all be settled with some fines.
discrimination_events.1.d.culture: Despite not enjoying full rights under [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] law, some wealthier [SCOPE.sPop('discriminated_culture_pop').GetCulture.GetName] people have begun moving into neighborhoods and frequenting establishments they would normally be excluded from.
discrimination_events.1.d.religion: Despite not enjoying full rights under [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] law, some wealthier [SCOPE.sPop('discriminated_religion_pop').GetReligion.GetName] people have begun moving into neighborhoods and frequenting establishments they would normally be excluded from.
discrimination_events.1.a: We may need some new regulations to keep the peace.
discrimination_events.1.b: They have fairly earned their success, with all it entails.
discrimination_events.2.d.culture: Humiliated by our recent military defeat, many people have directed the blame at the [SCOPE.sPop('discriminated_culture_pop').GetCulture.GetName] in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], claiming that they betrayed our war effort on the home front.
discrimination_events.2.d.religion: Humiliated by our recent military defeat, many people have directed the blame at the [SCOPE.sPop('discriminated_religion_pop').GetReligion.GetName] in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], claiming that they betrayed our war effort on the home front.
discrimination_events.2.f: He slammed down the glass. Suddenly the shift from bitterness to full-blown rage on his face was complete all at once.\n\n
discrimination_events.2.a: It must be so! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] would never lose a fair fight.
discrimination_events.2.b: We must accept this failure as our own.
discrimination_events.3.d: [SCOPE.sCulture('discriminated_culture').GetName] students sometimes use their native language in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] schools. Some have called for teachers to penalize the use of these languages, forcing children to speak the official language of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
discrimination_events.3.a: School should teach them to speak the proper language!
discrimination_events.3.b: Their language is part of their heritage.
discrimination_events.4.d: Factories in [SCOPE.sState('discrimination_state').GetName] have been reported to be placing [SCOPE.sCulture('discriminated_culture_pop').GetName] people into roles with incredibly poor work conditions, owing to their status as second class citizens in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
discrimination_events.4.b: They are lucky that they are given any job at all.
industrial_barriers_b_tt: All [SCOPE.sCountry('home_country').GetAdjective] states get a #RED -2#! [concept_sol] Modifier for [SCOPE.sCulture('discriminated_culture_pop').GetName]
africa_colonial_events.1.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s growing colonial empire in Africa along with new means to prevent malaria has made us a serious contender for colonial control of the continent.
africa_colonial_events.1.a: Bring out the maps and the straightedges!
africa_colonial_events.2.d: Our colonial efforts in Africa have borne fruit, claiming a sizeable part of the continent for our own designs.
africa_colonial_events.2.a: This is only the beginning of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] empire!
africa_colonial_events.4.d: A group of Christian missionaries want to bring the salvation of the Gospels to our colony in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state').GetName].
africa_colonial_events.4.a: Spreading the true faith is a vital part of the colonial project!
africa_colonial_events.4.b: We are there for the glory of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], not the glory of God.
africa_colonial_events.5.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('anti_slave_trade_ig_leader').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anti_slave_trade_ig').GetName] and a well-known opponent of the global slave trade, argues that our colonial ambitions in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state').GetName] should be leveraged towards ending the practice on the continent.
africa_colonial_events.5.a: We have a duty to end slavery wherever our power reaches!
africa_colonial_events.5.a.tt: Commitment to this goal may lead to other events later.
africa_colonial_events.5.b: Practical diplomacy must supersede such moralist sentiments.
africa_colonial_events.5.c: The local slave trade could be a good source of workforce for our local projects!
africa_colonial_events.6.d: Despite our proclaimed goal of ending the slave trade in Africa, recent reports suggest that laborers in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state').GetName] are, in all but name, slaves under our own colonial administration.
africa_colonial_events.6.f: The young man, who had been scribbling furiously, suddenly seemed lightheaded and gestured to the interpreter to stop.\n
africa_colonial_events.6.a: This is utter hypocrisy. These abuses must end!
africa_colonial_events.6.b: It may seem similar, but the hard work we provide builds character.
africa_colonial_events.7.d: Intellectuals from [SCOPE.sC('visiting_colonized_country').GetName] are visiting our capital, arguing the case that their home country is far more civilized than we make it out to be and that our colonial designs on them are unjustified.
africa_colonial_events.7.a: It's all affectations and lies. Send them back immediately.
africa_colonial_events.7.b: Perhaps there is some value in hearing their perspective.
africa_colonial_events.51.d: A [SCOPE.sC('african_colony_conflict_recipient').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] expedition in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state_sender').GetName] has encountered our own troops, suggesting their colonial ambitions in the region are in conflict with our own.
africa_colonial_events.51.a: They must turn back at once!
africa_colonial_events.51.b: There is enough land for everyone in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state_sender').GetName]!
africa_colonial_events.52.d: One of our colonial expeditions in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state_recipient').GetName] has encountered [SCOPE.sC('african_colony_conflict_sender').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] troops in the region. [SCOPE.sC('african_colony_conflict_recipient').GetName] demands we turn back and abandon our designs on [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state_recipient').GetName].
africa_colonial_events.52.f: Until instructions arrived from [SCOPE.sC('african_colony_conflict_sender').GetCapital.GetNameNoFormatting] and [SCOPE.sC('african_colony_conflict_recipient').GetCapital.GetNameNoFormatting], they seemed determined to maintain a jovial mood despite the nominal standoff. The [SCOPE.sC('african_colony_conflict_sender').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] officer uncorked a bottle of [SCOPE.sCountry('african_colony_conflict_sender').GetCustom('alcohol')] and proposed a toast. Reluctantly, the [SCOPE.sC('african_colony_conflict_recipient').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] commander took the glass.\n
africa_colonial_events.52.b: They have soldiers. We only have arguments.
africa_colonial_events.53.d: Colonists having moved to [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state').GetName] hoping to build a new life in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s new African territories are struggling to survive in the unfamiliar environment.
africa_colonial_events.53.a: We will supply them with what they need.
africa_colonial_events.53.b: The colonial administration should assist them.
africa_colonial_events.53.c: The African colonies are for survivors, not charity cases!
africa_colonial_events.54.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('african_colony_claim_conflict_recipient').GetName] appears to be disregarding our [concept_claim] on colonial projects in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_claim_state').GetName]. If given a stern enough reminder, they may be convinced to cede it to us.
africa_colonial_events.54.a: The maps are clear. The colony is ours!
africa_colonial_events.54.b: Let's not make an incident out of some lines on a paper.
africa_colonial_events.55.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('african_colony_claim_conflict_sender').GetName] has taken notice of our colony in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_claim_state').GetName], attempting to enforce their [concept_claim] on the region by demanding we cede the colony to them.
africa_colonial_events.55.a: What does a claim matter when we got there first?
africa_colonial_events.55.b: A simple misunderstanding! They shall have it.
refused_pledge_to_end_slave_trade: Refused Pledge to End Slave Trade
je_scramble_for_africa_reason: We have joined the colonial powers vying for control over the African continent, determined to carve out our own colonial empire.
scramble_for_africa_0_states: We have lost ground in our African colonies, but still have hope to retain our former glory.
scramble_for_africa_3_states: Our colonial empire in Africa is still in its infancy, but shows enough promise for us to be considered an important player in the region.
scramble_for_africa_4_states: Our colonial empire in Africa has grown beyond its humble origins, showing promise for future ambitions.
scramble_for_africa_6_states: We are close to achieving our ambition of establishing a large, permanent colonial empire on the African continent.
notification_colonial_conflict_demands_r: [SCOPE.sCountry('african_colony_conflict_recipient').GetName] has refused to back down and maintains their right to expand their colony in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state_recipient').GetName].
