notification_colonial_conflict_region_de: [SCOPE.sCountry('african_colony_conflict_recipient').GetName] has backed down from their expansion in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state_recipient').GetName], giving us a [concept_claim] on their colony.
[SCOPE.sCountry('african_colony_conflict_recipient').GetName] has failed to acknowledge our rightful claim to the colony in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_state_recipient').GetName].
notification_colonial_conflict_claim_dem: [SCOPE.sCountry('african_colony_claim_conflict_recipient').GetName] has refused to acknowledge our claim and maintains their right to keep the colony in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_claim_state').GetName].
[SCOPE.sCountry('african_colony_claim_conflict_recipient').GetName] has acknowledged our rightful claim and ceded their colony in [SCOPE.sState('african_colony_claim_state').GetName] to us.
je_pumpjacks_reason: We have only begun to discover the applications of oil, but we have discovered some supply of it. We must tap into it without delay.
je_electrical_generation_reason: There are those who claim that in the future, electricity could be used to power everything. Whether or not those dreams will come true, there is already plenty of use for it in industries. Where there is demand, we must make supply.
production_tech_events.401.d: The recent expansion of the [SCOPE.sBuilding('oil_rig_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('oil_rig_state').GetName] has boosted confidence in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s future as an oil producer.
production_tech_events.401.a: Get every drop from those wells!
production_tech_events.401.b: We'll find more things to put oil in!
production_tech_events.402.d: The recent expansion of the [SCOPE.sBuilding('power_plant_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('power_plant_state').GetName] has inspired faith in a future where all of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is electrified.
production_tech_events.402.b: All technology must be leveraged towards better trains.
production_tech_events.402.c: There must be other ways to produce electricity.
production_tech_events.402.e: With the light on around the clock, why should the work ever stop?
camera_film_pm_events.1.d: The interest in photographic arts throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has spawned many new artistic movements experimenting with the technology.
camera_film_pm_events.1.a: This should be the new tool of news reporters everywhere!
camera_film_pm_events.1.b: It should be used to capture the beauty of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
camera_film_pm_events.1.c: We should put our efforts towards making these pictures come alive.
camera_film_pm_events.2.d: The acquisition of film recording equipment and establishment of movie theaters throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has led to a fledgling film industry taking root.
camera_film_pm_events.2.f: When she was a young girl, she had once been allowed to borrow a phenakistiscope and found herself transfixed by the spinning disc, by the dancing couple seemingly turning round and round on it. Years later, she had thought it a child's fancy, a simple illusion for a malleable mind. \n\nHowever, as she saw the projection of the train entering the station, she felt herself transported back to that moment. The magic was real again.
camera_film_pm_events.2.a: Film is the perfect tool to capture the harsh reality of our age.
camera_film_pm_events.2.b: Cinema shall be the frontier of storytelling!
camera_film_pm_events.2.c: What political uses could we find for such an evocative medium?
je_camera_reason: From its origins as a technological novelty, the photographic camera is becoming a tool for artists to portray the world. We should be at the forefront of this new art form.
je_film_reason: The technology of recording and projecting moving pictures presents a fascinating opportunity for both new artistic ambitions and mass communication, which we should seize upon by laying the groundwork for this new industry throughout the country.
famine_political.d: The famine in [SCOPE.sState('famine_state').GetName] has sparked criticism of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s economic policy of
famine_political.1.d: $famine_political.d$ Traditionalism, with its opposition to international trade and refusal to change with the times.
famine_political.1.a: Maintaining traditions should not cost lives!
famine_political.1.b: Peasants have starved in every era. Such is the way of the world.
famine_political.2.d: $famine_political.d$ Isolationism, with its refusal to accept goods from other countries.
famine_political.2.a: We need to begin making exceptions.
famine_political.2.b: We shall be self-sufficient, no matter the cost.
famine_political.3.d: $famine_political.d$ Mercantilism, with its focus on export-heavy trade.
famine_political.3.a: Indispensable imports must be secured, even under mercantilism.
famine_political.3.b: What do the poor know of national economy?
famine_political.4.d: $famine_political.d$ Free Trade, with its resignation to market forces.
famine_political.4.a: We can put our hand on the scales if it saves lives.
famine_political.4.b: Markets set prices fairly; pay or die.
famine_political.5.d: $famine_political.d$ Command Economy, with its reliance on government planning.
famine_political.5.a: We must accept our failure and open our economy.
slave_owner_paranoia_reason: A low, but noticeable level of turmoil among slaves in some states has caused slaveholders to grow increasingly concerned about the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('slave_revolt_movement_scope').GetName]. They have begun a harsh crackdown against the slightest signs of rebellion amongst the enslaved populace.
slave_owner_paranoia_radicalization_high: There is a clear and present risk of a #b slave revolt#!.
slave_owner_paranoia_radicalization_mid: Slaveholders are paying close attention to rumors of a #b slave revolt#!.
slave_owner_paranoia_radicalization_low: Fears of a #b slave revolt#! persist, though unlikely.
slave_owner_paranoia_events.1.d: A small group of people have been caught instigating a slave revolt in [SCOPE.sState('small_conspiracy_state').GetName]. However, local slaveholders believe this to be signs of a much wider-reaching conspiracy and demand suspects punished.
slave_owner_paranoia_events.1.a: We cannot take any risk with such subversive activities.
slave_owner_paranoia_events.1.b: Such ruthlessness would be better applied to exorcising your own demons.
slave_owner_paranoia_events.2.d: Small communities of fugitive slaves, hidden away in remote areas of [SCOPE.sState('hidden_communities_state').GetName], have become targets of local slaveholders fearing they could assist in potential uprisings.
slave_owner_paranoia_events.2.f: He took the first watch. Soon, small nighttime sounds became distinguishable from what had at first felt like complete silence. Sounds of the trees and the marshland, wind and water; safe sounds.\n\nHe had always liked to listen to the night. Even back at the plantation, this silence, or as close to it as you ever got, had been a source of solace. Now, however, it meant something more: Every night of silence was another night of freedom.
slave_owner_paranoia_events.2.a: The very existence of such places undermines the authority of our institutions!
slave_owner_paranoia_events.2.b: What would they expect to accomplish by hunting down people in the middle of nowhere?
slave_owner_paranoia_events.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('visiting_abolitionist_scope').GetFullName] from the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('visiting_abolitionist_ig').GetName] has been touring [SCOPE.sState('visiting_abolitionist_state').GetName] recently, both gathering testimonies for and propagating the abolitionist cause. Slaveholders in the state view this as an attempt to agitate a violent revolt among slaves and demand [SCOPE.sCharacter('visiting_abolitionist_scope').GetLastName] be expelled from the state at once.
slave_owner_paranoia_events.3.b: Speaking about liberty and justice must always be permitted.
welfare_laws.1.d: The prospect of workhouses including religious instruction in their work has allowed the proposal of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] to gain favor with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName].
welfare_laws.1.a: Religious practices are key to the moral discipline the poor need!
welfare_laws.1.b: Moral principles can be instilled without the help of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetNameNoFormatting].
welfare_laws.2.d: Some intellectuals are warning that if the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] are not passed, an increasing population of unproductive poor will become an unmaintainable burden on society.
welfare_laws.2.a: A firm hand is required to stave off such disaster.
welfare_laws.2.b: This fearmongering makes the law seem outright inhumane.
welfare_laws.2.c: We must take the time to make better arguments known.
welfare_laws.3.d: Some social reformers among the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] have spoken out against the proposed [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], viewing them as an attempt to make poverty itself a crime.
welfare_laws.3.a: The poor are a burden on society, a crime in itself.
welfare_laws.3.b: There must be ways for this new system to respect personal liberty.
welfare_laws.4.d: A child who grew up in a workhouse institution spoke before [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('country_legislature_name')] today, detailing the conditions there and urging the abolition of the Poor Laws.
welfare_laws.4.a: More of these children must be heard!
welfare_laws.4.b: This makes the point well enough.
welfare_laws.5.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_ig').GetName] are concerned that, without the workhouses watching over the poor, they will be lacking the guidance they see as necessary for the lower classes.
welfare_laws.5.a: The poor are no more in need of guidance than the rich.
welfare_laws.5.b: The whip cracks out of love!
welfare_laws.6.d: The closing of workhouses with the abolition of the Poor Laws has some citizens concerned about increased crime rates as the poorest members of society will no longer be contained in these institutions.
welfare_laws.6.a: This fear of the poor is exactly what caused this inhumane law!
welfare_laws.6.b: These people have a right to feel safe from indigent drifters.
welfare_laws.8.d: Old veterans have spoken out in favor of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], rallying many in the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_ig').GetName] to support the reform.
welfare_laws.8.a: Military veterans are our highest priority in this new pension system.
welfare_laws.8.b: All workers serve their country in their own way.
welfare_laws.9.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_ig').GetName] are concerned about the proposed [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] reform giving the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] leverage in benefits negotiations.
welfare_laws.9.a: All the better. These should be rights, not benefits.
welfare_laws.9.b: We will work with business owners to draft acceptable reform.
welfare_laws.10.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] has recently held a speech warning against government overspending, making [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] supporters in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetInterestGroup.GetName] more skeptical of the proposed [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
welfare_laws.10.a: This proposal is about sharing the wealth, not diminishing it.
welfare_laws.10.b: It is important for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] to live within its means.
workhouse_children_outrage: Outrage Over Treatment of Workhouse Children
migration_laws.1.d: Inspired by the ongoing reform to [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('no_borders_visionary').GetFullName] of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('no_borders_visionary').GetInterestGroup.GetName] has penned a vision for a future where borders are abolished altogether.
migration_laws.1.a: This is the future we want!
migration_laws.1.b: It has the right spirit, but seems naïvely utopian.
migration_laws.2.d: The suggestion of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has caused debate among the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] about whether immigrants will share the uniquely [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] religious sensibilities.
migration_laws.2.a: We should accept immigrants who do not practice their faith as we do.
migration_laws.2.b: Perhaps we can place some restrictions to prevent this.
migration_laws.3.d: People living in [SCOPE.sState('improverished_state').GetName] under dire conditions are afraid that the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] reform will increase competition in the job market.
migration_laws.3.a: If they can't compete, they deserve to lose their jobs.
migration_laws.3.b: We will ensure that all are cared for, if it comes to that.
migration_laws.4.d: The effort to institute [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has been bolstered by a wave of antipathy towards our neighbors in [SCOPE.sC('immigrant_fear_neighbor').GetName], arguing that the reform is necessary to stop migration from there.
migration_laws.4.a: Those [SCOPE.sC('immigrant_fear_neighbor').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] swine are the exact reason for this law!
migration_laws.4.b: This is a general reform, which has nothing to do with [SCOPE.sC('immigrant_fear_neighbor').GetName].
migration_laws.5.d: Some free-trade proponents are concerned that the immigration reform towards [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] is the first steps to closing off [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] from the outside world, not just to migrants but to markets as well.
migration_laws.5.b: We will draft the law to make it clear it is not.
migration_laws.6.d: In response to the proposal of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('migrant_pop').GetName] people living in [SCOPE.sState('migrant_pop_state').GetName] have pointed out that they once immigrated there as well and that future restrictions may prevent relatives from joining them.
migration_laws.6.a: Part of the point is to stop everyone from inviting their family here!
migration_laws.6.b: This is not about the [SCOPE.sCulture('migrant_pop').GetName] at all.
je_liberalism_1_reason: A more democratic society with the right ideals will lay the groundwork for a country where the liberty of all citizens is paramount.
je_liberalism_2_reason: An open country which trades with neighbors and distant nations alike is key to a future of economic liberalism.
je_liberalism_3_reason: By allowing the word to be free, the thought will be freed with it, ushering in a new era of radical innovation and reform.
je_liberalism_4_reason: People of all races and creeds will be welcome in our free and open society!
liberalism.1.d: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('liberal_leader').GetInterestGroup.GetName], under the leadership of [SCOPE.sCharacter('liberal_leader').GetFullName], has ushered in an era of liberal politics that promises a freer society where all citizens have a part in the political process.
liberalism.1.b: Other political leaders would be wise to follow this trend!
liberalism.1.c: Perhaps a voice of reason is needed, before this gets too radical.
liberalism.2.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] market has grown famous worldwide for being welcoming and open to foreign trade.
liberalism.3.t: The Thought, the Word and the Ideal
liberalism.3.d: Those who seek to think boldly and freely are increasingly finding [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to be one of the safest places to explore their ideas.
liberalism.3.a: A utopia for the modern artist.
liberalism.3.b: A place where research is unimpeded by tradition.
liberalism.4.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has become renown around the world as a place that welcomes immigrants without discriminating.
liberalism.4.b: All will know us as a safe harbor!
education_laws.1.d: The teachers of our higher institutions of learning have offered to advise the government in the implementation of the new [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
education_laws.1.a: We'll be happy to have their help!
education_laws.1.b: Their research work is more important.
education_laws.1.c: They could be of help in finalizing the bill.
education_laws.2.d: The role of discipline in the new [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has been raised by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_ig').GetName] as an area of improvement in the plans for this new education system.
education_laws.2.a: We should focus on the curriculum.
education_laws.2.b: Working this into the school system is paramount.
education_laws.3.d: Disagreements within the government about what should be taught in the new [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] have brought implementation of the reform to a standstill.
education_laws.3.b: Take some time to work out the differences.
education_laws.3.c: Rearrange the law to create an independent body for this.
education_laws.4.d: Parents who have experience teaching children at home are offering to assist as teachers in rural areas to facilitate the new [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] system.
education_laws.4.a: It is fortunate we already have educated people!
education_laws.4.b: We must not let this distract from other work.
education_laws.4.tt: The impact of this effort is proportional to the [THIS.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [concept_literacy] in [Concept('concept_incorporated_state', '$concept_incorporated_states$')] of [THIS.GetCountry.GetIncorporatedLiteracyRate|%v]
education_laws.5.d: Debate over whether the new [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] should have separate classes for male and female students, and perhaps different curricula as well, is causing disagreements over how to implement the new education system.
education_laws.5.a: Such ideas are relics of a past age.
education_laws.5.b: We should work out two separate branches.
education_laws.6.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] have traditionally taken on some responsibility for the education in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. As the new system of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] is built, the question of their role in organizing these schools has become central to the reform.
education_laws.6.a: The organizational responsibility should be on the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName].
education_laws.6.b: We need to build a secular school system from the ground up.
citizenship_laws.1.d: Professors at the University of [SCOPE.sState('phreonology_state').GetName] believe new theories employing craniometry can be used to demonstrate racial differences, rallying support for [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
citizenship_laws.1.b: Don't waste time on this nonsense.
citizenship_laws.2.d: The debates around [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] have sparked discussion at the Art Academy in [SCOPE.sState('degenerate_art_state').GetName] about whether artistic movements influenced by [SCOPE.sCulture('degenerate_art_pop').GetName] artists have a place in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] art world.
citizenship_laws.2.b: Their work is part of our artistic legacy.
citizenship_laws.3.d: [SCOPE.sCulture('future_discriminated_pop').GetName] people have spoken out against the passing of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] legislation, arguing that they deserve the same rights as any other citizens.
citizenship_laws.3.a: They are a noxious and foreign presence!
citizenship_laws.3.b: They are part of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] society, but must be segregated.
citizenship_laws.4.d: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('supporting_ig').GetName] has been championing the passing of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], starting in their own ranks. A [SCOPE.sCulture('future_accepted_pop').GetName] politician may take over leadership in the fight for the culture's acceptance in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
citizenship_laws.4.b: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('supporting_ig').GetLeader.GetFullName]'s leadership is needed in these uncertain times.
citizenship_laws.5.d: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('discrimination_movement').GetName] has begun a propaganda campaign, painting [SCOPE.sCulture('future_accepted_pop').GetName] people as criminals who will be allowed to run rampant under the new [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
citizenship_laws.5.a: We must take a stand against these vile lies.
citizenship_laws.6.d: Some $shopkeepers$ have expressed opposition to the equal treatment of [SCOPE.sCulture('future_accepted_pop').GetName] people under the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law, announcing that they will refuse them service.
citizenship_laws.6.b: They can do what they wish with their own businesses.
distribution_of_power_laws.1.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName]'s efforts to consolidate power with [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] have been bolstered by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] natural charisma.
distribution_of_power_laws.2.d: $bureaucrats$ working to maintain many of the democratic institutions currently being dismantled in favor of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] are concerned about their future in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] regime.
distribution_of_power_laws.2.a: The dead flesh must be cut away to rejuvenate [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]!
distribution_of_power_laws.2.b: There will be a place for them in the new administration.
distribution_of_power_laws.3.d: Many people whose voice in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] political system will be silenced by the shift to [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] have gathered to protest outside of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('country_legislature_name')].
distribution_of_power_laws.3.a: They will be the first to taste how the new regime deals with dissenters!
distribution_of_power_laws.3.b: If they want to make themselves heard, they may. For now.
distribution_of_power_laws.4.d: Fearing tensions over the ongoing shift to [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('supportive_commander').GetFullName] has expressed support for the new law, promising to stand against possible attempts by the disenfranchised to stage an uprising.
distribution_of_power_laws.4.a: We need [SCOPE.sCharacter('supportive_commander').GetHerHis] support in face of the unruly masses!
distribution_of_power_laws.4.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('supportive_commander').GetSheHe|U] makes an excellent example of loyalty in our ranks!
distribution_of_power_laws.5.d: Politicians supporting the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] reform have raised the argument that it is necessary to remove the voting franchise from the lower classes, claiming that they are uneducated in political matters and ill equipped to make such decisions.\n\nThe impact of this argument is proportional to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] literacy rate of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTotalLiteracyRate|%v]
distribution_of_power_laws.5.a: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] public needs greater minds to care for it.
distribution_of_power_laws.5.b: This is foreign propaganda to slander our people!
distribution_of_power_laws.6.d: In response to the shift to [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_politician').GetFullName], a government minister of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_politician').GetInterestGroup.GetName], claims this curtailing of the franchise is at odds with [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_politician').GetHerHis] role as an elected representative.
distribution_of_power_laws.6.c: [SCOPE.sCharacter('opposing_politician').GetSheHe|U] will have to contend with a newly drawn district, then.
distribution_of_power_laws.7.d: In a show of public support for the new [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] reform, citizens in [SCOPE.sState('election_organizers_state').GetName] have offered to volunteer organizing upcoming elections.
distribution_of_power_laws.7.a: Send them out across the country!
distribution_of_power_laws.7.b: They should focus their efforts in [SCOPE.sState('election_organizers_state').GetName].
distribution_of_power_laws.8.d: The new [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] reform has led to a debate about the voting age in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
distribution_of_power_laws.8.a: A voting age of 25 should assure only responsible adults are included.
distribution_of_power_laws.8.c: A voting age of 18 is the way of the future.
distribution_of_power_laws.9.d: The [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] reform threatens the power held by many leading figures in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], some of whom are using the political connections they have to obstruct its passing.
distribution_of_power_laws.9.a: They must be ousted from their positions if they try to stop the new law!
distribution_of_power_laws.9.b: Perhaps we can collaborate with them in the creation of the new system.
distribution_of_power_laws.10.d: Proponents of the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] reform have called attention to past abuses of power by the current regime as a reason for why this change is urgently needed.
distribution_of_power_laws.10.a: Power corrupts, which is why the powerful must be held to account by the voters.
distribution_of_power_laws.10.b: The past is in the past. These issues have nothing to do with the reform.
distribution_of_power_laws.11.d: Proponents of [SCOPE.sLawType('universal_suffrage_type').GetName] have argued that the ongoing reform to [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] is an insufficient compromise, excluding many people from their right to participate in democracy.
distribution_of_power_laws.11.a: We should focus on our current reform, which is a clear improvement.
distribution_of_power_laws.11.b: [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] is a stepping stone on the road to [SCOPE.sLawType('universal_suffrage_type').GetName]!
distribution_of_power_laws.12.d: Implementing a proper voting system for the upcoming [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] elections has put a strain on the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] government's administrative capacities.
distribution_of_power_laws.12.a: We will use resources from other administrative branches, if necessary.
distribution_of_power_laws.12.b: We will simply have to take our time.
je_warlord_china_reason: The status of the #bold Progress Bar#! will #tooltippable;tooltip:[Country.GetTooltipTag],je_warlord_china_special_tooltip_advance advance#! or #tooltippable;tooltip:[Country.GetTooltipTag],je_warlord_china_special_tooltip_deplete retreat#! based on certain conditions. The #bold Progress Bar#! reaching #variable 0%#! will lead to the total loss of the central government's control, and the seizure of power by despotic local authorities.\n\nDespite a period of temporary stability under the Yongzheng and Qianlong Emperors, China has embarked upon a steady slide towards collapse at the hands of rebellions, mismanagement, and external pressure. If the authority of the central government is sufficiently eroded, local military powers within [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] threaten to tear the country apart into petty fiefdoms.
je_warlord_china_special_tooltip_deplete:
The following conditions will #bold deplete#! the #bold Progress Bar#!:
• Losing the #BOLD Opium Wars#!
• Failing to stop the appearance of the #BOLD Heavenly Kingdom#!
• Failing to retake the #BOLD Heavenly Kingdom#!
• Failing the #BOLD Boxer Rebellion#!
• Going into debt and taking any [concept_loans]
• Having a [concept_civil_war]
• Becoming a [concept_subject] under another country
• Abolishing the [GetLawType('law_monarchy').GetName]$warlord_china_coup_loc$
je_warlord_china_special_tooltip_advance:
The following conditions will #bold advance#! the #bold Progress Bar#!:
• Winning the #BOLD Opium Wars#!
• Ceasing to be an [concept_unrecognized_power]
• Finishing the #BOLD Stamp Out Monarchism#! [concept_journal_entry]
warlord_china_explosion_point_add_desc: The #BOLD Fragile Unity#! of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has been strengthened.
warlord_china_explosion_point_remove_des: The #BOLD Fragile Unity#! of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has been weakened further.
china_abolished_monarchy_tt: Successfully concluded the #BOLD Stamp Out Monarchism#! Journal Entry
doctrine_of_lapse_desc: We should use any means necessary, legal or illegal, to appropriate more land for the Company.
doctrine_of_lapse_cooldown_tt: Has not invoked the Doctrine of Lapse for 2 years
raj.3.d: Officials have raised concerns that a new type of rifle due to be issued to our troops use cartridge grease which may include tallow and lard, taboo in Hindu and Muslim faiths.
raj.3.a: We must make modifications immediately to avoid outrage.
raj.3.b: The soldiers won't find out anyway, will they?
raj.4.d: Due to proscriptions in the [SCOPE.sReligion('hindu_pop').GetName] faith against crossing seas, soldiers have been allowed an exemption from overseas service in the past. Some administrators now argue that this exception should be removed.
raj.4.a: It is necessary to account for these local traditions.
raj.4.b: They must serve wherever they are needed!
raj.5.d: The presence of [SCOPE.sReligion('suspected_missionaries').GetName] $clergymen$ in [SCOPE.sState('missionaries_suspicion_state').GetName] has caused some locals to suspect that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is planning to attempt converting people to Christianity.
raj.5.a: It couldn't be further from the truth.
raj.5.b: If they are there to promote their faith, they may do so.
raj.6.d: After a long time of brewing opposition to Company rule, soldiers and other locals have risen up to proclaim the restoration of the Mughal Emperor to power in northern India.
raj.7.a: The Company is over, but the Empire lives on.
je_corn_laws_reason: Our prohibitive import tax on grains acts as a strong protectionist policy for the interests of the landowning class and will cause an upheaval if removed.
corn_laws.1.d: The import tax on grain known as the Corn Laws has been abolished, signifying a political shift away from mercantilism and landowner power.
corn_laws.2.d: A new figure has risen in the ranks of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('pb_ig').GetName], organizing an innovative pressure campaign in support of abolishing the Corn Laws.
corn_laws.2.b: Rabble-rousing will not change this policy.
corn_laws.3.d: The Corn Laws, our taxes on grain imports, have afforded the landowning classes a great deal of economic leverage which they use to maintain their influence on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] policy.
corn_laws.3.a: Every country needs an aristocracy to rule its lessers.
corn_laws.4.d: Our prohibitive import tax on cereal grains has made it difficult for the poor to afford bread, with people in [SCOPE.sState('bread_buying_state').GetName] approaching the starvation line.
corn_laws.4.a: The poor, too, must reap the benefits of our policies.
corn_laws.4.b: They must bear with it, for the economy.
state_in_africa_desc: The state is located on the African continent.
meiji.7.d: In order to expedite our ambitions to build a railway network, it has been suggested that foreign advisors from countries with established railway systems could be brought in to help.
meiji.7.e: We have no need of foreign advice.
meiji.8.d: Being privy to the government's ambition to expand [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s railways, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_ig').GetName] have offered to support these efforts in [SCOPE.sState('military_railway_state').GetName].
meiji.8.a: An excellent collaboration between military and industry!
meiji.8.b: We will set the priorities ourselves.
meiji.9.d: As the special privileges of the samurai class diminish, their special right to carry swords as a status symbol has been called into question.
meiji.9.a: It's time for this right to be abolished.
meiji.9.b: The right could be extended to other citizens of status.
meiji.9.c: To take a samurai's sword would be to tear out his soul!
meiji.10.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetFullName] has begun organizing private military academies in [SCOPE.sState('kyushu_state').GetName], not only teaching military theory, but [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetHerHis] own political ideas.
meiji.10.a: They provide a valuable service to our armed forces.
meiji.10.b: They must be shut down before this political faction gets dangerous.
meiji.11.d: [SCOPE.sC('infringing_country').GetName] has attempted to force open one of our harbors, demanding access to the port in [SCOPE.sState('infringed_port_state').GetName].
meiji.11.a: Fight back! Sakoku must be protected.
meiji.11.b: Negotiate to meet some of their demands.
meiji.11.c: Perhaps [SCOPE.sC('assistance_country').GetName] could help mediate this difficult situation.
meiji.12.d: A recently published articles has debated where [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s future lies after the end of sakoku, weighing the benefits of aligning with other Asian counties or turning to the United States and the European powers.
meiji.12.a: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] must leave Asia behind and look to the Western powers.
meiji.12.b: We will stand with our neighboring nations.
meiji.12.c: The future is uncertain. We must be prepared for anything.
election_liberal_events.1.d: In their campaign for the upcoming election, the [SCOPE.sParty('liberal_party').GetName] have directed criticism at the [SCOPE.sParty('conservative_party').GetName] for allowing [SCOPE.sCharacter('extremist_leader').GetFullName] among their ranks, pointing to [SCOPE.sCharacter('extremist_leader').GetHerHis] far-right views as an example of the party accommodating extremists.
election_liberal_events.1.a: Far from the traditional [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] values they claim.
election_liberal_events.2.d: The anarchist political group [SCOPE.sParty('anarchist_party').GetName]'s rise to prominence has been invoked in the [SCOPE.sParty('liberal_party').GetName] election campaign, casting themselves as the more reasonable alternative.
election_liberal_events.2.b: A corrupt system cannot be reformed; it must be overthrown.
election_liberal_events.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('pacifist_leader').GetFullName], a well-known pacifist, has campaigned for the [SCOPE.sParty('liberal_party').GetName] in the upcoming election on a platform of a more peaceful foreign policy than the warmongering [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has become known for.
election_liberal_events.3.a: We are a peaceful nation now.
election_liberal_events.3.b: Our enemies should not stop fearing us, today or ever.
election_liberal_events.4.d: The high prices on [SCOPE.sGoods('expensive_good').GetName] have become a prominent talking point in the [SCOPE.sParty('free_trade_campaign_party').GetName] election campaign, arguing that their free trade policies would drive down the price.
election_liberal_events.4.a: This is the age of the global market!
election_liberal_events.4.b: Our current policies are needed to keep the economy stable.
election_conservative_events.1.d: The [SCOPE.sParty('liberal_party').GetName]'s endorsement of [SCOPE.sCharacter('atheist_leader').GetFullName] has come under attack by the [SCOPE.sParty('conservative_party').GetName] campaign, arguing that a leader who rejects religion can not be trusted to keep promises or maintain a sound moral compass.
election_conservative_events.1.a: Those so poor in spirit cannot lead [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
election_conservative_events.1.b: Perhaps [SCOPE.sCharacter('atheist_leader').GetLastName] sees things clearer unfettered by religious dogma.
election_conservative_events.2.d: In the light of the [concept_devastation] suffered by states like [SCOPE.sState('devastation_state').GetName], the [SCOPE.sParty('conservative_party').GetName] has campaigned on uniting [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] in this trying time behind traditional values.
election_conservative_events.2.a: We must come together during this difficult time.
election_conservative_events.3.d: Pointing to the rampant [concept_turmoil] from radical activities in [SCOPE.sState('turmoil_state').GetName], the [SCOPE.sParty('conservative_party').GetName] has campaigned on the platform of more policing.
election_conservative_events.3.a: This wound has been allowed to fester for too long.
election_conservative_events.3.b: The key to preventing crime is to prevent poverty.
election_conservative_events.4.d: Our neighbors in [SCOPE.sCountry('election_threatening_neighbor').GetName] have become known for their ruthless foreign policy, a concern that the [SCOPE.sParty('hawk_campaign_party').GetName] has raised in their election campaign, promising to be harsher in turn to deter aggression.
election_conservative_events.4.b: They are just looking for a target for their posturing.
election_moderate_events.1.d: The rise of far-left and far-right political parties in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has led [SCOPE.sParty('moderate_party').GetName] to portray themselves as the voice of reason in the upcoming election, a moderate centrist alternative to extremism.
election_moderate_events.1.a: A sensible and stable option for voters.
election_moderate_events.1.b: On the contrary, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] politics could use some shaking up!
election_moderate_events.2.d: The rise of communism in powerful countries like [SCOPE.sCountry('communist_country').GetName] has become a talking point in the [SCOPE.sParty('moderate_party').GetName] election campaign, warning against a similar homegrown movement.
election_moderate_events.2.a: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] streets will not run red, with blood or otherwise!
election_moderate_events.2.b: The international worker's movement cannot be stopped by parliamentarians.
je_dreadnoughts_reason: It is clear that these large, impressive ships are taken as a measure of naval power in peacetime, but how do they fare in an actual war?
je_destroyers_reason: Although our destroyer escorts provide theoretical safety, we will not fully know how to use them until they have been deployed in an armed conflict.
je_battleships_reason: Modern battleships are becoming increasingly complex. Can their impact in a real war hold up to their theoretical power?
naval_tech_events.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('dreadnought_tech_commander').GetFullName] has successfully deployed our impressive dreadnoughts in the ongoing conflict, proving that they are not mere vanity projects for the navy.
naval_tech_events.1.b: Now we know how to use them effectively, even in peacetime.
naval_tech_events.2.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('destroyer_tech_commander').GetFullName] has made use of destroyer ships in the ongoing conflict, teaching us much about how they are best utilized.
naval_tech_events.2.a: No one will dare to attack our convoys now!
naval_tech_events.2.b: They make up an important part of our fleets.
naval_tech_events.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('battleship_tech_commander').GetFullName]'s use of battleships during the ongoing war has demonstrated that these massive constructions may still serve a purpose in modern naval warfare.
naval_tech_events.3.f: The young girl looked wide-eyed at the ship floating in the harbor.\n\n
naval_tech_events.3.a: Their presence will be a compelling argument.
naval_tech_events.3.b: By their might we will rule the seas!
naval_tech_events.3.c: We will put this tactical experience to good use.
je_flamethrowers_reason: Our new invention, the modern flamethrower, is yet to be thoroughly tested in a real conflict. Its power to terrify should not be underestimated.
flamethrowers_event.1.d: Although a situational weapon, the flamethrower is proving effective in the [SCOPE.sWar('flamethrowers_event_war').GetName] as support in close range trench warfare.
flamethrowers_event.1.a: It should strike fear into the hearts of our enemies.
flamethrowers_event.1.b: It should be deployed where it can efficiently flush out soldiers.
slavery_law_events.7.d: With years having passed since the passage of [SCOPE.sLaw('slavery_banned_scope').GetName], pro-slavery ideals among the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('slaver_ig').GetName] have faded significantly.
slavery_law_events.7.f: In the echoing manor halls of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('slaver_ig').GetNameNoFormatting]' domain, the words which had once lambasted the government for their tyranny in taking their slaves had begun to shift. Now, instead of open condemnations and calls for the restoration of the institution, there were suggestions for alternatives - sharecropping, the use of prisoners, a dozen different means of disenfranchisement to restore what they saw as the natural order.\n\nBut none dared to raise the idea of openly flaunting the decree - not now, at least, when the government seemed vigilant, and the formerly enslaved were still wary. For now, at least, they would simply work with what they had.
slavery_law_events.7.a: Now is the time to come together and forgive.
slavery_law_events.7.b: We cannot forget the perpetrators of this crime.
victoria.1.d: The King is dead. With the ascension of his young niece [SCOPE.sCharacter('queen_victoria').GetFirstName], the realm rejoices and the crown of Hanover passes outside of British control. Long may she reign!
victoria.1.d2: The King is dead. With the ascension of his young niece [SCOPE.sCharacter('queen_victoria').GetFirstName], the realm rejoices. Long may she reign!
victoria.1.tt: The members of the [SCOPE.sCountry('hannover_victoria_scope').GetAdjective] [concept_customs_union] leave our economic sphere.
victoria.2.d: The King is dead. With the ascension of his young niece Victoria, the crown of Hanover passes outside of British control. Her uncle, [SCOPE.sCharacter('ernest_augustus').GetFirstName], now rules Hanover.
britain_monarchy.1.t: The Coronation of King George V
britain_monarchy.1.d: The King is dead. With the ascension of his son [SCOPE.sCharacter('george_v_relevant_ruler').GetFirstName], the realm rejoices. Long may he reign!
grand_exhibition_decision_custom_tooltip: Has not previously held a Grand Exhibition
prostitution.1.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('cda_ig').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('cda_state').GetName], led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('cda_ig_leader').GetFullName], are demanding that the government take a stance on prostitution. They request the enforcement of laws that allow police to detain women suspected of being prostitutes in lock-hospitals on the grounds that they spread venereal disease.
prostitution.1.d2: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('cda_ig').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('cda_state').GetName], led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('cda_ig_leader').GetFullName], are demanding a solution to high rates of venereal disease among their men. They request the enforcement of laws that allow police to detain women suspected of being prostitutes in lock-hospitals on the grounds that they spread venereal disease.
prostitution.1.c: Medical science shows the futility of such measures.
prostitution.2.d: Feminist groups led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('feminist_cda_ig_leader').GetFullName] demand the repeal of the Contagious Diseases Acts in [SCOPE.sState('feminist_cda_state').GetName]. They decry the brutal treatment of women by police and inhumane conditions in lock-hospitals. Even women with no connection to prostitution are routinely confined against their will.
prostitution.2.c: Repeal the Acts across the nation.
prostitution.3.d: Police have shut down a notorious male brothel. The arrested proprietor has revealed that [SCOPE.sCharacter('scandal_character').GetFullName] is part of his clientele, and this information is leaking to the press.
prostitution.3.b: Try to cover up the story.
prostitution.3.c: Our propagandists will minimize the impact.
prostitution.4.d: The use of extreme force is becoming increasingly common among police officers in [SCOPE.sState('police_brutality_state').GetName]. The working class and the socially conscious are rallying against the police as an institution.
prostitution.4.b: The use of force is warranted.
oregon_dispute_happened: The Oregon Border Dispute has been resolved
je_oregon_reason: The proper location of the Oregon border has long been an undecided matter between Great Britain and the United States. It is high time that this dispute is settled.
oregon_tt: Have discovered the Oregon Trail by mapping the American Western Frontier
oregon.2.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('usa_scope').GetName] have proposed a reasonable compromise on the Oregon border dispute. They propose that they annex [SCOPE.sState('washington_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sState('oregon_scope').GetName], and [SCOPE.sState('idaho_scope').GetName], while we retain our claims to the northern regions.
oregon.2.b: We will not surrender an inch of British land!
oregon.3.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetName] has agreed to our reasonable terms, and has ceded control of [SCOPE.sState('washington_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sState('oregon_scope').GetName], and [SCOPE.sState('idaho_scope').GetName] to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
oregon.4.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetName] has rejected our reasonable compromise on the Oregon border dispute. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s claims to the region are indisputable, and so a more violent transition of power may be an inevitability.
oregon.4.a: If they will not hand it over, we will seize it by force.
je_conquer_oregon_reason: Since the British have refused to cede Oregon diplomatically, we must take it by force of arms.
plague.1.d: A massive outbreak of an especially deadly strain of flu has broken out in [SCOPE.sState('plague_origin_state').GetName]. It threatens to spread rapidly, potentially escalating into a global pandemic.
plague.1.a: We must hope it doesn't spread!
plague_decisions_available.tt: The 'Pandemic Response' decision is available, which can mitigate the effects and spread.
plague_state_mortality.tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('plague_originator_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] Flu appears in [THIS.GetState.GetName], increasing [Concept('concept_pop_growth', '$concept_pop_growth_mortality$')] for the next 6 months; the state may get hit by further waves of the pandemic
plague.2.d: The deadly [SCOPE.sCountry('plague_originator_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] Flu has appeared in [SCOPE.sState('plague_spread_target').GetName]. The pandemic is quickly becoming a global crisis.
plague.3.d: The terrible plague continues in [SCOPE.sState('new_wave_state').GetName], with a new wave infecting many more of the population.
plague.3.a: May the heavens let this end soon.
plague.5.d: The government must determine its response to the flu pandemic that threatens to engulf the nation. Stricter measures will surely have a cost, but will save lives.
plague.5.a: Impose a strict lockdown and close non-essential businesses.
plague.5.b: Mandate health measures such as distancing and protective masks.
plague.5.c: We can't risk harming the economy.
plague_lockdown.tt: States are much less likely to experience successive waves of the flu.\nFlu mortality is greatly reduced for successive waves.
plague_measures.tt: States are less likely to experience successive waves of the flu.\nFlu mortality is reduced for successive waves.
plague_no_response.tt: States will always experience successive waves of the flu, up to four waves.\nFlu mortality may be very high.
spanish_flu_response_desc: With a deadly flu ravaging the land, we must act to protect our citizens.
has_not_taken_plague_decision_for_6_mont: Has not changed the national pandemic response within 6 months.
pandemic_response.tt: We will choose how to respond to the pandemic.\nWe will not be able to choose a different response for 6 months.
plague.7.d: Reports of the many deaths resulting from the [SCOPE.sCountry('plague_originator_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] Flu in [SCOPE.sState('plague_state').GetName] are harming popular support for our war efforts.
plague.7.a: We will not interfere with the free press.
plague.7.b: Distribute reassuring propaganda backed by medical science.
plague.7.c: Censor news of mortality rates and infections.
plague.8.d: With many unable to work due to our anti-pandemic measures, poorer citizens in [SCOPE.sState('plague_poverty_state').GetName] are struggling to pay rent. Newly unemployed laborers face eviction as landlords refuse their pleas for reprieve.
plague.8.a: Institute a rent freeze and eviction ban.
plague.8.c: There is nothing we can do about this.
plague.9.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('anti_mask_ig_leader').GetFullName] has formed the Anti-Mask League in opposition to our pandemic measures. They dispute the effectiveness of our policies and demand that we revoke them for the sake of the struggling economy.
plague.9.c: Discredit the League with medical science.
cable_street.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('fascist_leader').GetFullName] and the [SCOPE.sParty('fascist_party').GetName] are planning a major rally in [SCOPE.sState('fascist_rally_state').GetName]. They expect impassioned resistance from anti-fascist groups loosely organized under the banner of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('antifa_ig').GetName].
cable_street.1.a: We must protect their right to march.
cable_street.1.b: Let them fight, we will not interfere.
heavenly.1.d: Foreign missionaries based in [SCOPE.sCountry('treaty_port_owner').GetAdjective] [SCOPE.sState('treaty_port_scope').GetName] have asked for permission to build schools and hospitals in [SCOPE.sState('missionary_state').GetName]. They will surely use these as platforms to spread their faith.
heavenly.1.a: Allow them to build schools and hospitals
heavenly.1.b: We do not want their foreign faith.
heavenly.2.d: A strange cult has emerged in [SCOPE.sState('cult_state').GetName]. Taking elements from local faiths as well as Christianity, their leader believes he is the younger brother of Jesus Christ.
heavenly.3.d: The God Worshipping Society is rabidly evangelical, and has managed to attract a sizable following in [SCOPE.sState('cult_growth_state').GetName].
heavenly.3.a: This cannot be a good thing.
heavenly.4.d: The fanatics of the God Worshipping Society have risen up against us in response to our discrimination policies. They have established [SCOPE.sState('heavenly_kingdom_spawn').GetName] as their base of operations and will shortly seize other states where the cult has a presence.
heavenly.5.d: The Heavenly Kingdom has been defeated. We must decide how to handle the aftermath of the rebellion; supporters of the cult are still active any may still cause trouble for us in the future.
mass_reconversion_tt: #variable 10%#! of all non-[SCOPE.sReligion('state_religion_scope').GetName] [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetName] will convert to [SCOPE.sReligion('state_religion_scope').GetName].
heavenly.5.b: Show mercy and offer pardons to former rebels.
heavenly.6.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has swept aside [SCOPE.sCulture('manchu_culture').GetName] rule. Our state must continue to endure, and bring the word of God to all of China.
heavenly.6.d1: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has secured its independence from [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetName]. Our state must continue to endure, and be able to protect itself from [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetAdjective] reprisals.
heavenly.6.f: When people of this earth keep nothing for their private use, but give all things to God for all to use in common, then every place shall have equal shares, and everyone be clothed and fed.
heavenly.6.a: Prioritize spreading the word of God to the people.
heavenly.6.b: The reforms of the New Treatise will bring our state forward.
heavenly.6.b1: [SCOPE.sCharacter('hong_rengan_scope').GetFullName]'s New Treatise will bring us forward.
heavenly.6.c: We shall prepare to war anew against the [SCOPE.sCulture('manchu_culture').GetName] devils.
heavenly.6.e: Now is the time to build ties with the Western powers.
je_taiping_status: Defeat the rebellion of the Heavenly Kingdom.
je_taiping_reason: Fanatics have risen up against our rightful rule! Their rebellion must be utterly crushed.
rebellion_effects_remove: The effects of the #bold Siblings In Revolution#! and #bold The Taiping Rebellion#! modifiers will be removed
je_taiping_revolution_status: Defeat the devils of the Qing Dynasty.
je_taiping_revolution_reason: The people have risen against the devilry and corruption of [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetName]. The [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting]'s rule must be extinguished, and a new era of heavenly peace brought to China.
modifier_new_treatise_on_administration: A New Treatise on Aids to Administration
warlord_china_events.301.d: Our great [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has devised an elaborate new ideology intended to unify the nation. Drawing from many sources, it is complex and may be difficult to convey to the masses.
warlord_china_events.301.b: This doesn't make any sense. Focus on legitimizing the state instead.
british_raj_decision_desc: Mismanagement by the East India Company has gone on far too long. We must secure our rule over the subcontinent through more direct means.
doctrine_of_lapse_disabled: The #b Doctrine of Lapse#! will be abolished, preserving the [Concept('concept_princely_state','$concept_princely_states$')]
raj.1.d: The rule of the [SCOPE.sCountry('company_country').GetName] has ended, and the [SCOPE.sCountry('british_raj_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] government will now take a greater role in Indian affairs. History shall mark this day as the inception of the British Raj.
activate_british_raj: The East India Company will be reformed into the British Raj
raj.2.d1: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] Resident has invoked the Doctrine of Lapse, citing our ruler's advanced age and failure to produce a male heir. By [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] decree, the territory of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is to be immediately annexed into the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetName].
raj.2.d2: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] Resident has invoked the Doctrine of Lapse, citing the alleged incompetence of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]. By [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] decree, the territory of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is to be immediately annexed into the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetOverlord.GetName].
raj.2.f: At one PM sharp, the Resident entered. At five past one, tea was served to the the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] interpreter. At ten past one, the dictate was served. At fifteen, there was no more [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting], and no more [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]. The Resident departed, steam still rising from his untouched cup.
raj.2.a: There is no way that we might resist.
raj.2.b: Summon our army, we make our stand here.
transfers_treasury_to_eic_tt: The contents of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s [concept_treasury] (@money![ROOT.GetCountry.GetGoldReserves|K]) are transferred to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetOverlord.GetName]
transfers_treasury_to_eic_diplo_tt: The contents of [SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetName]'s [concept_treasury] (@money![SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetGoldReserves|K]) are transferred to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]
strike.1.d: Workers in the [SCOPE.sBuilding('prime_strike_workplace').GetName] have had enough of their poor conditions. Working with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('unions_ig').GetName], they have initiated an industry-wide strike in [SCOPE.sState('strike_state').GetName].
strike.2.desc: After thorough discussion with union leaders, they have agreed to suspend the strike if any of their major demands are met.
strike.2.flavor: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialist_ig').GetName] that rob us on a large scale also have the power to control the government and legalize their robbery. We who work hardest and produce the most have the least; we can run the mills without them but they cannot run them without us!
strike.2.a: Promise to pass the Old Age Pension law.
strike.2.b: Promise to pass the Wage Controls law.
strike.2.c: Promise to pass the Regulatory Bodies law.
strike.2.d: Promise to pass the Workers' Protections law.
strike.3.d1: With their demands still unmet, the strike has escalated into a nationwide general strike. Mining has all but ceased throughout [SCOPE.sCountry('strike_country').GetName].
strike.3.d2: With their demands still unmet, the strike has escalated into a nationwide general strike. Industrial factories have all but shut down throughout [SCOPE.sCountry('strike_country').GetName].
strike.3.d3: With their demands still unmet, the strike has escalated into a nationwide general strike. Railway travel has been rendered all but impossible throughout [SCOPE.sCountry('strike_country').GetName].
strike.3.f: Workers of the world unite! You have nothing to lose but your chains!
strike.4.d: Unwilling to negotiate with the unions, the government has proposed measures aimed at ending the strike.
strike.4.f: The government certainly has the right for its own preservation to discourage and prevent the use of force and violence to accomplish that which ought to be accomplished, if at all, by parliamentary or political methods. There is no time to waste on hairsplitting over infringement of liberty.
strike.5.d: The policy changes promised to the striking workers are being seriously considered by the government. It seems likely that the union's demands will be met.
strike.5.f: It's working, lads! What did I tell you? Direct action gets the goods! Now let's celebrate with a pint, we've all more than earned it.
strike.6.d: In a violent clash, police used their newly-granted powers to fire upon striking workers in an attempt to disperse them. Many workers were killed and several officers were wounded, but the crowd was ultimately broken up.
strike.6.f: The firing was unjustified and cruel, and to say it in plain language, it was cowardly, premeditated murder.
strike.7.d: Our policy of promoting strikebreaking is proving remarkably successful. Many striking workers are losing their fighting spirit and abandoning their cause.
strike.7.f: Our man will come to your factory and get acquainted, infiltrating the union and rising within its ranks. He asks for unreasonable things and keeps the union embroiled in trouble. If a strike comes, he will be the loudest man in the bunch, and will counsel violence and get somebody in trouble. The result will be that the union will be broken up.
strike.8.d: With the passing of the new law, the government has met the demands of the striking workers.
strike.8.f: With all their faults, trade-unions have done more for humanity than any other organization of men that ever existed. They have done more for decency, for honesty, for education, for the betterment of the race, for the developing of character in man, than any other association of men.
strike.8.a: The unions should be more involved in politics.
strike.8.b: This should keep them happy for a while.
strike.9.d: The spirit of the strikers is utterly broken. They no longer have the will to continue their struggle, and the strike has been formally called off by the unions.
strike.9.f: You've had your fun. Now get back to work; your pay has been docked accordingly and you will work whatever hours the company deems appropriate.
strike.9.a: They have learned to fear the truncheon.
strike.9.b: Round up the instigators. This will not happen again.
pass_pensions_or_else: We must pass the [GetLawType('law_old_age_pension').GetName] [concept_law] within 10 years or face a General Strike
pass_controls_or_else: We must pass the [GetLawType('law_wage_subsidies').GetName] [concept_law] law within 10 years or face a General Strike
pass_regulation_or_else: We must pass the [GetLawType('law_regulatory_bodies').GetName] [concept_law] within 10 years or face a General Strike
pass_protections_or_else: We must pass the [GetLawType('law_worker_protections').GetName] [concept_law] law within 10 years or face a General Strike
pass_institution_or_else: We must expand the [GetInstitutionType('institution_workplace_safety').GetName] [concept_institution] within 10 years or face a General Strike
pass_institution_or_else_2: We must expand the [GetInstitutionType('institution_social_security').GetName] [concept_institution] within 10 years or face a General Strike
je_strike_reason: Workers dissatisfied with their conditions have gone on strike. As they refuse to work, their industry has effectively come to a standstill.
je_fulfill_striker_promise_tt: Fulfill a promise to the strikers using the Labor Negotiations decision
je_is_not_on_strike_tt: Do #bold not#! have workplaces on strike
strike_conflict_resolved: The conflict behind the strike has been resolved
je_strike_promise_fulfilled_tt: Your promise to the strikers is fulfilled, appeasing the workers.
je_strike_promise_status: Pass the law or expand the institution that was promised to the Trade Unions.
je_strike_promise_reason: We have promised the striking Trade Unions that we will pass specific legislation within ten years. If we do not fulfill this promise, we can expect a disastrous General Strike.
je_strike_break_status: We should use whatever means are at out disposal to reduce Turmoil in striking States.
je_strike_break_reason: Ongoing strikes are hindering productivity. The Industrialists have asked us to resolve the matter in their favor.
je_break_the_strike_tt: Break the strike using the Anti-Strike Measures decision
strike_negotiation_decision_desc: A strike is ongoing in our nation. If we are not willing to dissolve it through force, we must negotiate.
anti_strike_measures_decision_desc: If we will not accept the striker's demands, we must find a way to break their spirits.
expedition_progress_explanation_tt: As the Expedition increases its Progress, it comes closer to achieving its goal.
je_rubber_reason: The applications for rubber are endless, the supply is low, and the demand is high. We are well placed to become one of the world's foremost suppliers of this marvelous substance!
production_tech_events.1.d: The recent expansion of the [SCOPE.sBuilding('rubber_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('rubber_state').GetName] has yielded extremely promising results. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] threatens to lead the world in rubber production.
production_tech_events.1.b: What other uses could we find for rubber?
je_mechanized_farming_reason: The future of farming has arrived! With marvelous modern technology we can drastically improve agricultural production. With such a vast food surplus, surely nobody will ever go hungry again!
production_tech_events.600.d: The grand project of mechanizing agriculture throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is complete. Never before have such abundant yields been tallied.
production_tech_events.600.a: Distribute surplus food to the poor.
production_tech_events.600.b: But could yields be even higher?
je_atmospheric_engine_reason: An ingenious device has been invented, it will be sure to drastically improve the output of our mines.
production_tech_events.601.d: Through the widespread introduction of the atmospheric engine in the mining industry, productivity is at an all-time high.
production_tech_events.601.a: I'm sure we can squeeze a little more from these machines.
production_tech_events.601.b: This has great implications for transport.
production_tech_events.601.c: Perhaps there is an even better way.
communism_variable_at_zero_tt: The #bold Progress Bar#! has been reduced to #variable 0%#!
je_communism_2_goal: The following must be true for at least 5 years:
je_communism_1_reason: The rising prevalence of socialist unrest within [SCOPE.sCountry('root_country').GetName] has begun to coalesce into a movement that threatens the rule of the upper classes. Struggle between classes has acquired a sharper edge as [SCOPE.sCountry('root_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] workers adopt the methods and principles of the socialist movement.\n\n#italic The voices of the proletariat cry out for liberty, for equality, and for bread. Workers of the world, unite!#!
communism_progress_from_laws_tt: level of #bold Policing#! and #bold Home Affairs#! [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institutions$')]
communism_progress_from_no_laws_tt: lack of #bold Policing#! or #bold Home Affairs#! [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institutions$')]
je_communism_2_reason: The people still suffer under the tyrant heel of kings, priests, and capitalists. We must overthrow the reactionary government and establish a worker's paradise.
communism.1.desc: With socialist ideas sweeping across [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName] government has determined that drastic concessions to arrest its progress must be considered. There is sufficient momentum for a rapid policy change.
communism.1.a: Offer greater wages for their labor.
communism.1.b: Put the last slavers out of their misery.
communist_unions.tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('unions').GetName] will be much more likely to select Vanguardist, Communist, or Anarchist leaders when [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure', '$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')] by an applicable [concept_political_movement].\nOther [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] are more likely to select Vanguardist, Communist, or Anarchist leaders when [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure', '$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')] by an applicable [concept_political_movement].
communism.2.d: The workers of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] have finally overthrown the bourgeois government and established a Council Republic. But there is still far more work to be done before socialism has been truly achieved.
communism.2.a: The vanguard party will lead the way!
communism.2.c: No gods! No masters! Anarchy forever!
chose_vanguardism.tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('unions').GetName] will be much more likely to select [GetIdeology('ideology_vanguardist').GetName] leaders when [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure', '$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')] by an applicable [concept_political_movement].
chose_communism.tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('unions').GetName] will be much more likely to select [GetIdeology('ideology_communist').GetName] leaders when [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure', '$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')] by an applicable [concept_political_movement].
chose_anarchism.tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('unions').GetName] will be much more likely to select [GetIdeology('ideology_anarchist').GetName] leaders when [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure', '$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')] by an applicable [concept_political_movement].
je_anarchy_reason: If there is a State, there must be domination of one class by another and, as a result, slavery; the State without slavery is unthinkable – and this is why we are the enemies of the State.
je_vanguard_reason: The proletariat needs state power, a centralized organization of force, an organization of violence, both to crush the resistance of the exploiters and to lead the enormous mass of the population to the organization of a socialist economy.
vanguard_custom_tooltip: Every Powerful Interest Group is led by a [GetIdeology('ideology_vanguardist').GetName], [GetIdeology('ideology_communist').GetName], or [GetIdeology('ideology_anarchist').GetName] leader.
vanguard_instruction_status: The Intelligentsia, Rural Folk, Trade Unions, and Armed Forces will adopt Vanguardism if they are marginalized.
je_communist_welfare_reason: Communism cannot be achieved until the needs of all have been fulfilled. From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs.
je_5_year_plan_reason: Communism is worker's power plus the electrification of the whole country.
communism.3.d: Reactionary elements within the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('new_vanguard_ig').GetName] have at long last been purged. We can be assured that their new leader, [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_vanguard_leader').GetFullName], will be loyal to the state and to socialism.
communism.3.b: They have an important role to play.
new_vanguard.tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('new_vanguard_ig').GetName] will be much more likely to select Vanguardist leaders when [Concept('concept_political_movement_pressure', '$concept_political_movement_pressured_short$')] by an applicable [concept_political_movement].
communism.4.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is fast becoming an anarchist utopia. Poverty has been completely eliminated, and a classless society based on mutual aid is taking root.
communism.5.d: Reactionary elements in the political landscape have been almost entirely eradicated or suppressed. The vanguard party reigns supreme.
communism.6.d: The Communist government has delivered on its promise to expand public institutions. All [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] citizens are guaranteed access to healthcare, social security, education, and a safe workplace.
communism.6.a: On such foundations is socialism built.
communism.7.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('popular_socialist_leader').GetFullName] of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('popular_socialist_ig').GetName] is rapidly gaining popularity among the people. The radical socialist message of equality [SCOPE.sCharacter('popular_socialist_leader').GetSheHe] espouses is proving especially appealing to the lower classes.
communism.8.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('red_army_general').GetFullName] has reorganized the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('red_army_ig').GetName] into the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] Red Army. The military is now devoted to defending the dictatorship of the proletariat.
communism.8.f: The international revolution will not be won through the jabbering of politicians, it will be won through force of arms. All the bourgeoisie of the world are assembled against us, the enemies of the proletariat are omnipresent. The Red Army is the only force standing between survival and annihilation.
red_army_tt: Armed Forces will be named Red Army
communism.9.d: The workers of [SCOPE.sState('coop_state').GetName] are running a successful cooperative in the [SCOPE.sBuilding('coop_building').GetName]. They live happy, productive, and prosperous lives.
communism.9.f: In a worker cooperative, the means of production are owned by the workers themselves. The workplace is democratic, self-managed, and collectively owned by its members. All share in the profits, so workers are highly invested in the success of the business. The good of one is the good of all.
communism.9.a: A happy worker is a loyal worker.
communism.9.b: [SCOPE.sState('coop_state').GetName] is a wonderful place to live.
communist_elections.1.d1: Members of the [SCOPE.sParty('anti_leftist_party').GetName] have been vigorously warning voters against [SCOPE.sParty('leftist_party').GetName]'s electoral campaign.
communist_elections.1.f: First they will take your boss's house and you will thank them for it. You'll receive them as the promised savior and knee before them. Then they will take your neighbor's house, and you will try to convince them, you'll say
communist_elections.1.a: These leftists are traitors to the nation.
communist_elections.1.b: The rhetoric here is needlessly alarmist.
communist_elections.1.e: The [SCOPE.sParty('leftist_party').GetName] has every right to spread its ideas.
communist_elections.2.d: With the approaching Council Elections, workers among all our nation have expressed their overwhelming preference towards the [SCOPE.sParty('unions_party').GetName].
communist_elections.2.f: If we don't vote for someone who defends our values, then why vote? The [SCOPE.sParty('unions_party').GetNameNoFormatting] shall look after our best interests, and only them. Who else is going to care? The military? The church? Those pompous, conceited kids of the [SCOPE.sParty('anti_union_party').GetNameNoFormatting]? I know for sure that I don't care about them.
communist_elections.2.b: Loyalty to the Party is mandatory.
communist_elections.2.c: Other voices should also be heard.
communist_elections.2.tt: The Worker's Party is in government.
communist_elections.3.d: The [SCOPE.sParty('socialist_party').GetName] is receiving election campaign support from the [SCOPE.sCharacter('foreign_socialist_leader').GetIdeology.GetName] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('foreign_socialist_ig').GetName] in [SCOPE.sCountry('socialist_country').GetName].
communist_elections.3.b: Try to limit foreign influence in the election.
election_socialist_support_tt: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('foreign_socialist_leader').GetIdeology.GetName] ideology will be more likely to appear in our country.
communist_elections.4.desc: [SCOPE.sCharacter('fascist_leader').GetIdeology.GetName] paramilitaries organized by the [SCOPE.sParty('fascist_party_scope').GetName] are using violence and coercion to intimidate voters loyal to rival parties.
communist_elections.4.f: Violence? Coercion? Someone has been looking at the dictionary lately, huh? If all we are doing is stating the facts, and people have nothing to rebate them, then why would that be called coercion? If I tell you that it won't snow unless it's cold, am I also coercing the weather?
communist_elections.4.b: Reinforce paramilitaries with the army and police.
communist_elections.4.c: Attempt to enforce voter suppression laws.
communist_elections.4.tt: A fascist leader is in government.
je_opium_reason: Demand for opium is soaring as this dangerously addictive substance enraptures the world. We should seek to be the leading supplier!
opium_events.1.d: Production at the [SCOPE.sBuilding('opium_building').GetName] is booming and foreign demand for opium could hardly be higher. The [SCOPE.sCulture('opium_addict_culture').GetName] people of [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_addict_country').GetName] have become so enamored with the stuff that it has all but become the national passtime.
je_opium_obsession_reason: Vast numbers of our people have become opium fiends. This is a national disgrace that must be addressed urgently.
je_opium_obsession_goal: The following conditions must be true for a total of 5 years (can be interrupted):
opium_wars.1.d: Opium addiction is ravaging [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. Vast numbers of [SCOPE.sCulture('addicted_culture').GetName] people have become opium fiends, causing a wave of crime, poverty, and idleness. Despite the obvious harm, [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_exporter').GetName] continues to flood the market.
opium_wars.1.f: Every household has a bed-bound opium fiend, every street corner has an opium den, and every port welcomes [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_exporter').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] merchants pouring a glut of opium down the throats of any who will pay for it.
opium_wars.1.b: We cannot risk the ire of [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_exporter').GetName].
opium_wars.2.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_target_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] government has announced its intent to put an end to the opium trade in [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_target_country').GetName]. As [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is a major exporter of opium, this is a matter of great economic concern.
opium_wars.2.a: They will eat their opium and they will like it!
opium_wars.2.b: We have other matters to attend to.
je_opium_wars_reason: We must protect our economic interests by ensuring that the opium trade continues.
opiumwars_fail_tt: Is one of the Powers opposing our efforts
opium_wars.3.d: We have broken the [SCOPE.sCulture('addicted_culture').GetName] dependence on opium through great perseverance. Not even the machinations of [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_aggressor_country').GetName] could prevent us from returning good health and prosperity to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
opium_wars.3.d2: We have broken the [SCOPE.sCulture('addicted_culture').GetName] dependence on opium through great perseverance. Not even the machinations of the Great Powers could prevent us from returning good health and prosperity to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
opium_wars.3.f: Just as the opium fiend shall break his addiction and rise from his idler’s bed, so shall our nation cast off the unwelcome yoke of foreign influence and rise as a sovereign state. No longer inundated with opium, our rivers shall flow with silver and our people shall return to virtuous living.
opium_wars.4.d: Our humiliating defeat at the hands of our enemies has forced us to open our markets. Not only will the flow of opium continue uninterrupted, but our sovereignty has been violated and the people are enraged.
opium_wars.4.d2: Our humiliating defeat at the hands of [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_treaty_port_winner').GetName] has forced us to concede the port of [SCOPE.sState('treaty_port_state').GetName]. Not only will the flow of opium continue uninterrupted, but our sovereignty has been violated and the people are enraged.
opium_wars.4.d3: Our humiliating defeat at the hands of our enemies has forced us to concede a treaty port. Not only will the flow of opium continue uninterrupted, but our sovereignty has been violated and the people are enraged.
opium_wars.4.f: Where is the nation that ruled for centuries over a harmonious land? We are slaves to opium, at the mercy of foreign greed. We cannot control our ports, the foreigners show no respect to our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle], and in every household the whispers of dissent grow louder. Dark days are coming; our mandate may be at an end.
opium_wars.4.a: They may herald the end of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
opium_wars.5.d: We have forced [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_target_country').GetName] to open their markets, ensuring the continuation of the opium trade for years to come.
opium_wars.5.d2: We have forced [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_target_country').GetName] to concede a treaty port in [SCOPE.sState('treaty_port_state').GetName], ensuring the continuation of the opium trade for years to come.
opium_wars.6.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] patrols have caught a group of [SCOPE.sCountry('smuggler_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] smugglers carrying opium into [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. This is a flagrant attempt by [SCOPE.sCountry('smuggler_country').GetName] to bypass the opium embargo.
opium_wars.7.d: The measures [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has taken to address the opium crisis are paying off. Citizens in [SCOPE.sState('recovry_state').GetName] have made a full recovery, and similar progress can be observed throughout the region.
opium_wars.7.a: Redouble our focus on caring for the sick.
opium_wars.7.b: Their love for opium shall be replaced by love for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
opium_wars.8.d: [SCOPE.sCulture('opium_addiction_pop').GetName] people are experiencing severe effects of opium addiction. The use and abuse of the substance has spread throughout [SCOPE.sState('opium_addiction_state').GetName].
opium_wars.8.f: The opium eater lies under the weight of incubus and nightmare; he lies in sight of all that he would fain perform, just as a man forcibly confined to his bed by the mortal languor of a relaxing disease, who is compelled to witness injury or outrage offered to some object of his tenderest love: he curses the spells which chain him down from motion; he would lay down his life if he might but get up and walk; but he is powerless as an infant, and cannot even attempt to rise.
opium_wars.8.b: Perhaps we can treat this as a medical matter.
notification_opium_wars_british_response: [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_aggressor_country').GetName] has responded angrily to the [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_target_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] ban on opium, with multiple threats towards the government of [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_target_country').GetName]
