[SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_aggressor_country').GetName] seems to be ignoring the [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_target_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] ban on opium
je_dialectics_reason: Though philosophy has existed for centuries, it is time we started taking it seriously as a discipline. A fully-funded philosophy department should be established at all of our finest institutions of learning.
dt_society_events.1.d: We have secured funding for philosophy departments in all of our institutions of higher learning. The [SCOPE.sBuilding('philosophy_department').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('university_state').GetName] has chosen to focus this funding on advancing Hegelian dialectics.
dt_society_events.1.c: We need a more pragmatic approach.
je_realism_reason: Artists are moving away from abstract, fantastical art and towards realistic portrayals of a concrete subject matter. As patrons of this movement there could be much to gain.
dt_society_events.2.d: The [SCOPE.sBuilding('art_building').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('art_state').GetName] has become a major center of the Realist movement, producing some of the finest works of our generation.
dt_society_events.2.f: Realism depicts the world as it is, warts and all, rather than the world as we might like it to be. It seeks not only to be true to how objects appear to the eye, but also to be true to the everyday experiences of ordinary people.
dt_society_events.2.a: Finally, art we can all relate to.
dt_society_events.2.b: Can we capture reality even more perfectly?
dt_society_events.2.c: The world is grim and mundane.
je_academia_reason: The world is changing rapidly, and if we cannot keep up with the latest technological, societal, and military advances we will fall into the background of history.
dt_society_events.3.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerselfHimself] has officially opened the [SCOPE.sBuilding('university_building').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('university_state').GetName]. Academia is beginning to flourish in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
dt_society_events.3.f: Philosophy is the highest calling of mankind. Through philosophy we can come to understand the very foundations of metaphysics, the nature of the divine, and the essence of virtue. It stands to reason then, that only the most enlightened of wisdom-seekers are fit to hold power.
dt_society_events.3.a: Society should be ruled by philosopher-kings.
dt_society_events.3.b: Modern institutions should employ modern methods.
je_sick_man_main_reason: We must modernize and restore the Ottoman Empire.
je_sick_man_main_failure_movements_tt: Cultural Minority [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')] in the Balkans will draw more support
je_sick_man_syria_reason: Syria has been lost to the tyrant of Egypt, who stole his dominion from our rightful hands. We must reclaim it!
je_sick_man_syria_status: Starting a diplomatic play against Egypt may result in support from the European [Concept('concept_great_power', '$concept_great_powers$')].
je_sick_man_egypt_reason: With Syria recaptured, we should turn our attention to Egypt. Rightfully an Ottoman possession, it has fallen into the hands of a usurper.
je_sick_man_economy_reason: Our economy is underdeveloped and unurbanized. We must embark on the path of industrialization.
je_sick_man_education_reason: So few within our domain have even a basic grasp of literacy. We should establish schools in which to teach them, as well as our own institute of higher learning.
je_sick_man_education_goal: Increase the literacy rate of your people by 20%.
je_sick_man_separatism_reason: We have already lost Greece and Serbia; we cannot allow our empire to collapse to separatist rebels.
je_sick_man_separatism_goal: The following must be true for 15 total years:
je_sick_man_army_reason: Though the Janissaries have been disbanded, there is far more that must be done to modernize our armed forces.
finished_sick_man_tt: Has completed or failed the Sick Man of Europe [concept_journal_entry]
sick_man.1.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is in a period of steady decline. If we do not reassert [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] sovereignty and reclaim our place among the Powers of the world, we risk catastrophe.
sick_man.1.f: We have fallen, but we can rise again. In an Auspicious Incident we deposed the Janissaries who had maintained their miserly grip on power for centuries, finally allowing reform to be possible. There is much more to do. First, of course, we need to replace the Janissaries with a truly modern military force. But in addition, we must restore the place of the Sublime Porte as the very height of civilization. Education, urbanization, and sovereignty shall be the top items of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] agenda.
sick_man.2.desc: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has successfully modernized and re-asserted itself on the world stage. A new era begins for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] state.
sick_man.2.f: Sublime. That is the only word for it. To walk the streets of Istanbul and see modern factories and schools, to see the guards practicing their military drill. A landscape once dominated by peasant farmers is now littered with shining cities. And to think that only a few decades ago the empire was on the brink of collapse! Where once the European powers looked upon us with pity and greedily sought to partition our lands, now we see their diplomats gazing in awe at our accomplishments, forced to recognize us as equals. God is good!
sick_man.2.a: The army could use additional reforms.
sick_man.2.d: We will reap the benefits of education.
sick_man.3.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has failed to modernize and re-assert itself on the world stage. The vultures begin to circle as the last days of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] draw near.
sick_man.3.f: The Sublime Porte falls silent. Just days after announcing [SCOPE.sCharacter('ottoman_sultan').GetHerHis] intention to abdicate, most likely under the duress of [SCOPE.sCharacter('ottoman_sultan').GetHerHis] ministers, the [SCOPE.sCharacter('ottoman_sultan').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has been found dead in [SCOPE.sCharacter('ottoman_sultan').GetHerHis] chambers. Much like our precious empire, the [SCOPE.sCharacter('ottoman_sultan').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] had been suffering from a long, creeping sickness that ultimately made [SCOPE.sCharacter('ottoman_sultan').GetHerHim] unable to bear the weight of the crown. A broken and deranged shadow of [SCOPE.sCharacter('ottoman_sultan').GetHerHis] former self.
sick_man.3.a: We belong to Allah, and to Him do we return.
je_meiji_main_reason:
The Emperor has been restored to power, and the process of building $JAP$ anew can now begin. There is much work to be done. Foreign powers look at us with hungry eyes. We must be able to withstand the onslaught of these nations not just militarily, but in economic and political terms as well:

• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('meiji_je_conditions_army')]
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('meiji_je_conditions_economy')]
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('meiji_je_conditions_diplomacy')]

We must build this new $JAP$ while the iron is hot, and use this opportunity to shape the country in ways our forefathers never dreamed.
je_meiji_status_has_completed_iwakura_mi: We #g completed#! #b Restoration: The Mission to the West#!
je_meiji_status_has_not_completed_iwakur: We #warning have not completed#! #b Restoration: The Mission to the West#!
adds_mission_to_the_west_je_tt: Activates the #b Restoration: The Mission to the West#! [concept_journal_entry]
je_meiji_economy_reason: Japan must modernize its industry to compete with nations that seek to control and exploit us.
je_meiji_army_reason: The Samurai are our ancient feudal-hereditary warrior caste. For centuries they have fought for us and commanded our armies. But in the centuries of relative peace we have enjoyed, they have forgotten the ways of war and have become a burden to the state.
je_meiji_diplomacy_reason: Japan has isolated itself for centuries to resist foreign influence. It is now time to open ourselves to the world, and establish our nation as an equal power on the world stage.
meiji_timeout_some_progress: At least #b 1#! Restoration Journal Entry is completed when #b 12 years#! have passed
meiji_timeout_no_progress: No Restoration Journal Entries are completed when #b 12 years#! have passed
meiji.1.d: The [GetLawType('law_bakufu').GetName] has fallen from power, and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName] has restored the political primacy of the monarchy. This momentous occasion marks the end of centuries of military rule in #v $JAP$#!, and heralds a new era of modernization and reform. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] must choose [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] political allies carefully.
meiji.1.f: The former Shōgun bows with respect and shame as he hands over his residence and seat of power, the mighty Edo Castle, to the restored Emperor. Renovations are set to begin at once; the old castle to be replaced by a glorious Imperial Palace. Though the exterior will appear much the same as the former imperial residence in Kyoto, the Emperor plans to combine Japan's rich decorative traditions with strange Western fashions. A metaphor, perhaps, for the future shape of Japan.
meiji.1.a: Industrial might will see us through.
meiji.1.b: We must look to the intellectuals.
meiji.2.d: A reformed army, an open and recognized country, a new society. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] stands as an equal among the powers of the world, and will perhaps begin to pursue imperial ambitions of her own.
meiji.2.b: We will need powerful friends, for we shall make powerful enemies.
meiji.2.c: Railways are the key to our future success.
meiji.3.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has succeeded in reforming the armed forces and putting an end to the backwards system of feudalism. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('samurai_ig').GetName] warrior caste seemingly no longer have a place within our modernizing society.
meiji.3.f: The Shōgun commanded the loyalty of the Daimyo, who in turn relied on their Samurai to help them enforce their rule over the enserfed peasantry. This was the basis of Japanese feudalism—now a relic of the past. There are those still loyal to Samurai ideals, the codes and virtues known as Bushido, and that legacy will surely endure. But the Samurai have fallen, and we will not see their like again.
meiji.3.a: Let them keep their status as officers and nobles.
meiji.3.b: The era of Samurai is over.
samurai_rename.tt: The Samurai Interest Group will be reorganized into the Armed Forces
meiji.4.d: Taking interest in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s modernization efforts, [SCOPE.sCountry('military_consultant_country').GetName] has offered us the service of General [SCOPE.sCharacter('military_consultant_general').GetFullName] as a military consultant. The terms of this arrangement appear favorable, but we should be wary of indebting ourselves to foreign powers.
meiji.4.b: We do not want their poisoned chalice.
meiji.5.d: As part of an ambassadorial voyage to the West, our dignitaries have met with [SCOPE.sCharacter('japan_embassy_politician').GetFullName], a senior [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_embassy_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] politician. Interested in establishing good relations with the newly opening [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] state, they have drafted several treaties we may wish to enter with [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_embassy_country').GetName].
meiji.5.c: We have nothing to gain from [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_embassy_country').GetName].
meiji.6.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('western_investor_ig_leader').GetFullName], a wealthy and powerful industrialist from [SCOPE.sCountry('western_investor_country').GetName], sees [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] as a lucrative and untapped market. In exchange for various political favors to be redeemed at an unspecified point in time, [SCOPE.sCharacter('western_investor_ig_leader').GetFullName] is willing to share with us the industrial technology of [SCOPE.sCharacter('western_investor_ig_leader').GetHerHis] homeland.
meiji.6.b: We no not need foreign meddling in our economy.
meiji.13.d: Forced to open itself to the world, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] must now contend with the economic interference of other powers. The authority of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastName] Clan and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('shogunate_ig').GetName] have, consequently, been greatly undermined.
meiji.13.f: The changing winds of time howl against our door and to preserve our establishement we must bend and open them to the whims of the world.
meiji.13.a: We must adapt to our new circumstances.
je_veiled_protectorate_reason: Our influence in Egypt has grown considerably, yet our power in the region is dependent on our relations with the unrecognized state. By establishing a protectorate over the country, our domination would be assured.
veiled_protectorate.1.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has secured dominion over [SCOPE.sCountry('egypt_country').GetName]. This state of affairs is quickly becoming known as the Veiled Protectorate, for by a technicality Egypt remains legally subject to the [SCOPE.sCountry('ottoman_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ottoman_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle], who helplessly observes the situation.
veiled_protectorate.1.f: Today the Nile was inundated with blood. Those who opposed the new regime were quickly put down. [SCOPE.sCountry('egypt_overlord_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] diplomats and politicians have fire in their eyes as they discuss, under the shadow of the pyramids, how they will bring civilization to the lands of Egypt.
veiled_protectorate.1.a: None can deny the power of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] Empire.
veiled_protectorate.1.b: Assure the new [SCOPE.sCountry('egypt_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [SCOPE.sCharacter('egypt_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of our support.
laws.1.d: Our beloved [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullName] has narrowly survived an assassination attempt. The would-be assassin has ties to the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('jedi_scope').GetName], who oppose the new powers that the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law would bestow upon the [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
laws.1.f: Troubling news of a failed attempt on the life of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has emerged from the capital. Carried out in the dead of night, the [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] was able to defeat the assailant with the aid of [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetHerHis] young protégé. Speaking from a hospital bed, the [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] told the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] that despite wounds that will surely leave lifelong scars, [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetHerHis] resolve and dedication are stronger than ever.
laws.1.a: For a safe and secure society.
je_heavenly_kingdom_main_reason: Dangerous zealots are inspiring dissent across the nation. They pose an extreme threat; if they can rally enough people to their cult, they will attempt to establish their own heretic kingdom. These madmen must be stopped at all costs.
canada_unite_can_desc: The dream of Canadian Confederation must be realized. By becoming economically dominant over our fellow colonies while maintaining good relations with the central government, we can propose the annexation of one of our neighbors.
canada_unite_gbr_desc: We desire that all of the Canadian colonies be merged into one, and for a Canadian nation to emerge. To achieve this we must convince the local colonial administrations that unification is in their best interests.
australia_unite_aus_desc: The Australian people would be best served by unifying the petty provincial governments into a single nation. We must work with lesser administrations as well as the Colonial Office to propose the annexation of our neighbors.
australia_unite_gbr_desc: The Australian people would be best served by unifying the petty provincial governments into a single nation. We must work with local colonial governments to ease the process of federation.
je_canada_can_reason: The dream of Canadian Confederation must be realized. By becoming economically dominant over our fellow colonies while maintaining good relations with the central government, we can propose the annexation of one of our neighbors.
je_australia_aus_reason: The Australian people would be best served by unifying the petty provincial governments into a single nation. We must work with lesser administrations as well as the Colonial Office to propose the annexation of our neighbors.
je_canada_gbr_reason: We desire that all of the Canadian colonies be merged into one, and for a Canadian nation to emerge. To achieve this we must convince the local colonial administrations that unification is in their best interests.
je_australia_gbr_reason: The Australian people would be best served by unifying the petty provincial governments into a single nation. We must work with local colonial governments to ease the process of federation.
unite_canada_tt: Two Canadian colonies will be unified.
unite_australia_tt: Two Australian colonies will be unified.
can_aus.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('canada_overlord_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('canada_overlord_ruler').GetFullName] has signed into law the confederation between [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('canada_annex_scope').GetName]. This marks a great victory in our goal of unifying all of Canada.
can_aus.1.f: With every document signed and stamped, we come one step closer to building a nation. The colonies haven't always seen eye-to-eye, but the people of Canada are resolute in their determination to see this through.
can_aus.2.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName]  has signed into law the confederation between [SCOPE.sCountry('canada_scope_1').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('canada_scope_2').GetName]. This marks a great victory in our goal of unifying all of Canada.
can_aus.3.d: The ink had not even dried on the bill of unification before our bureaucrats and politicians set to work on integrating [SCOPE.sCountry('canada_annex_scope').GetName]. With the blessing of [SCOPE.sCharacter('canada_overlord_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('canada_overlord_ruler').GetFullName], we are one step closer towards the Federation of Australia.
can_aus.3.f: The bureaucracy, as they say, expands to meet the needs of the expanding bureaucracy. At least in this instance it serves a noble purpose; the emergence of an Australian nation is imminent. Backed by the Colonial Office, the local administrations, and above all else by the will of the Australian people, we cannot fail in our quest.
can_aus.4.d: The ink had not even dried on the bill of unification before our bureaucrats and politicians set to work on integrating [SCOPE.sCountry('canada_scope_1').GetName] with [SCOPE.sCountry('canada_scope_2').GetName]. With the blessing of [SCOPE.sCharacter('australia_overlord_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('australia_overlord_ruler').GetFullName], we are one step closer towards the Federation of Australia.
can_aus.5.d: The unification of Canada is complete. The various colonial governments have been integrated into one, under the administration of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] and with the enthusiastic approval of [SCOPE.sCountry('canada_overlord_country').GetName].
can_aus.5.f: The dream of a united Canada has finally been achieved. From humble beginnings as a small colony in the vast and unknown north, the settlers have grown and adapted. They have become a people. They have forged a nation.
can_aus.5.a: The True North strong and free!
can_aus.6.d: The unification of Canada is complete. The various colonial governments have been integrated into one, under the administration of [SCOPE.sCountry('canada_country').GetName] and with the enthusiastic approval of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
can_aus.7.d: The colonies of Australia have been consolidated into a single government under the direction of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The [SCOPE.sCharacter('canada_overlord_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.sCountry('canada_overlord_country').GetName] has formally congratulated the Australian people.
can_aus.7.f: Today marks the beginning of the Australian nation. The Land Down Under was a great challenge for its first settlers, fraught with ferocious flora and fauna, malevolent and hostile. But through ingenuity, determination, and faith we have tamed this rugged land.
can_aus.8.d: The colonies of Australia have been consolidated into a single government under the direction of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has formally congratulated the [SCOPE.sCharacter('canada_country_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.sCountry('canada_country').GetName] for leading the integration efforts.
je_manifest_destiny_mexico_reason: It is our destiny to stretch our territory from the Atlantic to the Pacific. From sea to shining sea!
je_manifest_destiny_frontier_wars_reason: We intend for the Great Plains to become a new homeland for the American people. Its current inhabitants must be brought firmly under control.
manifest_destiny.1.d: We have wrested control of the American Southwest from the illegitimate clutches of Mexico. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] now stretches from the Atlantic to the Pacific.
manifest_destiny.2.d: The last vestiges of Native American rule have been stamped out, leaving only the dominion of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
labor_rights.1.d: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('serf_mistreaters').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('serf_state').GetName] have become notorious for brutalizing their serfs. Peasants complain of harsh punishments, impossible workloads, and even sometimes torture and murder.
labor_rights.1.b: We will punish the aristocrats with the full force of the law.
labor_rights.2.d: A group of influential [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anti_serfdom_ig').GetName] led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('anti_serfdom_advocate').GetFullName] are petitioning for the rapid abolition of serfdom.
labor_rights.3.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('serf_owners').GetName] refuse to give up their serfs without adequate compensation. Their significant political influence makes this a difficult demand to refuse.
labor_rights.3.a: The state will make up the cost.
labor_rights.3.b: Serfs must purchase their own emancipation.
labor_rights.3.c: You cannot own a human being.
labor_rights.4.d: Workers organized by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('unions_scope').GetName] are staging short strikes and work-to-rule periods in an effort to pressure the government to pass the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law. Though their methods seem effective, they are causing major damage to our industrial economy.
labor_rights.4.b: Offer assurances and try to de-escalate.
labor_rights.5.d: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('capitalists_scope').GetName] have agreed to state-mediated negotiations with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('unions_scope').GetName] over the implementation of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
labor_rights.6.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('capitalists_scope').GetName] are paying a group of armed thugs calling themselves a private investigation agency to break up [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('unions_scope').GetName] agitation for [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
labor_rights.6.b: We cannot risk angering the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('capitalists_scope').GetName] further.
je_texas_tex_reason: After years of cultural and political turmoil between us and Mexico, with the rights of our citizens having been increasingly curtailed, it is time for us to rise up!\nThe days of our glorious lands being beholden to the tyrannical Mexican regime is coming to an end.
je_texas_usa_reason: We observe the conflict between Mexico and Texas with great interest. Should the Texan Republic emerge triumphant, we should try to sway them towards joining our righteous union.
texas_je_tt: Texas will decide whether to accept US statehood
texan_war_of_independence.1.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] stands, after a hard-fought and bloody war, independent. There are many within the Republic that advocate for statehood within the [SCOPE.sCountry('usa_scope').GetName]. The [SCOPE.sCountry('usa_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting]s, by all accounts, would welcome us into their union.
texan_war_of_independence.1.f: The war with Mexico has ended, and our brave citizens have begun to lay down their arms and return to peacetime life. But what good is independence if we must spend every day watching our backs, waiting for the return of our oppressors? Texas can be stronger still as part of a greater union, one of like-minded states that will not infringe upon our God-given rights.
texan_war_of_independence.1.c: We don't need help from the Yankees.
texan_war_of_independence.2.d1: [SCOPE.sCountry('texas_scope').GetName] has won its independence from Mexico, and now seeks statehood within the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
texan_war_of_independence.2.d2: [SCOPE.sCountry('texas_scope').GetName] has won its independence from Mexico, and now seeks a special relationship with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], whereby they would not be integrated as a state, but instead as an autonomous protectorate.
texan_war_of_independence.2.d3: [SCOPE.sCountry('texas_scope').GetName] has won its independence from Mexico. Despite the best efforts of our ambassadors, they have foolishly refused the offer of US statehood.
nihilism.1.d: An anti-clerical and anti-monarchist movement known as Nihilism has taken hold among the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('nihilist_ig').GetName]. Led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('nihilist_scope').GetFullName], these dangerous thinkers are sure to be a thorn in the side of the status quo.
nihilism.1.c: The state must ban Nihilist literature.
nihilism.1.tt: A Nihilist [concept_agitator] will be created in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName].
bureaucracy.1.d: The civil service, currently led by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('bureaucrat_class').GetName], are deliberately stalling the government by creating unnecessary paperwork. They demand that their jobs be protected under the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
bureaucracy.1.a: Current civil servants can keep their positions.
bureaucracy.1.c: The secret police will keep them in line.
bureaucracy.1.e: Use this opportunity to train their replacements.
bureaucracy.2.d: A new guard of [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('meritocracy_ig').GetName] bureaucrats are outshining the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('bureaucrat_class').GetName] in every aspect of their work. This is a very encouraging omen for the efficacy of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
bureaucracy.2.b: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('bureaucrat_class').GetName] have done a shoddy job.
bureaucracy.2.c: Encourage the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('meritocracy_ig').GetName] to join the civil service.
bureaucracy.3.d: Our efforts to pass the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law have run into several classic bureaucratic hurdles. Debates rage around such lofty matters as the correct shape of filing cabinets.
bureaucracy.3.b: This will take as long as it takes.
bureaucracy.3.c: Let's just get it over with.
colonization.1.d: As we dismantle the institution of colonialism, the people of [SCOPE.sCountry('colony_scope').GetName] expect to be granted independence as part of this ideological shift.
colonization.1.a: They shall have the liberty they seek.
colonization.1.b: We have no intention of giving up [SCOPE.sCountry('colony_scope').GetName].
colonization.2.d: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('outsourcing_scope').GetName] is concerned that cheap colonial labor will be used to make their jobs obsolete.
colonization.2.b: Of course we will exploit the colonies!
colonization.3.d: The news that the government intends to pass the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law has created great enthusiasm among those that are eager to exploit new and distant lands.
colonization.3.a: Slow down, the law isn't signed yet!
colonization.3.b: We will take our rightful place on the world stage.
colonization.3.c: Load the ships, we depart for distant shores!
colonization.4.d: The government's attempt to pass the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law has brought the ethics of colonialism to the forefront of public debate.
colonization.4.b: We can concede to some of their points.
our_place_on_the_world_stage: A Place on the World Stage
anarchy.1.d: Anarchists have claimed responsibility for the bombing of a gentlemen's club frequented by members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anarchy_target_ig').GetName]. The body of [SCOPE.sCharacter('anarchy_target_leader').GetFullName] has been found amongst the rubble.
anarchy.1.a: No more than these reactionaries deserve.
anarchy.2.desc: As [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] moves towards [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anarchists_scope').GetName] are calling for the disestablishment of state institutions.
anarchy.2.c: The state has no right to control us!
anarchy.2.d: Colonialism is a blight upon mankind!
anarchy.2.e: The state will slowly wither away.
anarchy.3.d: Anarchists are creating communities that eschew profit and embrace mutual responsibility for the care of their fellow human beings. [SCOPE.sCharacter('anarchist_farmer').GetFullName], the new leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('farmer_ig').GetName], has been encouraging the establishment of cooperative farms.
anarchy.3.b: They have a fascinating approach to agriculture.
tax.1.d: A fringe group of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('antitax_rebels').GetName] has gained remarkable traction. They advocate for the abolition of all taxation, equating it to an act of theft by the state. Their intent seems to be to block any tax reform other than total abolition.
tax.1.a: But who would build the roads?
tax.2.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('patriotic_military').GetName] are rallying support for the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law, promoting the idea that the new tax is vital to support [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] in the [SCOPE.sDiplomaticPlay('war_scope').GetName].
tax.2.a: Dissenters have no sense of loyalty.
tax.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('death_and_taxes_leader').GetFullName] has suddenly died while drafting legislation for the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
tax.3.a: Let us mourn the loss of a great leader.
tax.4.desc: The people of [SCOPE.sState('bandit_state').GetName] tell the story of a highwayman who robs from the rich and gives to the poor. The legend is spreading quickly throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], damaging support for the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
tax.4.b: The police will make an example of the bandit.
tax.5.d: The [concept_upper_strata] have decided to donate generously to the poor. Many among them even advocate for the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law, agreeing that it would be a fair means of redistributing wealth.
tax.6.d: Ambitious [concept_middle_strata] citizens are opposing [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] on the grounds that when they inevitably become wealthy capitalists, they will be excessively taxed.
tax.6.b: Sway them with a tax cut.
je_schleswig_holstein_question_state_own: [GetPlayer.GetName] controls part of $STATE_SCHLESWIG_HOLSTEIN$ and no non-German [concept_country] may own or control a part of the [concept_state]
je_german_unification_complete_trigger_d: We have formed the nation of Germany
je_schleswig_holstein_question_status: The Schleswig-Holstein Question must be resolved before German unification can seriously be entertained.
je_schleswig_holstein_question_reason: The Schleswig-Holstein Question is currently occupying the thoughts and energies of the German nationalists. In order for Germany to progress towards national unification, the German people of Holstein must first be liberated from their Danish overlords.
je_schleswig_holstein_question_solved_tr: A German [concept_country] must have resolved the $je_schleswig_holstein_question$ [concept_journal_entry]
je_schleswig_holstein_question_solved_fa: Another German [concept_country] resolves this [concept_journal_entry] before us
je_german_unification_sole_candidate_tri: There must be no German [Concept('concept_unification_candidate', '$concept_unification_candidates$')] besides [GetPlayer.GetName]
je_german_unification_idea_reason: The ideas of nationalism are spreading like wildfire among the German people. Once these ideals have reached a critical mass of followers in the disparate states of the German Confederation, there is bound to be a push for national unification.
je_german_unification_idea_status: The idea of a German Nation is spreading through the states of the German Confederation.
je_north_german_unification_reason: The age of nationalism is upon us, and the German people seek unification. We must strive to be the foremost power in northern Germany, so that the people look to us as champions of the cause.
je_north_german_status: The North German minor nations will unify with us if we can become the sole [concept_unification_candidate].
je_german_status: To complete the unification of Germany, we should launch a Unification [concept_diplomatic_play]
je_south_german_status: The South German minor nations will unify with us if we can become the sole [concept_unification_candidate].
german_unification.1.d1: With [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] now seen as the sole realistic option for German Unification, many North German states have opted to join our banner. Hopes are high that this will soon lead to a federation of all the Germanies.
german_unification.1.d2: With [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] now seen as the sole realistic option for German Unification, many South German states have opted to join our banner. Hopes are high that this will soon lead to a federation of all the Germanies.
german_unification.1.f: From the scattered fiefdoms of the Holy Roman Empire to the chaos of Napoleon's wake, Germany has never truly been united. What the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] state has achieved today is a step towards the impossible and the inevitable.
german_unification.1.a: The statesmen responsible are national heroes.
german_unification.1.b: The world will know of our achievement.
german_unification.2.d: With [SCOPE.sCountry('german_unification_candidate').GetName] now seen as the sole realistic option for German Unification, many minor German states have opted to join their banner. Should we give up our independence for the sake of greater German unity?
german_unification.3.d: A nobleman named [SCOPE.sCharacter('bismarck_scope').GetFullName] has risen to a prominent position among the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('junkers').GetName]. Advocating for German national unity and political pragmatism, he offers his services to the state.
german_unification.3.b: Realpolitik is not the right policy.
je_german_unification_reason: The time has come to make a decisive push for German unification. As one of the foremost German states, it is our duty to bring about this goal.
german_unification.4.d: The tireless efforts of statesmen and soldiers has been rewarded; Germany is united into a single state.
german_unification.4.f: Through blood and iron, through diplomacy and guile, Germany is united. It is a day of triumph and of reflection. However the future unfolds, the German state will surely play a leading role in deciding the fate of mankind.
german_unification.4.b: This is a victory for the German people.
german_unification.5.d1: The ideals of Nationalism and National Unification have gained many supporters throughout the German Confederation. They look to the more powerful German powers such as ourselves in the hope that we will champion the cause of German unity on the greater European stage.
german_unification.5.d2: The ideals of Nationalism and National Unification have gained many supporters throughout the German Confederation. They look to the look to the more powerful German powers such as [SCOPE.sCountry('german_unifier_candidate').GetName] in the hope that they will champion the cause of German unity on the greater European stage.
german_unification.5.d3: The ideals of Nationalism and National Unification have gained many supporters throughout the German Confederation. With no clear leading power among the German states, it remains uncertain who would champion champion the cause of German unity on the greater European stage.
german_unification.5.a: Momentous times are ahead of us.
je_south_german_unification_reason: The age of nationalism is upon us, and the German people seek unification. We must strive to be the foremost power in southern Germany, so that the people look to us as champions of the cause.
je_age_of_princes_reason: Ethiopia has been shattered into a dozen warring fiefdoms. It is up to us to reunify the Empire and to restore peace and prosperity to our people.
je_age_of_princes_is_ethiopia: You have formed #b Ethiopia#! (see the [concept_nation_formation] tab in your #b Journal#!)
ethiopia.1.d: A minor noble of the House of Solomon has rapidly risen to power and popularity. Legally an outlaw, he has defeated every army sent against him and now he seeks to take the throne of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] by force.
ethiopia.1.f: The legend of the outlaw who robs from the rich and gives to the poor is as old as time, and this rogue Prince exemplifies it. Robbed of his noble inheritance, the man born as Kassa Hailu has raised not only an army but also the hearts of his followers.
ethiopia.1.a: Tewodros will lead us to glory. Enthrone him!
ethiopia.1.b: We will show him how we deal with outlaws.
je_risorgimento_reason: The winds of nationalism sweeping Europe have begun to pass through [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], inspiring figures both within our government and without to look towards the restoration of a single, unified Italy.\n\nWhilst this journal entry is active, having any active [concept_revolution] caused by an [SelectLocalization(SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('italian_national_movement').IsValid, SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('italian_national_movement').GetName, 'movement_italian_national')] will lead to the seizure of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] government by pan-Italian revolutionaries[ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('italy_fate_loc')].
austrian_radicals_cooldown_tt: Has not used the #bold Encourage Italian Nationalism#! decision in the past #v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('risorgimento_action_cooldown_years')]#!
italian_radicals_cooldown_tt: Has not used the #bold Sponsor Pro-Unification Sentiment#! decision in the past #v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('risorgimento_action_cooldown_years')]#!
is_italy_tt: Has formed the nation of #bold Italy#!
italy_will_get_couped_custom: and the instatement of a #bold democratic republic#!
italy_will_get_annexed_custom: and #red annexation#! into the leading Italian state
je_risorgimento_italian_minors_tt: The #b $ITA_ADJ$#! minor nations may unify with us if we become the sole #b $ITA_ADJ$#! [concept_unification_candidate]
je_risorgimento_austrian_radicals_button: Ever since the end of the Napoleonic Wars, Italian territories have been held by foreign powers. Our journey to unify the peninsula may inspire them to raise arms against their own oppressors.
je_risorgimento_italian_radicals_button_: Throughout the Italian peninsula, the masses are slowly awakening and turning towards the idea of a unified Italy. If their rulers are not inclined to follow the call, perhaps their people will be.
ausrad_cooldown_year_tt: This decision will become available again in #v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('risorgimento_action_cooldown_years')] years#!
itarad_cooldown_year_tt: This decision will become available again in #v [GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('risorgimento_action_cooldown_years')] years#!
owns_no_italian_homelands_tt: Does #b not#! own any [GetCulture('north_italian').GetName] or [GetCulture('south_italian').GetName] [concept_homeland] states
italian_unification.4.d_annex: Inspired by calls for the reunification of Italy, nationalist rebels have seized control of [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName] and have sworn themselves to a unified Italy under [SCOPE.sCountry('italian_leader').GetRuler.GetFullName] of [SCOPE.sCountry('italian_leader').GetName].
italian_unification.4.d_coup: Inspired by calls for the reunification of Italy, nationalist rebels have seized control of [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName] and declared the government of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] to have fallen.
italian_unification.4.a: We will rise again, as part of a whole.
italian_unification.4.c: We will rise again, as part of a whole.
italian_unification.5.d: Inspired by calls for the establishment of a single Italian nation, nationalist rebels have seized [SCOPE.sCountry('italian_pannational_country').GetName] and pledged themselves to the unification of Italy under the banner of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName].
italian_unification.5.f: A unified Italy has never been far from the lips of the mad and the ambitious alike. Indeed, a splendid reawakening of the peninsula would give even the single God pause. Such attempts have been folly in the past. Yet in furtive whispers, there is a belief that there may be hope for a new Rome to rise.
italian_unification.5.a: We welcome our brothers and sisters.
italian_unification.5.b: It is best to not frighten our neighbors.
italian_unification.6.d: Inspired by calls for the reunification of Italy, nationalist rebels have seized [SCOPE.sCountry('italian_pannational_country').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] and declared a republic over its former sovereign territories.
italian_unification.6.f: What the aide brought to him was incredulous: another attempt at bringing the Italian peninsula under a single banner. It seemed impossible, divided between at least a half-dozen petty lords and city-states that would as soon strangle each other as Europe. But as the aide spoke, it became plain that this was no idle boast. No, this merited envoys, carrying either a gladius or an olive branch.
italian_unification.6.a: Offer our sympathies to the new regime.
italian_unification.6.b: We have no common cause with these terrorists.
italian_unification.7.d: Following unrest amongst the Italian population of Lombardy-Venetia, nationalist rebels have declared the formation of the [SCOPE.sCountry('rsm_scope').GetName], a revolutionary state founded to seize independence from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] rule.
italian_unification.7.f: A rider in white, astride a white mare, passed along the grounds near where the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] took breakfast that morning. The footman who approached [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] with sweat seeping from every cracked pore carried a blood-red letter. The Italian holdings had entered revolt. The next sweating aide to enter carried another report: these revolting territories called for reinforcements. Reinforcements, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstNameNoFormatting] knew, that would surely be coming.
italian_unification.7.a: Take to the Quadrilateral at once!
italian_states_choose_sides_tt: The #bold Italian#! states will be given the opportunity to support the [SCOPE.sCountry('rsm_scope').GetName]
italian_states_choose_sides_danger_tt: @warning! Relations with #bold Italian#! states may rapidly deterioriate
italian_unification.8.d: Revolutionaries in [SCOPE.sCountry('rsm_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] have declared the formation of a [SCOPE.sCountry('rsm_scope').GetName], independent from the rule of [SCOPE.sCountry('rsm_revolted_scope').GetName]. They call for aid from all Italian states in their struggle.
italian_unification.8.a: They stand for us, and us for them.
italian_unification.8.b: We will not shed [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] blood for [SCOPE.sCountry('rsm_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName].
italian_unification.10.d: The winds of nationalism have begun to pass through the long-divided states of the Italian peninsula. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] patriots and romantic scholars alike have begun to call for the unification of a single Italian state.
italian_unification.10.a: Italy must be restored from oblivion.
italian_unification.10.b: We will not throw ourselves to the winds for this.
veiled_protectorate_ottomans_support: support for Ottoman reconquest of Egypt
german_leadership_neutrality: lacks reason to get involved in #v $dp_leadership_germany$#! play
unlock_national_agitation_tt: Unlocks the 'Stir National Agitation' Character Interaction for [Concept('concept_agitator','$concept_agitators$')]
risorgimento_unifying_stance_set_tt: We will be able to take extra actions to #bold support#! Risorgimento
risorgimento_opposing_stance_tt: Has not chosen to #bold support#! Risorgimento
notification_ita_italian_unification_int: The government of [SCOPE.sCountry('italian_unifier_candidate').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('italian_unifier_candidate').GetRuler.GetFullName] has signaled support for the unification of the Italian peninsula into a single nation.
notification_nationalism_national_agitat: [SCOPE.sCulture('agitation_culture').GetName] nationalist unrest has sharply increased in [SCOPE.sState('agitation_state').GetName]. Agents of [SCOPE.sCountry('agitation_sponsor').GetName] have been suspected of fostering the seditious behavior.
notification_nationalism_decision_agitat: #bold Italian#! nationalist [Concept('concept_activism', '$concept_activism_short$')] has sharply increased in our #bold Italian#! territories. [SCOPE.sCountry('saboteur_country').GetAdjective] propaganda is suspected to be the root of the unrest.
notification_sabotage_decision_agitation: Inspired by the calls for Italian unification from [SCOPE.sCountry('saboteur_country').GetName], the [Concept('concept_activism', '$concept_activism_short$')] of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('italian_nationalist_movement').GetName] has increased.
italian_unification.1.d: Under the heroic leadership of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName], the Italian nation has been birthed into the world. Unified under a common banner, Italy will surely shape the future of Europe and the world.
italian_unification.1.b: We will never forget our brave [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ruler_ig_scope').GetName].
italian_unification.2.d: Inspired by our leadership of the peninsula, the government of the small Italian state of [SCOPE.sCountry('italian_annex_country').GetName] has petitioned to join our efforts to unify the Italian people.
italian_unification.2.b: It is not the right time.
je_consolidate_colonial_rule_reason: The frontier of our Indian territories has proven a consistent source of risk. We are surrounded by disorderly polities under arbitrary rulers which may threaten the integrity of our territory at any time. In order to ensure the security of our core holdings, those native sovereigns who still evade our rule must be brought to heel, and any hint of popular resistance crushed before it spirals out of control.\n\nAs we expand our administration across India, we will have the opportunity to establish new [Concept('concept_princely_state', '$concept_princely_states$')] to aid our administration. Assuming direct rule over too much land will cause the [concept_liberty_desire] of our existing subjects to increase.
je_consolidate_colonial_rule_goal: Highest [Country.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] [concept_secession] Progress less than #variable 30%#! for #v 120#! months\n• (Currently this has been true for #variable [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('east_indies_revolt_var').GetValue]#! months)
je_reform_indies_reason: It has become clear to the Company that exploiting the East Indies through the antiquated continuation of agrarian feudalism and slavery is not a viable strategy. We must transform the economy thoroughly, so that exploitation can be achieved through private enterprise and investment instead.
je_ethical_policy_reason: Previous colonial administrations have allowed the people under their rule to wallow in poverty and ignorance, laboring under a government interested only in what it can extract from them. We have a chance to do better; to provide for these huddled masses a basic education as well as sufficient means to feed and clothe themselves.
east_indies.1.d: The great Indian Subcontinent has been brought completely under [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] rule. Those native forces which once threatened the security of our rule have been brought to heel.
east_indies.1.a: Loyal princes will keep the peace.
east_indies.2.d: The economy of the Indies has been transformed under our diligent rule. With slavery and feudalism abolished, our vast territories are ripe for exploitation through private enterprise.
east_indies.2.a: Investors are beginning to show interest.
east_indies.2.b: We should make greater use of local labor.
east_indies.3.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has superseded the old colonialism. The people under our rule now enjoy a high standard of living and have access to a solid education.
east_indies.3.a: We should teach them good [SCOPE.sReligion('indies_religion').GetName] values.
east_indies.3.b: This is a land of opportunity.
1848.1.d: The radical government has imprisoned [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] and hastily organized a trial. The expected outcome is a guilty verdict followed by public execution.
1848.1.a: Guilty! Long live the Republic! Long live [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]!
je_abolish_monarchy_reason: It is time to put the outdated system of hereditary rule behind us. The monarchy must be removed and its supporters humbled, and it must be given time to fade into memory.
je_abolish_monarchy_goal: The following must be true for 5 total years:
1848.2.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has successfully maintained a republican form of government for many years now. There are few who still remember the old monarchy with any fondness.
1848.2.a: We must put the past behind us.
1848.2.b: There is no harm in nostalgia.
no_more_royalists: [concept_interest_group] Leaders will no longer have the [GetIdeology('ideology_royalist').GetName] ideology
1848.3.d: The radical government has drafted a new constitution that guarantees [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('radical_leader_scope').GetFullName] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('radical_leader_scope').GetHerHis] supporters are demanding that the constitution be immediately signed into law.
1848.4.d: Under the leadership of [SCOPE.sCharacter('radical_leader_scope').GetFullName], the [GetIdeology('ideology_radical').GetName] movement is becoming very widespread in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. Whether we support or oppose them, this heralds a time of great change and reaction.
1848.4.d_no_leader: Spurred by revolutionary sentiments spreading across Europe, the [GetIdeology('ideology_radical').GetName] movement is becoming widespread in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. Whether we support or oppose them, this heralds a time of great change and reaction.
peoples_springtime_underway_tt: Any #b European#! [concept_country] with a [concept_rank] of [concept_major_power] or above is experiencing a #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],liberal_movements_list_tt Liberal#! or #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],socialist_movements_list_tt Socialist#! [concept_revolution] in her [Concept('concept_capital_state','$concept_capital_state_short$')]
je_secret_police_reason: Desperate times call for desperate measures. With the radicals at the gates threatening to destroy traditional hierarchies, we must be prepared to use coercion to restore order.
1848.5.d: The radical movement is becoming popular, uncontrollable, and violent. Calls for revolution echo in the streets. Extreme measures may be necessary.
1848.5.a: Secret Police will provide a discrete solution.
1848.6.d: The [SCOPE.sLawType('home_affairs_law').GetName] have sown terror throughout the ranks of the radicals. Already we are seeing how effective such a force can be, in the responsible hands of the state.
theocracy.1.d1: Patients at the [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName] Charity Hospital are recovering rapidly. They attribute their recovery to miracles performed by visiting clergy who are patrons of the hospital. Such displays are encouraging support for [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]
theocracy.1.d2: Students at the [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName] School for Orphaned Children rejoice as they receive a series of generous donations from local members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('priests_scope').GetName]. Such displays are encouraging support for [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
theocracy.1.d3: Reports abound of a miracle performed by clergymen in [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName]. Such displays are promoting religious piety throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
theocracy.1.a: Religious institutions are the backbone of the state.
theocracy.1.b: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('priests_scope').GetName] are true followers of the divine.
theocracy.1.c: [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] will fill our hearts with faith.
theocracy.2.d: As part of the transition to [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('priests_scope').GetName] have introduced and enforced a series of harsh anti-blasphemy laws in [SCOPE.sState('blasphemy_state').GetName]. These measures are polarizing even among the faithful.
theocracy.2.c: Blasphemers shall be put to death.
theocracy.3.d: Pogroms targeting [SCOPE.sReligion('target_religion').GetName] people living in [SCOPE.sState('pogrom_state').GetName] are being perpetrated by fanatical [SCOPE.sPop('perpetrator_pop').GetReligion.GetName] supporters of the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
theocracy.3.c: This will not stand. Arrest the perpetrators.
isolation.1.d: Taking an interest in the newly opening [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] economy, [SCOPE.sCountry('fraud_country').GetName] has proposed a trade agreement that seemed initially equitable. On closer inspection it contains numerous unfavorable clauses that were never agreed upon.
isolation.1.c: Sign the treaty, unfavorable as it is.
isolation.2.d: A visiting dignitary from [SCOPE.sCountry('murdered_visitor_country').GetName] has been murdered in a [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName] restaurant. It is suspected that this was an attempt to sabotage a trade agreement that would bring [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] out of its isolated state.
isolation.2.a: Convict a law student as a scapegoat.
isolation.2.b: We must get to the bottom of this crime.
dreadnought_hoax.1.d: The [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] reports that a group of rascal academics have disguised themselves as visiting members of the [SCOPE.sCountry('hoax_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] royal family. Officers at the [SCOPE.sState('hoax_state').GetName] [SCOPE.sBuilding('hoax_building').GetName] believed the deception and offered them a tour of the fleet. The incident has caused great embarrassment to the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('navy_ig').GetName].
dual_monarchy.1.d: We have reached accommodation with the [SCOPE.sCulture('hungarian_culture').GetName] people. After centuries of unbalanced rule, they will now play an equal role in an Austria-Hungarian state.
dual_monarchy.1.d2: The situation in Hungary has reached a boiling point. If we do not give the [SCOPE.sCulture('hungarian_culture').GetName] people an equal part in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] state, we risk open rebellion.
austria_hungary_tt: Country will become known as Austria-Hungary
je_electric_underground_railway_reason: As the capital becomes ever more densely populated, we must devise ever more ingenious transport solutions. Our leading engineers believe that it would be possible to construct an underground rail network powered by electricity beneath the city, allowing citizens to travel rapidly between key locations.
metro.1.d: The grand opening of the [SCOPE.sState('metro_state').GetCityHubName] Metropolitan Railway was received with much celebration. In a speech, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] congratulated the engineers who made this possible.
metro.1.b: Our railway will be the envy of the world.
je_patagonia_reason: The southern reaches of the continent remain outside of the control of any nation. Though the native population will certainly not make it easy, it is imperative that we secure this territory before it falls into the hands of our rivals.
patagonia.1.d: We have completed our long campaign to conquer the Patagonian south. Settlers are beginning to seek out promising sites from which to establish new towns and exploit the region's natural resources.
patagonia.1.a: At last, the south belongs to us.
patagonia.2.d: We have discovered that our rivals in [SCOPE.sCountry('rival_country').GetName] have been arming the [SCOPE.sCountry('patagonia_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] natives in [SCOPE.sState('patagonia_state').GetName]. This is likely to impede our efforts to conquer the region.
patagonia.2.b: If they want a fight, they'll get one.
amazon.1.d: Workers on the [SCOPE.sBuilding('devils_railroad').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('amazon_state').GetName] are dying in droves due to the harsh malarial conditions and the extreme demands placed upon them.
amazon.1.b: This is too high a price to pay.
amazon.2.d: Workers at the [SCOPE.sBuilding('rubber_plantation_scope').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('amazon_state').GetName] are being severely mistreated. Mutilation has become a common punishment for perceived failures.
amazon.2.b: Launch an inquiry into conditions at the plantations.
amazon.2.c: The perpetrators will pay for their crimes.
amazon.4.d: Returning from a safari expedition, [SCOPE.sCharacter('hunted_character').GetFullName] was marooned on a small island in the [SCOPE.sState('dangerous_game_state').GetName]. There [SCOPE.sCharacter('hunted_character').GetSheHe] was hunted like an animal by the [SCOPE.sCountry('hunter_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] aristocrat [SCOPE.sCharacter('hunter_character').GetFullName].
amazon.4.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('hunted_character').GetFirstName] had never slept in a better bed.
je_trans_siberian_railway_reason: Siberia is rich in resources but poor in infrastructure. We must build a great railway that will traverse the vast distance between Moscow and the Pacific!
major_railways.1.d: An extensive railway line now connects [SCOPE.sState('moscow_scope').GetName] to [SCOPE.sState('siberia_end_scope').GetName]. The riches of Siberia are ours for the taking!
major_railways.1.f: This is a triumph for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] nation. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] trains shall carry [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] coal, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] sulfur, and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] iron across the vast expanse of Eurasia!
siberia_mines.tt: Every owned state in the East Siberia and West Siberia Strategic Regions gets:
je_trans_continental_railway_reason: The railway shall connect us all, from sea to shining sea!
major_railways.2.d: With the route between the Atlantic and Pacific complete, the door is open for greater settlement of the American West.
major_railways.2.a: We will settle the Great Plains.
major_railways.2.b: The West Coast shall be just as prosperous as the East.
transcontinental.tt: Every owned state in the Great Plain Strategic Region gets:
major_railways.3.d: The Canada Pacific Railway has finally been completed, connecting the Atlantic and Pacific coasts. The new railway opens up new opportunities for settlement across the Western Provinces.
major_railways.3.a: The coast holds the most promise.
major_railways.3.b: There is great potential in the Prairies.
je_canada_pacific_railway_reason: A railway spanning from the Atlantic to the Pacific coast would open up new opportunities for settlement in Western Canada.
je_victoria_reason: The personal union between Great Britain and Hanover rests upon unstable ground. Different laws of succession guarantee that the union will end upon the death of King William, with the British throne passing to Princess Victoria.
billy_died: King William of Hanover has died
hanover_union_ends: The union between Britain and Hanover will end
je_general_strike_warning: If the strike has not been resolved within 5 years, a General Strike will occur
je_general_strike_active: A General Strike is in effect
je_scotland_yard_reason: As cities grow and dangerous ideas spread, the need to maintain public order becomes even more essential. The police must have the manpower and resources that they need to keep the peace, with priority given to the heart of our nation.
scotland_yard.1.d: Scotland Yard has solved a series of high-profile murders in [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName] thanks to the expansion of the [SCOPE.sLawType('police_law').GetName]. Public confidence in the institution is at an all-time high.
scotland_yard.1.d2: The [SCOPE.sLawType('police_law').GetName] has solved a series of high-profile murders in [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetCityHubName] thanks to our investment in their institution. Public confidence in the police is at an all-time high.
scotland_yard.1.a: Medals for all of our brave Bobbies!
siberia_tt: Every owned state in [SCOPE.sStrategicRegion('west_siberia').GetName], and [SCOPE.sStrategicRegion('manchuria').GetName] with a Railway gets:
plague_might_spread.tt: The virus may spread to [THIS.GetCountry.GetName] via neighboring states or common markets.
je_spanish_flu_reason: A deadly flu pandemic is ravaging the globe. The government's response to this plague will determine the fate of thousands, perhaps millions, of lives.
production_tech_events.700.d: The manufacture of steam engines has become a profitable industry in [SCOPE.sState('steam_engine_state').GetName] thanks to our sound investment in locomotive technology. These engines are already being employed across new [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] railway lines.
production_tech_events.700.c: We're on the track for innovation.
je_steam_engines_reason: The locomotive industry is a promising avenue not only for the development of our infrastructure, but also for profit and innovation. We should establish factories capable of manufacturing steam engines, and connect our cities through railways.
has_adjacent_railway_tt: Any owned neighboring state also meets these conditions
wedding.1.d: The nation celebrates the marital union of [SCOPE.sCharacter('royal_marriage_character').GetHerHis] Most Gracious Majesty [SCOPE.sCharacter('royal_marriage_character').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('royal_marriage_character').GetFirstName] and the charming [SCOPE.sCharacter('royal_marriage_character').GetCustom('wedding_son_daughter')] of [SCOPE.sCharacter('foreign_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('foreign_ruler').GetFirstName] of [SCOPE.sCountry('marriage_country').GetName].
wedding.1.a: Invite only those of the highest social standing.
wedding.1.b: A grand public wedding will placate the masses.
je_land_reclamation_reason: The Netherlands is densely populated, and arable land is increasingly scarce. Through great works of engineering, we can reclaim new land from the sea.
je_land_reclamation_goal: Has reclaimed at least 20 Arable Land
land_reclamation_no_tech: Each year there is a chance that our land reclamation effort will yield results and create more Arable Land. The process will be more efficient if we research Concrete Dockyards.
land_reclamation_tech: Each year there is a chance that our land reclamation effort will yield results and create more Arable Land. The process is more efficient because we have researched Concrete Dockyards.
land_reclamation.1.d2: Our land reclamation project in [SCOPE.sState('land_reclamation_state').GetName] has borne results. The state can now support additional agricultural land.
land_reclamation.1.d: Our land reclamation project in [SCOPE.sState('land_reclamation_state').GetName] has borne results. The state can now support additional agricultural land. With this final polder, a great feat of engineering is complete.
land_reclamation.1.b: We are the masters of land and sea.
central_america.3.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('secession_country').GetName] has declared its secession from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. This has prompted further instability and turmoil in the remaining states of our fragile union.
central_america_capital_tt: When Central America is dissolved, you will play as the country most appropriate to your capital state. You can change your national capital through the Political Lens.
central_america_breakup_status: Central American states with high turmoil may secede
je_peru_bolivia_goal: [SCOPE.sCountry('bolivia_scope').GetNameNoFlag] successfully maintains her [SCOPE.sCulture('south_andean_culture').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCulture('quechua_culture').GetName] [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] whilst keeping [concept_legitimacy] over #bold 50#! for 10 years
je_autocracy_reason: Our nation is defined by the absolute authority of our beloved ruler. We are one family, with one father and one fatherland; united and strong. If we wish to preserve these values, the Autocracy must be maintained.
je_autocracy_goal: The following must be true for 30 total years:
autocracy.1.d: The state policy of Religion, Autocracy, and Nationality has become the ubiquitous ideology of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] people. There are few who dare to question the absolute authority of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('monarch_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
autocracy.2.d: Clandestine groups of academics in [SCOPE.sState('secret_societies_state').GetName] are plotting against the state to advance the misguided cause of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('secret_society_ig').GetName].
autocracy.2.a: Leave them be, they pose no threat.
autocracy.3.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('church_scope').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('religious_serfs_state').GetName] are assuring [SCOPE.sPop('religious_serf_pop').GetName] that despite the harsh conditions of their lives, they are serving the greater good of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation. Serfs shall be rewarded in the hereafter for their service.
autocracy.3.a: Imbue them with loyalty to the state.
generals.1.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('low_rank_general_ig').GetName] demand the promotion of [SCOPE.sCharacter('low_rank_general').GetRankName] [SCOPE.sCharacter('low_rank_general').GetFullName], touting [SCOPE.sCharacter('low_rank_general').GetHerHis] history of loyal and effective service.
generals.1.f: So many medals adorned [SCOPE.sCharacter('low_rank_general').GetHerHis] jacket that one could scarcely see the fabric beneath, but it was not yet enough. Chest puffed out with pride, the General smiled as [SCOPE.sCharacter('low_rank_general').GetSheHe] imagined the look on [SCOPE.sCharacter('high_rank_general').GetLastNameNoFormatting]'s face when the [SCOPE.sCharacter('high_rank_general').GetRankName] learned of [SCOPE.sCharacter('low_rank_general').GetHerHis] imminent ascension; their rivalry was legendary among the officers.\n\nAt last [SCOPE.sCharacter('low_rank_general').GetSheHe] would have [SCOPE.sCharacter('low_rank_general').GetHerHis] due.
generals.1.b: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('low_rank_general_ig').GetName] will not force our hand.
shinto_decision_desc: With the restoration of the imperial household to political power, it would be wise to integrate local beliefs into an official state religion emphasizing the Emperor's divinity.
je_skyscraper_site_reason: Our architects believe that innovations involving steel frames and concrete would allow the construction of buildings taller than ever conceived before. We have authorized a survey to identify the best possible site to lay the foundations.
je_skyscraper_site_goal: Await the completion of the #BOLD 2 year#! survey
je_skyscraper_construction_reason: Having identified the optimal site for our skyscraper, we must set about the monumental task of its construction. When it is completed we expect this structure to be among the tallest in all the world.
skyscraper_decision_desc: Our architects believe that innovations involving steel frames and concrete would allow the construction of buildings taller than ever conceived before. They urge us to authorize a survey to identify the best possible site to lay the foundations.
skyscraper.1.d: Our architects and engineers have identified [SCOPE.sState('skyscraper_site').GetCityHubName] in [SCOPE.sState('skyscraper_site').GetName] as the optimal site to begin construction of a Skyscraper.
skyscraper.2.d: Construction of the [SCOPE.sState('skyscraper_state').GetCityHubName] [SCOPE.sBuilding('skyscraper_building_scope').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('skyscraper_state').GetName] is complete. Dominating the skyline, it inspires all who gaze upon it.
skyscraper.2.d2: Construction of the [SCOPE.sState('skyscraper_state').GetCityHubName] [SCOPE.sBuilding('skyscraper_building_scope').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('skyscraper_state').GetName] is complete. The first building of its type in the world, it dominates the skyline and inspires all who gaze upon it.
first_skyscraper_tt: We have constructed the first Skyscraper in the world
war_crimes.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('war_crimes_perpetrator').GetFullName]'s use of mustard gas against the civilian population of [SCOPE.sState('war_crimes_state').GetName] has branded [SCOPE.sCharacter('war_crimes_perpetrator').GetHerHim] a war criminal. There are widespread calls to institute laws outlining acceptable conduct in warfare.
war_crimes.1.a: All's fair in love and war.
je_war_crimes_reason: The recent development of terrifying chemical weapons has called the ethics of modern warfare into question.
war_criminal_desc: This character has committed crimes against humanity, greatly damaging their own reputation.
je_munitions_factories_reason: Developments in firearms technology have created a need for the manufacture of bullets more ammunition than musketballs. If we develop an industry around fabricating bullets, we could supply our own soldiers and potentially sell to other nations.
war_crimes.2.d: The establishment of [SCOPE.sBuilding('munitions_building').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('munitions_state').GetName] ensures an abundant supply of [SCOPE.sGoods('ammo_scope').GetName] for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag].
war_crimes.2.a: If you want peace, prepare for war.
war_crimes.2.b: Let's see some rapid-fire gains in research.
tunguska.1.desc: A massive explosion resounds across the region of Tunguska in [SCOPE.sState('tunguska_state').GetName]. Scientists believe that a celestial object has collided with the Earth.
cholera.1.t: On the Mode of Communication of Cholera
cholera.1.d1: The source of a cholera outbreak in [SCOPE.sState('cholera_state').GetCityHubName] has been traced by the ingenious surgeon-apothecary John Snow. This has led to great advancements in the field of public health.
cholera.1.d2: The source of a cholera outbreak in [SCOPE.sState('cholera_state').GetCityHubName] has been traced by an ingenious surgeon-apothecary. This has led to great advancements in the field of public health.
cholera.1.a: We need to keep the filth off the streets.
manifest_destiny.3.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('native_american_country').GetAdjectiveNoFlag] people of [SCOPE.sState('native_american_state').GetName] rely on bison for many of their basic needs. It would serve the interests of settlers in [SCOPE.sState('bison_state').GetName] if the bison population were to be depleted.
congo_opinion_small_tt: International condemnation of the Free State will increase.
congo_opinion_medium_tt: International condemnation of the Free State will increase significantly.
congo_opinion_high_tt: International condemnation of the Free State will greatly increase.
je_serial_killer_reason: A dangerous killer is stalking the streets of [SCOPE.sState('target').GetCityHubName] and terrifying the people of [SCOPE.sState('target').GetName]. We must do all in our power to catch the criminal before he kills again.
serial_killer_highest_chance: The police are hot on the trail, and are very likely to catch the killer.
serial_killer_high_chance: The police have narrowed down a list of potential suspects and are likely to catch the killer. We can improve our odds by investing in the Police [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institution$')].
serial_killer_medium_chance: The police are pursuing promising leads, and have a moderate chance to catch the killer. We can improve our odds by investing in the Police [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institution$')].
serial_killer_low_chance: The police are not actively investigating the killings. We can improve our odds by investing in the Police [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institution$')].
improved_serial_killer_chance: The police will be more likely to catch the killer
serial_killer_ig: The Ripper: Killer in our Midst
opium_ban_tt: Has taken the 'Ban Opium Trade' Decision
ban_liquor_desc: The consumption of liquor is reducing our citizens to their base urges. Liquor must be banned to ensure a moral and civilized society.
remove_liquor_ban_desc: Political or economic circumstances may require that we lift the liquor ban.
native_resettlement.6.d: With the passing of the [SCOPE.sLawType('pronativelaw').GetName] Law, the Indian Removal Act is annulled and the [SCOPE.sCulture('cherokee_culture').GetName] people are free to live on their ancestral lands.
native_resettlement.6.f:
Some bard shall lift a voice in praise of thee,
In moving numbers tell the world how men
Scoffed thee, hissed thee, charged with lunacy!
And who could not give 'nough honor when
At length, in spite of jeer, of want and need,
Thy genius shaped a dream into a deed.
trail_of_tears_stalled: Further removals will be stalled for 3 years
indian_removal_force_tt: Many Cherokee people will die along the way
indian_removal_normal_tt: Some Cherokee people will die along the way
indian_removal_end: If the Removal is not prevented, the Cherokee people will be forced to migrate at great loss of life.
indian_removal_fail_tt: No Cherokee [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] remain in the United States
notification_victoria_notification_desc: With the death of King William IV, differing succession laws have ended the [concept_personal_union] between these nations.
csa_releasable_tt: The American Civil War has happened
notification_law_notification_advance_de: [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has attracted new supporters, increasing [concept_enactment_success] by 15%
notification_law_notification_debate_suc: [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has been debated in political spheres with a positive outcome, increasing [concept_enactment_success] by 10%
notification_law_notification_debate_fai: [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has fared poorly in public debates, decreasing [concept_enactment_success] by 10%
notification_law_notification_stall_desc: [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] is failing to gain traction, stalling progress and decreasing [concept_enactment_success] by 15%
notification_law_notification_setback_de: [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] is failing to gain traction, stalling progress and causing the law to gain a setback
notification_law_notification_phase_forw: [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has successfully progressed to the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('enactment_phase_1')] phase of [concept_law] [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enactment$')]

[SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has successfully progressed to the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('enactment_phase_2')] phase of [concept_law] [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enactment$')]
skyscraper_can_construct_tt: Has identified and surveyed an appropriate site for a Skyscraper
unite_australia_je_aus_tt: Have at least Amicable relations and greater GDP than a neighboring Australian or Maori country with the same overlord
unite_canada_je_can_tt: Have at least Amicable relations and greater GDP than a neighboring Anglo-Canadian or Franco-Canadian country with the same overlord
gbr_aus_relations_tt: Have at least Amicable relations with two Australian or Maori subjects
gbr_can_relations_tt: Have at least Amicable relations with two Anglo-Canadian or Franco-Canadian subjects
opium_wars_fail_invalid_tt: The opium ban will continue unopposed.
strike_negotiate_tooltip: We will have to pass a [concept_law] or expand an [concept_institution] favorable to the Trade Unions
scramble_for_africa_complete_tt: Control #variable [JournalEntry.GetTotalGoalValue]#! or more [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_africa').GetName] through [Concept('concept_unincorporated_state','$concept_unincorporated_states$')] or [Concept('concept_subject','$concept_subjects$')]
expedition_cancelled_tt: The Expedition is cancelled due to lack of funds and progress
central_america_fail_tt: Owns less than 3 Central American States
kill_own_ruler_tt: The assassins will gain progress much more quickly
assassination_events.1.b: Perhaps this would not be such a terrible thing.
bic_breakup.1.d: Rudderless and without the support of its colonial overlord, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is on the verge of collapse. It seems that [SCOPE.sCulture('british_culture').GetName] rule is at an end.
bic_breakup.1.a: India will be divided between the Princes.
bic_breakup.1.b: This is the birth of an Indian nation.
bic_breakup.1.c: British rule must be maintained at all costs.
india_princes_independent_tt: All [concept_subject] countries will become independent, and our [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] will be divided between them.
warlord_china_implosion_tt: Our [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] will be divided between the warlords
dei_breakup.1.d: Rendered without support by the withdrawal of its colonial overlord, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s administration has begun to collapse across the Indonesian archipelago. It seems that colonial rule is at an end at last.
dei_breakup.1.f: Across the islands, the silence rose like a wave. Cut telegraph wires, deserting policemen, farms that would no longer report their harvests. And then, the silence broke, and with it came annihilation.
dei_breakup.1.a: The peoples of the archipelago have seized their right.
dei_breakup.1.b: One motherland, one nation, one language!
dei_breakup.1.c: We will rage against the storm until we are saved.
dei_vassals_independent_tt: All [concept_subject] countries will become independent, and our [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] will be divided between them.
