The progress of the emerging [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] #bold National Identity#! has reached #variable 100%#!
completed_pan_national_project_tt: We have successfully completed any of the #bold Peru-Bolivian Confederation#!, #bold Gran Colombia#!, or #bold Bolivar's Ambition#! [Concept('concept_journal_entry', '$concept_journal_entries$')]
notification_bol_salaverry_death_desc: The death of the leader of the Peruvian opposition has marked the end of the Peruvian civil war, and the beginning of the #bold Peru-Bolivian Confederation#!.
bol_no_revolutions_tt: None of [SCOPE.sCountry('bolivia_scope').GetNameNoFlag]'s [SCOPE.sCulture('south_andean_culture').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCulture('quechua_culture').GetName] [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] are currently in a [concept_civil_war]
communism.10.d: As our industries have grown more and more crucial to the future of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation, so too has the working class. Disparate workers' movements have begun to unite under the cause for socialism.
communism.10.b: The world will be free, one day.
communism_var_tick_05_tt: #bold Socialist#! unrest will #bold increase#! by #variable 0.5#! every month
communism.11.d: Whether through the trust of our people or the truncheons of our soldiers, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has emerged unbroken from the wave of socialist agitation that threatened it.
communism.11.f: They still saw the pamphlets, sometimes - decayed paper corpses, trapped in the gutters, caked in soot and mud, bold red and black ink abraded by rough stones and rougher footsteps. The police had not bothered to pick them up, viewing them as an affront to their gloves - or, perhaps, realizing that their fallen remnants made more of a statement than their complete disappearance.
communism.11.b: Things will never be the same again.
communism_je_1_fail_tt: [GetIdeology('ideology_communist').GetName], [GetIdeology('ideology_anarchist').GetName], and [GetIdeology('ideology_vanguardist').GetName] characters will appear much more frequently in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag]
communism_je_1_complete_tt: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] socialist movement will be weakened for the near future
culture_south_america.4.d: The legacy of our nation's independence from Spain has spurred the beginnings of a developed national identity. Conflicts have begun between the vision of a unique and independent [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], and the dream of an indivisible Latin America.
culture_south_america.4.f: For centuries, the guns had fired, first turned on those who resisted conquest, and then those who sought to chain the nation to its former master. An informal peace had come with the flight of the Spanish armies - but they had never truly stopped. They remain shouldered, pointed inwards and outwards - waiting for the end of this momentary confusion, and a single target to pursue.
culture_south_america.4.a: Our homeland takes another step towards freedom.
culture_south_america.4.b: We are but one nation amongst many.
slow_cultural_development_progress_tt: The development of a uniquely [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName] culture will be #bold slowed#!, but not averted
notification_brz_brazil_coup_desc: The [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjective] monarchy has fallen to a coup led by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_ig').GetName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_ig').GetName]. A Republic has been declared over the former Empire of Brazil.
notification_pbc_peru_bolivia_collapse_d: The Peru-Bolivian Confederation has collapsed to internal and external pressure, with its former constituent nations abrogating their legal ties.
notification_pbc_peru_bolivia_success_de: Representatives of Peru and Bolivia have ratified a formal constitution over the union, finally realizing the solidification of the [SCOPE.sCountry('pbc_scope').GetName].
notification_gco_unification_desc: The government of [SCOPE.sCountry('gco_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('gco_scope').GetRuler.GetFullName] has declared the restoration of the state of [SCOPE.sCountry('gco_scope').GetName].
notification_fnd_unification_desc: The government of [SCOPE.sCountry('federation_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('federation_scope').GetRuler.GetFullName] has declared the formation of the [SCOPE.sCountry('federation_scope').GetName], a vast superstate unifying much of Hispanophone America.
notification_plt_unification_desc: The government of [SCOPE.sCountry('plt_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('plt_scope').GetRuler.GetFullName] has declared the restoration of [SCOPE.sCountry('plt_scope').GetName], claiming the territory of the former Viceroyalty and United Provinces.
notification_brz_isabel_accession_name: The Death of Dom Pedro II
notification_brz_isabel_accession_desc: The Emperor of Brazil, Pedro II, has passed away, with [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetRuler.GetFullName] assuming the throne in his wake.
notification_sa_culture_genesis_desc: [SCOPE.sCountry('south_america_nation_scope').GetName], formerly known as a [SCOPE.sCulture('old_national_culture').GetName] nation, has experienced a widespread cultural awakening, transitioning towards a distinct [SCOPE.sCulture('new_national_culture').GetName] culture.
notification_brz_cultural_unification_de: The [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjective] has successfully consolidated its disparate regional cultures into a single [SCOPE.sCulture('brazilian_culture_scope').GetName] identity.
notification_brz_navy_completed_desc: A long period of naval modernization and enlargement by the [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjective] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('navy_scope').GetName] has come to fruition, with the [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] now being one of the most formidable in the world.
notification_brz_amazon_border_treaty_co: [SCOPE.sCountry('colombia_border_treaty_country_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName] have signed a border treaty, codifying their respective borders and consolidating more of the northern Amazon Rainforest under [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] control.
notification_brz_amazon_border_treaty_bo: [SCOPE.sCountry('bolivia_border_treaty_country_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName] have signed a border treaty, codifying their respective borders and consolidating more of the southern Amazon Rainforest under [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] control.
industrial_accident_events.1.d: A deadly fire has killed many workers in [SCOPE.sState('triangle_shirtwaist_factory_state').GetName], due in part to dangerous working conditions and locked emergency exits. It has been revealed that [SCOPE.sCharacter('guilty_factory_owner').GetFullName], a prominent member of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('guilty_factory_owner_ig').GetName], was the owner of the now-scorched factory.
industrial_accident_events.1.f: One of the men who tried to put out the fire testified at the inquiry.
industrial_accident_events.1.a: This is just the price of progress.
industrial_accident_events.1.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('guilty_factory_owner').GetFullName] must be held responsible for these deaths!
industrial_accident_events.1.b.tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('guilty_factory_owner').GetFullName] will be arrested and removed from [SCOPE.sCharacter('guilty_factory_owner').GetHerHis] position of power.
industrial_accident_events.2.d: Several workers dyed today at the [SCOPE.sState('dyeworks_state').GetName] dyeworks, when an industrial-sized tub of hot dye accidentally spilled out over the workshop floor and the unsuspecting workers.
industrial_accident_events.2.f: Locals are upset about the incident, claiming that the poor safety regulations in the hot and dangerous workplace are to blame for the accident, and are urging the government to take action. As rescue workers left the scene, several workshop employees were left dyeing.
industrial_accident_events.2.a: We shall all dye sooner or later.
industrial_accident_events.2.b: They shall not have dyed in vain!
industrial_accident_events.3.d: A railroad accident in [SCOPE.sState('casey_jones_state').GetName] only narrowly avoided heavy fatalities due to the quick thinking of the train's engineer, who perished in the crash. Only a few people died, but the wreckage will still take some time to clear.
industrial_accident_events.3.b: Railmen should get more than a song for dying on the job.
industrial_accident_events.4.d: A storage tank full to the brim with molasses intended for rum distillation has burst, flooding the streets of [SCOPE.sState('molasses_flood_state').GetCityHubName]'s commercial center, killing dozens and injuring hundreds of bystanders.
industrial_accident_events.4.a: Close the distilleries while the wreckage gets cleared.
industrial_accident_events.4.b: One tragedy must not stop progress!
industrial_accident_events.5.d: A factory in [SCOPE.sState('boiler_explosion_state').GetName] has been rocked by a tremendous boiler explosion, with dozens dead or injured. The story of this tragedy has quickly become a national event.
industrial_accident_events.5.a: These events are simply the price of progress.
industrial_accident_events.5.b: Workers should not be exploited and forced into such conditions.
industrial_accident_events.5.c: Machines are dangerous! Industry itself is a cancer.
industrial_accident_events.6.d: A mine in [SCOPE.sState('mining_accident_state').GetName] has collapsed, trapping miners within the dark shafts below. The scale of the accident has made the tragedy a story across [SCOPE.sState('mining_accident_state').GetName] and the nation.
industrial_accident_events.6.a: This is a small price to pay for the march of industry.
industrial_accident_events.6.b: This outrageous abuse of the common man cannot continue!
industrial_accident_events.6.c: These mines are a blight upon man and countryside alike.
egyptian_crisis_events.1.d: Egypt seized most of our Levantine provinces in 1833 after its governor tried and failed to overthrow the entire imperial government. The time to reclaim the lands we lost in that war is long overdue.\n\nHowever, this is likely to draw the attention of any [Concept('concept_great_power', '$concept_great_powers$')] in Europe.
egyptian_crisis_events.1.a: We must see to it that they are on our side.
egyptian_crisis_events.1.a.tt: [THIS.GetCountry.GetName] will be offered an [concept_interest] in the region.
egyptian_crisis_events.1.b: We do not need their approval to take what is ours.
egyptian_crisis_events.2.d: The Ottomans have begun their machinations to retake the lands we won from them in 1833. This is a violation of our sovereignty! However, this is likely to draw the attention of any [Concept('concept_great_power', '$concept_great_powers$')] in Europe, giving us a chance to gain powerful allies in the conflict.
egyptian_crisis_events.2.a.tt: All European [Concept('concept_great_power', '$concept_great_powers$')] will be offered an [concept_interest] in our region.
egyptian_crisis_events.4.d: The Ottoman Empire's attempt to take back control of the Levant from Egypt has become an international incident. Our involvement may tip the balance of power in the region.
egyptian_crisis_events.4.f: At thirty minutes past midday came the messenger with a single, wax-sealed envelope. Chill winds followed in his stumbling, breathless gait. Every other general and advisor gathered around the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] cried for decorum. The messenger brought it forward, with a choking gasp about its origin: Egypt. The Ottomans were coming for Egypt.
egyptian_crisis_events.4.a: We need to keep an eye on the region.
egyptian_crisis_events.4.b: We have no interest in this crisis.
texan_war_of_independence.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('santa_anna_scope').GetFullName], the ruler of Mexico and one of its leading generals, has been captured in a swamp wearing a dragoon's uniform by our forces. He is offering to immediately sign a peace with us in exchange for his release.
texan_war_of_independence.3.a: Use Santa Anna to press for a deal.
texan_war_of_independence.3.b: Let him run back to Mexico, we fight on!
notification_santa_anna_captured_notific: [SCOPE.sCountry('texas_scope').GetName] has captured the [SCOPE.sCountry('mexico_scope').GetAdjective] General Santa Anna, who has used his personal power to negotiate an end to the Texan Independence War
native_resettlement.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('indian_removal_president').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('indian_removal_president').GetFullName] has defied the ruling of the Supreme Court and ordered the removal of the [SCOPE.sCulture('cherokee_culture').GetName] people to the [SCOPE.sCountry('indian_territory_scope').GetName].
native_resettlement.2.d: Chief John Ross, one of the principal [SCOPE.sCulture('cherokee_culture').GetName] chiefs, has presented a petition to Congress asking them to void the treaty which will compel the [SCOPE.sCulture('cherokee_culture').GetName] nation to relocate to the [SCOPE.sCountry('indian_territory_scope').GetName]. His petition has almost as many signatures as the entire eastern Cherokee population.
native_resettlement.2.a: A treaty is a treaty. We cannot rescind what we have signed.
native_resettlement.2.b: Our conscience compels us to void the removal treaty.
native_resettlement.3.d: In accordance with the removal treaty, it is time for the [SCOPE.sCulture('cherokee_culture').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('indian_removal_state').GetName] to relocate to the [SCOPE.sCountry('indian_territory_scope').GetName]. Some holdouts refuse to leave their homes, and many are poorly equipped for the journey.
native_resettlement.3.b: Offer some assistance for their journey.
native_resettlement.4.d: Our efforts to remove the [SCOPE.sCulture('cherokee_culture').GetName] from eastern lands has led to the deaths of many during their overland march westward.
native_resettlement.4.b: Their blood is on our hands.
native_resettlement.5.d: The removal of the [SCOPE.sCulture('cherokee_culture').GetName] to the [SCOPE.sCountry('indian_territory_scope').GetName] is complete. For good or ill, the matter is settled.
native_resettlement.5.a: Let us pray that this shall never happen again.
je_indian_removal_reason: Settlers want the Cherokee nation to vacate coveted land. The President, in defiance of the Supreme Court, has ordered that the Cherokee nation should migrate to the Indian Territory.
USA_accepted_ross_petition: Accepted the Petition of John Ross
USA_rejected_ross_petition: Rejected the Petition of John Ross
je_railroads_status: Provide rail transportation for our industries.
je_railroads_reason: Our new Railways should be fed with traffic from smaller lines in order to fully utilize their capabilities.
production_tech_events.501.d: The growth of branch lines along the main rail routes has been immensely valuable to the growth of our burgeoning rail industry.
production_tech_events.501.b: The locomotive-builders of [SCOPE.sState('engine_state').GetName] should benefit from this boom.
production_tech_events.501.c: Let us not rest on our laurels, but anticipate the future!
je_indian_removal_resolve_the_chain: Conclude the ongoing process of Removal either by stopping the proceedings or completing them.
slavery_law_events.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('slaver_ig_leader_scope').GetFullName], the leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('slaver_ig_scope').GetName], has delivered a well-received speech regarding the classical basis of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] and its historical legitimacy.
slavery_law_events.1.a: Promote [SCOPE.sCharacter('slaver_ig_leader_scope').GetFullName] as a leader of men.
slavery_law_events.1.b: Praise the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('slaver_ig_scope').GetName] as cultivators of great minds.
slavery_law_events.2.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('slaver_ig_leader_scope')], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('slaver_ig_scope').GetName], has voiced [SCOPE.sCharacter('slaver_ig_leader_scope').GetHerHis] interest in arguing for slavery in a public debate. The theoretical debate may not go so well as [SCOPE.sCharacter('slaver_ig_leader_scope').GetSheHe] hopes, however.
slavery_law_events.2.a: There is no need to stage a public debate.
slavery_law_events.3.d: A surge of books written by former slaves abroad have recently been published in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName], detailing the horrific conditions they faced. This has shaken public confidence in the efforts to implement [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] here.
slavery_law_events.3.a: This is just a minor, tolerable hitch in our plans.
slavery_law_events.3.b: We must publicly challenge this slanderous material!
slavery_law_events.4.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('abolitionist_ig_leader_scope').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('abolitionist_ig_scope').GetName], has written a sensational story about life on a slave plantation.
slavery_law_events.4.b: Promote [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('abolitionist_ig_scope').GetName] as a publisher of anti-slavery works.
slavery_law_events.5.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('abolitionist_ig_scope')] has proposed staging a series of debates arguing the merits of abolition. If [SCOPE.sCharacter('slaver_ig_leader_scope').GetHerHis] debates go off well, [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('abolitionist_ig_scope').GetName] and the cause of Abolition will prosper.
slavery_law_events.5.a: A public debate risks too much. We cannot allow it.
slavery_law_events.5.b: Permit public debates on the merits of abolition.
slavery_law_events.6.d: Defenders of continued slavery have published a wave of diatribes, treatises, and sensationalized fictional narratives all to support their cause. The quantity, if not the quality, of these works has shaken public confidence in abolitionism.
slavery_law_events.6.a: Let the slavers speak empty words, full of nothing.
slavery_law_events.6.b: These publications are full of evil and lies, and must be challenged.
slave_revolt.1.d: Slaves on one of our nation's mercantile ships have risen up, seized control of the ship, and sailed to nearby [SCOPE.sCountry('neighbor_country').GetName], where slavery is illegal.
slave_revolt.1.b: It's out of our hands now.
notification_slave_revolt_1_desc: [SCOPE.sC('originator').GetName] has lowered our [concept_relations] because our rejection of slavery has led to their slaves fleeing to our territory for freedom.
slave_revolt.2.d: A significant group of slaves have risen up and made for the borders of [SCOPE.sCountry('neighbor_country').GetName], where slavery is illegal.
slave_revolt.2.a: We shall fund the capture of all fugitives.
notification_slave_revolt_2_desc: [SCOPE.sC('originator').GetName] has lowered our [concept_relations] because our rejection of slavery has led to their slaves fleeing to our territory for freedom.
slave_revolt.3.d: Slaves have risen up in [SCOPE.sState('slave_insurrection_state').GetName]. They are not a significant force yet, and there are multiple ways to approach them.
slave_revolt.3.a: Negotiate with the revolt's leaders to defuse this.
slave_revolt.3.b: We do not negotiate with insurrectionists.
did_not_protest_ship_seizure: Did Not Protest Slave Ship Loss
laws_police.1.d: An assassin's bullet narrowly missed a minister from the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('assassination_target_ig').GetName] this morning, prompting calls for the rapid passage of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] laws. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('they_dont_like_laws_ig').GetName], opponents of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], are also being accused of implicitly supporting the assassin.
laws_police.1.b: Those who oppose order must be censured.
laws_police.2.d: The national effort to implement [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has become the subject of debate between partisan newspapers, and may disrupt the lawmaking process.
laws_police.2.a: Let the newspapers say what they want.
laws_police.2.b: Issue our own editorials for the papers.
laws_police.2.c: The papers have spoken freely enough on this matter.
laws_police.3.d: A largely peaceful demonstration for the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('rally_movement').GetName] has been violently broken up by the local militia. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rally_movement_ig').GetName], a major supporter of the movement, is particularly upset by the violence. The incident has led many to question the wisdom in establishing any permanent law enforcement with the right to use force.
laws_police.3.a: Perhaps a period of reflection is necessary right now.
laws_police.3.b: We can't let word of this get out- crack down on the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('rally_movement').GetName].
laws_police.3.c: This is exactly why we need [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] instead of using these brutes!
monarchy_law_events.1.d: A procession of activists in the capital have been joined by soldiers and civilians, all calling for monarchy. [SCOPE.sCharacter('monarchist_ig_leader_scope').GetFullName] has taken the opportunity to speak directly to the assembled crowd.
monarchy_law_events.1.a: [SCOPE.sCharacter('monarchist_ig_leader_scope').GetFullName] is a figure who really knows [SCOPE.sCharacter('monarchist_ig_leader_scope').GetHerHis] stuff.
monarchy_law_events.1.b: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('monarchist_ig_scope').GetName] is clearly the home of monarchists, and therefore the nation.
monarchy_law_events.2.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameWithTitle] has been heard casually making positive comments about various secular governments. Some suspect that [SCOPE.sCharacter('secularizing_spiritualist').GetSheHe] is tiring of ruling [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] as a theocrat.
monarchy_law_events.2.a: [SCOPE.sCharacter('secularizing_spiritualist').GetFullName] knows which way the winds are blowing.
monarchy_law_events.3.d: The question of who should actually sit on the throne has prompted some monarchists to suggest inviting a member of the [SCOPE.sCountry('neighboring_monarchy').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] royal family over to serve as our monarch. This idea has been received, to put it lightly, contentiously.
monarchy_law_events.3.a: Let's not encourage these people to talk.
monarchy_law_events.3.b: Every monarchist deserves to be heard.
monarchy_law_events.4.d: Some monarchists have been discussing what the royal regalia ought to be, and it has led to a realization that the country has nothing that really seems appropriate for a monarch. One attempt at a homemade crown, made from tin and gold foil, has been seized as a symbol of the proposed monarchy's 'innately tawdy' nature.
monarchy_law_events.4.a: That crown is just a symbol! Er...
monarchy_law_events.4.b: That crown IS a symbol! A symbol of the nation's love for monarchy!
trains.1.d: An enterprising entertainer has arranged for two aging locomotives to run into each other at a local fair. The resulting collision may pose a danger to the crowd, although that hasn't stopped [SCOPE.sCharacter('train_crash_attendee').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('train_crash_attendee_ig').GetName], from declaring that [SCOPE.sCharacter('train_crash_attendee').GetSheHe] will have a front-row seat at the event.
trains.1.b: Forbid [SCOPE.sCharacter('train_crash_attendee').GetFullName] from risking [SCOPE.sCharacter('train_crash_attendee').GetHerHis] life attending this!
the_desire_to_smash_things_up_has_been_d: Denied Attendance to the Smashing Event
economy_laws.1.d: The central economic office has declared that our efforts to bring economic matters under government control has resulted in surprisingly positive growth.
economy_laws.1.f: The man nervously adjusted his glasses.
economy_laws.1.b: Excellent! Let's support the clerks who made this possible.
economy_laws.2.d: A faction of the government is objecting to the pace and approach to our changing economic policy, and wishes to discuss and revise our current agenda.
economy_laws.2.a: Let party members debate the issue.
economy_laws.2.b: Push our stance at party conferences.
economy_laws.2.c: Have a little chat with our opponents.
economy_laws.3.d: Our efforts to push our reform of the economy through has caused shortages and mismanagement in [SCOPE.sState('state_run_state').GetName].
economy_laws.3.b: We have no failures, only successes!
economy_laws.4.d: An orator from the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('pro_free_trade_ig').GetName] has gone on a speaking tour across the nation, denouncing [SCOPE.sLaw('standing_law_scope').GetName] and praising the value of Free Trade.
economy_laws.4.a: We work towards a common goal!
economy_laws.4.b: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('pro_free_trade_ig').GetName] has a truly remarkable speaker among them.
economy_laws.5.d: Opponents of our planned economic reforms have demanded the right to have their ideas heard as much as our own, and, gallingly, are using our Free Market rhetoric to justify their own right to speak.
economy_laws.5.a: We want free markets, not loose talk!
economy_laws.5.b: Competition is necessary, even in ideas.
economy_laws.5.c: In a free encounter, truth prevails!
economy_laws.6.d: Competing goods from abroad have led to a slump in demand for products from [SCOPE.sState('industrial_protectionist_state').GetName], which has raised concerns in the state about our planned reforms.
economy_laws.6.b: We must try to convince [SCOPE.sState('industrial_protectionist_state').GetName] the merit of our reforms.
economy_laws.6.c: We must forge ahead with our plans regardless.
africa_colonial_events.40.d: An officer in our African colonies has intentionally provoked a confrontation with [SCOPE.sCountry('jingoist_officer_victim').GetName], despite instructions to keep the peace. We can either save face by going along with the officer's plot, or recall him, admit that we lost control of the situation, and upset the jingoists.
africa_colonial_events.40.a: We have no choice but to attack [SCOPE.sCountry('jingoist_officer_victim').GetName].
africa_colonial_events.40.b: Recall the officer and end this madness!
africa_colonial_events.40.c: I like this guy! Continue the attack and promote the officer.
africa_colonial_events.41.d: A patriotic explorer and partisan of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rogue_imperialist_ig').GetName] has been surveying land in [SCOPE.sState('rogue_imperialist_state').GetName] and signing treaties with local leaders on behalf of our nation, but [SCOPE.sCountry('rogue_imperialist_target').GetName] has already established a presence in this area. If the explorer's claims are recognized, [SCOPE.sCountry('rogue_imperialist_target').GetName] will be furious with us.
africa_colonial_events.41.a: Accept the claim on [SCOPE.sState('rogue_imperialist_state').GetName] and upset [SCOPE.sCountry('rogue_imperialist_target').GetName].
africa_colonial_events.41.b: Reject the explorer and upset our own jingoists.
africa_colonial_events.41.c: This man is a rolemodel! He ought to go into politics!
anti_state_religion.1.d: A shocking exposé published in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] has revealed astonishing depths of corruption within our nation's religious institutions. Public opinion has swung decisively against [SCOPE.sReligion('country_religion').GetName] clergy.
anti_state_religion.1.b: Ghastly! Perhaps it's time for a change of heart.
anti_state_religion.2.d: The state's efforts to curb the power of the clergy has provoked a backlash among the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('community_rel_ig_scope').GetName], who are demanding the end to these anti-clericalist policies.
anti_state_religion.2.b: We should reconsider our planned policies.
anti_state_religion.3.d: A fiery [SCOPE.sReligion('country_religion_pop').GetName] preacher has shown up in the capital, provoking fights with guards and yelling the most incendiary rhetoric. He is clearly attempting to be arrested and make himself a 'martyr' for the faith.
election_neutral.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('mulligan_letters_leader').GetFullName], a prominent member of the [SCOPE.sParty('mulligan_letters_party').GetName], has been accused of gross corruption. [SCOPE.sCharacter('mulligan_letters_leader').GetSheHe|U] strenuously denied all allegations until damning letters surfaced signed by [SCOPE.sCharacter('mulligan_letters_leader').GetHerHim].
election_neutral.1.a: [SCOPE.sParty('mulligan_letters_party').GetName] should stand by [SCOPE.sCharacter('mulligan_letters_leader').GetFullName] and deny everything.
election_neutral.1.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('mulligan_letters_leader').GetFullName] should be isolated to protect the rest of the [SCOPE.sParty('mulligan_letters_party').GetName].
election_neutral.1.c: There are allies in the [SCOPE.sParty('mulligan_letters_party').GetName] who can speak in [SCOPE.sCharacter('mulligan_letters_leader').GetLastName]'s defense.
election_neutral.1.c.tt: A character in the [SCOPE.sParty('mulligan_letters_party').GetName] has the Charismatic trait.
election_neutral.2.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('electioneering_commander').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('electioneering_commander').GetLastName] has made public statements in support of [SCOPE.sParty('electioneering_commander_party').GetName], bringing into question the political neutrality of the military.
election_neutral.2.b: Reprimand [SCOPE.sCharacter('electioneering_commander').GetHerHim]—good soldiers don't give orders, they take them!
election_neutral.2.c: If [SCOPE.sCharacter('electioneering_commander').GetFullName] likes politics so much, [SCOPE.sCharacter('electioneering_commander').GetSheHe] ought to get more involved.
election_neutral.2.c.tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('electioneering_commander').GetFullName] does not have the Politician trait.
election_neutral.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('whistle_stop_leader').GetFullName] intends to travel across [SCOPE.sState('whistle_stop_state').GetName] by train to campaign for the [SCOPE.sParty('whistle_stop_party').GetName].
election_neutral.3.a: Campaigning by rail is a smart move.
election_neutral.3.b: It'd be a shame if that campaign train kept suffering delays.
election_neutral.3.c: The fate of the nation depends on that train running on time!
election_neutral.3.b.tt: An Interest Group supporting the [SCOPE.sParty('whistle_stop_party').GetName] is not in government.
election_neutral.4.d: The government's friendly relationship with [SCOPE.sCountry('midlothian_campaign_ally_country').GetName], an infamous country with a horrible reputation, has been the subject of sharp criticism and strong rhetoric from leading opposition candidates.
election_neutral.4.a: Perhaps the speaker from [SCOPE.sParty('opposition_party').GetName] has a point.
election_neutral.4.b: If the government distances itself from [SCOPE.sCountry('midlothian_campaign_ally_country').GetName], the [SCOPE.sParty('opposition_party').GetName]'s argument will be undercut.
election_neutral.5.d: Supporters of [SCOPE.sParty('campaign_club_party').GetName] have gone beyond simply campaigning for their own party, harassing and sometimes physically attacking opposing partisans.
election_neutral.5.c: Why should they limit who they target? Go forth and fight the good fight!
election_neutral.5.c.tt: A leader of the [SCOPE.sParty('campaign_club_party').GetName] has the Wrathful or Cruel trait.
election_neutral.6.d: Party-affiliated newspapers have been proliferating during this election season. Publications associated with the [SCOPE.sParty('newspaper_party').GetName] have been particularly effective in spreading the party line.
election_neutral.6.a: The [SCOPE.sParty('newspaper_party').GetName] has used the papers brilliantly.
election_neutral.6.b: Newspaper circulation is through the roof! This is a boom for publishers.
election_neutral.6.c1: It is in the State's interest to promote the truth.
election_neutral.6.c2: It is in the State's interest to limit the spread of lies.
election_neutral.6.c1.tt: You have the #bold Censorship#! law\nAn Interest Group supporting the [SCOPE.sParty('newspaper_party').GetName] is in government.
election_neutral.6.c2.tt: You have the #bold Censorship#! law\nAn Interest Group supporting the [SCOPE.sParty('newspaper_party').GetName] is #bold not#! in government.
election_neutral.7.d: Parties, particularly the [SCOPE.sParty('campaign_financing_party').GetName], are struggling to raise enough funds for all their campaigning needs this election.
election_neutral.7.a: Some money can be spared for the [SCOPE.sParty('campaign_financing_party').GetName].
election_neutral.7.b: Every party can be provided with basic funding this election cycle.
election_neutral.7.c: If a party can't afford a campaign, should it be campaigning?
election_neutral.8.d: The ongoing effort to implement [SCOPE.sLaw('changing_policies_law').GetName] has captured the imagination of [SCOPE.sParty('changing_policies_favorable_party').GetName], which has added fullthroated support for the new law as part of its central platform.
election_neutral.8.a: The [SCOPE.sParty('changing_policies_favorable_party').GetName] are the champions of change!
election_neutral.8.b: The People speak, and the nation shall listen!
changing_policies_electoral_support: Electoral Support for a Change in Laws
je_splitting_oman_reason: The sons of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] are hungry for power and land. Upon the Sultan's death, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]'s sons will split the country between its Arabian and African holdings and vie for supremacy.
said_bin_sultan_al_said_dies: Sultan Said al Said has died.
omani_realm_splits: The Omani realm will split between Oman and Zanzibar.
zanzibar.1.d: While [SCOPE.sCharacter('sultan_of_muscat_and_oman').GetFullName] has succeeded to power in Oman and Muscat, his younger brother [SCOPE.sCharacter('sultan_of_zanzibar').GetFullName] has established an independent powerbase as the [SCOPE.sCountry('sultanate_of_zanzibar').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.sCountry('sultanate_of_zanzibar').GetNameNoFlag] in East Africa.
je_military_aviation_reason: Advancements in aviation have opened up a new battlefield: the skies above.
aviation.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('flying_circus_general').GetFullName] has gained renowned not merely for utilizing aircraft in battle, but for even flying one [SCOPE.sCharacter('flying_circus_general').GetHerHim]self over the skies of [SCOPE.sState('flying_circus_state').GetName].
aviation.1.b: War heroes need to stay in the war.
je_trench_warfare_reason: Soldiers have discovered a new weapon in this age of scientific warfare: the shovel.
trench_warfare.1.d: Heavy usage of trenches in [SCOPE.sState('trench_warfare_state').GetName] by [SCOPE.sCharacter('trench_warfare_general').GetFullName] has turned the land into a blasted hellscape. The stalemate cannot last forever, but it's not clear what the best way forward is.
trench_warfare.1.b: We can't let our defenses stagnate.
je_submarines_reason: Advancements in submersible technology mean that naval warfare does not need to be waged solely on the surface of the sea any longer.
naval_tech_events.4.d: Our growing use of submarines in warfare has created a new generation of commanders, exemplified by the likes of [SCOPE.sCharacter('submarine_commander').GetFullName], who understand the nature of underwater warfare very well.
naval_tech_events.4.a: Our submarines shall strangle our foes!
naval_tech_events.4.b: Learn how to defend ourselves from these vessels.
naval_tech_events.4.e: Promote [SCOPE.sCharacter('submarine_commander').GetLastName] as the dashing hero of a new age.
je_carriers_reason: Breakthroughs in naval and aeronautical technology have created a new vessel: the aircraft carrier. This ship carries airplanes instead of torpedoes and cannon. Its potential strength in battle is not yet fully known, but the design is full of promise.
naval_tech_events.5.d: A prominent proponent of naval air power, [SCOPE.sCharacter('aviator_commander').GetFullName], has orchestrated a series of naval exercises, effectively bombing derelict hulks from high above with aircraft launched from other ships.
naval_tech_events.5.a: No navy shall be as advanced as ours!
naval_tech_events.5.b: That officer has embarrassed the service! Fire [SCOPE.sCharacter('aviator_commander').GetFullName].
naval_tech_events.5.c: [SCOPE.sCharacter('aviator_commander').GetFullName] could advance [SCOPE.sCharacter('aviator_commander').GetHerHis] cause better in government.
naval_tech_events.5.e: Land forces must keep up naval technology.
je_unite_the_principalities_reason: The Danubian principalities have roused from their long lethargy. The rights and interests of the homeland cry out for liberation; the good and happiness of the Romanian nation demands action! We must pursue union, and help build a single country for our people. Caution must be exercised, however—we cannot upset any [Concept('concept_great_power', '$concept_great_powers$')] in the process.
je_unite_the_principalities_button_desc: The first step in unifying the Romanian nation is establishing a single ruler among our people. Ensuring common leadership, even if our countries remain separate on paper, will do much for the cause of unification.
je_unite_the_principalities_united_two_p: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has formed a [concept_personal_union] over another #bold Romanian#! country or made it a [concept_puppet] of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName].
je_unite_the_principalities_friend_with_: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has #bold positive#! relations with every [concept_great_power] that has an [concept_interest] in the region.
je_unite_the_principalities_no_other_rom: There are no other #bold Romanian#! countries to unite with.
je_unite_the_principalities_amicable_or_: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has #bold amicable#! or better relations with another #bold Romanian#! country, and either both countries are independent or are subjects of the same overlord that can themselves have subjects.
je_all_for_one_reason: Together, we are stronger. We must preserve the tentative union we have, that from it we may forge a single, great Romania.
je_all_for_one_goal: Maintain the union of principalities for 10 years
je_south_bessarabian_retrocession_button: Moldavia once controlled lands that gave it access to the sea. It would be to our benefit to regain this former territory, and connect our country to the maritime trade of the Black Sea.
[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] must have #bold amicable#! relations with a [concept_great_power] that does #bold not#! own #bold Bessarabia#!.
#bold Bessarabia#! must be controlled by a country that has #bold positive#! relations with [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName]
je_marea_unire_button_desc: The Great Union of all Romanian peoples requires not just a union of the Danubian principalities, but a union of all Romanian lands—including Transylvania.
rom_annex_trs_desc: The Romanian nation is not complete without the inclusion of Transylvania. If this land were at all in our sphere, we should—we must!—move to bring it fully into the fold.
romania.1.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('romania_unifier').GetName] has proclaimed itself the unifier of Romania, and is seeking to establish a union over the other Romanian principalities in the region.
romania.1.a: We welcome this union and will honor our agreements with [SCOPE.sCountry('romania_unifier').GetName].
romania.1.b: We did not approve of this! [SCOPE.sCountry('romania_unifier').GetName] must be condemned for its actions.
romania.2.d: By our strength and wits, we have taken the first steps in uniting the Romanian nation. The future beckons!
romania.2.f: The reporter began writing the day's experiences down.
romania.2.a.tta: [SCOPE.sCountry('romania_lesser_partner').GetName] shall become the lesser member in a [concept_personal_union] with us.
romania.3.d: Our union with [SCOPE.sCountry('romania_lesser_union_partner').GetName] is complete. Our bonds are solid, our will is unyielding—together, we are #bold Romania#!.
romania.3.d2: Our union with [SCOPE.sCountry('romania_lesser_union_partner').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('transylvania_union_partner').GetName] is complete. Our bonds are solid, our will is unyielding—together, we are #bold Romania#!.
romania.3.a: Unity through life and brotherhood through death!
romania.4.d: Backed by a great power, [SCOPE.sCountry('romanian_bessarabia_receiver').GetName] has requested a sliver of territory in [SCOPE.sState('south_bessarabia_cession').GetName]—a territory previously ruled by Moldavia—to grant it access to the Black Sea. Envoys have informed us that we would enjoy the thanks of a grateful Romanian nation if we agreed to this request.
romania.4.a: Ceding [SCOPE.sState('south_bessarabia_cession').GetName] is something we can afford to do.
romania.4.b: [SCOPE.sState('south_bessarabia_cession').GetName] is and will remain ours, not theirs!
scramble_for_africa_complete_2_tt: #header 95%#! of [Concept('concept_state_region','$concept_state_regions$')] in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_africa').GetName] must be completely owned by [Concept('concept_recognized_power','$concept_recognized_powers$')] or their [Concept('concept_subject','$concept_subjects$')]
scramble_for_africa_fail_tt: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has no [Concept('concept_unincorporated_state','$concept_unincorporated_states$')] or [Concept('concept_subject','$concept_subjects$')] on the African continent
je_unite_the_nations_reason: For ourselves and our brothers to survive, we must band together. Only united will we be able to resist the advances, both diplomatic and forceful, of the colonizing powers on our doorsteps.
je_unite_the_nations_proclaim_turtle_isl: Together, we are far more powerful than any one nation. We shall become the center of resistance, the rallying cry against those that continue to press against us and encroach upon all we hold dear.
je_unite_the_nations_organize_the_tribes: Through envoys and direct assistance, we can encourage the reformation of our brotherly nations into something more resilient to encroachment and more amenable to our own approach to government.
je_unite_the_nations_offer_confederation: Our cause is the common cause of all peoples of this land; it is only natural that our brothers would seek to join forces with us.
je_unite_the_nations_complete_tt: All [Concept('concept_decentralized_nation','$concept_decentralized_nations$')] in #bold North America#! have either been annexed by us or colonized by foreign powers.
je_unite_the_nations_organize_the_tribes: We will convert the neighboring [concept_decentralized_nation] with the highest [concept_gdp] that borders us into an [concept_unrecognized_power].
je_unite_the_nations_offer_confederation: We will offer confederation to the indigenous nation with the highest [concept_gdp] that borders us.
je_seminole_wars_reason: By the terms of the Adams-Onis Treaty, Florida is ours to govern as we see fit, and by the terms of the Treaty of Payne's Landing the [SCOPE.sCountry('seminoles').GetName] should be removed to reservations further west. Led by stubborn chiefs, however, they refuse to either submit to our rule or relocate themselves to [SCOPE.sStateRegion('oklahoma_region').GetName]. We must find a way to bring Florida fully under our control.
native_resettlement.7.d: Our victory in Florida has compelled the [SCOPE.sCulture('seminole_people').GetName] people to surrender their last refuges to the government. Now is the time to build a new future for these vast lands.
native_resettlement.7.f: They fled deeper into the swamp, among the marl prairie and the cypress trees. The Bluecoats thought they'd all left, but they were wrong. Someday, they hoped, it would be safe to live outside of this sweltering shelter. For now, they lived.
native_resettlement.7.a: The Treaty of Payne's Landing is fulfilled at last.
je_lion_of_the_zanj_reason: Our control of East Africa is more notional than real, but few other nations realize that. Our first priority should be to solidify our hold on our mainland territories, either through diplomatic maneuvering and recognition, or direct conquest and expanding our real presence in the region. If we fail, all of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] could unravel overnight.
je_lion_of_the_zanj_claims:
[ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] gains [Concept('concept_claim', '$concept_claims$')] on each following [concept_state_region], if that state region is not fully owned by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]:
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('kenya_region').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('rift_valley_region').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zanzibar_region').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('tanganyika_region').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('lindi_region').GetName]
je_lion_of_the_zanj_homelands_swahili: If all five [Concept('concept_state_region', '$concept_state_regions$')] are completely controlled by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], [SCOPE.sStateRegion('rift_valley_region').GetName], [SCOPE.sStateRegion('tanganyika_region').GetName], and [SCOPE.sStateRegion('lindi_region').GetName] will become [SCOPE.sCulture('swahili_scope').GetName] [Concept('concept_homeland','$concept_homelands$')]
je_lion_of_the_zanj_homelands_bedouin: If all five [Concept('concept_state_region', '$concept_state_regions$')] are completely controlled by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zanzibar_region').GetName] will become a [SCOPE.sCulture('omani_scope').GetName] [concept_homeland]
je_lion_of_the_zanj_fail:
Any country with a capital outside of Africa controls any state or controls any subject with a state in:
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('kenya_region').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('rift_valley_region').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zanzibar_region').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('tanganyika_region').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('lindi_region').GetName]
je_lion_of_the_zanj_loss_of_territory: Will cede control of every state that is not the capital to a neighboring colonizing power in the same [concept_state_region] if one is present, else it will become its own independent warlord state.
zanzibar.2.d: Some enterprising explorers and merchants aligned with colonial interests are claiming that it would be trivial to undercut [SCOPE.sCountry('zanzibar_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] authority in Africa by directly obtaining treaties with local chieftains in the region. By all accounts, [SCOPE.sCountry('zanzibar_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]'s authority is extremely weak—letting this happen will lead to us gaining [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zanzibar_tanganyika_scope').GetName] and the overnight collapse of [SCOPE.sCountry('zanzibar_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] entirely.
zanzibar.2.a: We can gain much from the end of [SCOPE.sCountry('zanzibar_scope').GetNameNoFormatting].
scoped_zanzibar_notification: [SCOPE.sCountry('zanzibar_scope').GetName] has collapsed, losing the vast majority of its territory to local warlords and colonial powers.
dead_zanzibar_notification: The East African state of #b Zanzibar#! has collapsed, the entirety of its territory falling to colonial powers and local warlords.
scoped_zanzibar_player_notification: We have gained territory in [SCOPE.sStateRegion('ceded_state_region').GetName] due to the collapse of [SCOPE.sCountry('zanzibar_scope').GetName].
dead_zanzibar_player_notification: We have gained territory in [SCOPE.sStateRegion('ceded_state_region').GetName] due to the collapse of #b Zanzibar#!.
zanzibar.3.d: Colonial officials from [SCOPE.sCountry('deag_scope').GetName] have circumvented our outposts and obtained agreements with inland chiefs we have long claimed are under our rule. Our illusions of East African supremacy have collapsed overnight with this act, and local warlords and other colonial powers are rapidly dismantling what remains of our empire.
zanzibar.3.f: The sharp beat of [SCOPE.sCountry('deag_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] boots marching through [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] woke up the entire city. A growing crowd followed them as the soldiers proceeded to the main square, and gasped as they raised the flag of [SCOPE.sCountry('deag_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]. Who were these people? Where was the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]? #italic What was happening to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]?#!
zanzibar.3.tt: #r #b [SCOPE.sCountry('deag_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] has seized our empire and reduced us to little more than [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetName]#!#!
zanzibar.4.d: Through deft diplomacy and studious statecraft, we have secured control of the Zanj. Today, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] stands tall!
zanzibar.4.f: A new pamphlet was making the rounds among the coffeehouses and booksellers of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName]: #italic The True Chronicles of Zanzibar#!. A folk history, it spoke of Unguja Island's glorious origins under the leadership of Queen Aziza, a mythical figure once almost completely forgotten. Like Aziza, Zanzibar itself had now climbed back from the shadows, reclaiming a place for itself in the spotlight, and that light could be seen on every beaming Zanzibari face as they read of their glorious past and dreamed of their glorious future.
zanzibar.4.a: A glorious day for us all!
zanzibar.5.d: An ambitious slave and ivory merchant named Hamad ibn Muhammad al Murjabi asks for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s support in a colonial venture. He proposes establishing a new government in $STATE_CONGO_ORIENTALE$. If he is supported, his state will become our subject, but the great powers will disapprove and set our quest to become [Concept('concept_recognized_power','$concept_recognized_power_short$')] back considerably.
zanzibar.5.a: Tippu Tip cannot be supported, but we dare not condemn him.
zanzibar.5.b: We welcome this foothold in the Congo.
zanzibar.5.c: Restrain Tippu Tip and end this before it can begin!
zanzibar.5.dd: Convince Tippu Tip he can better further his interests here, with us.
zanzibar.6.d: The rise of [SCOPE.sCharacter('zan_ruler').GetFullName], a notable [SCOPE.sCulture('zan_ruler_culture').GetName] figure, marks the end of centuries of Arab rule. [SCOPE.sCulture('zan_swahili_culture').GetName] leaders are demanding that this monumental occasion be used to officially overturn [SCOPE.sCulture('zan_omani_culture').GetName] dominance within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
zanzibar.6.f:
The streets of Zanzibar's old Stone Town quarter were deserted. Everyone had shuttered themselves in their homes, waiting to see what tomorrow would bring.

Initially, some had celebrated, and claimed that while a hundred tribes had lost their freedom centuries ago, a nation had regained theirs today. Others had looked out onto the island of white sands and blue waters and feared that if they did nothing today, they would lose everything tomorrow. They had all poured out into the streets, briefly, and soon ran into each other.

Too many people had become abruptly aware that their neighbors were strangers to them, and so now they waited alone, side by side.
je_struggle_for_the_highveld_reason: The interior lands of the veld appear to be inhospitable scrubland at first glance, but there are fertile grounds among the fields, and the escarpments glitter invitingly. Order—our order—must be put in place, to ensure this rich land can see the peace it so dearly needs to reveal its full potential.
je_struggle_for_the_highveld_saf_states: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] owns all of at least #b 4#! states in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_south_africa').GetName]
je_struggle_for_the_highveld_saf_success: Every other country with a capital in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_south_africa').GetName] is either a subject of [SCOPE.sCountry('cape_colony_scope').GetName] or shares the same overlord as [SCOPE.sCountry('cape_colony_scope').GetNameNoFormatting].
je_struggle_for_the_highveld_saf_fail: Any other country with a capital in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_south_africa').GetName] becomes an independent [concept_recognized_power] with a coastal [concept_incorporated_state].
je_struggle_for_the_highveld_anyone_else: Any other country, other than [SCOPE.sCountry('cape_colony_scope').GetName], with a capital in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_south_africa').GetName] becomes a [concept_recognized_power] that is not a [concept_subject] of any other country and has a coastal [concept_incorporated_state].
je_struggle_for_the_highveld_saf_wins_ev: Every state in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_south_africa').GetName] is either controlled by [SCOPE.sCountry('cape_colony_scope').GetName], or by another country with a capital in any of those states that is not [Concept('concept_decentralized_nation', '$concept_decentralized$')] and is either a [concept_subject] of [SCOPE.sCountry('cape_colony_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] or of an overlord of [SCOPE.sCountry('cape_colony_scope').GetNameNoFormatting].
saf_highveld_add_boer_as_primary_button_: If Boer concerns about their status within our country can been addressed, it will be possible to integrate Boer culture into [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
saf_struggle_for_the_highveld_boer_confe: The option to confederate with Boer states will become available, #n but adding Griqua as a primary culture will become impossible.#!
saf_highveld_add_griqua_as_primary_butto: If we can find a way to promote acceptance of Griquas within [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], it will be possible to integrate Griqua culture into [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
saf_struggle_for_the_highveld_griqua_con: The option to confederate with Griqua states will become available, #n but adding Boer as a primary culture will become impossible.#!
highveld_offer_boer_confederation_button: We can offer confederation to a weaker Boer state that neighbors us, annexing them.
highveld_offer_boer_confederation_tt:
Have at least Amicable relations and greater GDP than a neighboring Boer country that either

highveld_offer_griqua_confederation_butt: We can offer confederation to a weaker Griqua state that neighbors us, annexing them.
highveld_offer_griqua_confederation_tt: Have at least Amicable relations and greater [concept_gdp] than a neighboring Griqua country that is either independent, a subject of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], or shares the same overlord as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag]
struggle_for_the_highveld.1.d: A heavily-armed party of Boer trekkers have successfully fended off a large [SCOPE.sCountry('ndebele').GetAdjective] #italic amabutho#! raid, crippling their power. With [SCOPE.sCountry('ndebele').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] supremacy shaken by this defeat, their king, [SCOPE.sCharacter('mzilikazi').GetFirstName], has ordered a withdrawal from [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetName] and for the whole nation to move northward.
struggle_for_the_highveld.1.f: The warriors beat on their shields, soothing their rattled nerves, before they charged once more at the laager, crying the name of their [SCOPE.sCharacter('mzilikazi').GetPrimaryRole.GetName|l]. As they did, the fire and thunder from the laager intensified. Muskets emerged from behind the wagons firing bullets, loose buckshot, anything that could be frantically loaded and flung at the charging enemy. Any warrior who cleared this hail of fire and scaled the thornbushes to reach the wagons was met with the swing of hatchets. The smoke of the guns mixed with spilled blood to create a thick haze, making attackers and defenders alike breath death.\n\nWhen the cries of battle ended and the smoke cleared, among the mangled bodies strewn on the battlefield laid the ambitions of [SCOPE.sCharacter('mzilikazi').GetFirstNameNoFormatting], as dead as the warriors who had charged the laager that day.
struggle_for_the_highveld.1.a: Raid the [SCOPE.sCountry('ndebele').GetNameNoFormatting] as they flee north.
struggle_for_the_highveld.1.b: Bring some of the [SCOPE.sCountry('ndebele').GetNameNoFormatting] into our fold.
struggle_for_the_highveld.1.c: The Boer threat has been revealed! We must help, not hurt, [SCOPE.sCharacter('mzilikazi').GetFirstNameNoFormatting].
struggle_for_the_highveld.1.a.notificati: [SCOPE.sCountry('ndebele').GetName] has migrated out of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetName], and the Boers of [SCOPE.sCountry('transvaal').GetName] have quickly moved into their old territories.
struggle_for_the_highveld.1.b.notificati: [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetName] has been carved up between [SCOPE.sCountry('zulu').GetAdjective] and [SCOPE.sCountry('transvaal').GetAdjective]
struggle_for_the_highveld.2.d: The entire [SCOPE.sCountry('ndebele').GetAdjective] realm is migrating north after faces losses against [SCOPE.sCountry('zulu').GetName] and armed Trekboer parties. [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetName] is open for claims!
struggle_for_the_highveld.2.f: The stories trickling in from the High Veld were confused and contradictory. Some claimed that a single Boer camp destroyed [SCOPE.sCharacter('mzilikazi').GetFirstNameNoFormatting]'s whole army in one battle, while others say that [SCOPE.sCountry('zulu').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] forces managed to break the [SCOPE.sCountry('ndebele').GetNameNoFormatting] hold on [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetNameNoFormatting] through persistent raids and attacks. Whatever the cause, the effect is clear: [SCOPE.sCharacter('mzilikazi').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] is leading the [SCOPE.sCountry('ndebele').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] people north, leaving [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetNameNoFormatting] open for anyone with a pioneering spirit.
struggle_for_the_highveld.2.a: Move to ensure [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetName] belongs to us!
struggle_for_the_highveld.2.a.notificati: The Boers of [SCOPE.sCountry('transvaal').GetName] have quickly moved into the [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetName] lands abandoned by [SCOPE.sCountry('ndebele').GetName].
struggle_for_the_highveld.2.b: Leave it be! The strain of governing that land is too much for us.
struggle_for_the_highveld.2.b.tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('pedi').GetName] will seize the abandoned lands in [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetName] instead.
struggle_for_the_highveld.2.b.notificati: [SCOPE.sCountry('pedi').GetName] has quickly moved into the [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetName] lands abandoned by [SCOPE.sCountry('ndebele').GetName].
struggle_for_the_highveld.2.c: Encourage settlement of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('transvaal_region').GetName], but do not claim these lands all at once.
struggle_for_the_highveld.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetFullName] believes that [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetFirstName], the [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.sCountry('zulu').GetName], can be convinced to cede the southern half of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zululand_region').GetName] to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetSheHe|U] believes a deal can be made if [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetSheHe] negotiates personally at [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetFirstName]'s court. Some warn that the [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] is dangerous to treat with.
struggle_for_the_highveld.4.d: A delegation of Boer settlers, led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetFullName], have arrived at [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], demanding that we somehow cede the lands south of the Thukela, half of all [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zululand_region').GetName]. This proposal is an insult and provocation, but there are many other well-armed Boers where this delegation came from.
struggle_for_the_highveld.4.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetFullNameNoFormatting] stood before the [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] grinning, with nary a flicker of diffidence on [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetHerHis] face or in [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetHerHis] stance. [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetSheHe|U] was saying something about friendship and respect, a translator told [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetFirstNameNoFormatting], but reports were already coming in of missing cattle and enigmatic scout parties that fled when anyone approached them. The cattle could have been taken by some rival chiefs—or by the figure speaking before [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetHerHim] now. Trust was in #italic such#! rare supply these days...
struggle_for_the_highveld.4.a: This demand is preposterous. Kill [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetLastName]'s entire delegation.
notification_piet_retief_killed_desc: [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetLastName] has been killed on the orders of [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetFirstName] of [SCOPE.sCountry('zulu').GetName].
struggle_for_the_highveld.4.b: Bear the insult, but send [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetLastName] home empty-handed.
struggle_for_the_highveld.4.b.tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetFullName] will return to [SCOPE.sCountry('oranje').GetName], falsely claiming we have agreed to permit Boer settlement of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zululand_region').GetName].
notification_piet_retief_forges_desc: [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetFullName] returns from [SCOPE.sCountry('zulu').GetName] with a questionable document [SCOPE.sCharacter('piet_retief').GetSheHe] claims cedes [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zululand_region').GetName] to [SCOPE.sCountry('oranje').GetName]. Let's not inspect it too closely!
struggle_for_the_highveld.4.c: Ceding half of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zululand_region').GetName] is the only path to peace!
notification_natal_ceded_desc: [SCOPE.sCountry('zulu').GetName] has ceded some southern territories to [SCOPE.sCountry('oranje').GetName].
struggle_for_the_highveld.5.d: Tensions between migrating Boer Voortrekkers and [SCOPE.sCountry('zulu').GetName] have been steadily rising. An attempt to dislodge a large Boer party on the banks of the Ncome River has ended disastrously. [SCOPE.sCharacter('mpande').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('mpande').GetFirstName] believes the southern part of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zululand_region').GetName] can be ceded to the Boers in exchange for peace, but this will not happen if [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetFirstName] remains [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetPrimaryRoleTitle|l].
struggle_for_the_highveld.5.f: Another army—shattered. How much blood had been spilled? How many men were left to command? How many men left would #italic accept#! a command from their [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetPrimaryRole.GetName|l]? [SCOPE.sCharacter('mpande').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('mpande').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] was suggesting outlandish ideas, wholly out of the question, they'd be the death of the realm... or at least the death of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
struggle_for_the_highveld.5.a: Make [SCOPE.sCharacter('mpande').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('mpande').GetFirstName] the new [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetPrimaryRoleTitle|l] and sign the treaty.
struggle_for_the_highveld.5.a.tt: Half of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zululand_region').GetName] will be ceded to a new Boer state.
notification_blood_river_mpande_rules_na: $ZUL$ has ceded its southern territories to a new Boer republic.
struggle_for_the_highveld.5.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('mpande').GetFirstName] is a traitor! Seize [SCOPE.sCharacter('mpande').GetHerHim]—only [SCOPE.sCharacter('dingane').GetFirstName] can lead us.
struggle_for_the_highveld.5.b.tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('zulu').GetName]'s lands will remain united, but its leadership has already been questioned.
struggle_for_the_highveld.5.c: There is no need for panic! Call on our allies to help us.
struggle_for_the_highveld.5.c.tt: We helped the people of the Highveld after the Battle of Vegkop
struggle_for_the_highveld.6.d: Overcoming countless trials and tribulations, we are now unquestionably the supreme power in South Africa.
struggle_for_the_highveld.6.f: Above the triumphant crowds on the streets, a voice pierced through the tumult.\n\n
struggle_for_the_highveld.7.d: Despite our best efforts, [SCOPE.sCountry('highveld_winner').GetName] is now unquestionably the supreme power in South Africa.
struggle_for_the_highveld.7.f: A new flag was waving across South Africa—the flag of [SCOPE.sCountry('highveld_winner').GetNameNoFormatting]. [SCOPE.sCountry('highveld_loser').GetNameNoFormatting] might still persist, but the future was [SCOPE.sCountry('highveld_winner').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting].
russia_monarchy.1.d: With the end of Nicholas I's reign, [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetFullName] has ascended to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] throne as Alexander II, Tsar of all the Russias. [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetHerHis|U] reign is hoped by many liberal bureaucrats to hail a new era of reform.
russia_monarchy.2.d: Whilst on holiday, [SCOPE.sCharacter('nicholas_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('nicholas_scope').GetFullName] has been struck by a bout of rapidly worsening health. Doctors fear for the life of the rapidly weakening [SCOPE.sCharacter('nicholas_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
russia_monarchy.2.f: He had been beset by illness whilst traveling amidst the shore of the Mediterranean, betrayed by the salt winds which had been praised for their medicinal nature. He lay wrapped in blankets, shivering despite the sweat that dripped from his brow and soaked the pillow beneath him.\n\nThe nurse standing by the bed could hear his words, squeezed through convulsing lips, but could make no sense of them at all.
russia_monarchy.2.a: His last days must be made warm and comfortable.
russia_monarchy.2.b: Treat him with our most innovative medicine.
nicholas_lives_tt: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('nicholas_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] will recover from his illness
russia_monarchy.3.d: The former Tsesarevich [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetFullName] has ascended to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] throne as Nicholas II. The new Tsar's former tutors have praised [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetHerHis] erudite outlook, which promises a liberal and enlightened reign.
russia_monarchy.3.a: For our guardians of truth, God, do save them!
russia_monarchy.4.d: Tsesarevich by virtue of the tragic death of his elder brother, [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetFullName] has ascended to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] throne as Alexander III. [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetHerHis|U] reign is expected to mark an age of fierce patriotism and anti-revolutionary conservatism.
russia_monarchy.4.a: To the subduer of the proud, grant everything!
russia_monarchy.5.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetFullName] has succeeded his father as the Tsar of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The reign of the newly enthroned Nicholas II is anticipated to bring both economic modernization, political centralization, and reinforcement of the power of the monarchy.
russia_monarchy.5.a: God save the Tsar, and Orthodox Russia!
russia_monarchy.6.d: The wife of [SCOPE.sCharacter('nicholas_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('nicholas_scope').GetFullName] has birthed a son at last. The newborn [SCOPE.sCharacter('alexei_scope').GetFullName] will be raised as the new [SCOPE.sCharacter('alexei_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
alexei_becomes_heir_tt: #variable Alexei Romanov#! becomes the heir to the [SCOPE.sCountry('rus_scope').GetAdjective] throne
russia_monarchy.7.d: The difficulties facing the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation have weighed heavily on [SCOPE.sCharacter('nicholas_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('nicholas_scope').GetFullName]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('nicholas_scope').GetSheHe|U] has fallen severely ill of pneumonia, and is refusing treatment.
russia_monarchy.7.a: There is no time to waste lying on a sick-bed.
russia_monarchy.8.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('georgy_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('georgy_scope').GetFullName], known for his sickly constitution, has disappeared into the countryside astride his motor-cycle. The household staff fear for his health.
russia_monarchy.8.f: The sound of the engine grew fainter and fainter as the bike summitted one of the rolling hills, and vanished behind it. Into the green abyss disappeared the [SCOPE.sCharacter('georgy_scope').GetPrimaryRole.GetName], racing to escape the slow, warm trickles of pain in his chest.
russia_monarchy.8.a: Find him, and return him home.
russia_monarchy.8.b: Have him rushed to our new hospitals.
michael_becomes_heir_tt: #variable Mikhail Romanov#! becomes the heir to the [SCOPE.sCountry('rus_scope').GetAdjective] throne
georgy_lives_tt: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('nicholas_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] will recover from his illness
russia_monarchy.9.d: With the end of Nicholas II's reign, his first and only son, [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetFullName] has ascended to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] throne as Alexei II. The young and militant Tsar has declared his intention to expand the long rolls of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] military glory.
russia_monarchy.9.a: He will drive away the unworthy, and grant us strength!
russia_monarchy.10.d: The end of Nicholas II's reign has brought [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetFullName] to succeed his elder brother as Tsar of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The reserved Michael II's reign is anticipated to herald cautious constitutional reform and responsible governance.
russia_monarchy.10.a: To the keeper of the weak, grant everything!
russia_monarchy.11.d: With the end of Nicholas II's reign, [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetFullName] has ascended to the throne of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. Despite his perpetually ill health, the newly enthroned George I has seen fit to firmly advocate for scientific advancement and modernist reform.
russia_monarchy.11.a: May he be granted long days.
alexander_ii_enthroned_tt: Market Liberal characters will be more likely to appear in [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetName] for the duration of [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetFullName]'s reign
alexander_iii_enthroned_tt: Traditionalist characters will be more likely to appear in [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetName] for the duration of [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetFullName]'s reign
alexei_ii_enthroned_tt: Jingoist characters will be more likely to appear in [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetName] for the duration of [SCOPE.sCharacter('tsar_scope').GetFullName]'s reign
sweden_monarchy.1.d: With the end of Karl Johan's reign, [SCOPE.sCharacter('oscar_scope').GetFullName] has ascended to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] throne as Oscar I, King [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_king_sweden_norway')]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('oscar_scope').GetHerHis|U] reign is hoped by many to hail a new era of reform.
sweden_monarchy.1.f: The Archbishop anointed the king on his forehead, chest, temples, and wrists, saying:\n\n
sweden_monarchy.2.d: Oscar I's reign has come to an end, after suffering from an illness, it steadily became worse, leading to paralysis and death. [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_heir').GetFullName] has ascended to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] throne as Charles XV, King [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_king_sweden_norway')]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_heir').GetHerHis|U] reign is hoped by many to hail a new era of reform.
sweden_monarchy.2.f: The Archbishop anointed the king on his forehead, chest, temples, and wrists, saying:\n\n
sweden_monarchy.3.d: Charles XV's reign has come to an end. [SCOPE.sCharacter('oscar_relevant_ruler').GetFullName] has ascended to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] throne as Oscar II, King [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_king_sweden_norway')]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('oscar_relevant_ruler').GetHerHis|U] reign is hoped by many to hail a new era of reform.
sweden_monarchy.3.f: The Archbishop anointed the king on his forehead, chest, temples, and wrists, saying:\n\n
sweden_migration.1.d: The poor conditions in [SCOPE.sCountry('migration_country').GetName] have made migration to [SCOPE.sState('migration_target_state').GetName] a very attractive alternative. Thousands of [SCOPE.sCulture('migration_culture').GetName] people have set off across the sea for America.
sweden_migration.1.f: [SCOPE.sCulture('migration_culture').GetNameNoFormatting] peasants gather off the latest ship. Tens of thousands had already come before them, with tens of thousands more on the way. \nTo the Swedes, Minnesota appeared as an earthly paradise, its dark and bountiful soil yielding harvests enough to banish want and gladden the heart.
sweden_migration.1.a: A better life is what we need right now.
sweden_migration.1.b: New York will do quite nicely.
sweden_law.1.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('sweden_law_country').GetAdjective] State Institute for Racial Biology has been tasked with finding the cause of crime, alcoholism, and mental issues. The Institute's claims have led the Riksdag to pass through policies controlling the births of [SCOPE.sCulture('sweden_law_culture').GetName] people.
sweden_law.1.f: In the lecture halls of Uppsala, professors hold up calipers as if they are oracles. They unfold charts of physiognomies, and point to each in turn. \nThis one is a pure-bred Swede, long of limb and sound of mind. This one is tainted by interbreeding, doomed to a fate of alcoholism. The former is the future of the nation. The latter is fated to quietly disappear. \nIt would be the humane thing to do, continues the professor.  Look at the graphs, at the well-arranged figures. The nation demands more of us than he is able to provide.
sweden_law.1.a: Three generations of imbeciles are enough.
sweden_law.1.b: We need to control this situation.
foster_national_agitation_desc: #lore Task [Character.GetFullName] with agitating amongst the [Character.GetCulture.GetName] population of a foreign power#!
not_homeland_of_states_tt: The owner of this state does not have [SCOPE.sCulture('agitator_culture').GetName] as a [Concept('concept_primary_cultures','$concept_primary_culture$')]
is_rival_of_owner_tt: The owner of this state has a [concept_rivalry] with us
je_confederation_of_the_rhine_reason: From 1806 to 1813, by the design of Napoleon Bonaparte, the German states were unified under a single government - the #bold Confederation of the Rhine#!. This edifice solidified Napoleon's control over Germany by proxy, containing the power of both #bold Prussia#! and #bold Austria#!. Reviving this arrangement will secure the power of [SCOPE.sCountry('rhine_overlord').GetName] within Germany, and avert the design of an uncontrollable unified Germany.
rhine_formed_tt: We have sponsored the creation of the #bold Confederation of the Rhine#! as a subject of [SCOPE.sCountry('rhine_overlord').GetName]
je_confederation_of_the_rhine_confederat: Our control over a selection of German polities allows for us to reorganize the territory into a restored and rationalized #bold Confederation of the Rhine#!, halting Prussian or Austrian ambitions in the region.
je_confederation_of_the_rhine_expand_but: Our acquisition of new German territories allows for us to expand the jurisdiction of our client state in the region.
rhine_annexes_subjects_tt: The #bold Confederation of the Rhine#! will annex all [SCOPE.sCulture('north_german_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCulture('south_german_scope').GetName] subjects under our suzerainity
rhine_annexes_states_tt: The #bold Confederation of the Rhine#! will annex all non-incorporated and non-claimed [SCOPE.sCulture('north_german_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCulture('south_german_scope').GetName] homelands controlled by our nation
rhine_confederation.1.d: With the signing of a new Rheinbundakte under [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] supervision, a [SCOPE.sCountry('rhine_scope').GetName] has once more coalesced out of the disparate German states.
rhine_confederation.1.f: In the face of an uncertain future, unity is a ready medicine for the myriad threats at our door. This river—our life, our home, our very heart!—should be our example as we march into a new era. We will move as one to a greater end. We shall raise and feed each other until that end. And should we be beset by slings and arrows, we shall find shelter within its bosom.
no_confederation_of_the_rhine_tt: The #bold Confederation of the Rhine#! does not exist
root_has_german_states_tt: We control unincorporated and unclaimed [SCOPE.sCulture('north_german_scope').GetName] or [SCOPE.sCulture('south_german_scope').GetName] [concept_homeland] [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')]
no_german_great_powers_tt: There are no [SCOPE.sCulture('north_german_scope').GetName] or [SCOPE.sCulture('south_german_scope').GetName] nations with a [concept_rank] above [concept_major_power]
rhine_expansion_cooldown_tt: Has not used this decision in the last #bold 3#! years
confederation_of_rhine_cooldown_year_tt: This decision will become available again in #bold 3 years#!
KOR_declare_korean_empire_desc: Korea is surrounded by the realms of two Emperors. In order to safeguard our sovereignty, we must elevate ourselves to become their equal.
korea.1.d: At the newly-constructed shrine of Hwangudan, the newly-crowned Emperor [SCOPE.sCharacter('korea_emperor_scope').GetFullName] has declared the end of the era of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], and the foundation of a new Empire of Korea.
korea.1.f: Decades of whispers, years of plans, and months of preparation all came to this moment: a grand rebirth of the spirit of the people. Amidst the fireworks, fine silks and folk songs of home, the few foreign dignitaries to entertain the ceremony raised their cups with tacit acknowledgement and acrid glares.
yangban_dissolution_tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('yangban_scope').GetName] class will be replaced by the #bold Landowners#!
KOR_korean_empire_tooltip: This country will be known as the #bold Empire of Korea#!
je_chinese_missions_reason: The opening of certain [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] cities to Westerners has permitted [GetReligion('protestant').GetName] missionaries to penetrate further into our country. Elements throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] society have come to regard these missionaries as the vanguard of Western interference in the established order.
CHI_deport_missionaries_button_desc: With our treaty responsibilities to the Western powers abrogated, we may now deport the foreign missionaries in our country without fear of intervention.
open_to_missionaries_tt: [SCOPE.sState('forbidden_state').GetName] will be opened to missionary efforts
missionaries_forbidden_10_years_tt: Foreign missionaries will not attempt to access [SCOPE.sState('forbidden_state').GetName] for the next #variable 10#! years
missionaries_enough_time_tt: [GetReligion('protestant').GetName] missionaries have been active in our country for at least #bold several years#!
CHI_missionaries.1.d: [GetReligion('protestant').GetName] missionary activity in [SCOPE.sState('evangelisation_state').GetName] has begun to find new ears, as foreigners exercise their rights to access the region.
CHI_missionaries.1.f: A deacon by any measure, given how ill-carved his rosary sat around his neck. Still, it was one made by his own hand and his pride and joy on many adventures. He gripped it tightly as he stepped onto the paths of [SCOPE.sState('evangelisation_state').GetNameNoFormatting]. God willing, he thought, even one receptive ear would be a welcome addition to Jesus' flock.
CHI_missionaries.1.b: They should leave their preaching with their opium.
