CHI_missionaries.2.d: A group of [GetReligion('protestant').GetName] missionaries hailing from [SCOPE.sCountry('missionary_country').GetName] have been caught several miles past the border of [SCOPE.sState('forbidden_state').GetName] province, which foreigners are forbidden to access.
CHI_missionaries.2.a: Bring them to the border, and have them executed.
CHI_missionaries.2.b: Enforce the Sixth Clause of our law against superstition.
CHI_missionaries.2.c: Open the province to limited travel.
deport_to_central_asia_tt: The missionaries will deported to [SCOPE.sState('deportation_state').GetName] to serve as slaves
CHI_missionaries.3.d: [GetReligion('protestant').GetName] missionaries have opened several charity schools in [SCOPE.sState('missionary_schools_state').GetName], offering education in Western religious and scientific practice.
CHI_missionaries.3.a: They are welcome to operate in the region.
CHI_missionaries.4.d: [GetReligion('protestant').GetName] missionaries have opened a charity hospital in [SCOPE.sState('missionary_hospitals_state').GetCityHubName], spreading their gospel whilst offering free treatment to the sick and wounded.
CHI_missionaries.4.f:
#bold God Welcomes All to His House of Healing! #!

New hospital in [SCOPE.sState('missionary_hospitals_state').GetNameNoFormatting] for those most in need. Jesus welcomes all.

#italic And he called to him his twelve disciples and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every affliction. (Matthew 10:1) #!
CHI_missionaries.4.a: They are welcome to operate in the region.
CHI_missionaries.5.d: Local authorities in [SCOPE.sState('missionary_strife_state').GetName] have arrested several [SCOPE.sCountry('missionary_country').GetAdjective] [GetReligion('protestant').GetName] missionaries for inducing conflicts with the locals. They have requested guidance on how the foreigners are to be treated.
CHI_missionaries.5.f: The green-clad constables brought forth a perfumed trunk and placed it in front of the manacled missionaries. One prised the lid open, and waved his hand around the documents inside. All except one of the missionaries furrowed their brows and shook their heads. The one in the middle winced: the neat, Latin handwriting was unmistakably his. Among the letters requesting cardinals for aid were reports detailing the habits of the local magistrate.
CHI_missionaries.5.a: Return them to the nearest concession area.
CHI_missionaries.5.b: They will be treated like any other criminals.
warlord_china_events.200.d: A period of diligent modernization and centralization efforts has finally put an end to the risk of petty warlordism shattering the state. Despite the efforts of enemies internal and external, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] stands unbowed and unified.
warlord_china_events.200.f: There at the edge of the horizon, lit by a setting sun, were the last of the foreign ships. Their colors flew at half-mast, a sure sign that they fled with their tails between their legs. Against them at sea was a Chinese flag flying high on Chinese soil. The message for the world was clear: China's mandate remains in its own hands. Its people alone will drive its future.
warlord_china_events.200.a: A state to endure until the end of time.
warlord_china_events.200.b: The ingenuity of our people will lead us ever further.
arrange_accident_desc: #lore Task our loyal [GetLawType('law_secret_police').GetName] with the assassination of [Character.GetFullName].#!\n\n@information! This interaction's likelihood of success will #b increase#! with the level of our $institution_home_affairs$ [concept_institution].
notification_arranged_accident_failed_de: Our [GetLawType('law_secret_police').GetName]'s assassination attempt on [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassinated_scope').GetFullName] has failed. The target is unaware of [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassinated_scope').GetHerHis] close brush with death.
notification_arranged_accident_failed_in: Our [GetLawType('law_secret_police').GetName]'s assassination attempt on [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassinated_scope').GetFullName] has failed. The failed attempt has been noticed and condemned by the now-enraged [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName].
assassination_attempt_failed_tt: Our #bold assassination attempt#! will fail, but remain undetected
assassination_attempt_failed_loud_tt: Our #bold assassination attempt#! will fail, and cause a major scandal
would_be_accepted_under_national_suprema: This [concept_pop]'s culture shares both a [Concept('concept_heritage_trait','$concept_heritage_trait_short$')] and [Concept('concept_language_trait','$concept_language_trait_short$')] [Concept('concept_discrimination_trait','$concept_discrimination_trait_short$')] with any of this country's [concept_primary_cultures]
resign_from_office_desc: This character will resign from [Character.GetHerHis] position as [Character.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [Character.GetCountry.GetName]
resignation.1.d1: With the total collapse of [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetHerHis] support amongst the [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetInterestGroup.GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetFullName] has announced [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetHerHis] resignation from the office of [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
resignation.1.d2: Following a series of devastating scandals and dismal public approval, [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetFullName] has announced [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetHerHis] resignation from the office of [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
resignation.1.d3: Citing ill health, [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetFullName] has announced [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetHerHis] resignation from the office of [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
resignation.1.d4: Citing a desire to spend more time with [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetHerHis] family, [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetFullName] has announced [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetHerHis] resignation from the office of [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
resignation.1.f: The reactions to the announcement were myriad. The [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetPrimaryRole.GetName]'s supporters, struggling to hold back their defeat and apprehension. The opposition, split between displays of sympathy and excitement over the prospect of claiming [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetHerHis] seat. For the house staff, however, all that it meant was another long week of dodging reporters and shuffling furniture.
resignation.1.a: Wish [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetHerHis] successor good health and good fortune.
resignation.1.b: A long series of disasters has come to an end.
resignation.1.c: Call an immediate election to assemble a new cabinet.
leader_resigns_from_office_tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetFullName] will resign from the office of [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]
caudillo.6.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_commander').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_commander').GetFullName], a prominent military commander, has begun to challenge the civilian leadership of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('leadership_challenge_ig').GetName] under [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_politician').GetFullName]. The [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_commander').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s ambitions threaten to expand caudillo rule to yet another sector of society.
caudillo.6.f: #bold New Martial Offensive: Civil Offices Under Fire! #!\n\nA peculiar clarion sounded this morning as [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_commander').GetPrimaryRole.GetName] [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_commander').GetFullNameNoFormatting] announced [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_commander').GetHerHis] intentions to introduce sweeping reforms amongst the current polity under [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_politician').GetFullNameNoFormatting]. Whispers from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName]'s streets about [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_politician').GetFullNameNoFormatting]'s leadership have become cries to step down, rising in chorus with denouncements against [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_commander').GetPrimaryRole.GetName] [SCOPE.sCharacter('leadership_challenge_commander').GetLastNameNoFormatting]. (Cont. Pg. 3)
caudillo.6.b: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('leadership_challenge_ig').GetName] must remain under civilian control.
resignation.2.d: With the collapse of civil order in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetFullName] has announced [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetHerHis] resignation from the office of [SCOPE.sCharacter('resigning_politician').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]. A power vacuum has emerged in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], and both revolutionaries and loyalists scramble to fill it.
resignation.2.b: We are helpless before the coming storm.
resignation.2.c: There is no time for half measures. Issue emergency powers.
resignation.3.d: With the collapse of civil order in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetFullName] has announced [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetHerHis] abdication from the throne of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. A power vacuum has emerged in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], and both revolutionaries and loyalists scramble to fill it.
resignation.3.f: It was plain to see from the third-storey balcony of the palace that the mandate of heaven had passed to the mob. [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetFullNameNoFormatting] was [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] no longer. Better, [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetSheHe] thought, to have stepped down now when the crowds would accept surrender than to be dragged to a noose.
resignation.3.b: Flee across the border whilst there is still time.
resignation.3.c: [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetHerHis|U] successor must reign with the strength [SCOPE.sCharacter('abdicating_monarch').GetSheHe] lacked.
ideology_not_too_close_tt: This [Concept('concept_character','$concept_character_possessive$')] [concept_ideology] is #b not#! too similar to that of our [concept_ruler]
ideology_not_too_far_tt: This [Concept('concept_character','$concept_character_possessive$')] [concept_ideology] is #b not#! too different from that of our [concept_ruler]
ruler_disapproves_of_revolutionary_law: The [concept_ruler] or their [concept_interest_group] must disapprove of the enactment of [SCOPE.sLawType('revolutionary_law').GetFullName]
ruler_disapproves_of_revolutionary_law_c: The [concept_ruler] or their [concept_interest_group] must disapprove of the [concept_law] enactment goals of this $concept_political_movement_short$
chi_add_1_fragile_unity_tt: The progress bar of the #Bold Fragile Unity#! [concept_journal_entry] is increased by #Bold 1#!
chi_remove_1_fragile_unity_tt: The progress bar of the #Bold Fragile Unity#! [concept_journal_entry] is depleted by #Bold 1#!
missionary_activities_begin_tt: [GetReligion('protestant').GetName] #bold missionary activities#! will begin in states neighbouring foreign [Concept('concept_treaty_port','$concept_treaty_ports$')] in our nation
owner_is_christian_tt: Owner has a [concept_religion] with the #variable Christian#! trait
government_collapse.1.d: Following the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] entering open insurrection, the power the [SCOPE.sParty('relevant_party').GetName] held over the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation has been utterly broken. Loyal government officials have proposed the abolition of the party to preserve the state.
government_collapse.1.a: We must install an emergency government.
government_collapse.1.b: Offer an olive branch before it is too late.
is_not_in_other_market_tt: Is not a [concept_junior_partner] in another country's [concept_customs_union]
corporate_state.1.d: Segments of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] have voiced their support for the official recognition of labor within the proposed [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. They serve as a valuable counterbalance against the communist opposition.
corporate_state.1.d1: Segments of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] have voiced their support for the official recognition of the role of labor within our state. They serve as a valuable counterbalance against the communist opposition.
corporate_state.1.b: Use them to recruit for our national labor organization.
corporate_state.1.c: An excellent opportunity to discredit our opponents.
corporate_state.2.d: Elements in our government have begun to debate the nationalization of key industries under the structure of the proposed [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. Many private entrepreneurs have argued against the proposal.
corporate_state.2.f: The owner of the factory was a small man, given inflated stature by heeled shoes, a fleshy face, and an impressive hat. A clear benefit of his fortunate position, and a fact that he was deeply conscious of.\n\n
corporate_state.2.a: Support socializing businesses with over a hundred employees.
corporate_state.2.b: Encourage forming shop councils to coordinate small businesses.
corporate_state.2.c: Endorse the nationalization of exclusively foreign-owned enterprises.
corporate_state.2.e: Private enterprise can control its own affairs.
corporate_state.3.d: News of brutal labor abuses in the [SCOPE.sBuilding('relevant_building').GetName] of [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetName] have spread across the nation. Dissidents have pointed to this as proof that the government's proposed [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] cannot be trusted to protect workers' rights.
corporate_state.3.a: Announce a legal action against the owners.
corporate_state.3.b: Suppress this story before it can spread further.
corporate_state.3.c: What do we care for some [SCOPE.sPop('relevant_pop').GetCulture.GetName] wastrels?
corporate_state.4.d: Through visibly favoring sectors of employment deemed productive, the government has successfully built support for the establishment of a [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. Their opponents have been decried as unproductive and parasitic.
corporate_state.4.b: For an honest regime of productive classes!
corporate_state.5.d: As the government debates establishing a [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], various organizations have made their cases for greater representation in corporate bodies. They include workers' organizations, employers' associations, and universities.
corporate_state.5.f: The chart that the proponents of the law had manifested was awe-inspiring to look at. A wall of black ink, lists of every officially-recognized [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] trade union and employer's confederations. Lines connected them to twenty-two large blocks, all organized under several coordinating bodies and the proposed council of ministers. Each provisional councilor that laid their eyes on it had the same thought - how could they fill in the blank spaces with their own names?
corporate_state.5.c: Support the bid of the universities and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName].
corporate_state.5.e: We will not play favorites in the nominating process.
on_enactment_trade_unions_bonus_tt: Upon enacting this law, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] receive a [concept_political_strength] bonus for as long as it is active
on_enactment_industrialists_bonus_tt: Upon enacting this law, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_ig').GetName] receive a [concept_political_strength] bonus for as long as it is active
on_enactment_intelligentsia_bonus_tt: Upon enacting this law, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] receive a [concept_political_strength] bonus for as long as it is active
corporate_state_trade_unions_bias_tt: The [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_trade_unions',GetPlayer).GetName] will receive a [concept_political_strength] bonus for as long as this law is active
corporate_state_industrialists_bias_tt: The [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_industrialists',GetPlayer).GetName] will receive a [concept_political_strength] bonus for as long as this law is active
corporate_state_intelligentsia_bias_tt: The [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_intelligentsia',GetPlayer).GetName] will receive a [concept_political_strength] bonus for as long as this law is active
corporate_state.6.d: The proposal to establish a [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has met pushback from the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName], who claim that the proposal will permit unqualified workers too much control over their enterprises.
corporate_state.6.a: Reassure them of our commitment to private property rights.
corporate_state.6.b: Issue a carve-out for these enterprises.
corporate_state.6.c: They have no right to speak about qualifications.
corporatist_leaders_boost_tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] will be more likely to select [GetIdeology('ideology_corporatist').GetName] characters
every_investing_country_upset_tt: Relations with every country that owns more than #b 1%#! of our total [concept_gdp] will deteriorate by #r 15#!
je_reunify_china_reason: The collapse of central government authority has led to the rise of various competing military powers across China. If we are to restore China from the ruins, we must establish ourselves as something more than just another #bold $gov_warlord_state$#!.\n\nWhilst this [concept_journal_entry] is active, less powerful Warlord States will be more likely to assist one another against more powerful states.
warlord_china_events.101.d: Through the diligence of our people and the bravery of our soldiers, the last warlord armies have been defeated or brought into compliance. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has been reunited, stronger than ever before.
warlord_china_events.101.f: She had never seen so much light in the sky. A sea of red, yellow, and pink sparks transformed night into day, interspersed with the detonations of yet more fireworks. In the streets beneath her home, her neighbors released lanterns in great glowing flocks that met the fireworks at their height.\n\nThe festival would end eventually, of course, for limited supplies and need for sleep, but the occasion it symbolized would not. China was one again - indivisible, sovereign, and eternal.
warlord_china_events.101.a: Our nation must be forever indivisible.
warlord_china_events.101.b: Let us dedicate all of our efforts into rebuilding.
central_government_defeated_tt: The #bold central government#! in [GetGlobalVariable('chinese_central_government').GetCountry.GetName|v] has been defeated
no_independent_chinese_countries_tt: Every [concept_country] with [GetCulture('han').GetName], [GetCulture('manchu').GetName], [GetCulture('yue').GetName], [GetCulture('yi').GetName], or [GetCulture('hakka').GetName] [concept_primary_cultures] has been annexed or made our [concept_subject]
je_great_reformer_reason: The accession of [SCOPE.sCharacter('alexander_ii_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('alexander_ii_scope').GetFullName] to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] throne has been hailed by many reformers as a chance to completely remodel the antiquated structures of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] state. The reform-minded [SCOPE.sCharacter('alexander_ii_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has created a multitude of commissions to study and implement various reform proposals. If these
je_great_reforms_serfdom_reason: Discontent with the practice of [GetLawType('law_serfdom').GetName] has long existed within reformist circles. Liberal [GetPopType('aristocrats').GetName] have criticized the practice for tying up vast sums of capital in owning unproductive serfs, limiting the ability of the aristocracy to invest in more productive spheres. So long as this practice continues, it will serve as a burden upon the potential of the state to undergo economic modernization.\n\nIn order to match the economic progress of Western Europe, the serfs must be emancipated, and the economy reoriented towards more productive ends.
je_great_reforms_military_reason: The #b Imperial Russian Army#!, largely made up of poorly-trained [GetLawType('law_peasant_levies').GetName], has fallen further and further behind the more professional military forces of Europe as time has passed. To make up for these defects, the quality of the Army's armaments and training must be improved, and conscription reformed to produce a larger pool of experienced military personnel.
je_great_reforms_bureaucratic_reason: Despite the efforts of the previous Tsar to strengthen the state bureaucracy, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state apparatus remains overly reliant upon arbitrary and antiquated local bodies. In order to see through our other reforms with the greatest efficacy, the equal rule of law and authority of the state must be ensured across our vast territories.\n\nThe taxation system, currently dependent upon local landowners collecting taxes from peasants, must be brought into the hands of the state. Likewise, local administrators must be made accountable, and the administrative privileges of the nobility reduced.
paralegal_discrimination.1.d: A minority group of [SCOPE.sCulture('newcomer_culture').GetName] has recently settled in the state of [ROOT.GetState.GetName], seeking a better future. However, the local [SCOPE.sCulture('biggest_primary_culture').GetName] elites are stirring up resentment, claiming the [SCOPE.sCulture('newcomer_culture').GetNameNoFormatting] newcomers will destroy the traditional way of life.
paralegal_discrimination.1.a: The [SCOPE.sCulture('newcomer_culture').GetName] people must accept their lot.
paralegal_discrimination.1.b: We must foster harmony between peoples, whether [SCOPE.sCulture('newcomer_culture').GetName] or [SCOPE.sCulture('biggest_primary_culture').GetName].
paralegal_discrimination.1.c: The old [SCOPE.sCulture('biggest_primary_culture').GetName] ways cannot continue to dominate our modern nation.
great_reformer.1.d: The most crucial of [SCOPE.sCharacter('alexander_ii_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('alexander_ii_scope').GetFullName]'s reforms have been passed. The liberal bureaucrats celebrate them as paving the way for modernity in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
great_reformer.1.a: The Tsar must be honored for his work.
unfriendly_nation_with_interest_in_alask: A hostile [concept_country] with a [concept_rank] higher than ours has an [concept_interest] in the #bold Pacific Coast#! [concept_strategic_region]
friendly_nation_with_interest_in_alaska_: A #bold North American#! [concept_great_power] with an [concept_incorporated_state] in the #bold Pacific Coast#! [concept_strategic_region] has positive [concept_relations] with us
not_sold_alaska_tt: We have #bold not#! successfully sold #bold Alaska#!
alaska_transaction_ongoing_tt: No country is currently making an offer for #b Alaska#!
has_alaska_sale_cooldown_tt: Has not used this action in the past #bold year#!
notification_alaska_negotiations_fail_de: [SCOPE.sCountry('alaska_buyer').GetName] has backed out of the negotiations for the sale of Alaska. The territory will remain under our control until another attempt is made.
je_sale_of_alaska_reason: [SCOPE.sState('alaska_scope').GetName], an isolated territory on the periphery of [SCOPE.sCountry('alaska_owner_scope').GetName], has come under threat of seizure by hostile foreign powers in recent years.\n\nTo extract some profit from the territory, and avoid the humiliation of having it seized by our enemies in the case of war, officials in the [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s government have suggested finding a buyer for [SCOPE.sState('alaska_scope').GetName].
je_sell_alaska_button_desc: The territory of Alaska represents more of a liability than a benefit to our state. Finding a buyer for Alaska will serve as a boon to both our treasury and our national security.
selling_alaska_tt: We will receive significant monetary compensation for [SCOPE.sState('alaska_scope').GetName], and improved [concept_relations] with its #bold buyer#!
je_buy_alaska_button_desc: Alaska is currently held as a colonial territory by a friendly nation. We may be able to leverage our relations to purchase the territory.
most_european_pops_abandon_alaska_tt: A large number of #bold European#! [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] will evacuate [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetName]
alaskan_declaration_of_independence_tt: We will declare our sovereignty as the #bold Alyaska Republic#!
alk_breakup.1.d: Rudderless and without the vital lifeline provided by its colonial overlord, the continuation of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s operations now appears untenable. European settlers are preparing to evacuate en masse.
alk_breakup.1.a: Make an orderly retreat from Alaska.
alk_breakup.1.b: Hold on in hopes of our overlord's return.
alk_breakup.1.c: Fetch a pen and stationary. We shall make this land our own!
alk_breakup.1.e: Turn the land over to its native peoples.
sale_of_alaska_happened: The Sale of Alaska has happened
usa_purchase_alaska_desc: Though some doubt the strategic and economic value of the vast expanses of Alaska, we should not pass up the opportunity to push the frontiers of liberty.
alaska.1.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('alaska_buyer').GetName] has made us an offer for the purchase of [SCOPE.sState('alaska_scope').GetName].
alaska.1.a: The land is worthless, let the [SCOPE.sCountry('alaska_buyer').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting]s have it.
alaska.2.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('alaska_seller').GetName] has agreed to our terms. A treaty for the purchase of [SCOPE.sState('alaska_scope').GetName] has been drafted.
alaska.2.a: What riches do these vast territories hide?
alaska.3.d: Negotiations with [SCOPE.sCountry('alaska_seller').GetName] over the purchase of [SCOPE.sState('alaska_scope').GetName] have failed.
alaska.3.a: We will continue diplomacy through other means.
alaska.4.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('alaska_seller').GetName] finds itself unable to protect its North American colony of [SCOPE.sState('alaska_scope').GetName], and appears willing to sell the territory to us for an affordable sum.
alaska.4.c: We cannot afford such an expense right now.
alaska.4.tt1: We will offer £3m over the course of 1 year.
je_alaska_reason: Situated in the far North, [SCOPE.sState('alaska_state').GetStateRegion.GetName] is a vast, uncharted territory that may hold many riches. Acquiring the territory will expand our borders greatly, advance our national prestige, and allow for dominating trade in the northern Pacific.
utopian.1.d: A group of people inspired by the [GetIdeology('ideology_utopian').GetName] theories of [SCOPE.sCharacter('utopian_leader_scope').GetFullName] have established an experimental colony in rural [SCOPE.sState('utopian_community_state_scope').GetName]. The colony styles itself as a window into an idyllic future society.
utopian.2.d: Amongst the current generation of socialists, a mode of analysis based upon class conflict has supplanted the multitudinous [GetIdeology('ideology_utopian').GetName] ideas of the past. To dream is no longer sufficient.
utopian.2.a: Socialism has evolved, and so must its proponents.
utopian.2.b: The liberation of the individual will bring forth utopia.
utopian.2.c: A new society will be birthed from cooperation between classes.
utopian.2.e: In dark times, one must cling to what inspires them.
non_pb_utopians_go_communist_tt: All [GetIdeology('ideology_utopian').GetName] [Concept('concept_character', '$concept_characters$')] #b not#! affiliated with the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_petty_bourgeoisie',GetPlayer).GetName] will adopt the [GetIdeology('ideology_communist').GetName] [concept_ideology]
non_pb_utopians_go_anarchist_tt: All [GetIdeology('ideology_utopian').GetName] [Concept('concept_character', '$concept_characters$')] #b not#! affiliated with the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_petty_bourgeoisie',GetPlayer).GetName] will adopt the [GetIdeology('ideology_anarchist').GetName] [concept_ideology]
pb_utopians_go_corporatist_tt: All [GetIdeology('ideology_utopian').GetName] [Concept('concept_character', '$concept_characters$')] affiliated with the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_petty_bourgeoisie',GetPlayer).GetName] will adopt the [GetIdeology('ideology_corporatist').GetName] [concept_ideology]
utopians_stay_utopian_tt: All currently existing [GetIdeology('ideology_utopian').GetName] [Concept('concept_character', '$concept_characters$')] will retain their current [concept_ideology]
no_more_utopians_tt: [GetIdeology('ideology_utopian').GetName] [Concept('concept_character', '$concept_characters$')] will no longer appear in this country
expedition_status_loc_antarctica_leader_: [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetFullName]'s expedition progresses towards the South Pole
[ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetFullName]'s expedition has reached the South Pole
italy_move_capital_to_rome_desc: Rome has always been the traditional center of Italy. With our nation reunified, we may restore the city to its rightful status as the capital.
election_generic.1.d: The ongoing election has drawn attention to the platforms of the various contending parties. Across [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], the electorate debates which party is worth trusting with the next term in government.
election_generic.1.e: The best arguments belong to the [SCOPE.sParty('party_4_scope').GetName].
election_generic.2.d: The eyes of the electorate have turned to the candidates that seek to acquire a position at the head of government. As the election approaches, voters debate who would provide the best leadership for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
election_generic.2.b: A term of [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('party_2_ig_scope').GetLeader.GetFullName] is what the country needs.
election_generic.2.c: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('party_3_ig_scope').GetLeader.GetFullName] has the character for the job.
generic_laws.1.d: This afternoon, [SCOPE.sCharacter('orator_ig_leader_scope').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('orator_ig_scope').GetName], delivered a fiery speech advocating for the enactment of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
generic_laws.1.f: Making an appearance before the public in [SCOPE.sCharacter('orator_ig_leader_scope').GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName]'s main square, [SCOPE.sCharacter('orator_ig_leader_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting]'s powerful rhetoric left even [SCOPE.sCharacter('orator_ig_leader_scope').GetHerHis] most embittered political opponents impressed. Excerpts from the speech are already being circulated across [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting], fanning the fires of an already roaring debate.
generic_laws.1.a: This should ease the path to reform greatly.
generic_laws.1.b: Performances like these reflect well on [SCOPE.sCharacter('orator_ig_leader_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('orator_ig_leader_scope').GetHerHis] cause.
generic_laws.2.d: Prominent members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('corrupt_ig_scope').GetName], including [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('corrupt_ig_scope').GetLeader.GetFullName], have been exposed in a corruption scandal, having exchanged political favors for personal
generic_laws.2.f: One aide was all it took. One boy squeezing acne from his face in the right place at the right time to overhear the howling laughter, smell the rich tobacco blend, and spot [SCOPE.sCharacter('corrupt_ig_leader_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting]'s new, golden cufflinks. One honest fellow's word to the right ears, and it was all uncovered.
generic_laws.2.a: Such is the nature of politics.
generic_laws.2.c: What horror! We must confiscate those gifts at once.
generic_laws.3.d: More pragmatically inclined members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('opposition_demands_ig_scope').GetName], currently opposed to the passing of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], have offered to change their stance were they to be offered certain political concessions. Such concessions would not be popular with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('opposition_demands_supporting_ig_scope').GetName], however.
generic_laws.3.a: Acquiesce to their demands, the bill must pass.
generic_laws.3.b: Compromise is a tool of the weak.
generic_laws.3.c: A prime opportunity to break the bill from deadlock.
generic_laws.4.d: In the midst of the debate surrounding [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], one of the country's leading playwrights, strongly associated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('playwright_ig_scope').GetName], has staged a widely acclaimed play whose politically laden theme makes no secret of the author's desire for the law to be passed.
generic_laws.4.a: [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] will be on everyone's lips now.
generic_laws.4.b: This sure puts the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('playwright_ig_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] in a good light.
generic_laws.4.c: Let us ensure the play gets a wider, international audience.
generic_laws.5.d: Lawmakers working towards the enactment of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] have found themselves mired in a particularly complex set of bureaucratic proceedings, grinding the work towards reform to a near halt.
generic_laws.5.f: The fully developed bureaucratic apparatus compares with other organizations exactly as does the machine with the non-mechanical modes of production. That is to say, the teeth of its individual gears meet in accord, or its gears will gnash and churn until it eventually breaks.
generic_laws.5.b: Cut through at least some of the red tape.
generic_laws.6.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has taken a personal interest in the ongoing debate concerning [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], and have resolved to use [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] royal prerogative to ensure the law passes.
generic_laws.6.f: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting] seldomly intervenes directly in matters of law, relying instead on a system of delegation and personal influence for the efficient running of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] realm. While legally, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] may exercise [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] royal powers at will, doing so is sure to rile up both republicans and opponents of the law in question.
generic_laws.6.a: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s assent is all that is required.
generic_laws.6.c: Advise the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] against it, it would do more harm than good.
generic_laws.7.d: The political wills and desires of the lower classes will always remain an opaque matter. For whatever reason, support for [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] has spread like wildfire across [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting], spurred on by charismatic speakers and lively debates in small-time social clubs.
generic_laws.7.b: Use this common ground to calm the masses.
generic_laws.8.d: What was meant as a routine speech about the merits of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] by [SCOPE.sCharacter('publicaddress_ig_leader_scope').GetFullName] has quickly devolved into a public relations disaster for the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('publicaddress_ig_scope').GetName].
generic_laws.8.f: Fumbling [SCOPE.sCharacter('publicaddress_ig_leader_scope').GetHerHis] way through a series of poorly presented talking points, [SCOPE.sCharacter('publicaddress_ig_leader_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting]'s arguments have been viciously and convincingly picked apart by [SCOPE.sCharacter('publicaddress_ig_leader_scope').GetHerHis] political opponents. The question on everyone's lips now is merely if this mishap was due to the inherent failings of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] or can be chalked down to the political incompetence of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('publicaddress_ig_scope').GetNameNoFormatting].
generic_laws.8.a: It is the fault of this poorly thought-through proposal!
generic_laws.8.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('publicaddress_ig_leader_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] must take the blame for this setback.
generic_laws.8.c: Scrap the current draft, and make a show of a rewrite.
generic_laws.9.t: Law Proposal Causes Uproar in [SCOPE.sCulture('non_accepted_culture_scope').GetName] Communities
generic_laws.9.d: Claiming that the enactment of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] would affect the country's [SCOPE.sCulture('non_accepted_culture_scope').GetName] inhabitants in a disproportionately negative way, [SCOPE.sCulture('non_accepted_culture_scope').GetName] firebrands have riled their communities against the current law proposal.
generic_laws.9.a: And their thoughts concern us how? Force the issue through!
generic_laws.10.d: An influential faction within the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('defectors_ig_scope').GetName] has grown frustrated with their comembers' neutrality on the topic of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. Themselves in favor of the law, they have now resolved to form a separate political faction intent on passing it.
generic_laws.10.a: With their support, the bill shall pass.
generic_laws.10.b: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('defectors_support_ig_scope').GetName] extend an open hand to these mavericks.
generic_laws.11.d: To outside observers, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('dissenters_ig_scope').GetName] may appear firmly committed to the idea of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], but behind this facade of unity discord has long festered. Now, a clique of dissenters have finally had enough, and have officially broken with their fellow members over the issue of reform.
generic_laws.11.a: Splitters! May the Devil take them.
generic_laws.11.b: Loosen our purse strings, perhaps we can lure some of them back.
generic_laws.11.c: Offer them custodianship over a new draft.
generic_laws.12.d: Frustrated with the lengthy legal process surrounding [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('underhanded_instigator_leader_scope').GetFullName] of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('underhanded_instigator_ig_scope').GetName] has approached us with an offer to expedite the process, utilizing [SCOPE.sCharacter('underhanded_instigator_leader_scope').GetHerHis] personal connections within the state apparatus.
generic_laws.12.a: Grant [SCOPE.sCharacter('underhanded_instigator_leader_scope').GetHerHim] permission, time is of the essence.
generic_laws.12.b: No, we do this by the book, or not at all.
je_sick_man_bureaucracy_reason: Our bureaucracy is a patchwork of archaic laws and systems, with corrupt, autonomous Beys barely exerting control over the Empire's provinces. If we are to overcome the many challenges to our rule, we must modernize our administrative system.
tanzimat_events.1.d: For centuries our administration has depended on tax farming for collecting revenue, but this highly inefficient system leaves much to be desired. Proposals for reform have flooded the Grand Vizier's desk, and the nation eagerly awaits our response.
tanzimat_events.1.f: Ever since the reign of Mehmed II, taxation rights have been auctioned off to the highest bidder, who in turn retain a part of the revenue for personal use. Over time, this has created a cadre of powerful, autonomous, and oftentimes corrupt [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('governors').GetNameNoFormatting], significantly reducing state revenues.\n\nWhile most agree that the system must change, few agree on how, and fewer still want to antagonize the landholding elite.
tanzimat_events.1.a: Abolish tax farming, but leave the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('governors').GetNameNoFormatting] in place.
tanzimat_events.1.c: Abolish the system in fact as well as in name.
tanzimat_events.2.d: Our existing system of land ownership is old, inconsistent, and in dire need of reform. Proponents of modernization demand action; how shall the High Porte respond?
tanzimat_events.2.f: Land ownership in the Ottoman Empire is a complicated affair, consisting of an overlapping patchwork of tenured and communal lands, tax-exempt villages, grants of conquest, and a slew of other land categories. Recognizing the current situation's negative impact on state administration and revenue, key figures in Constantinople push for reform. \n\nFearing conscription and increased taxation however, the Empire's rural population are sure to disapprove of any change to the status quo.
tanzimat_events.2.a: Reform the system, but recognize traditional land categories.
tanzimat_events.2.b: The old system has served us well.
tanzimat_events.2.c: Enact a truly modern land code.
tanzimat.2.tt1: Some peasants might resist the reform.
tanzimat_events.4.d: With our move towards a more professional bureaucratic system in motion, demands have been put forth to nominally elevate the legal status of non-Muslims, enabling them to serve as civil servants.
tanzimat_events.4.f: The preservation of the Sublime State in the face of unrest, insurrection, and foreign intervention is a, if not the, primary concern of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]. If we are to achieve this however, steps to appease our minority subjects might be necessary, lest they become pawns of malicious foreign powers.
tanzimat_events.4.a: Equal rights under the law! On paper at least.
tanzimat_events.4.b: Promise reform, but let us not get carried away.
tanzimat_events.4.c: These are mere concessions masqueraded as reform. Denied!
tanzimat.4.tt1: Elevating the status of Dhimmis might further antagonize radical Sunni voices.
tanzimat_events.5.d: A climate of paranoia has enveloped the city of [SCOPE.sState('paranoia_state_scope').GetCityHubName], after a local imam accused the [SCOPE.sReligion('discriminated_religion_scope').GetName] community of conspiring with [SCOPE.sCountry('neighbor_country').GetName] to undermine the authority of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
tanzimat_events.5.b: Crack down hard on suspected traitors, better safe than sorry.
tanzimat.5.tt1: Radical Sunni voices might take matters into their own hand.
tanzimat.5.tt2: Your actions should satisfy the Sunni radicals.
tanzimat_events.6.d: Outraged by the High Porte's decision to elevate the legal status of Dhimmis, and spurred on by rumors of foreign-backed insurrection, a large [SCOPE.sReligion('mob_religion').GetName] mob has rampaged through the [SCOPE.sCulture('mob_victim_culture').GetName] quarter of [SCOPE.sState('mob_state_scope').GetCityHubName].
tanzimat_events.6.a: This is for the local governor to handle.
tanzimat_events.6.c: Let the mob run its course.
tanzimat.6.tt1: Your actions may cause the situation to escalate.
tanzimat.6.tt2: Your actions are likely to keep the situation from escalating.
tanzimat.6.tt3: Your lack of action is likely to escalate the situation.
tanzimat_events.7.d: Horror! In a fit of merciless fury, a large crowd of [SCOPE.sReligion('sunni_religion').GetName] rioters have turned on their [SCOPE.sReligion('massacre_victims').GetName] neighbors. The streets of [SCOPE.sState('massacre_state_scope').GetCityHubName] run red with blood, and large parts of the city is ablaze.
tanzimat_events.7.a: Break up the crowds, with bullet fire if need be.
tanzimat_events.7.b: That should keep those would-be traitors in line.
tanzimat_events.8.d: A sense of normalcy has returned to the streets of [SCOPE.sState('orderrestored_state_scope').GetCityHubName]. Storefronts are being rebuilt and restocked, and statements of distrust and hatred are gradually being replaced with ones of reconciliation.
tanzimat_events.9.d: With the possibility of increased taxation and military service looming large, peasants from [SCOPE.sState('peasant_state').GetName] have refused to register their land, depriving us of much-needed tax revenue.
tanzimat_events.9.a: Let local Sheiks purchase their land, the tax must flow.
tanzimat_events.9.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('peasant_smashing_general').GetFullName] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('peasant_smashing_general').GetHerHis] men will quell this unrest.
tanzimat_events.9.c: Leave them be, who cares about [SCOPE.sState('peasant_state').GetNameNoFormatting]?
tanzimat_events.10.d: With the establishment of a military draft, the state must now decide the role, if any, of non-Muslims in our army.
tanzimat_events.10.f: The Empire's non-Muslim subjects have traditionally been exempt from military service, substituting their blood with a special 'cizye' tax paid to the High Porte. Proponents of army modernization have now suggested the extension of the draft to all Ottoman subjects, however, this would rob the imperial coffers of an important source of income.
tanzimat_events.10.a: Those who can afford it may pay a draft exemption tax.
tanzimat_events.10.b: The draft applies to all subjects, regardless of creed.
notification_country_shared_plastics_tec: [SCOPE.sCountry('plastic_origin').GetName] Shares Their Knowledge of Plastics with Us

A scientific delegation from [SCOPE.sCountry('plastic_origin').GetNameNoFormatting] has arrived in [SCOPE.sCountry('plastic_neighbor').GetCapital.GetCityHubName], carrying blueprints and schematics for the development and production of plastics.
notification_country_shared_radio_tech_n: [SCOPE.sCountry('radio_production_origin').GetName] Shares Their Knowledge of Radios with Us
notification_country_shared_radio_tech_d: A scientific delegation from [SCOPE.sCountry('radio_production_origin').GetNameNoFormatting] has arrived in [SCOPE.sCountry('radio_production_neighbor').GetCapital.GetCityHubName], carrying blueprints and schematics for the development and production of radios.
notification_warlord_china_explosion_poi: Our skillful steering of the country has legitimized our rule in the eyes of the people, steadily pulling the country back from the brink of collapse.
Our mishandling of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] affairs has delegitimized our rule, causing the country to inch ever closer to total collapse.
je_boxer_rebellion_reason: The humiliating loss of Chinese lands to foreign
qing_owns_all_han_states_tt: Owns all [GetCulture('han').GetName] [Concept('concept_homeland','$concept_homelands$')], and no [GetCulture('han').GetName] [concept_homeland] is a [concept_split_state]
boxer_rebellion_events.1.d: Furious with the growing foreign presence in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], [SCOPE.sCulture('han_culture').GetName] subjects are organizing into anti-foreign militias, bent on driving the
boxer_rebellion_events.1.a: Revive the Qing! Destroy the foreigner!
boxer_rebellion_events.1.b: These fanatics would spell our doom.
boxer_rebellion_events.2.d: Once more, the Yellow Dragon Flag soars from the rooftops of all the Middle Kingdom’s cities. From the shining pearls lining the Southern Delta to the great metropolises along the East Sea, the stain of imperialism has been washed away from our shores.
boxer_rebellion_events.2.a: May [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] reign for ten thousand years!
boxer_rebellion_events.2.b: May [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] endure for ten thousand years!
boxer_rebellion_events.3.b: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetNameNoFormatting] garrison revolts and storms the Forbidden City.
boxer_rebellion_events.3.tt1: The Manchus are ousted from power, and the Duke Yansheng, the main-line descendant of Confucius, is declared Emperor.
boxer_rebellion_events.4.t: The Fall of the Qing Dynasty
boxer_rebellion_events.4.d: With the stroke of a pen, two millennia of imperial rule has come to an end. As the last [SCOPE.sCulture('manchu_culture').GetName] emperor is escorted out of the Forbidden City, the world shifts its gaze to the East. What does this new age hold for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]?
boxer_rebellion_events.4.a: The [SCOPE.sCulture('manchu_culture').GetName] yoke has ended at last.
boxer_rebellion_events.4.b: Now is the time for reconciliation.
election_contextual_events.1.d: With the price of [SCOPE.sGoods('basic_foodstuff').GetName] soaring across the country, the [SCOPE.sParty('high_food_price_party').GetName] is finding itself under relentless pressure from the opposition—accused of recklessly toying with the welfare of its citizens.
election_contextual_events.1.a: They will just have to eat something else then!
election_contextual_events.1.b: Fund soup kitchens. A man with a full belly makes fewer mistakes.
election_contextual_events.2.d: Claims that the [SCOPE.sParty('public_debt_party').GetName]'s policy of extensive money loaning has saddled future generations with an undue burden have caused the party to leak voters like a faulty sieve.
election_contextual_events.2.a: Loans are a cornerstone of any healthy economy!
election_contextual_events.2.b: Find a scapegoat, the public demands a sacrifice.
election_contextual_events.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('pacifist_ig_leader').GetFullName], renowned pacifist and leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('opposition_pacifist_ig').GetName], has launched a scathing attack on the sitting [SCOPE.sParty('government_war_party').GetName], claiming that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] troops engaged in the [SCOPE.sWar('pacifist_war').GetNameNoFormatting] War have committed grave atrocities under their watch.
election_contextual_events.3.a: Our troops did what!? To whom!?
election_contextual_events.3.b: Interesting take. Let us censor it.
election_contextual_events.3.c: Interesting take. Let us censor it.
election_contextual_events.3.tt.1: The unpatriotic slander is kept from the public eye.
election_contextual_events.3.tt.2: The information is leaked despite our efforts.
election_contextual_events.4.d: The aged [SCOPE.sCharacter('decrepit_leader').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('decrepit_leader_ig').GetName], has unexpectedly expired mid-campaign—robbing the [SCOPE.sParty('decrepit_leader_party').GetName] of a cornerstone politician. The question of [SCOPE.sCharacter('decrepit_leader').GetHerHis] replacement is now on everyone's lips.
election_contextual_events.4.a: Go with the popular, but inept candidate.
election_contextual_events.4.b: The determined, but haughty youngster secures the chair.
election_contextual_events.5.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('low_sol_opposition_leader').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('low_sol_opposition_ig').GetName], has been loudly accusing the [SCOPE.sParty('low_sol_party').GetName] of misrule, given the country's low standard of living—claiming that only the [SCOPE.sParty('low_sol_opposition_party').GetName] has the willpower to set things right.
election_contextual_events.5.a: Why are we to blame? Have they tried being less poor?
election_contextual_events.5.b: Just a few bad eggs in the administration, nothing more.
election_contextual_events.6.d: The country's high standard of living has resulted in a widespread sense of contentment with the status quo, favoring [SCOPE.sCharacter('high_sol_leader').GetFullName] and the sitting [SCOPE.sParty('high_sol_party').GetName] in the ongoing elections.
election_contextual_events.6.a: If it is not broken, why fix it?
election_contextual_events.7.d: With the [SCOPE.sWar('ongoing_election_war').GetName] war going well, the country is swept up in a frenzy of war. The sitting [SCOPE.sParty('ongoing_election_war_party').GetName] has issued letters of endorsement to parliamentary candidates they feel support the war effort, drawing patriotic voters toward their cause.
election_contextual_events.7.a: Rally around the part... I mean flag!
election_contextual_events.7.b: Are you for us, or for our adversaries?
dove_of_peace_in_time_of_war: Dove of Peace in Time of War
election_contextual_events.8.t: A Torrent of Gin and Beer
election_contextual_events.8.d: The [SCOPE.sParty('temperance_party').GetName]'s anti-alcohol policy is hurting their electoral prospects, as scores of thirsty voters flock to the [SCOPE.sParty('anti_temperance_party').GetName]—hoping that a change in government will see an end to the country's temperance policies.
election_contextual_events.8.b: Run a smear campaign against these immoral bacchanalians.
je_rifling_reason: While the concept of rifled gun barrels is many centuries old, only recently have advances in industry and technology allowed for their production and distribution on a large scale—providing a level of accuracy to our armed forces yet unheard of.
je_machine_guns_reason: Serviceable by a single man, and capable of firing hundreds of shells per minute, the automated machine gun represents a near-insurmountable obstacle for any attacker facing entrenched positions.
military_tech_events.401.d: The change in large-scale production from smoothbore muskets to rifles in the [SCOPE.sBuilding('rifle_factory').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('rifle_state').GetName] has ushered in a new era for [SCOPE.sGoods('small_arms_good').GetName] production in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting].
military_tech_events.401.a: The [SCOPE.sState('rifle_state').GetCityHubName] Arsenal shall be famed throughout the world.
military_tech_events.401.b: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] shall be at the forefront of military innovation.
military_tech_events.402.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('machine_gun_general').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('machine_gun_general').GetFullName]'s use of dedicated machine gun teams in the [SCOPE.sWar('machine_gun_war').GetName] war has yielded advantageous results on the field of battle, leaving full platoons of enemies dead before they have even reached our lines.
military_tech_events.402.a: Our foes fall like grass before the scythe.
military_tech_events.402.b: Whatever happens, we have got the Maxim gun, and they have not.
military_tech_events.402.c: [SCOPE.sCharacter('machine_gun_general').GetFullName]'s mastery of this tool is unparalleled.
je_ironclads_reason: Metal-clad, steam-powered ships equipped with large-caliber guns capable of firing explosive shot, the ironclad represents a radical departure from the Age of Fighting Sail.
je_monitors_reason: Shallow draft vessels primarily intended for coastal defense operations, the monitor represents an affordable solution to any nation lacking the capital or industry to maintain a high seas ironclad navy.
military_tech_events.403.t: A Doctrine of Iron and Steam
military_tech_events.403.d: The introduction of vessels with metal-skinned hulls represents nothing less than a revolution in naval warfare. Near-impervious to traditional types of shot, [SCOPE.sCharacter('ironclad_admiral').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ironclad_admiral').GetFullName] assures us that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] dominion of the seas will be absolute.
military_tech_events.403.a: This will make our line of battle invincible.
military_tech_events.403.b: Metal bows? Metal Rams! What could go wrong?
military_tech_events.404.d: Designed for coastal defense operations, what monitors lack in oceangoing capabilites they make up for in cost effectiveness. [SCOPE.sCharacter('monitor_admiral').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('monitor_admiral').GetFullName] has informed the Admiralty in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] that [SCOPE.sCharacter('monitor_admiral').GetHerHis] fleet will keep any foes away from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] waters.
military_tech_events.404.b: Let us orient our naval doctrine around them.
military_tech_events.404.c: We don't win by having the best ships, we win by having the most.
net_expand_east_indies_desc: We currently hold lands in the East Indies that would be better administered by our colonial subject.
expand_east_indies_tt: Transfer control of all holdings or vassals in the East Indies to our colony.
expand_dei_cooldown_tt: Has not expanded the East Indies Administration for 2 years
je_christ_of_nations_reason:
#italic As Christ was martyred by the Romans, so too was Poland at the hands of her enemies, and as Christ is destined to come again in his glory, so too is Poland destined to do the same.#!

While the last independent [SCOPE.sCulture('polish_culture_scope').GetName] state disappeared off the map following the #bold Three Partitions#! of the late 18th century, the dream of its revival lives on in the minds of Poles from Poznań to Lwów.

#bold The Legacy of the Rzeczpospolita#!
Should a fully independent Polish state be established one way or another, we will be able to join their state to ours, provided [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] is itself independent.
christ_of_nations_button_desc: Across the domains of the old Commonwealth, countless groups, cells, and committees can be found working towards the reestablishment of [SCOPE.sCulture('polish_culture_scope').GetName] rule. By acting as a safehaven for Polish patriots, and through the funding and support of their efforts, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] can prepare the Polish lands outside our direct control for future liberation.
christ_of_nations_button_tt_1: Select a foreign [concept_country] with [SCOPE.sCulture('polish_culture_scope').GetName] [Concept('concept_homeland','$concept_homelands$')] to embolden [SCOPE.sCulture('polish_culture_scope').GetName] [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] in their [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')].
christ_of_nations_button_tt_2: Has not used this action in the last #bold 5#! years
poland_events.1.d: The [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjective] communities of [SCOPE.sCulture('polish_culture_scope').GetName] patriots and exiles are both large and well-motivated. By giving them aid and clear directions we can ensure that their zeal does not go to waste.
poland_events.1.c: The Poles of [SCOPE.sCountry('polish_agitation_target_3_scope').GetName] yearn for freedom.
poland_events.1.tt: The target nation's choices and [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] may affect the amount of radicals generated and the degree of our relationship change.
poland_events.2.d: Large protests have erupted throughout the [SCOPE.sCulture('polish_culture_scope').GetName] communities in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName], advocating for Polish statehood. Advisors believe the unrest may be connected to the actions of government-affiliated groups in [SCOPE.sCountry('sent_polish_agitators_country_scope').GetName].
poland_events.2.f: Peoples of a torn land will, invariably, pine for whatever glories and identities they once had. Such is the wisdom of empires of old: subjects of conquest kept their lands and their customs, but for a tribute and agreement to hold new laws. The consequences of stripping a people of their identity is, also invariably, catastrophe.
poland_events.2.b: Infiltrate and try to break up their groups.
poland_events.2.tt: By establishing either a [GetLawType('law_secret_police').GetName] or a [GetLawType('law_national_guard').GetName], we may lessen the impact of such events in the future. However, only the elimination of [SCOPE.sCountry('sent_polish_agitators_country_scope').GetName] as a self-governing entity can truly eliminate this issue once and for all.
poland_events.3.d: Calls for a political union between the two [SCOPE.sCulture('polish_culture_scope').GetName] states of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('polish_union_target_scope').GetName] have grown widespread as of late. An official proposal has now been issued from [SCOPE.sCountry('polish_union_target_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName], with the [SCOPE.sCountry('polish_union_target_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] delegation eagerly awaiting our response.
poland_events.3.b: This does not serve the interests of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]
poland_events.4.d: Defying the partitions, Poland has made a miraculous return to the world stage. But as the eyes of the nation are fixed upon its future, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName] looks to its past. A Poland has been reborn, but which?
poland_events.4.f: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastNameNoFormatting] sat in the half-darkness, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] face lit by a single candle almost burnt to its stump. If hope had a taste, it was victory; victory was jubilance; jubilance, in this case, was a rye aged thirty years in old wine barrels. But it could not dampen the anxiety of a new future. To harken the days of Jadwiga or Bolesław, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] thought, was to set the stage of Poland's next hundred years. [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe|U] sipped the rye, as [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] pondered the specter of a thousand years of history.
poland_events.4.a: Like in the days of Piast the Wheelwright, Poland is for the Poles.
poland_events.4.b: We are the heirs of the crowned republic, our destiny lies in the east.
poland_events.5.d: A great [SCOPE.sCountry('polish_rebel_country_scope').GetAdjective] rebellion has broken out against the [SCOPE.sCountry('polish_rebel_country_enemy_scope').GetAdjective] yoke. Our [SCOPE.sCulture('polish_culture_scope').GetName] brethren cry out for aid. How shall we answer them?
poland_events.5.f: #bold Street Clash: Polish Partizan Push!#!\nPolish nationals have taken to the streets in [SCOPE.sState('polish_rebel_state_scope').GetCityHubName] in an attempt to reunify the old Polish country. Multiple persons have since perished in the fierce wars on the streets, with many a brave constable sacrificing life and limb to put down this revolt. Authorities in [SCOPE.sState('polish_rebel_state_scope').GetCityHubName] believe the rebellion may soon be crushed in a matter of weeks. (cont. pp. 7-8)
poland_events.5.b: Send them volunteers, weapons, and supplies.
poland_events.5.c: Dig deep. We shall send them whatever they need.
poland_events.5.tt: If we are a subject, the effects of our aid will be halved.
je_poland_lithuania_reason: The borders of the old Commonwealth stretched far beyond the lands of the Poles and Lithuanians and into the vastness of Ruthenia. It shall do so again.
je_poland_lithuania_tt: We have formed the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth
poland_events.6.d: The Commonwealth of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has been restored, undoing decades of subjugation and partition. While the [SCOPE.sCulture('polish_culture').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCulture('lithuanian_culture').GetName] people now enjoy freedom from Russian and German rule, we must consider whether to extend our dominion to liberate [SCOPE.sCulture('ukrainian_culture').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCulture('byelorussian_culture').GetName] lands as well.
poland_events.6.f: A grand restoration, centuries in the making. Hussars with polished armor and silken wings stood at attention as the new government swept into the halls of power. The first order for the knights of the new commonwealth was thus: defend the borders, no matter the cost. But which borders were they to follow?
poland_events.6.b: We will restore the borders of the old Commonwealth.
plc_discrimination_tt: If we #bold do not have#! [GetLawType('law_national_supremacy').GetName] or [GetLawType('law_ethnostate').GetName]:
poland_events.7.d: The [SCOPE.sCulture('ukrainian_culture').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCulture('byelorussian_culture').GetName] people have been incorporated into our Commonwealth as equal partners in our great union.
poland_events.7.d2: The [SCOPE.sCulture('ukrainian_culture').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCulture('byelorussian_culture').GetName] lands have been annexed into our empire, restoring the place of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] as a true power in Europe.
je_colonial_administration_reason: In order to best leverage our rule over our African holdings, a #bold Colonial Administration#! may be established over a given region of the continent. #bold Colonial Administrations#! will expand into neighboring [Concept('concept_decentralized_nation', '$concept_decentralized_nations$')] on their own, and may be given jurisdiction over our other regional holdings.\n\n#lore The Scramble for Africa, so it is called, is underway in earnest. Every power worth a hoot is seeking slices of the great continent as more jewels in their crowns. Rich in untapped resources and filled with people yet to be put to work, power and prestige are the prizes for the victors. Make no mistake: blood will be spilled long before the scramble ends. Africa awaits.#!
je_colonial_administration_button_senega: North and west of the continent, Senegal stretches over the bones of long decayed empires. Spices and metal are plentiful in this place, as are cocoa and coffee.
je_colonial_administration_button_niger_: A veritable breadbasket of Africa, this area once hosted great kingdoms and mighty empires. Securing the African center will not only mean seizing food and timber, but allow us to reach anywhere around the continent.
je_colonial_administration_button_ethiop: The Horn of Africa is abundant in foodstuffs, and the fertile plains to support untold millions. Seizing this section of Africa will grant us access to medicines and food once held for the richest of the rich.
je_colonial_administration_button_zanj_d: The southeastern pocket of the continent, Zanj has long been a trading point for ivory, gold and flesh. Controlling this region will open the floodgates for our more exotic markets.
je_colonial_administration_button_southe: Mountains, grasslands, and deserts alike cover Southern Africa. Within them lies iron, specie, diamonds, and more. Securing this swathe of the continent would secure an industrialized future.
je_colonial_administration_button_congo_: The regions in and around the Congo Basin host some of the world’s greatest rainforests. Wood and food from this region would do greatly to bolster our military.
je_colonial_administration_button_tt_1: When establishing a local colonial administration, we will be able to tailor its [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] and [concept_government] to best suit the needs of the metropole, and its constituent [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')].
je_colonial_administration_button_tt_2: Any [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjective] lands within the relevant [concept_strategic_region] will be transferred to our new colonial [concept_subject]. If a [concept_state] has the [GetDecreeType('decree_greener_grass_campaign').GetName] [concept_decree], a random state with that decree will be designated as its capital.
je_colonial_administration_button_expand: We currently hold lands in [SCOPE.sStateRegion('senegal_region_scope').GetStrategicRegion.GetName] that would be better administered by our colonial subject. If we have more than one colonial [concept_subject] in this [concept_strategic_region], they will be merged together.

We currently hold lands in [SCOPE.sStateRegion('niger_region_scope').GetStrategicRegion.GetName] that would be better administered by our colonial subject. If we have more than one colonial [concept_subject] in this [concept_strategic_region], they will be merged together.

We currently hold lands in [SCOPE.sStateRegion('ethiopia_region_scope').GetStrategicRegion.GetName] that would be better administered by our colonial subject. If we have more than one colonial [concept_subject] in this [concept_strategic_region], they will be merged together.

We currently hold lands in [SCOPE.sStateRegion('zanj_region_scope').GetStrategicRegion.GetName] that would be better administered by our colonial subject. If we have more than one colonial [concept_subject] in this [concept_strategic_region], they will be merged together.

We currently hold lands in [SCOPE.sStateRegion('southern_africa_region_scope').GetStrategicRegion.GetName] that would be better administered by our colonial subject. If we have more than one colonial [concept_subject] in this [concept_strategic_region], they will be merged together.

We currently hold lands in [SCOPE.sStateRegion('congo_region_scope').GetStrategicRegion.GetName] that would be better administered by our colonial subject. If we have more than one colonial [concept_subject] in this [concept_strategic_region], they will be merged together.
colonial_transfer_two_subjects_tt: We have more than one colonial [concept_subject] in this [concept_strategic_region].
transfer_stuff_to_subject_tt: All owned states and subjects within this strategic region will be transferred to our designated #bold Colonial Administration#!
colonial_administration_cooldown: We can only establish a new colonial administration every #variable 3#! months.
colonial_administration_events.1.d: With the establishment of [SCOPE.sCountry('newly_formed_colonial_nation_scope').GetName], we must decide the direction of our new colonial administration.
colonial_administration_events.1.a: It will be administered by a chartered [SCOPE.sCountry('newly_formed_colonial_nation_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] Company.
colonial_administration_events.1.b: The [SCOPE.sPop('majority_religion').GetReligion.GetName] missions will uplift the local populace.
colonial_administration_events.1.c: In Darkest Africa, a new [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] shall emerge.
colonial_administration_events.1.e: The whip shall crack, and the colony provide.
colonial_administration_events.1_tt_1: [SCOPE.sCountry('newly_formed_colonial_nation_scope').GetAdjective] [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] will be tailored around #bold commerce#! and #bold private enterprise.#!
colonial_administration_events.1_tt_2: [SCOPE.sCountry('newly_formed_colonial_nation_scope').GetAdjective] [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] will be tailored around #bold conversion#! and #bold education.#!
colonial_administration_events.1_tt_3: [SCOPE.sCountry('newly_formed_colonial_nation_scope').GetAdjective] [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] will be tailored around #bold immigration#! and #bold colonial settlement.#!
colonial_administration_events.1_tt_4: [SCOPE.sCountry('newly_formed_colonial_nation_scope').GetAdjective] [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] will be tailored around #bold slave labor#! and #bold ruthless exploitation.#!
colonial_administration_events.2.d: With our administrative ties to the metropole cut off, massive protests have erupted throughout [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. Protest that our understaffed colonial forces are hard pressed to handle.
colonial_administration_events.2.b: Colonial governance is no longer sustainable. We must have majority rule.
most_european_pops_abandon_africa_tt: A large number of #bold European#! [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] will evacuate [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]
acw_events.9.d_1: With this final victory, the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] armies have surrounded [SCOPE.sState('acw_victory_capital_scope').GetCityHubName]. Independence is ours.
acw_events.9.d_2: The revolution has been quashed. Prisoners have been taken, and General [SCOPE.sCharacter('acw_victory_general_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] is proceeding with a court martial.
acw_events.9.f_1: Ten-thousand men with fixed bayonets rushed through the [SCOPE.sState('acw_victory_capital_scope').GetCityHubName] streets, hollering and howling as a gray tide of conquerors. An adjutant arrived at the side of General [SCOPE.sCharacter('acw_victory_general_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] with a dispatch in hand. A formal surrender was scrawled in hasty script, with full acknowledgement of independence.
acw_events.9.a: A triumph for the natural order.
acw_events.9.b: Immediately pass legislation to re-open the slave trade.
je_dynamite_reason: Dynamite is an extremely dangerous commodity, but can also be an extremely useful one. Either way we should increase our production of dynamite to match the demand from either the Industrial or Military Sector.
je_shortform_building_mine_tooltip: Building is Iron, Coal, Lead, or Sulfur Mines
je_combustion_engines_reason: With personal transportation being the new crazy many in the nation feel as though we should focus on providing citizens with their own private forms of transportation at the expense of public transportation.
je_elevator_reason: With the recent introduction of elevators, there has been a push to have these new marvelous inventions in as many buildings as possible. The question is if we can afford to do so. We should look to increase our production in goods needed for their construction and implementation.
je_mutual_funds_reason: Newly-developed mutual funds will allow for greater ease in raising capital for enterprises. We should strive to have as many of our financial districts as possible making use of these new methods to generate wealth for our capitalists.
is_production_building_tt: All Non-Government Production Buildings that can have the Publically Traded Production Method.
production_tech_events.102.d: The development of more stable [SCOPE.sGoods('explosives_goods').GetName] has led to an uptick in demand for explosive materials. Our military and industrial sectors have entered a bidding war to secure shares of our production.
production_tech_events.102.f:
""Civilian applications?" Really? What does a civilian firm want with two thousand tonnes of dynamite?" The Quartermaster-General paced back and forth, clutching the dossier to his chest. "If I had two thousand tonnes of dynamite, I could equip an artillery corps for the year. I could fill warehouses with shells."

"It is... regrettable," said the clerk, cautiously testing each word. "A bidding frenzy has erupted over the material. Our current budget would buy us a fraction of what it should."

Not ideal, thought the Quartermaster-General, but survivable. "Place the order, and tell me the figure. I will petition the Cabinet for twice as much."
production_tech_events.102.a: Increasing supply will lift all boats.
production_tech_events.102.b: The industrial sector will make best use of it.
production_tech_events.102.c: The military must have their cut.
production_tech_events.103.d: With the invention and implementation of motor transportation the question arises. Shall we focus on public or private transportation?
society_tech_events.104.d: With the introduction and implementation of elevators into daily society, we can now reap the benefits of our increased industries.
society_tech_events.105.d: Now that we have more publicly traded companies we should now focus on what comes next.
society_tech_events.105.b: Maybe we can use this elsewhere.
hawaii_events.1.d: With the death of the King, local business owners and foreign ministers seek to increase their influence in Hawaii.
hawaii_events.1.a: We must take steps to maintain our independence.
hawaii_events.2.d: With our strength shown and local business owners placated, we can now look to increase our standing on the international stage.
hawaii_events.3.d: Groups of protesters and local militia led by a coalition of business owners and ambassadors from [SCOPE.sCountry('hawaiian_coup').GetName] have successfully taken over the Government and are now petitioning to have the country annexed.
hawaii_events.3.a: How did it come to this?
hawaii_events.4.d: Local business owners with the help of our ambassador to Hawaii have staged a coup against the local government and are requesting that we incorporate the islands before others take advantage of the situation.
hawaii_events.4.a: Occupy the islands, but keep them autonomous.
hawaii_events.4.b: If we don't, someone else might.
hawaii_events.4.c: We will not be a part of this coup.
hawaii_events.5.d: The Hawaiian Government has deported our citizens from their islands and seized their property. We must respond to this appropriately.
je_hawaii_reason: Hawaii's position in the Pacific Ocean makes it extremely valuable for Trans Pacific Trade. We must be sure to placate the local businesses and dissuade any potential great power from wanting to take advantage of our islands.
interest_in_hawaii_desc: With the death of the monarch in Hawaii, a power vacuum has been formed and now there is potential for us to exert more control over the islands.
hawaii_interest_tt: Declaring interest in Hawaii may lead to acquiring control of the islands.
influence_hawaii_tt: We have taken the Decision to actively influence Hawaii.
je_hawaiian_interest_tt: We have started a coup against the Hawaiian Government. Now it is just a waiting game.
je_hawaiian_interest_reason: Recent developments in Hawaii have left an opening for the potential to secure the islands and thus bolster our influence in the region. If the Hawaiian Government cannot maintain control, we may be able to step in and secure the islands for ourselves.
invalid_influence_hawaii_tt: Hawaii coup occurs OR Hawaiian Government manages to avoid the coup.
hawaii_coup_happened_tt: The government of [SCOPE.sCountry('hawaii_scope').GetName] has fallen to a coup
hawaii_government_secured_tt: The government of [SCOPE.sCountry('hawaii_scope').GetName] has secured its position
conscription_laws.1.d: Members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rural_folk_conscription').GetName] have approached the government about the implementation of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. They believe that more time is needed before we are ready to implement this law.
conscription_laws.1.a: Push forward on passing the law.
conscription_laws.1.b: Lets take our time with this.
conscription_laws.2.d: Many of our professional soldiers have brought up the concerns that mixing conscripts with regular infantry during war will greatly affect the quality and competence of our troops.
conscription_laws.2.a: We need all the soldiers we can get.
conscription_laws.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('anti_conscription_advocate').GetFullName] the leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anti_conscription_ig').GetName] has given a rousing speech against the dangers of implementing [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] so rapidly.
decree_events.100.d: Our [SCOPE.sBuilding('manufacturing_building_production').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('decree_manufacturing_industry').GetName] is reporting a small production surplus in industrial goods. We should look into investing this back in the state.
decree_events.100.b: We should reinvest in the workers.
decree_events.101.d: The recent investment in [SCOPE.sState('decree_manufacturing_politics').GetName] production at our [SCOPE.sBuilding('manufacturing_building_production_politics').GetName] has raised the question who should get the credit for the boost in production.
decree_events.101.b: This is a victory for the workers.
decree_events.102.d: The encouragement of agricultural development in [SCOPE.sState('decree_agricultural_industry').GetName] has led to a small spike in production at our [SCOPE.sBuilding('agricultural_building_production').GetName]. We should look into using this before it goes to waste.
decree_events.103.d: Recent investments in [SCOPE.sState('decree_agricultural_politics').GetName] towards our  [SCOPE.sBuilding('agricultural_building_production_politics').GetName] has brought into question who should get the credit for the boost in investment. However, opinions seem to be split.
