decree_events.104.d: Raw goods industries in [SCOPE.sState('decree_resource_industry').GetName] are reporting a small spike in goods production at our [SCOPE.sBuilding('resource_building_production').GetName] which has led to an extra stockpile being available in the state, and there is now potential to reinvest it back into this state.
decree_events.105.d: With the recent investment in [SCOPE.sState('decree_resource_politics').GetName], the raw goods industry has resulted in a positive balance for the [SCOPE.sBuilding('resource_building_production_politics').GetName] there. Interest Groups are quick to try to claim credit for this investment.
decree_events.106.d: Favoritism of our regiments in [SCOPE.sState('decree_enlistment_origin').GetName] has led to an animosity from regiments in the neighboring state of [SCOPE.sState('decree_enlistment').GetName]. They are requesting that all regiments should be treated equally.
decree_events.106.b: We should invest more into organizing these troops.
decree_events.107.d: Our extra training has seemed to pay off. Troops in [SCOPE.sState('decree_elite_research').GetName] have put their training to use and learned some new tactics that might help us should we find ourselves at war.
decree_events.108.d: A peaceful march in [SCOPE.sState('decree_violent_supp').GetName] has suddenly turned violent as protesters and police have begun to clash in the streets.
decree_events.109.t: Violent Suppression Leads to Increased Discrimination
decree_events.109.d: Radicals in [SCOPE.sState('decree_increased_violence').GetName] seem to be getting support from discriminated [SCOPE.sCulture('violent_suppression_discriminated').GetName] citizens within the state.
decree_events.109.a: We say where they can and can not protest.
decree_events.109.b: Let them protest where they want.
healthcare_laws.1.d: Farmers in [SCOPE.sState('farming_accidents_state').GetName] have been making appeals to the government about the dangers of the equipment they are using, and would like to have some sort of healthcare to reduce the hardships for them.
healthcare_laws.1.c: This isn't for the poor anyways.
healthcare_laws.2.d: With the calls for some form of healthcare system, many are questioning where the money for setting up the new Healthcare System will come from. Some are suggesting simply taking it out of our tax funds, while others insist the government should find another way to cover the costs.
healthcare_laws.2.a: Take it from the tax funds.
healthcare_laws.2.b: The government should cover the costs.
healthcare_laws.2.c: We can get by without it.
healthcare_laws.3.d: As ironic as it might be, many members of the government seem to have caught a cold today, the day of the debate. Few members have enough strength to make it in for the debate.
healthcare_laws.3.a: We can’t hold a vote today.
healthcare_laws.3.b: Try and force the vote through anyways.
healthcare_laws.4.d: Due to a shortage of public healthcare services, citizens around the nation who can not afford their own medical care have begun demanding more accessible and available healthcare.
healthcare_laws.5.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('anti_public_healthcare_advocate').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anti_public_healthcare_ig').GetName], has brought up in today's debate the concerns of healthcare potentially becoming more accessible, but less available for those that already have it.
healthcare_laws.6.d: It has been brought to the Government's attention that we might not have sufficient bureaucrats available for the establishment of a Public Healthcare System.
republic_laws.1.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName] has missed a cabinet meeting of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] government and their cabinet members were unable to come to any conclusions on how to proceed.
republic_laws.1.a: This is unacceptable behavior for our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
republic_laws.1.b: Maybe he just accidentally slept in.
republic_laws.2.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('monarchist_supporter').GetFullName] of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rulers_fate').GetName] has asked what is to become of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] should the Government become a [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
republic_laws.3.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] delivered a roaring speech in an attempt to forestall the progress of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] becoming a [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
star_swarmed_banner_tt: Note District of Columbia will not be counted as a state. Additionally, West Virginia will not count until after the American Civil War has occurred.
the_western_protectorate_tt: Note this achievement requires treaty ports in the European Strategic Regions.
sickman_syria_egypt: Complete another Tanzimat [concept_journal_entry] by owning the following states: Lower Egypt, Middle Egypt, Upper Egypt, and Sinai.

GAME_STARTDATE_DESC: Smoke rises from the factories, concealing industrial progress under a layer of threatening dimness. With young Queen Victoria preparing for the throne of an ever-changing Britain, European powers face their brightest and darkest of times, empires are but a cough in the long breath of time.\n\nIt is a time of unparalleled exploration, of voracious curiosity, of hesitant greed. Political movements are born and spread, with socialism, liberalism and organized feminism placing the focus on human rights. Meanwhile, explorers all around the world race against time in the desperate pursuit of the last frontier.

dyn_c_ussr_californias: United Socialist Council Republics of California
GBR_FLAVOR_TEXT: Great Britain has roared into the 19th century, rapidly becoming the world's first industrial nation. The massive empire is kept afloat by the labor of colonies across the globe. However, King William IV is close to death and who knows what sort of era the next monarch will usher in.
BEL_FLAVOR_TEXT: In Belgium the industrial revolution is in full swing. The yoke of Dutch oppression was cast aside just six years ago and the country is bounding ahead of their former masters, with the construction of the first railroad in continental Europe. What does the future hold for them?
CHI_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Qing Dynasty has ruled in China for almost two hundred years and controls a third of the world's population, after the apex of its power under the Qianlong Emperor. However, the spread of opium and the interference of the European powers threatens the Dynasty’s period of internal balance. What will the future of China look like?
TIB_FLAVOR_TEXT: The young Dalai Lama is the theocratic leader of Tibet. Will Buddhism remain at the center of political power, or will it be displaced?
FRA_FLAVOR_TEXT: It has been six years since Charles X was tossed from the throne in favor of Louis Phillipe. The constant threats to the crown cause Louis Phillipe to rule with an ever tightening grip. Will France embrace a more liberal future?
RUS_FLAVOR_TEXT: Tsar Nicholas I started his rule by crushing a revolt and now rules Russia in a vise-like grip. He espouses the doctrines of Orthodoxy, Autocracy and Nationality. Will this authoritarian Russia thrive in the 19th century or will a new, different Russia emerge?
PRU_FLAVOR_TEXT: Prussia managed to gain large swathes of territory in the Napoleonic wars and has spent the last few years making startling reforms across the country. Will Prussia continue along this path and perhaps unite Germany?
JAP_FLAVOR_TEXT: The strength of the ruling Tokugawa shogunate is failing, with famine and unrest spreading all across the country. The Edo period has lasted in Japan for over 200 years, will it be able to last for 200 more?
EZO_FLAVOR_TEXT: Ezochi, or the 'Ainu Lands', has long been ruled by the Japanese Matsumae clan on the basis of the contract fishery system. While Japanese settlement north of the Wajinchi is forbidden by law, many fishermen overstay, putting increased pressure on the native population. Will the Ainu persevere, or will they be absorbed by their more powerful southern neighbors?
PER_FLAVOR_TEXT: Persia is still reeling from the loss of several territories to Imperial Russia at the beginning of the century. Will they be able to come back and reclaim its place as a great power?
AUS_FLAVOR_TEXT: Depending on who you ask, the Austrian Empire is in a period of either perfect balance or worrying stagnation. Revolutionary movements are suppressed across the nation, but will this status quo last forever?
USA_FLAVOR_TEXT: The United States of America has asserted the Americas' right to independence from European powers. However, the nation is also in the process of forcibly removing thousands of Native Americans from their homelands, and an intense debate rages between the states on the subject of slavery. What will the future for the United States look like?
TUR_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Ottoman Empire has been embroiled in various wars through the beginning of the 19th century, and while some reforms have been attempted, more will be needed to prevent the decline of this empire.
SPA_FLAVOR_TEXT: Ruling in the name of the young Queen Isabella, Queen Mother and regent Maria Christina has been forced to cede power to Spanish liberals to secure the throne against the Carlist threat. Can this threat be curtailed, or will another Ominous Decade come to pass?
SPC_FLAVOR_TEXT: Disputing the young Queen Isabella's right to the throne, Carlos, the late King Ferdinand's brother, has rallied conservatives across the nation with the intent to march on Madrid. Will this grand expedition succeed, or is Spain to be given over to liberalism?
BRZ_FLAVOR_TEXT: Brazil is in a period of upheaval following the abdication of Emperor Pedro I, which left the country in the rule of regents. Will Brazil manage to overcome these obstacles and emerge as a great power?
MEX_FLAVOR_TEXT: Tension between Mexico and the newly declared Texas Republic has turned into all out war. Will Mexico reconquer Texas and return to the status quo?
NET_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Netherlands lost Belgium to revolution six years ago and while still economically stable, their rate of industrialization is slow compared to some of their neighbors. Will the Netherlands be able to emerge as a powerhouse of the 19th century?
POR_FLAVOR_TEXT: It has been just two years since the end of the Portuguese Civil War and once again Queen Maria II sits the throne. Portuguese colonies stretch across the world. Now that the internal strife has been dealt with, what will the rest of the century bring?
SAR_FLAVOR_TEXT: In Sardinia-Piedmont reactionary anti-French monarchs have led the country for the past thirty years, encouraging the return of the nobility and the church while disbanding the Napoleonic reforms. Will this trend continue? Or will a more liberal nation emerge?
PAN_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Sikh Empire is in a period of conquest, winning engagement after engagement. But what does the future hold for this empire?
DEN_FLAVOR_TEXT: Across Denmark new liberal and national pushes are changing the face of politics. Meanwhile they are also undergoing a golden age of art, literature and philosophy. What will the rest of the century bring?
SWE_FLAVOR_TEXT: After losing Finland and gaining Norway in a personal union, Sweden has begun the slow process of industrialization, while also becoming more liberal in some ways. What does the future of Sweden hold?
CRO_FLAVOR_TEXT: Under a reformist Ban and amicable Austrian administration, Croatia-Slavonia is experiencing a period of national revival and pan-Slavic sentiment. The Illyrian movement is sweeping the country, with academics calling for resistance to Magyarization and linguistic reforms. Will Croatia find a place of its own within the Empire, or will it be drowned beneath the Hungarian yoke?
TRS_FLAVOR_TEXT: Separated from Hungary following Rákóczi's War in 1711, the Principality of Transylvania finds itself at the center of German, Hungarian, and Romanian attention. Can Transylvania maintain its autonomy, or will it be swallowed up by its ambitious neighbors?
HUN_FLAVOR_TEXT: Long subservient to its Austrian masters, the Kingdom of Hungary finds itself at a crossroads, with emerging factions arguing in favor of greater Hungarian independence. Will radical voices triumph, or will Hungary remain yet another jewel in the Austrian crown?
LAN_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Republic of Lanfang was established by a democratic syndicate of Chinese miners hoping to exploit the gold reserves of Borneo. Can Lanfang resist the advances of the Dutch and achieve the prosperity it seeks?
ACE_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Aceh Sultanate is experiencing a resurgence in power due to the efforts of the Raja Muda. Can Aceh restore its empire and assert its independence in the face of Dutch expansion?
BRU_FLAVOR_TEXT: Brunei has so far repelled the attempts of colonial powers to infringe upon its sovereignty. Will Brunei fall into decline and obscurity, or could it once more become a regional power?
JOH_FLAVOR_TEXT: Johor occupies a precarious position as both the British and the Dutch greedily eye their territory. Will Johor manage to retain what little sovereignty it has left?
SIA_FLAVOR_TEXT: Siam has established itself as the dominant regional power in South-East Asia under the Rattanakosin dynasty. But will Siam manage to reform its economy and society for the modern age?
DAI_FLAVOR_TEXT: A newly reunited Vietnam emerges from centuries of division and strife. Will Dai Nam consolidate itself and build a great nation, or is it destined to be divided once more?
BUR_FLAVOR_TEXT: It took many bloody conflicts to establish the Third Burmese Empire, and it seems that the struggle is far from over as the British Empire makes its ambitions known. Will Burma become yet another British colony, or will it stand strong against the foreign invaders?
CAM_FLAVOR_TEXT: Cambodia has fallen far since the golden age of the Khmer Empire. Can the Khmer state rise once more, or will this dark age last forever?
LUA_FLAVOR_TEXT: Once the seat of the mighty Kingdom of Lan Xang, Luang Prabang is a shadow of its former self. Split between the regional powers of Dai Nam and Siam, can the Lao people emerge strong and independent?
PHI_FLAVOR_TEXT: In the far-away archipelago of the Philippines, their Spanish overlords have high expectations that the Governor-General continues to maintain an iron rule over this territory out in the Pacific. But with a growing national consciousness, tensions are on the rise. What will the future for the archipelago look like?
UNT_FLAVOR_TEXT: The United Tribes have declared their sovereign independence, though in truth they are at the mercy of the British Empire. Can the British be trusted to respect their treaties with the Maori?
NSW_FLAVOR_TEXT: In its transition from penal colony to Crown Colony, New South Wales has seen its territory reduced as the other provinces gained their own administrations. What does the future hold for Australia?
SAS_FLAVOR_TEXT: South Australia was granted its own administration only two years ago, separating from New South Wales. What does the future hold for Australia?
WAS_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Swan River colonists impose upon the traditional lands of the aboriginal people, culminating in the Pinjarra massacre only two years ago. How will the colony settle this conflict?
TAS_FLAVOR_TEXT: Van Diemen's Land is the primary penal colony in British Australia. What does the future hold for this colony of convicts?
SER_FLAVOR_TEXT: Serbia has fought hard for its independence, and will surely have to continue its struggle to retain it. Wedged between great powers, will Serbia become the powder keg of Europe?
GRE_FLAVOR_TEXT: Through a bloody struggle, Greece has won its independence from the Ottoman Empire. Can Greece expand its borders?
WAL_FLAVOR_TEXT: Calls for Romanian unification and political independence complicate regional politics, as both Russia and the Ottomans have an interest in enforcing the status quo. Can Romania win its freedom?
MOL_FLAVOR_TEXT: Calls for Romanian unification and political independence complicate regional politics, as both Russia and the Ottomans have an interest in enforcing the status quo. Can Romania win its freedom?
ION_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Islands have passed from Ottoman to Russian, French and finally British control within the past 30 years. Can the Islanders achieve Enosis with the new Greek state or will they seek a new path forward under British guidance?
MON_FLAVOR_TEXT: Once little more than a loose collection of tribes resisting Ottoman taxation, Montenegro has achieved its independence at the Congress of Vienna. The tribes currently depend upon raiding the Ottoman Empire to sustain themselves, but the reformist Petar II seeks to transform them into a modern state. Will Montenegro successfully reinvent itself?
PAP_FLAVOR_TEXT: Though the political power of the Catholic Church has waned over the centuries, the Pope still presides over the Papal States. Does faith still rule the hearts of men?
TUS_FLAVOR_TEXT: The unpopular Duke Leopoldo seeks to liberalize the Grand Duchy, but faces great opposition to his rule. How will Tuscany fare as liberalism and nationalism compete over the hearts and minds of Italians?
SIC_FLAVOR_TEXT: Political repression of both liberals and Sicilian separatists is proving ineffective, with both movements moving underground and gaining supporters. What will the Two Sicilies look like after the situation inevitably comes to a head?
PAR_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Congress of Vienna confirmed the Rule of Napoleon's second wife Marie Louise over the Duchy until her death. In this time of nationalism and upheaval, will she be able to hold on to her lands?
LUC_FLAVOR_TEXT: Torn from their rightful Parman lands, the house of Bourbon-Parma was granted Lucca until they could reclaim their rightful throne within Parma upon the death of Marie Louise. With Italian nationalism on the rise, how long can this aberration survive?
MOD_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Duchy of Modena is both ruled by, and politically subservient to, the Hapsburgs and the Austrian Empire. Will Modena shake off these chains of family loyalty, or do the ties that bind restrict too much?
BAV_FLAVOR_TEXT: In the wake of recent revolutions across Europe, Bavaria has turned to reaction. But the embers of rebellion still burn; will Bavaria be consumed by the flames?
SWI_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Congress of Vienna has recognized Switzerland as a neutral power, affording some degree of safety in the theatre of European politics. Will Switzerland preserve its neutrality, or strike a different path?
HAN_FLAVOR_TEXT: Though Hanover is currently ruled by the British monarch, differences in inheritance laws mean that the end of the union is likely approaching. What new path will Hanover walk?
GERMAN_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Congress of Vienna established the German Confederation, a loose assortment of German states intended to keep the peace in Central Europe. The Confederation in practice is dominated by the rivalry between Austria and Prussia. Can the smaller nations survive the coming conflict?
KRA_FLAVOR_TEXT: The legacy of the Polish people rests heavily on the shoulders of the Free State of Krakow, distrusted by its constituting powers and occupied by Austria. Can a new Polish state rise from the ashes once again?
QUE_FLAVOR_TEXT: Once the colony of New France, Lower Canada has fallen under British rule. Tensions between the predominantly French population and the colonial government threaten to escalate in the near future, with little chance of peaceful resolution. Will Quebec win its freedom?
ONT_FLAVOR_TEXT: Emboldened by rising tensions in Lower Canada, the people of Upper Canada prepare to resist the colonial government. Will Ontario win its freedom?
HBC_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Hudson’s Bay Company is prepared to protect its monopoly on the fur trade by any means necessary. Agreements are made and broken with the First Nations as the Company sees fit, with little regard to any motive but profit. Will ruthlessness be enough to safeguard the Company?
NBS_FLAVOR_TEXT: The colony of New Brunswick is establishing a thriving shipbuilding industry, with colonists arriving from Scotland and Ireland to work with timber. Will New Brunswick lead a united Canada?
ORG_FLAVOR_TEXT: Currently under relatively autonomous administration, both the Hudson’s Bay Company and the US government have set their eyes on the disputed Columbia district. Will either power succeed, or will an independent Oregon emerge?
TEX_FLAVOR_TEXT: The newly declared Republic of Texas fights a seemingly impossible war against its Mexican overlords. Will a miracle save the Lone Star State?
HAI_FLAVOR_TEXT: Under Jean-Pierre Boyer, Haiti has come to rule over all of Hispaniola. Can this nation of former slaves achieve liberty, or is Haiti doomed to despotism?
CUB_FLAVOR_TEXT: Cuban relations with their Spanish overlords have become strained. Calls for representation in the Spanish parliament and resistance to the abolition of slavery have met with hostility from Madrid. Is a Cuban revolution inevitable?
PCO_FLAVOR_TEXT: Tensions between Puerto Rico and their Spanish overlords have been on the rise. While democratic institutions in the colony have been removed, power granted to appointed Governor-Generals have been maintained. Will Puerto Rico make progress towards greater autonomy?
KHI_FLAVOR_TEXT: In defiance of both Persia and Russia, Khiva is an independent power flourishing under the rule of the Khan. Can Khiva protect its independence?
BUK_FLAVOR_TEXT: Unlike the neighboring Khanates, the Emirs of Bukhara embrace Islamic rule rather than basing their legitimacy on descent from Genghis Khan. Will faith win the day?
KOK_FLAVOR_TEXT: Kokand struggles with disunity and discord within the Khan's court. Can Kokand become a dominant power in Central Asia?
KAB_FLAVOR_TEXT: The fall of the Durrani Empire has left its realm in a state of perpetual civil war between claimants to the throne. Can the ambitious Emir Dost Mohammad reunify Afghanistan, and cement the Barakzai Dynasty as its rulers?
HER_FLAVOR_TEXT: The civil war in Afghanistan has left the Emirate of Herat as the last bastion of Durrani rule. Can the heirs to the dynasty resist Persian incursions, and reunify Afghanistan under their restored Empire?
KAN_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Principality of Kandahar declared independence from Afghanistan in 1818, but soon fell into infighting between its confederal rulers. Can the reigning Dil brothers settle their differences, and eclipse the Emir of Kabul?
AFGHAN_MINOR_FLAVOR_TEXT: The fall of the Durrani Empire has left its realm in a state of perpetual civil war between claimants to the throne. Can the Khanates of the North assert their independence amidst the warring Afghan princes, and carve out empires of their own?
CHT_FLAVOR_TEXT: The fall of the Durrani Empire has left its realm in a state of perpetual civil war between claimants to the throne. Can the Chitrali state defend itself from both the Sikh Empire, resurgent Afghan states and British expansion into the Hindu Kush?
KAF_FLAVOR_TEXT: Surrounded by increasingly bellicose Islamic states, the so-called 'infidels' of the Hindu Kush are facing an uncertain future. Can the realm of Kafiristan maintain its ways, or will it be resigned to the footnotes of history?
MAK_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Khanate of Kalat has carved out a sphere of influence of its own in the wake of the collapse of the Durrani Empire. Will the tribes of Makran be able to preserve their territory in the face of threats from Persia and the Afghan princes?
KAL_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Khanate of Kalat has carved out a sphere of influence of its own in the wake of the collapse of the Durrani Empire. Can it maintain its long-sought-after sovereignty, and grow its empire to rival its neighbors?
ZHUZ_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Russian expansion into the Kazakh steppe has taken a new character, with the Russian Tsar recently issuing dictates abolishing the position and powers of the Khans. Will the Kazakh zhuzes break free, or will they slip further under Russian domination?
ARB_FLAVOR_TEXT: The rule of Sheikh Jaber al-Kaabi has led the sheikhdom of Muhammarah to a period of de facto sovereignty. Will Muhammarah maintain its privileged status, and grow into a power center of its own?
TRI_FLAVOR_TEXT: Following a long period of de facto independence, Tripolitania has once again fallen under Ottoman rule. Will the Barbary Pirates sail again?
TUN_FLAVOR_TEXT: After being forced to end its sponsorship of piratical raids, the Tunisian economy has taken a turn for the worse. Can the Bey restore prosperity?
ALD_FLAVOR_TEXT: Algeria lost much of its coastline to the French in the aftermath of the Barbary Wars. Can the remnants of this nation fend off further French incursions?
MOR_FLAVOR_TEXT: No longer under Ottoman protection, Morocco is vulnerable to French and Spanish expansionism. Can Morocco survive the imperialist onslaught?
CON_FLAVOR_TEXT: When the Algerian Deylik fell to the French in 1830, its Eastern province persevered in the capable hands of Ahmed Bey. Intent on restoring and modernizing the old Deylik, he will have to contend with both the French invaders and rivaling Algerian factions.
AIT_FLAVOR_TEXT: For centuries, the Berber kingdom of Ait Abbas has ruled in Kabylia, but shifting balances of power and infighting within the ruling Mokrani family has seen the state reduced to a mere tributary. Can Ait Abbas turn its fortunes around?
MAS_FLAVOR_TEXT: Unexpectedly thrust into power during the French invasion, the Islamic scholar Abdelkader finds himself at the helm of a resistance campaign turned nascent state. Can Mascara drive out the invaders, or will it succumb to French might?
TUG_FLAVOR_TEXT: After a bloody family feud resulted in the death of the previous Sultan, his capable, but ruthless wife seized power in the name of their child son. Can the desert realm of Touggourt secure a place for itself in the 19th century?
SOK_FLAVOR_TEXT: Under the banner of the Fulani Jihad, the Sokoto Caliphate is expanding rapidly. Can Sokoto unite West Africa and resist the Western powers?
GREAT_LAKES_FLAVOR_TEXT: The people of the Great Lakes have established fledgling empires, dominating both water and land. Will a great nation arise from among them?
TGR_FLAVOR_TEXT: Ethiopia is in the midst of the Age of Princes. The Emperor in Gondar has no effective power and local rulers divide the country between themselves. Will the empire ever be reunited?
SAF_FLAVOR_TEXT: Originally a Dutch trading post, the Cape Colony has recently become a British Crown Colony with most of its former autonomy curtailed. Now, tensions are rising between the British crown and the Boer states to the north, while in the east, the power of the Zulu Empire is growing. How will the Cape Colony weather the struggles ahead?
BIC_FLAVOR_TEXT: India is the jewel in the crown of the British Empire. Can the East India Company maintain rule over this vast landscape while appeasing its shareholders?
JAS_FLAVOR_TEXT: Almost all of India is now under the direct or indirect control of the British East India Company. The Nawabs of the princely states still exert a strong degree of rule over their territories, but ultimately answer to the Company. Will India ever be free from British rule?
BCE_FLAVOR_TEXT: Following the conclusion of the Kandyan Wars, Ceylon's fertile uplands have witnessed the rise of numerous plantations, fueled in part by the importation of Tamil laborers from the mainland. Can Ceylon sustain this momentum, or will it fall to internal strife?
MLD_FLAVOR_TEXT: Existing in relative isolation, the Maldives has thrived under British protection, shielded from the pirates that once threatened its shores. Will change ever come to this small island nation?
EGY_FLAVOR_TEXT: Under Muhammad Ali, Egypt has become independent from the Ottoman Empire in all but the most technical respect. Recent gains in Syria however are sure to incite a response from the Sublime Porte. Can Egypt survive the coming storm?
HDJ_FLAVOR_TEXT: As the Ottoman Empire declines, the future of Arabia becomes ever more uncertain. Will a new power emerge from the desert?
OMA_FLAVOR_TEXT: Ruling over both Oman and Zanzibar, the Sultanate is establishing an intercontinental empire. Can Oman remain united?
KOR_FLAVOR_TEXT: Korea under the Joseon dynasty looks inward, consumed by its factional politics. Will changing times force Korea to consider the outside world?
NOR_FLAVOR_TEXT: Norway has spent centuries under Danish and Swedish rule, but now dreams of sovereignty. What will it take for Norway to win its independence?
FIN_FLAVOR_TEXT: Finland has thus far enjoyed relative autonomy under the Russian Empire. But the whims of the Tsars are fickle; how will Russian rule shape Finland?
RYU_FLAVOR_TEXT: Ryukyu holds a highly strategic position in East Asia, existing in a state of dual subordination between the Qing Dynasty and the Japanese Shogunate. Will external pressure compel Ryukyu to play its hand?
UCA_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Federal Republic consists of provinces which would largely prefer to be independent. Can Central America hold together?
CLM_FLAVOR_TEXT: With the dissolution of Gran Colombia in 1830, New Granada stands alone and divided between its liberal and conservative factions. Will Colombia achieve greatness once more?
VNZ_FLAVOR_TEXT: Now independent from both Spain and Gran Colombia, Venezuela must carve out its own destiny. Can a stable government be formed, or is Venezuela doomed to be ruled by a succession of caudillos?
ECU_FLAVOR_TEXT: Conflict brews in South America, and Ecuador is embroiled in it. Can Ecuador avoid being assimilated by its more powerful neighbors?
NPU_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Peruvian civil war has left Peru split into two states of the nascent Peru-Bolivian Confederation. Will Peru continue to seek unification with Bolivia, or will it take its own course as an independent nation?
SPU_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Peruvian civil war has left Peru split into two states of the nascent Peru-Bolivian Confederation. Will Peru continue to seek unification with Bolivia, or will it take its own course as an independent nation?
IQU_FLAVOR_TEXT: The autonomous state of Iquichia has been caught in the maelstrom of the Peruvian civil war, and stood on the side of Santa Cruz. Can it maintain its independence in this new Confederation?
BOL_FLAVOR_TEXT: Bolivia has secured its domination over Peru amidst a Peruvian civil war, and now seeks to establish a Confederation between the nations. Will such a union stand the trials ahead?
ARG_FLAVOR_TEXT: Argentina has won its independence from Spain, but now faces internal divisions. Can Argentina form a stable government?
CHL_FLAVOR_TEXT: Chile is embarking on a process of political centralization, concentrating power into the hands of the government and the Church. What does the future hold for Chile?
PNI_FLAVOR_TEXT: The newly created state of Piratini, boldly declares its independence against Brazil, but how long can the fledgling nation last?
GENERIC_FLAVOR_TEXT: The Victorian era is an age of industry and exploitation, of revolution and reaction. What new challenges will the times bring?
REV_GENERIC_FLAVOR_TEXT: Dissatisfied with the direction that the so-called organized government was taking, these revolutionaries have decided to take up arms to overthrow it. Will they succeed in seizing power or will they be crushed like so many forgotten revolutions of the past?
DECENTRALIZED_FLAVOR_TEXT: Encroached upon by more organized powers, this country struggles to maintain their autonomy. Will they see the dawn of a new century, or will their name survive only in history books?
GLI_FLAVOR_TEXT: Galicia is a small and unremarkable country populated by cathedral enthusiasts. Will Galicia regain its past glory?

TREATY_ARTICLE_FLAG_IS_MONOPOLY_FOR_COMP: • [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName] has granted the [concept_company_monopoly] on [Article.GetBuildingType.GetName] in [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName] to the [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetAdjective] [concept_company] [Article.GetCompany.GetName]
enforce_embargo_effects_desc: • Establishes an agreement between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] that forces one $concept_country$ to not trade a specific [concept_good] with another $concept_country$
enforce_embargo_article_short_desc: [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetNameNoFormatting] will #bold_black not#! trade a $concept_good$ with a third $concept_country$
TREATY_DRAFT_ARTICLE_FLAG_IS_ENFORCE_EMB: • [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName] will #b not#! trade any [AddTextIf(ArticleDraft.GetGoods.IsValid, ArticleDraft.GetGoods.GetTextIcon)] [AddTextIf(ArticleDraft.GetGoods.IsValid, ArticleDraft.GetGoods.GetName)][AddLocalizationIf(Not(ArticleDraft.GetGoods.IsValid), 'concept_goods')] with [ArticleDraft.GetCountry.GetName]
TREATY_ARTICLE_FLAG_IS_ENFORCE_EMBARGO_E: • [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName] will #b not#! trade any [AddTextIf(Article.GetGoods.IsValid, Article.GetGoods.GetTextIcon)] [AddTextIf(Article.GetGoods.IsValid, Article.GetGoods.GetName)][AddLocalizationIf(Not(Article.GetGoods.IsValid), 'concept_goods')] with [Article.GetCountry.GetName]
law_commitment_effects_desc: • Establishes an agreement between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] where one $concept_country$ commits to passing or retaining a specific [concept_law].
no_tariffs_effects_desc: • Establishes an agreement between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] where one $concept_country$ agrees to not impose [concept_tariffs] on a specific [concept_good].
transit_rights_effects_desc: • Establishes an agreement between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] where one $concept_country$ is granted the right to handle its [concept_trade] through the [Concept('concept_world_market_hub', '$concept_world_market_hubs$')] of the other $concept_country$.
no_subventions_effects_desc: • Establishes an agreement where one [concept_country] agrees to not grant [concept_subventions] on a specific [concept_good].
trade_privilege_effects_desc: • Establishes [Concept('concept_trade_privilege','$concept_trade_privileges$')] between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] where one $concept_country$ grants favorable conditions to the traders of the other $concept_country$.
foreign_investment_rights_effects_desc: • Establishes unilateral [concept_foreign_investment_rights] in a [concept_country] allowing it to construct [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')] in the other $concept_country$.
strait_access_effects_desc: • Establishes an agreement between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] where one $concept_country$ is granted full access through straits controlled by the other $concept_country$
strait_access_article_short_desc: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetNameNoFormatting] is granted access through $concept_straits$ controlled by [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetNameNoFormatting]
TREATY_DRAFT_ARTICLE_FLAG_IS_STRAIT_ACCE: • [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] is granted access through $concept_straits$ controlled by [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName]
TREATY_ARTICLE_FLAG_IS_STRAIT_ACCESS_EFF: • [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] is granted access through [Concept('concept_strait', '$concept_straits$')] controlled by [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName]
no_strait_closure_effects_desc: • Establishes an agreement between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] where one $concept_country$ agrees to not restrict access to any [Concept('concept_strait', '$concept_straits$')] it controls.
no_strait_closure_article_short_desc: [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetNameNoFormatting] will #bold_black not#! restrict access to $concept_straits$ it controls
TREATY_DRAFT_ARTICLE_FLAG_IS_NO_STRAIT_C: • [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName] will #bold_black not#! restrict access to [Concept('concept_strait', '$concept_straits$')] it controls
TREATY_ARTICLE_FLAG_IS_NO_STRAIT_CLOSURE: • [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName] will #bold_black not#! restrict access to [Concept('concept_strait', '$concept_straits$')] it controls
toll_exemption_effects_desc: • Exempts a [concept_country] from paying [concept_tolls] to the other $concept_country$.
no_tolls_effects_desc: • Establishes an agreement between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] where one $concept_country$ agrees to not impose [concept_tolls] on any [Concept('concept_strait', '$concept_straits$')] it controls.
no_tolls_article_short_desc: [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetNameNoFormatting] will #bold_black not#! impose $concept_tolls$ on any $concept_straits$ it controls
alliance_effects_desc: • Establishes an [concept_alliance] between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')]\n• Both [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] may march their [Concept('concept_army', '$concept_armies$')] through the territory of their [concept_ally]
guarantee_independence_effects_desc: • An agreement established by one [concept_country] targeting another, where the second $concept_country$ is able to call the first to aid it in any [concept_diplomatic_play] where they are the defender.
support_independence_effects_desc: • An agreement established by one [concept_country] targeting another, where the first $concept_country$ commits to supporting a [concept_subject] in a [concept_diplomatic_demand] for independence from its [concept_overlord].
join_power_bloc_effects_desc: • An agreement where one [concept_country] officially joins another [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_power_bloc]
host_power_bloc_embassy_effects_desc: • Formally establishes a $host_power_bloc_embassy$ in a another [concept_country]
take_on_debt_effects_desc: • Establishes a deal where one [concept_country] takes over the other $concept_country_possessive$ [concept_loans]
military_assistance_effects_desc: • A military agreement between two [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] where one $concept_country$ grants [concept_military_assistance] to another [concept_country], aiding them with enhanced training and military expertise
non_piracy_agreement_effects_desc: • An agreement where one $concept_country$ stops engaging in [concept_piracy] against the other [concept_country]
recognize_independence_effects_desc: • An agreement where #b $SPA$#! will formally recognize the independence of her formal colony
recognize_independence_article_short_des: [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetNameNoFormatting] will formally recognize the independence of [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetNameNoFormatting]
TREATY_DRAFT_ARTICLE_FLAG_IS_RECOGNIZE_I: • [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName] will formally recognize the independence of [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName]
TREATY_ARTICLE_FLAG_IS_RECOGNIZE_INDEPEN: • [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName] has formally recognized the independence to [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName]
TREATY_PROPOSAL_ALREADY_ENTERED_INTO_FOR: Cannot propose [TREATY.GetName]: already entered in force
TREATY_PROPOSAL_COUNTRY_NOT_BOUND_BY_TRE: Cannot propose [TREATY.GetName]: [COUNTRY.GetName] would not be [Concept('concept_binding_period', '$concept_binding_period_bound$')] by the proposed [TREATY.GetName] [concept_treaty]

ARTICLE_TYPE_INVOLVEMENT_EFFECT_TARGET: • Increases the [concept_involvement] of the source [concept_country] by a maximum of $AMOUNT|v0$ in all [Concept('concept_strategic_region', '$concept_strategic_regions$')] where the target $concept_country$ is [Concept('concept_local_country', '$concept_local_country_short$')]
ARTICLE_TYPE_INVOLVEMENT_EFFECT_MUTUAL: • Increases the [concept_involvement] of both [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] by a maximum of $AMOUNT|v0$ in all [Concept('concept_strategic_region', '$concept_strategic_regions$')] where the other $concept_country$ is [Concept('concept_local_country', '$concept_local_country_short$')]
ARTICLE_INVOLVEMENT_EFFECT: • Increases the [concept_involvement] of [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] by a maximum of $AMOUNT|v0$ in all [Concept('concept_strategic_region', '$concept_strategic_regions$')] where [SOURCE_COUNTRY.GetName] is [Concept('concept_local_country', '$concept_local_country_short$')]

WAR_NO_NEGOTIATED_PEACE: A negotiated [concept_peace_deal] is not possible for a $TYPE|v$ [concept_diplomatic_play].
WAR_PEACE_BOTH_SIDES_CLAIM_STATE: [concept_peace_deal] is invalid due to both sides claiming [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] in [STATE.GetStateRegion.GetName]
WAR_PEACE_INVALID_WARGOAL: [concept_peace_deal] is invalid due to [WAR_GOAL.GetName|v] being invalid
WAR_PEACE_WARGOAL_NO_EFFECT: [WAR_GOAL.GetName|v] would have no effect if enforced with the rest of this [concept_peace_deal]
WAR_PEACE_ALREADY_ACTIVE_PEACE_DEAL: There is already an active [concept_peace_deal] being proposed
WAR_PEACE_ALREADY_WHITE_PEACE: Our proposed [concept_peace_deal] is already White Peace
WAR_PEACE_PROPOSAL_COOLDOWN: We must wait until #v $DATE$#! to propose another [concept_peace_deal]
WAR_PEACE_MUST_PRESS_INDEPENDENCE: $COUNTRY_NAME$ #bold does not agree#! to a [concept_peace_deal] that prevents its independence.
WAR_PEACE_ANNEXED_COUNTRY_CANT_PRESS_WAR: [Country.GetName()] can not press any [Concept('concept_war_goal', '$concept_war_goals$')]. They will be fully annexed by this [concept_peace_deal].
WAR_PEACE_MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_TREATY_ARTI: Peace deal cannot contain mutually exclusive [TREATY_ARTICLE_TYPE.GetName] [Concept('concept_war_goal', '$concept_war_goals$')].
dp_war_reparations_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to pay [concept_war_reparations].
dp_default_treaty_article_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to enforce a money payment [concept_treaty] on the targeted [concept_country].
dp_open_market_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to change their [GetLawGroup('lawgroup_trade_policy').GetName] [concept_law] to [GetLawType('law_free_trade').GetName] and [Concept('concept_open_market', '$concept_open_market_short$')] up their market to foreign trade.
dp_ban_slavery_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to abolish slavery by changing their [GetLawGroup('lawgroup_slavery').GetName] [concept_law] to [GetLawType('law_slavery_banned').GetName].
dp_conquer_state_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to cede a specific [concept_state] for you to take control of.
dp_return_state_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to return the specified [concept_state] to you.
dp_independence_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to grant you independence.
dp_leave_power_bloc_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to leave the [concept_power_bloc] led by the targeted [concept_country].
dp_liberate_subject_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to grant independence to one of their [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')].
dp_liberate_country_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to grant independence to a [concept_country] whose homeland [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] they own.
dp_release_as_subject_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to release a [concept_country] whose homeland [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] they own, as a [concept_subject] of ours.
dp_take_treaty_port_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to cede a [concept_treaty_port] in the targeted [concept_state_region].
dp_force_recognition_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to remove the [Concept('concept_unrecognized_power','$concept_unrecognized_power_short$')] status of you.
dp_contain_threat_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to release all [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] and [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] they have gained through conquest in the last #v [GetDefine('NDiplomacy', 'WAR_GOAL_CONTAIN_THREAT_YEARS_SINCE_CONQUEST')]#! years. Additionally, any $concept_war_goals$ held by them in other active [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] and [Concept('concept_war','$concept_wars$')] will be removed.
dp_transfer_subject_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to transfer their control of the targeted [concept_subject] to you.
dp_make_protectorate_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to become your [concept_protectorate].
dp_make_dominion_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to become your [concept_dominion].
dp_reduce_autonomy_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to reduce the [concept_autonomy] of the targeted [concept_subject].
dp_increase_autonomy_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to change your [concept_subject] type into one with more [concept_autonomy].
dp_make_tributary_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to become your [concept_tributary].
dp_annex_subject_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to completely annex the targeted [concept_country].
dp_revolution_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to put down the targeted [concept_revolution].
dp_secession_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to crush the targeted [concept_secession] and force them to return all [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] they have seceded from us.
dp_unify_germany_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to annex all German homeland states held by other nations.
dp_unify_italy_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to annex all Italian homeland states held by other nations.
dp_unify_scandinavia_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to annex all Scandinavian homeland states held by other nations.
dp_unify_ethiopia_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to annex all lesser Ethiopian countries.
dp_unify_china_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to annex all lesser Chinese countries.
dp_unify_arabia_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to annex all lesser Arabian countries.
dp_unify_india_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to annex all lesser Indian countries.
dp_unify_indonesia_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to annex all lesser Indonesian countries.
dp_unify_andes_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to annex all lesser Andean countries.
FND_tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetName] can form the Federation of the Andes
dp_unify_yugoslavia_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to annex all lesser Yugoslavian countries.
dp_southern_secession_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to crush the Southern [concept_secession] and force them to return all [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] they have seceded from us.
dp_humiliation_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to reduce the targeted [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_country_possessive$')] prestige and prevents them from opposing you in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] for #v 5#! years.
dp_leadership_germany_tooltip_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to kick out the targeted [concept_country] as a [concept_unification_candidate] of the German [Concept('concept_unification', '$concept_major_unification$')].
dp_leadership_italy_tooltip_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to kick out the targeted [concept_country] as a [concept_unification_candidate] of the Italian [Concept('concept_unification', '$concept_major_unification$')].
dp_leadership_scandinavia_tooltip_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to kick out the targeted [concept_country] as a [concept_unification_candidate] of the Scandinavian [Concept('concept_unification', '$concept_major_unification$')].
dp_leadership_andes_tooltip_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to kick out the targeted [concept_country] as a [concept_unification_candidate] of the Andean [Concept('concept_unification', '$concept_major_unification$')].
dp_force_nationalization_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to give up all property ownership in your state
dp_join_power_bloc_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to join our [concept_power_bloc]
dp_join_power_bloc_must_have_declined_in: They must have recently declined an invitation to join our [concept_power_bloc]
dp_give_foreign_investment_rights_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to give you [concept_foreign_investment_rights]. If they have the [GetLawType('law_isolationism').GetName] [concept_law] they must instead enact [GetLawType('law_free_trade').GetName].
dp_demand_strait_access_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to grant you military access through any [concept_strait] they control.
dp_demand_strait_access_already_has_acce: Must #b not#! already have access through the targeted [concept_country]'s [concept_strait]
dp_demand_toll_exemption_already_exempt_: Must #b not#! already be exempt from the targeted [concept_country]'s [concept_strait] [concept_tolls]
dp_demand_no_tolls_already_bound_tt: The targeted [concept_country] must still be allowed to charge [concept_tolls] on the [concept_strait] they control
dp_demand_no_strait_closure_already_boun: The targeted [concept_country] must still be allowed to close the [concept_strait] they control
dp_demand_toll_exemption_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to exempt you from the [concept_tolls] they charge on any [concept_strait] they control.
dp_demand_no_tolls_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to stop charging [concept_tolls] on any [concept_strait] they control.
dp_demand_no_strait_closure_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to keep any [concept_strait] they control open.
dp_sepoy_mutiny_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to completely annex the targeted [concept_country].
dp_restore_union_desc: Sets the initiating [concept_war_goal] to force the targeted [concept_country] to restore the [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetHolder.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [concept_ruler] to their throne.
war_goal_conquer_state_desc_partial: [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetHolder.GetName] conquers the part of the [concept_state] of [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetTargetState.GetName] that [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetTarget.GetName] took from them
war_goal_conquer_state_sway_desc: Try to convince [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetHolder.GetName] to join your side by forcing [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetWarGoalStakeholder.GetName] to cede them [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetTargetState.GetName].
war_goal_return_state_type_desc: Force them to Return a [concept_state] that is our rightful Claim.
war_goal_return_state_desc_partial: [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetTarget.GetName] returns the part of the [concept_state] of [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetTargetState.GetName] that they took from [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetHolder.GetName]
war_goal_return_state_sway_desc: Try to convince [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetHolder.GetName] to join your side by forcing [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetWarGoalStakeholder.GetName] to return them [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetTargetState.GetName].

dlc003_desc: The age of industrialization is the age of transformation, when millions of pastoral workers relocated to factories. This 14-track, nearly hour long collection of original music is a concert honoring the daily struggles and ambitions of the common people, inspired by the romantic yearnings for those simpler days of working on the land.
dlc004_desc: The people march with bouquets in one hand and blazing torches in the other with the Voice of the People immersion pack. As the gears of progress turn onward, new champions emerge to spearhead fresh modes of thought. And while these forces clash around the globe, France finds itself wracked with tumult from changing dynasties, claims on North Africa and on mainland Europe, and an affair that has become a battle for the nation’s soul. Allons-y!
dlc007_desc: From the glory of the sunrise to the glow of the gas lamp, this Art Pack takes the theme of light and shadow to add new life to the visual experience. A day-night cycle marks the time you spend in game, and other images shine with new life as the dawn of a new age is reflected in the art itself.
dlc008_desc: A new dawn rises over South America, and with this Region Pack comes the winds of change. In Brazil, a boy of age is put upon the throne abandoned by his father. Amidst the schemes of a new aristocracy finding its footing in coffee and milk, a church of science rises, and cangaceiros tear through the countryside. And in the ashes of Bolivar's ambitions, Paraguay ends its splendid isolation to take its place on the world's stage. A time of strife and hope will put Brazil to the anvil: what it becomes is up to you.
dlc010_desc: From the forests of the Caucasus to the mountains of Korea, the great empires of the Victorian age struggle against one another for diplomatic supremacy. Diplomats and common citizens alike lobby governments to project power outside of their borders, and strive to prevent their opponents from doing the same. Great Powers stand at the heads of mighty power blocs, using their subordinates to advance their interests. Influence, invest, and subjugate your way into expanding your own Sphere of Influence—for in the great game of international politics, there are only players and pawns.
dlc011_desc: The slow advance of the East India Company has brought the Indian subcontinent under its dominion, reducing the rule of the Mughal and Maratha emperors to their palace grounds. In this new, colonial India, the forces of British bureaucratic despotism clash with threats both internal and external - discontent soldiers, rising Indian nationalism, and the upstart Sikh Empire. Struggle against colonial domination at the side of a multitude of Indian freedom fighters, or stand with the British administration's efforts to maintain power over this Pivot of Empire—lest its sun finally set.
dlc012_desc: Watch the benefits of trade roll into port with the Trade Ships Bonus Pack, an art pack immediately available for free to everyone who buys the Victoria 3: Expansion Pass. This pack includes three new ship designs for the on-map representation of commercial vessels crossing the trade lanes of the globe.
dlc013_desc: The chatter of ticker-tape machines and the whistling of steamships mark the age of the global market. Companies and countries alike vie for prestige and market share on the world stage, with monopolies, warships, and unequal treaties as their weapons of choice. Secure a cultural edge with unique prestige goods, grant special charters to companies, and manipulate foreign nations with special diplomatic options. Buy, sell, and leverage your way to supremacy—for on the world market, there is no good will, only good business.
dlc014_desc: The Age of Progress has come to the Balkan region, and with it, its peoples' National Awakenings. In the sprawling Austrian Empire, the post-Napoleonic order of Metternich meets the challenges of modernity. Nationalists call for an independent Hungary, whilst ethnic federalists and neo-absolutists alike seek to realize their vision for a reformed Empire. The young nations of the Balkan region aspire to independence and greatness, seeking to forge peasants into citizens and claim their homelands from the ailing Ottomans. From the Danube to the Black Sea, two visions collide - will the people of the Balkans be subjects of an empire, or citizens of a nation?
dlc015_desc: The Victorian century is the age of emerging national identity. Academics swept up by the spirit of the age transformed peasant ballads into symphonies, which become striking symbols of their young nations. This collection of original music, recorded by a live symphony and chamber orchestra and inspired by the romantic spirit of the age, captures the pride of nations finding a new place in the world.
dlc016_desc: Long gone is the golden age of Iberia. Still reeling from the loss of their colonies on the American mainland in the wake of the Napoleonic Wars, the old colonial giants of Spain and Portugal seek new paths to greatness as the forces of reform and reaction tirelessly war over the soul of the nation. And in the colonial periphery, subjects are roused as new ideas and innovations are disseminated among them.
dlc018_desc: A new era is heralded by the churning of engines and plumes of steam on the horizon. Wield the industries of the Victorian Era to design swift frigates and powerful dreadnoughts, and place your flagship at their head to realize prestigious victories. Cast your fleet across the sea like a Great Wave, and use it to project power with decisive naval diplomatic actions. Use gunboat diplomacy to dominate as a colonial power; or, as Japan, turn the Westerners' methods against them to construct an Empire of your own.

japan_events.1.d: As modernist thinkers gain influence within the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], the limitations of the old courier system have become increasingly apparent. Whether through the dismantling of the feudal order or the spread of literacy among the population, the conditions now exist for a centralized postal service capable of supporting a modern state.
japan_events.1.f: Messengers, marked with the government seal, ran through the streets with their pouches, carrying an unusual amount of letters. In the capital, officials bent over maps, adjusting routes and counting stamps throughout the night. Merchants grumbled at the disruption of old courier networks, while curious children pressed their first letters into the new post boxes. The country, once divided by custom, was beginning to speak with one voice.
japan_events.2.d: Japan's centuries-old lunisolar calendar is increasingly out of sync with the Western world. Merchants have complained of difficulties in coordinating with foreign partners, whilst the populace has reported confusion over misaligned festivals, rents, and tax deadlines.
japan_events.2.f: Clerks sat bent over their books, copying each line carefully. Their stacks of paper grew taller with every repetition, and their eyes ached from tracking months that no longer existed. The old calendar was quietly slipping away.
japan_events.2.f_telegraph: Couriers hurried through the streets, delivering message after message. People paused to read each notice, their heads spinning as dates shifted faster than they could follow. News travelled instantly, and the old calendar vanished almost overnight.
japan_events.2.c: Preserve the old system for now.
japan_events.3.d: The adoption of the new calendar has quietly shortened the year. With fewer counted days, wages, rents, and taxes no longer align with expectations formed under the old system. Workers discover their pay diminished, and officials struggle to explain the discrepancy.
japan_events.3.f: Workers counted their coins again and again, shaking their heads in disapproval. Their hands had been roughened by labor, yet they saw little reward. The year had grown shorter, and each lost day had left its mark in tired arms and empty pockets.
japan_events.3.a: The year is shorter. So be it.
japan_events.3.b: Redistribute the burden across the population.
japan_events.3.c: Absorb the loss for the sake of stability.
japan_events.4.d: As the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] conducts diplomacy and trade with foreign powers, questions have arisen over how [GetCulture('japanese').GetName] names should be rendered in treaties, correspondence, and official documents. Western representatives increasingly expect names to follow their own conventions, placing the given name before the family name.
japan_events.4.f: Clerks leaned over their desks, pens scratching across letters for foreign officials. They whispered among themselves, debating whether clarity abroad justified a change to long-held tradition. A hand holding a seal paused over a paper, lingering for a moment before the ink was set.
japan_events.4.a: Adopt Western conventions in foreign correspondence.
japan_events.4.b: Maintain the traditional order of names.
japan_events.4.c: This is a new era—adopt the Western convention for all cases.
japan_events.5.d: Decrees, regulations, and records have long relied on classical language understood only by the educated few. Reformers have argued that administration conducted in Vernacular Japanese would improve clarity and efficiency, while others have insisted that tradition itself has lent authority to the written word.
japan_events.5.f: Bureaucrats worked late into the night, tirelessly rewording directives with quiet determination. One paused to rub his eyes, then pressed on, careful not to miss a single mark. Each scratch of the pen felt like a small battle against confusion and disorder.
japan_events.5.a: Promote Vernacular Japanese in official administration.
japan_events.5.b: Permit limited reform in internal correspondence.
japan_events.5.c: Retain classical Kanbun in all state documents.
je_ryukyu_rivalry_reason:
Since the #b invasion of 1609#! by the forces of the #b Satsuma Domain#!, the Kingdom of [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName] has existed as a domain of [SelectLocalization(SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').IsValid, SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetName, 'JAP')] in all but name. Despite its subjugation by the Satsuma, the court at Shuri has continued to receive investiture from [SelectLocalization(SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').IsValid, SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetName, 'CHI')] and dispatch tribute missions to Beijing, preserving the appearance of independence.

This arrangement has endured for generations; however, the balance of power in East Asia has shifted with the growing presence of western powers and the opening of Japan. Both parties must now clarify their relation to Ryukyu, triggering an open contest for the southern islands.
