strata_samurai_high_desc: High-ranking warrior elites such as daimyō and senior retainers, the upper echelons of the samurai class have monopolized most offices of note and enjoy significant hereditary prestige.
strata_samurai_low_desc: Lower-ranking warriors and retainers such as gokenin and ashigaru serving as the administrative and military workforce beneath the samurai elite.
strata_religious_desc: Shrine clergy organized through temple institutions and regulated by the authorities. While they are influential in local life, learning, and religious rituals, they exist somewhat outside the legally defined status classes.
strata_commoners_peasants_desc: A subdivision of the commoner class, the peasants are by far the most numerous of the Japanese social classes. Members of the peasant class are registered in villages and are bound to local obligations and taxation. They are defined by their registration—not occupation—and include rural craftsmen and merchants as well as farmers.
strata_commoners_townspeople_desc: A subdivision of the commoner class, the townspeople are the main inhabitants of Japan's urban centers. Members of the townspeople class are registered through town institutions and are traditionally associated with crafts and commerce. While they can accumulate significant wealth and influence, their social mobility is retarded by their non-warrior status.
strata_outcastes_desc: The Eta and Hinin form the lowest ranks of Japanese society. Heavily discriminated against, they are associated with 'unclean' occupations such as grave-digging, begging, and street performing.
law_strict_edo_system_desc: Everything from legal and professional opportunities to the number of residential gates one's status affords them is strictly regulated and enforced by the state. Any breach of the protocol is heavily sanctioned, and townsmen and peasants have no way to formally enter the ranks of the samurai.
law_intermediate_edo_system_desc: Legal and sumptuary laws have been relaxed, and commoners are afforded increasing influence and status in society. Wealthy townsmen or peasants may become gokenin—a low-ranking samurai—through purchase.
law_lax_edo_system_desc: Positions and roles previously exclusive to samurai are opened up for commoners, and enforcement of remaining sumptuary and professional limitations is only enforced selectively, usually limited to the most serious offenses alone.
je_tenpo_crisis_reason:
Declared in 1830, the Tenpō, or 'Heavenly Protection' Era initially lived up to its auspicious name. However, poor weather conditions on [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_honshu').GetName] would soon result in soaring rice prices and a country-wide famine, while the increasing wealth and influence of the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_petty_bourgeoisie',GetPlayer).GetName] threatens the established [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_armed_forces',GetPlayer).GetName] order.

Meanwhile, on the horizon, Western [Concept('concept_great_power','$concept_great_powers$')] are getting ever bolder, and their merchantmen and gunboats ever closer to our shores.

Seeking to address these issues, reform-minded notables have outlined their visions to the Bakufu.

#tooltippable;tooltip:tenpo_reformer_tt #b Reformer Agenda#!#!:
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_edo_system_lax')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] has enacted [GetLawType('law_lax_edo_system').GetName]
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_bureaucrats')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] has #b not#! enacted [GetLawType('law_hereditary_bureaucrats').GetName]
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_urbanization')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] has #v 3#! [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] with a level #v 3#! [GetBuildingType('building_urban_center').GetName]
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_clout')] The [concept_clout] of the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_petty_bourgeoisie',GetPlayer).GetName] [concept_interest_group] is #v 10#! or above
#tooltippable;tooltip:tenpo_hardliner_tt #b Hardliner Agenda#!#!:
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_edo_system_strict')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] has enacted [GetLawType('law_strict_edo_system').GetName]
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_social_control')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] has enacted [GetLawType('law_shinsengumi').GetName]
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_rural')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] has #v 40#! levels of [GetBuildingType('building_rice_farm').GetName]
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_pb_marginalized')] The [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_petty_bourgeoisie',GetPlayer).GetName] [concept_interest_group] is [concept_marginalized]
#tooltippable;tooltip:tenpo_shared_tt #b Shared Agenda#!#!:
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_famine')] #b No#! owned [GetCulture('japanese').GetName] [concept_homeland] [concept_state] is suffering from [concept_famine]
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_gdp')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] has a [Concept('concept_gdp', '$concept_gdp_short$')] of @gdp!#v [Country.MakeScope.Var('tenpo_gdp_goal').GetValue|k0]#! or above
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_army_size')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] army [concept_power_projection] is greater than #v 500#!
• [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('tenpo_checkbox_naval_size')] We have #v 10#! or more levels of [GetBuildingType('building_naval_fortification').GetName] in owned [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')]
je_tenpo_crisis_complete_header: Will conclude in a successful Tenpō reform if:\n
je_tenpo_crisis_failure_header: Will conclude in a failed Tenpō reform if:\n
je_tenpo_crisis_success_tt: We have completed at least #v 8#! agenda goals
je_tenpo_crisis_success_2_tt: Depending on the number of #tooltippable;tooltip:tenpo_shared_tt #b Shared#!#!, #tooltippable;tooltip:tenpo_reformer_tt #b Reformer#!#!, or #tooltippable;tooltip:tenpo_hardliner_tt #b Hardliner#!#! goals completed, the reward will change
je_tenpo_crisis_success_outcome_tt: Depending on the number of #b Shared#!, #b Reformer#!, or #b Hardliner#! goals completed, the reward will change.
je_tenpo_crisis_success_outcome_1_tt: If we have completed more #b Hardliner#! agendas:
je_tenpo_crisis_success_outcome_2_tt: If we have completed more #b Reformer#! agendas:
je_tenpo_crisis_success_outcome_3_tt: If we have completed an equal amount of #b Hardliner#! and #b Reformer#! agendas:
tenpo_hardliner_tt: The #b Hardliner Faction#! believes that Japanese society is in moral decay, and that this decay can only be arrested by a return to tradition.\n\nIt believes in the introduction of stricter sumptuary laws, and for the Samurai to forgo the luxuries of the cities and return to their idealized role as austere rural administrators.
tenpo_reformer_tt: The #b Reform Faction#! believes that Japanese society has irrevocably changed, and that the laws of the country should be based on the actual state of the country rather than the ideals of a romanticized past.\n\nIt believes in the political elevation of Japanese commoners and the promotion of commerce.
tenpo_shared_tt: Both the #b Hardliner#! and #b Reform#! factions believe that it is imperative to safeguard Japan from external threats, and that the issue of food security and the economy must be addressed.
button_je_tenpo_combat_rice_hoarding_des: The political and economic instability of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] has caused unscrupulous actors to purchase and hoard large quantities of rice, driving up prices. As a consequence, many Japanese families now find themselves without the means to purchase enough rice to feed themselves.
button_je_tenpo_frugal_ordinance_desc: The growing decadence of the urban [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_petty_bourgeoisie',GetPlayer).GetName] is threatening the stability of our rule. They have now begun to act above their station, flaunting their wealth for all to see.\n\nWe must remind them of their role in society by imposing further legal restrictions on luxury items, entertainment, and literature.
button_je_tenpo_confiscate_land_desc: The area within 10 #italic #tooltippable;tooltip:glossary_ri ri#!#! of Edo and Osaka represents a complicated jumble of tenryo-, daimyo-, and hatamoto-held land. As the lack of a unified administrative structure has severe effects on national defense and our ability to utilize the land's full potential, a leading Rōjū has proposed its confiscation and consolidation.\n\nDisplaced land-holders will be awarded compensatory land elsewhere in Japan.
glossary_ri: #b #italic Ri#!#! is a traditional unit of measurement derived from the Chinese #italic li#!.\n\nThe defined length of a ri shifted over time, but in the late Edo period it roughly corresponded to 36 #italic chō#!, or 3.9km.
tenpo_events.1.d: Following years of adverse weather, [concept_famine] grips the land of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag]. With the poor and destitute struggling to make ends meet, the Bakufu faces growing discontent from those who believe that the government could do more.
tenpo_events.1.f: His wife's woven textiles had always fetched a good price at the market, and in better days would even afford them the occasional piece of confectionary. Now they only fetched four or five gō of rice, if that. Barely enough to feed them for a day, he thought, much less the week they needed—even when supplemented with foraged leaves and weeds.\n\nHe took the path home, briefly stopping in view of old Tora's home. The pox had already claimed two of his children—and if the rumors about the rain coats were true, were likely to claim more in the weeks to come. Clutching his sack of rice tightly, he offered a silent prayer and left.
tenpo_events.1.tt_1: #r Severe#! [GetHarvestConditionType('torrential_rains').GetName] have struck [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_honshu').GetName], #r ruining#! the country's critically important #b rice harvests#! and severely degrading [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] [concept_food_security].
tenpo_events.1.tt_2: All across [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_honshu').GetName], the abodes of moneylenders and suspected rice hoarders are targeted by mobs engaging in so-called #italic #tooltippable;tooltip:glossary_uchikowashi uchikowashi#!#!, resulting in #r country-wide#! [concept_devastation].
glossary_uchikowashi: #b #italic Uchikowashi#!#! refers to the act of destroying the property of perceived immoral actors such as moneylenders, rice-hoarders, and price-gougers by members of the public.\n\nWhile these acts were often accompanied by looting, in many cases the perpetrators of uchikowashi would deliberately refrain from doing so in order to highlight the legitimacy of their act.
tenpo_events.2.d: Disillusioned with the established order and its inability to deal with the [concept_famine] plaguing [SCOPE.sState('osaka_scope').GetName], the magistrate and scholar [SCOPE.sCharacter('oshio_scope').GetFullName] has revolted against the local authorities. Large parts of [SCOPE.sState('osaka_scope').GetCityHubName] are already in flames, as [SCOPE.sCharacter('oshio_scope').GetHerHis] supporters torch local government offices.
tenpo_events.2.a: Drum up the militia and nail this traitor to a cross.
tenpo_events.2.c: The rebels overwhelm the local garrison and seize [SCOPE.sState('osaka_scope').GetCityHubName].
tenpo_events.2.tt_1: [SCOPE.sCharacter('oshio_scope').GetFullName] evades capture and commits suicide by immolation.
tenpo_events.2.tt_2: [SCOPE.sCharacter('oshio_scope').GetFullName] is tortured, salted, and crucified by the authorities.
tenpo_events.2.tt_3: Local militias #b put down the rebellion#! before it can spread further.
tenpo_events.2.tt_4: The [concept_agitator] [SCOPE.sCharacter('oshio_scope').GetFullName] is given a light, symbolic sentence, and allowed to continue his work.
tenpo_events.3.d: Pleased with the pace of reforms, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has congratulated the presiding councilors on their progress—believing the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation to be able to overcome any coming challenge, be it foreign or domestic.
tenpo_events.3.a: May this mark the end of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] moral and political decay.
tenpo_events.3.b: From peasant to samurai, are we not all subjects of the Emperor?
tenpo_events.3.c: The stability of the realm is paramount.
tenpo_outcome_hardliner_tt: We have completed more #b Hardliner#! than #b Reformer#! agendas
tenpo_outcome_reformer_tt: We have completed more #b Reformer#! than #b Hardliner#! agendas
tenpo_outcome_balanced_tt: We have completed an equal amount of #b Hardliner#! and #b Reformer#! agendas
tenpo_events.4.d: Unimpressed with the results of the reform program, and facing growing public dissatisfaction with the chief councilors, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has dismissed [SCOPE.sCharacter('roju_scope').GetFullName] from his post.
tenpo_events.4.f: Exile. The former councilor tasted the word, and did not much like it. Though perhaps it was preferable to staying in Edo given the events of yesterday. His remaining attendants were still clearing the pond and courtyard of thrown tiles and stones, and some of the threats he heard uttered that day could never be unheard.\n\nHe tasted the word again, and found it somewhat less repulsive. Besides, he thought, he had always desired to see Mount Gassan in the flesh.
tenpo_events.4.a: I never want to see this fool again in my life.
tenpo_events.4.b: Reverse his every decision, and make sure the public know it.
tenpo_events.4.tt_1: [SCOPE.sCharacter('roju_scope').GetFullName] is #r demoted#! and internally exiled to the province of #b Dewa#!
tenpo_events_4_demotion_tt: The [concept_leader] of an [concept_interest_group] [concept_in_government] is demoted and internally exiled
tenpo_events.5.d: Our move to confiscate the land in [SCOPE.sState('kanto_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sState('kansai_scope').GetName] has been met with widespread opposition from the local land-holders. The loudest complaints come from those whose lands were granted as reward for military service.
tenpo_events.5.a: Cancel the centralization before this gets out of hand.
tenpo_events.5.b: Offer those relocated additional land as compensation.
tenpo_events.5.c: Remind them that this is the will of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]!
modifier_will_of_the_shogun: In the Name of the Shogun
tenpo_events.6.d: The victory of [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetName] against the [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetAdjective] has greatly shaken our nation. Chinese junks and armies were easily routed by superior [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] forces, and many are now questioning the ability of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to resist a similar assault.
tenpo_events.6.a: Heaven protect us, for our samurai may not.
tenpo_events.6.b: Censor any negative reports from China.
tenpo_events.6.c: We are the cliff against which the barbarian waves will crash.
tenpo_events.7.d: Fearing for Japan's future in the aftermath of the Opium War, the Nagasaki magistrate [SCOPE.sCharacter('takashima_scope').GetFullName] has organized a modern Dutch-model military unit, and urges the rest of the country to follow suit.
tenpo_events.7.a: Authorize the adoption of barbarian arms and techniques.
tenpo_events.7.b: Favor the traditional musketry houses instead.
tenpo_events.8.d: Accusations of rice-hoarding and price-gouging has caused tensions between farmers and merchants in [SCOPE.sState('tenpo_unrest_state_scope').GetName] to boil over. With the peasants' ranks swelled by brigands and beggars, local authorities now face a province-wide rebellion.
tenpo_events.8.f: He had been one of the first. Those merry few who had attacked the wicked merchant's home and distributed his ill-gained goods to the masses. But as his eyes wandered around the campfire, he realized how few of them were left. Eikichi and Matsuzō remained still, though they resembled little the men he once knew, beaming with righteous fury. Fukumatsu had lost his life on the second day, followed by Takeshichi on the seventh. The rest had scattered like leaves as the magistrate's men pursued them.\n\nThe character of the men who had replaced them filled him with shame and despair, but he saw no other way. For even poor company such as theirs seemed divine when compared to the executioner's saw.
tenpo_events.8.a: Dispatch men to crush these villains.
tenpo_events.8.b: Let the unrest die out on its own.
tenpo_events.8.c: Ply local village headsmen to help quell the unrest.
je_taming_the_north_reason: With the formation of the #b [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetName] Development Commission#!, commonly known as the #b Kaitakushi#!, this former frontier is abuzz with activity. Every day [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('ezo_or_japan_arrival_text')] arrive from the south, seeking new lands and opportunities.\n\nYet this is no ordinary rush of peoples. For with the settlers come bureaucrats, intellectuals, and modernizing visionaries with a mission to shape the land—eager to see their vision of [SelectLocalization(SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').IsValid, SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetName, 'JAP')]'s future manifested in the [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetName] of today.
taming_the_north_agriculture_potentials_: We have used the #b $button_je_taming_the_north_agriculture_potentials$#! action #v 3#! times
taming_the_north_agriculture_arable_goal: We have used the #b $button_je_taming_the_north_agriculture_arable_land$#! action #v 3#! times
je_taming_the_north_additional_goal_pre: If we own all of #b $STATE_SAKHALIN$#! the #b $modifier_tamed_north$#! [concept_timed_modifier] will also apply to $STATE_SAKHALIN$ [concept_state_region]:
je_taming_the_north_additional_goal: If we own all of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('sakhalin_state_region_scope').GetName] the #b $modifier_tamed_north$#! [concept_timed_modifier] will also apply to [SCOPE.sStateRegion('sakhalin_state_region_scope').GetName]:
je_taming_the_north_additional_goal_comp: Since we own all of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('sakhalin_state_region_scope').GetName] the #b $modifier_tamed_north$#! [concept_timed_modifier] will also apply to [SCOPE.sStateRegion('sakhalin_state_region_scope').GetName]:
button_je_taming_the_north_establish_col: A colony without sufficient colonists is doomed to fail. We should consider incentives to help attract families from across [SelectLocalization(SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').IsValid, SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetName, 'JAP')] to settle in the north.
button_je_taming_the_north_integrate_ain: Until now, the Commission's stance towards the [GetCulture('ainu').GetName] has been one of forceful integration and cultural erasure. However, our incremental moves towards a more equitable relationship with the [GetCulture('ainu').GetNameNoFormatting] inhabitants of the North has resulted in a warming of relations between our two peoples.\n\nA proposal has thus been forwarded to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] to legally enshrine the [GetCulture('ainu').GetNameNoFormatting] as a protected brotherly people under [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] law, equal in both rights and duties to the [GetCulture('japanese').GetName].
ainu_frenship_tt: We have consistently furthered the interests of the [GetCulture('ainu').GetName] in #b events#!
button_je_taming_the_north_sapporo_agric: The north is the perfect arena to test out the latest theories in the fields of agriculture and land-management. We shall found a cutting-edge agricultural college staffed by skilled foreigners to serve as the nucleus for our scientific transformation of the land.
sapporo_partner_positive_catalyst_tt: A #g positive#! [concept_diplomatic_catalyst] will be triggered with a random country meeting the requirements
button_je_taming_the_north_agriculture_p:
The available acreage on the island may be of utmost importance, but true economic development will only take place if we also grow the right crops.

New developments within the field of agriculture—spearheaded by the #b Sapporo Agricultural College#!—enable us to introduce crops to this frigid frontier that were hitherto thought impossible.

Available Options:
• #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],modifier_opimizing_existing_variants_tt $modifier_opimizing_existing_variants$#! (scaling)
• [GetBuildingType('building_rice_farm').GetName]
• [GetBuildingType('building_dye_plantation').GetName]
• [GetBuildingType('building_opium_plantation').GetName]
• [GetBuildingType('building_vineyard').GetName]
established_sapporo_college_tt: We have established the #b Sapporo Agricultural College#!
hokkaido_agriculture_potentials_tt: This decision can be taken a total of #v 3#! times. (currently [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('hokkaido_agriculture_potentials_counter_var').GetValue|v0])
button_je_taming_the_north_agriculture_a: Whilst these vast lands are agriculturally underdeveloped, they hold great potential. The great mountain ranges—from which abundant water flows—offer ample opportunities for extending the acreage northwards.\n\nWe shall drain the wetlands, irrigate the fields, and tame the land as a testament to the unbreakable [GetCulture('japanese').GetName] spirit.
hokkaido_agriculture_arable_tt: This decision can be taken a total of #v 3#! times. (currently [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('hokkaido_agriculture_arable_counter_var').GetValue|v0])
hokkaido_events.1.d: With the incorporation of [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_scope').GetName]—or the Ainu-lands—into Japan proper, a new name must be chosen to reflect the new status of this land. The newly established Development Commission has presented a number of proposals to be reviewed by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
hokkaido_events.1.d_1: With the solidification of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s control over [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_scope').GetName]—or the Ainu-lands—a new name must be chosen to reflect the new status of this land. The newly established Development Commission has presented a number of proposals to be reviewed by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
hokkaido_events.1.a: Its name shall be #tooltippable;tooltip:hokkaido_events.1_tt_3 #b Hokkai-dō#!#!: The North Sea Circuit.
hokkaido_events.1.b: #tooltippable;tooltip:hokkaido_events.1_tt_2 #b Hokkai-dō#!#!, in honor of the inhabitants of this land.
hokkaido_events.1.c: #tooltippable;tooltip:hokkaido_events.1_tt_4 #b Kaitō-dō#!#!, the Sea-Island Circuit, is clearly the better option.
hokkaido_events.1.e: #tooltippable;tooltip:hokkaido_events.1_tt_5 #b Hitakami-dō#!#! has a certain literary ring to it.
hokkaido_events.1.tt_1: The town of #b Sapporo#! is founded and made the island's new administrative capital, replacing #b Hakodate#!
hokkaido_events.1_tt_2: #b The Northern Kai Circuit#!\nIn the words of the commission-member Matsuura Takeshirō, #italic kai#! (加伊) is understood to be an old Ainu endonym for their people.
hokkaido_events.1_tt_4: #b The Sea Island Circuit#!\nBeyond all else, the island is defined by its relationship with the sea—a fact that should be represented in its new name.
hokkaido_events.1_tt_5: #b The Sunrise Land Circuit#!\nAn archaic Yamato-era name for the northeastern frontier lands. Choosing this option roots the new colony firmly in Japan's ancient past.
hokkaido_events.2.d: The question of how to best settle the region has preoccupied the minds of the [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetName] Development Commission for some time now. Impatient administrators now demand we reach a final decision.
hokkaido_events.2.f: Growing up, his father often talked of their ancestors. Of the proud and noble warriors of the warring states period. Of their austere dignity and their great feats of war. The stories had captivated him as a child, but now that he was older they filled him with nothing but melancholy. The irony of his father, a paper-pushing, urbanite drunkard that had only carried a sword for the dignity it afforded him, extolling the virtues of the past was too much to bear.\n\nSo when his father asked him to assist in the administration of the business, he turned him down with contempt, and immediately set off for the north. Maybe there would he find salvation for his line?
hokkaido_events.2.b: The simple peasant is the backbone of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
hokkaido_events.2.c: Restrict most [GetCulture('japanese').GetName] settlements to areas unused by the [GetCulture('ainu').GetName].
hokkaido_events.2.tt_1: #v 1.5%#! of all [GetCulture('japanese').GetName] [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] from the [concept_capital_state] will relocate to [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetName]
hokkaido_events.2.tt_2: #v 3%#! of all [GetCulture('japanese').GetName] [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_migration_origin_scope').GetName] (one of the [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] with the lowest [Concept('concept_gdp_per_capita','$concept_gdp_per_capita_short$')] in the [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_home_islands').GetName]) will relocate to [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetName]
hokkaido_events.3.d: Recent breakthroughs at the Sapporo Agricultural College have prompted proposals to introduce new crops to the fields of [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetName].
hokkaido_events.3.f: #b Personal Lab Log, 154#!\nGrafts of western varieties now abandoned in favor of southern ones due to latest test results. The boys claim cultivation limit is expected to be pushed considerably northwards, perhaps even past Kamikawa. Further studies needed to assess yield potential, but feeling optimistic. Requested meeting with faculty head tomorrow. Need to buy new tie.
hokkaido_events.3.a: Focus our efforts on improving the crops already present.
hokkaido_events.3.b: Develop cold-resistant varieties to allow for local [GetBuildingType('building_rice_farm').GetName].
hokkaido_events.3.c: The lowlands are well suited for Indigo [GetBuildingType('building_dye_plantation').GetName].
hokkaido_events.3.e: The poppy takes well here, [GetBuildingType('building_opium_plantation').GetName] are the future.
hokkaido_events.3.g: Set up [GetBuildingType('building_vineyard').GetName] using specialized grape strains.
button_je_taming_the_north_complete: We have developed the land as much as our technology allows us
hokkaido_events.4.d: The [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetName] Development Commission has reached another important milestone, with vast tracts of former wetlands converted to valuable agricultural land.
hokkaido_events.4.f: It was impressive, really. A decade ago the largest vessel capable of safely navigating the river in front of him would have been a small rowboat. Now he was watching a group of workers unload crates and burlap sacks from a massive steam pram billowing smoke into the crisp mountain air above. Material for the next lock perhaps? Or for the drainage project further upstream? Or just supplies from the new village in the valley beyond? He couldn't say, and in truth it mattered not, for whatever it carried, it was carrying the future.
hokkaido_events.4.a: With each swing of the hoe, we mould this land.
hokkaido_events.4.b: And with each new home, we grow it.
hokkaido_events.4.tt_1: #v 2%#! of all [GetCulture('japanese').GetName] [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_migration_origin_scope').GetName] (one of the [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] with the lowest [Concept('concept_gdp_per_capita','$concept_gdp_per_capita_short$')] in the [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_home_islands').GetName]) will relocate to [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetName]
hokkaido_events.5.d: With the graduation of the first class of the [SCOPE.sCountry('sapporo_partner_country_scope').GetAdjective]-staffed Sapporo Agricultural College, the alumni are eager to put their newfound skills into action. Meanwhile, the college board deliberates the institute's future direction and focus.
hokkaido_events.5.a: An agricultural college should primarily focus on agriculture.
hokkaido_events.5.b: We should prioritize expanding the engineering faculty.
hokkaido_events.5.c: Establish a faculty of humanities and start local cultural studies.
hokkaido_events.5.tt_1: The influence of the [SCOPE.sCountry('sapporo_partner_country_scope').GetAdjective] staff in #b Sapporo#! leads to the creation of a local [GetCulture('japanese').GetName] [SCOPE.sReligion('sapporo_partner_religion_scope').GetName] community
hokkaido_events.6.d: In an atmosphere of some domestic controversy, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] has issued a new decree on the legal status of [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetName], formally delineating an Ainu homeland and establishing limited institutions to exist in parallel with the official [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] bureaucratic apparatus.
hokkaido_events.7.d: Formally announcing the success of their government-mandated mission, the [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetName] Development Commission has elected to transfer its remaining responsibilities to the state.
hokkaido_events.7.f: #b Proclamation No. 8#!\nThe [SCOPE.sState('hokkaido_state_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] Development Commission is hereby abolished and the three prefectures of Hakodate, Sapporo, and Nemuro are established. The boundaries of their respective jurisdictions shall be promulgated at a later date.
hokkaido_events.7.a: A shining example for future colonial endeavours...
hokkaido_events.8.d: The loss of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('hokkaido_state_region_scope').GetName] has forced the Development Commission to dissolve without having completed its mission. In response, outraged citizens have taken to the streets of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], protesting both the loss of national prestige and of their personal investments.
hokkaido_events.8.f: Exhausted, the administrator emeritus slumped down into his office chair and poured himself a generous cup of sake. Emptying the cup in one go, he let his eyes rest on the maps laid out in front of him on the table. Full with scribbles, notes, and marks, each denoting a separate scheme he had poured his life energy into. Now neither scheme nor energy remained, and the implied optimism in each note carried a mocking tone.\n\nTo hell with it all, he thought, and poured himself another cup.
hokkaido_events.8.a: Regrettably, this outcome is outside the government's control.
japan_events.31.d: A fire has burned down a popular kabuki theatre in [SCOPE.sState('kabuki_theatre_state').GetName]. While the theatre troupe makes plans to rebuild, [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] members—especially [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_leader').GetFullName]—see this as an opportunity to regulate entertainment in [SCOPE.sState('kabuki_theatre_state').GetCityHubName] and force the performers to rebuild their theatre outside of city limits.
japan_events.31.f: Atop the platform of a fire lookout tower there is a restless watchman who diligently keeps an eye over [SCOPE.sState('kabuki_theatre_state').GetCityHubName]. Late in the evening, he spots the telltale signs of a fire from his vantage point. As smoke billows and the acrid scent of fire fills the air, he rushes to ring the alarm bell.\n\nUnsuspecting townsfolk are alerted of the danger and fire brigades launch into action climbing roofs to control the flames. When the fires are extinguished, it is apparent much damage is already done. All that remains of one prominent kabuki theatre are cinders and ashes in the wake of this destructive blaze.
japan_events.31.a: They must rebuild outside of city limits.
japan_events.31.b: Allow the theatre troupe to rebuild.
japan_events.32.d: The work of a prolific ukiyo-e artist in [SCOPE.sState('ukiyo_e_state').GetCityHubName] has inspired the imagination of artists both in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] and abroad.
japan_events.32.f: A popular woodblock print depicts the lively theatre district in the outskirts of [SCOPE.sState('ukiyo_e_state').GetCityHubName]. Silver moonlight shines down on the main street filled with people where their silhouettes cast shadows. The east side of the street is lined with teahouses and puppet theatres. Opposite, to the west, are three kabuki theatres with a drum tower above each.\n\n
japan_events.32.a: No doubt [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] art will continue to gain global prominence.
japan_events.32.b: Excellent. Encourage the production for more of these works.
japan_events.33.d: The effect of Westernization on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] culture is significant. As customs rapidly change, [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetFullName] is sponsoring a Sumo wrestling tournament in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] to combat public antagonism of the tradition.
japan_events.33.f: Crowds begin to gather at the newly constructed Sumo Hall on temple grounds, filled with curiosity about this event that has the [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s endorsement. Among those present are some aristocrats and statesmen whose fixation with Western culture has left them skeptical of maintaining ties to this tradition. While the golden age of Sumo has long passed, [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetFullNameNoFormatting]'s attendance may re-establish the cultural importance of the sport in the eyes of the people.
japan_events.33.a: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s efforts will restore the public image of the sport.
japan_events.33.b: The tradition of this [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] sport will have great longevity.
japan_events.34.d: A boat sailing off the coast of [SCOPE.sState('whaling_state').GetName] has spotted two right whales—a mother and a calf. Driven by desperation after a season of poor catches, a whaling group has ventured out to sea despite bad weather conditions. More than 100 people have been reported missing.
japan_events.34.f: The bonfire on the boat has long disappeared out of view and the fleet can no longer be seen from ground causing great commotion in [SCOPE.sState('whaling_state').GetPortHubName].\n\n
japan_events.34.b: Focus our future efforts on $bg_fishing$ in [SCOPE.sState('whaling_state').GetNameNoFormatting] instead.
japan_events.35.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] have been concerned that the frequency of arson cases within the city limits of [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetCityHubName] has driven up prices of [SCOPE.sGoods('expensive_good').GetName] in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. They have argued that doubling down on strict anti-arson measures is necessary.
japan_events.35.f: The alarm bell rings out from the fire lookout tower alerting all to the imminent danger where another fire in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetCityHubName] has set residences and businesses aflame. As the fire brigades arrive to extinguish the blaze, $strata_commoners_townspeople$ gather in a large crowd in the street. Some regard their neighbors with suspicion and others begin to speculate whether this was an accident or if an arsonist is to blame. One thing is for certain, the prices for [SCOPE.sGoods('expensive_good').GetNameNoFormatting] will soon be multiplying.
japan_events.35.a: Strict measures are warranted. Execute suspected arsonists.
japan_events.35.b: Pardon outstanding crimes of those who aid in arrests.

korea_colinzation_3b_tt: Someone must take responsibility for this failure.
korea_colonization.2.d: The world now knows that [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_korea').GetName] is part of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] and firmly under our country's total control. By establishing our presence in the peninsula, our success further demonstrates the prominence of our place on the world stage.
korea_colonization.2.f: With the vision of unification between nations now realized, the ambition of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting] grows. From [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] seat in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] composes tanka poetry reflecting on the success of this endeavor and pleased with the developments in the peninsula.\n\nAt the same moment, out in $STATE_SEOUL$, a [GetCulture('korean').GetNameNoFormatting] bureaucrat suppresses public outcry from civilians who object to the new social order. Speaking to them with great equanimity, he insists this union will ensure the prosperity of all.
korea_colonization.2.a: The future prosperity and safety of the peninsula looks bright.
korea_colonization.2.b: Business has been integral to our agenda.
korea_colonization.3.d: [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_korea').GetName] is no longer under our control. The economic and diplomatic impact will be felt in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] for years to come.
korea_colonization.3.f: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] officials gather, feelings of frustration and displeasure abound, to discuss the government's failure to maintain order in the peninsula. Many refuse any compromise on how to move forward from this blow to the considerable power [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] has amassed in recent years.\n\nA gentleman rises to speak over the din of discussion:
korea_colonization.3.a: We must all shoulder the burden of the failure of our endeavor.
korea_colonization.3.b: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ig_leader').GetFullName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] must take responsibility for this failure.
japan_politics.1.d: The opening of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has rendered much of the school of Dutch Learning antiquated. Newer ideas have begun to sweep through the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] intellectual community, first among them the school of
japan_politics.2.d: With the industrialization of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_ig').GetName] have diversified into the manufacturing economy. By leveraging their wealth and connections to the state, they have been able to concentrate much of the industrial base under their control.
japan_politics.2.f:
The Finance Minister watched from the balcony as the brokers made their bids. In the days of the rice exchanges, the end of trading would have been signaled by a man throwing a bucket of water into the throng.

Now, it was a gavel-wielding man with eyes fixated on the clock. Near his desk, half-buried by a sea of brokers reaching to purchase bonds at seven percent interest, he could see someone signing a contract with a bond secured firmly in his mouth. The cacophony was deafening, buys and sells merging into something that sounded like waves crashing on rocks.

The clock struck, and the man at the desk slammed his gavel against a bronze disk. Shouts of indignation rose from the crowd, and the sound of last-minute deals only increased in volume. Grumbling, he crouched under his desk, and retrieved the bucket.
japan_politics.3.d: The erosion of the Edo class system has given rise to a civil society founded upon common nationality. Those once designated as [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('pb_ig').GetName] have come to view themselves, first and foremost, as patriotic citizens.
japan_politics.3.f: Shizo slowly turned his head back and forth, studying his new haircut in the bronze mirror. It was shorter than it had ever been, missing the knot he had kept for as long as he had remembered. The ends of the freshly-cut hairs felt thick and rough, and he could not stop reaching up to feel it.\n\nHe abruptly shook his head, and felt the strands shift in a way they had not before. It was like the new clothing, with the high collars that irritated his neck. Uncomfortable, but beneficial. The new styles made a statement, and attracted others to his shop. His was a civilized business, and he was a taxpayer, a guardsman, a national—a civilized man.
japan_politics.3.a: The strength of the nation is the peace of its citizens.
landowners_leader_is_tokugawa_tt: The [concept_leader] of the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetName] is a member of the #b Tokugawa#! clan
landowners_leader_is_not_tokugawa_tt: The [concept_leader] of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('daimyo_ig').GetName] is #b not#! a member of the #b Tokugawa#! clan
tokugawa_not_in_government_tt: no members of the #b Tokugawa#! clan [concept_in_government]
at_least_six_months_tt: The following has been true for at least #v 6#! months (currently [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('restoration_timer_var').GetValue|v0]) #indent_newline:3
ep2_meiji.1.d: The end of Sakoku has stirred a sense of powerlessness against foreign encroachment, undermining the authority of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName] clan. The enemies of the Shogunate have rallied around the slogan of #italic Sonnō Jōi#!:
ep2_meiji.1.f: On the second floor of a Kyōto inn, far from any windows, a dozen black-clad rōnin huddled around a table. Outside, rain poured down with a fury that drowned out the sounds of the street. Angry whispers passed between them—complaints, then denunciations, then a sworn oath and an interloper's death warrant.\n\nFar away, in a house overlooking Iso, a man in a green kimono watched a pillar of smoke ascend skywards. The hills cast long shadows over the constructions on the seashore. As the sun approached the horizon, the glow of the furnaces below grew more and more pronounced. Beyond them, reflected on the water, he could see the lights of ships. One day, he hoped, his cannon would banish them beyond the horizon.
ep2_meiji.1.a: We must adapt to our new circumstances.
ep2_meiji.2.d: The Shogunate reformers are split between two theories of governance. The theory of #italic Kōbu Gattai#! seeks to renew the legitimacy of the [GetLawType('law_bakufu').GetName] through fusion with the Imperial Court, whilst the theory of Public Deliberation seeks to establish a parliamentary system headed by the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastName] clan.
ep2_meiji.2.f:
The host placed a tray of higashi upon the table, and poured a bowl of thin tea for each of his guests. Three men sat around the table, the host and first guest with their hair bound in chonmage, and the second short-haired. Steam wafted from the bowls in front of them.

The host directed his gaze to the short-haired man, and spoke.
ep2_meiji.2.b: Public deliberation is the enlightened way.
traditionalist_shogun_warning_tt: @warning! A [GetIdeology('ideology_traditionalist').GetName] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] will be unwilling to pursue #b Parliamentary Government#!
ep2_meiji.3.d: The Emperor has agreed to arrange a marriage between [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] and Princess [SCOPE.sCharacter('imperial_princess_scope').GetFullName]. The marriage is conditioned on the Shōgun's repudiation of the [SCOPE.sTreaty('relevant_treaty_scope').GetName], and return to an isolationist policy.
ep2_meiji.3.d2: The Emperor has agreed to arrange a marriage between [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] and Princess [SCOPE.sCharacter('imperial_princess_scope').GetFirstName]. The marriage is conditioned on the Shōgun's expulsion of foreigners and return to an isolationist policy.
ep2_meiji.3.f: The procession enveloped the entire Nakasendō. A train of thirty thousand laborers, retainers, and members of the Princess' household, guarded by a perimeter of soldiers of the Owari Domain, stretched from Iijima Town to Shiojiri Station. At the heart of the procession, the Princess rode atop a palanquin of gold and red silk. Alongside it rode samurai from a dozen domains—[SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_1_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_2_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')], [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_3_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_4_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')], [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_5_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_6_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')].\n\nWithin her palanquin, the Princess stared out of the thin gap between its curtains. Town after town passed by, shutters closed and silent. She would have the next thirty #italic ri#! to ponder her fate.
ep2_meiji.3.a: For the good of the country.
je_meiji_imperial_marriage_reason: In [SCOPE.sCharacter('imperial_marriage_ruler').GetHerHis] pursuit of unifying the Imperial Court and Shogunate, Shōgun [SCOPE.sCharacter('imperial_marriage_ruler').GetFullName] has secured a political marriage with Imperial Princess [SCOPE.sCharacter('imperial_princess_scope').GetFirstName]. The Emperor's consent for the marriage is premised upon the expulsion of foreigners from the [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_home_islands').GetName], and a return to an isolationist policy.\n\nIf the Shōgun delivers upon [SCOPE.sCharacter('imperial_marriage_ruler').GetHerHis] vows, the marriage will contribute greatly to healing the rift between Japan's de jure and de facto rulers.
ep2_meiji.4.d: Alienated by the seizure of [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetHerHis] lands and titles, [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetHerHis] loyal retainers have risen in revolt against the Imperial Court. [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetSheHe|U] seeks to reverse the restoration of Imperial power, and restore the Bakufu.
ep2_meiji.4.a: This is our wish: slay the traitor, and restore peace.
ep2_meiji.4.b: The Emperor has come under the sway of robbers.
ep2_meiji.41.d: Enraged by the efforts of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastName] clan to hold onto power, a coalition of restorationist domains have risen in revolt against [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName]. They seek to restore the political primacy of the Emperor, free from the influence of the Tokugawa.
ep2_meiji.41.d_1: Enraged by the refusal of the government in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] to expel foreigners, a coalition of Sonnō Jōi-aligned domains have risen in revolt. They seek to depose the Emperor's Westernizing advisors, and carry out the expulsion of foreign influence from Japan.
ep2_meiji.41.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] stood atop the castle walls, gazing down. Before him, row upon row of [SCOPE.sState('revolter_state').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_state')] soldiers filed out of the gates. Some were modernized, clad in the new uniforms, dark blue with conical helmets. Others retained their traditional clothing—reds, greens, blues. Those in the new uniforms were placed first in the column, and gained approving looks from the cluster of foreign observers who had placed themselves several metres to [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting]'s left. Behind them came the mounted samurai with their rifle-muskets, and after them the artillery.\n\nOn the outskirts of [SCOPE.sState('revolter_state').GetCityHubName] waited the staging ground, where they would meet the forces of their allied domains to march against the Shōgun's army. Far away, beyond that wall of swords and bayonets, the captive Emperor awaited.
ep2_meiji.41.f_1: [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] stood atop the castle walls, gazing down. Before him, row upon row of [SCOPE.sState('revolter_state').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_state')] soldiers filed out of the gates. Some were modernized, clad in the new uniforms, dark blue with conical helmets. Others retained their traditional clothing—reds, greens, blues. Those in the new uniforms were placed first in the column, and a rainbow of sansaibaori followed behind them. The mounted samurai with their rifle-muskets came after—and, after them, the artillery.\n\nOn the outskirts of [SCOPE.sState('revolter_state').GetCityHubName] waited the staging ground, where they would meet the forces of their allied domains to march against the loyalist army. Far away, beyond that wall of swords and bayonets, the captive Emperor awaited.
kinmon_civil_war_tt: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] will fall into a #r $concept_civil_war$#! between #b Shogunate#! and #b Imperial Court#!
ep2_meiji.5.d: Facing increasing pressure from the opponents of the [GetLawType('law_bakufu').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] has petitioned the Emperor to return [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetHerHis] governing authority to the Imperial Court.
ep2_meiji.5.a: Naught but air beneath his feet.
ep2_meiji.51.d: The Emperor has issued his response to [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName]'s petition to return governing authority to the Imperial Court. The Shōgun's petition has been accepted, and the political supremacy of the Emperor restored.
ep2_meiji.52.d: The Emperor has issued his response to [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName]'s petition to return governing authority to the Imperial Court. The response states that the Shōgun retains the confidence of the Court, and that governing authority may remain with the Shogunate.
ep2_meiji.52.f: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('japan_choshu_castle_name')] Castle echoed with the sound of boots. Messengers and retainers had been in and out all day, bearing increasingly detailed retellings of the last week's news. [SCOPE.sCharacter('choshu_daimyo_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] had personally received them, remaining resolutely silent through each meeting. His brow had grown heavier and heavier as he heard of the developments—the Shōgun's triumphal procession, the Aizu left guarding the Imperial Palace.\n\nOutside the front palace, the sun had set. From his stage, [SCOPE.sCharacter('choshu_daimyo_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] looked to the twenty assembled retainers.
ep2_meiji.6.d: Opponents of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastName] clan within the Court have persuaded the Emperor to issue a decree formally restoring his own power. The decree abolishes the Shogunate, and establishes a government that excludes [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] from any official position.
ep2_meiji.7.d: With the Imperial Court lacking the practical expertise to govern, allies of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastName] clan within the Court have persuaded the Emperor to grant [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] the title of Taikun, placing [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetHerHim] at the head of the Imperial Office.
ep2_meiji.8.d: Through marriage into the Imperial Family and fulfillment of [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetHerHis] vows to the Emperor, [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] has eased the tensions between Court and Shogunate. The Emperor may continue [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetHerHis] secluded existence, assured that the Shōgun will ensure lasting peace.
ep2_meiji.8.f:
Even if stormy winds
Should rage through the country,
I shall wait for them
To return the sun in heaven
To its pristine radiance.

—Emperor Kōmei
ep2_meiji.8.a: The storm has come to an end.
ep2_meiji.9.d: Through confidence and deft maneuver, [SCOPE.sCharacter('taikun_scope').GetFullName] has seen through both the restoration of the Emperor and the preservation of [SCOPE.sCharacter('taikun_scope').GetHerHis] clan. The [SCOPE.sCharacter('taikun_scope').GetLastName] Taikuns will reign as first among the peerage of a modern $JAP$.
ep2_meiji.9.f: The Emperor no longer sat behind a screen. His ministers were arrayed along the table before him, with the Taikun to his left. Each wore a new court uniform, their sleeves and breasts decorated with intricate arrangements of gold leaf. Medals clicked and rustled as they adjusted themselves in the unfamiliar seats.\n\nThe Taikun had moderated the discussion for the past hour, with the Emperor not speaking a single word. He had been content to listen in, directing his attention to each speaker in turn. On the far side of the room, a former disciple of #italic sonnō jōi#! spoke of the necessity of a mission to America.
ep2_meiji.9.a: The Shōgun falls, the Taikun rises.
ep2_meiji.9.b: The Emperor is the Son of Heaven, and the Tokugawa his instruments.
ep2_meiji_pulse.1.d: Whilst traveling in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_treaty_port_state').GetName], a [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_gp').GetAdjective] merchant was killed by the retinue of [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetFullName] for refusing to dismount as he passed. The Daimyō of [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] has asserted the legality of the killing under the right to strike any commoner who disrespects him.
ep2_meiji_pulse.1.f: The foreigners broke the ranks of the musketeer squad, and shouts came from all around. Noticing the armed men surrounding him, the foreigner in the lead lashed his reins to the side, sending his horse into a rapid turn that very nearly knocked one of the musketeers off his own mount. [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] drew his sword, and his companions in the inner ring joined him.\n\n[SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] struck the first blow, opening a gash along the interloper's side. He shrieked, and lashed the reins once more. It was fruitless. The musketeer closest to him drew his own blade, and lashed out. An arc of red hung in the air like a cloud.
ep2_meiji_pulse.1.a: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] wish for nothing more than to cause us trouble.
ep2_meiji_pulse.11.d: Whilst conducting business in [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetName], a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] merchant by the name of [SCOPE.sCharacter('richardson_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] has been murdered by the local lord [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetFullName]. The lord has claimed [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetHerselfHimself] justified under the law of [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetHerHis] land, and refused to pay any sort of compensation for [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetHerHis] crime.
ep2_meiji_pulse.11.f: #b Editorial#!\n\nUnder the present circumstances, we repeat that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] has no alternative but to make ready for a great war, or to bid farewell to Japan. To abandon the foothold she has obtained there will not be thought of, and so we may look out for a conflict between the two empires. Many [SCOPE.sCulture('primary_culture_scope').GetCustom('getPluralDemonym')] dislike this idea, yet the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] deems it not only inevitable, but justifiable, merely on the ground of the refusal of the Japanese to punish the assassins of [SCOPE.sCharacter('richardson_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting]... (#italic cont. pg.02#!)
ep2_meiji_pulse.11.a: #italic Someone#! must pay. Raise the matter with the Tycoon.
ep2_meiji_pulse.11.b: Do we truly wish to get further involved in the East?
ep2_meiji_pulse.2.d: In retaliation for the [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] Domain's refusal to pay an indemnity for the death of [SCOPE.sCharacter('richardson_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting], [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_gp').GetAdjective] naval vessels have engaged in a multi-day artillery duel with the coastal defenses of [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetHomeState.GetCustom('japan_domain_seat_name')].
ep2_meiji_pulse.2.f: The bay hung hazy with cannon fire, and [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetHomeState.GetCustom('japan_domain_seat_name')] was burning. Across the water, one of the foreign ships was firing rockets into the foundries in the North of the town. With each launch, a hellish red glow drowned out the feeble light of the setting sun.\n\nThe last operational cannon at [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting]'s battery roared—a long shot, in good conditions, and hopeless now. The ball impacted several lengths from the third vessel in the foreign column, sending a mighty gout of water into the air. [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] grabbed [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetHerHis] sponge, and rushed to attend to the gun. Somewhere behind the rear wall, the men wounded by the last salvo were still screaming. Somehow, despite the ringing in [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetHerHis] ears, [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetSheHe] could still hear them.
ep2_meiji_pulse.2.a: A harsh price for their recklessness.
ep2_meiji_pulse.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('choshu_daimyo_scope').GetFullName], Daimyō of Chōshū Domain, has signaled [SCOPE.sCharacter('choshu_daimyo_scope').GetHerHis] compliance with the Emperor's order to expel foreigners. [SCOPE.sCharacter('choshu_daimyo_scope').GetSheHe|U] has ordered [SCOPE.sCharacter('choshu_daimyo_scope').GetHerHis] navy to fire upon all foreign vessels passing through the Shimonoseki Strait, spurring exchanges of fire with a [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_gp').GetAdjective] warship.
ep2_meiji_pulse.3.f: Daylit thunder rolled over the gentle slope of Hinoyama, and Masatake's head turned to the sky. He was greeted by a puffy, white cloud.\n\n
ep2_meiji_pulse.3.a: The foreigners do what we cannot.
ep2_meiji_pulse.3.b: Assist the Domain in reaching a settlement.
ep2_meiji_pulse.3.c: Offer the Westerners a port in exchange for an accord.
ep2_meiji_pulse.4.d: #italic Sonnō Jōi#! samurai of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] Domain have staged an attack on the in-construction [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_gp').GetAdjective] legation building in [SCOPE.sState('edo_state').GetCityHubName]. What would have been the first Western-styled building in the city has been burned to the ground, with the perpetrators nowhere in sight.
ep2_meiji_pulse.4.f:
Two men, hooded and masked, settled in atop the hill overlooking what would have been the legation. An orange glow still rose from its now-blackened shell. With all more accessible fuel extinguished, the flames struggled to sustain themselves on the dense inner beams.

As the glow faded to nothing, the two men remained. One spoke, voice quiet, staring off at the pillar of smoke left behind.
ep2_meiji_pulse.4.b: Forbid the [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] from bearing arms in the city.
shimonoseki_indemnity_tt: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] will pay an indemnity of @money!#v 3M#! over #v 10 years#! to [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_gp').GetName]
shimonoseki_indemnity_port_tt: The city of $HUB_NAME_STATE_KANSAI_port_japanese$ in [GetStateRegion('STATE_KANSAI').GetName] will be opened as a [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_gp').GetAdjective] [concept_treaty_port]
ep2_meiji_pulse.5.d: The Chief Minister of the Shogunate, [SCOPE.sCharacter('tairo_scope').GetFullName], has been assassinated at the gate of Edo Castle by rōnin of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_1_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_2_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] Domains. The manifesto left by the assassins expresses #italic Sonnō Jōi#! principles, condemning the Chief Minister's concessions to foreigners.
ep2_meiji_pulse.5.f: Chuzaburo watched Gorokuro step in front of the procession, and one of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('tairo_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] guards move to intercept him. Gorokuro gave him no more time to react. He drew his sword, and lunged. A great arc of blood flew from the [SCOPE.sCharacter('tairo_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] man's bisected face, and his companions surged forwards to avenge him.\n\nChuzaburo let his raincoat fall, and drew his pistol. He took aim at the exposed side of the palanquin, and pulled the trigger. The roar of a gunshot interrupted the sound of clashing blades and shouts, and then another. One of the guards wheeled to face him, and Jizaemon, the rōnin from [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_2_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')], swung his sword down towards his torso. Past the clashing duo, Chuzaburo could see a river of red trickling through the palanquin's doors, onto the snowy street. He drew his wakizashi, and ran towards it.
ep2_meiji_pulse.5.a: The samurai cross blades once more.
ep2_meiji_pulse.6.d: Guided by information gained by the torture of a militant of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('restorationist_movement_scope').GetName], the [GetLawType('law_shinsengumi').GetName] have launched a raid against a gathering of alleged conspirators at [SCOPE.sState('kyoto_state').GetName]'s Ikedaya Inn. The raid has transformed into a fierce sword battle in and around the inn.
ep2_meiji_pulse.6.f:
Otaka braced himself against the railing as the Shinsengumi burst through the door. He could see the bloodstains on the sleeves of their pale blue #italic haori#!—black-on-white in the dim lamplight. He raised his sword into a guard position.

Two of them detached from the rest, charging up the stairwell he guarded, two abreast. He struck out with his blade, felt it be parried, compensated. Sparks flew from the impact. The second man was striking out. He took a step back, twisted his wrist to-

There was a flash of fire-lit steel, and then something cold in his chest.
ep2_meiji_pulse.6.a: Reward the Shinsengumi for their initiative.
ep2_meiji_pulse.7.d: Soldiers of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('restorationist_movement_scope').GetName]-aligned [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_1_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] Domain have attempted to storm the Imperial Palace in [SCOPE.sState('kyoto_state').GetName], and restore the Emperor by force. They are opposed by soldiers of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_2_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] and Aizu domains.
ep2_meiji_pulse.7.f: The Hamaguri Gate was choked with gunsmoke. All around them, Kyōto was catching light.\n\nThe Aizu soldiers were concentrated along the wall, sending out volleys of musket-fire that scattered off the road and the chassis of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_1_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] cannons. Every few seconds, one of the balls would strike flesh, spurring cries that briefly cut above the crackle of gunfire. Kōzō huddled against a wheel of a cannon, struggling to unjam his musket. A bare #italic ken#! away, the leader of his squad lay face down, legless, armless. Somehow, he was still writhing.
ep2_meiji_pulse.7.a: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_2_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] and Aizu succeed in repelling the attackers.
ep2_meiji_pulse.7.b: The Imperial Palace falls under [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_1_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] control.
ep2_meiji_pulse.8.d: As retaliation for the [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_1_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] assault on the Imperial Palace, the Shōgun has ordered a punitive expedition to expel the #italic Sonnō Jōi#! faction from the Domain. Advisors sympathetic to the [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_1_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')] have offered a plan to secure peace in return for the seppuku of the guilty parties.
ep2_meiji_pulse.8.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_1_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting], Daimyō of [SCOPE.sCharacter('daimyo_1_scope').GetCustom('japan_domain_by_character')], stood on the castle's balcony, gazing into the distance. Far away, the sky was tainted by streams of smoke—the campfires of the approaching army.\n\n
ep2_meiji_pulse.8.a: If they can be defeated without fighting, so be it.
ep2_meiji_pulse.8.b: The Domain must be cleansed from top to bottom.
ep2_meiji_pulse.9.d: Angered by the treaties forced upon [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] by the Western powers, the Emperor has bypassed the Shōgun and issued an edict to expel foreigners from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] soil. Militants of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('restorationist_movement_scope').GetName] have rallied to the Emperor's cause.
ep2_meiji_pulse.9.f: The retainer stood abreast one of the cannons, looking out towards the strait. At this hour, the vessels steaming through were silhouetted by the setting sun. Off to the side, the lower samurai of Chōshū Domain busied themselves with ramrods and bags of black powder.\n\nAs looked up at the shape of Hinoyama and the town of Shimonoseki below, passage from the Edict came to mind.
ep2_meiji_pulse.9.a: The Shōgun must travel to Kyōto to discuss this.
ep2_meiji_pulse.9.b: This order is fraudulent—have it suppressed.

shogunate_strategy_title_decide_desc_loc: For the power of the Tokugawa to survive, the Shogunate must reform. Such a reform may proceed in one of two directions—the Shōgun may seek to renew the legitimacy of the Bakufu through unification with the Imperial Court, or he may pursue restoring the Emperor in a controlled fashion, to place himself at the head of a parliamentary government.
shogunate_strategy_title_revise_desc_loc: The Shōgun's present strategy for reform has proven not necessarily advantageous. Though changing approach will incur a cost, it is best not to adhere to a failed course.
imperial_restoration_unavailable_loc: The Emperor remains the sovereign of Japan. Without the Imperial sanction, the Shōgun is merely the most powerful Daimyō amongst hundreds. The Shogunate's survival—or its fall—will depend upon the will of the Imperial Court.
imperial_restoration_kobu_gattai_loc: For the crisis to end, there must be union between Shogunate and Court. The Daimyō must be convinced that the orders of the Shōgun carry imperial command, and that the Shōgun possesses the full confidence of the Court. To achieve this goal, the Shōgun must make himself vulnerable, and rely upon the Emperor to re-establish his authority.\n\nSuch a scheme is a fateful jump off the stage—if the Imperial Court is unwilling to cooperate, the Tokugawa will find themselves alone amidst their vengeful opponents.
imperial_restoration_kogi_yoron_loc: For the crisis to end, the Emperor must rule. If the power of the Tokugawa is to survive restoration, the Shōgun must see it through on his own terms. The final step of the Shōgun's reforms must be to return administrative powers to the Emperor, and establish a new role for his clan within a reformed Imperial government.\n\nSuch a scheme is a fateful jump off the stage—if the Imperial Court is unwilling to cooperate, the Tokugawa will find themselves alone amidst their vengeful opponents.
je_meiji_restoration_imperial_marriage_d: The project of #b Kōbu Gattai#! requires a union of the most literal sort—a political marriage between the sitting $RULER_TITLE_SHOGUN$ and an Imperial Princess. To realize this union, the $RULER_TITLE_SHOGUN$ must be prepared to meet the substantial conditions set forth by the Imperial Court.
