meiji_restoration_restore_emperor_warnin: @warning! If the [concept_legitimacy] of the #b Shogunate#! is too low, this interaction may cause #r unforeseen consequences#!
yoshinobu_is_the_guy_info_tt: @information! [SCOPE.sCharacter('yoshinobu_scope').GetFullName] is known for his developing [GetIdeology('ideology_modernizer_leader').GetName] sympathies
shogunate.1.d: As the new head of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastName] clan, [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] has been granted the office of Shōgun by the Emperor. The new Shōgun is viewed with derision by many [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('daimyo_scope').GetName], having yet to establish personal authority.
shogunate.1.f: A rainbow of Daimyō wound their way through the Ō-hiroma. Atop its uppermost dais sat the Shōgun, clad in black and red, the Imperial decree in a box to his right.\n\nOne by one, nobles in reds and blues and violets bowed before him, presenting swords and gifts of gold. The Shōgun did not speak, nor did those prostrating themselves. Those of lower rank, forbidden from seeing him, crowded outside the hall. A chant rose from the garden.
shogunate.2.d: The ill health of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s eldest son, [SCOPE.sCharacter('iesada_scope').GetFirstName], has raised concerns over whether he will be able to carry out the duties of [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle]. Outsider Daimyō led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetFullName] have rallied behind [SCOPE.sCharacter('yoshinobu_scope').GetFullName] as an alternative candidate.
shogunate.2.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetFirstNameNoFormatting]'s bedroom was empty. The screens were shut, and the veranda made clear. [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetSheHe|U] sat beside his bed, facing a blank sheet of paper. [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetHerHis|U] eyes were closed. Were a cat to tread through the adjacent hall, [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetSheHe] would be certain to hear it—and yet [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetSheHe] could not be certain that no one was listening. At such an early stage, it was best to keep [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetHerHis] ambitions firmly within [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetHerHis] own mind.\n\nWould the Imperial Court see the matter the same way as [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetHerHim]? [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetSheHe|U] had reason to believe so, but this was the easiest question by far. [SCOPE.sCharacter('armed_forces_leader').GetHerHis|U] mind turned. How best to procure a decree? How best to ensure it did not disappear?
shogunate.2.a: The inner [GetLawType('law_bakufu').GetName] will have their way.
shogunate.3.d: As the new head of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastName] clan, [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] has been granted the office of Shōgun by the Emperor. Sickly since childhood, the state of the Shōgun's health has already spurred a race to succeed him.
shogunate.4.d: As the new head of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastName] clan, [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] has been granted the office of Shōgun by the Emperor. The new Shōgun's supporters in the reformist domains have high expectations for his rule.
shogunate.5.d: The factions that emerged around Shōgun Ieyoshi's succession have clashed once more over whom will succeed the childless [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName]. The Hitotsubashi faction of outsider Daimyō and lower [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_ig').GetName] support [SCOPE.sCharacter('yoshinobu_scope').GetFullName], whilst the Nanki faction of insider [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('daimyo_ig').GetName] support [SCOPE.sCharacter('iemochi_scope').GetFullName].
shogunate.5.f: The messenger, blank-faced, looked at the floor before the man on the dais. His brush hovered over the paper.\n\n
shogunate.5.a: The will of the Shōgun is that [SCOPE.sCharacter('iemochi_scope').GetFirstName] rule.
shogunate.5.b: The Imperial Court requires an experienced successor.
shogunate.6.d: As the new head of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastName] clan, [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] has been granted the office of Shōgun by the Emperor. Though young, the Shōgun has already acquired a reputation for stoic, meticulous judgement.
shogunate.6.a_regency: [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetSheHe|U] will govern under a loyal guardian.
shogunate.6.b_regency: Compromise with the Hitotsubashi—appoint [SCOPE.sCharacter('yoshinobu_scope').GetFirstName] as [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetHerHis] guardian.
shogunate.7.d: As the new head of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastName] clan, [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName] has been granted the office of Shōgun by the Emperor. Worldly and open-minded, the Shōgun is expected to patronize the [GetLawType('law_bakufu').GetName]'s reformist factions.
shogunate.8.d: The heat of summer has sent the elderly [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName]'s health into a sharp decline. Now bedridden, the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] must fight one last battle against his failing heart.
shogunate.8.f: The Shōgun's bed had been moved to face the window. His attendants had hoped the cool air blowing in from the sea would supplement their fans. A chest of ice sat open at the foot of the bed, and a wet cloth across his forehead.\n\nThere was no wind, today. The air rippled beneath the setting sun. Merciless, all-enveloping. He could no longer make out the shape of the waves below.
house_yamato_tt: Is a member of the Imperial House
house_yamato_not_tt: Is #b not#! a member of the Imperial House
house_tokugawa_tt: Is a member of the #b Tokugawa#! clan
house_tokugawa_not_tt: Is #b not#! a member of the #b Tokugawa#! clan
special_character_japanese_emperor_desc: This character is the currently-enthroned Emperor of Japan, central to the Japanese religious and political establishments.
japan_monarchy.1.d1: Prince [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetFirstName] has ascended to the Chrysanthemum Throne as Emperor of Japan. [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetHerHis|U] accession has marked the beginning of the Kaei era, named for everlasting happiness.
japan_monarchy.1.d2: Prince [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetFirstName] has ascended to the Chrysanthemum Throne as Emperor of Japan. [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetHerHis|U] accession has marked the beginning of the Tenkyū era, named for heavenly permanence.
japan_monarchy.1.f:
From somewhere out of sight, a musician gave the signal. Two ladies of the court opened the Throne's curtains. There was the Emperor, dressed in scarlet robes decorated with white and green dragons. Their volume swallowed up his seat, making him seem as if he floated on air. A curtain of beads descended from his crown. The shadows they cast hid his eyes from view.

Clothing rustled around [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting], [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_scope').GetHerHis] fellow attendees prostrating themselves in a great wave. [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_scope').GetSheHe|U] followed them, and the Emperor's shadowed face disappeared from view.

Days later, on the road back to Edo, [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_scope').GetSheHe] attempted to reconstruct what [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_scope').GetSheHe] had seen, yet found no purchase. [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_scope').GetSheHe|U] could recall the crown, the curtains, the boxes resting at the Emperor's side. Of the man himself, there was nothing to be found.
japan_monarchy.1.a: Your years will be as many as the grains of sand on the shore.
japan_monarchy.2.d: Prince [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetFirstName] has ascended to the Chrysanthemum Throne as Emperor of Japan. [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetHerHis|U] accession has marked the beginning of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetFirstName] era, named for the promise of enlightened rule.
japan_monarchy.2.f: A gong sounded, and the curtain rose. For just an eyeblink, the audience saw the Emperor, clad in richly-decorated yellow silk, his face half-obscured. A green lacquered box rested on a stand to his left, concealing the sacred sword and jewel. And then the master-at-arms made his call, and they lowered their eyes to the floor. The herald spoke, voice strong and steady.\n\n
japan_monarchy.2.a: Your years will be as many as the grains of sand on the shore.
japan_monarchy.3.d: Prince [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetFirstName] has ascended to the Chrysanthemum Throne as Emperor of Japan. [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetHerHis|U] accession has marked the beginning of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetFirstName] era, named for the virtue of great righteousness.
japan_monarchy.3.f:
The joint groaned as a man passed along the scaffold. Yatarō held it as tightly as possible. Once the footsteps had passed, he set about locking it in place with his mallet.

He could hear similar sounds from all around him. Through the corner of his eye, he could see another crew assembling the black-wood plank walls of the next building over. A foreman shouted directions at a man carrying a teetering load of thatch.

In six days, the Emperor would pass through the passage he was building, part of a once-in-a-lifetime ceremony that would conclude in its destruction. He would not be able to attend. The best he could hope for was to witness its glow reflected off the clouds.
japan_monarchy.3.a: Your years will be as many as the grains of sand on the shore.
japan_monarchy.4.d: Prince [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetFirstName] has ascended to the Chrysanthemum Throne as Emperor of Japan. [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetHerHis|U] accession has marked the beginning of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetFirstName] era, named for the promise of enlightened peace and concord.
japan_monarchy.4.f: Four generations of the Takaishi family huddled around the radio set. The voice from it sounded as if it came from the bottom of a well, tinged with static. Giyō turned the dial one way, and then another. When it came through again, it was strong and steady.\n\n
japan_monarchy.4.a: Your years will be as many as the grains of sand on the shore.
japan_monarchy.5.d: With the political primacy of the Imperial Court restored, the Emperor has promulgated an edict reforming the system of eras. A new era will now be declared with the accession of a new Emperor, and last for as long as he rules.
japan_monarchy.5.f: #bold Imperial Edict#!\n\nThe establishment of a new era upon the sacred sovereign's receiving of Heaven's mandate constitutes the exemplary model of an enlightened age, and the standard for ten thousand generations. Having inherited the great lineage and personally attended to the myriad affairs of state, I now change the era name to mark a new beginning with the myriad subjects within the realm. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('JAP_era_year_name')] shall henceforth be known as the first year of [SCOPE.sCharacter('emperor_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting]. From this day forward, the old system shall be reformed, establishing the principle of one era name per reign as the permanent practice.
japan_monarchy.5.a: Those in authority shall implement it.
japan_monarchy.6.t: The Death of the Daijō Tennō
japan_monarchy.6.d: The Retired Emperor, abdicated father of the sitting Emperor, has passed away. [SCOPE.sCharacter('retired_emperor_scope').GetSheHe|U] is remembered for his efforts to restore imperial prestige, and has been granted the posthumous name of [SCOPE.sCharacter('retired_emperor_scope').GetFirstName].
japan_monarchy.6.f:
Tōhō dipped his brush into the ink. Its tip moved to the page, forming the characters for the day, year, and weather. It moved to the next column, and stopped.

What wording would be proper? How best to express the significance of what had happened? He had heard rumors of the retired Emperor's great efforts to restore the court—he recalled his reign, the reports of the ceremonies he had revived. And then he had received the Court's envoy, and had learned the truth of it.

The brush touched the paper.
japan_monarchy.6.a: Will his descendants realize his wishes?
iwakura_mission.1.d: The government has assembled a list of several ministers and officials suitable for the role of Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary. The chosen candidate will be sent to lead the expedition to the West for an expected period of ten months.
iwakura_mission.1.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader_1').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] stood before the mirror, checking and re-checking [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader_1').GetHerHis] tie. It had been some time since it had come to Japan—first as a trend, and then by state mandate—yet it had not yet come to feel natural. [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader_1').GetSheHe|U] would need to make do. If his deal broke through, if the government endorsed [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader_1').GetHerHis] bid, if he were to wake up in London and Boston and Paris, the end of the day would no longer mark a respite.
iwakura_mission.1.a: The matter demands the attention of [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader_1').GetFullName].
iwakura_mission.2.d: With the [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetLastName] Mission's return to $JAP$, [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetFullName] and [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetHerHis] fellow ambassadors have submitted their reports to [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('country_legislature_name')]. Their reports contain observations of industrial society, and recommendations for new state policies.
iwakura_mission.2.a: The West has provided us a window into modernity.
iwakura_mission.2.b: [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_good_economy_country').GetAdjective]-styled industries will be the future of Japan.
iwakura_mission.2.c: There is much to learn from [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_desired_law_country').GetAdjective] politics.
iwakura_mission.2.e: A [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_land_reform_law_country').GetAdjective]-inspired land reform would revitalize the countryside.
iwakura_mission.4.d: After a long voyage across the sea, the [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetLastName] Mission has arrived in [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_mission_host').GetName]. The Mission plans to travel along her railways to [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_mission_host').GetCapital.GetCityHubName], surveying [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_mission_host').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] institutions and industrial facilities en route.
iwakura_mission.4.a: The knowledge of a continent lies upon to us.
iwakura_mission.4.b: America is merely the gateway to Europe.
iwakura_mission.5.d: Having traversed from Pacific to Atlantic, the [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetLastName] Mission has arrived in [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_mission_host').GetName]. The Mission seeks to establish diplomatic relations with the [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_mission_host').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s Government, and tour the founding sites of the Industrial Revolution.
iwakura_mission.5.a: Follow every lead presented to us.
iwakura_mission.5.b: Two months is time enough to see all of [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_mission_host').GetCapital.GetCityHubName].
iwakura_mission.6.d: The [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetLastName] Mission has arrived in continental Europe, beginning in the country of [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_mission_host').GetName]. Over the next months, the Mission intends to observe, assess, and establish relations with the numerous nations of the Continent.
iwakura_mission.6.a: We will take our time to compare and contrast.
iwakura_mission.6.b: The timetable demands an expedited tour.
iwakura_mission.8.d: En route to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], the [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetLastName] Mission has made a stop in the [SCOPE.sCountry('iwakura_mission_host').GetAdjective] colony of [SCOPE.sState('iwakura_mission_location').GetName]. The Mission has spent several days observing both European colonial society and native [GetReligion('theravada').GetNameNoIcon] practices.
iwakura_mission.8.a: Could this fate have befallen us?
iwakura_mission.9.d: Having spent months abroad and completed a full circumnavigation of the globe, the [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetLastName] Mission has returned to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. They have brought with them compilations of data, foreign goods, and firsthand accounts of Western technologies and political institutions.
iwakura_mission.9.f: [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetFirstNameNoFormatting] stood on the deck of the steamer, gazing Westwards. In the distance, [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetSheHe] could see the vastness of Mount Fuji, wreathed in a morning fog that had only half-lifted. A coterie of Westerners—traders, perhaps, or fresh-minted world travelers like [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetHerselfHimself]—clustered around the railing. A German man sat on a bench by the cabin door, drawing the scene on a sketchpad. [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetSheHe|U] wondered if this was their first time, or if they, like [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetHerHim], had their breaths taken away whenever they saw this view.\n\nHow many could truly have been said to have done what he had? How many had crossed three oceans, visited four continents? More and more to come, [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetSheHe] thought. The railway and the steamship would create more and more like [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetHerHim], but history would remember [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetHerHim] as one of the first.
iwakura_mission.9.a: Home is the most beautiful sight of all.
je_iwakura_mission_reason: As part of its modernizing measures, the new government of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has sent [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetFullName] and a sizable entourage of ministers and scholars upon a diplomatic mission across the Western world. The [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetLastName] Mission seeks to renegotiate unequal treaties with the West, and conduct inquiries into the political and technological foundations of the Great Powers.\n\nFor each #b month#! the Mission remains in a country, there will be a chance that it collects findings on that country's Laws or Technologies. These findings will affect the report the Mission will issue upon its return, as well as the [concept_ideology] of the expedition leader.

iwakura_mission_decision_desc: With the restoration of the Emperor, the time of #v $JAP$#! as a passive actor must come to an end. We will dispatch a diplomatic mission to the Great Powers of the world, with the goal of improving our relations and establishing a blueprint for our own modernization.

bouncing_around_europe_for_90_days_tt: The [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetLastName] Mission will visit countries across continental [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_europe').GetName] for the next #v 90#! days
je_iwakura_mission_recall_mission_desc: The domestic situation has, by far, eclipsed foreign expeditions in terms of importance. [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetFullNameNoFormatting] and [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetHerHis] companions' talents are far better put to use in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName].
iwakura_mission_submits_report_tt: The [ROOT.Var('expedition_leader_storage_var').GetCharacter.GetLastName] Mission will make their return to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName]
notification_iwakura_mission_visited_des: A [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetAdjective] diplomatic mission, headed by [SCOPE.sCharacter('iwakura_scope').GetFullName], has visited our country. The [SCOPE.sCharacter('iwakura_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] Mission has taken an interest in our industries and political institutions.
notification_iwakura_mission_learns_laws: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('iwakura_scope').GetLastName] Mission has surveyed [SCOPE.sCountry('current_expedition_location_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFlag] political institutions, gathering insights on the policy of [SCOPE.sLaw('iwakura_law_learning').GetName].

je_zaibatsu_reason:
The rapid industrialization of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has brought much of the economy under the umbrella of the [concept_zaibatsu]. Profiting handsomely from their entanglement with state institutions, these enterprises have become vital organs within the military-industrial structure of #v $JAP$#!.

The concentrated nature of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] capital has made the country an international competitor, at the price of placing ever-greater political power in the hands of the Zaibatsu and their military patrons.[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('zaibatsu_democracy_snippet')]
$ZAIBATSU_LIST_HEADER$$ZAIBATSU_LIST_CONTENT$

glossary_zaibatsu: A #b #italic Zaibatsu#!#! is a family-owned and vertically-integrated industrial and financial conglomerate.\n\nA typical zaibatsu is organized around a holding company and a bank, which hold ownership shares in several, typically industrial, subsidiary companies. The zaibatsu emerged from family merchant congolomerates of the late Edo period, which made use of their pre-existing wealth and ties to the state to consolidate control of much of Japan's industrial base.

zaibatsu.1.d: The enduring partnership between the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('zaibatsu_ig').GetName] has cemented the power of the conglomerates within [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('country_legislature_name')]. The politicians may govern, but the generals and executives will rule.
zaibatsu.1.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('pm_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] looked down upon the bout from [SCOPE.sCharacter('pm_scope').GetHerHis] covered box. [SCOPE.sCharacter('pm_scope').GetHerHis|U] preferred wrestler's opponent had pushed [SCOPE.sCharacter('pm_scope').GetHerHis] champion to the very edge of the rice-straw ring, and [SCOPE.sCharacter('pm_scope').GetSheHe] had found [SCOPE.sCharacter('pm_scope').GetHerselfHimself] struggling to keep [SCOPE.sCharacter('pm_scope').GetHerHis] knuckles from going white. At the Prime Minister's side, perfectly serene, stood [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_zaibatsu_exec').GetFullNameNoFormatting].\n\nThe referee pointed his fan, and cheer rose from the lower seats. A rain of seat cushions flew through the air, showering the ring. [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_zaibatsu_exec').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] turned his head towards [SCOPE.sCharacter('pm_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting], and smiled. There, on the far side of the ring, stamped into one of the walls, was the #italic mon#! of [SCOPE.sCompany('relevant_zaibatsu').GetNameNoFormatting].
zaibatsu.1.a: Let [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] unfold like a sea of light.
zaibatsu.1.b: Our supply chain could always be more secure.
zaibatsu.2.d: The efforts of the [SCOPE.sCharacter('pm_scope').GetLastName] cabinet have curtailed the abilities of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('zaibatsu_ig').GetName] to exert control over [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('country_legislature_name')]. The politicians will rule, and the executives shall focus on their profits.
zaibatsu.2.d_1: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('pm_scope').GetLastName] cabinet's policies of free trade have eroded the network of military-industrial contracts key to the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('zaibatsu_ig').GetName]'s control over [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('country_legislature_name')]. The politicians will rule, and the executives shall focus on their profits.
zaibatsu.2.f: A flock of executives filtered into the uppermost meeting room of the [SCOPE.sCompany('relevant_zaibatsu').GetNameNoFormatting] headquarters. [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] was third to enter, after the secretaries. [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetSheHe|U] took [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetHerHis] seat by the door, and watched [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetHerHis] seniors pass by. A weak trickle of steam wafted off the cup of tea before [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetHerHim].\n\n[SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_zaibatsu_exec').GetFullNameNoFormatting] was the last to enter. [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_zaibatsu_exec').GetHerHis|U] gaze passed over each of [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_zaibatsu_exec').GetHerHis] employees in turn. There was a look in [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_zaibatsu_exec').GetHerHis] eyes, [SCOPE.sCharacter('name_a_scope').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] noticed, one that the Baron had never shown before. Exhaustion. The shadows cast on [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_zaibatsu_exec').GetHerHis] face seemed deeper than before, and [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_zaibatsu_exec').GetHerHis] silver hair ever thinner.
zaibatsu.2.b: Let the people know—[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('country_legislature_name')] will not be bought.

jap_abolish_edo_system_desc: The caste system of old stands in the way of the social mobility necessary for a modern economy. Every citizen can be a valuable part of the state, no matter their station in life.
abolish_edo_system_available_later_tt: The option to #v $je_end_edo_system_button_name$#! will become available through the $DECISIONS$ menu
faced_sufficient_pressure_to_abolish_sak: External events have put pressure on [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetName]
jap_upgrade_the_shinsengumi_desc: The $law_shinsengumi$ have proven their usefulness in suppressing seditious activity in the capital. With recent improvements to the bureaucratic apparatus, the unit may now serve as a template for an all-Japanese force similarly dedicated to the preservation of order.
ezo_republic.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetFullName], a former [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetCustom('getEzoCharacterTitle')] of the Shogunate, has fled to the island of [SCOPE.sState('ezo_state').GetName] alongside several thousand Tokugawa loyalists. [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetSheHe|U] intends to make a last stand at the fortress of Goryōkaku, alongside [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetHerHis] foreign advisors.
ezo_republic.1.d_1: [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetFullName], a former [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetCustom('getEzoCharacterTitle')] of the Shogunate, has fled to the island of [SCOPE.sState('ezo_state').GetName] alongside several thousand Tokugawa loyalists. [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetSheHe|U] has petitioned the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] government for an end to the war, and to be allowed to lend the efforts of the Tokugawa to develop the island.
ezo_republic.1.f: Tetsutarō's spyglass panned across the Northwards horizon. The wind was harsh, laden with salt and freezing mist, and each degree further to the West felt like a dry razor running across his face. The watchtower, an improvised construction whose wood still smelled fresh, offered little protection.\n\nThere. On the horizon, something wrong. He stopped, and squinted. There, perhaps a #italic ri#! from the shore, he could see a pair of masts, half-hidden in the haze. Far beyond that, thready plumes of smoke streamed skywards.
ezo_republic.1.a: Traitors must not be rewarded for their crimes.
ezo_republic.1.b: If it would mean a swifter reconciliation, it is a fair price.
ezo_republic.1.c: Their initiative is worth following more closely.
ezo_republic.2.d: Foreseeing the imminent collapse of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName] power, [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetFullName] has assembled a force of several thousand loyalist soldiers and retainers to land on the island of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_ezochi').GetName]. [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetSheHe|U] is faced with the decision to continue the war from Hakodate, or to petition the [SCOPE.sCountry('imperial_government_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] government for a settlement.
ezo_republic.2.a: Send the petition. The Samurai will persist in the North.
ezo_republic.2.b: No compromise. Our last stand will be at Goryōkaku.
ezo_republic.2.c: Halt at Sendai. We will make no further retreat.
settle_tokugawa_here_after_the_war_tt: @information! Upon our victory in the [concept_civil_war], the [SCOPE.sCountry('ezo_scope').GetName] will become a hereditary [GetLawType('law_colonial_administration').GetName] under the #b Tokugawa#! clan
chance_of_subjugation_tt: If [SCOPE.sCountry('imperial_government_scope').GetName] accepts, she will become our [concept_overlord]
tokugawa_settle_here_tt: @information! Upon a [SCOPE.sCountry('imperial_government_scope').GetAdjective] victory in the [concept_civil_war], the #v Ezo Government#! will become a hereditary [GetLawType('law_colonial_administration').GetName] under the #b Tokugawa#! clan

notification_ezo_tokugawa_heir_arrives_d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetAdjective] government has authorized [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetFullName], heir to the [SCOPE.sCharacter('shogun_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] Clan, to settle in Ezo as our new $RULER_TITLE_SOSAI$.
notification_ezo_japan_accepts_terms_des: The government of [SCOPE.sCountry('imperial_government_scope').GetName] has accepted [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetFullName]'s petition to settle former Tokugawa retainers on [SCOPE.sState('ezo_state').GetName], in return for a pledge of loyalty from [SCOPE.sCharacter('tokugawa_exile_leader_scope').GetHerHis] followers.
japan_earthquakes.1.d: Over the course of four days, three earthquakes outside the coast have caused damage across a vast area, with ensuing tidal waves exacerbating their impact in coastal areas.
japan_earthquakes.1.f: Within a very little time the whole village had noticed the phenomenon. Apparently no one had felt the previous motion of the ground, but all were evidently astounded by the movement of the water. They were running to the beach, and even beyond the beach, to watch it. No such ebb had been witnessed on that coast within the memory of living men. Things never seen before were making apparition; unfamiliar spaces of ribbed sand and reaches of weedhung rock were left bare even as Hamaguchi gazed. And none of the people below appeared to guess what that monstrous ebb signified.\n\n—Lafcadio Hearn, #italic A Living God #!
japan_earthquakes.1.a: Request the assistance of neighboring Daimyō.
japan_earthquakes.1.b: Let the local rulers handle the relief efforts.
japan_earthquakes.2.d: A great earthquake has struck near the coast in [SCOPE.sState('japan_earthquake_state').GetName], causing widespread damage to the city of [SCOPE.sState('japan_earthquake_state').GetCityHubName] and its castle.
japan_earthquakes.2.f: When prints of the great catfish Namazu first started growing in popularity after the earthquake, they seemed in line with traditional stories. The creature was shown being subdued by the gods to prevent it from causing more earthquakes.\n\nYet over time, the portrayals evolved. One print showed Namazu cutting open its belly and bleeding coins. Another showed builders sharing drinks with it. A satirical edge had crept into the artwork, suggesting that despite the disaster brought by this beast, perhaps it was also setting something right.
japan_earthquakes.2.b: Wealth must flow to those who can rebuild.
japan_earthquakes.3.d: A great earthquake has struck at the heart of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], killing thousands and creating unusually large fault breaks across the land.
japan_earthquakes.3.a: Invite foreign scholars to study these faults.
japan_earthquakes.3.b: Use this knowledge to set up more meteorological observatories.
japan_earthquakes.4.d: A great tidal wave has struck [SCOPE.sState('japan_earthquake_state').GetName], triggered by an earthquake off the Sanriku coast. In the wake of its devastating impact, monuments warning of future tsunamis have been suggested.
japan_earthquakes.4.b: Raise these stones wherever the tsunami struck!
japan_earthquakes.4.c: We must focus our efforts on the here and now.
japan_earthquakes.5.d: A massive earthquake, unprecedented in living memory, has struck close to [SCOPE.sState('japan_earthquake_state').GetCityHubName]. Within minutes, the disaster has razed much of the city and killed hundreds of thousands.
japan_earthquakes.5.f: If the wall of water that followed the tremors had seemed like the greatest threat, it was nothing compared to the fires. Soon, not only was the entire city set ablaze, but the earth and wind itself seemed to be on fire.\n\nPeople who had managed to escape the burning buildings were trapped by a tornado of flames, as if the conflagration was determined to leave no one alive. [SCOPE.sState('japan_earthquake_state').GetCityHubName] had become a vision of hell.
japan_earthquakes.5.a: The Japanese people must stand united against such devastation!
japan_earthquakes.5.b: This blow to our material wealth is a warning against decadence.
japan_earthquakes.5.c: We must use this opportunity to rebuild a more modern [SCOPE.sState('japan_earthquake_state').GetCityHubName].
je_shinbutsu_bunri_reason: With the power of the Emperor restored, we need to distinguish and uplift the native religious traditions which hold the imperial line sacred. To accomplish this, they need to be separated from the foreign influence of Buddhism, which has been inextricably linked with kami worship for hundreds of years through syncretic traditions. Leveraging discontent with Buddhist institutions from its connections with the Shogunate, we can make way for Shinto as the higher guiding principle.
je_taikyo_proclamation_button_desc: Make Shinto, the worship of kami and reverence for the Emperor, the principle of the state
je_taikyo_proclamation_conversion_tt: Each [concept_interest_group] leader has a #v 75%#! chance to convert to [GetReligion('shinto').GetName].
je_elevate_buddhism_reason: The Buddhist religious institutions in $JAP$ have strong historical ties to the administrative arm of the Shogunate. Having averted the end of the Shogunate once, strengthening these institutions could help us maintain its power and strengthen religious traditions for $JAP$ not focused on Emperor worship.
japan_religion.1.d: At shrine temples, it is common for Buddhist monks to perform rituals alongside Shinto practices. With the separation of Buddhism from Shinto, the role of these monks is being called into question.
japan_religion.1.a: Demand the monks convert and become Shinto priests.
japan_religion.1.b: Strip the monks of their titles.
japan_religion.1.c: Leave the monks to their duties.
japan_religion.2.d: It is a well-established idea that Buddhas revealed themselves in Japan as kami, reflected in terminology such as [concept_gongen], which considers them two parts of the same entity. Such terminology reinforces Buddhism's influence.
japan_religion.2.b: Ban referring to Hachiman as a [concept_boddhisattva].
japan_religion.3.d: The attempt to oust Buddhism's influence has mobilized general anti-Buddhist sentiment. Temple properties are being seized and damaged, with some being destroyed outright, while others are being stripped of Buddhist iconography.
japan_religion.3.f: Approaching the shrine, he stopped in his tracks. The two Niō, powerful Buddha statues which had stood guard outside the entrance, had been removed. In their place was nothing.\n\nAs he passed inside, he couldn't shake the feeling that for all its purity, the shrine was no longer as safe as it had once been. An unguarded gate.
japan_religion.3.a: Smelt the temple bells for cannons!
japan_religion.3.b: Destroy or remove Buddha statues from the temples.
japan_religion.4.d: Efforts to standardize Shinto practices and ensure that state kami are a part of local rituals have been met with opposition from local monks and shrine priests, who consider these teachings a break with tradition.
japan_religion.4.b: Local priests know best what suits local rituals.
japan_religion.5.d: In the process of separating Buddhism and Shinto, Confucianism's role has been questioned. Many scholars consider the philosophy highly compatible with Shinto, while others dismiss it as another foreign influence.
japan_religion.5.a: Confucianism is an important complement to Shinto.
japan_religion.5.b: We must restore Shinto to its ancient traditions.
japan_religion.6.d: Although [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has opened to foreigners, religion remains regulated. Christian countries may view the free import of their faith as equally important as the import of their goods.
japan_religion.6.a: Missionaries must be allowed to preach their faith.
japan_religion.6.b: It may be practiced, but it should not be spread.
japan_religion.6.c: Christianity was and remains a foreign threat.
japan_religion.7.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has a long tradition of different schools of Buddhism, many of which still wield influence today. With the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] gaining in political power, one school stands out.
japan_religion.8.d: With [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] being opened to the world, Buddhist scholars have shown interest in translating more foreign texts to incorporate their ideas in modern Buddhism.
japan_religion.8.a: Sanskrit and Pali texts, the roots of Buddhism.
japan_religion.8.b: Chinese texts, closest to our own schools of thought.
japan_religion.8.c: Works of European philosophy for comparative study.
japan_religion.9.d: The ongoing war effort has led to debates among the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] about the role of Buddhism in supporting the country during a violent conflict.
japan_religion.9.a: Force is necessary to establish lasting peace.
japan_religion.10.d: Since the end of Sakoku, meat-oriented restaurants have become increasingly common in port cities to cater to foreigners. This has called into question the standing ban on meat-eating in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
japan_religion.10.a: We must lift this ban, for nutrition and culinary expansion!
japan_religion.10.b: We will not let this barbarian practice take hold!
japan_religion.11.d: The separation of Shinto and Buddhist practices has been a success. The influence of the old religious institutions is waning and a new era of devotion to the gods, the emperor and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] dawns.
japan_religion.12.d: After navigating a tumultuous time of upheaval for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] have managed to reassert themselves as the country's religious authority and strengthened their ties to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetName].
japan_religion.13.d: The Proclamation of the Great Doctrine, declaring worship of the kami and reverence for the divine Emperor as principles of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] state and the duty of its citizens.
japan_religion.13.a: They must be heard throughout the country!
concept_gongen_desc: A Buddha manifesting as a kami, pairing an indigenous deity with a bringer of Buddhist enlightenment.
concept_boddhisattva_desc: In Buddhism, an enlightened being and teacher who helps other attain nirvana.
je_ryukyu_rivalry_reaffirm_suzerainty_bu: Ryukyu's court favors our opponent. We must remind them of their obligations to our domain, and bring them back under our influence.
ryukyu_rivalry_reaffirm_suzerainty_butto: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] exerts less #tooltippable;tooltip:ryukyu_rivalry_sway_tt #b Sway#!#! over [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName] than its opponent
ryukyu_rivalry_large_influence_gain_self: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] gains #green 3#! monthly #tooltippable;tooltip:ryukyu_rivalry_sway_tt #b Sway#!#! until end of [concept_journal_entry]
je_ryukyu_rivalry_sway_merchants_button_: By overseeing Naha's harbor, we can place envoys at court to sway which foreign powers gain access to trade and tribute.
ryukyu_rivalry_sway_merchants_button_tt: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] own a level #v 2#! or higher [GetBuildingType('building_port').GetName] in the [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetAdjective] [concept_capital_state]
je_ryukyu_rivalry_inspect_defenses_butto: With military access secured, we can send a trusted general to examine Ryukyu's fortifications, ensuring walls and watchtowers reflect our oversight and strategic intent.
je_ryukyu_rivalry_honor_kikoeogimi_butto: Pay tribute to the Kikoe-ōgimi, whose authority over court rituals and sacred observances can lend weight to our influence in Ryukyu's councils.
ryukyu_rivalry.1.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName] increasingly favors [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. In response, [SCOPE.sCountry('rival_scope').GetName] has hastened her own diplomatic efforts, providing tokens of respect while quietly reinforcing the obligations of [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]'s tributary relationship.
ryukyu_rivalry.1.f: Sealed boxes had been set with great care in the Ryukyuan hall. Courtiers whispered behind screens as letters were read aloud: one sealed with the red-stamped script of China, another bearing the careful calligraphy of Japan. With every phrase, they outlined duties and promises, as two powers tried to pull the kingdom their way.
ryukyu_rivalry.1.a: Issue a formal protest to the [SCOPE.sCountry('rival_scope').GetName].
ryukyu_rivalry.1.c: Remind the court of our long-standing patronage.
ryukyu_rivalry.1.e: This matter does not warrant intervention.
ryukyu_rivalry.1.tt1: [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName] is subject of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] with [concept_liberty_desire] lower than #v 25#!
ryukyu_rivalry.1.tt2: [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName] is not a subject of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] with at least #v Amicable#! [concept_relations]
ryukyu_rivalry.2.d: The presence of [SCOPE.sCountry('rival_scope').GetAdjective] envoys at [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName]'s ports has drawn the attention and cooperation of many [GetCulture('ryukyuan').GetName] merchants, strengthening their position in the eyes of the court. Our own sway has diminished in turn.
ryukyu_rivalry.2.f: Merchant ledgers had closed and reopened under different seals. Those who once sought our assurances now lingered in other reception halls, speaking of revised tariffs and safer passage. Coin, it seemed, had found a more persuasive steward.
ryukyu_rivalry.3.d: A general, [SCOPE.sCharacter('ryukyu_general_scope').GetFullName], with a retinue of officers, has arrived at [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName], seemingly to inspect the coastal defenses. Their presence has been acknowledged with respectful submission, strengthening [SCOPE.sCountry('rival_scope').GetName]'s influence at court while subtly eroding our own.
ryukyu_rivalry.3.f: The general strode along the ramparts with [SCOPE.sCharacter('ryukyu_general_scope').GetHerHis] officers, taking note of every cannon and watchtower. The Ryukyuan forces fell into formation, well-aware of evaluating eyes. Every gesture and salute would help tighten the invisible threads woven between the two powers.
ryukyu_rivalry_risk_of_confrontation: @warning! If forces from both [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetName] are inspecting coastal defenses, a #r confrontation#! may break out
ryukyu_rivalry.4.d: A general, [SCOPE.sCharacter('ryukyu_general_scope').GetFullName], with a retinue of officers from [SCOPE.sCountry('from_scope').GetName] has been received in [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName], eager to inspect our coastal defenses. Their presence has been acknowledged with respectful submission.
ryukyu_rivalry.4.a: Keep a close eye on them.
ryukyu_rivalry.5.d_victor: Our efforts in [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName] have borne fruit. Through sustained diplomatic, economic, and political pressure, their court now looks to us for guidance, and the question of their sovereignty has been resolved in our favor.
ryukyu_rivalry.5.d_loser: Despite our efforts, [SCOPE.sCountry('victor_scope').GetName] has secured decisive sway over [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName]. Their court has accepted a new political reality, placing the islands firmly within [SCOPE.sCountry('victor_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]'s sphere.
ryukyu_rivalry.5.d_ryu: The balance we sought to maintain can no longer be sustained. Under mounting pressure from [SCOPE.sCountry('victor_scope').GetName], our court has accepted a new political arrangement. The future of [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName] will now unfold under their ascendancy.
ryukyu_rivalry.5.f_annexed: Proclamations, written in ink still fresh on seals issued in [SCOPE.sCountry('victor_scope').GetCapital.GetName], were read in Naha's market square. [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] banners were taken down and replaced with the ruler's standard. By nightfall, the administrative office had been established, and new edicts posted.
ryukyu_rivalry.5.f_subject: Proclamations, written in ink still fresh on seals issued in [SCOPE.sCountry('victor_scope').GetCapital.GetNameNoFormatting], were read in Naha's market square. Each decree would define [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName]'s new place within the realm. Long a tributary to distant courts, the kingdom now saw its magistrates bound by formal obligations to a greater power. By nightfall, its course had been set.
ryukyu_rivalry.6.d_brawl: Officers dispatched by [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetName] have come to blows while inspecting the coastal defenses of [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName]. The dispute has resulted in a death, drawing anxious glances from the Ryukyuan court.
ryukyu_rivalry.6.d_accident: Forces from [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetName] sent to inspect coastal defenses have overlapped along the same fortifications in [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName], causing confusion among the garrison and a brief exchange of fire.
ryukyu_rivalry.6.d_fire: A fire has broken out within the lodgings assigned to the foreign inspection missions in [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName], consuming the quarters of the [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetAdjective] and [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetAdjective] contingents. The cause remains unclear, though local officials whisper of misplaced lanterns.
ryukyu_rivalry.6.f: Officer Kaimon ran between watchtowers and storehouses, passing orders to the guards. Every command shouted, contradicted, and repeated in quick succession. Though calmness eventually returned, Kaimon had been reminded of how competing missions between foreign powers could expose Ryukyu's fragile situation.
ryukyu_rivalry.7.d_ryukyu: After years of careful observation and subtle diplomacy, our council has declared its intent to govern its affairs without external interference. The court has set firm limits on outside influence, and enshrined the primacy of its own rituals, ministers, and traditional councils. The kingdom now charts its own course.
ryukyu_rivalry.7.d: After years of careful observation and subtle diplomacy, [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName] has cast off our influence and declared its intent to govern its affairs without external interference. The court has set firm limits on our presence, maintaining its rituals, ministers, and traditional councils as the kingdom turns away from our authority.
ryukyu_rivalry.7.f: Seals and tribute registers had been torn and scattered across the polished floors of Shuri Castle. In the audience halls, the influences of foreign powers were still felt, but no longer dictated action. Ryukyu's path would unfold in the form of a fragile neutrality, gained through patient diplomacy.
ryukyu_rivalry.7.a: The question of allegiance is settled.
ryukyu_rivalry.7.b: The use of force remains available to us.
ryukyu_rivalry.8.d: With [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetName] opening its ports, the long-dormant question of  [SCOPE.sCountry('ryukyu_scope').GetName]'s allegiance has resurfaced. For generations, the kingdom has walked a careful line. Outwardly a tributary of  [SCOPE.sCountry('china_scope').GetName], yet quietly maintaining allegiance to [SCOPE.sCountry('japan_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]. Both powers must now consider how to assert their influence.
ryukyu_rivalry.8.f: Lanterns glowed along the corridors of Shuri Castle, casting light on vermilion beams which the kings of Chūzan had raised in their great days. Beneath the painted ceilings, clerks laid tribute beside Satsuma decrees. The court had long balanced between investiture from the Middle Kingdom and the shadow of Kagoshima. Calmness endured for now, but the question of allegiance would soon demand its full attention.
je_sakoku_reason: Since the Kan'ei era and the earliest days of Tokugawa power, $JAP$ has been a country closed to outsiders. A trickle of trade with a few select nations at a few designated ports is all that has ever been allowed. While this system has lasted for more than two centuries, the world is beginning to change in ways that make it harder to keep the country locked down, even if interests within $JAP$ wish things could remain the same forever. If foreign attempts to open our lands cannot be stopped, then we must import their ideas as well as their goods.
je_sakoku_meiji_restoration: The #b Emperor#! has been restored to power and the #b Shōgun#! overthrown
je_sakoku_stop_being_closed_button_desc: The escalating situation and increasing pressures from abroad have made the end of [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetName] an outright emergency. Under these circumstances, we may be able to forcibly end the old system of isolation, but this will infuriate everyone who still supports the old laws.
notification_morrison_incident_has_incid: An adventurous merchant from our lands attempted to violate $JAP_ADJ$ restrictions on foreign trade ships and has been fired upon by a shore battery, souring relations between our nations.
ep2_sakoku.1.d: Our vast and venerable neighbor, [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_loser').GetName], has just lost a war over opium and trade against some upstart overseas nation. If [SCOPE.sCountry('opium_wars_loser').GetNameNoFormatting] cannot control her own market and keep the foreigners out, how can we maintain [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetName] in our own lands?
ep2_sakoku.1.a: The unthinkable must now be considered.
ep2_sakoku.1.b: The unthinkable must now be embraced.
end_sakoku_button_now_available: The option to forcibly end [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetName] early will now be visible in $je_sakoku$.
ep2_sakoku.2.d: With tumult rising from within and without, the [GetLawType('law_bakufu').GetName] has chosen to press for an immediate end to [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetName].
ep2_sakoku.2.f: A crowd of merchants flooded the customs house. Facing them, a single harried official stood alone.
ep2_sakoku.2.c: [GetLawType('law_protectionism').GetName] shall let us trade cautiously with foreign interests
ep2_sakoku.3.d: A merchant from [SCOPE.sCountry('morrison_incident_country').GetName] has attempted to ignore the strict protocols of [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetName] and trade at an unsanctioned port. Their vessel, the #italic [SCOPE.sCharacter('morrison_incident_country_namesake').GetLastNameNoFormatting]#!, has been driven away under fire by coastal batteries. Relations, such as they are, with [SCOPE.sCountry('morrison_incident_country').GetNameNoFormatting] have soured.
ep2_sakoku.3.f: The commander grinned as a cannonball finally struck the ship. The law was very clear; the ship had no right to sail these waters. He did not care what the captain aboard that vessel thought. All he wanted was for that ship to turn around and leave.
ep2_sakoku.3.a: The local garrison did what it was supposed to do.
ep2_sakoku.3.b: We should apologize to [SCOPE.sCountry('morrison_incident_country').GetNameNoFormatting] and compensate the merchant to smooth things over.
ep2_sakoku.3.c: This is the opportunity we need to review the necessity of [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetName]
ep2_sakoku.4.d: Navigating pressures from within and without, [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetName] has been overturned. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] has unlocked a new future for herself.
ep2_sakoku.4.f: The official looked out over the bay. New ships were at the docks. Unfamiliar ships, waving flags he had never seen before. What did they offer [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]? What did they seek to take from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]?\n\nHis gaze lingered on the docked ships for a long, long time, before he finally turned away. His eyes would not be able to give him the answer he wanted, not today. Only time would be able to tell him what this new era would give to his homeland.
ep2_sakoku.5.d: The continued observance of [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetName] in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting], even as the country is rocked by seismic political shifts, bodes ill for any hope of breaking out of the country's self-imposed isolation. It seems like [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetNameNoFormatting] is here to stay.
ep2_sakoku.5.f: The official looked out over the bay. Old ships sat at the docks, the same that his father would have seen, or his grandfather, or his ancestors for several generations back. Would his children see the same ships? His grandchildren? Would this vista ever change?\n\nHis gaze lingered on the docked ships for a long, long time, before he finally turned away. His eyes would not be able to give him the answer he wanted, not today. Only time would be able to tell if his homeland would truly remain the same forever.
meiji.14.d: Despite the heady promises of reform championed by the new [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('JAP_era_name')] government, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] has undergone no major changes. Critics lament that the state today is little different from the state before the Restoration.
meiji.14.f: An enormous engine huffed and chugged on the factory floor, spinning an enormous flywheel and powering tremendous lathes and drills. Those machines were carving new barrels, new locks, new triggers, for a vast new arsenal of weapons. A nation would soon wield this steam and iron to stamp their mark on the world—and that nation would not be [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting].
meiji.14.a: Today, the sun rests on a dream.
je_end_edo_system_button_desc: In this age of reform and renewal, the caste system of old holds us back. Every citizen can be a valuable part of the state, no matter their station in life.
edo_system_not_support_enforcement_tt: Does not support enactment of [GetLawType('law_intermediate_edo_system').GetName] or [GetLawType('law_strict_edo_system').GetName]
notification_edo_system_disappears_desc: Due to recent cultural and societal changes, the Edo System is no longer a recognized [concept_social_hierarchy] in [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country_scope').GetName].
