government_conflicts.3.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] are dissatisfied with the inclusion of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_ig').GetName] in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] government.
government_conflicts.3.a: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
government_conflicts.3.b: The power of money must be kept in check.
government_conflicts.3.c: Prosperity and charity should be companions, not enemies.
government_conflicts.4.d: Disagreements between the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] are causing conflicts in government.
government_conflicts.4.a: Superstitious nonsense belongs in the past.
government_conflicts.4.b: Eschewing tradition is the height of arrogance.
government_conflicts.4.c: Science determines fact, faith determines morality.
government_conflicts.5.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] are dissatisfied with the inclusion of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] government.
government_conflicts.5.a: All the charity in the world does not solve poverty.
government_conflicts.5.b: The labor movement could stand to be a bit more humble.
government_conflicts.5.c: Don't let different methods stand in the way of your common goals.
government_conflicts.6.d: Disagreements between the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('petty_bourgeoisie_ig').GetName] and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] are causing conflicts in government.
government_conflicts.6.a: No progress was ever made without putting theory into practice.
government_conflicts.6.b: So-called intellectuals should keep their feet on the ground.
government_conflicts.6.c: We need progress, but at a safe and reliable pace.
government_conflicts.7.d: Disagreements between the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('petty_bourgeoisie_ig').GetName] and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] are causing conflicts in government.
government_conflicts.7.a: The workers should be led by workers.
government_conflicts.7.b: Those who earn success deserve to reap its fruits.
government_conflicts.7.c: The important thing is that work gets done, not how.
government_conflicts.8.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rural_folk_ig').GetName] are dissatisfied with the inclusion of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_ig').GetName] in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] government.
government_conflicts.8.a: Like it or not, industrialization is the future.
government_conflicts.8.b: We must not forget those who feed the city-dwellers.
government_conflicts.8.c: Factories and farms will be equally needed in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s future.
government_conflicts.9.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] are dissatisfied with the inclusion of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_ig').GetName] in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] government.
government_conflicts.9.a: The army keeps the peace. Disturb it at your peril.
government_conflicts.9.b: The struggle within is more important than the struggle without.
government_conflicts.9.c: Let us hope the conflict never escalates that far.
government_conflicts.10.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_ig').GetName] are dissatisfied with the inclusion of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] government.
government_conflicts.10.a: Respect the soldiers who protect your right to pontificate.
government_conflicts.10.b: Do what you do best, soldiers, and follow orders.
government_conflicts.10.c: A nation needs protection from both armies and bad ideas.
government_conflicts.11.d: Disagreements between the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_ig').GetName] are causing conflicts in government.
government_conflicts.11.b: Workers deserve the fruits of their labor.
government_conflicts.11.c: Try to set class conflict aside for the common causes.
ig_petitions.1.d: Men associated with the influential [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_ig').GetName] have approached the government, seeking reforms. They argue that voting rights have expanded too much, too quickly, and ask the government to consider rolling back the passing of the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
ig_petitions.1.b: Restricting the franchise? Out of the question!
ig_petitions.4.d: Followers of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] have expressed their support to the government efforts to recognize the beliefs of the faithful as the one true church of the state and formally implement a [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
ig_petitions.4.a: This will greatly support our cause.
ig_petitions.4.b: We cannot let the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] become too influential.
ig_petitions.7.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('intelligentsia_leader').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName], has publicly supported the government efforts to pass the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law. However, there are some that think [SCOPE.sCharacter('intelligentsia_leader').GetSheHe]'s only doing it for [SCOPE.sCharacter('intelligentsia_leader').GetHerHis] own benefit.
ig_petitions.7.f: The scholar has been sitting all day in that velvet lined chair. He mutters about what's going on in the east. Something is always going on in the east.\n\n
ig_petitions.7.a: It would be good to ensure [SCOPE.sCharacter('intelligentsia_leader').GetSheHe] gets the necessary support.
ig_petitions.7.b: We cannot personalize the law in just one person.
ig_petitions.10.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rural_folk_ig').GetName] are already looking ahead to the next harvest. The draft regularly draws away the most able hands away from the farm just when they're needed most. A delegation has arrived, asking for a stop to the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
ig_petitions.10.f: Their sturdy hands are sweaty, sometimes they shake.
ig_petitions.10.b: The military needs men more than the farm needs hands.
ig_petitions.13.d: Representatives of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] have approached the government, expressing their disappointment in the passing of the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
ig_petitions.13.a: We should calm these people before we go ahead.
ig_petitions.13.b: We cannot let the public opinion have an impact in our decisions.
ig_petitions.16.d: A group of influential [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_ig').GetName] have approached the government, unhappy with the proposed tax system, which they say places an undue burden on the most successful members of society, and seek the repeal of the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law.
ig_petitions.16.b: They only want the rich to get richer.
ig_petitions.19.d: Officers from the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_ig').GetName] have expressed their support to the enactment of the new [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law. However, some have also raised their concerns about this lowering the overall quality of the army.
ig_petitions.19.b: We should invest in creating a reliable army.
ig_petitions.22.d: Members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('petty_bourgeoisie_ig').GetName] have vehemently expressed their support for the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law, writing articles in its favor.
ig_petitions.22.a: Tighter restrictions on citizenship are called for.
goldrush.1.d: Gold has been discovered in [SCOPE.sState('goldrush_state').GetName]. People from all corners of the earth are converging there, confident that they will discover the next great lode and become incredibly rich.
goldrush.1.f: It was a single, misplaced foot in the river. His son quick at his side, hoisting him from the water before the currents claimed him. Then, as the sediment rose with both his leg and his walking stick, they saw it: the unmistakable shimmer of Plutus' very blood. By next morning, they were both at the river with sieves and shovels. By that night, the whole town joined them.
gold_always_attract_tt: This event will be hidden in the future, and the above effects will be applied automatically during every gold rush.
gold_always_exploit_tt: This event will be hidden in the future, and the above effects will be applied automatically during every gold rush.
goldrush.2.d: The rich mineral deposits in [SCOPE.sState('goldrush_no_more_state').GetName] have been drained. Mines are being shuttered, and all the prospectors who moved in are beginning to drift away, in search of the next big strike.
goldrush.2.f:
#bold Alluvial Gold Dried Up: Miners Go Home#!

River dried up due to miner activity. Shafts condemned as threat to life.

#italic Enter at own peril. Trespassers will be shot. Survivors will be shot again.#!
goldrush.2.b: We cannot just let them leave!
goldrush.2.e: We should never let them leave!
gold_always_let_go_tt: This event will be hidden in the future, and the above effects will be applied automatically at the end of every gold rush.
gold_always_make_stay_tt: This event will be hidden in the future, and the above effects will be applied automatically at the end of every gold rush.
goldrush.3.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('petty_ig').GetName] have spoken out against the migrants moving into [SCOPE.sState('pb_gold_state').GetName], pleading with the government to support
goldrush.3.a: We need every spare hand we can get in [SCOPE.sState('pb_gold_state').GetNameNoFormatting].
goldrush.4.d: Miners and mine owners are both scrambling to protect their interests in [SCOPE.sState('gr4_gold_state').GetName] by formally organizing themselves and their work. However, the approaches of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_ig').GetName] cannot work together.
goldrush.5.d: A story has been making the rounds about a miner who struck it rich and became the wealthiest man in his town. People in [SCOPE.sState('gold_rush_state').GetName] are beginning to live beyond their means, convinced they'll all become rich soon enough.
goldrush.5.b: All that is gold does not glitter.
ig_leaders.20.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('reckless_leader').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('reckless_ig').GetName], has been openly preaching about the benefits that a mysterious and secret political gamble can bring to our government. When asked for details, [SCOPE.sCharacter('reckless_leader').GetSheHe] smiles coyly, refusing to elaborate.
ig_leaders.20.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('reckless_leader').GetFullNameNoFormatting] has always had a taste for adventure and suspiciously tall hats. [SCOPE.sCharacter('reckless_leader').GetHerHis|U] closest friends don't seem to pay attention to these dangerous qualities, but the most respectable gentlemen have voiced their concerns in a mildly passive aggressive manner.\n\n
ig_leaders.1.d: A dramatic scheme in our capital has just come to fruition. Now that it's been revealed, the plot obviously had its risks and flaws, but no one can deny that it's paid off handsomely for [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('reckless_ig').GetName] this time.
ig_leaders.1.b: The nation will reap the rewards.
ig_leaders.2.d: A dramatic scheme by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('reckless_ig').GetName] in our capital has just come to a disastrous end. The risks were high from the beginning, but [SCOPE.sCharacter('reckless_leader').GetFullName] decided it was worth pursuing nonetheless. The results have, of course, been calamitous for everyone involved.
ig_leaders.2.f: A judiciary struck his gavel three times. The courtroom stifled their cries of outrage, if only for a moment. No ally of [SCOPE.sCharacter('reckless_leader').GetFullNameNoFormatting] was coming for a daring rescue. Then in the silence before the judge spoke, it all became clear to the defendant... this venture was doomed from the start.
ig_leaders.2.a: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('reckless_ig').GetName] cannot be trusted with power.
ig_leaders.2.c: Steady on, leave the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('reckless_ig').GetName] in charge.
ig_leaders.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('meticulous_leader').GetFullName], the methodical leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('meticulous_ig').GetName], has been studiously working to increase the nation's credit. At last all [SCOPE.sCharacter('meticulous_leader').GetHerHis] work has paid off, but for the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('meticulous_ig').GetName] or for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]?
ig_leaders.3.f: The [SCOPE.sCharacter('meticulous_leader').GetWomanMan] is so pleased with [SCOPE.sCharacter('meticulous_leader').GetHerHis] acts that [SCOPE.sCharacter('meticulous_leader').GetSheHe] looks like [SCOPE.sCharacter('meticulous_leader').GetSheHe]'s about to burst into flames of contained emotion. How charming. Professionally speaking, though, not the most clever move.\n\n
ig_leaders.4.d: The ruling [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('charismatic_ig').GetName], led by the charismatic [SCOPE.sCharacter('charismatic_leader').GetFullName], has initiated a great promotional tour. The decision to focus efforts domestically or internationally has been left to the last minute, however, and it's unclear if [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('charismatic_ig').GetName] will do more for itself or for the country as a whole.
ig_leaders.4.a: The tour should drum up support for the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('charismatic_ig').GetName].
ig_leaders.4.b: The tour should drum up support for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
ig_leaders.5.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('smug_leader').GetFullName], leader of the ruling [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('smug_ig').GetName], has had enough of compromising with [SCOPE.sCharacter('smug_leader').GetHerHis] coalition partners. [SCOPE.sCharacter('meticulous_leader').GetSheHe|U] has demanded that either [SCOPE.sCharacter('smug_leader').GetHerHis] collaborators follow [SCOPE.sCharacter('smug_leader').GetHerHis] orders, or [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('smug_ig').GetName] will never approve of their changes.
ig_leaders.5.a: What a ridiculous thing to say.
ig_leaders.5.b: Very well, [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('smug_ig').GetName] shall be the leading force.
ig_leaders.6.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('reckless_out_of_govt_leader').GetFullName], leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('reckless_out_of_govt_ig').GetName], has made a remarkable play for power in the capital in order to secure a spot for [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('reckless_out_of_govt_ig').GetName] within the government. However, it's not entirely clear if they should be rewarded for their... novel tactics.
ig_leaders.6.f: There's only one light in the street that leads to the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('reckless_out_of_govt_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] headquarters. There's also only one light inside. There, [SCOPE.sCharacter('reckless_out_of_govt_leader').GetFullNameNoFormatting] relaxes among the sumptuous mahogany furniture and velvet cushions. The lamp is identical to those that have been sent from the East.\n\n
ig_leaders.6.b: Not all is fair in love and war.
neighbor_events.1.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('devout_ig').GetName] wish to strengthen our ties to [SCOPE.sC('neighbor_country').GetName] through our shared faith.
neighbor_events.1.f: He stopped for a moment, wiping his brow, when he noticed the [SCOPE.sC('neighbor_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] farmhand on the adjacent field seemed to be knelt down in the furrow.\n\nConfused, he peered over, finally noticing that the man was deep in prayer. He should have recognized it, but it had never crossed his mind what they might have in common: A few hard years and a faith that things would get better.
neighbor_events.1.a: Despite differences, we must cherish our shared values.
notification_neighbor_events_1_desc: [SCOPE.sC('originator').GetName] has improved our [concept_relations] by appealing to our shared [SCOPE.sC('originator').GetStateReligion.GetName] faith.
neighbor_events.2.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_ig').GetName] suggest a more hardline foreign policy towards [SCOPE.sC('neighbor_country').GetName] due to our poor relations.
neighbor_events.2.a: Set aside polite formalities. They are the enemy.
neighbor_events.2.b: Despite our mutual dislike, there is no need to escalate this.
neighbor_events.3.d: Internationalist sentiment within the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('trade_unions_ig').GetName] has generated suggestions to reach out to workers in [SCOPE.sC('neighbor_country').GetName].
neighbor_events.4.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('industrialists_ig').GetName] are interested in making investments in neighboring [SCOPE.sC('neighbor_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] industries.
neighbor_events.4.f: He stood up, put on his hat and headed towards the door. At first it seemed he would leave without another word, but then he turned around and spoke with barely suppressed anger.\n
neighbor_events.5.d: A newspaper banned under [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] law has started being printed again under the permissive laws of [SCOPE.sC('neighbor_country').GetName] and smuggled across the border.
neighbor_events.5.a: We can look the other way, just this once.
neighbor_events.5.b: Crack down hard on everyone spreading this filth!
neighbor_events.6.d: A book rejected for publication in [SCOPE.sC('neighbor_country').GetName] due to their restrictive laws has been accepted by a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] publisher.
neighbor_events.6.f: The printer's devil picked up an unfamiliar typeface. His master noticed his curiosity and nodded towards it.\n
neighbor_events.6.a: The publisher should show more tact and respect our neighbors.
neighbor_events.6.b: By the laws of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], they have the right to print it.
neighbor_events.7.t: The Other Side of the Fence
neighbor_events.7.d: People have been complaining about the difference in living standards between us and our neighbors in [SCOPE.sC('neighbor_country').GetName].
neighbor_events.7.f: After the shop door swung shut, they exchanged a meaningful glance.\n\n
neighbor_events.7.a: This is simply an example of global economic inequality.
neighbor_events.7.b: Clearly, they are liars who cheat foreigners out of money.
neighbor_events.7.c: It is the way things are, not worth thinking about.
commander_events.2.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('commander_with_addiction').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('commander_with_addiction').GetFullName]'s personal habits are starting to get in the way of [SCOPE.sCharacter('commander_with_addiction').GetHerHis] role as a [SCOPE.sCharacter('commander_with_addiction').GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
commander_events.2.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('commander_with_addiction').GetFullNameNoFormatting] smiles at the officer, exultantly, avidly. [SCOPE.sCharacter('commander_with_addiction').GetHerHis|U] eyes have obviously seen better days. Carefully recumbent on [SCOPE.sCharacter('commander_with_addiction').GetHerHis] leather armchair, [SCOPE.sCharacter('commander_with_addiction').GetHerHis] voice comes out as rubbery as the material:\n\n
commander_events.4.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('arguing_commander_one').GetFullName] has brought to light some questionable habits that [SCOPE.sCharacter('arguing_commander_two').GetFullName] partakes in and is demanding they be fired.
commander_events.5.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('commander_invention').GetFullName] has worked out how to improve upon the  invention of the #bold repeaters#!.
law_events.1.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('anti_conscription_ig').GetName] argues that citizens with moral or religious objections to violence should be exempt from [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName].
law_events.1.a: Objectors are excluded from the draft.
law_events.2.d: The newly established police force has requested that the streets be lit to make their job much easier.
law_events.4.d: The secret police have requested that you research $identification_documents$.
law_events.5.d: Several mine owners from [SCOPE.sState('state_with_mine').GetName] are requesting an exemption from the mining regulations.
law_events.6.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] have shown their unhappiness with the passing of the [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] law, arguing that education and religion should be separate matters.
notification_expedition_progress_average: Your current expedition proceeds without incident
Your expedition continues to make steady progress
expedition_events.1.t: Expedition to Plot the Niger River
expedition_events.1.d: Despite many attempts to navigate it, the full course of this river remains a mystery. Shall we send an expedition to attempt to plot the course of the river?
expedition_events.1.a: I know the person for the job.
expedition_events.2.d: A group of strong candidates have expressed their interest in leading the expedition. However, this is not a decision we should make lightly.
expedition_events.2.f: The first to arrive was a well-dressed, fresh-faced, almost young gentleman whose keenness to impress was only matched by his willingness to oblige. His smile, as wide as one can imagine, was fashionably put together:
expedition_events.3.d: How much money would you like to assign to the expedition budget?
expedition_events.4.d: After a few weeks of preparation and travel, the expedition to plot the course of the River Niger led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has arrived at their starting point.
expedition_events.30.d: One member of the expedition has suggested that we stop at some of the nearby settlements and try to hire some local guides. Other members of the group have expressed concerns this might take a while.
expedition_events.30.b: No, it will take too long.
expedition_events.31.d: After a few hours, some guides have been found and payment has been settled on.
expedition_events.32.d: Not a second passed two hours did it dawn on [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetLastNameNoFormatting]'s navigator that they were utterly, irrevocably lost. An eager footman then quickly put forth the idea of abandoning the search for local guides in favor of finding the river bank again.
expedition_events.40.d: In the night a member of the expedition fell off the boat. We could spend time looking for them, or we could move on.
expedition_events.41.d: The latest report from the expedition informs us that several of the crew have come down with malaria.
expedition_events.41.b: Tell them to rest for a while.
expedition_events.50.d: While the expedition is traveling by river they are attacked by locals.
expedition_events.51.d: The expedition manages to successfully defend from the attack.
expedition_events.52.d: The expedition fails to defend from the attack and has to retreat.
expedition_events.53.d: The expedition leaves the area as quickly as it can.
expedition_events.60.d: A member of the expedition has requested that they pause for a day, so that they can film some of the local wildlife.
expedition_events.70.d: The latest report from the expedition is that several of the crew have come down with cases of dysentery. One member has even died.
expedition_events.70.b: Tell them to rest for a while.
expedition_events.80.d: A hippopotamus has been sighted further along the river. It might be safer to wait for it to move on than to try to row past it.
expedition_events.80.a: We will try to go past it.
expedition_events.81.d: The earlier sighted hippo has rammed one of the expedition boats, flipping it. Two crew members died and some supplies were lost.
expedition_events.82.d: The hippo did not move as we continued down river, and we managed to pass on without incident. Its eyes apathetic to our presence.
expedition_events.83.d: The expedition waited for a few hours, and eventually the Hippo moved on.
expedition_events.90.d: The expedition comes across some graves dug at the side of the river. The trinkets and items left atop them indicate it is all that remains of a previous expedition.
expedition_events.90.a: Even in Arcadia, It is still here.
expedition_events.100.d: Word arrives from the expedition that several of the members including [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] have been kidnapped by a local king who is demanding a ransom.
expedition_events.100.b: They will need to figure it out.
expedition_events.101.d: After organizing the payment of the ransom, the expedition crew is released unharmed and even sent in the correct direction.
expedition_events.102.d: Despite not paying the ransom, a few members of the expedition have managed to secure their freedom. However many more of the crew were left behind.
expedition_events.110.d: During a small skirmish, a musket ball embedded itself in [SCOPE.sCharacter('dead_expedition_leader').GetHerHis] leg. The wound itself was fine but the infection wasn't. [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has taken over as the new leader.
expedition_events.110.a: Lets hope the new leader is competent.
expedition_events.11.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has returned triumphantly, the course and termination of the Niger River has been plotted.
expedition_events.12.d: After not receiving any reports for many months, it has become clear that your expedition to find the source of the Niger River has failed and [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has been lost along with it.
civil_war_events.1.d: Despite our pessimistic expectations, our national kindred won their own struggle for independence—without our help.
treaty_port_inheritance_events.1.d: With the old regime swept aside, the treaty ports it once granted to [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] have passed into our keeping. Their merchants still raise a foreign flag over our harbors under agreements we never signed. We may honor what we have inherited, or cast the foreigners out and reclaim these ports for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
treaty_port_inheritance_events.2.d: There has been an upheaval in the lands about our treaty ports. With the previous regime gone, [SCOPE.sC('new_host').GetName] has chosen to honor the agreements struck with those who came before. Our merchants may continue to fly our flag over their harbors.
treaty_port_inheritance_events.3.d: There has been an upheaval in the lands about our treaty ports. With the previous regime gone, [SCOPE.sC('new_host').GetName] has torn up the agreements struck with those who came before. Our ports have been seized and our merchants turned out into the street. This insult shall not soon be forgotten.
diplomatic_events.1.d: [SCOPE.sC('initiator').GetName] has sent an ultimatum to [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] demanding they join them in the [SCOPE.sW('war').GetName|v] war.\nThey refused and sided with [SCOPE.sW('war').GetLeaderOfOppositeSide( SCOPE.sC('initiator') ).GetName]!\nWhat do we do?
diplomatic_events.1.f: The smoke coming from the fireplace is enough to stain the windows of the office with a pale smog, now that the sunset is imminent. The street lamps are getting lit, and two men share a concerned look.\n\n
violate_sovereignty_tt: Join the [concept_war] in the defense of [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName]
cultural_homeland_events.1.d: Some [SCOPE.sCulture('state_majority_culture').GetName] people are unfairly blaming the poor living conditions in [SCOPE.sState('culture_state').GetName] on their [SCOPE.sCulture('state_minority_culture').GetName] neighbors.
cultural_homeland_events.1.a: We all must learn to live together.
cultural_homeland_events.10.d: A newspaper called the [SCOPE.sState('culture_state').GetNameNoFormatting] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('newspaper_type')] has printed a bigoted article about the [SCOPE.sCulture('state_minority_culture').GetName] people living there. We can suppress the article or we can let it be released.
cultural_homeland_events.10.f: He threw the tabloid across the table with a huff.
cultural_homeland_events.20.d: [SCOPE.sCulture('state_minority_culture').GetName] people in [SCOPE.sState('culture_state').GetName] are being blocked from entering certain businesses by some local [SCOPE.sCulture('state_majority_culture').GetName] people.
cultural_homeland_events.20.b: Shopkeepers can sell—or not sell—to who they like.
cultural_homeland_events.30.d: [SCOPE.sCulture('state_minority_culture').GetName] people are having a hard time getting employed in [SCOPE.sState('culture_state').GetName], due to the prejudices of some [SCOPE.sCulture('state_majority_culture').GetName] employers.
cultural_homeland_events.30.b: It's up to bosses to decide who they hire.
cultural_homeland_events.40.d: [SCOPE.sCulture('state_minority_culture').GetName] businesses and homes have been attacked all across [SCOPE.sState('culture_state').GetName] by groups of [SCOPE.sCulture('state_majority_culture').GetName] people.
cultural_homeland_events.40.b: Our hands are tied for... reasons.
cultural_homeland_events.50.d: [SCOPE.sCulture('state_minority_culture').GetName] people are being attacked and killed by some members of the [SCOPE.sCulture('state_majority_culture').GetName] people in [SCOPE.sState('culture_state').GetName].
cultural_homeland_events.50.a: Order and morality must be restored!
cultural_homeland_events.50.b: I'm afraid there's nothing we can do.
notification_west_america_expedition_pro: West America Expedition continues without problems.
West America Expedition continues without problems.
expedition_events.200.t: Expedition to Map the Western Frontier
expedition_events.200.d: Send out an expedition to map the unknown geography of the Western Frontier.
expedition_events.200.a: I know the person for the job.
expedition_events.202.d: How much money would you like to assign to the expedition budget?
expedition_events.205.d: After several weeks of silence, the expedition to map the Western Frontier led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] has come back, empty handed.
expedition_events.300.d: After a long and arduous journey, the expedition has finally come to an end. The most interesting discovery of the journey, was that the long fabled Buenaventura river does not actually exist!
expedition_events.300.a: A disappointment, but an educational one.
expedition_events.301.d: After a long and arduous journey, the expedition has finally come to an end. The expedition has managed to map the entire length of the Oregon Trail.
expedition_events.302.d: After a long and arduous journey, the expedition has finally come to an end. The expedition has managed to find and map the entirety of the Great Salt Lake
expedition_events.220.d: The expedition members come across a river that is bursting at the banks. They can try to raft across, which would be quick, but dangerous. Alternatively, they could search for a more suitable place to cross, though this could take some time.
expedition_events.221.d: The expedition successfully crossed the river, with little to no difficulty.
expedition_events.222.d: Unfortunately the expedition's raft capsized while crossing the river and several supplies were lost.
expedition_events.230.d: A large grizzly has been sighted up ahead. We could hang back and wait for it to leave or we could hunt it.
expedition_events.230.b: Better to wait for it to leave.
expedition_events.231.d: The expedition has successfully hunted and killed the grizzly bear.
expedition_events.232.d: The expedition attempted to hunt the bear but it went wrong.
expedition_events.233.d: The grizzly bear that was earlier ignored, attacks the expedition.
expedition_events.240.d: A member of the expedition wishes to stop for a day or so and take some wildlife photographs.
expedition_events.240.b: There is no time for this.
expedition_events.250.d: A member of the expedition has suggested we detour to climb a mountain and claim it in the name of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
expedition_events.251.d: Upon arriving at the summit of the mountain you see it already had been claimed by [SCOPE.sCountry('mountain_claim_country').GetName].
expedition_events.252.d: The expedition has scaled the mountain and claimed it in the name of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. They have also decided to name it 'Mount [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetLastName]'.
expedition_events.252.f: With one, final heave, [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullNameNoFormatting] threw [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetHerselfHimself] over the lip of the last cliff. As [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetSheHe] straightened both posture and snowy clothes, the first light of a new day broke behind them. A hero's welcome to the west, and a mountain claimed. And the cream on top of the mash, the flag of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting], brought forth by a younger expeditionary.
expedition_events.253.d: While climbing the mountain, a rockfall struck a member of the expedition, rendering them unconscious. The group was forced to turn back.
expedition_events.253.f: As the rocks tumbled down the mountain, snow cascading in their wake, blood dripped over the ledge where a struck expeditionary lay. The steam escaping his split lips were the only sign of life from the poor boy. With a pang of guilt, [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullNameNoFormatting] threw the boy over [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetHerHis] shoulders and marched down the mountain.
expedition_events.260.d: Some members of the expedition have expressed concern that the weather is turning against them. They insist on hunkering down to avoid the worst of it.
expedition_events.261.d: While it was difficult, the expedition has successfully pushed through the snow.
expedition_events.262.d: Unfortunately the expedition got caught in a snow storm, a few members died and several supplies were lost.
expedition_events.263.d: After a while the snow has subsided enough to push on.
expedition_events.270.d: A member of the expedition has asked for a few days to stop and collect samples of a previously unknown plant species.
expedition_events.280.d: The expedition to map the west has been traveling in circles. [SCOPE.sCharacter('expedition_leader').GetFullName] can either pick a random direction and push on, or wait for night to fall and use the stars as a guide.
expedition_events.281.d: The members of the expedition managed to get even more lost. Eventually they found the right way but not before wasting a large amount of supplies and time.
expedition_events.282.d: The expedition managed to find the correct trail again and have set off, losing relatively little time.
expedition_events.400.d: Our survey of the Suez Isthmus is complete. We have confirmed that it would be possible to construct a canal linking the Mediterranean to the Red Sea.
expedition_events.410.d: Our survey of the Panama Isthmus is complete. We have confirmed that it would be possible to construct a canal linking the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
ig_revolutions.1.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_on_the_edge').GetName], led by wily [SCOPE.sCharacter('ig_on_the_edge_leader').GetFullName], have threatened to join the revolutionary forces if their demands are not met. Although the concessions they demand are small, the power they will wield if we admit our weakness to them shall be tremendous.
ig_revolutions.1.a: Give them what they ask for.
ig_revolutions.1.b: We will give them nothing but cold steel!
ig_revolutions.2.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_lo_on_the_edge').GetName] are on the precipice of revolt, threatening to join the revolution if certain demands are not met.
ig_revolutions.2.a: Whatever satisfies their so-called 'dignity', let them have it.
ig_revolutions.2.b: Ridiculous! They have no right to ask for anything.
ig_revolutions.2.c: They can be dignified in handcuffs.
ig_revolutions.3.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_rf_on_the_edge').GetName] are furious with the government, and it seems that they may join the current revolution if we cannot appease them.
ig_revolutions.3.a: Let us hope concessions now can be the seed of peace for the future.
ig_revolutions.3.b: They will get nothing from us!
ig_revolutions.3.c: If they sow the wind, then they can reap the whirlwind!
ig_revolutions.4.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_dv_on_the_edge').GetName] claim to have suffered under our 'amoral' government for far too long, and now have nailed a list of demands on the door of a government office.
ig_revolutions.4.a: Let us grant them these concessions and pray for peace.
ig_revolutions.4.b: I don't care a fig for what they want!
ig_revolutions.4.c: They can believe what they please in jail.
ig_revolutions.5.d: Officers associated strongly with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_af_on_the_edge').GetName] have publicly issued a list of grievances, and demand immediate action from the government. Dark rumors suggest they may join the revolution if they are not satisfied.
ig_revolutions.5.a: We salute the sacrifices our soldiers have made and recognize their need for support.
ig_revolutions.5.b: Here's some orders for you: Get out!
ig_revolutions.5.c: I believe it's time for our boys in blue to serve the nation.
ig_revolutions.6.d: A disgruntled consortium of [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_in_on_the_edge').GetName], unhappy with the government, are demanding 'compensation'. If we refuse, they threaten to throw in their lot with the Revolution.
ig_revolutions.6.b: Let's pass—their price is too high.
ig_revolutions.6.c: The only thing they'll get is time in prison.
ig_revolutions.7.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_it_on_the_edge').GetName] have written a manifesto, demanding the government make certain concessions in order to protect the public welfare and preserve liberty. If not, they hint that more drastic actions may be taken.
ig_revolutions.7.a: They make a strong case for concessions.
ig_revolutions.7.b: They make a strong case for nothing at all.
ig_revolutions.7.c: They make a strong case for their own imprisonment.
ig_revolutions.8.d: It seems that the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_pb_on_the_edge').GetName] are determined to extract concessions from the government during this moment of crisis. If we refuse to bend, they threaten to throw in their lot with the Revolution.
ig_revolutions.8.b: This is ridiculous! Let them try their worst.
ig_revolutions.8.c: If they want strength, we can show them that.
ig_revolutions.9.d: Extremely unhappy with the government, representatives of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_tu_on_the_edge').GetName] have now escalated matters and are seeking immediate concessions from the government. If nothing is done, their representatives airily suggest that actions may escalate further.
ig_revolutions.9.a: Very well, let the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_tu_on_the_edge').GetName] get their concessions.
ig_revolutions.9.b: We shall grant nothing to this rabble!
ig_revolutions.9.c: Times like these are what the police are for.
commander_events.6.d: An affair between [SCOPE.sCharacter('seducer_commander').GetFullName] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('cheated_leader').GetFullName]'s spouse has reached our ears, threatening to affect [SCOPE.sCharacter('cheated_leader').GetHerHis] public image if we don't destitute the general.
commander_events.6.f: As if being caught in the act wasn't enough, [SCOPE.sCharacter('seducer_commander').GetFullNameNoFormatting] stepped from the bath to see a telltale rash spreading. There was only one liaison [SCOPE.sCharacter('seducer_commander').GetSheHe] was seeing. Now, there was no denying it, not after the general's very flesh betrayed the affair.
commander_events.6.a: We still need a general, and these are personal matters.
commander_events.6.a.tt: We will just say [SCOPE.sCharacter('cheated_leader').GetFullNameNoFormatting] sat on the wrong toilet.
commander_events.6.b: We cannot trust a [SCOPE.sCharacter('seducer_commander').GetWomanMan] like this.
commander_events.6.c: They should settle accounts on their own.
unable_to_enact.1.d: Despite many efforts on the part of the government to successfully revive [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName] from its present imbroglio, the law has come to be regarded as nothing but an inevitable failure.
unable_to_enact.1.a: We must sponsor a complete rewrite of the bill.
unable_to_enact.1.b: Off to the fire with the entire notion, then.
unable_to_enact.2.d: After a series of costly and embarassing setbacks, the sitting [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] government has decided to halt its pursuit of [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetName]. It will be some time before political will exists to try again.
unable_to_enact.2.f: Defeat lingered in the air, along with the stench burnt tobacco and spoiling liquor. Hopes crushed, ideas splintered, and desire spoiled. For better or worse, the message was clear: nobody wanted [SCOPE.sLaw('current_law_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] but the men in the room.\n\nA long, treacherous path lay ahead to reingratiate the idea.

MULTIPLAYER_LOBBY_OPEN_GAME_RULES: Take a look at the Game Rules
setting_lenient_ai_behavior_desc: AI countries will act friendlier towards Player countries and treat them more leniently in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')]
setting_standard_ai_behavior_desc: AI countries will view Player and AI countries in the same way, with no special considerations for Players
setting_harsh_ai_behavior_desc: AI countries will be more suspicious of Player countries' intentions and treat them more harshly in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')]
setting_low_ai_aggression_desc: AI countries will start fewer [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] and are less inclined to conquer territory
setting_standard_ai_aggression_desc: AI countries have standard aggression settings based on their strategies
setting_high_ai_aggression_desc: AI countries will start more [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play', '$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] and are more inclined to conquer territory
setting_no_subject_flags_desc: The flags of [concept_subject] [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] will #b not#! change based on who their $suzerain$ is
setting_allow_subject_flags_desc: The flags of [concept_subject] [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] may change based on who their $suzerain$ is
setting_no_subject_map_color_desc: The map color of [concept_subject] [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] will #b not#! change based on who their $suzerain$ is
setting_allow_subject_map_color_desc: The map color of certain types of [concept_subject] [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] will change based on who their $suzerain$ is
setting_achievements_allowed_desc: Achievements can be unlocked during this campaign
setting_achievements_blocked_desc: Achievements will #b not#! be unlocked during this campaign
setting_all_formable_nations_desc: Allow implausible and fantasy-esque nations to be formed
setting_plausible_formable_nations_desc: Allow only historically plausible nations to be formed
setting_all_releasable_nations_desc: Allow implausible and fantasy-esque nations to be released
setting_plausible_releasable_nations_des: Allow only historically plausible nations to be released
setting_autonomous_investment_pool_desc: The [concept_investment_pool] will be used to autonomously fund [Concept('concept_private_construction', '$concept_private_constructions$')] of appropriate [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] depending on the [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_country_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')].
setting_directly_controlled_investment_p: The [concept_investment_pool] is drawn on directly by each [concept_country] and can be used to fund [Concept('concept_government_construction', '$concept_government_constructions$')] of appropriate [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] depending on the [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_country_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')].
setting_allow_monument_effects_desc: [Concept('concept_monument', '$concept_monuments$')] may produce a variety of different effects depending on its nature, and sometimes employ [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] to do so.
setting_prestige_only_monument_effects_d: All [Concept('concept_monument', '$concept_monuments$')] generate a fixed amount of [concept_prestige] for its country. No $concept_monument$ employ [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')].
setting_no_monument_effects_desc: [Concept('concept_monument', '$concept_monuments$')] are decorative only. The reward for constructing them is purely visual.
setting_loyalties_grace_period_none_desc: You bear the full brunt of both [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] and [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalists$')] right from the start.
setting_loyalties_grace_period_short_des: [concept_radical] and [concept_loyalist] gain starts out low but progressively increases, with full effect #v 1 year#! after game start.
setting_loyalties_grace_period_long_desc: [concept_radical] and [concept_loyalist] gain starts out low but progressively increases, with full effect #v 5 years#! after game start.
setting_loyalties_grace_period_extra_lon: [concept_radical] and [concept_loyalist] gain starts out low but progressively increases, with full effect #v 10 years#! after game start.
setting_free_construction_scaled_all_des: All [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] start with a base [concept_construction] capacity scaled to their [concept_gdp].
setting_free_construction_scaled_player_: Player-controlled countries always get the maximum amount of base [concept_construction], while AI-controlled [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] have it scaled to their [concept_gdp].
setting_free_construction_unscaled_desc: All countries receive the maximum amount of base [concept_construction], regardless of their [concept_gdp].
setting_no_consolidation_desc: [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] will never consolidate outside of [concept_assimilation] or [concept_conversion] rules, regardless of size.\n@warning! This could greatly harm performance in the mid- to late game
setting_minor_consolidation_desc: [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] will only consolidate if they are very small and ineffectual.\nMay harm performance in the mid- to late game.
setting_moderate_consolidation_desc: [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] may consolidate if they are quite small and have a limited impact on gameplay.
setting_aggressive_consolidation_desc: Given the right conditions even [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] of moderate size may consolidate.\n@warning! May improve performance, but will impact game balance
setting_allow_fantastical_content_desc: Allow supernatural or fantastical content during this campaign
setting_no_fantastical_content_desc: Allow no supernatural or fantastical content during this campaign
setting_no_custom_rng_seed_desc: The game will automatically set an RNG seed leading to different outcomes on each playthrough.
setting_use_custom_rng_seed_desc: Allows setting a specific RNG seed so most random outcomes follow that seed. As a result, initialization and observer games without player interaction will give the same results across multiple playthroughs using tha same seed.
setting_allow_dynamic_naming_desc: [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] and #bold cities#! will change their names based on the [concept_culture] of the [concept_country] that owns them
setting_no_dynamic_naming_desc: [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] and #bold cities#! will not change their names based on the [concept_culture] of the [concept_country] that owns them
setting_no_ruler_selector_desc: Allow no [concept_ruler] Selector during this campaign
TRIGGER_COUNTRY_IS_ON_SAME_CONTINENT: [COUNTRY.GetNameNoFlag] is on the same continent as [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName]
TRIGGER_COUNTRY_IS_ON_SAME_CONTINENT_NOT: [COUNTRY.GetNameNoFlag] is #bold not#! on the same continent as [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName]
geographic_region_honshu_desc: Historically known as #italic Akitsushima#!, or 'Dragonfly Island', Honshū is the largest island of the Japanese archipelago, and home to the majority of the its people and places of importance.
geographic_region_ezochi_desc: Ezochi refers to the northernmost islands of the Japanese archipelago, encompassing the island of Ezo, Kita-Ezochi, and the Kuril Islands. It has historically been regarded as a frontier territory, inhabited by the Ainu and other foreign peoples.
geographic_region_ring_of_fire_desc: A chain of seismically active sites and volcanoes around the edge of the Pacific Ocean.
geographic_region_alpide_belt_desc: A seismically active belt of earthquake epicenters.
geographic_region_great_rift_valley_desc: An active continental rift zone with some seismic activity.
geographic_region_polar_seas_desc: Seas bordering the polar regions, prone to sea ice.
geographic_region_tropical_seas_desc: Seas bordering the Equator, prone to tropical storms.
gov_absolute_kingdom_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the power rests completely with the [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_KING$')] or [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_QUEEN$')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_kingdom_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the power rests mainly with the [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_KING$')] or [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_QUEEN$')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_feudal_kingdom_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the power rests mainly with the feudal [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_KING$')] or [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_QUEEN$')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_constitutional_kingdom_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_KING$')] or [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_QUEEN$')] is the [concept_head_of_state], but [Concept('concept_votes','$concept_voting$')] and a constitution dictates the [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_absolute_empire_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the power rests completely with the [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_EMPEROR$')] or [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_EMPRESS$')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_empire_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the power rests partially with the [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_EMPEROR$')] or [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_EMPRESS$')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_feudal_empire_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the power rests completely with the feudal [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_EMPEROR$')] or [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_EMPRESS$')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$

gov_parliamentary_dictatorship_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a parliament which is led by a [Concept('concept_ruler','Dictator')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_parliamentary_oligarchy_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a rich and powerful political class.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_parliamentary_democracy_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a democratically [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elected$')] parliament.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_free_city_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_BURGOMASTER$')] chosen by a democratically [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elected$')] town council.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_parliamentary_single_party_state_des: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by an [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elected$')] parliament composed of representatives of a single legal political party.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_technate_parliamentary_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] ruled by the [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_CHIEF_ENGINEER$')], the senior figure on a board of technocratic professionals.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_american_parliamentary_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a democratically [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elected$')] legislature.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_american_parliamentary_dictator_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where a [Concept('concept_ruler','Dictator')] rules a [concept_country] through the institutions of a legislature.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_danubian_federation_parliamentary_re: This is a [concept_government_type] within which the state is organized into a multitude of federal units drawn along ethnic lines. Central power is held by a democratically [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elected$')] Bundesrat, headed by a [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_MINISTER_PRESIDENT$')].\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_danubian_federation_technocratic_par: This is a [concept_government_type] within which the state is organized into a multitude of federal units drawn along ethnic lines. Central power is held by the [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_CHIEF_ENGINEER$')], the senior figure on a board of technocratic professionals.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_danubian_federation_parliamentary_re: This is a [concept_government_type] within which the state is organized into a multitude of federal units drawn along ethnic lines. Central power is held by a Bundesrat selected by a rich and powerful political class.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_council_dictatorship_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by an unelected council.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_council_republic_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a council which is [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elected$')] directly by the workers.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_anarchist_commune_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] does not have a formal leadership structure and instead is made of self organizing communes.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_soviet_dictatorship_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by an unelected Soviet.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_soviet_republic_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a Soviet which is [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elected$')] directly by the workers.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_papal_commune_desc: A [concept_government_type] led by the principles of Christian Socialism and the traditions of the Catholic Church. Every man a Cardinal!
gov_soviet_single_party_state_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a Supreme Soviet which is [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elected$')] by the workers through the mechanisms of a dedicated communist party.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_council_single_party_state_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a council which is [Concept('concept_election','$concept_elected$')] by the workers through the mechanisms of a dedicated communist party.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_cybernetic_state_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a council of professionals, appointed by representatives of the technical organs of the socialist state.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
gov_phalanstere_desc: This is a [concept_government_type] where the [concept_country] is ruled by a council of professionals, appointed by representatives of the technical organs of the socialist state.\n\n$TRANSFER_OF_POWER_NAME_DESC$
transfer_of_power_hereditary_desc: Under Hereditary [concept_transfer_of_power], [Concept('concept_ruler', '$concept_rulers$')] reign for life and have an [concept_heir] who becomes the new $concept_ruler$ when the $concept_ruler$ dies.
transfer_of_power_presidential_elective_: Under Presidential Elective [concept_transfer_of_power], [Concept('concept_ruler', '$concept_rulers$')] are chosen from the leader of the [concept_interest_group] with the most [concept_clout] at the end of each [concept_election].
transfer_of_power_parliamentary_elective: Under Parliamentary Elective [concept_transfer_of_power], [Concept('concept_ruler', '$concept_rulers$')] are chosen from the leader of the [concept_interest_group] in [concept_government_type] with the most [concept_clout].
transfer_of_power_dictatorial_desc: Under Dictatorial [concept_transfer_of_power], [Concept('concept_ruler', '$concept_rulers$')] reign for life. On the death of the $concept_ruler$, a new $concept_ruler$ is chosen from the leader of the [concept_interest_group] with the most [concept_clout].
transfer_of_power_default_desc: Under Random [concept_transfer_of_power], [Concept('concept_ruler', '$concept_rulers$')] reign for life. On the death of the $concept_ruler$, a new $concept_ruler$ is randomly generated.
drought_desc: A prolonged period of time devoid of rainfall which leaves the affected land in an arid and barren state.
flood_desc: A stark reminder of nature's might, rising waters animated by incessant rainfall lay waste to the land and settlements alike.
frost_desc: A thin layer of ice that cloaks the lands in a delicate frozen blanket, as deceitfully beautiful from afar as it is devastating to the harvests underneath it.
wildfire_desc: A capricious and destructive fire whose wild flames lay waste to the land it roams.
hailstorm_desc: A form of precipitation in which falling lumps of ice inevitably damage crops and occasionally cause a bruise or two to anyone unlucky enough to get hit.
locust_swarm_desc: A surge of flying insects that take to the skies pillaging crops in their wake.
heatwave_desc: A suffocating mantle of abnormally hot weather where the ground sizzles like a scorching pan and the air overflows with oppressive heat.
disease_outbreak_desc: A desperate proliferation of rot and disease across crops, worrying farmers about the upcoming harvest.
extreme_winds_desc: A violent tempest that ravages the lands it passes through and is best avoided.
torrential_rains_desc: A prolonged period of rainfall so heavy that even one's sturdiest umbrella cannot protect against the deluge.
pollinator_surge_desc: A life-affirming frenzy of fragrances, nectar and vigor, set in motion by busy bees and other small insects dancing from flower to flower.
optimal_sunlight_desc: An occasion that is neither too warm nor cold, emanating with such delight the ideal amount of brightness that one cannot help but smile as a result.
moderate_rainfall_desc: A joyous event that breathes life into land below, from which eager crops rise to greet the drops falling from above.
tsunami_desc: An unstoppable force of water flattening and subsuming anything where it meets the land.
earthquake_desc: A violent, abrupt shaking of the Earth's surface that leaves ruin and devastation in its wake.
