texan_war_of_independence.2.title: Texan Revolution
texan_war_of_independence.2.desc: Upon victory we will remove the Texan Interest. If we lose then Texas will reclaim the full extent of their borders.
texan_war_of_independence.2.flavor: The unruly Texans have finally shown their true colors and declared war against our great nation. They aim to seize control of our lands, no doubt with backing from the United States of America fanning the flames.\nWe will stand against these traitors!
SETTING_INPUT_CONTEXT_COMMON_TOOLTIP: Keybinds for the common input context
institution_colonial_affairs_desc: The office handling the management of foreign colonial holdings.
institution_schools_desc: The nation's school system, ensuring growth in population literacy.
institution_social_security_desc: A safety net for the old or infirm.
institution_workplace_safety_desc: The ministry controlling that labor laws are followed.
institution_police_desc: The national police force enforcing the nation's laws.
institution_health_system_desc: Keeping the spread of disease at bay.
ig_trait_noblesse_oblige_desc: We are better than the common folk, which means we have a duty to care for them. Their attempts to organize things for themselves are self-destructive and doomed to failure.
ig_trait_family_ties_desc: In these changing times, we still know the value of a good marriage. Our connections are older than the borders they surpass and will outlast both alliances and governments.
ig_trait_noble_privileges_desc: Whatever happened to the idea that the nobility should be left to perform its duties without being hounded by tax collectors? It is time to bring those days back.
ig_trait_profitable_estates_desc: Didn't you know? What's good for the nobility is good for the nation—prosperity trickles up.
ig_trait_the_velvet_book_desc: Only the most august families can etch their names in this venerable book. We know who belongs and who does not.
ig_trait_bad_boyars_desc: So they want to say the country's Good Tsar is being misled by his bad boyars? Oh, we can show them what bad boyars are capable of.
ig_trait_latifundios_desc: The productivity and wealth of our estates is unparalleled. Money flows through our hands like water through rapids. Truly, these are golden days for us all.
ig_trait_junkerdom_desc: Our power comes from our lands, and our lands are mighty lands. Whatever we chose to do, the nation shall follow.
ig_trait_patrician_philanthropy_desc: It's high time we did something for our fellow man—and made sure our names were emblazoned on whatever ends up being built, of course.
ig_trait_wiener_walzer_desc: Someone had the nerve at the last ball to ask for a minuet to be played. My dear, we do waltzes! We set what's fashionable, and it's #italic not#! the minuet!
ig_trait_fazenda_ibicaba_desc: Manpower is a constant issue for our enterprises, and so we must pursue every path possible to get the labor we need.
ig_trait_summon_no_zamindars_desc: The rulers of our country have demonstrated that they have no interest in negotiation or flexibility. If this is so, then they should not miss the more subtle things we do to keep order.
ig_trait_famine_reserves_desc: It is our duty to open our stores of grain when a pressing need emerges. What better way is there to purchase goodwill from our tenants?
ig_trait_fudai_support_desc: In these changing times, we still know the value of loyalty. It is our duty to serve and to assist, bolstering the forces of order and virtue.
ig_trait_outspoken_tozama_desc: Although the #italic Tozama#! are not favored by the government, we share the common interests of our noble station. In these pressing times, their voice is our voice as well.
ig_trait_job_creators_desc: One must spend money to make money. As long as the government can be trusted not to interfere with our investments, there's nowhere we'd rather put our profits than towards economic growth.
ig_trait_engines_of_progress_desc: Behold the marvels of the modern age! There is no time for hesitation. If it can be thought, designed and patented, it should be built, tested and put to immediate use.
ig_trait_tax_avoidance_desc: Who knows best where our money should be spent? Not the government, and certainly not the current one. Fortunately, their incompetence has left tax loopholes that can be put to good use.
ig_trait_zaibatsu_cooperation_desc: A healthy relationship between industry and the government benefits everyone. It's in both our interests to ensure this amicable state of affairs continues.
ig_trait_zaibatsu_withdrawal_desc: Our financial health would benefit most through a refocusing on currency speculation and internal re-investment. Public trading is, sadly for the government, not a priority right now.
ig_trait_kommerskollegium_desc: It behooves us, as the scale of our commercial interests continues to grow, to ensure that the wealth earned is equitably managed.
ig_trait_ventilate_unify_beautify_desc: Have you seen what it's like out there? It's a workshop of disease, a place where the sun never shines, where plants whither and perish, and where misery and plague work in concert. It falls to us, of course, to fix this mess.
ig_trait_the_goods_must_flow_desc: It's all well and good to produce as much as our nation does, but what use is it if it can't reach the markets it needs to be sold at? Now is the time to ensure the country understands how necessary good transportation is.
ig_trait_wounded_honor_desc: We are an enlightened few in a land that resists any enlightenment. Our methods are superior—any disorder is a betrayal, and betrayal must be met with the harshest sanction.
ig_trait_stamped_and_signed_desc: Stamps and ledgers are the methods we use to create order out of chaos. The governance of India requires an ocean of paper, and it is our task to ensure it circulates flawlessly.
ig_trait_responsible_government_desc: Our mission is to extend justice and civilization to all men—and, of course, to perpetuate the rule which permits this forevermore.
ig_shipping_magnates_desc: With their ancestral ties to merchant fleets, shipyards, and coastal commerce, our industrial elites know their way around the sea better than most navies. When they're happy, the ports are busy, the markets are flooded with goods, and the shipyards never sleep.
ig_trait_patriotic_fervor_desc: No matter how brilliant the strategy and how advanced the weapons, some battles can only be won with hard work and guts. Soldiers who truly believe in what their country stands for will fight bravely regardless of the odds.
ig_trait_veteran_consultation_desc: Technological advancements are changing the face of war, but we can only make use of them if we understand how. Fortunately, those of us with firsthand experience should have an idea.
ig_trait_materiel_waste_desc: Loyalty to the nation is not loyalty to the government. If we can't trust the people in charge, we might as well use what we're given as we see fit.
ig_trait_elan_vital_desc: While the latest arms and armaments are all well and good, the path to victory depends on a driving spirit that will not bow in the face of adversity. Soldiers who truly believe in what the nation stands for will advance bravely, regardless of the odds.
ig_trait_newly_created_army_desc: The heart of a modern army lies not in the latest rifles, or the finest uniforms, but in organization and logistics. To keep every soldier supplied, to keep the flow of munitions and rations regular and reliable, to make sure every man knows his role in the vast military machine—that's how to make an army worth something.
ig_trait_self_strengthening_desc: Our intelligence and wisdom are necessarily superior to those who surround us. Thus, what we have to learn from abroad is only one thing: solid ships and effective guns.
ig_trait_parochial_leadership_desc: In these dark times, it's every man for himself, and every province must look to its own welfare first and foremost. It is unreasonable to expect every officer to lead enthusiastically far away from home, when his own hearth could be under threat.
ig_trait_el_buen_jefe_desc: What every good soldier needs is a good officer to lead him. In these times, what the whole nation needs is a good officer.
ig_trait_clube_militar_desc: A place where officers and soldiers like us can rest, relax and organize in their spare time is sure to be harmless. If anything, a place where we can all talk and plan things out may serve the country some good.
ig_trait_coronelismo_desc: Have you seen the latest decree from the government? Don't they realize who they're dealing with? A decorated gentleman like me, with all my men and estates, is not to be trifled with!
ig_trait_divided_ranks_desc: There is a fundamental rift between our soldiers and our officers, one which has grown too wide to ignore. Why would a man put his life on the line for one who treats his customs with contempt?
ig_trait_imperial_service_desc: To wear our uniform and expand our frontier is a great honor, one which millions strive towards. It is fortunate for them that there are always positions to fill.
ig_trait_veerta_desc: Ours is the army which conquered all of India, producing an unending stream of victories against all matter of foes. Our bravery and discipline ensure that this roll of honor will never come to an end.
ig_trait_farmers_markets_desc: Getting the goods we produce out to the people who need them seems to be a big concern these days. Under good circumstances, we're quite capable of getting them where they need to be ourselves.
ig_trait_honest_work_desc: We make our living by honest work and honest sweat. If that means we produce more than we need, so much better.
ig_trait_old_ways_desc: These people running the country seem to have all sorts of ideas about what the future should look like. Why should we trust them when they're the ones who made the present what it is?
ig_trait_obshchina_desc: Life in our little village isn't so bad. Dividing up the work between us all is easy, and spreading around the produce and profits doubly so.
ig_trait_fellahin_desc: Our lot in life is to work these fields as best we can. Sometimes, our work actually pays off for us.
ig_trait_nucleos_coloniais_desc: A new home means a new start on life. What's not to love about that? Come on, let's see what that new settlement has to offer.
ig_trait_plantation_work_desc: We work hard day after day, and get what we need to get by. Some days, though, we get more than that, and we cherish those days.
ig_trait_of_the_sovereign_alone_desc: The burden placed upon us by those who own the land is unbearable. These intermediaries must be reminded that we are ryots of the sovereign alone, and they have no rightful power over us.
ig_trait_imandari_desc: Our land is a wealthy one, and we work it with diligence. In good times, we can produce what we need and more.
ig_trait_bazaar_bargains_desc: It is our bazaars which enrich our towns and draw visitors from miles around. If prosperity requires some extra organization, that's a price we're willing to pay.
ig_trait_born_particularists_desc: You may draw new borders and draft new maps, but the Schwalbach peasant still to this day calls his land
ig_trait_solidarity_desc: All those who want work should have work! No one will be excluded or left out. We must support each other's right to fairly compensated labor.
ig_trait_industrial_organizers_desc: No matter who is in charge, the way workers collaborate ultimately has a larger impact on how well a factory works than any rules handed down from on high.
ig_trait_work_to_rule_desc: It seems like the people in charge want us to just shut up and do what we're told, rather than think for ourselves. Let's see how they like it if we actually apply that philosophy to our 'unskilled' labor.
ig_trait_bourse_du_travail_desc: Organization doesn't end at the end of workday! A united front requires aiding each other not just on the factory floor, but in our homes and communities as well.
ig_trait_propagandists_desc: In our poetry, our letters and our political manifestos, we must above all uphold the progress achieved in our home country as an example of what this new age has to bring to less fortunate parts of the world.
ig_trait_avant_garde_desc: What others dare not even think, we will already be speaking aloud. Our art and ideas will cut directly to hearts and force open eyes, if not in astonishment, then in shock!
ig_trait_social_criticism_desc: People in power often think they are beyond reproach, but authority does not make someone's ideas interesting. We have a lot of interesting things to say, and we know exactly who to say them about.
ig_trait_restoration_desc: In this era of great challenges and great achievements, we pride ourselves on our dogged pursuit of restoring the nation to its old greatness. Extraordinary work has reaffirmed the status of our civilization, and extraordinary work will bring it to even greater heights.
ig_trait_crisis_of_identity_desc: The nation we serve may not be the nation we truly are. How much do we really have in common with the people in charge?
ig_trait_les_beaux_arts_desc: Our arts, our exhibitions, and our creative talent is second to none. Why shouldn't we show off? We deserve to make others jealous.
ig_trait_brasilidade_desc: Come, friend, let's celebrate tonight! Over here we can hear the most beautiful ballads under the starlight with a bottle in our hands, and over there—ah, look at what he's painting already! Isn't this the life?
ig_trait_bachareis_desc: We know what the nation needs! After all, we speak for the people—What? No, we didn't say we speak #italic to#! the people.
ig_trait_swaraj_desc: We find ourselves both alienated from and enslaved by the state. Our rulers deny us agency whilst requesting our unthinking service. Such a thing is doomed to fail—and, if needed, we will work to ensure that it does.
ig_trait_westernisation_desc: Our present government serves as a representative of justice and progress, yet much of our country remains distant from it. We must seek to reduce the separation between state and people.
ig_trait_treasury_bonds_desc: As long as the government can be trusted to pay its debts, putting our hard-earned savings towards funding this great nation is not only patriotic, but a good investment.
ig_trait_middle_managers_desc: We can't make everyone do everything by the book, but we can at least keep what's done on the books. Someone needs to remember the proper way to do things around here.
ig_trait_xenophobia_desc: We all know who's to blame for the state of our country, people are just afraid to say it. Meanwhile, they're laughing behind our backs at what we let them get away with. Someone needs to act.
ig_trait_bergsbrukens_valdistrikten_desc: The close collaboration between mining interests and the burgher estate means that in better times, we can make sure the state gets a kind of support other countries can only dream of.
ig_trait_effendi_desc: By earnest habits and honest means, we have risen to the top, and our efforts are rightly lauded by all.
ig_trait_reorganization_desc: We know that with the right mandates and departments in place, we reform so much. Just say the word, and we'll get started.
ig_trait_master_of_the_house_desc: Please! Sit yourself down. We aspire to refinement here—to be servants to the poor, butlers to the great, comforters and philosophers to the nation.
ig_trait_haute_finance_desc: In the game of continental finance, we aim to be the victors by being the first to play our hand.
ig_trait_old_lady_of_threadneedle_street: The Old Lady of Threadneedle Street
If the nation needs help, there's an old lady around who is prudent, secure, and always can be turned to in a crisis: the Bank of England.
ig_trait_civil_service_desc: People do have funny ideas about civil servants. We're here to help you formulate and implement your policies, that's all.
ig_trait_bah_humbug_desc: The poor and destitude are in want, you say. Are there no prisons? Are the workhouses still in operation? Then leave me alone! Those who are badly off must go there.
ig_trait_swadesh_desc: We are as industrious as any other people, yet we are denied credit and forced into servitude by foreign businesses. If our rulers seek to exclude us from the economy, we will do the same for them.
ig_trait_lines_of_credit_desc: Were it not for credit provided by our own adept financiers, the Company could never have conquered India. If we are given a solid business case, we are entirely willing to continue this relationship.
ig_trait_cooperative_agencies_desc: Our rulers possess abundant capital, but have little knowledge of our country. By pooling their resources and our expertise, we may enrich our homeland far more than they ever would alone.
ig_trait_biedermanner_desc: Orderly, respectable, and deeply afraid of disorder, the Biedermann pays his taxes, minds his shop, and avoids politics. Even when the world is burning just outside his window.
ig_trait_be_fruitful_and_multiply_desc: Asceticism is fine for the few who dedicate their life to spiritual pursuits, but in the common people, the most important values to instill are those of building a family and caring for children.
ig_trait_divine_right_desc: We believe that there is an order to our lives. Society can reflect that order better or worse. As long as the rulers are virtuous and their decrees just, we can ensure the people know why.
ig_trait_pious_fiction_desc: The values of today are so poisoned and the literature so corrupting that education itself has an eroding effect on morals. Better than teaching people whatever the current establishment considers 'true' is to teach them what ought to be true.
ig_trait_work_ethic_desc: Remember, money has a generating nature. Money begets money; the production of profits is an act of creation, an honoring and glorification of God's own work.
ig_trait_asceticism_desc: To abstain from the pleasures of this world is the right path. Do not let yourself be too perturbed by material changes; these too shall pass.
ig_trait_kar_seva_desc: God is with us and among us. To selflessly serve others, then, is to serve God's creation and serve God. It behooves us all to engage in honest work and share the fruits of that labor with others, and by those means be closer to God.
ig_trait_temporal_mandate_desc: The line between the heavens and earth is often blurry; so too is the line between faith and government. It takes all types to administer the secular world—we can always find ways to make our systems work together.
ig_trait_the_best_revenge_desc: If you want to take revenge against your enemy, acquire more good qualities and walk in the path of righteousness. In so doing, you will inevitably take vengeance against your enemy for he will be distressed over your good qualities, and he will be grieved over your good reputation.
ig_trait_yeshivot_desc: Studying the Sifrut Chazal is a key duty of every youth. If no one went to school, how could our laws be remembered and kept?
ig_trait_traditsye_desc: The world is rapidly changing all around us. How are we meant to maintain our balance if we rush after this unknowable whirlwind of change?
ig_trait_heavenly_sovereign_desc: The heirs to Emperor Jimmu have tended to one of the most venerable institutions on earth. This font of tradition rightly deserves veneration, and as a nation we should acknowledge that.
ig_trait_secular_shrine_theory_desc: Shrines are an inherent belief of the Japanese people; they exist intitutionally for the purpose of public rituals of the state. Shintoism is ideological: it is an expression of patriotism that we expect of every citizen.
ig_trait_haibutsu_kishaku_desc: Foreign religions must be abolished from the nation and their figures destroyed. Look at what havoc they have caused! Go into their shrines, their temples, their shacks, and show them that they have no place here!
ig_trait_da_wat_desc: We must go out, to invite others to join us in the faith and to live according to the will of Allah. The ummah welcomes all.
ig_trait_sharia_desc: Living correctly requires knowing the laws that define what is correct and what is not. The interpretation of the law is one of the most honored and solemn duties we can perform.
ig_trait_mecelle_desc: Based in Hanafi jurisprudence, the Mecelle-i Ahkâm-ı Adliye ensures that we shall follow a code that satisfies both our faith and our expectations of secular law.
ig_rural_folk_desc: People in the countryside whose political interests are mostly aligned with their agrarian livelihoods.
ig_devout_desc: The most dedicated followers of the majority religion, viewing it as the best source of moral and political wisdom.
ig_industrialists_desc: Investors and shareholders with an interest in technological advancement and industrial growth.
ig_landowners_desc: The owners of great estates and vast plantations, the landowners are custodians of tradition and old money.
ig_intelligentsia_desc: The intellectuals leading the nation’s trends in literature, art, music and theater.
ig_petty_bourgeoisie_desc: Proprietors of small shops, landlords with a half dozen tenants, frugal clerks with tiny pensions and others who have more than the poor, but less than the rich.
ig_armed_forces_desc: Professional soldiers and others whose interest are tied strongly to the country’s military.
ig_trade_unions_desc: Organized labor seeking to organize workers in the mines, factories and fields and in so doing pool the strengths of the disparate interests into one voice.
ig_catholic_church_desc: Catholicism is the largest sect of Christianity. Believers hold that the Archbishop of Rome, the Pope, is the uninterrupted successor to the authority of Jesus Christ via Saint Peter. Other important beliefs include veneration of the saints and of the Virgin Mary.
ig_orthodox_church_desc: The Orthodox churches tend to be Eastern churches not in communion with the Pope.
ig_oriental_orthodox_church_desc: The Oriental Orthodox churches tend to be Middle Eastern churches not in communion with the Pope.
ig_anglican_church_desc: The Anglican Church was created by King Henry VIII during the Protestant Reformation. Anglicans believe that the Bible is the main authority on Christian dogma, rejecting the Pope while being less radical than other Evangelical churches.
ig_evangelical_church_desc: The Evangelical churches were created mostly in Northern Europe during the Protestant Reformation. Evangelicals believe that the Bible is the sole authority on Christian dogma, rejecting the Pope and seeing the Catholic veneration of the saints as bordering on idolatry.
ig_rabbinical_council_desc: The leadership of a country’s Jewish populace tend to be well-educated Rabbis with strong traditions of debate and scholarship.
ig_sunni_madrasahs_desc: Sunnism is the largest sect of Islam. Believers hold that Muhammad was succeeded as Caliph of Islam by his uncle, Abu Bakr, as opposed to the Shi’a view that his son-in-law Ali was the legitimate successor.
ig_shia_madrasahs_desc: Shi’ism is the second largest sect of Islam. Believers hold that Muhammad was succeeded as Caliph of Islam by his son-in-law, Ali, as opposed to the Sunni view that his uncle Abu Bakr was the legitimate successor.
ig_ibadi_madrasahs_desc: Ibadism is a sect of Islam that believes that faithful should be led by local imams, chosen based on their piety and learnedness. Believers hold that Muhammad was succeeded as Caliph of Islam by his son-in-law, Ali, but that Ali later became unfit for rule and was succeeded by Abdullah ibn Wahb al-Rasibi, the first Ibadi imam.
ig_hindu_priesthood_desc: Probably the oldest organized religion still in existence, Hinduism holds that breaking the cycle of reincarnation and achieving Nirvana requires adherence to a caste system whereby individuals serve a role to improve their karma, just as the many gods worshiped by Hindus serve different roles.
ig_vajrayana_monks_desc: Vajrayana Buddhism is strongest in Tibet and Mongolia. It emphasizes the use of meditation and self-discipline.
ig_mahayana_monks_desc: Mahayana Buddhism is strongest in China, Vietnam and Korea. It emphasizes that everyone in society should be encouraged to seek enlightenment through perfection. Mahayana sees Buddha as a God-like figure.
ig_theravada_monks_desc: Theravada Buddhism is strongest in Burma, Siam, Cambodia and Ceylon. It places great emphasis on individuals seeking Nirvana to break the cycle of reincarnation. Theravada sees Buddha not as a God, but as an enlightened man who showed the rest of mankind the path to perfection.
ig_shinto_monks_desc: Shintoism is a syncretic faith, combining Buddhist concepts of karma and reincarnation with worship and placation of kami, the spirits of nature and dead ancestors.
ig_pagan_shamans_desc: Animism is the worship and placation of natural spirits. Rituals undertaken by animists include sacrifices of food and livestock, and consumption of hallucinogenic drugs for spiritual journeys of introspection.
ig_london_missionary_society_desc: Representing both Christian converts and the interests of their home country, these missionaries promote the causes of Christendom and Free Trade.
ig_taiping_god_worshippers_desc: The God-Worshipping, or Emperor-Worshipping Society, is a syncretic Christian faith prominent amongst the Heavenly Kingdom, supporting an interpretation of Christianity that views all believers as sons and daughters of God.
ig_landed_gentry_desc: The owners of great estates and vast properties, the landed gentry are custodians of tradition and old money.
ig_junkers_desc: Descended from the ’jung herrs’ (young lords) who followed in the wake of Teutonic conquests of the pagan Baltic to settle and Christianize the Prussian lands, the Junkers are Prussia’s nobility and major landlords. They tend to oppose movements towards democracy as a threat to elite rule.
ig_southern_planters_desc: Many of the Founding Fathers saw the independent yeomen farmers of the North as the basic building block of the citizenry, but the vast wealth of the Southern tobacco and cotton plantations cannot be denied. That wealth gives the Southern Planters a just claim to participate in the administration of the republic.
ig_evangelicals_desc: Ardent Christians from a surprisingly wide variety of Protestant denominations, the Evangelicals all agree that the nation needs to find its own spiritual awakening in order to save itself.
ig_yeoman_farmers_desc: The smallholding American rural class, regarded by many of the Founding Fathers as the bedrock of the nation. The yeoman class has long established itself as the vanguard of both American rural populism and Westwards expansion.
ig_local_governors_desc: The rulers of the provinces can acquire huge influence by building up local patronage networks. Dynasties can become so powerful they are effectively independent states only nominally tied to the empire.
ig_literati_desc: Scholars in China serve an important role, both as supporters of the government and as critics of it.
ig_scholar_officials_desc: The landed gentry in China are not really China’s nobility. They preserve their wealth through purchasing properties, but they owe their power to their positions in the government.
ig_confucian_desc: More of a social tradition, Confucianism coexists comfortably with a multitude of faiths, but nonetheless demands social harmony and strong morals from those that follow it.
ig_roman_landowners_desc: Consisting of noble families and landholding elites granted titles by the Pope, the Roman civic nobility serve as people of wealth, influence, and temporal power across the Holy See’s territories.
ig_samurai_desc: The Samurai are the hereditary military nobility of Japan, serving as privileged retainers to the powerful landowning Daimyo, and as enforcers of their feudal masters’ wills.
ig_shogunate_desc: The Shogunate refers to the military government that has ruled Japan in the Emperor’s name since the 12th century. Anchored in the support of powerful feudal lords, the Daimyo, the insitution is dedicated to the upholding of Japan’s traditional order.
ig_daimyo_desc: The Daimyō are the powerful feudal lords of Japan, and the most influential supporters of the Shogunate. Their political interests lie in upholding Japan's traditional order.
ig_kazoku_desc: The Kazoku are the new aristocracy of Japan, formed from the amalgamation of the daimyō and traditional #italic kuge#! courtier class. Though the Restoration has eroded their formal privileges, they retain their lands and social connections.
ig_peasants_desc: Heimin denotes the Japanese class of commoners, born without any kind of social privileges, and with political interests primarily reflecting those of rural farmers.
ig_jisha_desc: Existing alongside, and often at odds with the native Japanese belief in kami, by the 19th century Buddhism has been present in Japan for over a millennium. The Buddhist schools patronized by the state throughout the Edo era emphasize the syncretic relationship between kami and buddhas.
ig_gosho_desc: The Gōshō are the greatest and most influential merchants. Their houses represent the largest concentrations of capital in Japan, offering financial services to the state and private actors alike.
ig_zaibatsu_desc: Descended from the powerful merchant houses of the Edo period, the Zaibatsu are the great vertical industrial conglomerates that dominate the Japanese economy.
ig_christian_missionaries_desc: The Christian Missionaries came to Hawai’i just a few decades ago but have already supplanted the Kahuna as Hawai’i’s dominant clerical class. They advocate for trade with the Western powers, attracting migrants from the West, and the conversion of native Hawaiians to Christianity.
ig_alii_desc: The Ali’i represent the lesser nobles of Hawai’i in service of the reigning monarch. They advocate for traditional values and preserving the rule of the monarchy.
ig_maka_ainana_desc: The Maka’āinana represent Hawai’i’s rural class, often working in plantations and fisheries. They advocate for traditional values and for Hawai’i’s continued economic dependency on the agricultural sector.
ig_hawaiian_democrats_desc: The Democrats represent Hawai’i’s liberal reformers. They advocate for removing the absolute power of the monarch in favor of a democratic regime and the continued trade relations with Western powers.
ig_church_of_sweden_desc: The Church of Sweden was instigated by King Gustav Vasa in the 16th century and is the official State Church of Sweden. Being a Lutheran institution, the Church holds that the Bible is the sole authority on Christian dogma, thus rejecting the authority of the Pope and traditions such as the veneration of saints.
ig_church_of_finland_desc: Born from the separation of Finland from Sweden in 1809, the Church of Finland was established as the country's official state church. Being a Lutheran institution, the Church holds that the Bible is the sole authority on Christian dogma, thus rejecting the authority of the Pope and traditions such as the veneration of saints.
ig_church_of_denmark_desc: Established in the 16th century by King Christian III, the Church of Denmark is the official state church of Denmark. Being a Lutheran institution, the Church holds that the Bible is the sole authority on Christian dogma, thus rejecting the authority of the Pope and traditions such as the veneration of saints.
ig_aristocracy_of_officials_desc: Lacking any significant historical nobility and with the institution being formally abolished in 1821, Norway’s upper class is instead made up of civil servants, with lawyers, priests, and doctors occupying the positions of a traditional nobility.
ig_church_of_norway_desc: The Church of Norway was established as a separate body from the Roman Catholic Church and integrated with the Norwegian state in the 16th century as a result of the Protestant Reformation. Being a Lutheran institution, the Church holds that the Bible is the sole authority on Christian dogma, thus rejecting the authority of the Pope and traditions such as the veneration of saints.
ig_yangban_desc: The Yangban represents the landed and unlanded gentry of Korea, who derive their titles and influence from positions within the country’s bureaucratic apparatus. Exemplifying the Confucian ideals of the Scholar-Official, they are staunch defenders of Korea’s traditional order.
ig_gentry_assembly_desc: The Gentry Assembly is the self-governing body representing the Russian Aristocracy. Granted official status in 1785, the Assembly has ever since advocated for the retention or expansion of the nobles’ traditional powers and privileges.
ig_squattocracy_desc: The ’Squattocracy’ represents the class of white Australian settlers who have occupied large tracts of land with little or no legal claim. Often the first settlers to arrive in a given area, the squattocracy has gained immense wealth and social influence primarily through the proceeds of raising livestock on their territories.
austrian_aristocracy_desc: The Austrian Aristocracy represents the established noble class of Austria, historically awarded with noble titles by the Habsburg Holy Roman Emperors and Archdukes of Austria, and possessing great influence within the imperial court.
ig_red_army_desc: The Red Army is an institution dedicated to the defense and propagation of the Revolution, born through the amalgamation of the traditional armed forces with the proletariat and Communist ideology.
ig_fellahin_desc: Gaining their name from the plows they work and the fields they till, the fellahin are the farmers and peasants of Egypt.
ig_zamindars_desc: The Zamindars are the typically hereditary owners of large estates. They often represent the remnants of the Mughal-era aristocracy, granted the right to collect land revenues on behalf of their rulers.
ig_east_india_company_desc: The East India Company is the private corporation tasked with ruling India under the supervision of the British Parliament. Following the revocation of its commercial mandate in 1833, it has become a purely administrative body.
ig_presidency_armies_desc: The Presidency Armies are the armed forces of colonial India, typically composed of native Indian sepoys under the command of European officers.
ig_indian_army_desc: The Indian Army is the primary armed force of colonial India, formed by unifying the Presidency Armies into a singular body. It is largely composed of native Indian soldiers under the command of European officers.
ig_ryots_desc: The Ryots are the traditional farmers and peasants of India, typically without any land of their own. Their interests are largely agrarian in nature.
ig_civil_servants_desc: The Civil Servants encompass the native Indian intelligentsia which has developed primarily from the various organs of the Indian colonial bureaucracy. They typically hold or have held roles as clerks or other low-to-mid-level administrators.
ig_government_of_india_desc: The Government of India refers to the European colonial administration tasked with advancing the interests of the British crown in India.
ig_kisanharu_desc: The Kisanharu are the traditional farmers and peasantry of Nepal, typically without any land of their own. Their interests are largely agrarian in nature.
ig_wamanga_desc: The newest wave of Arab settlers to the Swahili Coast are known individually as #italics Manga#!—the new Omani aristocracy of Zanzibar.
ig_kleinburger_desc: Made up of shopkeepers, clerks, master craftsmen, and lower professionals throughout the German lands, the Kleinbürger are regarded by many as the very embodiment of the German character.
ig_landvolk_desc: The Landvolk are the smallholding farmers, village elders, and rural folk who live by the rhythm of the land. Loyal to their Gemeinde and shaped by centuries of custom, they form the rooted backbone of the countryside.
ig_magnates_desc: Descended from great medieval lords and leaders, the magnates of the realm are heirs to centuries of land, tradition, and privilege.
ig_boyars_desc: The Boyars are the landowning elites of Wallachia and Moldavia, comprising both traditional nobles and large landowners of non-noble birth.
ig_guardia_civil_desc: Established by the Spanish colonial government, the Guardia Civil is a branch of the Spanish Civil Guard overseen by the Captaincy General of the Philippines.
ig_ilustrados_desc: Intellectuals that have been exposed to European nationalist ideals. They seek equitable political and economic reforms.
interest_tier_none_desc: At this $concept_interest_tier_short$, a [concept_country] is either completely or only marginally involved in a [concept_strategic_region] and it has no effects on either the $concept_country$ or the $concept_strategic_region$.
interest_tier_observant_desc: At this $concept_interest_tier_short$, first steps have been taken to establish a diplomatic presence in the [concept_strategic_region], navy vessels may be patrolling the coasts or envoys might be exchanged with [Concept('concept_local_country', '$concept_local_countries$')].
interest_tier_engaged_desc: At this $concept_interest_tier_short$, a [concept_country] is starting to get involved in a local affairs, signing [Concept('concept_treaty', '$concept_treaties$')] and establishing a more permanent presence.
interest_tier_influential_desc: At this $concept_interest_tier_short$, a presence has been fully established in a [concept_strategic_region], [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] are striking long-term deals and staking their claims.\n\n@information! $concept_countries$ with their [Concept('concept_capital_state', '$concept_capital_state_short$')] in this $concept_strategic_region$ may never drop below this $concept_interest_tier_short$.
interest_tier_pervasive_desc: At this $concept_interest_tier_short$, a [concept_country] has established significant control over a [concept_strategic_region]. [Concept('concept_great_power', '$concept_great_powers$')] and [Concept('concept_local_country', '$concept_local_country_short$')] powers fight for dominance as power is consolidated.
interest_tier_hegemonic_desc: At this $concept_interest_tier_short$, a [concept_country] has firmly established itself as the undisputed power broker in the [concept_strategic_region]. Other nations, #italic if they exist#!, will have to subordinate themselves or deal with the Hegemon to earn their guarantee to not meddle in local affairs.

combat_unit_type_dragoons_desc: Mounted infantry for increased mobility on the battlefield.
combat_unit_type_cuirassiers_desc: Armored cavalry that is fighting on the front row.
