admiralty_desc: The Admiralty is a complex system of ranks connected by a rigid chain of command to help the navy work more efficiently.
anaesthetics_desc: Anaesthetics are sedatives or painkillers used during surgery to prevent patients feeling the knives and invasive prodding of the medical staff, which could be discomfiting.
anarchism_desc: A political ideology promoting self-governance and opposition to authority. Anarchism seeks to do away with the state and other institutions which rule over people against their will, replacing them with voluntary associations.
aniline_desc: Aniline makes certain dye colors trivial to produce.
anti_clericalism_desc: Power corrupts and religious institutions are no more immune to this corruption than any others. They may claim to offering salvations to the masses but instead the seek to feather their own nests and deny the rights to those they deem unworthy. We must sweep away the influence of organized religion from our public sphere and leave that matter as a choice to the unenlightened.
antibiotics_desc: Antibiotics are an advanced medicine used for fighting infections, allowing a greater survival rate in hospitals.
antiseptics_desc: Science has established that exposure to heat will destroy germs. The problem is that this is not a valid solution when it comes to living tissue. However, when experiments where done where wounds were covered with pads soaked a solution of phenol we saw incidents of gangrene dramatically decline. This science of anti-sceptics has been born.
arc_welding_desc: By generating a large amount of electricity, it is possible to create enough heat to melt two pieces of metal together.
army_reserves_desc: Army Reserves is the concept that a set of semi professional soldiers made up of citizens could work as a support for the regular army.
art_patronage_desc: Art is not free and to develop art and culture you need the wealthy to take an interest and support art. In return for doing this they gain prestige for having such beautiful things around them.
art_silk_desc: By using materials collected from plants, it is possible to create a relative approximation of silk, for much cheaper.
assembly_line_desc: By streamlining the process of building things so each action is done correctly after each other action a much more efficient factory can be made.
atmospheric_engine_desc: The Atmospheric Engine is the first steam engine that has an actual practical application.
automatic_bottle_blowers_desc: By automating the process of blowing the glass into a bottle shape, it is possible to make many more bottles a day.
battlefleet_tactics_desc: Operating a large battlefleet can be a difficult task. By practicing and learning specific tactics as a fleet, greater performance can be achieved.
battleship_tech_desc: By taking the dreadnought design and making all the guns high caliber, as well as some other changes, it is possible to make an even more devastating warship.
bessemer_process_desc: The Bessemer process is a technique for the mass production of steel from pig iron.
bessemer_steel_desc: The Bessemer Process blasts cold air into molten pig iron, burning off carbon, silicon and manganese, and creating mild steel. This is not as high quality as that produced in crucibles, but it is vastly cheaper, allowing the use of lower grade iron ores and enabling mass production of railway lines and reinforced concrete.
biological_determinism_desc: The study of genetics and inheritance in nature opens up questions about how much of human behavior is determined by biology.
feminism_desc: Feminism is an ideology concerned with advancing social, economic, and political equality for women. Feminists believe that women should have the same legal rights as men to own property, work, and participate in politics.
blast_furnaces_desc: A blast furnace is used to add extra oxygen to metallurgical processes such as the smelting of ore, originally with hand—or water-wheel-powered bellows. This causes the furnace to reach even greater temperatures than an open air furnace, burning away impurities and allowing alloys of exotic metals. The blast furnace is especially useful for the production of pig iron, which can then be made into wrought iron or mild steel using more advanced processes.
bolt_action_rifles_desc: A bolt action rifle works by having a bolt which is manually manipulated to put the cartridge in or out of the rife, which allows for a more reliable and powerful weapon.
chemical_bleaching_desc: Through the addition of certain salts, minerals, or chemicals to the raw materials, the visual qualities of manufactured goods can be greatly increased.
artillery_desc: Long-range bombardment with heavy munitions intimidates and scatters enemy forces without risking your own troops. Inaccurate, slow-moving, and expensive, yet a crucial ingredient in any modern army.
breech_loading_artillery_desc: By changing the design to load the shells from a port in the artillery, rather than down the barrel it is possible to make a much more efficient weapons.
tech_bureaucracy_desc: Bureaucracy is the machine of government, the cogs and wheels that decide the efficiency of the state.
centralization_desc: By centralizing administrative tasks within a logical hierarchy, standards of government operation can be developed that put achievements previously thought impossible within reach.
camera_desc: Through a complex chemical process it is possible to capture reality itself in a single moment. An instant painting.
canals_desc: Coastal and riverline barges are a very efficient method of transporting goods. Digging canals into the interior of a country expands the coverage of these barges, although it can be an expensive proposition when different heights need to be bridged by lock systems.
canneries_desc: Canneries are machines made specifically to seal food in an airtight container, so that it can be preserved for longer.
canning_jars_desc: The armies of the French Revolution required innovative solutions to their supply problems. One solution was to cook food within within glass jars, to prevent ill humors and miasma mixing with the contents and thereby spoiling the rations. Molten wax is poured into the mouth of the jar to act as a seal against the outside world.
canning_machines_desc: Early canned food production lacked automation. Cans were rolled and soldered by hand. The use of machines to quickly turn tinplate into cans improves standards and increases throughput.
carrier_tech_desc: By designing large ships with a large flat deck and equipping them appropriately, it is possible to create a sea borne airfield.
catalytic_contact_process_desc: In 1831, British vinegar merchant Peregrine Phillips invented a process for producing more concentrated sulfuric acid by using platinum as a catalytic converter. While not especially useful for the production of ash soda or fertilizer, this soon became a boon to organic dye production.
chemical_isolation_desc: Chemicals can be purified in many ways, such as distillation, filtration and evaporation. The quality of the purification process will obviously affect the quality of the isolate.
chemical_synthesis_desc: Dog urine was famously synthesized by the German chemist Friedrich Wöhler in 1828. This began to blur the boundaries between organic and inorganic chemistry, and as more chemicals are synthesised new industrial processes are opening up.
chemical_warfare_desc: Certain chemical combinations produce adverse or even fatal effects when humans are exposed to them. Weaponizing this brings a whole new horrific aspect to warfare.
civilizing_mission_desc: It falls on our great nation's shoulders to shine the light of modernity into every uncivilized corner of the world, to educate and instill in the less developed peoples the divine values of our glorious culture.
colonization_desc: As a population grows, it becomes possible to go elsewhere and find new mainly unclaimed land for the taking.
color_photography_desc: Early technique to capture photographs in full color, based in insights into how light is perceived by the eye. By effectively taking three pictures through different color filters, these can be combined into one image recreating the original colors.
combination_acts_desc: Working men meeting together in secret and swearing oaths to each other is a threat to the security of the state and clearly a means for the radical Jacobin to subvert to state. It could also be a threat to our ability to defend ourselves from external enemies due to threats of action by the working men at a critical moments of the conflict. We will pass a series of laws that will allow us to regulate such behaviour for the common good.
combustion_engine_desc: A combustion engine allows fuel to be turned directly into mechanical power, based on combustions taking place inside the engine constantly.
central_planning_desc: Leveraging all the latest innovations in management science and electric communication, long-term plans for sweeping societal development can be coordinated by a single administrative office.
compound_microscopes_desc: The lenses used in optics require very fine glassmaking skills. One innovation in this field is to use two lenses, one focused on an object and the other focused on the first lens, to increase the magnification. Such a microscope can be used to view living bacteria.
compression_ignition_desc: A compression ignition engine ignites the fuel by compressing air and has the highest thermal efficiency of any engine.
concrete_dockyards_desc: Sturdy and cheap, concrete allows for the construction of far larger piers that are able to support far heavier freight loads.
concrete_fortifications_desc: By introducing concrete into fortifications it is possible to make strong entrenched positions very quickly.
condensed_milk_desc: Ordinarily, milk must be consumed quickly after being extruded from a bovine mammary gland. By lowering the pressure inside a container, such as a vacuum pan, the water content of the milk evaporates, and the condensed milk can then be canned and sold.
conspicuous_consumption_desc: Wealth has a prestige all its own. Displays of wealth can make one appear more prestigious and help advance through the social classes, opening new opportunities for the social climber such as contacts with businessmen and politicians. In a materialist society, frivolities and extravagance paradoxically help one become richer.
conveyors_desc: By applying motors to belts it is possible to create platforms that move goods along them without the use of human labor.
cotton_gin_desc: The cotton gin is a machine which quickly separates the cotton from its seeds, enabling a much faster processing time than doing it by hand.
crucible_steel_desc: Produced by applying heat to a stone crucible containing powdered iron and charcoal, this high-carbon alloy is thought to be similar to 'Damascus steel', created in the India and Persia until around 1750. This process produces steel of a high grade suitable for use in tools, springs and other extra-hard and expensive objects.
law_enforcement_desc: A professional force trained to a set standard permits the state to police its populace with increased authority.
defense_in_depth_desc: By making multiple lines of defense, it is possible to spread out and slow down the enemy and sometimes even envelop them.
democracy_desc: Democracy is at its heart the idea that the population of a country get to choose how their country is run, through voting or other means.
distillation_desc: Distillation is the ability to separate components of a liquid using different boiling temperatures, allowing for all sorts of further uses.
divine_revelation_desc: The basis of all law is derived on our holy scriptures. Only through the obedience to a higher power can our society be properly ordered and stability be guaranteed.
watertube_boiler_desc: The Water-tube Boiler is an improvement on the original boiler, by splitting up the water into smaller tubes they would heat up faster and thus improve efficiency.
pre_dreadnought_tech_desc: Standardizing ship designs of battleships in order to produce a higher number of them. These ships are built from steel and powered by steam engines.
dreadnought_tech_desc: By making a warship with only heavy caliber guns and steam propulsion, it is possible to overpower all other types of ship.
dynamite_desc: By applying a stabilizing agent to nitroglycerin it is possible to make a much safer and more reliable explosive.
egalitarianism_desc: Egalitarianism is the doctrine of the equality of mankind and the desirability of political, economic and social equality.
electric_arc_process_desc: By putting an electric arc through metal it is possible to smelt it more quickly and efficiently.
electric_railway_desc: By using electricity to power the trains rather than steam, it is possible to have a much more reliable rail system.
electrical_generation_desc: It is possible to capture the very essence of lightning and use it to power all sorts of different types of machinery.
elevator_desc: Through a complex system of weights and pulleys, it possible to raise people and objects to desired heights at will.
empiricism_desc: An epistemological philosophy deriving knowledge from empirical evidence, information gathered from experiences rather than cultural norms or religious beliefs.
enlightenment_thought_desc: During the Age of Reason, old dogmas began to be questioned. It was no longer accepted that 'God wills it', and those in power began to have to justify their position in society. Even the absolute monarchs saw the prestige of these new ideas, and the 'Enlightened Despots' reformed the educational, legal and economic systems of Europe. These reforms did not go far enough, however, and thinkers such as John Locke, Voltaire, Jean-Jacques Rousseau and Thomas Paine led an attack on the establishment that culminated in revolutions in America and France which themselves inspired liberals across the world.
fascism_desc: Fascism is a political system where the government has strict control over all aspects of society.
field_works_desc: Field works is modifying the terrain where the battle is held thus giving soldiers greater protection.
film_desc: By taking many photographs in quick succession, it is possible to capture movement in real time. This can then be processed and played back.
flash_freezing_desc: By subjecting food to a very low temperature, it can be quickly frozen, allowing it to be preserved for longer.
floating_harbor_desc: By keeping a dock at a constant level along a tidal waterway, ships can more quickly dock and transfer goods without having to consider relative changes between the waterway level and docks.
food_sterilisation_desc: By trial and error, businessmen have discovered methods of preserving food, such as the heating of milk in pasteurization or its condensation into thick syrup, the pickling of fruits and vegetables, and the canning of meats and soups. The common thread amongst all these technology is the elimination of germs from the preserved food, a concept not fully understood until the discovery of bacteria under microscopes. With widespread understanding of these ideas, standards in the food industry are improving, and with this the health of the public.
four_field_crop_rotation_desc: Famously expounded by the landowner Charles 'Turnip' Townsend, the use of nitrogen fixers, such as turnips or clover, allows farmland to remain in constant use without being exhausted or having to be left fallow.
fractional_distillation_desc: Repeated vaporizing and condensing allows the liquids to be separated into purer components. The practical applications of this process are endless.
fruit_jars_desc: The idea of preserving meat and soup within metal cans has gained in popularity. Other kinds of food preservation are also becoming widespread, such as preserving fruits and vegetables in pickling fluids or boiling them into jams.
fulminates_desc: A fulminating material is one which ignites when struck sharply. Such materials include ions of mercury, silver and potassium. They were first discovered by Edward Charles Howard in 1800, and their military application in percussion cap systems soon became apparent.
functionalism_desc: A theoretical framework viewing society as a system of components defined by the social functions. Using mechanical and biological systems as metaphor, it views society's structures and their interdependence as determining its stability.
gantry_cranes_desc: Useful in construction and transportation, gantry cranes are large enough to straddle the width of a ship. This gives them a sturdiness that means they can lift the heaviest loads a ship can possibly carry.
general_staff_desc: Having a set of officers to act as a conduit between the high command and the troops themselves, allows for greater communication and effectiveness.
germ_theory_desc: Thucydides was the first person to state that diseases could spread from person to the other and since ancient times we have believed that miasmas were the causes of diseases like cholera. However science has province that microorganisms, called germs, are responsible for disease.
gunpowder_desc: A chemical compound composed of sulfur, charcoal and nitrates, gunpowder conflagrates rapidly, expanding into a gas which can propel projectiles down tubes. The combustion leaves behind large quantities of smoke from the sulfur and charcoal, which makes musketry a dirty and blinding business on the battlefield. Gunpowder charges also have more civil uses in opening up the earth for mining and construction. The Chinese invented gunpowder a thousand years prior and used it for celebratory fireworks and siege artillery.
gunsmithing_desc: Gunsmithing allows the creation of explosive powered weaponry, making the relevance of physical strength much less important.
gymnastics_desc: For the Spartans gymnastics formed part of the training of you military recruits, and the word itself has been around since the 1570s to refer to athletic exercises. Now though we realize that the Spartans were onto something, to discipline the mind we must discipline the body. Educational pioneers have developed a series of exercises for boys on various apparatus to help them develop self discipline. Some radicals are even suggesting to extend these exercises to girls.
gyroscopes_desc: A gyroscope is made by combining a series of gimbals, which are simply rotating supports. One gimbal spins vertically and another horizontally, so the innermost supported object can spin freely in any direction. Gyroscopes are useful for keeping an object steady while its surroundings are moving, such as a magnetic compass on a tossing ship.
handcranked_machine_gun_desc: By using a mechanical crank to rotate the barrel it is possible to fire bullets at a much faster rate than a standard firearm.
hydraulic_cranes_desc: Cranes powered by water pressure are vastly stronger than earlier stationary cranes. Their strength and efficiency can greatly increase the flow of goods in and out of commercial ports.
hydraulic_power_desc: Water-wheels have long been used for milling grain. Adapting them to other industrial uses, such as powering machines, is a logical step forwards.
hypodermic_syringes_desc: Inoculations were originally given to patients by opening the skin and rubbing diseased material in the wound. The idea of using a hollow needle to inject fluids into a patient is obviously more hygienic, and it also has the benefit of allowing precise volumes to be administered by the doctor. Early syringes have been made from silver, but glass is becoming popular as manufacturing processes become more refined, allowing narrower needles to be made.
idealism_desc: A number of philosophies holding that our knowledge is dependent on how we perceive things, which limits us to knowing the idea of a thing, rather than the thing as it actually is.
identification_documents_desc: By creating documents identifying citizens of a country, it is much easier to keep track of them.
impressionism_desc: An art style focused on techniques recreating the general visual sensation of a scene. The same artistic ambition of recreating the feeling and experience of a situation was also applied in art forms beyond the visual.
improved_fertilizer_desc: By experimenting with different chemicals it is possible to make even more effective fertilizers.
international_trade_desc: The ability to trade not just within your country, or even within your continent, but across the entire world has revolutionized the global economy.
ironclad_tech_desc: By cladding a ship in iron plating it is possible to make it much more durable and resistant to incendiary ammunition.
jeune_ecole_desc: By having many smaller ships rather than a few big ones, it is possible to keep a certain level of maneuverability that would otherwise be impossible.
labor_movement_desc: Just as the world becomes more industrialized, so too do the workers become more organized, campaigning for better wages and better working conditions.
land_reform_desc: Land ownership and society go hand in hand. Land is the primary source and wealth and status in any country and thus who gets to own the land is who has wealth and status. If we wish to create the society that we want we must be prepared to fundamentally alter who owns the land.
lathe_desc: The lathe is a machine for rotating a piece of material, be it metal or wood, so that it can be easily be machined into the desired shape.
lathes_desc: A lathe is a tool which rotates the material the tool is working on, as opposed to a drill, which is itself rotated against the material. This whittles the material down in a symmetrical fashion. This has applications in many industries, from artisanal candleholders to the boring of artillery pieces. Early lathes are powered by hand, by horse, or by water-wheel, depending upon the scope of the industry.
laws_of_physics_desc: The fundamental laws governing bodies in motion can be easily observed with the use of a telescope. Sir Isaac Newton was a pioneer in this field, thanks to his technology of a higher quality reflective telescope and the rigorous application of his observations to existing scientific predictions by Johannes Kepler.
crystal_glass_desc: By adding lead to glass it is possible to create glass with the appearance of crystal, which is sought after due to its value.
automatic_machine_guns_desc: The machine gun takes the concept of the handcranked machine gun and cranks it up a notch, replacing the human rotation with an automated system to allow for more bullets to be fired even faster.
malaria_prevention_desc: Through a combination of medicine and preventative methods such as mosquito nets, it is possible to lower the effect of Malaria in affected regions.
manufacturies_desc: The guilds controlled the methods and hiring practices a business could use, limiting entry into the labor force and demanding that only highly skilled and certified (by the guild, naturally) craftsmen perform certain tasks. Increasingly, industrialists left the cities and founded new sites of innovation, free from the exacting standards and high wages of the guild masters.
mass_communication_desc: Mass Communication is the easy spread of information utilizing technologies such as the newspaper.
mass_propaganda_desc: By printing and distributing a large amount of information in a short amount of time, it is possible to get your version of truth spread much more quickly and effectively than ever before.
mass_surveillance_desc: By having specific people whose sole purpose is to follow and report on others, it is possible to keep a much closer eye on what is going on in your country.
mechanized_farming_desc: By replacing various aspect of physical farm labor with machine power, it is possible to increase the efficiency of farming greatly.
mechanized_workshops_desc: A Mechanized Workshop is the replacement of various physical tasks in a workshop with mechanical solutions, allowing a greater amount of work to be completed at a faster rate.
military_aviation_desc: By combining conventional aviation with military technology, it is possible to create aircraft that can fulfill a variety of military roles.
mobile_armor_desc: By equipping a motorized vehicle with metal plating, it is possible to create an advanced weaponry platform.
modern_nursing_desc: By using techniques such as hand washing and bedside care, nurses are able to reduce the amount of fatalities by a considerable amount.
modern_sewerage_desc: Modern Sewerage is the creation of specific tunnels and pipes to remove refuse from a city, leading to a better standard of living.
currency_standards_desc: By establishing a standardized currency the population can be taxed in a uniform fashion, collecting tax via currency rather than labor or goods.
monitor_tech_desc: By making a smaller warship better suited for shallow water and slapping massive guns on it, it is possible to make an effective naval weapon.
musical_instruments_desc: Music is a key part of the development of any culture and art. In that regard the evolution of musical instruments a culture creates first have an echoing influence on all future cultural developments.
napoleonic_warfare_desc: Napoleon revolutionized warfare, emphasizing the importance of properly utilizing artillery.
nationalism_desc: Who am I? It is a key question that runs to the hearts of the identity of a person. In times past people have said they are from a province, a town or even a family as an expression of that identity. A new ideas have developed that transcends these notions and instead see identity as something that is shared amongst the nation. What is more, the nation should be united into a single country.
natural_selection_desc: Natural selection is a mechanism by which lifeforms evolve by passing on heritable traits to future generations. Its discovery provide an explanation to how species arise and adapt according to their environment.
naval_theory_desc: By applying some strategy to naval movements it is possible to make a much more effective Navy.
drydocks_desc: Creating enclosed areas where ships can be docked on dry land allows for easier and more thorough maintenance of cargo vessels and warships alike.
navigation_desc: Through various different methods, from stars, to maps, to a compass it is possible to correctly chart a course across the world.
neoclassicism_desc: The Classical period of art, theater and music stretched from around 1750 to 1820, with innovations since then being labelled Neoclassical. The name also alludes to Classical Antiquity, and hence compares the West's high culture to that of Rome and Greece, thereby establishing the pedigree of Europe's ruling class as masters of the known world.
nitrogen_fixation_desc: By combining various chemicals at a high temperature, it is possible to create ammonia in large quantities.
nitroglycerin_desc: This was the technique of producing reliable explosives out of nitrates. This often meant using fertilizers as base material.
open_hearth_furnace_desc: The production of steel involves the removal impurities from pig iron and then adding in other materials to create the grade of steel you are after. To produce steel requires very high temperatures and the open hearth furnace uses the waste gas from the furnace to heat bricks and reverse the flow of fuel and air passes over these bricks to build up the heat of the furnace. The process is slower than others, but is easier to control and scale allowing large quantities of steel to be produced in a single batch.
open_hearth_process_desc: This is a special process to burn out the impurities from pig iron and thus allow it to turn into steel.
opium_dens_desc: An Opium den is simply a place were opium can be purchased and smoked. However, there are people that worry that these dens are of a more sinister bent and are a source of moral corruption.
paddle_steamer_desc: The paddle steamer is a steam powered watercraft, where the steam is used to turn paddles that pushes the ship through the water.
pan-nationalism_desc: The notions of nationalism are in general the idea of people who speak the same language are the same people. But what of those who almost speak the same language as us? People see them as our cousins, but there is a new school of thought that they are really our long lost brothers and we should be united into a great whole. Together we will be stronger and able to protect our people.
percussion_cap_desc: The percussion cap is a single use device which allows firearms to operate reliably in all types of weather.
percussion_caps_desc: Percussion caps take previously unreliable firearms and make it possible for them to fire in any weather.
personal_liberty_desc: In addition to the question of how society should be governed, there is also the question of what should be beyond governance. Establishing individual liberties upon which the tyranny of the majority may not intrude is a crucial part of liberal ideals.
pharmaceuticals_desc: The discovery of Pharmaceuticals allows for medicine to jump ahead as they can be prescribed for all types of ailments.
policing_by_consent_desc: Sir Robert Peel, while serving as Home Secretary, created the Metropolitan Police, a constabulary distinct from the gendarmerie of Continental tyrants because they are civilians acting in the public interest rather than soldiers repressing political enemies.
political_agitation_desc: By taking to the streets, political agitators rile people up, encouraging them to take political action at the first possible moment.
political_theory_desc: How to run a country is a question many have started to ask and several theories have been drawn up on what exactly the best blueprint for a state would look.
popular_sovereignty_desc: The authority of a state and by extension of its government can only be created and sustained through the consent of its people. In a free government, the rulers are the servants and the people their superiors and sovereigns.
portland_cement_desc: So named for its resemblance to stone quarried from an island in Dorset, England, this cement is an effective component in concrete, used for building large structures. It is produced from limestone and other common materials, making it very cheap.
potash_desc: Produced by burning wood and depositing the ashes into a pot of water, potash is used in chemical processes such as the production of glass, soap, lye, gunpowder and fertilizer. It lends its name to the element potassium, which is the active ingredient in these processes.
power_looms_desc: A loom is a device for weaving wool, cotton and other fibers. Early looms used hand or foot power to spin the thread. The 'flying shuttle' invented in 1733 is credited with spurring the industrial revolution, and the use of mechanical power in weaving allows less skilled weavers to mass produce cloth. Additional innovations include the Jacquard loom, a system of programmable punch cards developed in 1804 to automate patterns.
power_of_the_purse_desc: Power of the Purse gives the ability to make purchases to the captains, allowing for a much more autonomous and effective fleet.
pre_modern_warfare_desc: The conflicts of yesteryear pale in comparison to the ravages of modern war, yet they were still bloody affairs in their own right.
propaganda_desc: During the Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars, the governments of Europe established propaganda wings to garner public support for the hardships faced by the common people. Political pamphlets and satirical cartoons were distributed in the cities, while patriotic verses were written to be sung to popular tunes.
puddling_furnaces_desc: A puddling furnace is used to produce wrought iron from pig iron. A brick furnace is heated so that the iron melts with accompanying cinder, after which the mixture is mechanically worked, such as with a crowbar, so that excess carbon in the iron is brought into contact with the air, forming carbon monoxide, while sulfur and other impurities are carried off by lighter slag that rises to the surface. After two hours of being worked by hand, 'puddle balls' of wrought iron form and can be removed from the remaining slag. This is a difficult, skilled, and therefore expensive job to perform.
quinine_desc: Isolation of quinine allows it to be used as a most effective medicine against the harsh effects of malaria.
radio_desc: By using invisible 'waves' it is possible to pass information over a great distance wirelessly.
railways_desc: The first steam locomotive railways were built to transport passengers, only later being used for industrial purposes. The efficient and rapid method of travel quickly rendered canal systems obsolete, sometimes just years after the canals had been completed at great expense.
rationalism_desc: Rationalism is the philosophical doctrine that knowledge is acquired by reason without resort to experience.
realism_desc: An artistic movement seeking to portray reality accurately, avoiding romanticizing or exaggerating the subject. It often focuses on contemporary everyday life of people of varying class and profession.
reinforced_concrete_desc: By adding steel reinforcing bars, or rebar, to concrete, structures can take advantage of steel's greater strength with only a modest increase in cost and weight.
repeaters_desc: The Repeater allows the firing of several cartridges in between reloading, which in turn leads to a greater rate of fire.
rifling_desc: Rifling is the discovery that by etching spiral grooves into the barrel of a gun it is possible to impart spin on the projectile thus increasing accuracy.
romanticism_desc: An art movement celebrating the emotional and imaginary, in contrast to the proper and rational. Depictions of nature, history and dramatic, emotionally powerful scenes are common.
rotary_valve_engine_desc: A rotary valve engine is a steam engine with various additions, such as variable valve timing. These additions make it much more heat efficient than the standard steam engine.
rubber_recycling_desc: The use of a 'masticator' to chew up and reform old rubber allows us to recycle and reuse this valuable material.
rubberised_fabrics_desc: Using natural rubber to stick two fabrics together, or to combine plant fibers into a kind of artificial leather, produces waterproof articles such as the Mackintosh coat, or elastic clothing such as suspenders.
rule_of_law_desc: Usually present in a system of government with either a written (as in the United States) or unwritten (as in the United Kingdom) constitution, Rule of Law consists of a group of related ideas on jurisprudence, such as that the state's violence be predictable, and therefore avoidable, by having the government set down clearly what is illegal and what the punishment for crimes will be; and that the state's agents themselves be subject to the laws they enforce.
screw_frigate_desc: The Screw Frigate is the application of screw propeller technology to create faster ships.
sea_lane_strategies_desc: By focusing naval power on controlling the sea lanes, naval dominance is much easier to achieve.
semaphore_signalling_desc: Railway signals convey instructions to trains active on railway lines, helping direct traffic even when a locomotive is in motion and away from personnel at a station. The use of semaphore signals, inspired by a military signalling system utilized by Napoleon's armies, creates a uniform system that all railroads can utilize.
separation_of_powers_desc: The idea of distinct branches of government with different roles which oversee one another to prevent corruption and abuse has become vastly more popular since the relative success of the 'great American experiment', with her Constitution splitting the government into executive, legislative and judicial branches.
sericulture_desc: The ancient and closely guarded technique of cultivating silkworms for the production of silk.
sewage_systems_desc: The growth of cities have lead to rivers choked with sewage, they have turned black and smell like death. Time to look back to the ancients who build sewer systems to carry these foul waters from the city.
shaft_mining_desc: By mining straight down to the desired depth before branching it off, and then using a lift system to raise materials up and down it is possible to make a much more efficient mine.
shell_gun_desc: The Shell Gun is a remarkable piece of artillery due to the nature of its ammunition. The projectiles themselves are explosive leading to more damage than a simple chunk of metal would.
slag_fertilisers_desc: The low pH value of the waste from blast furnaces and steel converters makes it an excellent addition to soil for farming purposes. Silicate lime slag is more soluble than natural limestone or dolomite, increasing the phosphate content of the soil.
socialism_desc: A political ideology that encourages common social ownership of the means of production and self management by workers rather than an upper class.
enclosure_desc: The merger of subsistence plots into enclosed, privately owned fields permits for more organized agriculture and the use of arable land for growing cash crops rather than food.
intensive_agriculture_desc: By integrating food production into the industrial supply chain it is possible to realize much higher yields.
steam_donkey_desc: By applying steam power to a winch system it is possible to achieve similar levels of power without the same amount of labor.
threshing_machine_desc: By removing the physical labor aspect of threshing the grain, the Steam Powered Threshing Machine makes farming much more efficient.
steel_frame_buildings_desc: By making a steel frame to hold up the rest of the building, it is possible to make much taller and sturdier buildings.
steel_railway_cars_desc: Steel Railway Cars allow trains to be much sturdier and in turn to carry much more weight.
stormtroopers_desc: Having troops trained and equipped specifically for infiltration allows greater success when assaulting more embedded positions.
streamliners_desc: New train designs utilizing modern tractive power and new aluminum-body construction enable railroads to run more trains reliably at higher speeds.
submarine_desc: Submarines take the concept of a boat and submerge it, leading to greater stealth and thus tactical capability.
multilateral_alliances_desc: The industrial potential and global reach of modern states requires the formation of truly international alliances to ensure the safety of our interests.
synthetic_dye_desc: This incorporated a chemical process that created different types of dye in a synthetic way. It revolutionized the coloring of fabric and brought an end to the production of agricultural dyes, which became too expensive to produce.
system_gin_desc: By making various improvements to the cotton gin, such as using steam power, it is possible to make a much more efficient machine.
telegraph_desc: Electricity can be used to pass signals down lines almost instantly, such as with Morse code. The chief source of delay is in the human operator, who needs to be well trained to code and decode the messages which have been transferred in the form of short and long 'dots' and 'dashes' of noise.
telephone_desc: Telephones make long distance communication viable allowing a much faster spread of information across the globe.
telephones_desc: In theory we have known that the idea of the speaking telegraph could be possible, but we just weren't sure how. Advances in the field of electronics have made this idea finally possible and the telephone is born.
tin_cans_desc: The concept of canned food dates back to glass jars used by armies of the French Revolution. Soon, the idea spread to civilian use. Meat or soup which has been cooked inside a metal can is protected from exposure to the outside world and can be consumed at leisure by middle-class households. The name derives from tinplate, which has a thin layer of tin outside the iron or steel plate to protect the metal from rusting in the open air.
trench_works_desc: By equipping soldiers with the correct tools, it is possible for them to create strong fortifications with little effort.
triage_desc: By treating the wounded in regard to the seriousness of their wounds and the likelihood of recovery, it is possible to make a much more effective, emergency care system.
urban_planning_desc: By planning out cities before they are built, rather than letting them develop naturally, it is possible to create a much more efficient living area.
urbanization_desc: As more and more people move from living in the countryside to living in the cities, their very way of life is bound to change too.
vaccination_desc: Inoculating people with what were hoped to be less virulent forms of a disease had been known for centuries but was also highly risky. Vaccination, which involved either using a less dangerous but related disease or by treating the agents of the diseases so they lost the ability to infect, was much safer and much more reliable.
vacuum_canning_desc: Vacuum Canning is a method of sealing cans using a vacuum to keep the contents preserved for longer.
vulcanization_desc: Rubber used in the clothing industry provides many advantages such as waterproofing and elasticity, but it becomes brittle in cold weather and sticky in hot weather. Vulcanization is the process of combining the rubber with sulphur and heat to make it more durable and preserve its shape after manufacturing.
wargaming_desc: By mocking up imaginary warfare scenarios and practicing strategy, it is possible to improve officers combat abilities.
water_treatment_desc: Water has been found to be carrying diseases into our homes. Still science has the answer, we can simply make the water clean again by application of filtration and chemical treatments.
central_archives_desc: A modern state requires good record-keeping, and good record-keeping requires thorough paperwork. If you wish to learn more, please fill form ML-4.11866 in triplicate and expect a reponse in 2-5 working days.
steelworking_desc: The hardy qualities of steel have been widely prized for millennia, but large-scale production of this invaluable iron alloy has proven difficult to master until recently.
prospecting_desc: Mining gold requires first finding gold. From individuals panning for riches to industrial-scale searches, prospecting is what makes fortunes real.
baking_powder_desc: Baked goods have been around since the dawn of civilization, but only with the advent of baking powder has baking at an industrial scale become truly possible.
mechanical_tools_desc: Handcrafted goods can be of exceptional quality, but for consistency and rapidity in production, mechanical aids are needed.
rubber_mastication_desc: Natural rubber is a strange, viscous thing that needs heavy working in order to create a suitable material for industrial use.
pumpjacks_desc: The trick with crude oil is getting it out of the ground in a regular, consistent flow. The pumpjack, a straightforward pump, fits the bill perfectly.
shift_work_desc: Rotating teams of laborers in and out of a workplace is a sound way to maintain a steady flow of production over the course of a day for much longer than could be expected from one team working extended hours.
paved_roads_desc: Dirt roads are bumpy, uneven, and at the slightest hint of water they become horrible muddy traps for heavy vehicles. Paving roads, providing a solid surface that won't wear and tear so quickly as dirt and gravel, helps provide a nicer experience for road-users and improve the flow of freight and passenger traffic.
pasteurization_desc: Briefly heating milk and juices eliminates disease-carrying bacteria and enzymes, making the products safer to drink and prolonging their shelf-life.
pneumatic_tools_desc: One of the greatest forces man can harness is the air itself. Pressurized air, applied correctly in pipes and pistons, can provide an astounding amount of force for industrial use.
steam_turbine_desc: Using the power of steam to drive large rotors, turbines create tremendous amounts of energy that serve equally well as stationary machines in a plant and as the driving engines of seagoing vessels.
plastics_desc: There's a great future in plastics. They're moldable, malleable, able to be shaped and kept in any form anyone wants. Soon, it will be a plastic world.
dough_rollers_desc: To produce all the food demanded by a rapidly-growing population, traditional bakers won't suffice any longer.
oil_turbine_desc: The power of a turbine can be amplified with the use of oil, a far more energy-rich fuel than coal.
standing_army_desc: The complex challenges of foreign policy and domestic unrest can no longer be dealt with by hastily-mustered militias. Modern times require a military ready at all times to act.
mandatory_service_desc: Volunteers and mercenaries might not meet all the manpower demands of a modern military force. Sometimes, the nation simply must demand service from all its citizens.
line_infantry_desc: Soldiers equipped with standardized gear and trained with standardized methods give a greater uniformity to an army, and in that way give it a greater reliability.
logistics_desc: The greatest guns in the world don't matter in the slightest if the soldiers equipped with them are too exhausted and hungry to aim, or if the guns themselves have no bullets chambered in them.
electric_telegraph_desc: Through the use of simple electric pulses, messages can be rapidly transmitted through codes across vast distances. Officers in a stuffy office can send commands to armies on the far side of the world instantaneously. What hath God wrought?
enlistment_offices_desc: Offices built to attract recruits help immensely with bolstering the nation's military manpower.
military_statistics_desc: A good general knows not just where every bullet was fired, but where that bullet was supplied from and how many bullets are left.
war_propaganda_desc: Convincing a population to commit its time, its resources, and its blood, all for the sake of victory, is a whole field of work on its own.
nco_training_desc: It's as important to maintain a trained body of lower-ranking officers familiar with their craft as it is to maintain academy-trained captains and generals.
destroyer_desc: Lighter vessels, equipped with torpedoes and smaller guns, are just as important in modern navies as capital ships.
landing_craft_desc: Vessels designed specifically for protecting waterborne troops greatly improve the chances of an amphibious assault actually succeeding.
flamethrowers_desc: A great way to drive entrenched soldiers out of their defensive positions is to light a fire under them.
banking_desc: A vast financial institution, the bank provides security for public and private interests, and can become the centerpiece of a vast monetary network of investments, loans, and opportunities.
academia_desc: Institutions of higher education don't just improve individual minds, but bring the nation's best and brightest together, where they can create extraordinary things.
international_relations_desc: Formalizing diplomacy provides a firm framework for both improved cordiality and hostility with other nations.
stock_exchange_desc: An organized market where stocks and bonds can be bought and sold, the stock exchange is a central element of the modern market economy.
medical_degrees_desc: Public health is greatly improved when those given responsibility for it are trained and certified in their fields.
organized_sports_desc: Sports aren't just for those playing them. They're a show, an expression of community, a place where a crowd can feel like they belong. The spectacle of sports matters just as much as the feats committed on the field.
central_banking_desc: Harnessing and centralizing the banks brings an immense amount of power into the hands of the government.
corporate_charters_desc: Companies whose assets and incomes are separate from that of their owners and investors, thereby mitigating personal risks while encouraging entrepreneurship.
joint_stock_companies_desc: A joint-stock company is one whose ownership is divided into a number of shares which are held unequally by many investors, who derive dividends from the company according to the size of the portion they own. This allows trading of partial ownership and investment by both rich and middle-class businessmen.
investment_banks_desc: Towering financial institutions catering to the needs of corporate finance, invenstment banks primarily assist in the raising of capital for private enterprise.
corporate_management_desc: By synergistically introducing higher degrees of streamlining, professionalization, and scientification within our existing corporate culture, we can expect to leverage substantially maximized revenue and collaboratively evolve the industry through the seamless visualization of efficient initiatives.
dialectics_desc: Applying philosophical concepts to material conditions produces may create novel concepts, and perhaps new political ideas.
psychiatry_desc: The idea that mental disorders can be approached medically, and by being approached medically can be diagnosed and treated, is a new concept that opens up new worlds for the betterment of people.
postal_savings_desc: A valuable method for people to save money even if they do not have access to a bank, postal savings promote both the storage and flow of money among even the poorest of citizens.
human_rights_desc: Embracing the idea of universal, inalienable rights for all people invites new concepts into the nation's social and political venues.
mutual_funds_desc: A sort of pooled investment funds, the mutual fund helps combine the individual wealth of investors into massive pools of money that can flex immense financial strength to acquire securities and other costly financial instruments.
zeppelins_desc: A sort of rigid lighter-than-air aircraft, the zeppelin can carry freight and passenger loads high above the clouds, surpassing obstacles on land and sea.
international_exchange_standards_desc: Establishing an international system of accounting and exchange makes trade between nations simpler and cheaper to maintain.
psychoanalysis_desc: Theories of personal mental development provide the framework for broader theories of social behavior, which can be used to help understand the collective instincts and thoughts of the population.
philosophical_pragmatism_desc: The application and actions of philosophical thought can open up whole new avenues for social and political analysis.
modern_financial_instruments_desc: Moneymaking methods continue to grow and proliferate. Some methods may involve money flowing in a pyramid upwards, but all of them involve more and more money flowing all the time.
macroeconomics_desc: Money should be approached holistically. Why only consider how a single market may fare in the next five years, when all the markets, together, globally, can be accounted for?
behaviorism_desc: Establishing the law of effect, it becomes possible to create a predictive model of behavior that can be applied to the public at large.
analytical_philosophy_desc: A rigorous, argumentative approach to philosophy, the formal logic and near-mathematical attitude of analytic philosophy provides a solid framework to approach social movements with.
electrical_capacitors_desc: Electrical Capacitors allow for the increased usage of electricity without the necessity of having a directly connected generator.
corporatism_desc: An approach towards social relations based on collaboration between different corporate groups in society, with the ultimate goal of superseding conflict between classes.

princely_state_creation.1.d: With our acquisition of [SCOPE.sState('baluchistan_state').GetName], we have established the Baluchistan Agency to coordinate the governance of the region. Proposals have been put forth to return regions of Baluchistan to native rule.
princely_state_creation.1.a: Distribute the Southern regions to our loyal princes.
princely_state_creation.1.b: Partition the region, with Kalati authority over Makaran.
princely_state_creation.1.c: Establish a nineteen gun salute state of Kalat.
princely_state_creation.1.e: The High Commissioner may take full control of the province.
princely_state_creation.2.d: Prior to our acquisition of [SCOPE.sState('sindh_state').GetName], the region was split between the various branches of the Talpur Dynasty. Proposals have been put forth to establish a princely state in Sindh, under compliant Talpur rulers.
princely_state_creation.2.a: Allow the Northern Talpur dynasty to remain in place.
princely_state_creation.2.b: Establish all of Sindh as a nineteen gun salute state.
princely_state_creation.2.c: Fold all of Sindh into the Bombay Presidency.
princely_state_creation.3.d: Our acquisition of [SCOPE.sState('pashtunistan_state').GetName] has brought our border to the Pamir Mountains. Proposals have been made to delegate the administration of this remote region to compliant native rulers.
princely_state_creation.3.a: Grant autonomy to the region's loyal rulers.
princely_state_creation.3.b: Expand the territory of Chitral to the entire North.
princely_state_creation.3.c: The native rulers have proven to be unreliable.
princely_state_creation.4.d: Our newly-acquired province of [SCOPE.sState('kashmir_state').GetName] was once a powerful kingdom in its own right. Proposals have been made to establish a new, powerful princely state to administer the region.
princely_state_creation.4.a: Establish Jammu and Kashmir as a twenty-one gun salute state.
princely_state_creation.5.d: The newly acquired [SCOPE.sState('shan_state').GetName] are organized as a complex patchwork of various Shan principalities. Proposals have been made to organize them as a confederation of princely states under their current forms of government, with a shared Resident.
princely_state_creation.5.a: Grant them autonomy under their own rulers, with a shared Resident.
princely_state_creation.5.b: Incorporate them as a Shan District.

india_events.1.d_2: With the establishment of Crown rule over India, [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetFullName] has assumed the title of
india_events.1.b: Advise [SCOPE.sCharacter('ruler_scope').GetHerHim] against this course of action.
india_events.2.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjective] administration has planned a grand durbar in [SCOPE.sState('delhi_scope').GetCityHubName] to officially proclaim [SCOPE.sCharacter('monarch_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('monarch_scope').GetFullName] as [SCOPE.sCharacter('monarch_scope').GetCustom('getEmpressEmperor')] of India. Dignitaries from across [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] India have been invited to attend.
india_events.2.a: Shah in Shah Padishah. May God bless [SCOPE.sCharacter('monarch_scope').GetHerHim].
india_events.2.b: A chance to offer [SCOPE.sCharacter('monarch_scope').GetHerHim] our loyalty, and one humble request.
india_events.3.d: With the capture of [SCOPE.sState('punjab_scope').GetCityHubName] by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] forces, we have acquired the legendary Koh-i-Noor diamond.
india_events.3.a: Present the diamond as a spoil of war to [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetRuler.GetFirstNameNoFormatting].
india_events.3.b: Transport the diamond to our treasury in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName].
koh_i_noor_in_europe_tt: A #bold European#! [concept_country] has seized the #bold Koh-i-Noor#! diamond
demand_return_of_diamond_tt: We will demand that [SCOPE.sCountry('diamond_country').GetName] return the #bold Koh-i-Noor#! diamond
returned_koh_i_noor_tt: The #bold Koh-i-Noor#! diamond will be returned to India
india_events.4.d_1: The nation of [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetNameNoFlag], recently independent from our rule, has requested the return of the Koh-i-Noor diamond. The diamond is currently held within our vaults as a spoil of war.
india_events.4.d_2: The nation of [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetNameNoFlag] has requested the return of the Koh-i-Noor diamond. The diamond is currently held within our vaults as a spoil of war.
india_events.4.a: It is ours by treaty and right of conquest.
india_events.4.b: Valuable things are meant to be spent.
india_events.5.d: Indebted [GetPopType('peasants').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('riots_site_scope').GetName] have launched a series of rebellions against local moneylenders, intended to destroy the records of their debts.
india_events.5.a: Send in the Army to contain the rebellion.
india_events.5.b: Annul these debts before the riots worsen.
india_events.6.d: Our intelligence service has discovered a conspiracy involving Indian revolutionaries colluding with agents of the [SCOPE.sCountry('enemy_great_power_scope').GetAdjective] government. They intend to orchestrate a pan-Indian rebellion against [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjective] rule.
india_events.6.b: Remain vigilant, but we must not be rash.
conspiracy_trials_in_30_days_tt: Suspected conspirators will be put on trial in #v 30#! days
india_events.7.d: In the city of [SCOPE.sState('conspiracy_trial_state').GetCityHubName], several hundred members of Indian independence organizations have been put on trial for conspiring with [SCOPE.sCountry('enemy_great_power_scope').GetAdjective] agents to subvert [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjective] rule.
india_events.7.f: The newspapers and the people followed the trial with great interest. For some it was a sign of the growing discontent. For others, it was proof that no gunpowder plot, whether led by Englishmen or Indians, could undermine the Crown. For most locals, however, it was simply what it was. A solemn procession of three hundred men, condemned one after another.
india_events.7.a: Let us hope this is the end of it.
india_events.7.b: Forty-two death sentences make forty-two martyrs.
india_events.8.d_1: The city of Delhi has turned out to celebrate harmony between Hindus and Muslims with the festival of Phool Walon Ki Sair. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] has made [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] traditional appearance, observing the Sair from the Zahar Mahal.
india_events.8.d_2: The city of Delhi has turned out to celebrate the traditional Indian festival of Phool Walon Ki Sair. The occasion celebrates communal harmony between Hindus and Muslims.
india_events.8.d_3: The city of Delhi has turned out to celebrate harmony between Hindus and Muslims with the festival of Phool Walon Ki Sair. Floral offerings are placed on the city's shrines, and dance and song fills the streets.
india_events.8.f: Music thrums through the air, accompanied by the scent of thousands of flowers. People across the city gather, Hindus and Muslims. Their religion is not forgotten, but the usual tensions have been replaced with a mutual love for dance, prayer and food.
india_events.8.a: A beautiful show of harmony and color.
india_events.8.b: There is a clear danger of the festival being politicized.
india_events.8.c: Offer an official contribution to the displays.
india_events.9.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('government_scope').GetName] has issued an order unifying the three [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('presidency_armies').GetName] into a single body - the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] Army.
india_events.9.b: An opportunity to further incorporate native troops.
india_events.10.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('carmichael_scope').GetFullName], a Christian missionary active in [SCOPE.sState('dohnavur_state').GetName], has become well-known in the region for providing sanctuary to children forced into prostitution. She has founded a ministry to further her works.
india_events.10.a: Her cause warrants an official donation.
india_events.10.b: We cannot be seen sponsoring missionaries.
india_events.11.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('mehta_scope').GetFullName], the child of a local judge, has been spotted participating in protests against the [SCOPE.sCharacter('simon_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] Commission in [SCOPE.sState('mehta_state').GetName]. Her and other child protesters face the police whilst dressed in the colors of the Indian flag.
india_events.11.f: Their ages had not insulated themselves from the attention of the colonial police. A week ago, they had faced a lathi charge, dozens of grown men with batons scattering their picket line and casting down the flag they had made themselves. They had returned to their parents in tears, blood leaking from skinned palms and knees.\n\nNow, instead of holding a flag which could be torn out of their hands, they draped themselves in its colors. Even if the children were knocked down once more, their clothing would show the the world their cause.
india_events.11.a: Such bravery at such a young age.
india_events.11.b: Her father will suffer consequences for this.
india_events.12.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('besant_scope').GetFullName], a former socialist activist turned Theosophist, has announced her intention to depart [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] for India. She will soon join her Theosophist colleagues at their headquarters in [SCOPE.sState('madras_state').GetName].
india_events.12.a: May she have a safe journey.
india_events.13.d: Members of the Theosophical Society in [SCOPE.sState('madras_state').GetName] have declared the young [SCOPE.sCharacter('krishnamurti_scope').GetFullName] to be the likely future vessel of the divine entity Lord Maitreya. [SCOPE.sCharacter('besant_scope').GetFullName], a Theosophist activist, has sought to adopt the boy.
india_events.13.f: The monsoon had yet to come, and the sky was still cloudless. The boy stood on the beach, staring aimlessly at the incoming waves. Lost, aloof, insulated from all around him by some intangible barrier. His father trudged through the sand, and placed a hand on his shoulder. The boy looked to him once more, and the memory of the sea silently passed away.
india_events.13.a: [SCOPE.sCharacter('besant_scope').GetSheHe|U] will allow him to realize his full potential.
india_events.13.b: The boy belongs with his father, well away from the occult.
krishnamurti_chain_end_tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('krishnamurti_scope').GetFullName] will live an ordinary life with his family
krishnamurti_chain_adopted_tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('krishnamurti_scope').GetFullName] will be adopted into the Theosophical Society, and be raised to become the #bold World Teacher#!
india_events.14.t: The Order of the Star in the East
india_events.14.d: The Theosophical Society has founded an organization dedicated to prepare the world for the arrival of the divine Lord Maitreya. [SCOPE.sCharacter('krishnamurti_scope').GetFullName], believed to be the future vessel of this being, has been appointed as the head of the organization.
india_events.14.f:
#bold Declaration of Principles#!

1. We believe that a great Teacher will soon appear in the world, and we wish so to live now that we may be worthy to know Him when He comes.

2. We shall try, therefore, to keep Him in our minds always, and to do in His name, and therefore to the best of our ability, all the work which comes to us in our daily occupations.

3. As far as our ordinary duties allow, we shall endeavour to devote a portion of our time each day to some definite work which may help to prepare for His coming.
india_events.14.a: A means to inspire the world.
india_events.14.b: An Order to realise our earthly agenda.
india_events.15.d: Whilst on retreat in [SCOPE.sState('california_state').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('krishnamurti_scope').GetFullName] has been struck by peculiar physical symptoms and a strong feeling of
india_events.15.a: Could it be true? Is he touched by the divine?
india_events.15.b: This man is troubled, nothing more.
india_events.16.d: In an announcement at the Order of the Star's annual convention in [SCOPE.sState('star_camp_state').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('krishnamurti_scope').GetFullName] has disavowed his following and proclaimed the Order dissolved. The Theosophical Society has been thrown into confusion by the announcement.
india_events.16.a: The cause of freedom requires no leader.
india_events.16.b: Only the World Teacher could be so humble.
india_events.16.c: Perhaps it is time for him to retire.
india_events.17.d: A procession of carriages through the streets of [SCOPE.sState('khudiram_state').GetFarmHubName] has been interrupted by a bombing attack which killed two [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] women. One of the perpetrators, [SCOPE.sCharacter('khudiram_scope').GetFullName], has been brought into custody.
india_events.17.f: There was not a hint of trepidation on the young man's face, even with an armed policeman to his side and a hostile judge ahead of him. His back was erect, his shoulders were relaxed, and his face bore a beatific smile.\n\nThe outcome of the trial was not ever in doubt, even with a skilled counsel defending him. His mistake had been fatal, his end was certain from the moment the constables had laid eye on him. The worries of life had evacuated him, and left him unburdened. There was nothing to do but ensure he would be remembered.
india_events.17.a: His crimes warrant execution by hanging.
india_events.17.b: Life imprisonment will prevent him from becoming a martyr.
khudiram_in_jail_tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('khudiram_scope').GetFullName] will be sentenced to life imprisonment
