notification_koh_i_noor_sent_desc: The legendary Koh-i-Noor diamond, formerly owned by the Mughal, Persian, and Sikh Empires, has been captured by our forces and sent to [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] on the orders of the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of India. The diamond has been presented to [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetRuler.GetFullName] as a spoil of war.
notification_koh_i_noor_not_sent_desc: The legendary Koh-i-Noor diamond, formerly owned by the Mughal, Persian, and Sikh Empires, has been captured by our forces in India. The diamond has been sent to the treasury in [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] as a spoil of war.
notification_koh_i_noor_returned_desc: The [SCOPE.sCountry('koh_i_noor_owner_scope').GetAdjective] government has agreed to return the Koh-i-Noor diamond to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag], as a symbol of reconciliation between them and their former colonial subjects.
notification_koh_i_noor_not_returned_des: The current holders of the Koh-i-Noor diamond in [SCOPE.sCountry('koh_i_noor_owner_scope').GetName] have refused to return the Koh-i-Noor diamond, claiming that it is rightfully theirs by the terms of the treaty signed with its previous owners.
notification_combatting_hindu_german_con: Our intelligence service in the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] has discovered a conspiracy involving Indian revolutionaries colluding with agents of the [SCOPE.sCountry('enemy_great_power_scope').GetAdjective] government. The [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetAdjective] administration is launching a crackdown to catch the suspects.
notification_not_combatting_hindu_german: Our intelligence service in the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] has discovered a conspiracy involving Indian revolutionaries colluding with agents of the [SCOPE.sCountry('enemy_great_power_scope').GetAdjective] government. The [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetAdjective] administration has been less than proactive with its investigation.
notification_besant_to_india_desc: The Theosophist activist [SCOPE.sCharacter('besant_scope').GetFullName] has moved to India to continue [SCOPE.sCharacter('besant_scope').GetHerHis] reformist efforts
demand_return_of_koh_i_noor_desc: Our former colonial masters removed the legendary Koh-i-Noor diamond from India during the period of their rule, and placed it within their own vaults. We will issue a demand to have our nation's stolen property returned to us.
koh_i_noor_return_requested_too_recently: An Indian [concept_country] has not demanded the return of the #bold Koh-i-Noor#! in the past #v 10#! years
not_at_war_with_koh_i_noor_owner_tt: Is not at war with the owner of the #bold Koh-i-Noor#!
granted_india_home_rule_tt: We have elected to grant [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] #bold Home Rule#!
no_south_asian_primary_cultures_tt: None of our [Concept('concept_primary_cultures','$concept_primary_cultures$')] have the trait #v $heritage_group_south_asian$#!
south_asian_culture_over_60_tt: Any culture with the #v $heritage_group_south_asian$#! trait has a base [concept_acceptance] above #v 60#!
je_india_home_rule_reason: Across the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName], national consciousness is rising amongst the native Indian population. Native Indians educated in [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFlag] schools and employed by the colonial government have begun to agitate for equal status within imperial institutions, greater economic opportunity, and the eventual establishment of home rule for all of India.\n\nWhilst this [concept_journal_entry] is active, we will have the opportunity to petition [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetName] for greater autonomy and other local reforms. The chance that these petitions will be accepted is dependent upon the status of the #bold progress bar#!.
preserve_british_rule_forever_tt: Preserve [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] rule over #v $BHT$#! for as long as possible
india_home_rule_events.1.d: Following a long period of reform and negotiation with native Indian leaders, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjective] Parliament has passed a law reorganizing the former Raj into the Dominion of India.
south_asian_primary_cultures_tt: All #bold South Asian#! [Concept('concept_culture', '$concept_cultures$')] with [Concept('concept_homeland','$concept_homelands$')] in our nation will become [concept_primary_cultures]
india_home_rule_events.2.d: Facing pressure from the Indian national movement, the government of the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] has requested our approval to permit democratic elections to positions in the Indian administration.
india_home_rule_events.2.f: The request was met in the House of Lords with some amusement.\n\"To vote,
india_home_rule_events.2.a: Indians are incapable of responsible government.
india_home_rule_events.2.b: A necessary step for stabilizing our administration.
india_home_rule_events.2.c: Draw up the reform ourselves, and order it enacted.
india_home_rule_events.3.d: Amidst a peaceful protest in [SCOPE.sState('jallianwala_bagh_state').GetFarmHubName] against our suppression of the Indian national movement, a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] Army unit headed by [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetFullName] has opened fire on the crowd. Hundreds of Indians have been killed, and thousands wounded.
india_home_rule_events.3.a: This must be covered up immediately.
india_home_rule_events.4.d: Despite our efforts to contain the situation, the news of the massacre in [SCOPE.sState('jallianwala_bagh_state').GetFarmHubName] has spread across [SCOPE.sState('jallianwala_bagh_state').GetName]. Riots have begun to break out in major cities as Indians protest the killings.
india_home_rule_events.4.f: In response to the suppression of the Amritsar rebellion this Sunday, the people of India have taken to rioting.\n\n
india_home_rule_events.4.a: Detain [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetLastName], and promise that justice will be done.
india_home_rule_events.4.b: Dispatch the Army to pacify the riots.
india_home_rule_events.4.c: Deploy the Air Force to disperse the crowds.
india_home_rule_events.5.d: As outrage grows over the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('army_ig').GetName]'s actions, a government commission has assembled to investigate the massacre in [SCOPE.sState('jallianwala_bagh_state').GetFarmHubName]. An interview with [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetLastName] has revealed [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetHerHis] claimed motive - to preserve [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetHerHis] honor.
india_home_rule_events.5.b: We must have this man disciplined.
dyer_returns_home_tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetLastName] will be permitted to resign without penalty, and return to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetName] with [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetHerHis] honor intact
dyer_disgraced_tt: [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetLastName] will be stripped of [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetHerHis] rank and awards, and deported back to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetName]
india_home_rule_events.6.d: The former Brigadier General [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetLastName] has returned to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName], following the conclusion of the inquiry into the [SCOPE.sState('jallianwala_bagh_state').GetFarmHubName] massacre. [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetCustom('dyer_fate')]
india_home_rule_events.6.f: The barkeep had not expected his usual crowd to be so divided this Friday evening; for one, there was no game that day. Yet the subject of [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting] had everyone up in arms. Half the people there wanted him dishonourably discharged; the butcher of Poonjab they called him. The other half were passing around a hat for donations. They wished to chip in for the Sword of Honor and purse that some newspaper was planning to give [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] next week.
india_home_rule_events.6.a: We can consider this affair concluded.
india_home_rule_events.6.b: A fundraiser and sword? How depraved are they?
india_home_rule_events.7.d: National consciousness in India is beginning to grow amongst [ROOT.GetCountry.GetOverlord.GetAdjective]-educated [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('petty_bourgeoisie_ig').GetName] who find their financial interests clashing with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] businesses. Their demands range from greater self-governance to full independence.
india_home_rule_events.7.f: Walking to the warehouse, I found my path barred by all the workers. They did not attack me but their intent was clear, no work would be done today. Aware of my frailty, I stood aside and went to have a second cup of tea. Here I overheard two workers, men who had served under me.\n\n
india_home_rule_events.7.a: We must keep an eye on this.
india_home_rule_events.7.b: Their demands may have some merit.
independence_lobby_formed_tt: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] has formed, favoring greater autonomy from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetOverlord.GetName]
india_home_rule_events.8.d: National consciousness in India is beginning to grow amongst our native [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName] and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('petty_bourgeoisie_ig').GetName] who find their financial interests clashing with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] businesses. Their demands range from self-governance to full independence.
india_home_rule_events.8.f:
#bold Indian Subjects turn Traitorous! Call for Complete Independence#!

While many bureaucrats remain loyal to the British government, the general public has turned treasonous. Many have justified their traitorous intent by claiming self-rule as a birthright.

The House of Lords debated the matter. Some believe that this is a natural escalation after the failed debates over Home Rule. Others argue that this is the work of a few rebellious instigators. A member who wished to remain anonymous said,
india_home_rule_events.8.a: Keep a close eye on this.
india_home_rule_events.8.b: They revolt against responsible governance itself.
affect_bar_india_policies_tt: As long as the #v $je_india_nationalism_britain$#! [concept_journal_entry] is active, we may receive reform requests from the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName]
india_home_rule_events.9.d: In response to growing nationalist agitation against [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjective] rule, the [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] has authorized a series of government reforms in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. They establish several elected bodies to assist in the governance of India.
simon_commission_in_ten_years_tt: In #v 10#! years, a [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjective] government commission will assess the results of these reforms
india_home_rule_events.10.d_1: The government has made the decision to immediately dispatch a commission to the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] to discuss constitutional reform. Political divides have emerged over whether the commission should have Indian members.
india_home_rule_events.10.d_2: As scheduled, the government has begun to assemble a commission to send to the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] to discuss constitutional reform. Political divides have emerged over whether the commission should have Indian members.
india_home_rule_events.10.a: They are [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] subjects, and they will have a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] commission.
india_home_rule_events.10.b: Indian people must have a role in their own governance.
ideology_sympathetic_to_indians_tt: The [concept_leader] of this [concept_interest_group] has an [concept_ideology] sympathetic to the #v Indian#! cause
commission_sent_conservative_tt: An all-white commission will be dispatched to the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] to discuss constitutional reform
commission_sent_liberal_tt: A joint [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting]-Indian commission will be dispatched to the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] to discuss constitutional reform
india_home_rule_events.11.d_1: The [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjective] government has dispatched a commission to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] to assess the need for further constitutional reform in India. Several local Indian leaders have been invited to sit on the commission.
india_home_rule_events.11.d_2: The [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjective] government has dispatched a commission to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] to assess the need for further constitutional reform in India. The all-European commission has sparked discontent amongst Indian nationalists.
india_home_rule_events.11.f_1: The [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] had sent seven men, three of them Indian. Many of the Congress-men had been shocked when the news reached [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName]. The moderates hailed this as a victory, already conjuring visions of equal status under a parliamentary system of their own. The radicals raised the point that a token Indian presence on the Commission could only serve the ends of the government, reducing protest to manageable levels before stabbing the hopeful populace in the back. For the first time in some years, the approach to take seemed truly ambiguous.
india_home_rule_events.11.f_2: The police had cleared the port itself, but the roads outside were a lost cause. Black flags lined the street, emblazoned with nationalist slogans and demands for the commissioners to return to [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName]. A piece of fruit impacted the lead automobile, and stuck to the window. To those inside, the slowly dripping juices looked like blood.
india_home_rule_events.11.a: Something may come of it yet.
india_home_rule_events.11.b: Proclaim a boycott of this insulting spectacle.
india_home_rule_events.11.g: We will settle for nothing but full independence!
simon_commission_dispatch_timer_tt: If this action is not taken, the #bold Indian Statutory Commission#! will be dispatched in [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').MakeScope.Var('simon_commission_timer_var').GetValue|v0] months
india_bar_retreat_10_tt: The #v $je_india_nationalism_britain$#! #b progress bar#! will retreat by #v 10#!
india_bar_retreat_25_tt: The #v $je_india_nationalism_britain$#! #b progress bar#! will retreat by #v 25#!

progressbar_above_50_tt: The #b progress bar#!'s value is greater than or equal to #v 50#!
dyer_fate_disciplined: [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetSheHe|U] returns home in disgrace, stripped of rank and awards.
dyer_fate_unrepentant: [SCOPE.sCharacter('dyer_scope').GetSheHe|U] has been greeted with a gift of money and a sword of honor by pro-imperialist citizens.
home_rule_is_over_tt: Any hopes for #bold reconciliation#! between #bold British#! authorities and #bold Indian#! subjects have come to an end.
india_can_change_governance_principles_t: [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] will be able to change its #bold Distribution of Power#! [concept_law]
BIC_not_able_to_change_distribution_of_p: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is forbidden from changing its #bold Distribution of Power#! [concept_law] without permission from its [Concept('concept_overlord','$suzerain$')]
je_india_home_rule_request_democracy_per: The nationalist calls for self-governance have grown too loud to ignore. We must petition our suzerain for permission to provide needed concessions in this direction.\nIf [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetName] accepts, we will be able to enact #b $lawgroup_distribution_of_power$#! [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')]
je_india_nationalism_britain_indian_self: Despotic rule in India is clearly unsustainable. In order to preserve our colonial government in the region, we must offer additional opportunities for Indians to participate in their own governance.
je_india_nationalism_britain_dispatch_si: Our earlier reforms to the Indian administration have proven insufficient in the eyes of many nationalists. Dispatching a commission to study further constitutional reform will serve as a show of our continued commitment to Indian self-governance.
requested_dop_permission_tt: Has not used this action in the last #Bold 5#! years
je_india_nationalism_reason: The collapse of goodwill between moderate nationalist leaders and the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] colonial government has led to radicalization of the Indian national movement towards #b full independence#!. Those few who remain committed to the mission of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('government_scope').GetName] fear that, barring extraordinary efforts, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] will soon be #bold rendered ungovernable#!.
india_independence_movement_defeated_tt: The #b Indian National Movement#! has become politically irrelevant
invoke_doctrine_of_lapse_desc: Annexes a [concept_princely_state], under the justification of either a lack of male heir or incompetent governance.
invoke_doctrine_of_lapse_action_notifica: [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] has declared the [concept_princely_state] of [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] to be ruled in an incompetent manner, ordering it annexed under the Doctrine of Lapse.
[INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] has declared the [concept_princely_state] of [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] to be ruled in an incompetent manner, ordering it annexed under the Doctrine of Lapse.
britain_might_abandon_india_tt: If a [concept_civil_war] breaks out, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetName] may choose to #b abandon India#!
princely_state_lapsed_tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetName] will be sent a [Concept('concept_diplomatic_demand', '$concept_diplomatic_demand_short$')] for #b annexation#!
india_nationalism_events.1.d: Unchecked unrest in the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] has led to the outbreak of a civil war across the Indian subcontinent. Figures across [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] society have suggested abandoning the collapsing subcontinent to its fate.
india_nationalism_events.1.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('british_politician_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting], a senior politician and professor of Oriental studies, was asked about the state of India and if there was any hope for re-establishing governance. He had this to say:\n\n
india_nationalism_events.1.a: Evacuate our personnel, and wash our hands of this affair.
india_nationalism_events.1.b: India has been pacified before. It will be again.
india_nationalism_events.2.d: The outbreak of open civil war across India has broken the resolve of the [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjective] government. They have ordered our administration abrogated, and all [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] citizens to evacuate India immediately.
india_nationalism_events.2.f:
#bold [TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]#!
#bold Imperial [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] Gymkhana Club#!
To all members,
It is with great sorrow that I must ask you to abandon your duty to India. Its ungrateful people have chosen to spit on the very hand that raised them. Say goodbye to our great works and make way for the ports our ancestors built; we will depart from them one last time.
india_nationalism_events.2.a: Burn our papers, and make for the ports.
india_nationalism_events.2.b: Announce an official transfer of power to [SCOPE.sCountry('revolution_scope').GetRuler.GetFullName].
india_nationalism_events.2.c: We will carve out a land of our own from [SCOPE.sState('calcutta_scope').GetCityHubName].
european_pops_may_flee_tt: [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in #bold India#! with the $heritage_group_european$ [Concept('concept_heritage_trait','$concept_heritage_trait_short$')] [Concept('concept_discrimination_trait_group','$concept_discrimination_trait_group_short$')] may flee to our remaining territories
most_european_pops_abandon_india_tt: A large number of #bold European#! [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] will evacuate [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]
some_european_pops_abandon_india_tt: Much of our #bold European#! [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')] will evacuate to [SCOPE.sState('calcutta_scope').GetName]
bengal_free_state_tt: We will declare our sovereignty as the #bold $dyn_c_bengal_free_state$#!
india_nationalism_events.3.d: Indian independence activists led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetFullName] have marched to the seaside of [SCOPE.sState('salt_march_state').GetName] to protest the state salt monopoly. Upon arriving at the shore, they intentionally violated the law by harvesting salt.
india_nationalism_events.3.f:
#bold Salt Riot in [SCOPE.sState('salt_march_state').GetPortHubName]!#!

On [TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString], a large group arrived in [SCOPE.sState('salt_march_state').GetPortHubName] with the clear intent of breaking the Imperial law. They collected seawater and boiled it to produce salt. Nearly all the people gathered were arrested.

We asked the march leader, a senior member of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('anti_overlord_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting], what they intended to do with the salt. He explained that they deemed the salt tax untenable and wished to exert their right to self-rule through this nonviolent protest. If the reader is amused, then they are not alone! But at least one can rest assured that the nationalist movement is in harmless hands.
india_nationalism_events.3.a: Our jails have space for them all.
india_nationalism_events.4.d: An Indian lawyer by the name of [SCOPE.sCharacter('gandhi_scope').GetFullName] has founded the Natal Indian Congress, an organization dedicated to advocating for the rights of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] Indian population.
india_nationalism_events.4.f: #bold Another Treasonous Voice#!\n\n[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] saw the founding of the Natal Indian Congress—another organization in a series of rebellious groups unhappy with the current government. Led by the young Indian advocate, [SCOPE.sCharacter('gandhi_scope').GetFullNameNoFormatting], their focus seems to be the plight of Indians. Our more astute readers will find this unsurprising, as [SCOPE.sCharacter('gandhi_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] was recently reported demanding the right to vote for Indian people. Perhaps we can take solace in the knowledge that despite their grand rebellious notions, these groups remain disunited.
india_nationalism_events.4.a: The Indian community has found its champion.
india_nationalism_events.4.b: We will see how he contends with the [SCOPE.sState('gandhi_state').GetCityHubName] mob.
india_nationalism_events.5.d: After spending many years abroad, [SCOPE.sCharacter('gandhi_scope').GetFullName] has returned to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. He has put his theory of Satyagraha, or
india_nationalism_events.5.f: As the advocate, recently returned from his travels abroad, speaks for the sixth hour, the convention is listless.\n\n
india_nationalism_events.5.a: A hero returns to his native land.
india_nationalism_events.5.b: Order the newspapers to keep this quiet.
notification_gandhi_leaves_desc: [SCOPE.sCharacter('gandhi_scope').GetFullName] has departed [SCOPE.sCountry('gandhi_exit_scope').GetName], seeking to assist the Indian independence movement.
india_nationalism_events.6.d_1: Indian nationalists living in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] have founded the India League, an organization dedicated to advocacy for Indian independence. The League's membership includes several sitting [SCOPE.sParty('india_league_party').GetName] members of parliament.
india_nationalism_events.6.d_2: Indian nationalists living in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] have founded the India League, an organization dedicated to advocacy for Indian independence. The League's membership includes prominent political figures such as [SCOPE.sCharacter('india_league_character').GetFullName].
india_nationalism_events.7.d: The India League has published a brief on conditions in the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName], highlighting extreme poverty and policies of repression against nationalist activists.
india_nationalism_events.7.f: The officer eyed the telegram on his desk, a smirk tugging at his lips. The Governor-General had written to him to complain about the India League and their lengthy document about the treatment of Indians in India. The Governor was furious that the Home Office had allowed the League any room to breathe. The Governor had his sympathies, but the officer could not help but laugh. Surely, the Indian people knew their condition? What did the league hope to achieve? Only a traitor would support their cause. That they allowed some Indians to come study in this great country was kindness enough.
india_nationalism_events.7.a: Something must be done about this.
india_nationalism_events.7.b: Order the work banned in India.
notification_prisoner_out_of_jail_desc: [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetFullName], previously arrested on charges related to [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetHerHis] political activities, has been released from prison.
send_to_jail_desc: #lore Trial and imprison [Character.GetFullName] for any crimes that [Character.GetSheHe] may have committed.#!
jail.1.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetFullName] has been arrested and put on trial for crimes related to [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetHerHis] political agitation. [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetSheHe|U] faces an unsympathetic judge, and a lengthy jail sentence if convicted.
jail.1.a: A three-year sentence, to remind [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetHerHim] of [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetHerHis] place.
jail.1.b: A five-year sentence will get [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetHerHim] out of the public eye.
jail.1.c: [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetSheHe|U] has tested our patience for too long. Ten years.
jail.1.e: We don't want a fiasco. Let [SCOPE.sCharacter('prisoner_scope').GetHerHim] off with a warning.
indian_igs_change_ideologies_tt: [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] will change their [Concept('concept_ideology','$concept_ideologies$')] to reflect the new national situation
at_least_ten_acceptance_5_pops_tt: Has at least ten pops of different cultures at @acceptance_status_5! $full_acceptance$
achievement_be_prepared_tt: Any state has a negative [concept_harvest_condition] with an [Concept('concept_harvest_condition_intensity','$concept_harvest_condition_intensity_short$')] above 5
achievement_be_prepared_2_tt: Does not have an active [concept_famine] in any owned [concept_state]
achievement_be_prepared_3_tt: Has an investment level of 3 or higher in an [concept_institution] that helps alleviate the effects of [Concept('concept_harvest_condition','$concept_harvest_conditions$')] or [Concept('concept_famine','$concept_famines$')]
sepoy_mutiny_events.11.d: The benevolent despotism of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has led to marked improvement in every aspect of public life. The immediate threat of native rebellion has been vanquished, and the Company's rule firmly cemented.
sepoy_mutiny_events.11.b: Let our rule never be threatened again.
upgrade_company_rule_modifier_tt: The effects of the #tooltippable;tooltip:[GetPlayer.GetTooltipTag],modifier_india_company_rule_tt $modifier_india_company_rule$#! modifier will be #b improved#!:\n[GetStaticModifier('modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded').GetDesc]
no_more_utilitarianism_tt: The #v $je_imperialism_of_promise$#! [concept_journal_entry] will no longer be available
end_company_rule_made_available_tt: The #v $bic_end_company_rule$#! decision will become available upon researching #b $civilizing_mission$#!
bic_end_company_rule_desc: The experiment of rule by private corporation has run its course. If we are to normalize our relations with our subjects, we must place India under the direct rule of Parliament and [GetPlayer.GetTopOverlord.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle].
je_federation_of_india_reason:
[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_federation_of_india_intro_text')]

Whilst this [concept_journal_entry] is active, [concept_princely_state] [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] with low [concept_liberty_desire] and high [concept_relations] will occasionally petition for accession into the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_federation_union')].

#b The [concept_privy_purse]:#!
The former rulers of the #b Princely States#! will be entitled to a state pension as compensation for accession to the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_federation_union')]. The $concept_privy_purse$ payments will add #b National Expenses#! of @money![GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('privy_purse_multiplier_base')|D-] times the number of #b Princely States#! annexed using this [concept_journal_entry].[SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_federation_of_india_diploplay_text')]
je_federation_of_india_reason_intro_home: Per the terms of the #b Indian Home Rule Act#!, any #b Princely State#! may petition for accession into the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
je_federation_of_india_reason_intro_inde: The process of our independence has left a multitude of autonomous #b Princely States#! scattered across the Indian subcontinent. If these colonial remnants are not integrated into [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] proper, their continued existence could provide a pretext for further division of our nation.
je_federation_of_india_reason_diploplay_: \n\n@information! Independent Indian nations may be annexed into [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] through the $dp_unify_india$ [concept_diplomatic_play]
invite_princely_states_cooldown_tt: Has #b not#! used this action in the past #b year#!
je_federation_of_india_invite_princely_s: By the terms of our Constitution, any Princely State that wishes to accede to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] may do so at will. If we so wish, we may speed up this process by offering invitations en masse to those Princely States that maintain particularly good relations with us.
federation_of_india.1.d: The government of [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetNameNoFlag] has formally invited [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to accede to the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetCustom('get_federation_union')] of [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]. Whilst the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] family will receive a government allowance, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] time as an independent ruler will come to an end.
federation_of_india.2.d: The last of the Princely States have been incorporated into the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetCustom('get_federation_union')]. The authority of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] now reaches across the entire subcontinent.
federation_of_india.3.d_cr: The rise of a communist government in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has caused a collapse in relations with the remaining Princely States. If these colonial remnants are to be wiped off the map, it will be at the point of the bayonet.
federation_of_india.3.d_infamy: The aggression of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] government has caused a collapse in relations with the remaining Princely States. If they are to be integrated into the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetCustom('get_federation_union')], it will be at the point of the bayonet.
federation_of_india.3.a: India will be one, by pen or by sword.
federation_of_india.3.b: There can be no revolution in silk gloves.
federation_of_india.4.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_princely_state').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_princely_state').GetNameNoFlag] has requested the accession of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_princely_state').GetRuler.GetHerHis] state to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_federation_union')] of $BHT$.
federation_of_india.4.b: We have no need for another territory.
bht_end_privy_purse_payments_desc: The #b $modifier_privy_purse_payments$#! we are paying to the former ruling families of the #b Princely States#! we have annexed add up to a sizable percentage of our budget. We may end these payments prematurely, at the cost of angering the Aristocrats that have come to depend upon them.
warning_may_cause_massive_debt_tt: @warning! Will cause additional #b $modifier_privy_purse_payments$#! of up to @money![GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('privy_purse_value_potential')|D-]
no_federation_je_tt: Does #b not#! have an active #v The Federation of India#! [concept_journal_entry]
no_union_je_tt: Does #b not#! have an active #v The Union of India#! [concept_journal_entry]
all_princely_states_get_invitation_tt: All eligible [Concept('concept_princely_state','$concept_princely_states$')] will be invited to join [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag]
notification_joins_union_of_india_desc: The [SCOPE.sCountry('princely_state_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.sCountry('princely_state_scope').GetName] has signed an instrument of accession to join [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetNameNoFlag].
notification_refuses_to_join_union_of_in: The [SCOPE.sCountry('princely_state_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.sCountry('princely_state_scope').GetName] has refused the offered invitation to join [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetNameNoFlag]. [concept_relations] between the two states have consequentially deteriorated.
upset_every_princely_state_federation_tt: The [concept_liberty_desire] of every [concept_princely_state] will increase by #r 30#! and [concept_relations] will deteriorate by #r 50#!
notification_overlord_government_reform_: [SCOPE.sCountry('india_overlord_scope').GetName] has granted our request to democratize our administration. We may now enact #b $lawgroup_distribution_of_power$#! [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')]

[SCOPE.sCountry('india_overlord_scope').GetName] has refused our request to democratize our administration. [Concept('concept_radical', '$concept_radicalism$')] amongst our #b $heritage_group_south_asian$#! [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')] has increased as a result.\n\nWe may request reform again in #v 5 years#!
je_imperialism_of_promise_reason: We have a duty to promote the common good by any means necessary. Basic liberties and equal opportunities play a central role in policymaking. A [GetIdeology('ideology_utilitarian_millian').GetName] approach to colonial administration promises a strong force for progress both in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] and around the world.
je_imperialism_of_promise_status: Oversee a [GetIdeology('ideology_utilitarian_millian').GetName] approach to colonial administration in [JournalEntry.GetCountry.GetName].
has_any_secessionists_fail_tt: Any seceding countries have broken away from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
bureaucrats_no_shortage_trigger: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFlag] [concept_bureaucracy] is greater or equal to #v 0#! and the country is #bold not#! about to enter a [concept_bureaucracy] deficit
utilitarian.1.d: The principles of [GetIdeology('ideology_utilitarian_millian').GetName] ideology now play a central role in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] policymaking. The administration has been reformed to function like a well-oiled machine.
utilitarian.1.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetFullNameNoFormatting]'s commitment to Utilitarianism has deepened with this success in steering the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]'s development. While some still question the value of [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetLastNameNoFormatting]'s approach to colonial administration, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] have stepped forward to advocate for utilitarian approach.\n\nAs the people of India carry on with their lives, time will tell if the fruit of the administration's labor will be as lasting and far reaching as all hope. The success is a beacon for future reform.
utilitarian.1.f2: The administration's commitment to Utilitarianism has deepened with this success in steering the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]'s development. While some still question the value of this approach to colonial administration, staunch supporters have stepped forward to advocate for a utilitarian approach.\n\nAs the people of India carry on with their lives, time will tell if the fruit of the administration's labor will be as lasting and far reaching as all hope. The success is a beacon for future reform.
utilitarian.1.a: The future looks happy and bright.
utilitarian.2.d: The chaos engulfing the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] serves as a testament to the failure of the [GetIdeology('ideology_utilitarian_millian').GetName] project. Its proponents have been accused of irreversibly destabilizing the administration.
utilitarian.2.f: The promise of a Utilitarian approach to colonial administration has not come to fruition. The failure has left the project's staunchest supporters disillusioned with mocking remarks directed towards them.\n\n
utilitarian.3.d: While a [GetIdeology('ideology_utilitarian_millian').GetName] approach to colonial administration was promising, it did not take root here in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
utilitarian.3.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetFullNameNoFormatting]'s commitment to Utilitarianism has wavered as the project has lost momentum. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] no longer priorities a Utilitarian agenda.\n\nFor a quiet moment, [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetLastNameNoFormatting] reflects on the lessons of the whole endeavor.
utilitarian.3.f2: The administration's commitment to Utilitarianism has wavered as the project has lost its staunchest supporters.\n\nFor a quiet moment, one man reflects on the lessons of the whole endeavor.
utilitarian.4.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] claim that public opinion and the press in [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_overlord').GetName] are negatively influencing [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] policy.
utilitarian.4.a: Take control of the narrative in the press.
utilitarian.4.b: The opinions of the [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_overlord').GetAdjective] public are harmless.
utilitarian.5.d: The attitudes and actions of the [SCOPE.sCulture('not_discriminated_culture').GetName] administrators in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetName] towards the [SCOPE.sCulture('discriminated_culture').GetName] people threaten our [GetIdeology('ideology_utilitarian_leader').GetName] mission.
utilitarian.5.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetFullNameNoFormatting] attests to recent reports of violence towards [SCOPE.sCulture('discriminated_culture').GetNameNoFormatting] people in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetNameNoFormatting]:\n\n
utilitarian.6.d: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] is actively increasing their efforts to fortify the ties [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has with [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName].
utilitarian.6.f: The portrait of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting] looms large over the two distinguished figures as they argue late into the evening.\n\n
utilitarian.6.a: We need more autonomy right now.
utilitarian.6.b: See that the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName]'s efforts are undisturbed.
utilitarian.7.d: Letters from [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_overlord').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] have arrived with new governing guidances for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] officers and officials.
utilitarian.7.f: Often, the day-to-day actions of this [SCOPE.sCulture('not_discriminated_culture').GetNameNoFormatting] official have little oversight in his corner of [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetNameNoFormatting]. His actions have long been unchecked. The letters from [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_overlord').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] outline new guidance on reporting paperwork discrepancies.\n\n
utilitarian.7.b: Let local officials use their own judgment.
utilitarian.8.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has received a formal dispatch from [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_overlord').GetName] recommending the expansion of education in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
utilitarian.8.f: The telegraph had arrived late at night. Having read it, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] wished he had left it for the morning.\n\n
utilitarian.8.a: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] can help enact these changes.
utilitarian.8.b: It is disadvantageous to respond to the dispatch.
clerk_state_radicals_increase_tt: [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in states with above 10% [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] political strength will become more [concept_radical]
utilitarian.9.d: Colonial administrators adhering to [GetIdeology('ideology_utilitarian_leader').GetName] philosophy have developed ambitious plans for a wholesale rationalization of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] society. Their critics call it an impossible, extraordinarily demanding vision.
utilitarian.9.b: Persuade more officials to join our cause.
utilitarian.10.d: An organized census has been proposed to create a comprehensive understanding of the population in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
je_india_railway_reason: A grand railway network shall connect us all. It will bring great progress to the country and shape the future of our nation!
je_india_railway_status: Construct a grand $building_railway$ network to connect India.
indian_railway_gujarat_bombay_tt: The Gujarat-Bombay line includes the $concept_state_regions$ of:\n$STATE_BOMBAY$\n$STATE_GUJARAT$
india_railway.1.d: International press has been reporting on a train robbery in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetNameNoFormatting] led by [SCOPE.sCulture('discriminated_culture').GetNameNoFormatting] agitators.
india_railway.1.b: No use covering up our losses.
india_railway.2.d: Deliberations have started in the train robbery trial where the accused revolutionaries are charged with robbery and murder.
india_railway.2.f: The roar of the crowd gathered outside the courtroom warms the hearts of the defendants. The same roar makes it hard to hear the prosecutor. Relentless, he strives on.\n\n
india_railway.3.d: Mass exports of grains and crops have left the people of [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetNameNoFormatting] vulnerable during a regional famine.
india_railway.3.f: #italic Dear Elizabeth,\n\nI was escorting the Crown's collections across India the other day when I saw a most terrible sight. A man, thin as the stick he held, stood guard in front of his starving wife and two children. When I asked my mates, what he was guarding, they explained that the village had taken to cannibalism. #!
india_railway.3.a: Use rail transport to supply food-surplus.
state_grain_expensive_tt: #variable Grain#! is more than #variable 70%#! more expensive than [concept_base_price]
india_railway.4.d: While many people are now embracing rail travel, tensions between communities are high as segregation holds strong.
india_railway.4.f: Two boys lean out of the train door, the fierce wind cooling them against the hot miserable day.\n\n
india_railway.4.b: More tea stalls will lessen the tension.
india_railway.5.d: The grand railway project has finally been completed. The new railway opens up new opportunities for people to travel, work, and connect across the country.
india_railway.5.f: With the completion of this station, the Raj's future is secure. Our network of trains will be the backbone of our trade, our military, our very government. Steam and Coal will run in the veins of the empire.\n\nAnd this beautiful station, named after our great [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_overlord').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle], will be its beating heart.
india_railway.5.f2: With the completion of this station, the Raj's future is secure. Our network of trains will be the backbone of our trade, our military, our very government. Steam and Coal will run in the veins of the empire.\n\nAnd this beautiful station, named after our great [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle], will be its beating heart.
je_victoria_terminus_reason: Affiliates of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_terminus_ig').GetName] have raised funds for #tooltippable #tooltip:victoria_terminus_construct_tt #bold the creation of a grand Terminus#! #!#!in $STATE_BOMBAY$. This elegant Terminus with additional railway platforms and adminstrative offices promises to elevate public opinion of India.
victoria_terminus_populated_tt: $building_victoria_terminus$ workforce [concept_occupancy] is greater or equal to #variable 50%#!
victoria_terminus.1.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_terminus_ig').GetName] have submitted a proposal to construct a grand Terminus in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_bombay_state').GetName]. The group has collected a significant sum of money to be used in its construction.
victoria_terminus.1.f: Pipe smoke fills the small office as a group of officials consider the designs for a new train terminus.\n\n
victoria_terminus.1.b: This funding should be redirected where needed.
victoria_terminus_construct_tt: $building_victoria_terminus$ may be constructed using the [concept_political_lens] in $STATE_BOMBAY$.
victoria_terminus.2.d: The completed $building_victoria_terminus$ is a fusion of architectural influences and marks a new chapter for both [SCOPE.sState('relevant_bombay_state').GetName] and India as a whole.
victoria_terminus.2.f: Two British men in suits stand outside the newly built terminus while a coolie carries their luggage.\n\n
victoria_terminus.2.a: This Terminus will serve all of India well.
victoria_terminus.2.b: The world will marvel at our novel achievement.
je_sikh_sovereignty_reason:
These are the early days of our newly established dynasty. Our burgeoning kingdom has enjoyed great success in the years since the #bold Sher-e-Punjab#! conquered the former Mughal imperial capital.

It is critical at this time that we protect our territory from outside aggression and honor the tenets of our [GetReligion('sikh').GetName] faith. May the legacy of this dynasty be long-lasting!

#b [concept_empire_stability] and [concept_court_intrigue]#!
The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] faces more than just external threats. Forces within our court may conspire to overthrow our [concept_ruler] in favor of their preferred candidate. If our #b $sikh_empire_intrigue_bar$#! reaches #v 100%#!, our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] ($concept_ruler$) will be assassinated, #b $sikh_empire_progress_bar$#! will be #bold reset#! to #v 0#!, $concept_court_intrigue_short$ will decrease, and a new candidate will be enthroned.
sikh_empire.1.d: In a great feat of diplomatic and political performance, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has invited the country's elite and foreign representatives to a lavish wedding for the prince.
sikh_empire.1.f: The courtly chronicler in the Maharaja's employ records the festivities in great detail:\n\n#italic
sikh_empire.1.b: Secure our role on the global royal stage.
notification_sikh_wedding_diplomacy_mess: Relations between  [SCOPE.sCountry('pan_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('bic_scope').GetName] have improved since attending the royal wedding in [SCOPE.sCountry('pan_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName].
sikh_empire.2.d: Whilst our generals attended the royal wedding, forces from [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName] have made an attempt to seize territory in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetName].
sikh_empire.2.f: I was in Lahore when word reached the Maharaja about the Emir’s attack on his fortresses. I could tell you the hour of the day for the festivities came to a sudden end. For a moment, the whole city fell quiet.\n\nAnd then, I heard a loud, commanding voice shout the war cry that had terrorized enemies of the Sikhs for decades,
sikh_empire.2.a: Encourage more soldiers to join our forces.
sikh_empire.2.b: Have the Khalsaji strategize our next move.
notification_pan_encroaching_neighbor_me: [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName] has made an attempt to seize territory in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetName]. We must respond.
sikh_empire.3.d: The Maharaja has passed away suddenly in [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetHerHis] sleep. The nation mourns our loss.
sikh_empire.3.f: In the courts of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting], the news of [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetFullNameNoFormatting]’s death was celebrated.
sikh_empire.3.a: May the Maharaja's legacy live on.
notification_eic_encroaching_pan_message: Units of the [SCOPE.sCountry('pan_scope').GetAdjective] military have adopted a hostile stance towards us after Ranjit Singh's death.
sikh_empire.4.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_general').GetFullName] has been vocal in [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_general').GetHerHis] disapproval of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName]'s rule.
sikh_empire.4.f: For hours, men have been debating the reports from across the Sikh border in the offices of the British East India Company in Delhi. The committee head has grown tired but then an idea comes to him.\n\n
sikh_empire.5.d: A mysterious, crippling illness has rendered [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetFullName] unable to keep [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetHerHis] throne. Intense speculation about the circumstances is circulating among the ruling elite.
sikh_empire.5.f: The young palace servant returned home to find his whole family present. Everyone had questions for him.\n\n
sikh_empire.5.a: The people will mourn this loss.
notification_pan_encroaching_eic_message: With the ignominious abdication of $Kharak$ $Singh$, fears have arisen of potential hostilities with the [SCOPE.sCountry('bic_scope').GetName].
sikh_empire.6.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetFullName] has been hit by falling masonry on [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetHerHis] return from [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetHerHis] father's funeral. The Wazir insists the [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] is gravely injured and nothing can be done.
sikh_empire.6.f: The people gathered on the streets. The same thoughts running through all their minds. Maharaja Ranjit's death was dismal, but he was old. Kharak's death was concerning, but Waheguru must have deemed it so. But if [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetFirstNameNoFormatting] died a day after [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetHerHis] father, then it was time for despair. How would a child protect them? Would they fall to the Afghans or the Company first?
sikh_empire.6.b: Do everything to save the Maharaja.
notification_neighbor_encroaching_pan_me: The incident that mortally wounded our ruler has left our country vulnerable. There are fears of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName] commencing a campaign against us.
sikh_empire.7.d: Our empire is no longer independent. What the Sher-e-Punjab established is now gone.
sikh_empire.7.d2: Death haunts the halls of our court. Now, with the recent death of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle], what the Sher-e-Punjab established may very well be gone.
sikh_empire.7.a: Alas, the legacy of the lion is no more.
sikh_empire.8.d: Our country has survived years of turbulence and is not a subject to another nation. The Sher-e-Punjab's legacy will live on.
sikh_empire.8.a: More days of glory are ahead.
sikh_empire.9.d: The young [SCOPE.sCharacter('duleep_character').GetFullName] who was deposed after the fall of the Sikh Empire, has now resurfaced.
sikh_empire.9.f: The court was abuzz with the arrival of the Landless Prince, though they dared not call him that to his face. The young lad was handsome and polite and had the court’s sympathy. Raised without parents, he was a prince with nothing to rule. But he never seemed to let this bother him. Then again, some wondered if he understood the true extent of all he had lost.
sikh_empire.9.a: Perhaps he will find his purpose.
sikh_empire.9.b: He's sure to be welcomed someplace with open arms.
sikh_empire.10.d1: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetFullName] has been assassinated whilst inspecting the weapon of [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassin_scope').GetFullName]. As the [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] gazed down the barrel of [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassin_scope').GetHerHis] shotgun, [SCOPE.sCharacter('assassin_scope').GetFirstName] pulled the trigger.
sikh_empire.10.d2: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetFullName] has been assassinated by a courtier demonstrating an imported shotgun. As the [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] gazed down the barrel of the shotgun, the courtier pulled the trigger.
sikh_empire.11.d: The brutal court intrigue consuming the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has claimed another victim. The short-lived [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetFullName] has been found dead in [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ruler').GetHerHis] chambers, [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('sikh_ruler_death_reason')]
ig_granthis_desc: Granthis are the religious officials in Sikhism, a monotheistic faith holding that worldly pursuits are distractions from the oneness of God.
ig_trait_rehat_desc: Since the time of the first Panj Pyare, our faith has stirred the greatest warriors to join our righteous cause. In these challenging times, soldiers are once again moved by faith to serve under our banners.
ig_khalsaji_desc: The prominent fighting force of the Sikh Empire, the Khalsaji combine Sikh Khalsa traditions with modernized Franco-British principles.
ig_trait_khalsa_desc: We have a duty to practice arms and protect the innocent. As warriors we must fight bravely regardless of the odds and live true to the Rehat traditions.
ig_jats_desc: The Jats are traditional farmers and peasants of the Punjab region with origins in pastoralism. Their interests are largely agrarian in nature.
ig_trait_khalsa_panth_desc: Truthful living and hard work. We live the way of the holy, avoid extremes, and walk the middle path. The goods we produce get to the people who need them.
princely_state_decision_desc: For far too long, the British have underestimated and undermined our authority. Launch a campaign to secure independence
je_princely_states_reason: Our great [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting] may rule over [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] but we are still subject to the whims and folly of [SCOPE.sCountry('top_overlord_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]. [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]'s power grows day by day, but we can still shape our fate.\n\nThe tides are in our favor to increase [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]'s autonomy and pursue a path for independence, lest the [SCOPE.sCountry('top_overlord_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] take full control.
notification_struggle_for_sovereignty_me: The [SCOPE.sCountry('princely_state_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.sCountry('princely_state_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] has made [SCOPE.sCountry('princely_state_scope').GetRuler.GetHerHis] intentions known that [SCOPE.sCountry('princely_state_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] is seeking independence from [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetNameNoFormatting].
princely_states.1.d: The desire for independence can be felt in all corners of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting] must decide on how to act at this juncture.
princely_states.1.f: A longing to break free from [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]'s rule grows steadily. It is on the minds of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] from all walks of life. That restlessness among the people begs the question of how [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] might take charge of its own destiny.\n\nA traveler passing through [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] cannot escape the whispers of how the people no longer wish to live under [SCOPE.sCountry('overlord_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]'s thumb.
princely_states.2.d: After a hard fight for independence, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] is no longer a mere Princely State. The people celebrate, and the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] looks to expand [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]'s power.
princely_states.2.f: Mubarak Ho!\n\nOn [TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting] celebrated [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] newfound power with a lavish parade that concluded with a gun salute. There was a general sense of merriment in the air as food was distributed among the people, promising a new age of plenty. Only time will tell if the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] will deliver on [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] promises!
princely_states.2.a: We have a bright future under the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s leadership.
annex_neighbor_princely_state: A neighboring Princely State with a shared #bold heritage#! trait and #green #bold cordial#!#! relations or better will be annexed by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
princely_states.3.d: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] plans to send some of our finest camels to aid the [SCOPE.sCountry('top_overlord_scope').GetAdjective], who are experiencing a shortage of pack animals.
princely_states.3.f: The court had spent hours debating the matter. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] listened quietly, putting on a somber expression and nodding along to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] advisors' arguments. But to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim], the choice was an illusion for those in denial of who was really in power. Aiding the British or not was not a choice between loyalty to former allies and money; it was a choice between struggling and thriving.
princely_states.3.a: So long as they pay us, this is fine.
princely_states.3.b: Their fight is not our fight.
notification_pack_animal_loan_message_de: Relations between [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('top_overlord_scope').GetName] have improved since the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] sent camels to aid the [SCOPE.sCountry('top_overlord_scope').GetAdjective].
princely_states.4.t: The Most Exalted Order of the Star of India
princely_states.4.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('top_overlord_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCountry('top_overlord_scope').GetRuler.GetFullNameNoFormatting] will honor [SCOPE.sCharacter('award_winner_scope').GetFullName] by appointing [SCOPE.sCharacter('award_winner_scope').GetHerHim] Knight Grand Commander of the Order of the Indian Empire.
princely_states.4.f: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] strolled the halls of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] family palace. Paintings of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] ancestors loomed around [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim]. What would they do if they were in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] stead? These fierce men and women who recognized no authority but that of the gods? Would they tell [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] to bow? Or would they remind [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] that somebody has to start. Somebody has to step forward and say no.
princely_states.5.d: By the use of the doctrine of lapse, [SCOPE.sCountry('bic_scope').GetName] has taken over another princely state.
princely_states.5.f: Growing up, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] tutors had encouraged [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHim] to play chess. Looking back, the game captured one aspect of being a ruler well. The ruler never got to move more than a step at a time. And yet, if [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] fell, no one else would matter. Today, as another one of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] neighbors fell to [SCOPE.sCountry('bic_scope').GetNameNoFormatting], the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] felt like the king on the chessboard, surrounded by enemies but unable to do much. But even then, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] had one move left. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe|U] just had to make sure it was the right one.
princely_states.5.b: Perhaps there is wisdom in this.
notification_doctrine_of_lapse_reaction_: Relations between [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('bic_scope').GetName] have worsened since the [SCOPE.sCountry('bic_scope').GetName] used the doctrine of lapse to annex a princely state.
notification_caste_hierarchy_appears_des: The Caste System is a recognized [concept_social_hierarchy] in [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country_scope').GetName].
notification_caste_hierarchy_disappears_: Due to recent cultural and societal changes, the Caste System is no longer a recognized [concept_social_hierarchy] in [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country_scope').GetName].
je_dravidian_movement_reason: The common people of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] have responded to the disproportionate representation and political power of Brahmins. After a series of anti-Brahmin conferences, the Dravidian Movement has formed and set a new agenda to oppose Brahmin dominance. They seek to remove caste distinctions from law and government administration.
dravidian_movement_fail_tt: Has passed the Indian Home Rule Act
caste_conflict.1.d: Tension between castes has been more pronounced since a recent census revealed the disproportionate representation of Brahmins in government jobs and highlighted the limited qualifications for Non-Brahmins.
caste_conflict.1.f: Praveen's resume, his two masters in economics and law, crumpled in his hands as he stormed away furiously from another rejection.\n\nHe knew he shouldn't be so angry or so surprised. He knew that when he moved to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], he would be far from the support of his forward-thinking university, and yet the blatant segregation shocked him. Despite his qualifications he was struggling to feed himself, while others, equally educated, enjoyed chai in manors. What infuriated him most was how the guards barred the way for him. As if they were any better than him in the eyes of the lords they so dearly guarded.
caste_conflict.1.b: [SCOPE.sCountry('top_overlord_scope').GetName] has their reasons to support this.
caste_conflict.2.d: The success of the Dravidian Movement's agenda has overseen the enactment of a new law and improved quality of life for non-Brahmins.
caste_conflict.2.f: The battle was far from over, this Praveen Pallar knew. Yet he could not help but smile as he took his seat in the simple government office, the fan above him gently cooling the sweat of his back.\n\nAcross from him he saw a Mr. Iyer, and to his left sat a Mr. Agastya. High caste Brahmins both. And here he was, a Pallar, holding the same position and pay as them. Neither seemed to meet his eyes. Yes, there was still work to be done, but for today, this would do.  He thanked his allies who had marched and protested with him and flipped open his first file.
caste_conflict.2.b: The future for non-Brahmins is bright.
notification_verge_of_collapse_desc: The Dravidian Movement's agenda has lost momentum. [SCOPE.sCharacter('rural_folk_leader_scope').GetFullName] stepped down as leader of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rural_folk_ig_scope').GetName].
caste_conflict.4.d: The Non-Brahmin Manifesto has been circulating in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], causing tension between the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('rural_folk_ig_scope').GetName] and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig_scope').GetName].
caste_conflict.4.f: The two party leaders sat across from each other, and their aides listened intently as the two minds battled for the second hour now.\n\n
caste_conflict.4.b: Perhaps the manifesto makes valid points.
caste_conflict.5.d: To assert their rights, the Dalit community drank from a public water tank that they had been denied access to. This nonviolent protest was led by [SCOPE.sCharacter('character_scope').GetFullName] and, in turn, met with a protest by Brahmin priests.
caste_conflict.5.f: The young Dalit girl, Meena, watched the procession from afar, hidden behind a large tree. She had come here the day before with her mother, and they had drank from the water tank. It had seemed like a big event, though she had just been to skip work that day. But what she saw now horrified her, these priests were pouring cow urine and dung into the water. Had Meena drunk cow urine water? Either way, she would never drink from this polluted tank again.
caste_conflict.5.a: The actions of the priests are unacceptable.
caste_conflict.5.b: Let them keep each other distracted.
company_bombay_dyeing_company: Bombay Dyeing and Manufacturing Company Limited
sepoy_mutiny_events.1.t: In the Name of the Peshwa
sepoy_mutiny_events.1.d: Ruling as the hereditary prime ministers of the Maratha Empire, the Bhat family were second only to the Chhatrapati in prestige and power. Now [SCOPE.sCharacter('nana_saheb_scope').GetFirstName], the adopted son of the last Peshwa comes offering his sword, promising to expel the British and restore the Empire.
sepoy_mutiny_events.1.f: The soldier cleared his throat but it did nothing to dislodge the lump stuck in there. His forebears had been the thorn in Aurangzeb's side. A mighty force that the Chhatrapati had led to freedom against the Mughal's tyranny.\n\nBut it seemed it had all been for naught, for here they were, preparing to fight another fierce foe. Would he make his ancestors proud, or would his actions fall short? The thought fell from his mind as his captain yelled, 'FORWARD MARCH.'
sepoy_mutiny_events.1.b: He may serve the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle], but only on the battlefield.
sepoy_mutiny_events.1.c: Send him away, the age of the Bhat Peshwas is over.
sepoy_mutiny_events.1.e: Baji Rao lives still, offer the position to the last rightful Peshwa.
sepoy_mutiny_events.2.d: The catastrophic victory of the Indian mutineers has spurred heated debates within the offices of the Company administration. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName] must now decide whether to abandon India alltogether, or to focus dwindling resources on maintaining a foothold on the continent.
sepoy_mutiny_events.2.f:
The Governor-General paced the length of his office, the walls barely containing his wrath. His aide stood perfectly still. He did not wish to land up like contents of the general's tea tray, plastered across the map of India.

India, the golden goose they had pinned by the wings, the head, and the tail had imploded on them and all their options reeked. If it were up to him, he would take Calcutta, their first foothold, and leave the rest. Then again, Bombay had cost them dearly, and Madras had much left to offer. A tough choice -BANG!
The aide flinched; the general had fired his pistol into the wall. Perhaps it was time he went to see if there were more messages for the general.
sepoy_mutiny_events.2.a: India is lost. Let Whitehall squabble over our remaining assets.
sepoy_mutiny_events.2.b: Fort William must not fall. Redirect all forces to Calcutta.
sepoy_mutiny_events.2.c: Company rule will persist in the south. Pull back to Madras.
sepoy_mutiny_events.2.e: Bombay holds! Direct all remaining forces to the West.
india_retreat_to_bengal_tt: All [concept_subject] countries outside the [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_bengal_old').GetName] [concept_georegion] will become independent, and any [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] we hold there will be divided between them.

sepoy_mutiny_events.3.d: The breaking point has been reached. Across India, sepoys are striking their regimental colors and taking up arms against the Company. Joined by disaffected locals of all ranks, they have seized power in cities across the continent.
sepoy_mutiny_events.3.f: As the sepoy from Poona fires at his captain, a Muslim lad hands him more bullets. A Sikh sepoy, bleeding out from his wounds, takes in the sight. What would their forefathers say if they saw them fighting together instead of against each other? And then, as the life leaves him, a more pressing thought occers to him; what will their grandchildren say of their actions today? Waheguru, will they be proud? Ashamed? Will they even remember?
sepoy_mutiny_events.3.a: Muster all loyal troops. Strike these rebels down.
sepoy_mutiny_events.3.b: [SCOPE.sCountry('mughals_scope').GetRuler.GetFirstName] Zindibad! Long live the rightful Emperor!
sepoy_mutiny_events.3.c: Har Har Mahadev! Advance the banner of the Chhatrapati!
sepoy_mutiny_events.3.e: Vande Mataram! Drive the Lal Patan from our shores!
sepoy_mutiny_events.3.g: Khalsa Ji Di Sarkar! The Sikh Empire will rise again!
sepoy_mutiny_events.3.h: Forward, let us cleanse the Deccan of the firangi scourge.
sepoy_mutiny_events.3.tt_1: Indian rebels will declare [concept_war] on the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]
sepoy_mutiny_events.3.tt_2:
The following will be true for all [Concept('concept_presidency', '$concept_presidencies$')], based on their [Concept('concept_presidency_stability','$concept_presidency_stability_short$')]:
• Indian rebels will take control of relevant [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')]
• Radicals and negative [Concept('concept_modifier','$concept_modifiers$')] will be added in all constituent [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')]
• A random non-capital $building_barrack$ will be destroyed
sepoy_mutiny_events.4.d: Sepoys in the employ of the [SCOPE.sCountry('eic_scope').GetName] have mutinied against their old masters, throwing British India into disarray. Hawkish members of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] court loudly argue for us to join the rebel cause, so we may oust the British from India together.
sepoy_mutiny_events.4.f: Few understand the burden of a crown. Even as every member of his court argues, the Prince knows they await his decision. They might call for war or wish to sue for peace, but they do so freely because they know that if it fails, they can always blame it on him. And who can he blame it on? Who will console him as he lies awake hearing the screams of soldiers who died for his promise of liberty?
sepoy_mutiny_events.4.a: Together we shall drive the firangi into the sea.
sepoy_mutiny_events.4.b: Pledge our fealty to the Emperor in Delhi.
sepoy_mutiny_events.4.c: The Marathas will rise again, raise the banner of the Chhatrapati.
sepoy_mutiny_events.4.e: This is a mistake. Reaffirm our loyality to the Company.
sepoy_mutiny_events.6.d: Ever since the adoption of the new, standard-issue Enfield rifle-musket, soldiers across the presidency armies have been complaining that the new gunpowder cartridges taste disgusting.
sepoy_mutiny_events.6.f: As the Lieutenant Colonel of the 13th Regiment of Bengal Native Infantry, I faced a conundrum. As the regiment leader, I expected my troops to follow orders as and when I gave them. But, I had bit into the new cartridge myself and barely suppressed a gag. Would it be right to punish them when even I could not rise up to the task?
sepoy_mutiny_events.6.a: A soldier’s life is hard enough, research ammunition improvement.
sepoy_mutiny_events.6.b: If they can’t stomach this, how will suffer the trials of war?
sepoy_mutiny_events.7.d: Beeswax has been suggested as an alternative to the grease used on the cartridges. The troops are happy with this change. However, some are asking what changed.
sepoy_mutiny_events.7.f: The soldiers sat around the canteen that night, pleased that the company had provided them with better cartridges.\n\n
sepoy_mutiny_events.7.a: Explain to the troops that beeswax replaced a factory-made grease.
sepoy_mutiny_events.8.d: Soldiers in the Bengal Presidency have heard rumors that the grease used on the cartridges is animal fat.
sepoy_mutiny_events.8.f: The young subedar had not slept all night. He threw up again, panic twisting his gut, 'What if the rumors were true? Had he really bit into cow fat?'' He looked at the temple across the road, 'Would he still be welcome there? What about home? What would happen to his wife? Their son? Or perhaps there was no cause for worry, the Captain had assured them it was just a chemical. The Captain wouldn’t lie to them!'
sepoy_mutiny_events.8.a: Reassure the soldiers it is not animal fat.
sepoy_mutiny_events.8.b: Suggest soldiers use their hands to open the cartridges if the taste offends them.
sepoy_mutiny_timer_decrease_5_months: Advance the timer for the $je_uneasy_raj$ [concept_journal_entry] by #variable 5#! months.
sepoy_mutiny_events.9.d: The rumors have taken root and some soldiers believe the cartridges were, or are, an attempt at forced conversion. They are refusing to fire weapons during drills.
sepoy_mutiny_events.9.f: The Captain was worried, he was sure he had seen some off-duty soldiers following him as he exited the church. A tense air hung over the camp, the native regiments had been acting odd, breaking curfew, sticking together in large groups, carrying their rifles off-duty, and apparently some had refused to follow orders.\n\nHe counted the other British officers in the camp, a fair number, could they hold their own if the natives rebelled? A nervous laugh escaped his mouth. No, if it came to that they would be dead before their first reload.
sepoy_mutiny_events.9.b: Relieve them of their duty but let the rest continue
sepoy_mutiny_events.10.d: On hearing that troops have been sentenced to hard labor, sepoys from other regiments have broken rank and attempted to break their fellow soldiers free.
sepoy_mutiny_events.10.f:
Cawnpore Garrison.
To General [SCOPE.sCharacter('sepoy_general_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting]

Urgent.

Some 50 sepoys have barred themselves in the ammunition hold and are firing at any officers that approach. Trouble began at midnight when they got drunk and attacked their superior officer. Remaining regiments have been disarmed and asked to stay in their barracks. The loyal among them have advised that the mutineers intend to free the troops sentenced to hard labor.

Please Advice!

Unrest is brewing in the three [Concept('concept_presidency', '$concept_presidencies$')] of the [SCOPE.sCountry('raj_scope').GetName].

Worse still, discord can be found even within the proud ranks of the native sepoy regiments, who resent any challenge to their traditional status and privileges.

indian_famines.1.d: [SCOPE.sState('indian_famine_state_scope').GetName] is in dire straits and does not have enough grain this year to feed itself, let alone pay its taxes. Of course, it has some reserves from previous years that are currently being used to feed the hungry.
indian_famines.1.f: The Tax collector eyed the farmers suspiciously. They had all come to him as a group, hands joined as if begging. Usually, he would dismiss their pleas for tax relief. Every year was a tough year if you heard the farmers speak it.\n\nBut this time, he had seen the dead cows and the lifeless fields on the way in. Even if they had some grain stored away, it would likely not seem them all through the year. And then, who would he collect his tax from?
indian_famines.1.a: A deal is a deal. [SCOPE.sState('indian_famine_state_scope').GetName] must pay its taxes in full.
indian_famines.1.b: The state can pay reduced taxes till the famine lasts.
indian_famines.1.c: Let us hope they will remember this act of kindness. Forgive taxes and provide food relief instead.
not_recently_had_war: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] has been at peace for at least #variable 5#! years.
indian_famines.2.d: In the face of the famine that plagued [SCOPE.sState('indian_famine_state_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('hunger_strike_agitator_scope').GetFullName] has put forth a petition demanding that the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] allow farmers to grow Food Crops in place of Cash Crops.
indian_famines.2.f: The aged farmer looked at [SCOPE.sCharacter('hunger_strike_agitator_scope').GetLastNameNoFormatting] with a reverence that worried the officer. Zealous followers were dangerous and difficult to reign in. He was glad that, for now, they were simply putting forth a petition, yet he wondered what would happen if they ever decided to swing their sickles at flesh instead of grain.
indian_famines.2.a: A reasonable demand. Allow select farmers to change crops.
indian_famines.2.b: Everyone in the world can grow wheat. It is indigo and cotton that we came here for.
indian_famines.2.tt: The following will apply to every #bold Indian#! [concept_state] that suffers from [concept_famine]:
following_applied_to_every_owned_state: The following will apply to every owned [concept_state]:
indian_famines.3.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('hunger_strike_agitator_scope').GetFullName] has begun a fast until death to persuade [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetName] to allow food crops to replace cash crops.
indian_famines.3.f: As the Governor General strolled the length of the office, his secretary couldn't help but smile. The general commanded an army of thousands, yet his biggest threat was a fasting man. If the man died, there would be terrible consequences. If he lived, he would bully them again just so. Only the lives of Kings and Queens mattered so much. How had they let a simple man get so important?
indian_famines.3.a: Perhaps the farmers can practice fasting too.
indian_famines.4.d: The famine in [SCOPE.sState('indian_famine_state_scope').GetName] has left many people destitute. To make ends meet, destitute farmers from [SCOPE.sState('indian_famine_state_scope').GetFarmHubName] have walked all the way to [SCOPE.sState('indian_famine_state_scope').GetCityHubName]. They await entry at the city gates.
indian_famines.4.f: The child yawned, he was sleepy, hungry, and the air in the city smelt bad. But his father had told him that they had to come here if they wanted to ensure his sister lived to turn two years old. So here they were after a whole week on the road.\n\nAnd yet he could so see no food in sight. No fields to toil. Just large brick houses that looked cold, filled with even colder people. How was this going to help Ma and Didi?
indian_famines.4.a: The city is no place for a farmer.
indian_famines.4.b: The factories and godowns might be willing to hire them in return for reduced taxes.
