second_liberalism.1.d: The heroic efforts of Crown and Cortes have established [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] as a thoroughly modern and liberal nation. The constitutional order has triumphed over all who would challenge it.
second_liberalism.1.f: A thick layer of smoke had collected around the ceiling of the officers' club, shifting the light of the lamps towards a reddish hue. It was nearly two in the morning, and all but the most diehard revelers had retreated back into their accommodations. A man in the uniform of a General sat in the corner, surrounded by his staff and enthusiastically chatting with a serving-girl.\n\n
second_liberalism.1.b: The spirit of Vintismo will never die.
second_liberalism.2.d_1: Through the ousting of the monarchy, we have made redundant the compromises and capitulations of the old constitutionalists. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] will now have a government of, by, and for its people.
second_liberalism.2.d_2: The triumph of the proletariat has brought the age of liberalism in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] to its end. No more will we settle for an ever more perfect form of bourgeois rule.
second_liberalism.2.d_3: The rule of the Church has put an end to the Constitutionalist experiment. No more will [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] be defined by the contradiction between divine right and the laws of man.
second_liberalism.2.a: So begins a new chapter of history.
second_liberalism.2.b: A Third Liberalism waits over the horizon.
second_liberalism.3.d: The restoration of [SCOPE.sCharacter('miguelist_claimant_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('miguelist_claimant_scope').GetFullName] to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] throne marks the ultimate defeat of the Constitutionalist project. No more will the Crown need to compromise its God-given power.
second_liberalism.3.a: The liberal aberration has met its end.
second_liberalism.3.b: One cannot simply ignore the present.
je_portugal_regeneration_agriculture_rea: $regeneration_shared_loc$\n\nThe inefficient and antiquated nature of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] agriculture has long served as a brake on development. The countryside is the realm of vast, inefficient noble estates and church lands which make use of techniques unchanged for centuries. If Regeneration is to come to the countryside, it must come alongside the use of new technologies and more entrepreneurial forms of land ownership.
je_portugal_regeneration_public_works_re: $regeneration_shared_loc$\n\nMainland [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] is a rough, sparsely-populated land, with many isolated regions and underdeveloped lines of communication. When one takes its overseas Empire into account, the problem of transportation acquires a new level of urgency. The telegraph and the railway are regarded by the politicians of Regeneration as the very embodiment of progress - technologies which will bind nation and empire together more than they have ever been before.
je_portugal_regeneration_institutions_re: $regeneration_shared_loc$\n\nThe state itself - the framework within which contracts are enforced, funds allocated, and a stable environment ensured - is central to the program of Regeneration. To construct a modern state, a modern population is needed - one that is educated, competent, and patriotic. A new generation of jurists, clerks, and officers will fill the ranks of the bureaucracy, and create the institutions needed for further development.

portugal_regeneration.1.a: For the good of the country.
portugal_regeneration.2.d: The Regeneration has brought modernity to every facet of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] society. If it were once true that our nation was in decline, our successes have proved this need not be permanent.
portugal_regeneration.2.f: The space around the sick-bed was crowded with relatives, so much so that João could barely see a hair on his grandfather's head. His voice, once a strong baritone, had grown reedy over the years. Still, he projected the best he could, and those with tears running down their faces shushed themselves so he could be heard.\n\n
portugal_regeneration.2.b: Our heroes are those who dream of infrastructure.
portugal_regeneration.3.d: The period of political and fiscal stability that allowed for the ambitious program of Regeneration has come to an end. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] may no longer afford to dream.
portugal_regeneration.3.f: It was over. All the Minister had worked for, all the measures he had spent the past decade so carefully outlining. Perhaps the state of the country was simply irrecoverable. Perhaps it had been futile from the start, and there was never anything he could have done to restore its sunward ascent. Perhaps it was even worse than that, and it had been entirely salvageable, were it not for the egos of generals and other fools.\n\nThe academics would argue over it for the next century, he knew. He would need to contend with seeing books about the aborted Regeneration on the shelves, feeling the terrible desire to see what they had to say about him. What was there to do but weep?
portugal_regeneration.4.d: The agrarian reforms of the Regeneration have both increased productivity and transitioned to a more entrepreneurial ownership system. Harvest time is now accompanied by the clattering of machines, and a bountiful pall of smoke.
portugal_regeneration.4.a: The countryside, long unchanged, finds a new life.
portugal_regeneration.4.b: Regeneration uplifts all that it touches.
portugal_regeneration.5.d: The Regeneration has brought the railway and telegraph to every province of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. Widely available transportation has opened once-isolated communities to the free exchange of goods and information.
portugal_regeneration.5.a: We need no longer remain strangers to one another.
portugal_regeneration.5.b: All politics may be reduced to transportation.
portugal_regeneration.6.d: The Regeneration has changed the face of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] public administration. An unprecedented number of students enter school each year, and an abundance of fresh university graduates provide recruits for private enterprise and the state bureaucracy alike.
portugal_regeneration.6.f: The students sat in neat rows, books resting in their laps, eyes forward. None of them dared make a sound. The professor looked over them, before speaking. His voice echoed off of the tiled floor, the walls covered in paintings of century-old rectors.\n\n
portugal_regeneration.6.a: Our people will become the most sophisticated in Europe.

je_portugal_and_brazil_reason: Since our recognition of its independence in 1825, the former [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] colony of [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName] has dominated the South American continent. Though the brief period of post-independence personal union under King and Emperor Pedro IV and I ended in failure, cultural ties between #b $POR$#! and #b $BRZ$#! remain strong. These existing ties present a prime opportunity for establishing a lasting economic and diplomatic relationship.
je_portugal_united_kingdom_reason:
From 1807 to 1821, the court of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] ruled from Rio de Janeiro. In an attempt to accommodate [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjective] concerns, King João VI elevated #b $BRZ$#! to the status of a co-equal Kingdom, forming the #b United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil, and the Algarves#!. Though the independence of #b $BRZ$#! ended the first United Kingdom, #b $POR$#! and #b $BRZ$#! were, soon after, placed under a brief personal union under King and Emperor Pedro IV and I.

The recent resurgence of $POR_ADJ$ power, and current positive atmosphere between us and our former colony, have raised hopes of restoring the #b United Kingdom#!. If the #b $BRZ_ADJ$#! succession laws are amended, these hopes may become a reality.

Whilst this [concept_journal_entry] is active, we will be able to sign a [concept_treaty] to $amend_succession$ with [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName], laying the groundwork for a future [concept_personal_union].

lusofonia.1.d: Per the terms of the [SCOPE.sTreaty('relevant_treaty_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCharacter('portuguese_monarch_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('portuguese_monarch_scope').GetFullName] and [SCOPE.sCharacter('portuguese_monarch_scope').GetHerHis] descendants have been restored to their rightful position in the [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjective] line of succession. Once [SCOPE.sCharacter('brazil_monarch_scope').GetFullName] departs the throne, a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] monarch will reign over [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] once more.
lusofonia.1.f: The law of October 30th, before it was amended, had stated that no foreigner may hold the throne of Brazil. It had excluded Queen Maria from the line of succession, and split the house of Bragança in two—those of Portugal, and those of independent Brazil.\n\nCould one truly claim that any Portuguese was a foreigner? Yes, said the nationalists, who pointed at Brazil's independent heritage, at the abuses of the Portuguese Cortes, at its hard-fought independence. No, said the unionists, who proclaimed the universality of the Portuguese identity, its pluricontinental history. How could the land which once held the Portuguese court ever consider itself a separate nation?
lusofonia.2.d: Sensing the Republican threat to the Crown, agents of [SCOPE.sCountry('portugal_scope').GetName] have offered diplomatic assistance in support of [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('pedro_scope').GetFullName].
lusofonia.2.b: We will stand on our own merits.
lusofonia.3.d: Through shrewd diplomacy, we have retrieved what was once thought irrecoverably lost to us. [SCOPE.sCountry('portugal_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName] are once more bound together in trans-oceanic matrimony.
lusofonia.3.d2: Through a decisive show of force, we have retrieved what was once thought irrecoverably lost to us. [SCOPE.sCountry('portugal_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName] are once more bound together in eternal union.
lusofonia.3.f: Antônio stood with his arms behind his back, watching the artist scratch away at the drafting paper. What had been rough shapes were now resolving themselves into something more detailed—two women draped in the flags of the United Kingdom, the Southern Cross in the sky, a pair of angelic wings. When the charcoal pencil had finished the first pass over their faces, he cleared his throat.\n\n
lusofonia.3.a: Let our bonds be stronger than ever before.
lusofonia.3.b: Ours is the Fifth Empire, and the greatest of all.
lusofonia.4.d: On the eve of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName]'s accession to the throne of [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetName], the [SCOPE.sCountry('brazil_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('brz_armed_forces').GetName] have made a grab for power. They have proclaimed a Republic, and sworn to defend the country against any would-be foreign ruler.
lusofonia.4.f: The Ambassador's face twitched as he read the telegram. It was too cold. The fireplace blazed behind its pink marble hearth, but he could no longer feel it.\n\n
lusofonia.4.b: Anchors aweigh! We end this here and now.
lusofonia.4.c: We have done all we can.

je_portugal_and_brazil_pursue_united_kin: Not long ago, #b $POR$#! and #b $BRZ$#! were co-equal units within a single United Kingdom. Though the #b $BRZ_ADJ$#! General Assembly has taken measures to prevent the restoration of the union, law need not be set in stone—what once was may be again.
je_portugal_and_brazil_pedro_button_desc: Emperor Pedro II of #b $BRZ$#! is a firm supporter of constitutional rule, and serves as a moderating presence at the head of our former colony. If he finds his rule threatened, we may offer assistance in upholding his reign.

independence.1.d: Our war for independence from [SCOPE.sCountry('former_colonial_overlord').GetName] has sent the remnants of the colonial administration running for [SCOPE.sCountry('former_colonial_government').GetCapital.GetName]. If we are to be independent, we must settle upon a structure to fill the vacuum.
independence.1.b: We will have a Republic, under the leadership of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName].
independence.1.c: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] will have the Crown, if [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] wills it.
independence.1.e: The union of classes will secure our victory.
independence.1.g: The proletariat stand at the forefront of our struggle.
independence.2.d: The old colonial structures which formerly governed our territory are woefully insufficient for an independent state. We must settle upon the foundations of a free and independent [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
independence.2.f: The Governor did not have time to pack up his furniture before he left. Half a dozen fine European chairs graced his dining room, surrounding a table that had hastily been stripped of the silverware and its silken cloth by the fleeing prior occupants. Those fine chairs now hosted six fine gentlemen. Some of them, fortunate enough to warrant an invitation to the Governor's dinners, had been here before. The remainder were rougher, newer. If any here would were inclined to present something bold, it would be one of them.
independence.2.c: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] will have the Crown, if [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] wills it.
independence.2.e: The union of classes will preserve our independence.
independence.2.g: It was the proletariat that earned our victory.

je_spain_provisional_government_reason: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('spa_provisional_government_reason_loc')] With the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] throne made empty, the newly-declared Provisional Government has set itself to the task of finding a candidate to serve as King.
je_spain_provisional_government_reason_s: A military revolt has toppled the unpopular [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('spa_couped_dynasty_loc')] dynasty, and sent the former rulers of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] scurrying off into exile.
The short-lived Republican experiment in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has been toppled, and a government of committed royalists brought into power.

je_spain_provisional_government_esparter: General Baldomero Espartero is both one of the great military heroes of $SPA$, a committed liberal, and an inspiring study in social mobility. He, more than any low-born Spaniard, possesses the record necessary to legitimize his enthronement. To enthrone him would be to create a royal dynasty from a family of carpenters.
je_spain_provisional_government_hohenzol: The House of Hohenzollern, ruling dynasty of $PRU$ and Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen, are the paramount family amongst the German states. To enthrone a Hohenzollern would grant $SPA$ closer ties with the masters of Germany, but arouse fears of encirclement in $FRA$.
je_spain_provisional_government_italian_: More than any other Italian dynasty, the House of Savoia have tied themselves to the notion of Italian nationhood. To enthrone a Savoyard prince would be uncontroversial amongst the European powers, and guarantee $SPA$ a sovereign with a commitment to constitutional rule.
je_spain_provisional_government_bonapart: The House of Bonaparte ruled over $SPA$ for a brief period between 1808 and 1813. The King during this period, Joseph I Bonaparte, was never considered legitimate by the majority of the Spanish population, and was chased from Spain by a popular uprising. Past events, however, do not guarantee future returns. If the Provisional Government wishes to make an overture to $FRA$, it may invite a Bonaparte prince, and hope for a better outcome.
je_spain_provisional_government_republic: Republicanism is a new position in $SPA$, only recently emerging to contest the constitutional monarchism typical amongst Spanish doctrinaire liberals. If no King can be found, or if republicanism politically eclipses constitutionalism, to declare a Republic may be the only option that remains.

spain_provisional_government.32.f:
There were storm clouds building over Barcelona. Francisco lay with his back to the roof tiles, watching the ever-grey sky turn black as pitch.

He heard the clattering of feet on tiles next to him, and turned his head. There stood the copyist, arms spread wide to keep him steady. A fat raindrop, swollen with smoke from the textile mills, had left a grey streak running down his cheek. It was strangely beautiful.

spain_provisional_government.41.f:
There was all too much good cheer around, thought Francisco. The street was choked with berets and toques - the garb of the exultant middle-classes. He had been caught out when the news arrived, the streamers went up, and his journey tripled in length. Past another row of hats, he could see his objective, a two-story townhome that hosted two presses - one above-board, one covert.

He elbowed a reveler aside, jammed his key into the lock, and slipped inside.

spain_provisional_government.5.f: The street was lined with red-and-yellow streamers, yet there was no one to be seen. Francisco pressed his forehead against the dusty window, looking this way and that. The clattering of the press in the other room filled his ears, drowning out his thoughts. All the better, for to capture them and take a solid look would only send him further into the abyss.\n\n
spain_provisional_government.5.a: The rightful dynasty returns to the throne.
spain_provisional_government.6.d: The Carlist-sympathetic Cortes has elected [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName], the current member of the house of Borbón in the Carlist line of succession, as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetCustom('getQueenKing')] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. Once more, a staunch traditionalist will rule over the country.
spain_provisional_government.6.f: Francisco rushed into the townhouse, pulling the door closed behind him. It took all he had to not slam it, to not alert the neighbors of his agitated state. The sound of scurrying feet sounded on the stairs. Pale, spidery fingers gripped the corner wall, and haunted eyes gazed down at him.\n\n

anarchism_events.6.d: The spectre of anarchism has been exorcized from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] soil. Order has been returned to the streets, and our citizens no longer need fear anarchist terror.
anarchism_events.6.f:
The arcades of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] shone with glass and gaslight. Silk-clad figures flitted from store to store, handing over a decade's wage for a necklace or a hat. Cashiers with frozen smiles filled their palms with pesetas destined for their employers' pockets.

In the fields outside [SCOPE.sState('agricultural_state_scope').GetFarmHubName], scythes rose and fell in a hypnotic wave. A worker in the middle of the line, blinded by sweat and airborne chaff, took a clumsy step forwards. He fell, and the snap of his ankle resonated like a gunshot.

The print shop's window showed nothing but blue and brass. The first policeman through the door was hideously young—devoid of whiskers, acne-spotted, voice breaking as he shouted. Francisco looked into his eyes, and plunged the dagger into his own chest.
anarchism_events.6.b: This is all there is, all there will ever be.
anarchism_events.7.d: Drawn by interest in the growing [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('anarchist_movement_scope').GetName], a representative of the International Workingman's Association by the name of [SCOPE.sCharacter('international_man_scope').GetFullName] has crossed the border from [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_border_country').GetName].
anarchism_events.7.f:
The International [SCOPE.sCharacter('international_man_scope').GetWomanMan] came at midnight. He slipped through the shop's back door like a breeze, greeting the waiting men with a nod and a whispered password, and then drifting upstairs.

There, behind the safety of a drawn curtain, they exchanged their aliases, their cover-stories, the tales of their battle-scars. The hard floor would suffice for now, said the International [SCOPE.sCharacter('international_man_scope').GetWomanMan]. His hosts smiled at [SCOPE.sCharacter('international_man_scope').GetHerHis] bravado, and offered him pride of place on the loft's sole rug. The copyist would take first watch, settling down by the window with a shrouded candle.

By seven in the morning, the [SCOPE.sCharacter('international_man_scope').GetWomanMan] was on a cart Southwards, and the locals congratulated themselves on a task well done.
anarchism_events.7.b: Keep a close eye on this foreigner.
iberia_union_political_text_monarchy: At the height of the Spanish and Portuguese Empires, all Iberia was bound together under the #v Iberian Union#!. Dynastic unionists call for the restoration of this Union, seeking to bring down the economic barriers separating Spain and Portugal and realize a new golden age.
iberia_union_political_text_theocracy: The universal Catholic Church stands above all nations. Fervent universalists call for an #v Iberian Concordat#! to bring all of the peninsula into sacred union.
iberia_union_political_text_republic: Inspired by the example set by the European liberal revolutions, radical republicans call for the unification of all the peoples of the peninsula under a single #v Iberian Federation#!.
iberia_union_political_communist: The proletariat knows no nation—the feudal and bourgeois constructs that have ruled the peninsula for centuries must be destroyed, and a socialist #v Iberian Federation#! born from their ashes.

iberia.1.d: The rising pan-nationalist sentiment spreading across [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_europe').GetName] has made its way to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. Dynastic unionists and internationalist radicals alike have come to call for the unification of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_iberia_old').GetName] under their preferred form of government.
iberia.1.a_1: We have been divided for too long.
iberia.1.b: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] is a sovereign nation, and that she will stay.
iberia.11.d: With pan-national sentiments rising across [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_iberia_old').GetName], the government of [SCOPE.sCountry('iberia_forming_country').GetName] has declared unification of the peninsula to be official policy. With [SCOPE.sCountry('iberia_forming_country').GetNameNoFormatting]'s position made clear, we must declare our own.

iberia_all_countries_involved_tt: All [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_iberia_old').GetName] are Involved in this [concept_journal_entry]
iberia_union_desc_monarchy: The Iberian states have sufficiently harmonized their laws, creating the foundation for an Iberian legal code. We may now bring the Crowns into a permanent Union.
iberia_union_desc_theocracy: The Iberian states have sufficiently harmonized their laws, creating the foundation for an Iberian legal code. We may now sign a permanent Concordat to bring them into unity.
iberia_union_desc_republic: The Iberian states have sufficiently harmonized their laws, creating the foundation for an Iberian legal code. We may now issue a new Constitution, establishing a Federal Assembly and granting it supreme legislative authority over the peninsula.
iberia_union_desc_communist: The Iberian republics have sufficiently harmonized their policies, creating an administrative path towards their unification. We may now create a new Assembly of Councils for Iberia, and bring the Republics into Federation.
iberia_union_desc_anarchy: The Iberian communes have sufficiently harmonized their policies, and a broad consensus has been reached towards unification. We may now consider them as units within a single Iberian Confederation.
je_iberia_preserve_union_button_desc: The personal union that currently exists between the Iberian states is a sufficient basis for the political organization of the peninsula. We shall issue a constitution that permanently enshrines this loose Union, and guarantees full internal autonomy for its constituents.

iberia.2.d_1: The petty nation-states of Iberia have been vanquished, and the peninsula liberated by the united workers of[ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('to_the_or_not_to_the')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. From Alentejo to the Pyrenees, the black flag flies high and free.
iberia.2.d_2: The proletariat of Iberia have joined together under one [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. No more will the peninsula be divided by the fiat of petty kings and generals.
iberia.2.d_3: Once more, the thrones of $SPA$ and $POR$ are held by a single [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]. This new [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] promises a new golden age for the peninsula, one greater than ever before.
iberia.2.d_4: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has brought the faithful of the peninsula into one grand convocation. From Alentejo to the Pyrenees, the sound of church bells heralds a new golden age.
iberia.2.d_5: At long last, $SPA$ and $POR$ have unified under an [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. From Alentejo to the Pyrenees, the peoples of Iberia look forwards to a new golden age.
iberia.2.f: As the stones impacted the surface of the Douro, they sent up a great gout of water that soaked the barge-men to their skins. Clouds of silt and disturbed fish boiled up from the river-bottom, staining the water around the craft a cloudy green-brown.\n\nIn a week, they hoped, the pile would extend three meters above the water. In a month, five more would join it, each connected to their brothers by a lattice of support beams. By year's end, this would be a bridge, one of a dozen new constructions spanning the former border. Wearily, triumphantly, the barge-men watched the stones settle, and picked up their poles anew.
iberia.2.e: Peace among ourselves, war to the tyrants!
iberia.3.d: Through the unification of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_iberia_old').GetName], we seek to form a new society upon the principles of proletarian internationalism. The constructed language of #b $language_esperanto$#!, popular amongst Iberian socialists, may serve as a suitably international language of administration.
iberia.3.b: National languages, bourgeois cultures... it all must go.
iberia.3.c: Hope, above all else, is what defines us.
je_iberia_adopt_esperanto_language_desc: Iberian socialists have a history of interest in #b $language_esperanto$#!, a constructed language intended as an international auxiliary language. To adopt $language_esperanto$ as an official language will be a great step towards establishing a truly international federation.
je_iberia_forsake_unification_desc: The unification of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_iberia_old').GetName] is a lost cause. Let us focus our efforts on matters with a greater chance of bearing fruit.
nobody_cares_about_iberia_tt: No [concept_country] in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_iberia_old').GetName] is Involved in this [concept_journal_entry]

caciquismo.1.d: With the beginning of the election season, the patronage networks that riddle rural [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] have roused themselves to readiness. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('get_political_boss_name')] await the marching orders of the provincial governors.
caciquismo.1.f: The atmosphere in the casino hung heavy with smoke. In a corner booth, a man in a Panama hat waved a Cuban cigar in the air, a faux-melancholic expression on his face.\n\n
caciquismo.1.b: The [SCOPE.sParty('party_2_scope').GetName] could use a term in government.
caciquismo.1.e: The [SCOPE.sParty('party_4_scope').GetName] is in need of assistance.
caciquismo.1.g: Let the chips fall as they may.
caciquismo.2.d: Election season has begun in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] - and, with it, the strategizing of the government's fixers. If we wish, we may wield the power of the state to ensure a favorable result.
caciquismo.2.f: On the table, a map of [SCOPE.sState('rural_state').GetNameNoFormatting] sprawled across books, empty mugs, and lost drawing-instruments. Four men formed a circle around it, chattering about the intuitive leaning of [SCOPE.sState('rural_state').GetFarmHubName]. It was certain to go for the government, they decided - but by how much? Could they muster an extra thousand votes out of the suburbs? How would the recent accumulation of laborers in the area affect voting patterns?\n\nHalf an hour into what had been intended to be a lunch break, they reached their decision. The town would grant their party eight thousand votes, with a solid - but fruitless - opposition bloc in the working-class areas. Far more tasteful than 101% turnout.
caciquismo.2.a: The [SCOPE.sParty('party_1_scope').GetName] is the natural party of governance.
caciquismo.2.c: Change course - grant the [SCOPE.sParty('party_3_scope').GetName] a term in power.
caciquismo.2.e: The [SCOPE.sParty('party_4_scope').GetName] is in need of assistance.
caciquismo.2.h: If we are to achieve anything, the elections must be free.

caciquismo_can_be_abolished_tt: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] has made sufficient progress towards establishing a #b $amendment_tradition_of_free_elections$#! (currently [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('electoral_fraud_abolish_var').GetValue|v0]/#v 5#!)

notification_colonial_governor_cycle_des: [SCOPE.sCharacter('current_governor').GetFullName]'s term as [SCOPE.sCountry('colony_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [SCOPE.sCountry('colony_scope').GetName] has come to an end. [SCOPE.sCharacter('current_governor').GetSheHe|U] has been replaced by [SCOPE.sCharacter('current_governor').GetCustom('get_special_colonial_trait')].
achievement_unanimity_tt: Has removed all non-marginal opposition to a law currently being enacted
achievement_portugal_is_not_a_small_coun: Has established a land connection between [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_angola').GetName] and [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_mozambique').GetName]
achievement_regeneration_tt: Has completed the #b Economic Regeneration#! [concept_journal_entry] without using the $je_spa_economic_regeneration_reduce_economic_objectives_button$ or $je_spa_economic_regeneration_cheat_button$ interactions
decision_reorganize_iberian_crowns_desc: With the former crown of Castile under our control, we have the opportunity to determine the future shape of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_iberia_old').GetNameNoFormatting]. One option before us is to place a [GetPlayer.GetRuler.GetLastNameNoFormatting] on the throne of #v $SPA$#!, establishing a co-equal Kingdom of #v $SPA$#! in union with #v $POR$#!.
decision_restore_kingdom_of_brazil_desc: Once more, #v $BRZ$#! has come under $POR_ADJ$ suzerainty. To reduce the strain of transoceanic administration, and appease those who desire $BRZ_ADJ$ autonomy, we may re-establish a co-equal Kingdom of #v $BRZ$#! in union with #v $POR$#!.
portugal_spawn_spain_tt: #v $SPA$#! will be granted the territories of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_castile').GetName] and [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_aragon').GetName], and placed into a [concept_personal_union] with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]
portugal_spawn_brazil_tt: #v $BRZ$#! will be granted the territory of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_brazil').GetName], and placed into a [concept_personal_union] with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]
je_philippines_development_reason: In the far-away archipelago of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag], an increase in international trade has set the stage for a burgeoning middle class to gain more influence despite ongoing political upheavals.\n\nGrow the domestic agricultural sector, increase the [concept_sol], and build ports to secure a fruitful future for the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting].
je_filipino_ethnogenesis_reason: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] nation is home to many peoples, who – while sharing a common history – remain distinct from each others in matters of culture and language. If we are to build a strong nation, such minor differences must be swept aside.
je_filipino_ethnogenesis_colonization_bu: From the martial sultanates of the [GetCulture('moro').GetName] Gulf to the disparate [GetCulture('lumad').GetName] tribes of the highland, the peoples of [GetStateRegion('STATE_MINDANAO').GetName] have long resisted our attempts at imposing order on this uncivilized land.\n\nIt is time to bring them into the Filipino fold, whether they want it or not.
je_philippines_main_reason: Upward mobility from the burgeoning middle class has contributed to a growing national consciousness. Tensions within the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] are on the rise. [GetCulture('spanish').GetName] [GetPopType('clergymen').GetName] dominate secular and religious life, while [GetCulture('filipino_mestizo').GetName] [GetPopType('clergymen').GetNameNoFormatting] lead revolts against their authority. [GetCulture('filipino_mestizo').GetNameNoFormatting] elites of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('intelligentsia_ig').GetName], too, are maneuvering for greater representation in government.\n\nUltimately, the [SelectLocalization(ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.IsValid, ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjective, 'SPA_ADJ')] government has high expectations that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] maintains an iron rule over their territory out in the Pacific. This friction threatens to topple our stability, putting the future of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] at risk.

je_philippines_main_ilustrado_button_des: Many upper and middle class [GetCulture('filipino_mestizo').GetCustom('getPluralDemonym')] and so-called #italic Indios#! have been exposed to [GetCulture('spanish').GetName] [GetIdeology('ideology_liberal').GetName] ideals. This rapidly growing educated class has begun to align themselves with the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_intelligentsia',GetPlayer).GetName]. They seek to reform laws and set a more liberal agenda in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
notification_filipino_mestizo_now_primar: Now that we are no longer under $SPA_ADJ$ rule, [GetCulture('filipino_mestizo').GetName] is our [Concept('concept_primary_cultures','$concept_primary_culture$')].
philippines.1.d: Amidst growing tensions more people seek greater representation in government while others call for independence from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetName]. Will [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] rule prevail or will the people of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] succeed in gaining greater liberties?
philippines.2.d: Independent and thriving, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] will be a stalwart presence in the Pacific for many years to come.
philippines.2.a: The future of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is bright.
notification_filipino_culture_genesis_de: The [SCOPE.sCountry('filipino_nation_scope').GetName] has experienced a widespread cultural awakening, transitioning towards a distinct [GetCulture('filipino').GetName] culture.
philippines.3.d: We continue to benefit from our ties with the metropole, as [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjective] and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] affairs become increasingly intertwined.
philippines.3.f: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] rule in this archipelago remains steadfast as it has for centuries and the people of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] have shown a growing committment to strengthening ties with [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetNameNoFormatting].\n\nFor some members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ilustrado_ig_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] this is a victory and a promise of great things to come. For others, these firm bonds are troubling and a threat to the future of the country.
philippines.3.a: This indeed marks a new chapter for our country.
notification_filipino_hispanophone_cultu: The [SCOPE.sCountry('filipino_nation_scope').GetName] has experienced a widespread cultural awakening, transitioning towards a distinct [GetCulture('filipino_hispanophone').GetName] culture.
philippines.4.d: A newspaper article written in protest of an old decree from the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjective] government argues that [GetCulture('filipino_mestizo').GetName] friars should wield the same authority as [GetCulture('spanish').GetName] friars.
philippines.4.f: The newspaper circulated all around in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], rousing the ire of [GetCulture('spanish').GetNameNoFormatting] friars and government administrators alike.\n\n
philippines.4.a: [GetCulture('filipino_mestizo').GetNameNoFormatting] friars are just as capable of managing local parishes.
philippines.4.b: Contributions of [GetCulture('spanish').GetName] friars have been invaluable.
philippines.5.d: Thanks to our efforts, the Ilustrado have secured more of a foothold in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] government.
philippines.5.a: The influence of the Ilustrados will continue to grow.
philippines.7.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastName], on behalf of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] administration, has introduced the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_armed_forces',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant] to the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] archipelago.
philippines.7.a: But will the officers abuse their new-found authority?
philippines.7.b: Very well, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has everything well in hand.
philippines.9.d: With ports opened to foreign trade, the archipelago has more potential to develop into a thriving region. Port cities and the agricultural sector have the most to gain.
philippines.9.f: On the right bank of the river Pasig lives the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] who oversees the development of these islands on behalf of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetTopOverlord.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] administration. And on the very same river bank three miles down are the wharves and warehouses of the accomplished merchants who bolster the economy by no inconsiderable amount.\n\n[ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], one of the most frequented harbors of the region, is rich with opportunity for those who seek it.
philippines.9.a: We must focus our efforts on our ports.
philippines.9.b: It is crucial we focus on developing the agricultural sector.
philippines.10.d: The stage has now been set for a burgeoning middle class to gain more political influence. Steady progress has been made in the development of the archipelago.
philippines.10.f: In [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] is impressed with the development of the agricultural sector and thriving ports in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting].\n\nAs the country's development impresses the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle], the lives of many improve and money lines the pockets of a rising middle class. These upwardly mobile families now send their children to universities both in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] and abroad. Domestic prospects certainly are looking up.
philippines.10.a: [SCOPE.sState('visayas_scope').GetStateRegion.GetName] will surely thrive for generations to come.

je_lands_of_anarchy_reason:
Over the centuries, the holy Makhzen and the uncivilized tribes scattered across our lands have coexisted in a mutually diplomatic relationship without much concern.

With an ambitious dream of becoming the #b $dyn_c_ottoman_empire$#! of the West, our nation is recognizing the importance of a strong central government with the means to reach every part of its realm.

Recently, our [Concept('concept_lands_of_anarchy_control','$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$')] over these settled tribes of the deserts and highlands has begun to weaken. We must establish connections and reasons between the two lands and draw them out of their tents into urban life.
je_lands_of_anarchy_complete_tt: All [Concept('concept_lands_of_anarchy_control','$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$')] bars of the owned [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] are above #bold 400#!.

je_lands_of_anarchy_harka_activate_butto: Go out on a royal expedition to the states of anarchy, projecting the aura of a well-run nation. By personally leading these expeditions, the aim is to turn the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetName] into the symbol of a disciplined and encompassing authority.\n\n #italic - The Throne of the Emperor of Morocco is his horse; his canopy is the sky.#!
je_lands_of_anarchy_harka_deactivate_but: Return from the expedition to Bilaad al-Makhzen, lands of the government.
je_lands_of_anarchy_colonize_sahara_butt: From the tribes of the Tekna to Tafilalt, from the oasis of Tuat to the mines of Mali. Once did Morocco control the movement of trade and people across the entire region, and now the time has come to look outwards once more.
lands_of_anarchy.1.d: Time-honored tribes around the corners of our nation have become increasingly difficult to control. If we don't demonstrate our authority, they might slip out of our grasp.
lands_of_anarchy.1.a: They shall face the might of Makhzen.
lands_of_anarchy.1_tt: [SCOPE.sState('al_rif_state_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sState('marrakech_state_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sState('inner_morocco_state_scope').GetName] have received a modifier named #bold State of Anarchy#!, with scaling penalties based on their [Concept('concept_lands_of_anarchy_control','$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$')] values shown in the #bold $je_lands_of_anarchy$#! [concept_journal_entry].
lands_of_anarchy.2.d: All lawless tribes have surrendered to our authority, willingly or not. Our rule over the mainland remains undisputed, allowing us to invest more in these lands.
lands_of_anarchy.2.f: The Makhzen is not the only beneficiary of recent changes in Moroccan society. Old hatreds and cultural gaps have mostly disappeared, giving way to new neighbors, shared traditions, and experts in all fields, contributing with an innate disposition to urban life.\n\nThose who refused to be a part of the central crowd and stayed rural have also found communal bliss through modern communication methods provided by the government. Merchants, tax collectors, and armed forces, among others, are safer to roam the lands to carry out their tasks.
lands_of_anarchy.2.a: This was a good lesson on coffers and how to fill them.
lands_of_anarchy.2.b: A civilization is defined by its ways.
lands_of_anarchy.2.c: Let the light of knowledge shine upon our people.
lands_of_anarchy.3.d: As we failed to maintain control, several tribes have gone rogue, making them almost unreachable to our authority.
lands_of_anarchy.3.b: No matter what happens, we must always build.
lands_of_anarchy.3.c: Let's at least guard our tax collectors.
lands_of_anarchy.4.d: Within the last few weeks, the advisors have collected reports regarding connections between several interest groups and certain well-known tribal families.
lands_of_anarchy.4.f: The couple, isolated from the hall's conversations, had sincere insecurities, growing up among the #italic uncivilized#!.\n\nListening to a dull oud performance, the scent of mint tea and perfumes of royalty brightened their senses as they waited for their sly contact. They had never been whispered to so much compared to city life in recent months.
lands_of_anarchy.4.a: The tribes of [SCOPE.sState('marrakech_state_scope').GetName] are known to fight well.

[Concept('concept_lands_of_anarchy_control','$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$')] per month over the state as long as the character stays as the leader.

[Concept('concept_lands_of_anarchy_control','$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$')] per month over the state as long as the character stays as the leader.
lands_of_anarchy.4.c: Noone knows these lands better than [SCOPE.sState('inner_morocco_state_scope').GetName]'s natives.

[Concept('concept_lands_of_anarchy_control','$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$')] per month over the state as long as the character stays as the leader.
lands_of_anarchy.4.e: We are here to govern them, not the other way around.
lands_of_anarchy.4.e_tt: #bold -0.3#! [Concept('concept_lands_of_anarchy_control','$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$')] to all anarchy states for #bold 5 years#!.
lands_of_anarchy.5.d: A plea for our aid has been sent out by a specific tribe in [SCOPE.sState('anarchy_state_scope').GetName] regarding an incurable pandemic by their means.
lands_of_anarchy.5.f:
A smoke of despair rises from a central fire of distress, attempting to lure in foreigners for aid.

Recitations of duas believed to ease the pain of the sick from different suffering families can be heard easily through the coughs of the weak, as they ask the Creator for a way out of this test of faith.

Unaffected young men occasionally climb to the nearby dunes to see if a royal party is arriving to bring glad tidings, though so far, there has been no success.
lands_of_anarchy.5.a_tt: Royal chemists will prepare medicine packages for [SCOPE.sState('anarchy_state_scope').GetName], generating #bold 1#! [Concept('concept_lands_of_anarchy_control','$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$')] per month over the state for our merciful gesture.

[Concept('concept_lands_of_anarchy_control','$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$')] per month over the state for saving their lives.
lands_of_anarchy.5.c: They have the ways of alternative medicine after all.
lands_of_anarchy.5.c_tt: Refusing to spend our resources to unruly tribes will make a part of our population in [SCOPE.sState('fez_scope').GetName] happy, but the tribesmen will not forget this for a long time, reducing [Concept('concept_lands_of_anarchy_control','$concept_lands_of_anarchy_control_short$')] for [SCOPE.sState('anarchy_state_scope').GetName] by #bold 0.5#! per month

portuguese_monarchs.1.a: Her legacy will carry on through her offspring.
portuguese_monarchs.1_tt: A suitable heir has already been chosen to wear the crown.
portuguese_monarchs.2.d: Fanatical culprits have managed to take the life of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName] and the heir apparent while the royal family was enjoying a peaceful journey in their carriage.
portuguese_monarchs.2.f:
The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] was ambushed by Alfredo Luís da Costa and Manuel Buíça while travelling in an open carriage. Tragically, gunshots fatally struck him and his heir, injuring his younger son, who would soon be crowned.

Some perceived the motives for the regicide as a bold stand against a repressive monarchy, while others regarded it as a frantic effort to spark political transformation.

After investigations took place, it was revealed that the assassins were part of a larger revolutionary group called the
portuguese_monarchs.2.a: The crown weighs heavily on the new [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s temple.
portuguese_monarchs.2_tt: Having been saved with non-fatal wounds, the second son of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFirstName] is the only reasonable candidate to become the new ruler.
portuguese_monarchs.3.d: The centuries-long reign of the Most Serene House of Bragança has ended in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. The residents have successfully demonstrated that true nobility resides in their hearts and hands.
portuguese_monarchs.3.f:
There once was a man who began life as the future founder of a house that produced many kings and queens, to the very soil where his grave was dug.

He was bestowed the name Alfonso by his father, the monarch of Portugal, in the Gregorian year of 1337.

Today, that legacy has reached its conclusion.

Tomorrow will mark the triumph of the common folk against those who claimed to be the chosen ones.
portuguese_monarchs.3.a: We shall take off, one last time.
portuguese_monarchs.3_tt: To prevent conflict and harm to the family members, King [SCOPE.sCharacter('manuel_scope').GetFullName] is forced to leave the country, perhaps never to return.

portuguese_monarchs.4.b: We need to visit them on site to boost morale.

portugal_single_fire_events.3.c: Assemble a public stunt to sacrifice a brave soul.

portugal_single_fire_events.4.c: Let us raise our hands and gaze to the sky.

portugal_single_fire_events.5.f: The boy held his mother’s gloved hand tightly, eyes flicking from the sway of an elephant’s trunk to the shimmer of green-and-gold feathers above. Each cage seemed like a doorway to another world. Monkeys jumping like living fireworks, a lion’s yawn echoing through his chest.\n\nIn that moment, [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] felt as vast as the maps in his schoolbook.
portugal_single_fire_events.5.b: What's next, a parliament for parrots?
portugal_single_fire_events.6.d: Two folk healers from [SCOPE.sState('shanghai_state_scope').GetName] have been working in a hotel in [SCOPE.sState('capital_scope').GetName], claiming to cure vision problems with alternative methods. The governor, a physician himself, tried to stop them, but the locals' objections have become a matter of public order.
portugal_single_fire_events.6.a: Brand them as witches and do whatever is necessary for such individuals.
portugal_single_fire_events.6.b: Force the governor to let go of the ladies to ease the tension.
portugal_single_fire_events.6.c: Let [SCOPE.sCountry('shanghai_owner_scope').GetName] deal with them, deport the duo.
je_portuguese_colonialism_reason:
It would be a great embarrassment and injustice for our centuries-old empire to fall behind that of other powers.

Having already a foothold on the coasts of Africa, we are determined to seize the opportunity and extend the influence of our culture.

Our first campaign aims to establish colonies at the southern ends of the strategic regions of [SCOPE.sStrategicRegion('congo_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sStrategicRegion('zanj_scope').GetName], so we might consider declaring them as our strategic interests if we haven't already. After that, we will focus on connecting the two coasts in the middle. Our colonial specialists are already working on mapping this area, but first, we should make an impact on the region with our newly founded colonies.
je_the_pink_map_reason: With multiple colonies successfully established on east and west coasts of Africa, we can take the opportunity to connect them with a corridor in the belly of the continent.\n\nWe have developed a proposal called #bold The Pink Map#!, which outlines our goals for which areas to colonize. Accomplishing such a goal will evolve us into an unmatchable power in the colonial race.
owned_by_root_or_a_colonial_subject_tt: Is owned by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] or any of her #v $colonial$#! or #v $company$#! [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')]

[Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] do #b not#! own any [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] in #v $geographic_region_angola$#! or #v $geographic_region_mozambique$#!
does_not_own_any_state_in_angola_mozambi: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] or any of her #v $colonial$#! or #v $company$#! [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] do #b not#! own any [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] in #v $geographic_region_angola$#!, #v $geographic_region_mozambique$#!, or #v $geographic_region_zambezi_basin$#!
pink_map_desc: Send a delegation of diplomats to Britain to negotiate our ambitions for the Pink Map. Also referred to as the #bold Rose-Coloured Map#!, this campaign strives to establish a land connection between our colonies of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_angola').GetNameNoFormatting] and [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_mozambique').GetNameNoFormatting].
pink_map_tt2: Should we decide to pursue this endeavor, our diplomats will prepare a presentation and travel to #bold Britain#! to solicit their approval. They may simply grant their approval, request a reciprocal favor, or deny our proposal. We will retain the option to proceed with the campaign regardless of their response.
goa_decision_desc: Having enough reasons to be considered a real Portuguese state, Goa deserves an official declaration of incorporation.
macao_decision_desc: The treaty port of Macao has great potential, and is increasingly crucial to our trade network. We should consider an investment plan to capitalize on its development.
macao_decision_tt: We will have to choose a payment plan.
portuguese_colonialism.1.d: Successfully colonizing [SCOPE.sState('colony_state_scope').GetName] has reignited centuries of expertise and ambition. The government sees building strong foundations along the African coasts as an excellent opportunity.
portuguese_colonialism.1.f: It had been nearly a month since Fr. Duarte left. The trip was fairly smooth, though the days went by quicker than he expected as he worked to organize various records about pagan religious sites, rock art, and megaliths with ritual carvings.\n\nHe couldn't wait to show his documents to his fellow brothers and start planning the work schedule for potential missionaries heading to the new colony.
portuguese_colonialism.1.a: Yes, this is the course of action we should undertake.
portuguese_colonialism.1.b: We have other issues that require our attention.
portuguese_colonialism.1.b_tt: Removes #bold Além-mar Africano#! from the Journal of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
portuguese_colonialism.2.d: We have established several colonies along the eastern and western coasts of Africa, and several exploration missions are currently being organized to explore the central region.
portuguese_colonialism.2.a: We must rapidly populate these colonies.
portuguese_colonialism.2.b: Let our objectors know that the old [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName] is back.
portuguese_colonialism.2.c: The whole world shall realize our greatness.
portuguese_colonialism.3.d: Our attempts to colonize the African coastlines have ended with an unfortunate blunder. We have failed to establish or hold a single colony around the landmass we initially aimed for.
portuguese_colonialism.4.d: Suspicious of our potential ambitions in southern Africa, emissaries from [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName] have arrived to seek accord regarding a document called
portuguese_colonialism.4.a: This is of no harm to us.
portuguese_colonialism.4.a_tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName] will receive our blessing of #bold The Pink Map#!.
portuguese_colonialism.4.b: We may do so, with a caveat.
portuguese_colonialism.4.b_tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName] will receive an event about our demand, and upon accepting, they will owe us an [concept_obligation]. They might also choose to back down, or ignore our demand.
portuguese_colonialism.4.c_tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName] will receive an event regarding our refusal. They may still choose to proceed, damaging our [concept_relations].
might_get_additional_rewards_tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName] may send an additional token of their appreciation, granting us increased [concept_prestige] and [concept_relations] with #v $POR$#!
portuguese_colonialism.5.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('gbr_scope').GetName] has given us their blessing for The Pink Map campaign. We shall begin the preparations.
portuguese_colonialism.5.f: Pereira adjusted his attire one last time before entering Visconde Duarte's room. He knew the news of his success had spread faster than he could arrive in these halls, but he was still excited to share his achievement, expecting the proud look of a father towards a son.\n\nAnd that is precisely what happened. Duarte was thrilled that his pupil finally experienced a diplomatic triumph after years of performing simple tasks.
portuguese_colonialism.5.b: Dispatch something of value in return for their good will.
portuguese_colonialism.5.b_tt: An exquisite work of art will be commisioned and sent to [SCOPE.sCountry('gbr_scope').GetName] as a gift. They will receive a boost to their [concept_prestige] and increase [concept_relations] with us by #bold 30#!.
portuguese_colonialism.6.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('gbr_scope').GetName] has refused to give us their blessing for The Pink Map campaign. What will be our response?
portuguese_colonialism.6.f: The proprietor of the gazette press waited anxiously, remaining still at the scheduled time of the officer and his personnel's arrival.\n\nAfter issuing the warning, he realized that describing the events in Britain as a
portuguese_colonialism.6.a: We should not poke the beast.
portuguese_colonialism.6.a_tt: This will forever disallow us to add #bold The Pink Map#! entry to our [concept_journal_entry].
portuguese_colonialism.8.d: The Pink Map is now a reality. We have reminded the world of the might of [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName].
portuguese_colonialism.8.f: “It was Portugal, small among the nations of Europe, that first brought to the world the idea of a universal civilization, connecting peoples and continents through commerce, the Christian faith, and scientific curiosity. Not with the destroying sword, but with the cross, the language, and ingenuity, the Portuguese opened routes across unknown seas, revealed unknown peoples, and extended European influence to the farthest reaches of the globe.”\n\n— Oliveira Martins, #italic História da Civilização Ibérica, Chapter X#!
portuguese_colonialism.8.b: I am the supreme [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of Africa!
portuguese_colonialism.9.d: Though the Pink Map initiative has long been a national dream, we have overestimated our ability to make it a reality.
portuguese_colonialism.9.f:
The lone colonial officer stood beneath the burning African sun before his hut, clutching a crumpled copy of a torn Pink Map.

Behind him, the [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] flag had been lowered from a makeshift wooden pole, with native porters looking on silently, some with hidden smiles, others with contempt.

The vision of a vast Lusophone Africa, stretching unbroken from coast to coast, crumbles like the brittle paper in his grip.
portuguese_colonialism.10.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('gbr_scope').GetName] has requested concessions in return for their approval of the Pink Map campaign.
portuguese_colonialism.10.a: Let them have their way, this time.
portuguese_colonialism.10.a_tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('gbr_scope').GetName] drafts #bold The Pink Map [concept_treaty]#! with [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName], obligating [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName] to pay a tribute of @money! #bold 200#! per month for #bold 24 months#!.
portuguese_colonialism.10.b: This is starting to feel like a pointless aspiration.
notification_pink_map_britain_portugal_i: Despite our stance, [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName] has declared that they shall pursue their ambition of realizing The Pink Map.
notification_pink_map_britain_accepts_wi: The [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetAdjective] officials have sent us a beautiful piece of art in return of our blessing of The Pink Map.\n\nOur [concept_prestige] has increased accordingly.
notification_pink_map_britain_portugal_b: [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName] has decided to abandon the Pink Map. They will need to look elsewhere for expansion.\n\nOur [concept_prestige] has increased accordingly.
notification_pink_map_britain_accepts_wi: [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetName] has acquiesced to our request for compensation in return for our approval of the Pink Map.
notification_pink_map_britain_portugal_i: The [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetAdjective] have rejected our demand, stating their commitment to realizing the Pink Map without compromises.\n\nOur [concept_prestige] has decreased, and [concept_relations] with [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] have suffered.
portuguese_colonialism.15.d: The recent census of [SCOPE.sState('goa_scope').GetName] has made it clear that it deserves an official act of recognition from the government to incorporate it as a [SCOPE.sCountry('por_scope').GetAdjective] state.
portuguese_colonialism.15.f:
Goa’s Carnival, a lively pre-Lenten festival, is a legacy of our rule that brings two cultures together.

#italic Entrudo#!— People splashed water, eggs, and sometimes colored liquids on each other in the streets.

#italic Masquerades#!—Participants wore colorful costumes and masks, and danced to Portuguese and Goan music.

#italic Rex Momus #!—A “#bold King Momo#!” figure presided over festivities, declaring days of revelry before Lent.
portuguese_colonialism.16.d: There has been a significant increase in reports of [SCOPE.sState('macao_scope').GetName] achieving impressive economic feats for such a small state.
portuguese_colonialism.16.f: Businessmen from all cultures and walks of life have flocked to [SCOPE.sState('macao_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]'s markets and meeting halls in recent years, trying to seize trade opportunities with local proprietors. Portuguese adventurers and Cantonese brokers mingled in narrow alleys and busy waterfronts.\n\nThe aroma of spices and salt air accompanied fierce negotiations over rice wine.
portuguese_colonialism.16.a: Send experienced administrators to oversee trade.
portuguese_colonialism.16.b: What they need are architects and builders.

je_spa_economic_regeneration_reduce_econ: The goals put forth in the initial report appear to have been slightly too ambitious. By redefining our economic targets now, we may avoid the worst consequences of failing to deliver on our promises.

By manipulating the ledgers ever so slightly in our favor, we can pursue an economic reform policy more amenable to [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s true ability.\n\nWe merely must ensure that no compromising material falls into the hands of the press.

je_spa_economic_regeneration_master_reas: Long gone are the days when [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] was a byword for wealth. Centuries of mismanagement and misfortune have rendered the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] economy a shadow of its former self—unable to meet even the most basic demands of the modern age. \n\nBut as Jesus raised Lazarus from his tomb, so too shall the good men of the Hacienda raise the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] economy from its long slumber. For [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]'s destiny is to be found not in the decrepit empires of yore, but in the strength of tomorrow.
je_spa_economic_regeneration_land_reform: The question of land reform has long been on the lips of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] politicians, with some seeking to break the power of the great landowning elites of the south, while other seek to cement it even further.\n\nThe time has come for the government to decide, and to pursue its course with unwavering resolve.
If we decide to side #b with#! the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_scope').GetName]:
If we decide to side #b against#! the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('landowners_scope').GetName]:
je_spa_economic_regeneration_modernise_a: To traverse the less-developed regions of the Meseta Central is to step back through time. The ploughs and tools of the farmers therein remain little changed from those of their ancestors; their yields stunted by practices long abandoned elsewhere.\n\nWithout reform, the land cannot hope to sustain the prosperity of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
The following has been true for #b 24#! consecutive months (currently #v [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('je_spa_economic_regeneration_modernise_agriculture_timer_var').GetValue]#!):
The following has been true for #b 12#! consecutive months (currently #v [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('je_spa_economic_regeneration_modernise_agriculture_timer_var').GetValue]#!):
je_spa_economic_regeneration_mining_reas: The Iberian peninsula is home to large, untapped deposits of raw minerals, rife for exploitation.\n\nWhile the sector currently remains underdeveloped, our chief geologists insist that the ground holds enough wealth for us to propel the nation into a new golden era of mining—surpassing even the days of Roman Hispania.
je_spa_economic_regeneration_mining_upgr: We will be able to #g double#! the effects of one of the #tooltippable;TOOLTIP:je_spa_economic_regeneration_mining_upgrade_iberian_state_traits_tt #bold Mining-Related State Traits#!#! in [GetGeographicRegion('region_iberia').GetName]

We will be able to grant a #g positive#! #b temporary effect#! to complement one of the #tooltippable;TOOLTIP:je_spa_economic_regeneration_mining_upgrade_iberian_state_traits_tt #bold Mining-Related State Traits#!#! in [GetGeographicRegion('region_iberia').GetName]
je_spa_economic_regeneration_light_indus: In no place is [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s premodernity felt as keenly as in her manufactoring sector. Still largely artisanal in nature, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] manufactories have been struggling to compete with cheap, foreign goods, save for in a select few localities like Barcelona.\n\nBy developing a strong manufacturing sector in key locations across our realm, we can turn the tide of foreign economic domination.
every_state_following_requirements_tt: Every [concept_state] fulfilling the requirements will get the following modifier:
je_spa_economic_regeneration_railways_re: Of the many great inventions of this age, few measure up to the raw potential of the steam locomotive. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] interior has long remained relatively isolated from the rest of the country, hemmed in by mountainous terrain, poor road networks, and rivers that are only navigable in part.\n\nBut, where cart and barge has failed, the steam locomotive shall triumph, and every inch of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] soil will be as connected to the wider market as the port of Bilbao is today.
je_spa_economic_regeneration_ultramar_re: During the so-called Golden Century, much of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s wealth came from her colonies. While the dynamics of colonialism has changed much since then, certain truths hold as well today now as they did then:\n\nThe Ultramar contains great riches, and we would be fools not to exploit them.
every_colonial_subject_following_require: Every #b colonial#! [concept_subject] fulfilling the requirements will get the following modifier:
spa_economic_regeneration_events.1.t: On the General State of the Public Treasury
spa_economic_regeneration_events.1.d: Emphasizing the underdeveloped state of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] economy, the Minister of the Treasury has sketched out an ambitious reform plan designed to re-establish the country among the world's premier economies.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.1.f: #bold Economic Report on the General State of the Public Treasury to the Most Illustrious [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]#!\nIt should come as no surprise to the esteemed gentlemen of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName], that the waves of industrial and commercial innovation, which have so transformed our brethren beyond the Pyrenees, have not as yet reached the shores of our own dominions in earnest. It is the opinion of the Hacienda, that in the absence of immediate policies intending to correct this growing imbalance, our country's path will be steered not towards civilization and prosperity, but rather towards barbarism and destitution. The following report will ...
spa_economic_regeneration_events.1.b: We are not in a position to pursue this at the moment.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.1.tt_1: The #bold Economic Regeneration Program#! calls for a series of reforms to be carried out within #v 20#! years.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.1.tt_2: Failure to fulfill the program's goals in time will #r worsen#! [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] political stability
spa_economic_regeneration_events.1.tt_3: The #bold $je_spa_economic_regeneration_master$#! [concept_journal_entry] will be #r deactivated#! for now, but will be #g available again#! after #v 5#! years.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.2.d: Intrepid reporters working for the [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('generic_newspaper_type')] have uncovered our attempts at manipulation and published a scathing report accusing the government of incompetence and deceit.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.2.f: The coffee tasted better today. It always did when his mood was up. And his mood was up today. Nothing, at least nothing one could put in print, gave the old man greater pleasure than seeing the current government fumble their way from scandal to scandal.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.2.a: Damn them all. Reaffirm our committment to the original targets.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.2.b: Run a massive press campaign to discredit their claims.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.2.tt_1: The original targets will remain unchanged, and we will be unable to attempt this again.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.3.d: The vast [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] mining investments have borne fruit, and the country's mine pits are abuzz with activity like never before. A particularly successful company has now approached the government with a proposal to improve the mining infrastructure of one of our principal mining districts.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.3.f: Two sharp knocks on the door interrupted the miner's breakfast. He had lingered too long and the foreman's boy was making the rounds. #italic That damned lickspittle#!. Kissing his wife goodbye, he slung his sack across his back and stepped into the chill of the early dawn. A somber procession snaked its way from the company town up to the pithead, silent save for the dull clank of metal on metal. Twelve hours of toil and darkness awaited.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.3.a: Direct them to the rich [GetGoods('iron').GetName] veins of the [SCOPE.sState('basque_country_scope').GetStateRegion.GetName].
spa_economic_regeneration_events.3.b: The [GetGoods('sulfur').GetName] pits of [SCOPE.sState('lower_andalusia_scope').GetStateRegion.GetName] could be expanded.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.3.c: The older [GetGoods('lead').GetName] mines of [SCOPE.sState('murcia_scope').GetStateRegion.GetName] are in need of modernization.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.3.e: What else but [GetGoods('coal').GetName], the black gold of [SCOPE.sState('asturias_scope').GetStateRegion.GetName].
spa_economic_regeneration_events.4.d: Referencing the economic reform program proposed some years back, the Minister of the Treasury now demands that we take immediate action to implement it, claiming that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] will be relegated to the dustbin of history if the government's inaction persists.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.4.a: Very well, make the necessary announcements.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.4.b: We are still in no position to pursue this.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.4.tt: As we have #bold already postponed#! the reforms once, the #r penalties#! for doing so again are #r doubled#!.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.5.d: Having successfully carried out the Regeneration reform program, the government is receiving praise even from her most embittered opponents.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.5.f: With a steady hand, the minister opened the great ledger and glanced once more at the figures within. To what degree they could be trusted he was not entirely certain, but that mattered little beside the public jubilation they were sure to inspire. No, he thought. That reckoning could be left to the children of tomorrow. Today belonged to him.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.6.d: The government's inability to carry through the Regeneration reforms has provoked public outrage. Angry crowds gather outside the Hacienda, while the press proclaims the failure a national disgrace.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.6.f: How many humiliations must this country bear? Were the events of the last century not enough? The minister drew the curtain aside and peered into the street, where the crowd had raised an effigy in his likeness—a crude figure dangling from a poorly knotted rope. Its face bore a twisted parody of the same mustache that greeted him every morning, bobbing up and down to the rhythm of the crazed lunatics below him.\n\nHe turned to face his valet.
spa_economic_regeneration_events.6.a: The cards were stacked against us.
spanish_new_world_events.1.d: With order restored at home, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] must decide her stance toward her former rebellious colonies in the Americas, whose independence remains unrecognized by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName].
spanish_new_world_events.1.a: The old empire is gone. It is time to face the reality of our situation.
spanish_new_world_events.1.b: Cowards. Send for the war minister, treason shall not be rewarded.
spanish_new_world_events.1.tt_1: This will set us on a path of #g normalisation#! with our former colonies.
spanish_new_world_events.1.tt_2: This will set us on a #b difficult#! path of #r conquest#! targeting our former colonies.
spanish_new_world_events.1.tt_3: [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetName] and the [SCOPE.sCountry('usa_scope').GetName] will be likely to #b intervene against us#! in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] targeting our former colonies, unless we enjoy very good relations with them.
spanish_new_world_events.1.tt_4: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [concept_relations] with [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetName], [SCOPE.sCountry('usa_scope').GetName], and #b all former [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] colonies#! deteriorates by #r 30#!
spanish_new_world_events.1.tt_5: We will #b disgrace#! ourselves in the eyes of the international community, and all South American countries will lose the #b $modifier_not_recognized_by_spain$#! [concept_modifier]
spanish_new_world_events.1.tt_3_event_in: #b $GBR$#! and #b $USA$#! will be likely to #b intervene against us#! in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] targeting our former colonies, unless we enjoy very good relations with them.
spanish_new_world_events.1.tt_4_event_in: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [concept_relations] with #b $GBR$#!, #b $USA$#!, and #b all former [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] colonies#! deteriorates by #r 30#!
spanish_new_world_events.2.d: The impossible made manifest: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s dominion over the New World has been restored. To mark this momentous occasion, large triumphs have been arranged in the capitals of the restored Audiencias.
spanish_new_world_events.2.f: When the bugle sounded and the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] flag was hoisted over the Castillo de San Felipe de Barajas that morning, the young corporal's heart was filled with pride. Even in the sleepy Asturian village of his youth, the memory of the defense of Cartagena loomed large. Now, the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] banner fluttered proudly from its battlements once more.\n\nWith a silent vow to himself and to the Almighty, he swore that so long as breath remained in his body, that standard would never fall again.
spanish_new_world_events.2.a: Once more, our Empire stretches from shore to shore.
spanish_new_world_events.2.b: All must know the strength of the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] legions.
spanish_new_world_events.3.d: With the signing of the last treaty, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] diplomatic relations with her former subjects have been clearly defined, with the voices of cordiality and mutual benefit triumphing over those of revenge.
spanish_new_world_events.3.f: As the last delegate departed, the ambassador's mind drifted from practical matters. A century ago, such a meeting would have been between master and servant; now, they met as equals. He lingered on the thought, uncertain whether it stirred pride or sorrow. How would his grandsires judge this turn of fate, and how would his grandchildren? And above all, how would the Almighty? Were Spain's dominions not once held as God-given?\n\nNo matter, all he focus on for now was one simple thought:
spanish_new_world_events.3.a: A mother and her children, reconciled at last.
spanish_new_world_events.4.d: With the re-establishment of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country_scope').GetName], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] finds herself one step closer to the restoration of her ancient dominion. We must now decide the territorial extent of our [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] subject.
spanish_new_world_events.4.d_caribbean: With [SCOPE.sCountry('new_spain_scope').GetName] once again under [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] control, some colonial officers have argued in favor of the consolidation of our Caribbean colonies.
spanish_new_world_events.4.f: Around him, messengers bustled through the chamber, each bearing papers that would decide the fate of thousands. He signed them all without pause, each decree carrying the weight of empire. For years, old colonial records had been scoured, councils convened, and voices from every corner of Spain's dominion heard.\n\nNow, at last, the labor bore fruit: [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] had returned to the fold.
spanish_new_world_events.4.a_1: Award them the North American Mainland.
spanish_new_world_events.4.a_2: They shall hold dominion over all of [GetStrategicRegion('region_gran_colombia').GetName].
spanish_new_world_events.4.a_3: They shall hold dominion over all of [GetStrategicRegion('region_andes').GetName].
spanish_new_world_events.4.a_4: They shall hold dominion over all of [GetStrategicRegion('region_la_plata').GetName].
spanish_new_world_events.4.a_5: [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country_scope').GetName] shall hold dominion over all of the [GetStrategicRegion('region_caribbean').GetName].
spanish_new_world_events.4.b_1: The pre-Napoleonic borders must be restored in full.
spanish_new_world_events.4.c: Leave the current administrations in place.
