spanish_new_world_events.5.d: With the legal status of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] no longer in question, the country's presence on the international stage is bound to increase.
spanish_new_world_events.5.f:
While true independence was won at the point of a bayonet by the valiant fighters of the wars of liberation, it was through the labors of men of letters like himself that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] legal sovereignty would be secured.

As glorious as a heroic defense or a glorious charge? Perhaps not.

The squares and plazas of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] would likely never bear his name, yet he took great comfort in knowing that in the storied history of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] #italic he#! had left a mark.
spanish_new_world_events.5.a: This date will go down in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] history.
je_spanish_new_world_dummy_status_desc: The Fate of the New World has yet to be decided.
je_spanish_new_world_dummy_tt: We will have to decide between normalisation and the betterment of mutual relations between us and our former American colonies, or punish these nations as the rebels they are.
je_reconquista_reason: In our moment of greatest need, when the armies of the accursed marshal burned their way through our lands, ingrates and radicals of the lowest sort seized the opportunity to cast away the love and protection of their #italic madre patria#!.\n\nThese misguided fools must learn to know the consequences of their actions. For [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is eternal, and her domain over the New World will be restored.
je_reconquista_goal_tt: If you complete this [concept_journal_entry] before #v January 1, 1880#!, this [concept_modifier] will be #g indefinite#!
new_world_colonies_cooldown: Has not re-established an American colony in the past #bold year#!
button_reestablish_new_spain_desc: The first, and perhaps most important Spanish viceroyalty to be established, New Spain was founded in 1535 on the ruins of the old Aztec empire. Encompassing all of Spain's territories and claims in North America, it also held juristiction over the Caribbean and the Spanish territories in Asia.
button_reestablish_new_grenada_desc: Born in 1717 from the impracticalities of governing Spain's vast lands in the Caribbean basin and the northern Andes from Lima, the viceroyalty of New Grenada enjoyed a brief and troubled history. Lacking the vast mineral wealth of New Spain or Peru, the viceroyalty drew most of its revenues from agriculture and trade.
button_reestablish_peru_desc: The second oldest of Spain's viceroyalties, Peru once encompassed all Spanish-held territories in South America, and would bear witness to everything from the fall of the Inca Empire to the revolutions of the early 19th century. Traditionally known for its rich mineral wealth, by the 19th century its economy is mainly dominated by the agricultural sector.
button_reestablish_la_plata_desc: Established in 1776, the Viceroyalty of the River Plate was the final of its sort to come into existence before the collapse of Spanish authority on the New World. Stretching from the rich agricultural lands of the River Plate estuary to the famed silver mines of Potosí, it saw the concentration of some of the New World's greatest wealth.
button_reestablish_caribbean_desc: The Spanish Caribbean was where Spain first made landfall some four centuries ago, and it was here that Spanish rule persisted after the fall of the mainland.\n\nWith our rule restored on the mainland once more, we must decide the fate of our Caribbean administrations.
button_proclaim_independence_desc: The moon does not heed the barking of dogs. If we were to show the world that the might of the New World surpasses that of the Old, the judgement of our old, neglectful motherland would be of no consequence.
je_hispanoamerica_reason:
We will not waste men and resources in a futile attempt to restore what once was. Instead, cordiality and mutual benefit will define the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] relationship with her former colonies. We shall instruct our diplomats to draw up [Concept('concept_treaty','$concept_treaties$')] of Commerce and Friendship with our former subjects, sending a powerful message to the world of our magnanimity.

#b Formal Recognition#!
While [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]'s former colonies in the Americas achieved #italic de facto#! independence following the #b Spanish American Wars of Independence#! in the early 19th century, no #italic de jure#! recognition of this new status followed.

Until [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] formally recognizes the independence of her former colonies using the #b Recognize Independence#! [concept_treaty] [concept_article], bilateral diplomatic relations will remain #b severely hindered#!.
je_hispanoamerica_improve_relations: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] [concept_relations] with #b all former [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] colonies#! improves by #g 30#!
je_hispanoamerica_improve_leverage: If we are the leader of a [concept_power_bloc], [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] gains #positive_value 100#! [concept_power_bloc_leverage] in #b all former [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] colonies#!
je_spanish_american_independence_reason:
While [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] both appears and acts as a fully sovereign nation, our standing in the eyes of the world will forever remain uncertain as long as our former overlords withhold recognition. We should strive to establish good relations with Madrid, or present such a mighty visage to the world that none may dare to question our legitimacy.

#b Formal Recognition#!
While Spain's former colonies in the Americas achieved #italic de facto#! independence following the #b Spanish American Wars of Independence#! in the early 19th century, no #italic de jure#! recognition of this new status followed.

Until Spain formally recognizes the independence of her former colonies using the #b Recognize Independence#! [concept_treaty] [concept_article], bilateral diplomatic relations will remain #b severely hindered#!.
je_spanish_american_reconquista_tt: Should Spain pursue the idea of an #b American Reconquista#!, she will #b disgrace#! herself in the eyes of the international community, and we will lose this [concept_modifier]
je_spanish_american_optional_tt: If our [concept_relations] with [SCOPE.sCountry('spain_scope').GetName] are equal to or greater than #v 80#!, it will start a [SCOPE.sCountry('spain_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [concept_mass_migration] of to our nation
je_spanish_american_optional_tt_2: Since our [concept_relations] with [SCOPE.sCountry('spain_scope').GetName] is equal to or greater than #v 80#!, a [SCOPE.sCountry('spain_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [concept_mass_migration] will start to our nation
je_vernacular_policy_reason: For centuries, the [SCOPE.sCulture('official_culture_scope').GetName] [Concept('concept_homeland','$concept_homelands$')] have been home to many [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('getRegionalLanguagesType')]. Considered distinct cultures and languages in their own right by some and nothing but corrupted variants of true [SCOPE.sCulture('official_culture_scope').GetName] by others, their prevalence has sparked fierce discussions on the 'vernacular issue' in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName].\n\nWith some arguing that the nation cannot hope to be truly united before regionalism is stamped out, other counter with arguments that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] never has been, and never can be anything but an amalgamation of regional tongues and identities, none inherently superior to the other.
je_vernacular_policy_accept_catalan_butt: Formally recognize [GetCulture('catalan').GetName] as an accepted vernacular in administration, education, and public life.
je_vernacular_policy_accept_aragonese_bu: Formally recognize [GetCulture('aragonese').GetName] as an accepted vernacular in administration, education, and public life.
je_vernacular_policy_accept_asturleonese: Formally recognize [GetCulture('asturleonese').GetName] as an accepted vernacular in administration, education, and public life.
je_vernacular_policy_accept_galician_but: Formally recognize [GetCulture('galician').GetName] as an accepted vernacular in administration, education, and public life.
je_vernacular_policy_accept_basque_butto: Formally recognize [GetCulture('basque').GetName] as an accepted vernacular in administration, education, and public life.
je_vernacular_policy_accept_francoproven: Formally recognize [GetCulture('francoprovencal').GetName] as an accepted vernacular in administration, education, and public life.
je_vernacular_policy_accept_breton_butto: Formally recognize [GetCulture('breton').GetName] as an accepted vernacular in administration, education, and public life.
je_vernacular_policy_accept_occitan_butt: Formally recognize [GetCulture('occitan').GetName] as an accepted vernacular in administration, education, and public life.
je_vernacular_policy_accept_wallonian_bu: Formally recognize [GetCulture('wallonian').GetName] as an accepted vernacular in administration, education, and public life.
vernacular_events.1.t: On the Status of the Regional Tongues
vernacular_events.1.d: Arguing in favour of the universalisation of the [SCOPE.sCulture('official_culture_scope').GetName] language, prominent politicians and intellectuals have pushed for harsh assimilation measures targeting [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s regional language speakers.
vernacular_events.1.f: While it would be genuinely liberating for a single global language to exist, that is not politically feasible, but a single language inside the state would be a viable project.\n\n— Henri Grégoire, #italic Report on the Necessity and Means to Annihilate the Patois and to Universalise the Use of the French Language#!
vernacular_events.1.b: No. Work towards granting the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('getRegionalLanguagesType')] co-official status.
vernacular_events.1.c: Continue existing policy, no need to rock the boat.
vernacular_events.1.a_tt: We will attempt to #r assimilate#! the speakers of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('getRegionalLanguagesType')] and make good [SCOPE.sCulture('official_culture_scope').GetCustom('getPluralDemonym')] out of them. Doing so will reward us with #b powerful bonuses#! pertaining to the #b centralization#! and #b homogenization#! of our state
vernacular_events.1.b_tt: We will attempt to #g integrate#! the speakers of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('getRegionalLanguagesType')], rewarding us with additional [concept_primary_cultures]. This will require #b high cultural#! [concept_acceptance] and the fulfillment of various #b regional agendas#!
conquest_of_wallonia_tt: If we were to conquer [GetStateRegion('STATE_WALLONIA').GetName], it will become a [GetCulture('french').GetName] [concept_homeland]
vernacular_events.2.d: The assimilation efforts have borne fruits, and once-dominant [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCustom('getRegionalLanguagesType')] are now merely found on the lips of rural hermits and stubborn old crones.
vernacular_events.2.b_tt: The following modifier will be applied to all [SCOPE.sCulture('official_culture_scope').GetName] [concept_homeland] [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')]:
vernacular_events.3.d: With the status of regional languages of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] now recognized and protected by law, the country's uneasy relationship with regional identitarianism has been settled at last.
vernacular_events.3.f: Processing local petitions had never been an easy task, but after the introduction of the new regulations it had turned nightmarish. Any country bumpkin with a penny to his name was now sending their thoughts to him in writ: a confounded cacophony of words and expressions no gentleman of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] would ever deign to utter!\n\n'No' he thought to himself and shook his head. In the good old days, such men would never dare to engage with the state apparatus.
subject_interactions.1.d: There are several potential types of candidates that we can consider for the head of administration in [SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetName]. What type of leader are we looking for?
subject_interactions.1.b: Let us go with a [GetCharacterTrait('special_character_colonial_local').GetName]: Mr. [SCOPE.sCharacter('colonial_governor_local_scope').GetLastName].
subject_interactions.1.c: Award the office to Mr. [SCOPE.sCharacter('colonial_governor_extraction_scope').GetLastName], the [GetCharacterTrait('special_character_colonial_extraction').GetName].
subject_interactions.1.e: Mr. [SCOPE.sCharacter('colonial_governor_business_scope').GetLastName], the [GetCharacterTrait('special_character_colonial_business').GetName], is the best choice.
subject_interactions.2.d: It is in our right to correct issues in the governance of [SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetName]. The question is solely what sort of changes need to be made.
subject_interactions.2.f: The figures crowded around the table, exchanging dossiers. It was extraordinary—here they were, shuffling words around, and with a collective nod and stroke of the pen they were going to alter the very fabric of a nation.
subject_interactions.2.a: We shall change ruling parties in [SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetName].
subject_interactions.2.dd: We need to reform the markets of [SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetName].
subject_interactions.2.e: [SCOPE.sCountry('target_country').GetName] shall become the vanguard of the revolution!
subject_interactions.3.d: Deeming [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetLastName]'s handling of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] affairs inadequate, the political establishment of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] has requested that [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName] appoint a new governor more aligned with its objectives.
subject_interactions.3.b: Let us go with a [GetCharacterTrait('special_character_colonial_local').GetName]: Mr. [SCOPE.sCharacter('colonial_governor_local_scope').GetLastName].
subject_interactions.3.c: Award the office to Mr. [SCOPE.sCharacter('colonial_governor_extraction_scope').GetLastName], the [GetCharacterTrait('special_character_colonial_extraction').GetName].
subject_interactions.3.e: Mr. [SCOPE.sCharacter('colonial_governor_business_scope').GetLastName], the [GetCharacterTrait('special_character_colonial_business').GetName], is the best choice.
special_character_colonial_plantation_de: This character is a major colonial planter, deeply intertwined with the country's landowning elite.
special_character_colonial_local_desc: This character is a skilled administrator raised from the local political establishment.
special_character_colonial_extraction_de: This character is a business tycoon heavily involved in the country's extractive industries.
special_character_colonial_business_desc: This character is an influential business figure with strong ties to the world's wider financial networks.
special_character_colonial_military_desc: This character is an experienced military officer well-accustomed with service abroad.
notification_appointed_new_governor_noti: Citing administrative concerns, [SCOPE.sCountry('source_country').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] has replaced our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] with a new candidate.
notification_requested_new_governor_noti: The administration in [SCOPE.sCountry('source_country').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] has requested the appointment of a new [concept_ruler], reducing their [concept_liberty_desire].
spanish_events.1.d: Attempting to remedy centuries of diglossia, [GetCulture('catalan').GetName] intellectuals have started working towards the revival of Catalan as a literary and cultural language.
spanish_events.1.c: What is Spain but a union of peoples, united by the crown.
spanish_events.2.d: Attempting to remedy centuries of diglossia, [GetCulture('galician').GetName] intellectuals have started working towards the revival of Galician as a literary and cultural language.
spanish_events.2.c: What is Spain but a union of peoples, united by the crown.
spanish_events.3.d: Attempting to remedy centuries of diglossia, [GetCulture('asturleonese').GetName] intellectuals have started working towards the revival of Asturleonese as a literary and cultural language.
spanish_events.3.c: What is Spain but a union of peoples, united by the crown.
dominican_events.1.d: Meeting at a secret location, a group of revolutionaries known as the Trinitaria has announced their intentions to liberate [SCOPE.sState('santo_domingo_state_scope').GetName] from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] mismanagement.
dominican_events.1.a: I want these traitors found, and I want them hanged. Now!
dominican_events.1.b: Increase the funding of our eastern departments.
modifier_expanding_the_eastern_departmen: Expanding the Cibao and Ozama Departments
dominican_events.2.t: Rebels Seize the Puerta del Conde
dominican_events.2.d: Catching the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] garrison completely by surprise, a group of revolutionaries have stormed Santo Domingo's main fortress and raised the [SCOPE.sCountry('dominican_scope').GetAdjective] flag over its battlements, signalling the start of open hostilities against [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName].
dominican_events.2.f: In the shadow of Santo Domingo's great fortress, the conspirators waited. Far fewer than those who had solemnly pledged their name to the cause days prior, and far less boisterous now. Suddenly, a runner stumbled in, breathless:
dominican_events.2.a: Are we blind? Deploy the army!
dominican_events.3.d: Our integration efforts have borne fruit, and the once-powerful 'Trinitarian' revolutionaries in [SCOPE.sState('santo_domingo_state_scope').GetName] have lost most of their support base. The island is whole at last.
dominican_events.3.f:
To dominate a people is one thing, the aging general thought to himself. To win their hearts is another.

He had been able to do the former quite well. The fear of his fusillades had kept many an ansipiring rebel at home. But he had to admit he latter had always escaped him – a fact which [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetLastNameNoFormatting] was all too keen to remind him of.

As his battallion left the cantonment, ostensibly for the last time, he couldn't help but feel a pang of bitterness. The civilians may claim the glory of the peace as their own, but they owe their operational latitude to his methods.
dominican_events.3.a: Extend an olive branch to those willing to grasp it.
dominican_events.3.b: We must ensure nothing like it can emerge again.
dominican_events.4.d: [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] is free from Haitian tyranny at last, yet threats lurk around every corner. It may be wise to request the protection of a great power.
dominican_events.4.a: Our independence is absolute, it cannot be compromised.
dominican_events.4.b: We shall become a Captaincy General of [SCOPE.sCountry('spain_scope').GetName] once again.
dominican_events.4.c: The might of [SCOPE.sCountry('france_scope').GetName] will safeguard us.
dominican_events.5.d_1: Fearing for their safety, [SCOPE.sCountry('dominican_scope').GetName] has requested to once again become a Captaincy General of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
dominican_events.5.d_2: Fearing for their safety, [SCOPE.sCountry('dominican_scope').GetName] has requested the establishment of a [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] protectorate over the country, offering up the Samana peninsula on a hundred year lease.
dominican_events.5.b: Turn them down. This would just mean trouble.
samana_lease_tt: The #bold Samana Peninsula#! will be leased as a [concept_treaty_port] for #v 100#! years in exchange for an annual payment of @money!#v 2000#!
je_la_trinitaria_reason: The union of Hispaniola's western and eastern part; [SCOPE.sState('haiti_state_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sState('santo_domingo_state_scope').GetName], has not been a happy one. Established through force of arms in 1822, it initially enjoyed some limited support from select elites and Afro-Dominicans. However, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]'s policies of heavy taxation, land redistribution, and mass confiscations, combined with anti-Catholic practices and general mismanagement, would soon turn the majority of the population against rule from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName].\n\nUnless decisive steps are taken, this discontent is likely to materialize as an armed insurrection in the near future.
dominican_movement_suppressed_tt: No #v $movement_dominican_national$#! exists with [Concept('concept_activism','$concept_activism_short$')] of $RADICALISM_AGITATING$ (#v 25%#!) or above
je_conquest_of_tetouan_reason:
The last straw to break the camel's back has been pulled by the Anjeran tribesmen local to the [SelectLocalization(SCOPE.sState('al_rif').IsValid, SCOPE.sState('al_rif').GetName, 'STATE_AL_RIF')] region. They recently carried out a bloody raid on one of our border garrisons.

The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] and local subjects of the region demand retribution against these marauders beyond the border to [SelectLocalization(SCOPE.sCountry('morocco_scope').IsValid, SCOPE.sCountry('morocco_scope').GetName, 'MOR')].

Our national stature will significantly deteriorate if military measures aren't taken promptly.
je_western_saharan_conquest_reason: After the victory in [SCOPE.sStateRegion('al_rif_scope').GetName], a strategic location beyond the horizon has been identified by the experienced generals of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName]. Along with its natural resources, this part of Africa will surely aid us in our mission to reclaim the prestige we once possessed.
je_guinean_conquest_reason: Reinforcing the coastal security of Western Africa and its isolated areas has rekindled our ambition to reclaim our imperial status as a significant power on the continent.\n\nWe need to push forward and expand our influence along the coasts of [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_subsaharan_africa').GetName], as our imperial competitors are also eager to profit from the region's riches.
je_moroccan_conquest_reason: Given the success of our recent initiatives in Africa, officials agree that our efforts would be truly fulfilled by acquiring the territories beyond the $strait_gibraltar$.\n\nThey also warn us that it would present a new challenge to subdue its inhabitants under our rule, even after conquering the official lands, considering the numerous tribal communities separated from central politics. Nevertheless, we'll turn this part of the Maghreb into our backyard beyond Andalusia by accomplishing this task.
je_guinean_conquest_complete_tt: At least #v 3#! [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_subsaharan_africa').GetName] are owned by [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] or any of her #v $colonial$#! [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')]
revoke_fernando_po: Revoke the Lease of Fernando Po
revoke_fernando_po_desc: Having officially claimed the island in 1778, we have the right to demand Great Britain to abandon its hold over it. We shall send an envoy, and hear their response.
revoke_fernando_po_tt: Sends a formal demand for #v $GBR$#! to revoke their lease on the island of #b Fernando Po#!. If they accept, we will take control of the island immediately. If they refuse, our [concept_relations] with them will deteriorate heavily, and they will receive an international diplomatic blow.
spanish_africa.1.d: Tribesmen of [SCOPE.sState('al_rif_state_scope').GetName] has been relentlessly raiding our side of the border, harassing travellers and caravans. Their assault on a military garrison was the final straw. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] insist that this is the perfect moment to take long-awaited action against [SCOPE.sCountry('rif_enemy_scope').GetName].
spanish_africa.1.f: Overlooking the encampment in his saddle, Chief Rashan assessed dim prospects while dusk nearly concealed their presence on this side of the hill.\n\n
spanish_africa.1.a: Let us demonstrate who we are.
spanish_africa.1.a_tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] and their supporters will expect us or one of our subjects to own [SCOPE.sStateRegion('al_rif_scope').GetName] within 10 years. Failing to achieve this will reduce our [concept_legitimacy] and their [concept_approval], and foster [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] within their ranks. Conversely, succeeding will put us on better terms with them and boost our [concept_prestige].
spanish_africa.1.b: We must not kindle the fire.
spanish_africa.2.d: Subduing [SCOPE.sStateRegion('al_rif_scope').GetName] and ensuring our dominance over the northern coast has reassured our people. However, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] seek further glory. They urge us to shift our focus southward, toward the wild expanse of [SCOPE.sState('west_sahara_state_scope').GetName].
spanish_africa.2.f: Vendors and workshops in Tetouan, run by local families for generations, felt a collective uneasiness about the future of their businesses. Even before the Spaniards' official arrival, bazaars were affected by the idea of the industrious juggernauts hailing from northern countries with their mass-produced goods.\n\nThey quickly realized that endlessly increasing taxes issued by the Makhzen or inflating local economies should've been the least of their concerns, compared to what might await them under the 'protection' of the Andalusians.
spanish_africa.2.a: No point in stopping now, let us keep the momentum.
spanish_africa.2.a_tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] and their supporters will expect us or one of our subjects to own [SCOPE.sStateRegion('west_sahara_scope').GetName] within 10 years. Failing to achieve this will reduce our [concept_legitimacy] and their [concept_approval], and foster [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] within their ranks. Conversely, succeeding will put us on better terms with them and boost our [concept_prestige].
spanish_africa.2.b: We should rather settle and focus on our internal struggles.
spanish_africa.3.d: With [SCOPE.sState('west_sahara_scope').GetName] brought under our rule, we have obtained a new foothold that can be utilized to connect the mainland to the core of Africa. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] urge us to keep up our present momentum by expanding our presence South of the Sahara.
spanish_africa.3.f:
Accustomed to nomadic traditions, some clans could not envision living under the rule of infidels and began their hijra toward the vast ocean that is the Sahara.

Among them was Banu Khezzan, a small group of families with herds to protect. Unaware of the political complexities of recent events, Saleeh, a young member of the clan, felt something difficult to articulate in his small mind.

Something that reeked of vengeance and fury toward those who had forced him to move once again.
spanish_africa.3.a_tt: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] and their supporters will expect us to have at least 3 [Concept('concept_colony','$concept_colonies$')] in [GetGeographicRegion('geographic_region_subsaharan_africa').GetName] within 10 years. Failing to achieve this will reduce our [concept_legitimacy] and their [concept_approval], and foster [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] within their ranks. Conversely, succeeding will put us on better terms with them and boost our [concept_prestige].
spanish_africa.3.b: We must not stray too far from our homelands.
spanish_africa.4.d: Emboldened by the success of our recent forays into Africa, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] suggest maneuvering our now-experienced soldiers to seize control of what is between the mainland and [SCOPE.sState('west_sahara_scope').GetName].
spanish_africa.4.a_tt:
The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] and their supporters will expect us to make [SCOPE.sCountry('morocco_scope').GetName] our [concept_subject] or own the following [Concept('concept_state_region','$concept_state_regions$')] within 10 years:
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('al_rif_scope').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('fez_scope').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('inner_morocco_scope').GetName]
• [SCOPE.sStateRegion('marrakech_scope').GetName]
Failing to achieve this will reduce our [concept_legitimacy] and their [concept_approval], and foster [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] within their ranks. Conversely, succeeding will put us on better terms with them and boost our [concept_prestige].
spanish_africa.4.b: We should not act on the whims of soldiers.
spanish_africa.5.d: At long last, we have taken the Rock of Gibraltar back from the $GBR_ADJ$, restoring the $strait_gibraltar$ as an integral part of our dominions. The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has declared a new national holiday to celebrate the reconquest.
spanish_africa.5.f:
#italic Plus Ultra#!—With this motto, the Spanish Empire had always aspired to an unimaginable journey across all coasts beyond its peninsular homelands.

#italic Further Beyond#!—In the esteemed Latin tongue, its meaning signifies our duty as a nation to uphold the gates of wonder and courage for those who wish to take risks and strive for excellence beyond the Mediterranean.

Once again, we are the rightful guardians of the East and West.
spanish_africa.6.d: An envoy from [SCOPE.sCountry('spain_scope').GetName] has been awaiting our diplomatic response regarding a request to surrender [SCOPE.sState('fernando_po_scope').GetName], asserting their claim as the rightful owners of the island.
spanish_africa.6.f:
Even as an experienced one, the diplomat from [SCOPE.sCountry('spain_scope').GetNameNoFormatting]'s arrival in [SCOPE.sState('gbr_capital_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] for the first time was an unforgettable memory. From bustling boulevards to neatly walled parks and intricately built bridges, there was something awe-inspiring about this place, unlike any other, he thought.

Unfortunately, it was not the time to linger, as the appointment was set for the same day.

The message was clear; and his [SCOPE.sCountry('spain_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] would hardly accept a refusal for an answer.
spanish_africa.6.a: They have the right, evacuate the island.
spanish_africa.6.a_tt: We will let [SCOPE.sCountry('spain_scope').GetName] know that the lease is revoked.
spanish_africa.6.b_tt: [SCOPE.sCountry('spain_scope').GetName] will soon receive the news of our refusal.
spanish_africa.7.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('gbr_scope').GetName] has accepted our request to revoke the lease of [SCOPE.sState('fernando_po_scope').GetName]. [SCOPE.sCountry('gbr_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] forces will soon withdraw from the island.
spanish_africa.8.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('gbr_scope').GetName] has rejected our request to revoke the lease of [SCOPE.sState('fernando_po_scope').GetName].
spanish_africa.8.f: #bold Agnign#!—an expression the indigenous people of [SCOPE.sState('fernando_po_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] uses, roughly translates to the European tongues as
spanish_africa.9.d: Our great nation has successfully achieved all the goals set concerning Africa. Who knows what lies beyond the horizon now?
spanish_africa.9.f: Today was an extraordinary day for the field commander—one that would fill his remaining years with pride and glory for his country.\n\nNothing compares to the recognition that comes with a successful service to one's country and the honor of receiving a medal after a challenging campaign, particularly overseas.
spanish_africa.9.b: We have something tangible to promote here.
spanish_africa.9.c: Let's dedicate the victory to our people.
spanish_africa.10.d: Failing to achieve our expansionist prospects in Africa have made the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('armed_forces_scope').GetName] and its supporters intensely agitated.
further_events_upon_researching_civilisi: Further opportunities will manifest upon developing a [GetInstitutionType('institution_colonial_affairs').GetName] [concept_institution], and researching #v $civilizing_mission$#!
je_global_test_reason: The presence of numerous feral Lippes is making investors nervous, we have to ensure all Lippes are properly cared for or else the global economy will collapse.
annex_a_lippe_desc: We shall assume responsibility for the care and feeding of a Lippe in the interests of global order.
pay_lippe_service_desc: Announce our loud and belligerent support for the cause of the orphaned and downtrodden Lippes.

You have successfully changed your education law to secular giving you the $modifier_religious_schools_abolished_intelligentsia$ and $modifier_religious_schools_abolished_devout$ modifiers.
