ideology_moderate_desc: #lore This leader is considered a moderate in their Interest Group, with no particular ideology of their own.#!
ideology_traditionalist_desc: #lore This leader believes in maintaining traditional customs, viewing them as an extension of natural laws. #!
ideology_traditionalist_minoritarian_des: #lore This leader believes in maintaining traditional customs, viewing them as an extension of natural laws. Whilst their country remains under the rule of a different religion, they will oppose imposing the state religion upon the populace. #!
ideology_nihilist_desc: #lore This leader prioritizes the questioning and overturning of traditionalist social order and institutions at all costs, seeking to clear the ground for a comprehensively revolutionary society. #!
ideology_republican_leader_desc: #lore This leader seeks to establish a republic ruled by elected officials. #!
ideology_radical_desc: #lore This leader strives for radical liberal reforms advancing democratic ideals. #!
ideology_abolitionist_desc: #lore This leader finds slavery an abhorrent violation of human rights and seeks to abolish it from the world. #!
ideology_slaver_desc: #lore This leader views slavery as a natural part of their way of life and opposes its abolition. #!
ideology_feminist_desc: #lore This leader holds that women are equal to men and strives for the extension of their rights as citizens.#!
ideology_reformer_desc: #lore This leader wants to make a few incremental changes to make society just a bit more equal. But not too much.#!
ideology_pacifist_desc: #lore This leader believes in non-violence as their method and peace as their goal.#!
ideology_jingoist_leader_desc: #lore This leader advocates an aggressive foreign policy, emphasizing readiness to go to war to advance its ambitions. #!
ideology_royalist_desc: #lore This leader's loyalties are to the monarchy and its rightful ruler.#!
ideology_social_democrat_desc: #lore This leader believes in achieving a socialist society through parliamentary reform. #!
ideology_communist_desc: #lore This leader believes in the working class seizing political power through whatever means necessary. #!
ideology_vanguardist_desc: #lore This leader believes in achieving a socialist society through a vanguard party of dedicated radicals. #!
ideology_fascist_desc: #lore This leader is an ultranationalist who espouses the revival of perceived traditional, authoritarian values in a modern context. #!
ideology_anarchist_desc: #lore This leader seeks the abolishment of hierarchy, authority and the state, leaving people to govern themselves. #!
ideology_ethno_nationalist_desc: #lore This leader believes in a nation defined on ethnic grounds. #!
ideology_theocrat_desc: #lore This leader believes in a state run by the church in line with doctrinal values.#!
ideology_market_liberal_desc: #lore This leader believes that the invisible hand of the free market should be the guiding force of the nation's economy.#!
ideology_liberal_leader_desc: #lore This leader prioritizes the institution of democracy and opposes uncontested rule over the nation. #!
ideology_carlist_desc: #lore This leader upholds the line of Infante Carlos' claim to the Spanish throne, supporting a traditionalist monarchy and rejecting modernist notions of popular sovereignty and constitutionalism. #!
ideology_miguelist_desc: #lore This leader supports an absolute monarchy founded upon Catholic values. They reject the outcome of the Liberal Wars, which removed the traditionalist King Miguel I from the throne of Portugal. #!
ideology_ilustrado_leader_desc: #lore This erudite leader seeks secularization of the parishes in the Philippines, as well as political and economic reforms that are equitable to all. #!
ideology_despotic_utopian_desc: #lore This character believes in a society influenced by the principles of the Enlightenment, but where an autocratic government acts in the best interests of the people.#!
ideology_authoritarian_desc: #lore This character believes that great nations need strong leaders, and that they are uniquely qualified for the position.#!
ideology_humanitarian_desc: #lore This character is an advocate for the human race. Every man, woman, and child should be guaranteed a set of inalienable and non-negotiable rights by the state.#!
ideology_protectionist_desc: #lore This character believes that domestic industries and international trade should be closely monitored and regulated by the state.#!
ideology_humanitarian_royalist_desc: #lore This character believes that the ideal form of society is a radically egalitarian nation ruled by an enlightened and humanist monarch.#!
ideology_orleanist_desc: This leader sees the merits of a restrained monarch, and champions a French constitution fit for such purpose.
ideology_legitimist_desc: This leader yearns for the French kings of old, before the Reign of Terror sullied everything.
ideology_bonapartist_desc: This leader would see a new Bonaparte lead France into a new era of unquestioned might.
ideology_land_reformer_desc: This character is committed to breaking the power of large landowners and redistributing land to be worked by the common people.
ideology_sovereignist_leader_desc: This leader opposes oppressive measures imposed upon their nation by colonial authorities, preferring policies that serve the ends of national self-governance.
ideology_utopian_desc: This leader seeks the establishment of a socialist society founded upon the principles of egalitarianism, rationalism, and communal ownership.
ideology_utilitarian_leader_desc: #lore This leader believes it is an important function of the government to pursue the common good, be it through basic liberties or benevolent despotism.#!
ideology_mitogaku_desc: #lore This leader is an adherent of Mito studies, a patriotic academic and political doctrine originating from the Mito domain. They revere the Emperor as ruler of the world, and seek to reform Japan in order to resist foreign encroachment.#!
ideology_shojoi_desc: #lore This leader desires the immediate expulsion of foreigners from the country, and supports the unilateral abrogation of any commercial treaties with foreign powers.#!
ideology_sikh_militancy_desc: #lore The Sikh have a militarized movement that will support having a strong national army.#!
ideology_sikh_moralist_desc: #lore The Sikh believe all have an equal connection with God and respect the practice of other faiths.#!
ideology_montenegrin_moralist_desc: #lore This group has a strong belief in a religious moral order and views diversity of opinion as a threat to this order.#!
ideology_colonialist_desc: This group represents a colonial interest reliant upon the continuous extraction of wealth from their territory, and favors the maintenance of this system over independent economic development.
ideology_sovereignist_desc: This group opposes oppressive measures imposed upon it by colonial authorities, preferring policies that serve the ends of national self-governance.
ideology_austrian_hegemony_desc: #lore This group believes that Austrians alone should form the social and political elite of the country.#!
ideology_patriarchal_suffrage_desc: #lore This group believes men should have political authority and that women should obey their fathers and husbands, but have accepted women's right to work and vote.#!
ideology_feminist_ig_desc: #lore This group holds that women are equal to men and strives for maintaining their rights as citizens.#!
ideology_constitutionalist_desc: #lore This group believes in constitutional rule and the role of strong democratic institutions in statecraft.#!
ideology_socialist_desc: #lore This group has committed itself to socialist ideology, advocating for ownership of the means of production and the dismantling of capitalism.#!
ideology_paternalistic_desc: #lore This group has little faith in the populace attempting to govern itself, believing they need the guidance of a traditional aristocracy.#!
ideology_magnatial_desc: #lore This group has a long tradition of parliamentary governance, favoring cooperation between the monarchy and an elected chamber dominated by a landed elite.#!
ideology_carlist_ig_desc: #lore This group supports a traditionalist monarchy, rejecting modernist notions of popular sovereignty and constitutionalism. #!
ideology_moderantist_desc: #lore This group has adopted a moderate liberal outlook, favoring cooperation between the monarchy and an elected chamber dominated by the landowning oligarchy.#!
ideology_patriarchal_desc: #lore This group believes men should have political authority and that women should obey their fathers and husbands.#!
ideology_republican_desc: #lore This group believes the best leaders are elected by public vote and supports a republican form of government.#!
ideology_populist_desc: #lore This group believes in governance by the people and seeks to expand the franchise to all social classes.#!
ideology_hierarchic_desc: #lore This group favors maintaining a hierarchy in society through traditional forms of taxation and labor relations.#!
ideology_oligarchic_desc: #lore This group favors monopolizing power in the hands of a secular state controlled by local oligarchies.#!
ideology_laissez_faire_desc: #lore This group believes in the free flow of trade and labor forces, favoring the judgment of markets over that of governments.#!
ideology_interventionist_desc: #lore This group supports close cooperation between the state and private enterprise, favoring policy that actively invests in industrial development.#!
ideology_individualist_desc: #lore This group believes each person is responsible for their own fate and opposes government programs to provide services that can be paid for by the individual.#!
ideology_pious_desc: #lore This group believes religious principles are paramount moral truths and that they should permeate all of society.#!
ideology_particularist_desc: #lore This group wants local autonomy in their work, free of feudal provisions of indentured servitude.#!
ideology_isolationist_desc: #lore This group wants the state to focus on domestic matters, opposing ambitions to expand into foreign lands as well as immigration from them.#!
ideology_moralist_desc: #lore This group has a strong belief in a religious moral order and views diversity of opinion as a threat to this order.#!
ideology_jingoist_desc: #lore This group believes in an aggressive foreign policy and maintaining an army to back it up.#!
ideology_loyalist_desc: #lore This group believes each citizen should pay their dues to fund the vital functions of the state.#!
ideology_meritocratic_desc: #lore This group believes success is earned and that those who have achieved it deserve the accompanying responsibility and wealth.#!
ideology_patriotic_desc: #lore This group is fiercely devoted to its country and wants harsh measures against those who would spread dissent.#!
ideology_military_absolutist_desc: #lore This group supports harsh measures against those who threaten the stability of the state, and denounces parliamentary rule as an impediment to this end.#!
ideology_liberal_desc: #lore This group views liberty and legal equality as important values to be safeguarded.#!
ideology_anti_clerical_desc: #lore This group opposes the influence of organized religion on the political and education system. They believe that rational minds should be at the forefront of governance.#!
ideology_proletarian_desc: #lore This group views politics through the lens of class struggle and sides with the workers in this conflict.#!
ideology_egalitarian_desc: #lore This group believes that equal and humane treatment of people should be a cornerstone of political policy.#!
ideology_anti_slavery_desc: #lore This group abhors slavery and views it as a feature of a barbarous past.#!
ideology_pro_slavery_desc: #lore This group views slavery as a necessary part of a well-functioning society.#!
ideology_pro_slavery_colonial_desc: #lore This group views slavery as a necessary and profitable component of colonial economies.#!
ideology_reactionary_desc: #lore This group is nostalgic for a past, real or imagined, where just kings ruled over a uniform society.#!
ideology_plutocratic_desc: #lore This group believes that the wealthy have proven their worth as decision-makers and form an intellectual elite well suited to set the course of society.#!
ideology_agrarian_desc: #lore This group believes the focus of economic policy should be on agriculture and the interests of farmers.#!
ideology_corporatist_desc: #lore This group believes in the resolution of conflict between classes through the application of religious principles.#!
ideology_corporatist_leader_desc: #lore This leader believes in the resolution of class conflict through concessions from the upper class and collaboration between different social groups.#!
ideology_agrarian_jeffersonian_desc: #lore This group believes that the smallholding farmer class forms the foundation of the country, supporting agrarianism as the basis for a free society.#!
ideology_isolationist_expansionism_desc: #lore This group fervently opposes immigration into the country. They are however enthusiastic about settling in newly seized territories.#!
ideology_utilitarian_millian_desc: #lore This group believes that governmental functions should be codified and rationalized in order to promote the common good.#!
ideology_republican_paternalistic_desc: #lore This group favors rule by the landed elite, but still supports a republican form of government.#!
ideology_scholar_paternalistic_desc: #lore This group would prefer to see the country ruled by a monarch advised by the wise and educated.#!
ideology_junker_paternalistic_desc: #lore This group believes the landed nobility are best suited to lead the country to its future.#!
ideology_papal_paternalistic_desc: #lore This group supports the authority of the Pope and the traditional hierarchy of the Holy See.#!
ideology_confucian_desc: #lore This group believes in the teachings of Confucius, supporting a social order they view as rooted in the laws of Heaven.#!
ideology_bakufu_desc: #lore This group supports the shogunate and believes power belongs in the hands of the warrior class.#!
ideology_shinto_moralist_desc: #lore This group believes in the divinity of the Emperor and ties this belief to the old worship of gods and spirits.#!
ideology_caudillismo_desc: #lore This group tends to support strongman leaders with military backgrounds over constitutional rule of law.#!
ideology_heavenly_kingdom_theocratic_des: #lore This group supports the idea that all people become sons and daughters of God when redeemed by Christ, and favors a theocratic form of government.#!
ideology_papal_moralist_desc: #lore This group has a strong devotion to maintaining both the temporal and ecclesiastical powers of the Catholic Church.#!
ideology_liberal_modern_desc: #lore This group views liberty and legal equality as important values to be safeguarded.#!
ideology_egalitarian_modern_desc: #lore This group believes that equal and humane treatment of people should be a cornerstone of political policy.#!
ideology_enclavist_desc: #lore This group's interests lie in preserving its position as a colonial ruling class, secluding itself from its subjects and preserving its power by means of an intricate and unaccountable bureaucratic system.#!
ideology_malthusian_desc: #lore This group subscribes to the economic theories established by Thomas Malthus, believing any effort to alleviate poverty to be made self-defeating due to consequent population growth.#!
ideology_ibadi_shura_desc: #lore This group believes that good jurisprudence is based on the Islamic principle of #italic shura#!, consultation and collective decision-making, and that the foundation of any solid government relies on the support and deliberation of learned scholars and landowning notables.#!
ideology_ibadi_imamate_desc: #lore This group supports the leadership of an #italic Imam#!, and promotes the political supremacy of the Imamate and an ideal political-religious order.#!
ideology_technocratic_desc: #lore This group supports the reordering of the social system along scientific lines, favoring technocratic governance and a rationalized economy.#!
ideology_cartist_desc: #lore This group values national stability, and upholds the moderate form of liberalism embodied by the Portuguese Constitutional Charter of 1826 towards this end.#!
ideology_regenerator_desc: #lore This group desires to restore Portugal's previous status as a prestigious power. It is committed to radical institutional reform to realize this goal.#!
liberal_and_egalitarian_amended_tt: The [GetIdeology('ideology_liberal').GetName] and [GetIdeology('ideology_egalitarian').GetName] [Concept('concept_ideology','$concept_ideologies$')]' stances on the $lawgroup_rights_of_women$ will change
carlist_amended_tt: The [GetIdeology('ideology_carlist').GetName] [concept_ideology]'s stances on the $lawgroup_economic_system$ and $lawgroup_distribution_of_power$ will change
miguelist_amended_tt: The [GetIdeology('ideology_miguelist').GetName] [concept_ideology]'s stances on the $lawgroup_economic_system$ and $lawgroup_distribution_of_power$ will change
ideology_russian_patriarch_desc: #lore The Orthodox Patriarchy sees itself as one of the three pillars of the country, that the Tsar is above all and that the peasants deserve be serfs.#!
ideology_orthodox_patriarch_desc: #lore The Orthodox Patriarchy sees itself as one of the three pillars of the country, and that the right to rule comes from God.#!
ideology_buddhist_moralist_desc: #lore The Buddhist path is clearly set out and that the theocracy is required to best guide the nation down the path it its teachings.#!
ideology_hindu_moralist_desc: #lore Hindu Priests believe that bureaucrats should adhere to the caste system.#!
ideology_hindu_moralist_british_india_de: #lore Hindu Priests favor upholding the traditional Hindu caste system. Whilst India remains ruled by foreigners, they staunchly oppose the colonial government imposing their religion upon the populace.#!
ideology_oriental_orthodox_patriarch_des: #lore The Oriental Orthodox Patriarchy believe that children's education should be a priority for the nation.#!
ideology_ilustrado_desc: #lore The Ilustrados are an educated class committed to the secularization of the parishes, as well as political and economic reforms that are equitable to all.#!
ideology_liberal_praetorian_desc: #lore This group believes that the armed forces has a right and a duty to intervene in politics in order to promote and defend select liberal values.#!
ideology_conservative_praetorian_desc: #lore This group believes that the armed forces has a right and a duty to intervene in politics in order to promote and defend select conservative values.#!
ideology_rangaku_desc: #lore This group supports an end to international isolation, and favors the adoption of Western practices of governance.#!
ideology_mercantile_desc: #lore This group desires a legal apparatus that grants recognition and support to commercial interests.#!
ideology_japan_hierarchic_desc: #lore This group upholds the Edo #italic bakuhan#! system, in which self-governing Daimyō domains share power with the ruling Shogunate.#!
ideology_anti_slavery_movement_desc: #lore This movement abhors slavery and views it as a feature of a barbarous past.#!
ideology_pro_slavery_movement_desc: #lore This movement views slavery as a necessary part of a well-functioning society, and supports the institutions that uphold it.#!
ideology_pro_slavery_colonial_movement_d: #lore This group views slavery as a profitable component of colonial economies, and supports the institutions that uphold it.#!
ideology_absolutist_movement_desc: #lore This movement is loyal to the institution of the monarchy, and supports vesting it with absolute power.#!
ideology_royalist_movement_desc: #lore This movement's loyalties are to the monarchy and its rightful ruler.#!
ideology_proletarian_movement_desc: #lore This movement views politics through the lens of class struggle, supporting better conditions and increased political influence for workers.#!
ideology_socialist_movement_desc: #lore This movement supports workers' ownership of the means of production and the dismantling of the capitalist system.#!
ideology_communist_movement_desc: #lore This movement believes in the working class seizing political power through whatever means necessary.#!
ideology_anarchist_movement_desc: #lore This movement seeks the abolition of hierarchy, authority and the state, leaving people to govern themselves.#!
ideology_vanguardist_movement_desc: #lore This movement seeks to achieve a socialist society through a revolution headed by a vanguard party of dedicated radicals.#!
ideology_fascist_movement_desc: #lore This movement seeks the establishment of a totalitarian state founded upon corporatist principles, and the revival of perceived traditional, authoritarian values in a modern context.#!
ideology_integralist_movement_desc: #lore This movement desires a return to traditionalist Catholic values in governance, and rejects conventional conservatism and parliamentarianism.#!
ideology_corporatist_movement_desc: #lore This movement supports the resolution of class conflict through concessions from the upper class and collaboration between different social groups.#!
ideology_liberal_movement_desc: #lore This movement values the institution of democracy, and supports guaranteeing essential freedoms for citizens. #!
ideology_liberal_republican_movement_des: #lore This movement holds democratic and republican ideals, and supports guaranteeing essential freedoms for citizens. #!
ideology_radical_movement_desc: #lore This movement strives for radical liberal reforms advancing democratic ideals. #!
ideology_nihilist_movement_desc: #lore This movement prioritizes the questioning and overturning of traditionalist social order and institutions at all costs, seeking to clear the ground for a comprehensively revolutionary society.#!
ideology_positivist_movement_desc: #lore This movement supports a society founded upon technocratic and anticlericalist lines, disdaining both the arbitrary power of monarchs and the fickle whims of the public.#!
ideology_land_reformer_movement_desc: #lore This movement is committed to breaking the power of large landowners, and redistributing land to be worked by the common people.#!
ideology_feminist_movement_desc: #lore This movement holds that women are equal to men, and strives for the extension of their rights as citizens.#!
ideology_reactionary_movement_desc: #lore This movement seeks to restore a past, real or imagined, where just kings ruled over a uniform society.#!
ideology_modernizer_movement_1_desc: #lore This movement is strongly invested in modernizing and centralizing the nation under rational lines.#!
ideology_modernizer_movement_2_desc: #lore This movement is strongly invested in modernizing and centralizing the nation under rational lines.#!
ideology_traditionalist_movement_desc: #lore This movement seeks to maintain traditional customs, viewing them as an extension of natural laws.#!
ideology_traditionalist_minoritarian_mov: #lore This movement seeks to advance the station of their religion within society, both protecting its followers from discrimination and seeking to uphold its traditional customs.#!
ideology_ethno_nationalist_movement_desc: #lore This movement desires a nation defined on ethnic grounds, within which the supremacy of the dominant ethnicity is legally enshrined.#!
ideology_pluralist_movement_1_desc: #lore This movement wishes to safeguard their cultural traditions, identity and language. #!
ideology_sovereignist_movement_desc: #lore This movement opposes oppressive measures imposed upon their nation by colonial authorities, and seeks to advance policies that serve the ends of national self-governance.#!
ideology_utilitarian_movement_desc: #lore This movement supports codifying and rationalizing government functions in order to promote the common good.#!
ideology_orleanist_movement_desc: #lore This movement supports the house of Orléans' claim to the French throne, desiring a constitutional order under a restrained monarch.#!
ideology_bonapartist_movement_desc: #lore This movement supports the restoration of a Bonaparte to the French throne, and a new Emperor to lead France into a new era of unquestioned might.#!
ideology_legitimist_movement_desc: #lore This movement yearns for the time of the French kings of old, before the Reign of Terror sullied everything.#!
ideology_national_liberal_movement_desc: #lore This movement wishes to unify its culture's homelands under a nation-state founded upon liberal values.#!
ideology_carlist_movement_desc: #lore This movement upholds the line of Infante Carlos' claim to the Spanish throne, supporting a traditionalist monarchy and rejecting modernist notions of popular sovereignty and constitutionalism#!
ideology_miguelist_movement_desc: This movement supports an absolute monarchy founded upon Catholic values. They reject the outcome of the Liberal Wars, which removed the traditionalist King Miguel I from the throne of Portugal.
ideology_slave_revolt_movement_desc: #lore This movement is made up of slaves that wish to emancipate themselves by force of arms.#!
ideology_meiji_restorationist_movement_s: #lore This movement seeks to overthrow the ruling Shogunate, restore the power of the Emperor, and carry out the immediate expulsion of foreign interests from Japan.#!
ideology_meiji_restorationist_movement_d: #lore This movement seeks to overthrow the ruling Shogunate, restore the power of the Emperor, and make use of Western methods to develop Japan's military and economic strength.#!
ideology_tokugawa_loyalist_movement_desc: #lore This movement supports the strict Edo class hierarchy, with a privileged position for the Samurai and primacy for the Shogunate.#!
lawgroup_governance_principles_desc: The foundational principles and authority by which your country is governed. Determines who the Head of State is.
law_chiefdom_desc: A hierarchical pre-industrial political system based on kinship, with a warlord or elder of a prominent family at the head. It is incapable of efficient centralized control over entire states.
law_monarchy_desc: A form of governance where an aristocratic dynasty represents the country's national identity and yields executive powers to the royal head of the dynasty.
law_presidential_republic_desc: A political system where power is held by the people and their elected representatives. Republics have an elected or nominated $RULER_TITLE_PRESIDENT$ as Head of State.
law_parliamentary_republic_desc: A political system where power is held by the people and their elected representatives. The leader of the legislature acts as the Head of State and is referred to as $RULER_TITLE_CHANCELLOR$.
law_theocracy_desc: The government is ruled by a clergy and their interpretation of holy scripture. The Head of State is nominally the person of worship, though in practice a worldly representative selected by merit, status, or birth.
law_council_republic_desc: A political system where workers elect delegates to local councils. Extends concepts of workplace organization to general governance.
law_corporate_state_desc: A political system based around institutionalized collaboration between officially recognized corporate groups. The state serves as a forum for negotiation between different social classes.
law_colonial_administration_desc: The state is legally an administrative sub-division of a foreign power, possessing no sovereignty of its own. It is delegated powers with which to administer a given territory on the behalf of the metropole.
law_social_monarchy_desc: A political system in which the state positions itself as the ultimate mediator between the nation's corporate groups. The monarchy is held to be a symbol of the country's national identity.
lawgroup_free_speech_desc: Laws regulating free speech and right to public assembly.
law_outlawed_dissent_desc: Criticizing the government is considered treasonous and illegal.
law_censorship_desc: There is active censorship of the press and no guaranteed right of assembly.
law_right_of_assembly_desc: Citizens enjoy the right to public assembly.
law_protected_speech_desc: The protection of free speech is enshrined in law.
lawgroup_army_model_desc: How your army is organized and regulated.
law_peasant_levies_desc: The army's main force comes from conscripted infantry with zero to basic training.
law_national_militia_desc: The standing army is small, but local militias can be activated to defend their homes.
law_mass_conscription_desc: Large numbers of infantry conscripts can be activated as needed to supplement the professional army.
law_professional_army_desc: The army consists of well-trained, professional regulars.
lawgroup_navy_model_desc: Organization and doctrine of your naval forces.
law_merchant_navy_desc: The fleet is focused on the propagation and protection of overseas trade and supply.
law_jeune_ecole_desc: A naval model prioritizing the use of smaller, heavily armed ships to combat a larger enemy.
law_professional_navy_desc: Focused on the construction and maintenance of a mighty battlefleet in order to impress and deter rivals.
law_diplomatic_navy_desc: Prioritizing long-range cruising in order to build and maintain a global diplomatic presence.
lawgroup_distribution_of_power_desc: How political power is distributed. Determines who the Head of State is accountable to.
law_autocracy_desc: The Head of State's power is absolute and they are held accountable to no earthly power.
law_oligarchy_desc: The Head of State shares power and responsibility with a small group of powerful, unelected individuals.
law_landed_voting_desc: Those who own land or capital property are given a vote.
law_wealth_voting_desc: Wealthy citizens are granted a vote. Men of more wealth are granted more votes.
law_census_voting_desc: Literate men of particular status is given a vote.
law_universal_suffrage_desc: Every adult man is given an equal vote.
law_elder_council_desc: The most venerated men have a say in the nation's governance.
law_anarchy_desc: Local communities govern their own affairs and send representatives to serve limited terms on larger cooperative councils. With no formal hierarchies, central authority is difficult to exercise.
law_single_party_state_desc: The state is governed by a single legal political party, which has a monopoly on all political activity within the nation.
ruler_in_party_tt: The [concept_ruler] of this nation is a member of an [concept_interest_group] that has an active political [concept_party]
sps_no_party_tt: This nation has no active [Concept('concept_party', 'Political Parties')]
sps_government_reshuffle_tt: [concept_government] composition will be updated with members of the single legal [concept_party]
law_organic_regulation_desc: This country's government is constituted through a set of
law_neo_absolutism_desc: The Head of State rules as an enlightened autocrat, with their rule facilitated by a modern, centralized state apparatus.
law_bakufu_desc: Absolute power is vested in the Shōgun, who officially serves in the name of the Emperor.
law_warrior_caste_desc: Bearing arms is a privilege limited to an elite warrior strata. Commoners are barred from serving in combatant roles.
law_first_past_the_post_desc: Also known as Winner Takes All, this system elects the single candidate who wins the most number of seats in regional sub-elections. It tends to create single-party governments with strong mandates but is vulnerable to gerrymandering.
law_proportional_representation_desc: This system distributes parliamentary seats in proportion to the number of votes cast. It tends to create multi-party coalition governments where compromise is key to getting anything done.
law_serfdom_desc: Peasants are tied to their land and must perform labor for their feudal masters.
law_no_workers_rights_desc: Workers have no particular labor rights guaranteed by the state.
law_regulatory_bodies_desc: Government institutions have been created to regulate the excesses of employers.
law_worker_protections_desc: Workers enjoy extensive protections that are enshrined in law.
lawgroup_childrens_rights_desc: The rights and protections afforded to children.
law_child_labor_allowed_desc: No legal restrictions are placed on where children may work.
law_restricted_child_labor_desc: No child is permitted on the factory floor.
law_compulsory_primary_school_desc: All children must attend several years of primary school during which they're prohibited from working.
law_slavery_banned_desc: No human being may be owned by another.
law_debt_slavery_desc: Those who cannot clear their debts instead forfeits their person as their creditor's property.
law_slave_trade_desc: Demand for cheap labor is fulfilled through a dehumanizing trade in foreign bodies.
law_legacy_slavery_desc: As a compromise between abolitionists and slaveholders, the institution of slavery may continue as long as it does not expand.
law_colonial_slavery_desc: The institution of slavery is legal in this country's colonies. Any slave that sets foot upon the mainland is made free.
lawgroup_church_and_state_desc: The relationship between physical and spiritual governors.
law_state_religion_desc: The church is an official organ of the state. All minority religions are discriminated against.
law_freedom_of_conscience_desc: The state has an official state religion but the people may choose what to believe. Only particularly exotic religions are discriminated against.
law_total_separation_desc: No church or faith may interfere in government functions. No religion may be discriminated against.
law_atheist_state_desc: Preaching religious belief is prohibited, and practicing one is frowned upon. All religions are discriminated against.
law_millet_system_desc: The state upholds Sunni Islam as the official religion. Adherents of other Abrahamic religions are grouped under confessional communities, exempting them from conscription and granting them legal autonomy in return for paying a religious tax.
law_people_of_the_book_desc: The state adheres to the principles of Islamic law. Adherents of other Abrahamic religions are recognized as #italic Dhimmi#!, exempting them from conscription and granting them legal autonomy in return for paying a religious tax.
law_ethnostate_desc: The state considers itself inextricably tied to a certain ethnicity, with other ethnicities barred from citizenship. All foreign cultures are discriminated against.
law_national_supremacy_desc: The state defines its citizens by compliance with a certain national identity, which is held to be supreme over all others. Foreign cultures are discriminated against unless they share both heritage and language (or other customs).
law_racial_segregation_desc: The state considers citizenship rights to be tied to the concept of shared racial heritage. Foreign cultures of different heritage are discriminated against.
law_cultural_exclusion_desc: The state offers citizenship rights to people of all cultural identities, whilst considering a certain official identity to be paramount. Foreign cultures with nothing in common with your primary cultures are discriminated against.
law_multicultural_desc: The state upholds equal citizenship rights for people of all cultural identities, and makes no attempt to officially uphold a certain culture over others. No cultures are discriminated against.
law_subjecthood_desc: The state defines its people foremostly as subjects of a sovereign, making little effort to encourage any official nationality. Cultures are largely left to their own devices within their own communities.
lawgroup_caste_hegemony_desc: Erasure of rights among members of society based on the British Indian Caste System.
law_hindu_caste_enforced_desc: Caste hierarchy is legally enforced and prevents upward socioeconomic mobility.
law_hindu_caste_codified_desc: Caste hierarchy is recognized and used to restrict upward socioeconomic mobility.
law_hindu_caste_not_enforced_desc: Socioeconomic mobility on the basis of caste is not legally restricted but discrimination may still persist.
law_affirmative_action_desc: Active measures to create an equitable socioeconomic situation, prioritizing previously marginalized groups.
lawgroup_economic_system_desc: The fundamental principles of your economy.
law_traditionalism_desc: Pre-industrial subsistence economy with little central control.
law_agrarianism_desc: A rural economy emphasizing agricultural development and community.
law_cooperative_ownership_desc: An economic system based around the concept of social ownership, where surplus production is distributed more evenly among the workers.
law_command_economy_desc: An inward-focused interventionist economy where the government directly manages most aspects of production.
law_laissez_faire_desc: A liberal economy founded on the principles of comparative advantage and that fewer government interventions means greater growth
law_interventionism_desc: To ensure the stability of our nation, government must curb the worst excesses of private businesses.
lawgroup_trade_policy_desc: Laws governing trade and the exchange of goods across borders.
law_free_trade_desc: The free exchange of goods must not be impeded, as trade is for the benefit of all.
law_protectionism_desc: Our industries must be protected from the depredations of foreign market actors.
law_isolationism_desc: An economy focused on supplying the nation's needs internally, while keeping out of the affairs of others.
law_mercantilism_desc: An export-focused economy with an emphasis on keeping a positive current account and competing with other nations.
law_canton_system_desc: A variant of $law_isolationism$ where trade is only permitted in a single coastal state.
canton_system_trade_center_trigger_tt: Under the [GetLawType('law_canton_system').GetName] [concept_law], Trade Centers can only be constructed up to level [Building.GetState.GetModifier.GetNonFormattedValueWithBreakdownAndNoDecimalsFor('state_trade_center_max_limit_add')|v] in #v $STATE_GUANGDONG$#!
law_sakoku_desc: A variant of $law_isolationism$ where contact with other nations is heavily restricted and trade is limited to only a handful of designated ports.
sakoku_trade_center_trigger_tt: Under the [GetLawType('law_sakoku').GetName] [concept_law], Trade Centers can only be constructed up to level [Building.GetState.GetModifier.GetNonFormattedValueWithBreakdownAndNoDecimalsFor('state_trade_center_max_limit_add')|v] in #v $STATE_KYUSHU$#!, where commerce with foreign interests can be kept under strict supervision.
internal_controls_relaxed_tt: Internal movement controls will be relaxed, causing us to adopt [GetLawType('law_migration_controls').GetName]
internal_controls_strengthened_tt: Restrictions will be placed on contact with foreign nations, causing us to adopt [GetLawType('law_closed_borders').GetName]
lawgroup_taxation_desc: How the state raises revenue by taxing its citizens.
law_consumption_based_taxation_desc: A tax system where there are no direct income or per-capita taxes and instead revenue is raised through taxing the consumption of goods.
law_land_based_taxation_desc: A traditional form of land-based taxation, collected mainly from the peasantry.
law_per_capita_based_taxation_desc: A tax system that disproportionally taxes the poor through a combination of income and per-capita taxes.
law_proportional_taxation_desc: A mainly income-based tax system that tries to ensure everyone pays a roughly equal share of their income to the state.
law_graduated_taxation_desc: A tax system that aims to put the burden of taxation primarily on the well-to-do through high Dividends taxes.
lawgroup_education_system_desc: For when the children are done with chimney sweeping chores.
law_no_schools_desc: Education is the parents' responsibility. Only the most leisurely citizens learn to read and write.
law_religious_schools_desc: Letting the church take care of state education ensures a loyal and morally healthy population.
law_private_schools_desc: Schooling is best left to private interests who can assure freedom of choice in one's education.
law_public_schools_desc: Schooling is the responsibility of the state, and should be standardized and equally accessible to all.
law_terakoya_desc: The education of commoners is left to a decentralized system of privately-owned Terakoya, or temple schools.
lawgroup_health_system_desc: Laws about the government's involvement (or lack thereof) in providing healthcare for its citizens.
law_no_health_system_desc: The government does not fund any system of healthcare.
law_charitable_health_system_desc: Charitable organizations—often religious ones—provide some help to anyone who's sick or dying, to the degree they are able.
law_private_health_insurance_desc: Population health is managed through a system of privately owned hospitals paid through private health insurance programs, ensuring the well-being of those who can afford it with minimal impact on the government treasury.
law_public_health_insurance_desc: The government provides a publicly funded health insurance program ensuring equal access to care for all.
lawgroup_welfare_desc: Government assistance for the income deprived.
law_no_social_security_desc: It is not the state's role to provide for those who cannot provide for themselves.
law_poor_laws_desc: Getting the tramps and hobos off our streets and into the workhouses is well worth the cost.
law_wage_subsidies_desc: All who are willing to work have a right to eat. No man should lack the means to provide for his family.
law_old_age_pension_desc: There is a practical limit to the age where our workforce is no longer efficient and their subsequent welfare must fall under the purview of government.
law_disability_insurance_desc: It is the state's responsibility to care for those who, through no fault of their own, find themselves unable to work.
lawgroup_rights_of_women_desc: The legal regulations of the fairer sex.
law_no_womens_rights_desc: Women are legally under the guardianship of men and enjoy very few rights.
law_women_own_property_desc: Whether inherited or otherwise earned, even women have the right and duty to own and cherish their possessions.
law_women_in_the_workplace_desc: How will we be able to keep the furnaces of progress aflame with only half the potential workforce?
law_womens_suffrage_desc: In the adjustment of the new order of things, we women demand an equal voice; we shall accept nothing less.
lawgroup_policing_desc: The priorities of the national police force.
law_no_police_desc: Any sort of structured police force does not exist in this country.
law_local_police_desc: This country has local police forces operating.
law_dedicated_police_desc: This country has a dedicated police force with standardized training.
law_militarized_police_desc: By giving your police force military equipment and military training, their effectiveness at carrying out your will increases.
law_hereditary_bureaucrats_desc: Bureaucrats hold their position through traditional inheritance, passing on the responsibilities to their children.
law_appointed_bureaucrats_desc: Bureaucrats are appointed by rulers to serve the country's best interests in exchange for high wages.
law_meritocratic_bureaucracy_desc: Bureaucrats vie for positions of power through merit. Over time this creates enormous, byzantine administrations.
law_elected_bureaucrats_desc: Local governors are elected by their constituents, decentralizing power while making citizens easier to manage.
law_crownland_diets_desc: Local governance is carried out by traditional assemblies elected from the ranks of the regional nobility.
lawgroup_colonization_desc: Your stance on establishing colonies to supplant and conquer [concept_decentralized_nation].
law_no_colonial_affairs_desc: The country does not engage in any formal type of colonization and cannot establish colonies.
law_colonial_resettlement_desc: Colonies are established to provide land to settlers from the country's incorporated states.
law_colonial_exploitation_desc: Colonies are established to exploit the area for their natural resources and cheap labor.
lawgroup_internal_security_desc: Keeping your own affairs in order.
law_no_home_affairs_desc: The state relies upon conventional military and police forces to suppress unrest and uprisings.
law_national_guard_desc: The state maintains an independent volunteer force of citizen-soldiers charged with upholding public order.
law_secret_police_desc: The state possesses a secret police bureau tasked with monitoring dissidents and investigating political crimes.
law_guaranteed_liberties_desc: The state's home affairs bureau is solely focused on addressing the grievances of the citizens, and is forbidden from investigating or arresting them without due cause.
law_shinsengumi_desc: The state commissions an elite organization of swordsmen to protect government officials and police the capital.
law_no_migration_controls_desc: The country makes no attempt to control movement across its borders.
law_migration_controls_desc: Only people of cultures and religions not discriminated against may migrate in or out of the country.
law_closed_borders_desc: No migration in or out of the country is permitted.
enslave_discriminated_farm_workers_tt: All $laborers$ with low [concept_acceptance] working on farms, ranches and plantations in former Slave States will be [Concept('concept_slavery', '$concept_enslaved$')].
enact_law_radical_leftist_government_war: @warning! Enacting this [concept_law] may cause [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] without a similar form of $lawgroup_governance_principles$ to become aggressive against us.
enact_law_radical_leftist_economy_warnin: @warning! Enacting this [concept_law] may cause [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] without a similar form of $lawgroup_economic_system$ to become aggressive against us.
lawgroup_labour_associations_desc: Regulations placed upon worker's and craftsmen's associations.
law_guild_system_desc: A system in which eligibility for employment within certain fields is dependent upon membership of a formalized craft or merchant guild.
law_combination_acts_desc: The formation of labor associations of any kind is prohibited by law.
law_anti_strike_laws_desc: Whilst the formation of labor associations is permitted, strikes and certain forms of collective bargaining are prohibited.
law_right_to_associate_desc: No especial restrictions are placed upon the formation and activity of labor associations.
law_corporatized_unions_desc: Labor associations have been brought under the direct or indirect control of the state, serving foremostly as a means to facilitate collaboration between classes.
law_factory_councils_desc: Workers have been radicalized by revolutionary conditions, seizing control of their workplaces and supplanting previous management structures.
law_industry_banned_desc: An economic view that rejects heavy industry and automation, preferring the fruits of honest labor over soulless machinery.
industry_banned_tt: It will no longer be possible to build #bold Heavy Industry#! buildings
industry_banned_destroy_tt: @warning! All #bold Heavy Industry#! buildings in this country will be dismantled
ideology_luddite_desc: Luddites are opposed to industrial automation, or in more extreme cases to industry itself.
law_extraction_economy_desc: A colonial economic system which focuses on maximum extraction of capital for the benefit of the metropole.
lawgroup_land_reform_desc: The laws governing agricultural land and the people who work it.
law_tenant_farmers_desc: Agricultural land is owned by hereditary elites. Workers are not tied to the land, and may seek alternative employment if they can find it.
law_homesteading_desc: Farmers lay claim to plots of land which they work alongside their hired laborers.
law_commercialized_agriculture_desc: Agriculture is a business like any other, subject to market forces and owned by capital.
law_collectivized_agriculture_desc: Agricultural land is organized into plots worked by groups of farmers as a joint enterprise.
law_latifundias_desc: Agricultural land is dominated by vast estates worked by seasonally employed and poorly paid day-laborers
law_manorialism_desc: Agricultural land is owned by hereditary elites. Tenants are granted freedom of movement, but are obliged to perform unpaid labor for their landlords.
law_peasant_proprietorship_desc: Agricultural land is largely owned by independent peasant-proprietors, with a scattering of larger commercial estates.
ideology_jacksonian_democrat_desc: This character advocates for greater public participation in government - for a certain definition of 'public'.
law_frontier_colonization_desc: The wild frontiers on our borders are ripe for settlement if they can first be pacified and tamed.

lobby_events.40.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName]'s passage of the [SCOPE.sLaw('relevant_law_scope').GetName] law has impressed the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting]. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] are joining the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.40.f: Members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] observed emissaries of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting] making mischief to sway lawmakers in their favor.\n\n
lobby_events.40.a: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting] will benefit from the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] support.
lobby_events.40.b: Excellent. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting]'s will make powerful friends.
lobby_events.31.d: Impressed by the work imported from [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetAdjective] filmmakers, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] plan to join the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName]. They are willing to collaborate with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_lobby_member').GetName] to advance their interests.
lobby_events.31.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ig_leader').GetFullNameNoFormatting] is steadfast in [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ig_leader').GetHerHis] talks with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_lobby_member').GetNameNoFormatting].\n\n
lobby_events.31.a: Very well, let's see what comes of this.
lobby_events.31.b: This will not be a fruitful partnership.
lobby_events.32.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] regard [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName] as a strong model of their values, with proper leadership that [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] should follow by example. They seek to join the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.32.a: Excellent. We have much to learn from [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetNameNoFormatting].
lobby_events.33.d: With too many parties each in pursuit of their own agendas, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] seek to part ways from the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.34.d: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] regards [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName] as exemplary after recent laws enacted there. They seek to leave the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.34.a: Well said! The [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting] surely no longer needs their support.
lobby_events.35.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] regard [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName] unfavorably after recent laws enacted there. They seek to join the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.35.a: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting] will benefit from their support.
lobby_events.35.b: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting] does not need their support right now.
lobby_events.36.d: Unhappy with the proposed [SCOPE.sLaw('relevant_law_scope').GetName] law, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] are lobbying to distance [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] from [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName] - a country where [SCOPE.sLaw('relevant_law_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] is practiced.
lobby_events.36.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_ig_leader').GetFullNameNoFormatting] spoke with an urgency that moved attendees,
lobby_events.36.a: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] are right to oppose the law.
lobby_events.36.b: Very well. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] have made their opinion known.
lobby_events.37.d: Impressed with [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName]'s success passing the [SCOPE.sLaw('relevant_law_scope').GetName] law, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] are joining the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.37.a: Their passion will give the law momentum.
lobby_events.37.b: Very well. But the proposal is not our priority.
lobby_events.38.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] are unhappy with the proposed [SCOPE.sLaw('relevant_law_scope').GetName] law. They have joined the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName], criticizing [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName]'s enactment of a similar law.
lobby_events.38.b: Don't the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] have other matters to attend to?
lobby_events.39.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName]'s passage of the [SCOPE.sLaw('relevant_law_scope').GetName] law has been met with much enthusiasm by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName]. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] are now lobbying for closer ties to [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName].
lobby_events.39.b: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting] have a lot of work ahead of them to pass the [SCOPE.sLaw('relevant_law_scope').GetNameNoFormatting] law.
lobby_events.51.d: Members of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] have discreetly dispatched one of their number to amplify their mission in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]'s most widely read newspaper.
lobby_events.51.f: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting] has calculated, with utmost mastery, the dissemination of materials to secure a foothold in both the political world and the public's imagination.\n\nWith great satisfaction, a lobbyist comments:
lobby_events.52.d: Increased sightings of [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] members socializing with lawmakers at restaurants and entertainment establishments are raising concerns about lobbyist conduct.
lobby_events.52.f: A lobbyist hands a drink to a politician and pats him on the back. Liquid amber swirls in their tumblers. Jovially, he tells him:
lobby_events.52.a: This indulgent behavior should not be tolerated.
lobby_events.52.b: The facts do not call for any action to intervene.
lobby_events.53.d: Private, inflammatory letters written by a member of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] have been leaked to the national newspaper. [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetAdjective] officials have taken notice and are displeased.
lobby_events.53.f: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_lobby_member').GetNameNoFormatting] send a representative on behalf of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting] to converse with the newspaper editors. The representative steers the conversation away from the leaked correspondence:
lobby_events.53.b: These letters should not be circulated further.
lobby_events.54.d: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] has been frequently hosting [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_agitator').GetFullName] as an honored guest and speaker. This is now drawing the attention of [SCOPE.sCountry('agitator_home_country').GetAdjective] officials.
lobby_events.54.f: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_agitator').GetFullNameNoFormatting] commands the attention of all in attendance. Leaders of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting] welcome [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_agitator').GetLastNameNoFormatting]'s political acumen.\n\nLobby members remark on this fortuitous association:
lobby_events.54.a: Perhaps these salons should not meet so frequently.
lobby_events.55.d: Police officers in uniform have been discovered supporting [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] activity while on duty, lowering public confidence in the police force.
lobby_events.55.f: A resident of [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetNameNoFormatting] comments on members of the police force patrol that walk by in pristine uniforms with a hint of arrogance to their gait. Disdain drips from the onlooker's voice.\n\n
lobby_events.55.a: As long as everyone is discreet, there is no harm.
lobby_events.55.b: We need to restore the public's confidence.
lobby_events.56.d: A bookkeeper in government administration employed by the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] is under investigation for bribery.
lobby_events.56.f: The committee leading the investigation gather to consider the facts collected. They argue over the scandal.\n\n
lobby_events.56.a: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting] is responsible for the agent they hired.
lobby_events.56.b: Perhaps it was just a clerical error.
lobby_events.57.d: Members of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] are greatly impressed by the advancements [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName] have made in medicine. With urgency, they seek to model the [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] approach to medical innovation.
lobby_events.57.f: A lobby member that has recently returned from touring [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetNameNoFormatting] and speaking with [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] doctors shares more about the experience:
lobby_events.57.a: Send some of finest to study medicine in [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetNameNoFormatting].
lobby_events.58.d: An internal investigation has discovered that a government official received many gifts from [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_lobby_leader').GetFullName] on behalf of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.58.f: The official leading the investigation details his findings:
lobby_events.58.b: Perhaps their leader should step down.
lobby_events.59.d: A man employed by a powerful member of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] is delivering lectures and pamphlets addressed to targeted constituencies in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetStateRegion.GetCityHubName].
lobby_events.59.f: One lawmaker writes to a fellow politician:
lobby_events.59.a: Make it clear lobbies are responsible for the emissaries they hire.
lobby_events.59.b: Any concerns about the emissary's behavior are unfounded.
lobby_events.60.d: Private correspondence exchanged by members of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] have been published in pamphlets. The letters praise [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_lobby_country').GetName], contrary to the intentions of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_lobby_member').GetName].
lobby_events.60.f: Frustration brews at the gathering of all the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetNameNoFormatting] members. Many are quick to blame the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_lobby_member').GetNameNoFormatting] for this mishap with the series of pamphlets distributed without their sanction.\n\nOne member challenges the fervor of the group:
lobby_events.60.b: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_lobby_member').GetNameNoFormatting] should pull any remaining pamphlets.

naval_mission_type_intercept_desc: Seek out and destroy any hostile vessels.
naval_mission_type_hunt_pirates_desc: Seek out and destroy any pirating vessels currently disrupting our imports.
naval_mission_type_blockade_desc: [concept_blockade] a coastal sea node, cutting off [concept_trade] and [concept_supply] in adjacent hostile ports. [Concept('concept_fleet', '$concept_fleets$')] must reach at least #v [GetDefine('NMilitary','BLOCKADE_SEA_PRESENCE_THRESHOLD')|%0]#! [concept_presence] until they have an effective [concept_blockade].
naval_mission_type_raid_supply_desc: A [concept_naval_mission] given to a [concept_fleet] to sink hostile [Concept('concept_supply_ship','$concept_supply_ships$')] passing through a sea region.
naval_mission_type_protect_supply_desc: A [concept_naval_mission] given to a [concept_fleet] to protect [Concept('concept_shipping_lane','$concept_shipping_lanes$')] by escorting [Concept('concept_supply_ship','$concept_supply_ships$')] safely, engaging hostile vessels as needed.
naval_mission_type_project_power_desc: A [concept_naval_mission] given to a [concept_fleet] to sail off the shores of [Concept('concept_strategic_region','$concept_strategic_regions$')] and thereby generating [concept_involvement].
naval_mission_type_port_bombardment_desc: A [concept_naval_mission] given to a [concept_fleet] to bombard hostile coastal states adjacent to the sea region, generating devastation and potentially damaging [Concept('concept_coastal_building','$concept_coastal_buildings$')].
naval_mission_type_piracy_desc: A [concept_naval_mission] given to a [concept_fleet] to seize the [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] from hostile or neutral countries that passes through the assigned regions.
naval_mission_type_privateer_desc: A [concept_naval_mission] given to a [concept_fleet] to seize the [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] from hostile countries that passes through the assigned regions.
amenability_law_worried_to_be_tie_breake: Could turn the tide of this [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws', '$concept_enactment_of_laws_enactment$')]
amenability_law_makes_no_difference: Confident the law will fail anyway
amenability_already_letting_go: Already letting law through due to high [concept_approval]
negotiate_promise_failed_effects: \n\n Failure will result in the following effects:
FailurePromiseLine_1: Failure will partly [Concept('concept_radicalized_interest_group', '$concept_radicalize$')|l] the [ROOT.GetInterestGroup.GetName], however penalties will be reduced if we partially achieve the commitment.\n
FailurePromiseLine_2: Failure will #r significantly#! [Concept('concept_radicalized_interest_group', '$concept_radicalize$')|l] the [ROOT.GetInterestGroup.GetName], however penalties will be reduced if we partially achieve the commitment.\n
FailurePromiseLine_3: Failure will #r completely#! [Concept('concept_radicalized_interest_group', '$concept_radicalize$')|l] the [ROOT.GetInterestGroup.GetName], however penalties will be reduced if we partially achieve the commitment.\n
will_not_negotiate_again_tt: Will not negotiate again until the commitment is kept
law_two_years_tt: Penalties will be reduced if [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] attempts to enact [SCOPE.sLaw('government_petition_law').GetName] for at least #v 24 months#!. \n#v Current failure effects:#!
closer_we_get_neg_tt: Penalties will be reduced as we approach the commitment. \n#v Current failure effects:#!
notification_neg_failed_quest_toast_desc: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] are displeased that we failed to deliver on our promises.
negotiation.1.d: Amid much shouting, insults and regrettable turns of phrase, several paths have emerged that would convince the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] to allow [SCOPE.sLaw('law').GetName] to pass.
negotiation.1.d2: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] have agreed to meet at a local market to surreptitiously discuss changing their stance on [SCOPE.sLaw('law').GetName]
negotiation.1.f2: I walked around the square several times before approaching the stall. I spoke the key phrase:
negotiation.1.d3: Despite ungentlemanly comments, raised voices, and the shaking of fists, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] have admitted to several compromises that would change their perception of [SCOPE.sLaw('law').GetName].
negotiation.1.f3: After I delivered the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s offer, I became incredibly grateful for the lector in front of me, my hardwood shield against the onslaught of insults and very physical detritus that was tossed at my person. \n\n I raised my arms, but kept my voice level.
negotiation.1.d4: After several rounds of terse correspondence, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] have met with the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s representatives and outlined their demands.
negotiation.1.d5: Whispering through a haze of cigar smoke in [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetLeader.GetFullName]'s private dining hall, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] discuss what compromises they might accept for changing their stance on [SCOPE.sLaw('law').GetName].
negotiation.1.d6: The [ROOT.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('supporting_ig').GetInterestGroup.GetName] have held secret discussions with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName], seeking a certain arrangement concerning [SCOPE.sLaw('law').GetName].
negotiation.1.d7: Prominent [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] meet in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetCityHubName] finest cafe to discuss [SCOPE.sLaw('law').GetName]. With the right leverage, perhaps their opinions could be swayed.
negotiation.1.d8: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetLeader.GetFullName] has agreed to a private meeting, clearly seeking a path that will benefit both the nation and the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName]' interests over [SCOPE.sLaw('law').GetName].
negotiation.1.d9: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] pour only their best vintage and smoke only their finest tobacco during a polite discussion with government representatives about [SCOPE.sLaw('law').GetName].
bribe_tier_1: Quietly create a special subsidy for these good people.
bribe_tier_2: Perhaps if we reconsider the distribution of funds...
bribe_tier_3: Put them in charge of the treasury.
negotiation.1.o2: Place their members in administrative positions.
negotiation.1.cancel: These offers are not in [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag]'s interest.
negotiation_go_away_button_desc: Due to unforeseen circumstances, and with the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle|l]'s deepest regrets, this endeavor will be postponed to a later date.
discard_petition_neg_tt: We will abandon our commitment with [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName]
already_asked_for_extension_neg_tt: Has not already announced a delay
negotiation_extension_button_desc: The [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle|l] has every intention of carrying out this commitment to its fullest. However, it does seem some unfortunate changes to timing are inevitable.
negotiation.1.o3: Commit to increasing the size of the army.
promise_grow_army_tt: We will commit to grow our [concept_army_power_projection] from #tooltippable #tooltip:[ROOT.GetCountry.GetTooltipTag],PANEL_MILITARY_ARMY_POWER_PROJECTION_TOOLTIP [ROOT.GetCountry.GetArmyPowerProjection|v0]#!#! to [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('desired_army_size').GetValue|v0] within #v 10 years#!. [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetCustom('FailurePromiseLine')]
je_negotiate_army_quest_reason: We have sworn commitments with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] to increase the might of our nation's military. \n\nEither by training more troops, or by upgrading their equipment, we will ensure [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] stands ready to defend its interests.
promise_pass_law_tt: We must pass [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('desired_law_var').GetLaw.GetName] within #v 7 years and 6 months#! [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetCustom('FailurePromiseLine')]
promise_pass_law_extra_help_tt: [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] will push particularly hard for [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('desired_law_var').GetLaw.GetName] during its enactment, periodically boosting enactment chance.
je_government_petition_negotiation_versi: After supporting the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s efforts to pass [SCOPE.sLaw('law').GetName], the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] are expecting the [concept_government] to honor its obligations and pass [SCOPE.sLaw('government_petition_law').GetName].\n\nShould we fail to enact [SCOPE.sLaw('government_petition_law').GetName] in time, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] will be greatly displeased, faith in the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s government will be shattered, and there will be a greater risk of a [concept_revolution] or [concept_coup].
notification_help_from_ig_desc: Reminding their allies of their commitments has increased [concept_law] enactment chance.
negotiation.1.o5: Perchance if we invested in more [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('promised_building_type').GetBuildingType.GetName].
promise_build_tt: We must increase the amount of [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('promised_building_type').GetBuildingType.GetName] in our [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] from [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.ScriptValue('building_levels_existing')|v0] to [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('building_level_increase').GetValue|v0] within #v 10 years#!. [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetCustom('FailurePromiseLine')]
je_negotiate_buildings_reason: We have promised the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] to construct more [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('promised_building_type').GetBuildingType.GetName] within our [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')], an action that will surely improve the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] economy.
promise_building_group_tt: We must increase the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('promised_building_group').GetBuildingGroup.GetName] in our [Concept('concept_state', '$concept_states$')] from [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.ScriptValue('building_group_levels_existing')|v0] to [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('building_group_level_increase').GetValue|v0] within #v 10 years#!. [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetCustom('FailurePromiseLine')]
je_negotiate_building_group_reason: We have vowed to steer the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] investment towards [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('promised_building_group').GetBuildingGroup.GetName]. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] eagerly await the results of the initiative, which they insist will only lead to the betterment of life for all [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] citizens.
negotiation.1.o7: Lowering taxes could help the economy.
tax_tier_low_short: We commit to leave [concept_taxes] at #v Low#! or #v Very Low#! for #v 2 years#!.
tax_tier_low: We commit to leave [concept_taxes] at #v Low#! or #v Very Low#! for #v 4 years#!.
tax_tier_very_low: We commit to leave [concept_taxes] at #v Very Low#! for #v 4 years#!.
je_negotiate_taxes_reason: We have made a deal with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] to lower taxes so the economy can flourish. Now we must retain taxes at the current level, no matter the state finances, or else risk angering the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetNameNoIcon] and the populace at large.
neg_taxes_remain_low_tt: [concept_taxes] remain at [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('GetPromisedTaxLevelOneWord')] for as long as agreed
NEGOTIATE_LAW_SUCCESS_CHANCE_INCREASE_TT: [THIS.GetInterestGroup.GetName] will support [ROOT.GetCountry.GetLawBeingEnacted.GetName], causing [Concept('concept_enactment_success', '$concept_enactment_success$')] chance to increase by #g [THIS.ScriptValue('law_enactment_change')|=0%]#!
NEGOTIATE_LAW_STALL_CHANCE_DECREASE_TT: [THIS.GetInterestGroup.GetName] will cease opposing [ROOT.GetCountry.GetLawBeingEnacted.GetName], causing [Concept('concept_enactment_stall', '$concept_enactment_stall$')] chance to decrease by #g -[THIS.ScriptValue('law_enactment_change')|0%]#!
negotiation.1.o8: Let's add some fine print about [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('negotiation_amendment_type').GetAmendmentType.GetName].
negotiation.1.o9: Vow to improve the lives of the common people.
promise_higher_sol_tt: We will commit to increasing average [concept_sol] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] to [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').MakeScope.Var('promised_sol_level').GetValue|v1] within #v [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetCustom('SOL_commitment_duration')] years#! [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetCustom('FailurePromiseLine')]
je_negotiate_sol_reason: We have sworn an oath to the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig').GetName] to improve the lives of the common people. There is truly no more noble goal for the rulers of this nation than increasing the [concept_sol] of our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjective] citizens.
