objective_tutorial_desc: Play a campaign guided by challenges that help you learn both how the game works and how to play it.
objective_economic_dominance_desc: Aim to expand your production, market reach, and trade influence until the world economy is firmly within your control. Your ultimate goal will be to control the lion's share of global GDP.
objective_hegemon_desc: Nothing short of complete domination of the global populace will satisfy you. Subjugate, conquer, or simply grow your own population until most of the world live inside your borders.
objective_egalitarian_society_desc: Power to the people! Become a guiding beacon of liberty and equality for the world to look up to, by assuring opportunity and raising Standard of Living across your nation.
OBJECTIVE_TYPE_RECOMMENDED_GAME_RULE_DES: The following Game Rule(s) are recommended:
economic_dominance_welcome_desc: Through the course of this objective you will be given a series of [Concept('journal_entry','$Journal Entries$')] to complete. How you choose to complete these tasks will be left up to you, the player.\n\nNOTE: You will need to have an Iron or Coal mine in your country before getting your first Journal Entry.
je_objective_expand_goods_production_rea: We should take our first steps towards increasing our domestic output. We should expand the [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetState.GetName]. This will place us in a strong position to expand industries further in the future.
expand_goods_production_complete_1_desc: Well done! You have completed the first part of the Economic Dominance Objective. Continue to complete [Concept('journal_entry','$Journal Entries$')] to unlock additional tasks.
je_refining_goods_status: Have a level 4 [GetBuildingType('building_steel_mill').GetName] in a state.
je_refining_goods_reason: Having increased our raw [Concept('concept_good','$concept_goods$')] production, we should now look to refine these $concept_goods$ to increase potential for profits across our nation. Why import from others when we can make it ourselves?
je_specialized_goods_status: Have a level 2 [GetBuildingType('building_motor_industry').GetName] in a state.
je_specialized_goods_reason: We should look to diversify our goods production further. We have started production of one good, but if we begin producing even more expensive goods, we will be able to export it to all the corners of the globe.
je_expanding_the_market_status: Have 8 nations a part of your [concept_customs_union].
je_expanding_the_market_reason: We should look to expanding our $concept_customs_union$ with additional nations. This will allow for freer and more direct trade with other nations, without the need to [concept_trade] with the [concept_world_market].
je_strong_market_reason: The time has come to establish ourselves as the largest and most powerful market on the globe.
economic_dominance_complete_desc: Well done! You have completed the Economic Dominance Objective. Feel free to continue playing the game or try a different objective.
je_objective_expand_goods_production_inv: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetState.GetName] is no longer owned by [GetPlayer.GetName]
je_specialized_inputs_reason: With our production of industrialized products now well under way we should look to reinvest these goods back into our other buildings. We will then be able to free up other workers to work elsewhere.\n\nNOTE: Completing this journal entry will invalidate the Exporting our Profits journal entry.
je_utilizing_our_strength_reason: As we have decided to focus on using our industrial goods for ourselves. It would be best to keep the price of these goods as low as possible so as to not ramp up costs on other buildings that rely heavily on these goods to stay profitable.
je_exporting_profits_reason: Now that we have a large stockpile of goods, we can begin exporting these goods as to increase the profitability of their production buildings.\n\nNOTE: Completing this journal entry will invalidate the Improving Production journal entry.
je_raise_exports_value_reason: With our focus now being placed on the exportation of our valuable goods, the best course of action would be to increase the value of these goods to maximize the profits the buildings are earning.
je_lower_production_costs_reason: With our growing industries not only do we need to maintain a steady stream of goods into our factories, we also need to check that these input goods are not too expensive and negatively affecting production of additional more valuable goods.
tt_lower_production_costs_sub_obj: Have [GetGoods('iron').GetName], [GetGoods('coal').GetName], and [GetGoods('steel').GetName] in [AccessPlayer.AccessFirstMarket.GetName] 20% cheaper than their [concept_base_price]
je_african_colonies_own_a_colony: Is a [concept_colony] on the African continent
je_objective_encourage_liberal_ideas_rea: The first steps to creating any form of Egalitarian Society should be to get the right people in government. With them in a position to enact change, we can take our first steps towards a more equal society.
je_pass_laws_reason: Now that we have a more powerful liberal element in our government, we should look to using their influence in passing more egalitarian laws.\n\nNOTE: Regressing any of these laws after completing this Journal will result in this Journal being hidden until the law is enacted again.
je_public_services_reason: With our laws in place we should look to expand our [Concept('concept_institution','$concept_institutions$')] so that they can become more readily available and accessible to our population.$egalitarian_objective_note_loc$
je_liberate_the_slaves_reason: How can we even begin to call ourselves an Egalitarian Society when we are still in the active practice of utilizing slavery within in our nation? It is vital that our first step should be to put a stop to this outdated and immoral practice.
je_women_and_children_reason: We have taken many steps towards establishing our Egalitarian Society, but we still need to make sure that these rights are available to all. We should look towards ending unfair practices against women and children.$egalitarian_objective_note_loc$
je_egalitarian_society_reason: Now that we have all the laws and institutions in place, we should look to making sure that we have an equal society that allows for equal opportunities for all our citizens. Our nation should be seen as a shining beacon that will lead the world on an Egalitarian Path.$egalitarian_objective_note_loc$
liberalizing_the_government_complete_des: Now that you have completed your first Journal Entry you are well on your way to completing the remaining parts of this objective and creating your Egalitarian Society.
egalitarian_society_welcome_desc: Welcome to the Egalitarian Society Player Objective. In this objective you will be given a series of [Concept('concept_journal_entry', '$concept_journal_entries$')] to complete that will guide you down a path towards an Egalitarian Society.
liberalizing_the_government_complete_1_d: Well done! You have just completed your first objective and now you are now well on the way to creating your Egalitarian Society.
egalitarian_society_complete_desc: Well done! You have completed the Egalitarian Society Objective. Feel free to continue playing the game or try a different objective.
egalitarian_objective_note_loc: \n\nNOTE: Regressing any of the laws passed in the previous Journal Entries will result in this Journal being hidden and you will be unable to progress further through this objective until the law is enacted again.
je_colonization_laws_reason: Our first steps to establishing our hegemony should be to expand our borders overseas. We should amend our laws to allow us to colonize, in order to further our goals.
je_african_colonies_reason: Now that our laws allow us to establish our own colonies, we should look towards acquiring new lands on the African Continent as our first steps in expanding our hegemony.
je_expand_navy_and_army_reason: With our first colonies established, we should be prepared for the worst. Our army doesn't need to be the strongest in the world, but we should aim to dissuade others from attempting a [concept_diplomatic_play] against us.
je_form_alliance_reason: Maintaining a powerful army is important, but it is not the only way we can maintain our security. We should also create alliances with other powers around the globe that can come to our aid in case another nation wishes to attempt to take what is rightfully ours.
je_take_subject_reason: With our power solidified, we should expand our sphere of influence over other nations. Subjugating a few nations will go a long way in increasing our influence on the international stage.
je_increase_technology_reason: Numbers are great, but we shouldn't have to rely on having an overwhelming amount of soldiers if it can be helped. We should look into getting our soldiers the right tools for the right jobs.
je_greatest_power_reason: We may be recognized on the global stage as a Great Power, but we should show the world that we are the Greatest Power, none should be our equal.
je_greater_power_reason: We have been a regional power, but now we should look to solidify our standing in the world and join the other Great Powers as a show of our might.
je_great_power_reason: We have never been the strongest, but that changes now! We will show the world we aren't some tiny speck of land off in the distance whose tiny voice should be ignored.
je_the_hegemon_reason: We have shown the world what we are capable of. We have made great strides. Now however we should make sure we have the population to back our global standing.
colonization_law_passed_complete_1_desc: Well done! You have just completed your first objective and are now well on your way to establishing your own hegemony.
hegemon_welcome_desc: Welcome to the Hegemony Player Objective. In this objective you will be given a series of [Concept('concept_journal_entry', '$concept_journal_entries$')] to complete that will guide you down a path towards creating your own hegemony.
hegemon_complete_desc: Well done! You have completed the Hegemony Objective. Feel free to continue playing the game or try a different objective.
from_capitalism: Has the Laissez-Faire Ideology, or Leader has the Market Liberal Ideology
from_powerful_capitalists: Has the Laissez-Faire Ideology and is Powerful
from_social_democrat: Leader has the Social Democrat Ideology
from_weak_communists: Stronger Social Democrat Interest Group Leader
from_liberty: From No Home Affairs or Guaranteed Liberties Laws
from_vanguard_anarchy: From Vanguardist Ruler with Council Republic
from_no_or_religious_schools: No Schools or Religious Schools Laws
from_no_proportional_or_per_capita_tax: Support for Proportional or Per Capita Taxation Laws
from_no_oligarchy_wealth_voting: Support for Oligarchy or Wealth Voting
from_three_or_more_prior_members: Three or more other party members

LAW_POLITICAL_MOVEMENT_TO_PRESERVE: The [PoliticalMovement.GetName] is demanding we abort the replacement of this [concept_law]
LAW_POLITICAL_MOVEMENT_TO_ENACT: The [PoliticalMovement.GetName] is demanding the enactment of this [concept_law]
je_law_imposition_status_not_yet_enactin: Preparing to enact [SCOPE.sLaw('foreign_imposition_law').GetName] at the behest of [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetNameNoFlag]
je_law_imposition_reason: Our [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetSubjectOrPowerBlocHierarchyLabel(GetPlayer.Self)] [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetName] has declared it imperative that we enact [SCOPE.sLaw('foreign_imposition_law').GetName].
impose_law_cooldown: Cannot Be Targeted by Law Impositions
law_imposition_events.1.d: [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetNameNoFlag], in their capacity as our [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetSubjectOrPowerBlocHierarchyLabel(GetPlayer.Self)], has issued a demand we reform our [SCOPE.sLaw('foreign_imposition_law').GetGroup.GetName] towards [SCOPE.sLaw('foreign_imposition_law').GetName].
law_imposition_events.1.a.1: Begin immediately, our relations with [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetNameNoFlag] are imperative.
law_imposition_events.1.a.2: Demands from [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetNameNoFlag] are more important than [ROOT.GetCountry.GetLawBeingEnacted.GetName].
law_imposition_events.1.b: Surely [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetNameNoFlag] must understand that this is not the time.
law_imposition_events.1.journal_entry_hi: #instruction @information! While the Journal Entry is active you will be unable to start or cancel any law enactments except for enacting the law being imposed. You can dismiss the Journal Entry anytime, but at a considerable cost.#!
law_imposition_events.2.d: After some consideration we have refused the [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetAdjectiveNoFlag] attempt to meddle in our politics by imposing [SCOPE.sLaw('foreign_imposition_law').GetName] on us.
law_imposition_events.2.a: How might they react to our refusal?
law_imposition_events.3.d: [SCOPE.sC('country_imposed_upon').GetName] has refused our demand they enact [SCOPE.sLaw('foreign_imposition_law').GetName].
law_imposition_events.3.f: The ambassador returns, bearing the news of rejection.
law_imposition_events.3.a: How ought we react to such insubordination?
button_implement_law_imposition_desc: Accept the imposition and begin enacting the law proposed by [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetNameNoFlag].
button_refuse_law_imposition_desc: Abandon this venture and notify [SCOPE.sC('foreign_imposition_country').GetNameNoFlag] that you will not be adhering to their wishes after all.
law_imposition_already_enacting_law: We are #b not#! already enacting the proposed law
notification_imposition_demand_sent_desc: [SCOPE.sC('country_imposed_upon').GetName] shall soon be enacting [SCOPE.sLaw('foreign_imposition_law').GetName] at our demand.
notification_imposition_started_desc: [SCOPE.sC('country_imposed_upon').GetName] has begun the process of enacting [SCOPE.sLaw('foreign_imposition_law').GetName], which you imposed upon them.
notification_imposition_deferred_desc: [SCOPE.sC('country_imposed_upon').GetName] accepts the imposition of [SCOPE.sLaw('foreign_imposition_law').GetName] on them, but has elected to carry it out in due time.

HAPPY_IN_REPUBLIC: [concept_approval] is #v 0#! or above with #b no#! active [GetLawType('law_monarchy').GetName] [concept_law]
HAPPY_WITHOUT_FASCISM: [concept_approval] is #v 0#! or above with #b no#! active [GetLawType('law_corporate_state').GetName] or [GetLawType('law_ethnostate').GetName] [concept_law]
aristocrats_desc: Wealthy landowners, old money with old connections. They exclusively work in [GetBuildingType('building_manor_house').GetName] [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')], where they own farms and plantations. They contribute some of their profits to the [concept_investment_pool]. Their political interests are represented as the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_landowners',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant].
bureaucrats_desc: Officials responsible for administration of government functions and infrastructure. Politically, they tend to align with the Intelligentsia or Petite Bourgeoisie.
capitalists_desc: Captains of industry, new money for a new era. They exclusively work in [GetBuildingType('building_financial_district').GetName] [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')], where they own mines and manufacturies. They contribute some of their profits to the [concept_investment_pool]. Their political interests are represented as the [GetInterestGroupVariant('ig_industrialists',GetPlayer).GetNameWithCountryVariant].
clergymen_desc: Priests, scholars and other religious leaders tending to the spiritual needs of the rural population. Politically, they are the backbone of the Devout.
clerks_desc: Lower-ranking office workers performing administrative tasks in government, infrastructure and shops. Commonly part of the Petite Bourgeoisie, although some join Trade Unions.
engineers_desc: Inventors and designers of technical solutions, working with advanced machinery in sectors like manufacturing, mining and construction. Some support the Industrialists or Petty Bourgeoisie, while others join Trade Unions.
farmers_desc: Sharecroppers, smallholders and others who make a stable but scant living producing food or growing cash crops. Most see their interests represented as the Rural Folk.
peasants_desc: Subsistence farmers found only in [Concept('concept_subsistence_building', '$concept_subsistence_buildings$')], where they produce agricultural and simple manufactured products they use mostly for their own needs. They rely on [concept_subsistence_output] for survival and play only a limited role in the [concept_market] economy. They tend to be [Concept('concept_politically_unaligned_aligned', '$concept_politically_unaligned$')].
laborers_desc: Day laborers, farmhands and others with little to no employment security, performing whatever work is available throughout society. They are usually not engaged in politics, but may get involved through Trade Unions.
officers_desc: Commissioned officers commanding the nation's military forces in the army and navy. Politically, they represent the upper echelons of the Armed Forces.
academics_desc: Researchers, doctors, lawyers and other educated professionals studying and teaching in academic institutions. Politically, they are at the forefront of the Intelligentsia.
shopkeepers_desc: Owners and managers of stores, selling wares to customers in cities. They usually fall within the Petite Bourgeoisie politically.
slaves_desc: Treated not as a person but as property, performing forced labor in various sectors in countries where slavery is permitted. Due to their status, they are not allowed to participate in politics.
soldiers_desc: Soldiers and sailors making up the bulk of the nation's military personnel. They commonly align politically with their role as part of the Armed Forces.
machinists_desc: Manual workers with stable employment operating machinery in manufacturies, mines, mechanized farms and other sectors. Politically, they tend to be a driving force in the Trade Unions.
ACADEMICS_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Only pops with adequate [concept_literacy] can become #v $academics$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_literacy] and [concept_wealth]. Pops whose [concept_culture] have low [concept_acceptance] take a much longer time. #v $clerks$#! and #v $aristocrats$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $academics$#!.
ARISTOCRATS_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Only pops with adequate [concept_wealth] can become #v $aristocrats$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_wealth] and to a lesser degree [concept_literacy]. Pops whose [concept_culture] have low [concept_acceptance] take a much longer time. #v $officers$#! and #v $bureaucrats$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $aristocrats$#!.
BUREAUCRATS_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Only pops with adequate [concept_literacy] can become #v $bureaucrats$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_literacy]. Pops whose [concept_culture] have low [concept_acceptance] take a much longer time, while it goes faster for those of both [concept_culture] and [concept_religion] with high $concept_acceptance$. #v $clerks$#! and #v $clergymen$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $bureaucrats$#!.
CAPITALISTS_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Only pops with adequate [concept_wealth] can become #v $capitalists$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_wealth] and [concept_literacy]. Pops whose [concept_culture] have low [concept_acceptance] take a much longer time. #v $shopkeepers$#! and #v $engineers$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $capitalists$#!.
CLERGYMEN_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Only pops with adequate [concept_literacy] can become #v $clergymen$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_literacy]. Pops whose [concept_religion] have low [concept_acceptance] take a much longer time, while it goes faster for those of [concept_religion] with high $concept_acceptance$. #v $academics$#! and #v $aristocrats$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $clergymen$#!.
CLERKS_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Any pop can become #v $clerks$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_literacy]. #v $laborers$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $clerks$#!.
ENGINEERS_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Only pops with adequate [concept_literacy] can become #v $engineers$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_literacy] and [concept_wealth]. #v $machinists$#! and #v $clerks$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $engineers$#!.
FARMERS_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Any pop can become #v $farmers$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_wealth]. #v $peasants$#! and #v $laborers$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $farmers$#!.
MACHINISTS_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Pops with minimal [concept_literacy] can become #v $machinists$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_literacy]. #v $laborers$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $machinists$#!.
OFFICERS_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Only #v $soldiers$#! or pops of [concept_culture] with high enough [concept_acceptance] can become #v $officers$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_literacy]. #v $aristocrats$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $officers$#!.
SHOPKEEPERS_QUALIFICATIONS_DESC: Only pops with some [concept_wealth] can become #v $shopkeepers$#!. Potential increases with greater [concept_wealth]. #v $clerks$#! and #v $farmers$#! have a particularly easy time becoming #v $shopkeepers$#!.
identity_sovereign_empire_desc: This $concept_power_bloc_identity_extra_short$ is focused on an [Concept('concept_overlord', '$concept_overlord_possessive$')] [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] and territories within the $concept_power_bloc$.
identity_military_treaty_organization_de: This $concept_power_bloc_identity_extra_short$ is focused around having a militaristic approach, the specifics of which can be determined through [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle', '$concept_power_bloc_principles$')].
identity_trade_league_desc: This $concept_power_bloc_identity_extra_short$ is heavily focused on [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')] banding together to focus on internal and external trade.
identity_ideological_union_desc: This $concept_power_bloc_identity_extra_short$ values ideological cohesion among its [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')], while not being tied to a specific political side or ideology.
identity_religious_desc: This $concept_power_bloc_identity_extra_short$ focuses on religious unity. It thrives in religious homogeneity.
identity_cultural_desc: This $concept_power_bloc_identity_extra_short$ focuses on cultural unity. It thrives in cultural homogeneity.
principle_group_construction_desc: Efforts in the $concept_power_bloc$ to streamline [concept_construction] of [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')] have resulted in higher efficiency and even the creation of specialized [Concept('concept_company', '$concept_companies$')].
principle_group_internal_trade_desc: [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')] agree to reduce [concept_tariffs] and harmonize regulations to facilitate the free flow of [Concept('concept_good', '$concept_goods$')] and services within the $concept_power_bloc$.
principle_group_market_unification_desc: Unifying the [Concept('concept_market', '$concept_markets$')] of all [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')] under the [Concept('concept_power_bloc_leader', '$concept_power_bloc_leader_possessive_short$')] guidance, leading to higher cooperation within the $concept_power_bloc$ and less with external [Concept('concept_country', '$concept_countries$')].
principle_group_vassalization_desc: Benefits from turning the trusting [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')] of the $concept_power_bloc$ into loyal servants.
principle_group_advanced_research_desc: Internal communication for the exchange of scientific information benefitting all [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')].
principle_group_defensive_cooperation_de: The $concept_power_bloc$ commits to mutual defense, ensuring collective security and strategic alignment among [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')].
principle_group_aggressive_coordination_: Strengthening the Bloc's capabilities to plan offensive maneuvers.
principle_group_external_trade_desc: The $concept_power_bloc$ adopts a unified external [Concept('concept_tariffs', '$concept_tariff$')] and trade policy to negotiate favorable trade agreements with #b non-member#! countries.
principle_group_food_standardization_des: Standardization of food production related processes. The food is easier to produce and even healthier.
principle_group_police_coordination_desc: New equipment and tactics for local police forces make them more effective.
principle_group_transport_desc: Guidelines stipulate the joint development and funding of cross-border transport infrastructure to enhance connectivity and economic integration.
principle_group_military_industry_desc: [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle', '$concept_power_bloc_principles$')] dictate collaborative development and production of military technologies and equipment.
principle_group_colonial_offices_desc: [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] are designed to maximize resource extraction and economic benefit from [Concept('concept_colony', '$concept_colonies$')], ensuring the metropolitan [concept_country] effectively controls and profits from $concept_colonial$ territories.
principle_group_foreign_investment_desc: The $concept_power_bloc$ establishes transparent rules for foreign investors, aiming to attract and protect overseas investments.
principle_group_creative_legislature_des: Guidelines encourage streamlined legislative processes across [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')], making [concept_law] enactment more efficient.
principle_group_freedom_of_movement_desc: [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')] ensure the right to work, live, and travel freely across borders, fostering cultural exchange and economic opportunities.
principle_group_divine_economics_desc: [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle', '$concept_power_bloc_principles$')] integrate religious values and church oversight into economic policies.
principle_group_exploit_members_desc: [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle', '$concept_power_bloc_principles$')] allow the [Concept('concept_power_bloc_leader', '$concept_power_bloc_leader_short$')] to leverage the resources and labor of weaker [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')].
principle_group_sacred_civics_desc: Governmental policies and civic duties are considered to be infused with a religious or mystical significance that goes beyond mere mundane politics.
principle_group_ideological_truth_desc: [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] enforce the propagation and education of the $concept_power_bloc_possessive$ official ideology, suppressing dissenting views to maintain ideological purity and unity among [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')].
principle_group_companies_desc: Encouraging the usage of [Concept('concept_company', '$concept_companies$')] and [Concept('concept_company_charter', '$concept_company_charters$')] to prosper.
principle_group_shared_canon_desc: Shared traditions and histories give the [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')] of the $concept_power_bloc$ a common vocabulary for governance, education, and public life.
principle_group_navy_desc: [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member', '$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')] commit to expanding naval capacity and shipbuilding infrastructure to secure dominance at sea and safeguard [concept_trade], territory, and strategic [Concept('concept_interest', '$concept_interests$')].

ship_type_frigate_desc: A lightly armed sailing ship used for scouting, patrol, and escort duties.
ship_type_iron_frigate_desc: An iron-hulled evolution of the sailing frigate, this ship combines the traditional roles of the frigate with increased durability and firepower.
ship_type_ship_of_the_line_desc: A large warship designed to operate in the line of battle. The Ship of the Line carries numerous guns on multiple decks.
ship_type_monitor_desc: A low-profile armored vessel designed for use in coastal waters.
ship_type_coastal_defense_ship_desc: A heavily armed and armored vessel designed for use in harbors and coastal waters.
ship_type_destroyer_desc: A fast, but heavily armed vessel designed for fleet and escort operations.
ship_type_aircraft_carrier_desc: A ship from which airplanes may take off and land, the Aircraft Carrier's duties involve reconnaissance as well as some offensive operations.
ship_type_torpedo_boat_desc: Small, agile vessels designed to deliver devastating strikes on larger, slower warships.
ship_type_torpedo_boat_destroyer_desc: A vessel designed to counter smaller torpedo boats, while still being capable of launching torpedo attacks themselves.
ship_type_light_cruiser_desc: Lightly armored cruisers built for long-range patrol, trade protection, and power projection.
ship_type_armored_cruiser_desc: A larger cruiser with a heavy armor belt, capable of engaging most targets save battleships.
ship_type_protected_cruiser_desc: A fast, long-range cruiser with an armored deck protecting its vital components.
ship_type_seaplane_tender_desc: A ship designed to carry and launch seaplanes for reconnaissance and limited offensive operations.
ship_type_early_ironclad_desc: A powerful ocean-going, steam-powered, and iron-armored vessel.
ship_type_modern_ironclad_desc: An evolution of the traditional ironclad, the modern ironclad incorporates many
ship_type_pre_dreadnought_desc: A powerful battleship mounting a mixed battery of heavy guns.
ship_type_dreadnought_desc: A revolutionary battleship built around a uniform battery of heavy guns.
ship_type_super_dreadnought_desc: An enlarged dreadnought with heavier guns and greater armor.
ship_type_submarine_desc: A dive-capable vessel primarily intended for use against enemy merchant shipping.
ship_type_early_troop_ship_desc: A sailing merchantman pressed into military service to carry soldiers overseas.
ship_type_troop_ship_desc: A purpose-built supply ship designed to carry men and materiel across the globe.
ship_type_supply_ship_desc: A ship that transports military goods from one place to another.
ship_graphics_type_borodino_desc: The Borodino class pre-dreadnoughts were the newest battleships in the Russian Imperial Navy at the time of the Russo-Japanese War. Forming the nucleus of Admiral Rozhestvensky's doomed Second Pacific Squadron, four members of the class would be sunk or captured at the Battle of Tsushima.
ship_graphics_type_mikasa_desc: The flagship of Admiral Tōgō throughout the Russo-Japanese War, the pre-dreadnought battleship Mikasa fought in every major fleet action of the war – becoming an enduring symbol of Japan's naval ascendancy.
ship_graphics_type_dingyuan_desc: The pride of the Beiyang Fleet, the ironclad battleships Dingyuan and Zhenyuan were the most striking symbols of late-Qing military modernization. Fighting valiantly at the Battle of Yalu River, their performance was hampered by the chronic underfunding of the Chinese Imperial Navy.
ship_group_capital_ships_desc: Capital ships are the largest, most combat capable ships afloat and are intended for service in the line of battle.
ship_group_cruisers_desc: Cruisers are smaller, more lightly armed vessels intended for long-range cruising operations.
ship_group_torpedo_craft_desc: Torpedo craft are small, agile vessels that rely on the self-propelled torpedo as their main armament.
ship_group_supply_ships_desc: Supply ships are the civilian and purpose-built vessels that support and resupply military fleet operations.

default_social_hierarchy_desc: A system of organization which classifies members of society into clearly defined categories, seeking to describe social relationships between individuals and groups. Greater material and social resources are afforded to those in higher status groups than those in lower status ones, leading to divergent outcomes and opportunities.
upper_class_desc: Members of society with the most privilege and undisputed power. They are in the upper echelon of the Social Hierarchy.
middle_class_desc: Members of society with more privilege than the Lower Class. They are mid-ranking within the Social Hierarchy and have some potential for social mobility.
lower_class_desc: Members of society with the least privilege, power, and wealth. They are of the lowest ranking of the Social Hierarchy and have limited social mobility.
british_indian_caste_system_desc: A simplified codification by the British of an ancient Hindu class hierarchy. Initially created to serve and guide the central administration of the Raj. One's position in the hierarchy, and thus one's rights and privileges, are inherited and fixed.
british_indian_caste_system_trigger_desc: Has #b $hindu$#! [concept_religion] and belongs to a [concept_culture] that has the #b $heritage_group_south_asian$#! [concept_heritage_trait]
brahmins_desc: Traditionally teachers and priests, the Brahmins are the sole people with the right to interpret religious Hindu texts. As such, they dictate the divine rights and privileges afforded to every other caste. Brahmins within the Raj often serve as political representatives and intermediaries.
kshatriyas_desc: Traditionally warriors, the Khashtriyas are charged with military and leadership positions. They enjoy most rights and privileges, bar the ability to dictate divine will.
vaishyas_desc: The Vaishya caste consists of merchants, traders, and landowners. As such, they are allowed to accumulate wealth and knowledge in the service of the castes above them.
shudras_desc: Shudras are the lowest class within the four recognized castes. They are restricted to servant and labor positions at the mercy of higher castes. They cannot accumulate wealth or knowledge.
dalit_desc: A term used to describe those born out of the four castes. Dalits have no way to join the hierarchy. As such, they are and have been, ostracized and marginalized for generations. Dalits are forced to do menial labor and are afforded no rights or privileges.
STRATA_CONCEPTS_DEPEND_ON_SOCIAL_HIERARC: Which $concept_pops$ belong to this Strata depends on the [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] [concept_social_hierarchy].
objective_great_game_desc: The new century marks the beginning of a long conflict waged across the world's largest continent, through intrigue, warfare, and deft diplomacy. Guide Russia and Britain to dominate Asia, or lead Afghanistan or Persia on the path to sovereignty.
gg_core.1.d: Through intrigue, deft diplomacy, and decisive warfare, we have brought the Great Game to a favorable conclusion. Our victory has brought [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] glory, and [SCOPE.sCountry('opponent_scope').GetName] humiliation on the world stage.
gg_core.1.f: Even the [SCOPE.sCountry('opponent_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] newspapers were saying it, now. The headlines that once spun even great setbacks into subtle victories and bouts of revanchism seemed subdued, solemnly reporting on foreign affairs as if [ROOT.GetCountry.GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] hegemony had been something that had always existed. The Ambassador looked at the spread of papers, and turned to a clerk who was barely repressing his own excitement.\n\n
gg_core.1.a: A jewel in our crown to match none other.
gg_core.2.d: Decisive [SCOPE.sCountry('opponent_scope').GetAdjective] victories across the fields of the Great Game have caused [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] immense humiliation on the world stage. The conflict is over, and it has ended with our defeat.
gg_core.3.d: Despite enormous expenditures in the battle for international influence, neither [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] nor [SCOPE.sCountry('opponent_scope').GetName] has achieved a decisive victory in the Great Game. Both sides have emerged from the conflict bruised and unable to best the other.
gg_core.3.f: Even before the Game was halfway through, there had been tell-alls published about it. Explorers' journals, musing about what they had seen in Bukhara or Kabul. No consensus had ever been reached, though there were periods where some ephemeral triumph had made it fashionable to proclaim a British or Russian advantage.\n\nOne was being reached now, however, and it was one that neither nation was proud of. The Great Game as a folly. From there, it would only be one short step towards a new game, one of finding a politician to blame.
gg_core.4.d: The Great Game which once treated our homelands as a playing-field between foreign powers has been brought to an end. The last [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetAdjective] and [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetAdjective] forces have departed Central Asia, forced out not by the other's machinations, but by our own hands.
gg_core.4.f: In this day, newspapers were easier to come by. The minister had accumulated quite a collection - the Times of [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName], the [SCOPE.sCountry('russia_scope').GetCapital.GetCityHubName] Record, the Correspondent from Paris. Last week, they had reported on the return of a military expedition. This week, on the resignation of his counterpart in the [SCOPE.sCountry('britain_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting]. A dozen minor stories which hinted at their painful reality. They had failed, and were trying to save face. They, ever-haughty, may be unwilling to say it outright - but he knew nonetheless, and he expected their own people did as well.
gg_core.4.a: They will address us as equals, now and forever.

je_unify_afghanistan_objective_reason: The fall of the Durrani Empire has left Afghanistan in a state of constant civil war between petty contenders for the throne. In order to ward off the enroaching European powers, we must form a unified and enduring Afghan state.
je_unify_afghanistan_reason: The succession crisis sparked by the death of Timur Shah Durrani in 1793 has thrown the former Durrani Empire into a period of endless civil strife. With the threat of European powers enroaching from all sides, we must take it upon ourselves to end this period of warring principalities and reconstruct a unified Afghanistan.\n\nWhile appealing to a European [concept_great_power] to assist us in reunification may earn us their support, their #bold opponents#! will become more hostile towards our goals.

je_consolidate_afghanistan_amu_darya_lin: Drawing a border along the Amu Darya river will provide a solid buffer between Tajikistan and Kashmir, at the cost of abandoning any territory we may control South of the river.

gg_afghanistan.1.d: The [Concept('concept_great_power','$concept_great_powers$')] of [SCOPE.sCountry('gp_scope').GetName] and [SCOPE.sCountry('rival_gp_scope').GetName] have mutually agreed upon a plan to
gg_afghanistan.1.f: The tone was that of a world-shaking document, one which would usher in peace in the region for centuries to come. Each concession from [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] was worded as a favor from one of the competing powers, the transfer of land claimed by one of the two to the people already inhabiting it. It was a wonder, the ambassador mused, that the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] had been informed of the agreement at all.
gg_afghanistan.1.a: We have no choice but to accept.
gg_afghanistan.1.b: Object to this in the strongest terms we may.
gg_afghanistan.2.d: The [SCOPE.sCountry('afghanistan_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] has sent [SCOPE.sCountry('afghanistan_scope').GetRuler.GetHerHis] response to the proposed [SCOPE.sCountry('gp_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting]-[SCOPE.sCountry('rival_gp_scope').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] agreement - a firm denial. With the Afghan government unwilling to enforce the treaty in its present state, we may need to make alterations.
gg_afghanistan.2.f: As he exited, the courier fully expected that the glares of the [SCOPE.sCountry('afghanistan_scope').GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle]'s companions would make the tails of his coat catch fire. He was backed by thousands of guns, millions of pounds, fleets of stately vessels - but none of that mattered in the now, far from any shore, with the nearest outpost miles away.
gg_afghanistan.3.d: [SCOPE.sCountry('afghan_nation_scope').GetName] has petitioned for our assistance in the reunification of Afghanistan. Securing a friendly Afghan state will be of use as a tool against our rivals in the region.
gg_afghanistan.3.f: The map was loosely defined at best. A selection of states born from the collapse of the Durrani Empire, representing the warring scions of the Barakzai and Durrani dynasties, as well as attempts at representing the areas of control of local tribes and rebellious provinces. The envoy placed the letter on the desk nearby, looking at the bespectacled staff officer he had walked in on.\n\n
gg_afghanistan.3.b: We have no interest in this.
gg_afghanistan.4.d: With the defeat of the last rebellious province, the civil wars unleashed by the fall of the Durrani Empire have come to an end. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullName] is now the sole legitimate [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetPrimaryRoleTitle] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
gg_afghanistan.4.f: The wars had been the easiest part, [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] mused. Managing the loyalties of the tribes and [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetHerHis] subordinates had always been more involved, and now [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe] would have to do much the same on a national scale. If the government faltered, how long would it take for another wave of revolts? It was a rare [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetWomanMan] indeed who could win through both war and peace.\n\nFor now, however, it was time to celebrate. The people were joyous, and demanded a speech. [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetSheHe|U] would give them one.
gg_afghanistan.4.a: There is yet more land to reconquer.
gg_afghanistan.4.b: We shall keep our country as long as we can.
gg_afghanistan.5.d: Our proposal for the Northern border of #v $AFG$#! contradicts that proposed by the [SCOPE.sCountry('sender_scope').GetAdjective] negotiating team, to the extent that a compromise cannot be reached. One side must give for the negotiation process to move forwards.
gg_afghanistan.5.f: There were three lines drawn across northern Afghanistan, in different coloured ink. They diverged from one another wildly, meandering over the Torkestan mountains and the Amu Darya, the Turkmen desert and the southern Pamirs, the depressingly few overlaps appearing as rainbow-colored blots where the ink had bled through the paper completely.\n\n
gg_afghanistan.5.e: Our decision is final. The [SCOPE.sCountry('sender_scope').GetAdjective] must acquiesce.
gg_afghanistan.6.d: Our proposal for the Southwestern border of #v $AFG$#! contradicts that proposed by the [SCOPE.sCountry('sender_scope').GetAdjective] negotiating team, to the extent that a compromise cannot be reached. One side must give for the negotiation process to move forwards.
gg_afghanistan.6.f: There were three lines drawn across northeastern India, in different coloured ink. They diverged from one another wildly, meandering over the Indus river and the Baluchi Desert, forming arbitrary shapes as they snaked crazily up through the rippling mountains of the Kakar ranges, the depressingly few overlaps appearing as rainbow-colored blots where the ink had bled through the paper completely.\n\n
gg_afghanistan.6.e: Our decision is final. The [SCOPE.sCountry('sender_scope').GetAdjective] must acquiesce.
je_disrupt_russian_caucasus_reason: The fledgling state of Circassia, located on the Black Sea in the Caucasus region, presents an opportunity to arrest Russian consolidation in the region. Extending recognition to the Circassian state, and ensuring its continued existence, must be a priority of ours.
je_secure_persian_border_reason: The presence of insurgent states in the North Caucasus threatens our control of the region, and by extension our ability to project power in the Middle East. The long-running Caucasian War must come to an end that is favorable to our nation.
je_codify_chinese_border_reason: Our border with China is both long and unformalized. Seeking to draw a formal border between our state and China could permit generous transfers of land into our control, and a minimal risk of future border conflicts.

je_chinese_concessions_reason: The region of Manchuria contains several areas which may serve as valuable warm-water ports. Acquiring treaty concessions and constructing railways in the region will immensely benefit our power projection in the Pacific Ocean.

je_pacify_kazakh_steppes_reason: Despite formally extending our authority over the various Kazakh Khanates in the early eighteenth century, effectively governing the Kazakh steppe has proven difficult. Our re-organization of the region in 1828 has officially replaced each former Khan with a Russian-appointed [Concept('concept_ruler','$RULER_TITLE_SENIOR_SULTAN$')], but the issue of banditry and widespread discontent with their rule remains. To resolve this, the three Zhuzes must be successfully pacified and brought under direct Russian rule.
je_acquire_korean_protectorate_reason: The Korean Peninsula represents an opportunity for further expansion of our influence into East Asia and the Pacific Ocean. A properly developed Korea under our supervision could rival Japan, and serve to bolster our Far Eastern possessions against foreign invasion.
je_counter_russian_pacific_influence_rea: The Russian acquisition of quality ports on their Pacific coast represents an unacceptable risk of losing naval dominance in the north Pacific. To contain their influence in the region, we must seek a reliable ally amongst the independent powers of the region.

je_consolidate_british_india_reason: The existence of independent states on the fringes of the [SCOPE.sCountry('india_scope').GetName] represents opportunity to expand and enrich our colonies in the region, as well as remove possible avenues for our opponents to threaten the highly profitable lands of India.

je_pamir_expedition_dismiss_button_desc: This proposal is almost certain to lead to a ruinous full-scale war against Russia. It is best that it never again sees the light of day.

movement_events.1.a: We must respect the principle of free expression.
movement_events.1.b: Confiscate this pamphlet wherever it emerges.
movement_events.1.c: Begin an inquiry into the identities of its authors.
movement_events.2.d1: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_agitator').GetFullName] has assisted with founding a national organization dedicated to uniting the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] under a national leadership.

movement_events.2.b: Send them a firm reminder of our disapproval.
movement_events.3.d: Organizers affiliated with the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] have founded an organization devoted to fostering popular participation in politics in the [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetNameNoFormatting] region.
movement_events.3.a: The people have begun to make themselves heard.
movement_events.3.b: Order this shuttered before it grows out of control.
movement_events.4.d: Several prominent supporters of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] have approached the government with an ambitious petition to see through their agenda. The petition has been promoted as a necessary starting point amongst the movement's membership.
movement_events.4.f: There were at least a hundred signatures on the paper, some unintelligibly ornate, others generic names that the official would have to do some incredible feats of deduction to narrow down. This was the benefit of a petition - past a certain point, it became infeasible to punish every signatory.\n\nIf one person dissented, it would be easy to scoop them up, but when it was a thousand, things became much more difficult.
movement_events.4.a: Permit debate on the raised issues.
movement_events.4.b: The formal procedures of government must be upheld.
movement_events.4.c: Order an investigation into this convenient list of names.
movement_events.5.d: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] has convened in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetCityHubName] to rally support and publicly discuss the specifics of [SCOPE.sLawType('relevant_law').GetName]. The event has attracted much attention from locals.
movement_events.6.d: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] has organized mass protests across the [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetName] region. While the protests have remained peaceful for now, local authorities have raised concerns about possible violence.
movement_events.6.f: It was more people than he had every seen. [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetFarmHubName], once quiet and known for an almost pastorial character, had come alive with shouting voices and waving flags. He wondered if any of his neighbors were in that crowd. He had always thought that he shared nothing in common with them. Perhaps he had been wrong.
movement_events.6.a: Allow them to air their concerns.
movement_events.6.b: The authorities must act to halt these displays.

In some cities, there is scarcely a wall left unmarked by pro-[SCOPE.sLawType('relevant_law').GetName] displays.

#italic Refreshments available at 7:30 for all attendees. Subscribe to the local
movement_events.7.a: They will wash away with the rain.
movement_events.7.b: Order these walls cleaned at once.
movement_events.8.d: The arrest and alleged ill treatment of a disorderly protester affiliated with the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] has sparked resentment amongst his compatriots. Further demonstrations have been arranged, urging his release.
movement_events.8.f: Prison was a miserable place. Iron bars, stone walls, and cold floors. In the past few weeks, the guards had taken to casually tapping their batons against the bars when they passed by, making sleep impossible. He could not even escape in his dreams, as the tension he felt in the waking world began to bleed into his sleep as well.\n\nAnd all this for pushing a policeman away? He had regretted it, at first. Now, though, perhaps he could say that every one of them deserved that, and more.
movement_events.8.a: Perhaps an early release for good behavior can be arranged.
movement_events.8.b: We will not make exceptions because of some hooligans.
movement_events.9.d: A wave of workers' strikes inspired by the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] have wracked industries in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetName]. Striking workers have joined protests in several cities across the region.
movement_events.9.f: The officer had expected the workers to be different than they were. Unwashed, stained with industrial effluvia, soaked in sweat. They were none of those things. They wore the same clothes they would on the weekends, fresh and clean. There was pride in their eyes. Instead of the cowed expression of exhausted men, they stood defiant, their faces hard, their hands gripping signs that called for the world and more.
movement_events.9.a: Make it known that we recognize their demands.
movement_events.10.d: A demonstration organized by the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetName] has been violently dispersed by police, leading to several fatalities and serious injuries. Memories of the incident have become a rallying cry for dissidents.
movement_events.10.f: He had been smiling, when he ordered his horse through the crowd. His expression was etched in her mind as if by acid on a metal plate. What kind of man could maintain such a hideous serenity amongst the screams, the broken bones, the spurts of blood? As people fled around him, he had ordered his officers forward... and then what?\n\nAmidst the blur of human terror, she had found herself sheltering in a haphazardly shuttered bar. Many others had not been so lucky. When she walked through the place where the demonstration had been held, she could not tell how many of the people sprawled across the flagstones were still moving.
movement_events.10.b: They were ordered to disperse. The police are not to blame.
movement_events.11.d: An explicitly partisan newspaper founded by members of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetCityHubName] has published its first issue. Between advertisements and political cartoons, it hosts ruthless critique of government policy.
movement_events.11.f: There was a certain brilliance to it. By printing it on the cheapest paper, by skimping on ink, by flooding it with advertisements and large text, one could produce a profitable paper for only a penny per copy, whilst its competitors sold for five to ten times that amount. By making that paper relentlessly and shamelessly endorse a certain viewpoint, one could have every working person in their city aware of it by evening. If one's competitors refused to stoop that low, they would become responsible for their own suffocation.
movement_events.11.a: How long can a partisan paper last?
movement_events.11.b: Is that so? Deny them a printing license.
movement_events.12.d: A series of perceived poor decisions by the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] has led to a notable decrease in its ability to raise money. Numerous wealthy sympathizers have quietly halted their support for the movement in its current form.
movement_events.12.a: Perhaps it will find alternative sources of funds.
movement_events.12.b: Everything dies in the end, some faster than others.
movement_events.13.d: Organizers affiliated with the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] have embarked on a focused campaign to inspire support for [SCOPE.sLawType('relevant_law').GetNameNoFormatting] in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetName].
movement_events.13.f: Residents of every region in the world like to say that their home has a long and unique history of tight-knit community. The organizer almost agreed. The problem was, of course, was that said community often did not extend to outsiders. He had been thrown out on his ear more times than he could count, but he persisted nonetheless. If he could introduce the right phrase into the right circles, perhaps even an idea that had been rejected out of hand at first would begin to find purchase.
movement_events.13.a: There are plenty of willing ears in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetNameNoFormatting].
movement_events.13.b: They must be concerned with far more grounded things.
movement_events.14.d: A group of students attending the [SCOPE.sBuilding('relevant_university').GetName] in [SCOPE.sState('relevant_state').GetName] have arranged a demonstration in support of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName]. The display has inspired other students to join the cause.
movement_events.14.f: The lecture hall was barren. There were always one or two students missing, for illnesses, travel, or family occasions, but nothing of this scale. There were three or four students per row, each thrown into sharp contast by the empty seats to their sides. It was material for a lecture of its own, he thought. Like a heap of sand whose grains had blown away one after another until its form suddenly changed, so followed what had once been a class.
movement_events.14.a: The youth will lead [ROOT.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting] into the future!
movement_events.14.b: They had ought to focus on their studies.
movement_events.15.d: An event organized by the [SCOPE.sPoliticalMovement('relevant_movement').GetName] transformed into a brawl as opponents of the movement infiltrated the crowd. When the police arrived, no participant was willing to give a consistent statement.
movement_events.15.f: Most of them had at least one bruise, a cut lip, or a bloody nose. His was much less honorably obtained than most of theirs. He had whacked his hip against the corner of a table while rushing for the exit, only to nearly run headlong into an approaching gendarme. Two conflicting stories rose to mind. One that he would tell to the detective, and one that he would tell to his friends.
movement_events.15.a: Give them all a day in jail to cool off.
movement_events.15.b: Seek charges for the event's organizers.

lobby_proposal.3.d: The [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] has offered us an opportunity to [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('pro_lobby_opportunity_text_def')] [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName]. The lobby has offered to use their connections to smooth the negotiating process.
lobby_proposal.3.f: The negotiations, done under the table with a representative of the [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] government, had been long and arduous. The [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] representative knew they were dealing with a group without power to match theirs, and had adjusted their strategy accordingly. Nonetheless, they had come to an agreement. Nothing in writing, but that was hardly important. When the government sent the official copy - if they did - they would find that there was already a drafted response waiting in [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetCapital.GetCityHubName].
lobby_proposal.3.a: We would be happy to pursue this.
lobby_proposal.3.b: This is not in our interests.

Their proposal, if accepted, is intended to counter [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjective] interests.
lobby_proposal.4.f: It was a veiled sort of aggression, one which could, in theory, appeal to both ardent jingoists and those who preferred to mitigate losses. It would force the enemy to respond, possibly drive them towards a reckless confrontation in response to a seemingly benign maneuver.\n\n
lobby_proposal.4.a: We would be happy to pursue this.

lobby_events.1.d_join: Seeking to escape accusations of communism by drawing a hard foreign policy line, the [GetIdeology('ideology_social_democrat').GetName] leadership of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] have begun to align themselves with the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.1.d_form: Seeking to escape accusations of communism by drawing a hard foreign policy line, the [GetIdeology('ideology_social_democrat').GetName] leadership of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] have laid the groundwork for a lobby to oppose [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjective] interests.
lobby_events.1.a: Their patriotism sets a good example.
lobby_events.1.b: Their patriotism sets a good example.
lobby_events.1.c: They should avoid these foreign entanglements.
lobby_events.2.d_join: Publicized accounts of discrimination against [SCOPE.sReligion('relevant_religion').GetName] people in [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName] have led the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] to align themselves with the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.2.d_form: Publicized accounts of discrimination against [SCOPE.sReligion('relevant_religion').GetName] people in [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName] have led the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] to begin lobbying for a hostile stance against [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName].
lobby_events.2.a: When words fail, we must bring the sword.
lobby_events.2.b: When words fail, we must bring the sword.
lobby_events.2.c: They wish to cause an international incident over #italic this#!?
lobby_events.3.d_join: Inspired by the prowess of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [GetPopType('engineers').GetName] and [GetPopType('academics').GetName], the technically-inclined [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] have begun to align themselves with the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.3.d_form: Inspired by the prowess of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [GetPopType('engineers').GetName] and [GetPopType('academics').GetName], the technically-inclined [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] have started to lobby in favor of closer ties with [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName].
lobby_events.3.a: We will make great strides together.
lobby_events.3.b: We will make great strides together.
lobby_events.3.c: Our creations far outstrip those cheap [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] toys.
lobby_events.4.d: The defeat of the [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_foreign_ig').GetName] in a revolution has broken the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetNameNoFormatting]'s interest in upholding the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName]. They have halted their advocacy for closer ties with [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName].
lobby_events.4.f: The letters they had sent had all gone unanswered. A discreet visit confirmed their worst suspicions - the building they once owned had been seized, and now housed an apathetic-sounding lawyer, his practice, and his extended family. This new man was a friend of a minister - one who had just fought for his position in a very literal sense. A moment's glimpse of the bullet holes that still speckled the facade served as a definitive statement that recompense would not be provided.
lobby_events.4.a: All of their work, gone in an instant.
lobby_events.4.b: It seems they're only the first of many.
lobby_events.5.d_join: The interest of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] in the lucrative [SCOPE.sGoods('relevant_goods').GetName] trade with [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName] has led them to align themselves with the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.5.d_form: The interest of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] in the lucrative [SCOPE.sGoods('relevant_goods').GetName] trade with [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName] has led them to begin lobbying in favor of closer ties with [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetNameNoFormatting].
lobby_events.5.c: Our relationship should remain strictly transactional.
lobby_events.6.d: Defectors spearheaded by the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] are rushing to depart the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName], alienated by communist rule in [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName].
lobby_events.6.a: This should come to no surprise.
lobby_events.6.b: Could we contain the scope of this defection for now?
lobby_events.7.d_join_defect: The [SCOPE.sIdeology('relevant_ideology').GetName] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName], citing international solidarity with the proletariat of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName], have defected from the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('old_lobby').GetName] to the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.7.d_join: The [SCOPE.sIdeology('relevant_ideology').GetName] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName], citing international solidarity with the proletariat of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName], have aligned themselves with the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.7.d_defect: The [SCOPE.sIdeology('relevant_ideology').GetName] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName], citing international solidarity with the proletariat of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName], have defected from the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('old_lobby').GetName] to support their [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] allies.
lobby_events.7.d_form: The [SCOPE.sIdeology('relevant_ideology').GetName] [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName], citing international solidarity with the proletariat of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetName], have begun to lobby in support of their [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] allies.
lobby_events.7.c: Do what they will, we will not hear them.
lobby_events.8.d: The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('first_party_member').GetName], prominent supporters of [SCOPE.sParty('relevant_party').GetName], have proposed support for the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] to be a component of the official party platform.
lobby_events.8.a: The party stands together on this.
lobby_events.8.b: And be accused of foreign puppeteering?
lobby_events.8.c: This could benefit the party's campaigning.
lobby_events.9.d_join: Impressed by the [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjective] military's usage of sophisticated [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('impressive_miltech_text')], the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] have begun to align themselves with the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
lobby_events.9.d_form: Impressed by the [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjective] military's usage of sophisticated #v [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetCountry.GetCustom('impressive_miltech_text')]#!, the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] have begun lobbying in favor of closer ties with [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetNameNoFormatting].
lobby_events.9.f: The reports from [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetNameNoFormatting] had been passed around the room so many times that the edges had already started to become soft. Some attendees were in awe, others more measured in their opinion. Some simply refused to believe what was written.\n\n
lobby_events.9.a: The [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] model is one worth following.

fund_lobbies_events.3.d: Reports of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjective] money arriving in the hands of domestic actors amicable to them has caused the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName] to issue a flurry of condemnations directed at its opponents.
fund_lobbies_events.3.f: Vindication was a feeling that [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetLeader.GetLastNameNoFormatting] had been feeling more and more often as of late. The reports strewn across [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetLeader.GetHerHis] desk confirmed what [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetLeader.GetSheHe] had been warning against for what felt like years - the penetration of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjectiveNoFormatting] influence into the highest levels of governance. [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetLeader.GetHerHis|U] rivals could all be said to be suspects, and [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetLeader.GetHerHis] allies painted as savvy insiders.\n\nIt would take work, of course. These same confirmations would be flowing to groups other than [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetLeader.GetHerHis], and others were certain to have the same idea. It was a race, now, and he who started earliest was nearly guaranteed to finish first.
fund_lobbies_events.3.a: They have established themselves as a sort of authority.
fund_lobbies_events.3.b: Even a broken clock is occasionally right.
fund_lobbies_events.4.d: [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetFullName], a prominent ally of the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName], has recently been sighted living significantly above [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetHerHis] means. Its freshly polished stucco was unlike the weathered facades of [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetHerHis] neighbors, all of which transmitted a sort of timeless, quiet dignity. There was none of that in [SCOPE.sCharacter('relevant_character').GetHerHis] facade, and there was none of it inside. It hosted a lavish party which seemed to blur between days without ever stopping.\n\nThe sight of it posed a question to all of who observed. It lingered in the air, palpable and pressing. How?
fund_lobbies_events.4.a: Order an investigation into the source of this wealth.

fund_lobbies_events.5.d: With the influx of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetAdjective] lobbying money, elements of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('relevant_ig').GetName] have sensed an opportunity to enrich and empower themselves. They have begun gravitating towards the [SCOPE.sPoliticalLobby('relevant_lobby').GetName].
fund_lobbies_events.5.f:
A fraction of them made excuses. A smaller fraction of them made good excuses, essays that presented lines of logic which sprawled out over hundreds of pages. Most of them did not. They claimed that their choice was informed by their friends, or by the atrocities of [SCOPE.sCountry('relevant_country').GetNameNoFormatting]'s enemies, or by their unerring sense of justice.

But why, then, said their critics, did they only come to this epiphany now? Why not when their coffers were lean, and all they had to their names were their principles?

None of them could think of an answer.
fund_lobbies_events.5.a: They had ought to be ashamed of themselves.
fund_lobbies_events.5.b: It is best to assume they have a better reason than that.
fund_lobbies_events.5.c: If an opportunity presents itself - seize it!
je_donghak_movement_reason: Donghak, or Eastern Learning, has begun to spread amongst the [GetPopType('peasants').GetName] of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName] as a response to the opening of the country to the outside world. Followers of Donghak, often affiliated with the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('donghak_ig').GetName], advocate for equality and rights for all, and a rejection of foreign influence.\n\nThe infrastructure that followers of Donghak have created spreads throughout the country, and may serve as a means to rapidly organize rebellion in the future.
je_gyojo_shinwon_reason: Followers of Donghak amongst the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('donghak_ig').GetName] have presented a petition to the government, calling for toleration of the Donghak doctrine, the expulsion of foreigners, and the execution of corrupt members of the [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('yangban_ig').GetName].\n\nThe government promising to hear the demands of the movement has temporarily reduced social unrest from its adherents, but turning our back on the petitioners will certainly lead to renewed revolutionary activity.
je_korean_rebellion_reason: The rebellion breaking out across [SCOPE.sCountry('korea_scope').GetName] has threatened the balance of power in the country. The overthrow of [SCOPE.sCharacter('korea_ruler_scope').GetPrimaryRoleTitle] [SCOPE.sCharacter('korea_ruler_scope').GetFullName] will certainly lead to independence for [SCOPE.sCountry('korea_scope').GetNameNoFormatting], and opportunities for European powers to acquire influence in the peninsula.
