lesson_reform_government_complete_desc: Your new government has a much more reasonable [concept_legitimacy] score of [GetPlayer.GetGovernmentLegitimacy], letting it attempt to enact new Laws every [GetDefine('NPolitics','LAW_ENACTMENT_COOLDOWN_DAYS')|0] days. Hopefully it is also able to enact the political changes you desire! If not, you can always make changes to your government as long as you're willing to pay the price in Legitimacy and/or Radicalism.
lesson_increase_relations_how_0_desc: You need at least #v [GetDiplomaticActionType('increase_relations').GetMaintenanceCostFormatted(GetPlayer.Self, GetTutorialJournalEntry.GetTarget.GetCountry.Self)]#! available @inf![Nbsp][concept_influence] to [GetDiplomaticActionType('increase_relations').GetName] with [GetTutorialJournalEntry.GetTarget.GetCountry.GetName]. End this lesson now and return once you have canceled some other [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')].
lesson_increase_relations_how_1_desc: [GetDiplomaticActionType('increase_relations').GetName] is a type of [concept_diplomatic_pact] and can be found under the #b Diplomacy#! Lens.
lesson_increase_relations_how_1_continue: Select [GetDiplomaticActionType('increase_relations').GetName] under #b Diplomatic Actions#! in the #b Diplomacy#! Lens
lesson_increase_relations_how_2_desc: We want to [GetDiplomaticActionType('increase_relations').GetName] with [GetTutorialJournalEntry.GetTarget.GetCountry.GetName]. Most [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')] require @inf![Nbsp][concept_influence] to maintain, and we can see how much it would cost us ahead of time.
lesson_increase_relations_how_2_continue: Find and click on [GetTutorialJournalEntry.GetTarget.GetCountry.GetName] on the map or the @map_list_plus_small! plus button in the map list to start increasing your $concept_countries$' relation
lesson_increase_relations_how_3_desc: Some [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')] require approval by the other party, in which case your request would have been sent off and returned a few weeks later with an either positive or negative response. Usually you can tell if a country would accept the $concept_diplomatic_pact$ before you send it.\n\n[GetDiplomaticActionType('increase_relations').GetName] requires no approval, and both countries could actually [GetDiplomaticActionType('increase_relations').GetName] (or [GetDiplomaticActionType('damage_relations').GetName]!) at the same time.
lesson_increase_relations_why_1_desc: Spending your @inf![Nbsp][concept_influence] on maintaining [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')] with strategically selected countries is key to increasing your soft power and expanding your sphere of influence. Increasing [concept_relations] not only encourages them to support you in conflicts but also enables you to establish other $concept_diplomatic_pacts$ with them.
lesson_increase_relations_why_1_continue: Open any $concept_country$'s #b Diplomacy#! tab to continue
lesson_increase_relations_why_2_desc: Here you can see all [Concept('concept_diplomatic_action','$concept_diplomatic_actions$')] you can take against the country, and whether or not they are likely to accept an offer if it requires their approval. Some $concept_diplomatic_actions$ require certain [concept_relations] levels to take - not always positive!\n\nIt is common for certain [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')] to require a certain level of $concept_relations$ or better, so ensure you maintain them.
lesson_increase_relations_why_3_desc: [concept_relations] naturally [concept_decay] towards #b Neutral#! over time when not maintained, and may decay faster or slower depending on current events. Negative $concept_relations$ also decay towards #b Neutral#!.
lesson_increase_relations_complete_desc: Having successfully increased your [concept_relations] with your counterpart, you can now choose to maintain this [GetDiplomaticActionType('increase_relations').GetName] [concept_diplomatic_pact] or cancel it to get more @inf![Nbsp][concept_influence] for other matters. Remember that if no country is working on your mutual $concept_relations$, it will gradually [concept_decay] towards #b Neutral#!.
lesson_expand_military_how_1_desc: Your military forces are created and maintained by [Concept('concept_military_building','$concept_military_buildings$')]. Expanding your military simply entails expanding these building.\n\nHowever unlike other buildings, these are built from a specific Formation tab.
lesson_expand_military_how_2_desc:
Barracks create and maintain [Concept('concept_battalion', '$concept_battalions$')] which make up your [concept_army]. Battalions are commanded by [Concept('concept_general', '$concept_generals$')] to advance or defend [Concept('concept_front', '$concept_fronts$')], and are used to protect the integrity of your borders, by being stationed on the front line.

Regardless of the Battalion you wish to recruit it will always build a Barrack.

Inside the [concept_military_formation] Panel you can find buttons to build new Barracks for the different unit types: Infantry, Artillery and Cavalry.
lesson_expand_military_how_2_continue: Open the [GetTutorialJournalEntry.GetTarget.GetMilitaryFormation.GetName] Formation to continue and recruit units
lesson_expand_military_how_3_desc: Like all buildings, [Concept('concept_military_building','$concept_military_buildings$')] are constructed in [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')], but the [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units_short$')] they provide will be assigned to the [concept_military_formation] it was built from, and can later be transferred to other Formations. Ensure your Military originates from states where you can spare the [concept_workforce] but still have good access to [concept_infrastructure] and [Concept('concept_military_good','$concept_military_goods$')].\n\nEnsure the costs of your expanded Military is not larger than your [concept_treasury] can manage! If your budget is not balanced, wait with expanding further until you have made the necessary improvements.
lesson_expand_military_how_3_continue: Start expansion in any [concept_state] to continue
lesson_expand_military_why_1_desc: Simply put, a [concept_country] without a military cannot defend itself and therefore cannot guarantee its continued existence. While it is possible to protect yourself from aggression by pledging as a [concept_protectorate] to a country with a high [concept_rank], or even by maintaining good [concept_relations] with countries with [Concept('concept_interest','$concept_interests$')] that overlap yours, if you're hoping to become a major player on the world stage you need to back up your diplomacy with something tangible.
lesson_expand_military_why_2_desc: Every [concept_unit] contributes to your [concept_power_projection], which translates directly into [concept_prestige]. A large military might be expensive to maintain, but also impacts how capable you are and how credible you seem.\n\n@ships! [Concept('concept_ship','$concept_ships$')] improve your $concept_power_projection$ more than @battalions![Nbsp][Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] do, but can also be costly to maintain.
lesson_expand_military_why_3_desc: Having a strong economy is necessary to maintain a strong military. Both [Concept('concept_military_wage','$concept_military_wages$')] and [Concept('concept_military_good','$concept_military_goods$')] can be major expenses, particularly in times of [concept_war] due to [Concept('concept_mobilize_battalion','$concept_mobilize_battalion_mobilization$')]. Ensure your industries are able to manufacture the equipment you need, or that you have reliable trading partners for it!\n\nIt can be tempting to rely on [Concept('concept_conscription_center','$concept_conscription$')] to raise @battalions![Nbsp][Concept('concept_battalion','$concept_battalions$')] as needed, but keep in mind that conscripts are recruited from your regular [concept_workforce] and your economy may be disrupted in unforeseen ways. A standing army might be more expensive but is more sustainable in the long run, and provides [concept_power_projection] during peacetime.
lesson_expand_military_complete_desc: Your Military is now more capable! This is sure to come in handy in the future, whether for defensive, aggressive, or diplomatic reasons. As your country grows in power, you should occasionally revisit your Military forces to ensure they are sized appropriately and are able to compete globally. You will also get access to [Concept('concept_technology', '$concept_technologies$')] that let you upgrade your forces in exchange for greater [concept_good_consumption] of [Concept('concept_military_good','$concept_military_goods$')].
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how: How to Fix a Capacity Deficit
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_1: How to Fix a Capacity Deficit
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_1_desc: Much like your budget, your three [Concept('concept_capacity','$concept_capacities$')] have inflows and outflows. The value you see at the top of the screen is the size of your excess or deficit. Instead of accumulating, the balance is converted into a positive effect if above zero, and a negative effect if below zero.\n\nThe negative effect is much more severe than the positive, so it's usually better to allocate your $concept_capacities$ up to the limit than to maintain a high positive balance. However, it is always very bad to run a deficit, and you will want to correct that as soon as possible.
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_2_desc: To fix your deficit you must take stock of your inflows and outflows, and either increase your generation of the [concept_capacity], reduce your allocation of it, or both. Hovering the capacity will show the contributing factors. We will go through each in turn.
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_3_desc:
Start by hovering @bur![Nbsp][concept_bureaucracy].

@bur![Nbsp]$concept_bureaucracy$ is primarily generated by [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_3_desc_added','Government Administration')], and generating more can be as simple as constructing more of those.

It is expended to maintain [Concept('concept_taxes','$concept_tax$')] collection efficiency across your [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporated_states$')], and this cost scales by the size of your population. Furthermore, each [concept_institution] [concept_investment_level] costs a certain amount of @bur![Nbsp]$concept_bureaucracy$ depending on the size of your $concept_incorporated$ population.

In addition, @bur![Nbsp]$concept_bureaucracy$ is allocated to maintain [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')], with higher [concept_commander_rank] demanding more $concept_bureaucracy$.
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_4_desc:
Maintaining a @bur![Nbsp][concept_bureaucracy] excess increases @construction![Nbsp][concept_construction] efficiency, letting you get better bang for your buck from your [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_4_desc_added','Construction Sector')].

If you run a deficit you incur [concept_tax_waste], which can rapidly sink your economy.

While constructing additional [SelectLocalization(GetPlayer.IsValid,'lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_4_desc_added_2','Government Administration')] or switching them to more effective [Concept('concept_production_method','$concept_production_methods$')] is usually the best way to fix a @bur![Nbsp][concept_bureaucracy] deficit, if this is not on the table you can always reduce an [Concept('concept_institution','$concept_institution_possessive$')] [concept_investment_level] or retire a [concept_commander].
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_6_desc:
Maintaining an @aut![Nbsp][concept_authority] excess increases your legislative efficiency, letting you [Concept('concept_enactment_of_laws','$concept_enactment_of_laws_enact$')] [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')] faster (though not necessarily easier).

If you run a deficit of [concept_authority] the [concept_approval] of [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] [concept_in_opposition] will decrease, causing negative [Concept('concept_interest_group_trait','$concept_interest_group_traits$')] to activate, more frequent and [concept_radical] [Concept('concept_political_movement','$concept_political_movements$')], possibly even [concept_revolution].

Enacting stricter $concept_laws$ is one way of increasing generation of @aut![Nbsp][concept_authority], but when you are already running a deficit it may be safer in the short-term to cancel a [concept_decree] or even issue a temporary [concept_consumption_tax] relief.
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_8_desc:
Maintaining an @inf![Nbsp][concept_influence] excess increases your [concept_infamy] [concept_decay], which helps manage the fallout of starting and making claims in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')].

Running a deficit can be catastrophic, as it penalizes your [concept_prestige] which in turn can affect your [concept_rank] and cause your @inf![Nbsp]$concept_influence$ generation to drop.

If you want to have a voice in world affairs you should always be working towards greater $concept_prestige$ and $concept_rank$ to maximize your @inf![Nbsp]$concept_influence$, but this is a long-term pursuit and not a solution to a deficit. To get yourself out of an $concept_influence$ hole you need to break [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts_short$')] or, if the deficit is small enough, you can establish a [concept_rivalry].
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_how_9_desc: Use the information in the previous steps to bring the balance of the relevant [concept_capacity] up above zero. Depending on your approach it may take a while; that is okay, as long as you keep an eye on the consequences and move in the right direction.\n\nGood luck!
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_complete: Your [concept_capacity] has returned to positive balance!
lesson_fix_capacity_deficit_complete_des: Nice work! Ensuring you maintain at least a small excess in each [concept_capacity] is always a good idea, as it protects you from unexpected deficits and gives you a minor bonus. But don't overdo it, since the benefit you get from allocating the $concept_capacity$ is usually more valuable than the bonus you get from the excess, and it is often possible to withdraw allocations to return to a positive balance.
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_1_d: New [Concept('concept_commander','$concept_commanders$')] can be recruited on any [Concept('concept_military_formation','$concept_military_formation_possessive$')] info panel, either an [concept_army] or a [concept_fleet].
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_2_d: Each [concept_army] or [concept_fleet] has a single [concept_commander]. They affect the [concept_command_limit] that your [concept_military_formation] has available. When you press the big + button in the $concept_commander$ section, you will see a few candidates for a new one.
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_2_c: Open the $concept_commander$ Recruitment popup via the + button in the $concept_commander$ section
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_3_d: You now have several choices of $concept_commander$ to choose between. Let's take a look at why you might want to choose one over another.
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_4_d: Their [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] impact their behavior and abilities in and outside of [concept_battle]. Tooltip them to find out what they do. Some $concept_character_traits$ only have an impact if the [concept_character] acts in a particular role. We are currently only interested in the effects the $concept_character_traits$ have for $concept_commanders$.\n\n#u Blue#! $concept_character_traits$ are #u Personality#! $concept_character_traits$, which all $concept_characters$ have only one of. It will generally not change. #v White#! $concept_character_traits$ are #v Skill#! $concept_character_traits$, which affect the $concept_character_possessive$ abilities in their current [concept_character_role]. #v Skill#! $concept_character_traits$ can be gained or developed over time with [concept_life_experience]. #r Red#! $concept_character_traits$ are #r Conditions#!, which have a negative impact on the $concept_character$ and typically do not change.
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_5_d: All characters are members of an [concept_interest_group] whose politics they support. $concept_commanders$ increase their $concept_interest_group$'s [concept_clout]. When an $concept_interest_group$ revolts, $concept_commanders$ who support them will join the revolution. It is prudent to ensure your highest-ranking $concept_commanders$ support the kind of politics you want to see in your country.
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_6_d: [concept_commander_rank] determines the $concept_commander$'s [concept_command_limit] as well as the degree by which they increase their $concept_interest_group$'s [concept_clout]. Most $concept_commanders$ start their career as first rank, but you can promote them anytime to increase it at a cost of @bur![concept_bureaucracy].
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_7_d: Evaluate your options and choose a [concept_commander] to recruit.
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_8_d: You can find the [concept_general] you recruited in the Formation tab. Find the [concept_commander] you recruited and select their portrait to continue.
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_8_c: Go to the newly recruited #b Commander's#! Panel
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_8_b: Open the Recruit Commander panel to go back
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_9_d: From here you can promote the [concept_commander] to a higher [concept_commander_rank]. This will not increase their abilities but only their [concept_command_limit], which governs the size of the force they can have under their direct command.
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_9_b: Close the recruited #b Commander's#! Panel to backtrack
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_how_10_: You can promote the [concept_commander] by clicking the #b Promote#! button on this panel, open the interactions menu, or right-clicking the $concept_commander$ in any interface.
Promote the $concept_commander$ to complete the tutorial.
lesson_recruit_promote_commander_complet:
Recruiting and promoting another $concept_commander$ has increased the potential number of [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] you are able to order around, and increased the numbers of $concept_units$ under the $concept_commander$'s direct command.

It has also given you access to a character with new [Concept('concept_character_trait','$concept_character_traits$')] that might become useful. The [concept_clout] of the new $concept_commander$'s [concept_interest_group] has also increased. All this has come at an expense in @bur![concept_bureaucracy].

These effects will remain until the $concept_commander$ dies or is forced to retire. If you choose to retire the $concept_commander$ in the future, it would impact the [concept_approval] of their $concept_interest_group$.
lesson_declare_interest_how_1_desc: [Concept('concept_interest','$concept_interests$')] are established by building up [concept_involvement] in the relevant [concept_strategic_region].\n\n$HOW_TO_INCREASE_INVOLVEMENT$
lesson_declare_interest_how_1_continue: Find and click #b Declare Interest#! in the #b Diplomatic#! Lens
lesson_declare_interest_how_2_desc: Now try to build up your [concept_involvement] in the target [concept_strategic_region] until you have at least enough $concept_involvement$ to reach the [GetInterestTierType('interest_tier_observant').GetName] [Concept('concept_interest_tier', '$concept_interest_tier_short$')].
lesson_declare_interest_why_1_desc: By default you always gain an [concept_interest] in your [Concept('concept_capital_state', '$concept_capital_state_short$')] [concept_strategic_region] and all $concept_strategic_regions$ neighboring it. Beyond that you can create more $concept_interests$ by building up [concept_involvement] in other $concept_strategic_regions_short$.
lesson_declare_interest_why_2_desc: An [concept_interest] can mean many things! Perhaps you intend on conquering or colonizing land in the [concept_strategic_region], or perhaps you simply want the option to intervene if others start conflicts there.\n\nIf you have a [GetDiplomaticActionType('rivalry').GetName] with another [concept_country], you gain additional @inf![Nbsp][concept_influence] for every $concept_strategic_region$ in which you both have $concept_interests$. You will both also get [concept_involvement] in $concept_strategic_regions_short$ where either of you is considered [Concept('concept_local_country', '$concept_local_country_short$')].
lesson_declare_interest_complete_desc: Your new [concept_interest] is now [Concept('concept_active_interest','$concept_active_interest_short$')], extending your reach to a new [concept_strategic_region]. This opens the door to start or participate in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')], establish new [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')], and even engage in [Concept('concept_colony','$concept_colonization$')] if there is suitable land in the $concept_strategic_region$.
lesson_start_diplomatic_play_how_1_desc: You can start [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')] via the #b Diplomatic#! Lens in the Diplomatic Play tab.
lesson_start_diplomatic_play_how_1_conti: Go to the #b Diplomatic Play#! tab in the [concept_diplomatic_lens]
lesson_start_diplomatic_play_how_2_desc: The #G green number#! in the right corner of each [concept_diplomatic_play] indicates how many [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] you can perform this $concept_diplomatic_play$ with.
lesson_start_diplomatic_play_how_2_back: Close the #b Diplomatic Play#! tab in the [concept_diplomatic_lens] to backtrack
lesson_start_diplomatic_play_how_3_desc: Now you have started a [concept_diplomatic_play] where you are the [concept_initiator]. It will now progresses in 3 phases over the upcoming months. The first phase is [concept_opening_moves] followed by [concept_diplomatic_maneuvers] and then the [concept_countdown_to_war]. If neither side backs down before the $concept_countdown_to_war$ begins, a [concept_war] is inevitable!
lesson_incorporate_state_how_1_desc: You can start [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporating$')] an [concept_unincorporated_state] under the #b State Actions#! tab in the [concept_political_lens].
lesson_incorporate_state_how_1_continue: Go to the #b State Actions#! tab in the $concept_political_lens$
lesson_incorporate_state_how_2_desc: In order to [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporate$')] a [concept_state], the $concept_state$ needs to be [Concept('concept_unincorporated_state','$concept_unincorporated_state_short$')] and #b not#! undergoing [Concept('concept_colony','$concept_colonization$')]. You currently have [GetPlayer.GetNumStatesThatCanBeIncorporated] [SelectLocalization(GreaterThan_int32(GetPlayer.GetNumStatesThatCanBeIncorporated,'(int32)1'),'$concept_unincorporated_states$','$concept_unincorporated_state$')] that can be [Concept('concept_incorporated_state', '$concept_incorporated$')].
lesson_incorporate_state_how_2_continue: Click the #b $concept_incorporate_state$#! option and start to $concept_incorporate$ one of your $concept_unincorporated_states$
lesson_incorporate_state_how_2_back: Close the #b State Actions#! tab in the $concept_political_lens$ to backtrack
lesson_incorporate_state_how_3_desc: You have now started to [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporate$')] your chosen [concept_state]. [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporating$')] [Concept('concept_state','$concept_states$')] can take many years depending on how culturally similar the territory is to your [concept_primary_cultures]. The full @bur![Nbsp][concept_bureaucracy] cost is imposed immediately, but the $concept_incorporation$ benefits will accumulate over time.
lesson_incorporate_state_complete_desc: Well done! You have now [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporated$')] an [concept_unincorporated_state]. This means they will now pay taxes, gain access to benefits from [Concept('concept_institution', '$concept_institutions$')], and participate fully in your Country's political system.
lesson_interest_group_1_desc: Interest Groups can be viewed on the $POLITICS$ panel in the $OVERVIEW$ tab.
lesson_interest_group_1_continue: Open the $POLITICS$ panel on the $OVERVIEW$ tab
lesson_interest_group_2_desc:
An [concept_interest_group] is a faction within your country whose [concept_pop] supporters share a political interest. $concept_interest_groups$ can have one of three different statuses in your country.

[concept_in_government]: part of the ruling class, whether by free elections, divine right, violent force, or other means

[concept_in_opposition]: asserting their influence outside of the halls of power

[concept_marginalized]: not strong enough to matter, dormant for all intents and purposes

All countries have the same kinds of $concept_interest_groups$, but many have unique variations depending on historical, cultural, or religious conditions.
lesson_interest_group_2_back: Close the $POLITICS$ panel on the $OVERVIEW$ tab to backtrack
lesson_interest_group_3_desc: #b You#! decide freely which of your $concept_interest_groups$ to include [concept_in_government], with the caveat that your current [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] determine how [Concept('concept_legitimacy', '$concept_legitimate$')] it is considered to be. A high $concept_legitimacy$ government is more efficient in enacting new $concept_laws$ while a low $concept_legitimacy$ government takes longer to get things done and is more prone to fall to [Concept('concept_revolution', '$concept_revolutions$')].
lesson_interest_group_3_continue: Go to any of your $concept_interest_group$'s details panel
lesson_interest_group_4_desc: The most fundamental aspect of [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] is its [Concept('concept_ideology', '$concept_ideologies$')]. These specify not only how the $concept_interest_group$ feels about [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] but also which $concept_laws$ they prefer over others.\n\nHover over an $concept_ideology$ to see the $concept_laws$ they care about and how they feel about them.
lesson_interest_group_5_desc: The [concept_ideology] at the top of the list of $concept_ideologies$ originates from its [concept_leader]. $concept_leaders$ will change during the course of the game and the Leader's $concept_ideology$ with it, but in some cases $concept_leaders$ may drastically and permanently come to change what an $concept_interest_group$ stands for.\n\n$concept_leaders$ can have other effects on an $concept_interest_group$ as well, due to its [Concept('concept_character_trait', '$concept_character_traits$')] or current [concept_popularity].
lesson_interest_group_6_desc: [Concept('concept_interest_group', '$concept_interest_groups$')] have their own [Concept('concept_interest_group_trait', '$concept_interest_group_traits$')] with direct effects across the entire country. $concept_interest_group_traits$ activates and deactivates on different [concept_approval] levels and scales in power if the $concept_interest_group$ is [concept_powerful].\n\nKeep an $concept_interest_group$ happy and your people will enjoy benefits. But if you anger them, they will lash out until you change your ways.
lesson_interest_group_7_desc: An [concept_interest_group]'s power is measured by its [concept_clout], which is equal to its share of total [concept_political_strength] across your country. $concept_political_strength$ ultimately originates from [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')], who will support those $concept_interest_groups$ they think best represents their interests in shaping the country to best benefit them.
lesson_interest_group_8_desc: All [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] supporting an [concept_interest_group] can be viewed in their panel. Note that every individual in a $concept_pop$ can decide for themselves which [concept_interest_group] to support, so support across an entire $concept_pop$ is usually split in different proportions across two to four $concept_interest_groups$.
lesson_interest_group_9_desc: [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] the [concept_interest_group] supports are also available in list form sorted in order of most to least desired. Hovering the $enact$ button will clarify the [concept_approval] effects of the $concept_law$ on this and other $concept_interest_groups$ in the country.
je_tutorial_expand_basic_building_reason: One way of growing your economy is by constructing or expanding [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')]. You cannot always know ahead of time if a certain $concept_building$ will be profitable or not, but expanding a basic agricultural $concept_building$ such as [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetBuildingType.GetName] is a relatively safe investment.

Growing your economy by constructing [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')] is a vital part of making [Country.GetName] prosper. Expanding a basic agricultural $concept_building$ such as [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetBuildingType.GetName] is a relatively safe investment. It has low material costs and produces foodstuff staples, which tend to be in high demand as they are consumed by everyone in your country. Because of this it is usually able to turn a small profit at minimal risk.\n\n@information! [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetBuildingType.GetName] are not [Concept('concept_government_building', '$concept_government_buildings$')] and do not contribute their revenues directly towards your income. Revenues are paid out as [Concept('concept_building_wage', '$concept_building_wages$')] to the [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] working in the building who will contribute some of that [concept_money] to the state through [concept_budget_income_taxes].
je_tutorial_expand_basic_building_invali: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetState.GetName] is no longer owned by [GetPlayer.GetName]
je_tutorial_fix_budget_deficit_status: Have fixed income that exceeds fixed expenses
je_tutorial_fix_budget_deficit_reason: Our economy is currently unhealthy, as our fixed expenses exceed our revenues, resulting in a weekly deficit. There are several ways to address this, such as raising taxes, cutting government/military wages, or reducing the levels of government-funded buildings.
je_tutorial_change_production_method_rea: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetState.GetName] is a [concept_building] whose earnings could potentially be improved by changing a [concept_production_method].\n\nFor the purpose of this lesson, it is recommended that you change a relatively safe $concept_production_method$, such as activating [GetGoods('fruit').GetName] or [GetGoods('liquor').GetName] production on a farm, or the use of [GetGoods('tools').GetName] on a ranch.
je_tutorial_change_production_method_inv: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetState.GetName] is no longer owned by [GetPlayer.GetName]
je_tutorial_change_production_method_goa: The new $concept_production_method$ on [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetState.GetName] has been active for #variable [JournalEntry.GetGoalProgressValue|0]/[JournalEntry.GetTotalGoalValue|0]#! weeks.
je_tutorial_expand_productive_building_r: The [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetState.GetName] is a highly productive [concept_building] that is bringing in a large amount of revenue compared to its expenses, making it an ideal candidate for expansion. Expand this $concept_building$ in order to grow our [concept_gdp] and tax base.
je_tutorial_expand_productive_building_i: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetState.GetName] is no longer owned by [GetPlayer.GetName]
je_tutorial_fix_unproductive_building_re: The [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetState.GetName] is not bringing in sufficient revenue compared to its expenses to stay competitive.\n\nUse of what you have learned about [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] and [Concept('concept_production_method','$concept_production_methods$')] to try and resolve this problem. You can also try to solve the problem with [concept_subsidies].
je_tutorial_fix_unproductive_building_in: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetState.GetName] is no longer owned by [GetPlayer.GetName]
je_tutorial_fix_unproductive_building_go: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetBuilding.GetName] has maintained a [concept_productivity] of at least #v @money!5.0#!, or been [Concept('concept_subsidies','$concept_subsidized$')], for [JournalEntry.GetGoalProgressValue|0]/[JournalEntry.GetTotalGoalValue|0]#! weeks.
je_tutorial_promote_movement_reason: It is time to choose a political vision for your country. Review your active [Concept('concept_political_movement', '$concept_political_movements$')] and choose one or several to [concept_bolster] for the rocky road ahead.
je_tutorial_grow_gdp_reason: This is an open-ended task that makes use of all that you have learned about [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')], [Concept('concept_market', '$concept_markets$')] and [concept_trade] to grow the [concept_gdp] of your country.\n\nBuilding $concept_buildings$, growing your [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_population$')], tweaking [Concept('concept_production_method', '$concept_production_methods$')] and manipulating $concept_market$ prices are all potential ways to grow your $concept_gdp$.
je_tutorial_increase_market_access_by_de: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetState.GetName] has had [GetDecreeType('decree_road_maintenance').GetName] $concept_decree$ in place for [JournalEntry.GetTotalGoalValue|v0] weeks

[concept_market_access] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetState.GetName] has dropped below 100%, causing adverse price conditions. Improve this by issuing the [GetDecreeType('decree_road_maintenance').GetName] [concept_decree] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetState.GetName].
je_tutorial_improve_market_access_with_r: [concept_infrastructure] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetState.GetName] is no longer sufficient to support its industries, impacting [concept_market_access]. Invest in local Railways to fix this problem once and for all.
$concept_infrastructure$ balance in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetState.GetName] must be positive. Current Balance: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetState.GetInfrastructureBalance|0+=]
je_tutorial_increase_immigration_reason: Development in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetState.GetName] is putting a strain on the local labor supply. There is plenty of available labor elsewhere in the [JournalEntry.GetCountry.GetCapital.GetMarket.GetName]. Encouraging [concept_migration] to [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetState.GetName] could help us with this matter.
je_tutorial_increase_immigration_invalid: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetState.GetName] is no longer owned by [GetPlayer.GetName], or 10 years have passed
je_tutorial_improve_supply_network_reaso: Our [concept_supply_network] has begun to buckle under the strain of overuse. You should look to remedy this before it becomes a larger issue and begins affecting our [concept_trade] [Concept('concept_treaty', '$concept_treaties$')] or overseas [concept_market_access] and army [concept_supply].
je_tutorial_improve_consumer_goods_acces: Many of your [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')] in [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetStateGoods.GetState.GetName] are reporting that they are having a hard time getting access to [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetStateGoods.GetGoods.GetName]. Alleviating these pains for your $concept_pops$ will increase [concept_sol] and help build [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalty$')].
je_tutorial_make_interest_group_happy_re: The [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetInterestGroup.GetName] seem to have a low [concept_approval] of our [concept_government]. We should keep them happy to avoid any potential of them becoming [Concept('concept_radicalized_interest_group','$concept_radicalized$')] and turning against us.
je_tutorial_enact_institution_law_reason: There is a surplus in our [concept_bureaucracy]. We should look to passing a law that will allow us to invest this surplus back into our [Concept('concept_pop', '$concept_pops$')].
je_tutorial_reform_government_reason: Our $concept_legitimacy$ is becoming rather low. If it continues to drop, it will become increasingly more difficult for us to pass new [Concept('concept_law','$concept_laws$')]. We can fix this problem with [Concept('concept_government_reform', '$concept_government_reform_short$')] to our [concept_government].
je_tutorial_increase_relations_reason: Your ability to make it through the tumultuous 19th Century will increase greatly if you get along with countries around you, and maybe make one or two strong allies. [GetDiplomaticActionType('increase_relations').GetName] with [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetCountry.GetName] to form a closer bond between your countries, increase the likelihood of them agreeing to future [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')] and supporting your side in [Concept('concept_diplomatic_play','$concept_diplomatic_plays$')].
je_tutorial_improve_rank_reason: In order to gain recognition on the international stage we should look to increasing our [Concept('concept_country','$concept_country_possessive$')] standing on the world stage. We can accomplish this by either raising our national [concept_prestige] or by elevating our nation to a higher $concept_country$ [concept_rank].
je_tutorial_prevent_revolution_reason: We have a [concept_revolution] brewing in our country. We should take the appropriate steps needed to quell this before it breaks out into a [concept_civil_war].
je_tutorial_earn_obligation_reason: [Concept('concept_obligation', '$concept_obligations$')] are an important aspect of global politics. They allow us to call on other nations to help us in times of war and allow us to force certain [Concept('concept_diplomatic_action', '$concept_diplomatic_actions$')] on other nations.
je_tutorial_expand_military_reason: To maintain peace, we must look to ensure our security. Our army could use some bolstering. Not only will this be useful should we find ourselves in a war, but also when projecting our power.
je_tutorial_expand_military_goal: Number of Battalions in your [concept_army] is at least #v [JournalEntry.GetTotalGoalValue]#!
je_tutorial_recruit_promote_commander_re: Now that our army has [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] we will need to put someone in charge of these $concept_units$. Without a commander the army will have low organization and not be as effective if we find ourselves in a conflict. We should be prepared for this eventuality.
je_tutorial_recruit_promote_commander_co: Has recruited and promoted a Commander
je_tutorial_mobilize_army_reason: Now that we are at [concept_war] we should mobilize our forces. If we do not, our forces will be unable to defend our country effectively.
je_tutorial_send_general_to_front_reason: [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetMilitaryFormation.GetName] has been [Concept('concept_mobilize_army','$concept_mobilize_army_mobilized$')] but hasn't been sent to a [concept_front]. If the [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetMilitaryFormation.GetName] isn't send to a $concept_front$, these forces will be divided up between multiple potential $concept_fronts$. This will hamper their ability to effectively influence the outcome of the war.
je_tutorial_convoy_raiding_reason: Our $concept_units$ stand ready to fight the enemy. By default our commanders will be on aggressive orders. Those orders can be shifted to deal with other situations. We should change the orders of [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetCharacter.GetFullName] to $defend$ so we are prepared for more situations.
je_tutorial_recover_from_default_reason: It appears that you have fallen into [concept_default]. While in default we will be unable to expand any of our buildings. The longer you stay in default the more likely it will start to have a negative effect on our economy.
je_tutorial_recover_from_default_goal: Keep your [concept_principal] (@money![GetPlayer.GetPrincipal|Dv]) below your [Concept('concept_credit','$concept_credit_limit$')] (@money![GetPlayer.GetMaxCredit|Dv]) for [JournalEntry.CalcCurrentGoalValue|v0]/[JournalEntry.GetTotalGoalValue|v0] weeks
je_tutorial_start_diplomatic_play_reason: Now that we have established an [concept_interest] in a [concept_strategic_region], we should look to start a [concept_diplomatic_play] to expand our borders.
je_tutorial_is_play_target_reason: We have been targeted by another nation in a [concept_diplomatic_play]. We need to act quickly and add a wargoal to this play and prepare to defend ourselves.
je_tutorial_capacity_deficit_reason: Overusing your country's [Concept('concept_capacity', '$concept_capacities$')] imposes serious penalties. Sort this problem out as soon as possible, either by increasing your generation or decreasing your usage.
je_tutorial_capacity_deficit_goal: Maintain a positive [concept_capacity] balance for [JournalEntry.CalcCurrentGoalValue|v0]/[JournalEntry.GetTotalGoalValue|v0] weeks
je_tutorial_declare_an_interest_reason: To expand your influence beyond your borders, you should look to establish an [concept_interest] in the [concept_strategic_region] in which the capital of another nation is. \nBuild up [concept_involvement] until you reach the [GetInterestTierType('interest_tier_observant').GetName] [Concept('concept_interest_tier', '$concept_interest_tier_short$')] in [SCOPE.sC('target').GetCapital.GetStateRegion.GetStrategicRegion.GetName].
je_tutorial_declare_an_interest_goal: Establish and maintain an [concept_interest] in [SCOPE.sC('target').GetCapital.GetStateRegion.GetStrategicRegion.GetName] for [JournalEntry.GetTotalGoalValue]#! weeks
je_tutorial_incorporate_state_reason: There [SelectLocalization(GreaterThan_int32(GetPlayer.GetNumStatesThatCanBeIncorporated,'(int32)1'),'are','is')] currently [GetPlayer.GetNumStatesThatCanBeIncorporated] [Concept('concept_unincorporated_state','$concept_unincorporated_states$')] that can be [Concept('concept_incorporated_state', '$concept_incorporated$')] in [GetPlayer.GetNameNoFlag]. [Concept('concept_incorporated_state','$concept_incorporating$')] a [concept_state] will increase your [Concept('concept_taxes','$concept_tax$')] revenue and make it easier to manage.
je_tutorial_invest_into_an_institution_r: You can increase your investment into the [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetInstitution.GetName] [concept_institution] to increase its impact on your population.
je_tutorial_colonize_state_reason: We should look to expand our empire abroad by [Concept('concept_colony','$concept_colonizing$')] a [concept_decentralized_nation].
je_tutorial_colonize_state_status_first: Start a [concept_colony] in a suitable region
je_tutorial_colonize_state_status_second: Grow or conquer surrounding land until the [concept_colony] encompasses its entire [concept_state_region]
je_tutorial_make_peace_reason: All wars eventually come to an end. We should look to make sure we get as much out of this conflict as possible. It is important to remember it is some times better to gain nothing then lose everything.
je_tutorial_research_technology_reason: We should select a [concept_technology] to research that best fits our needs for the future. It is best not to fall behind in this new age.
je_tutorial_research_technology_complete: Select a $concept_technology$ to research, and research it to completion
suppress_localization_errors: #debug custom_tooltip used on non-player-facing trigger to suppress errors, should never be visible to the player#!
tut_customs_union_block_txt: Unable to form/join Customs Unions before completing #b Improve Access to Consumer Goods#!.
je_tutorial_create_formation_reason: The [concept_army] is the backbone of our power. Creating new $concept_armies$ is a must for not only maintaining the security of our borders, but also increasing our influence. Having more $concept_armies$ to command will also increase the flexibility of our deployments allowing for [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] to defend our more potentially dispersed territories.
lesson_create_formation_how_1: How to Create a New Formation
lesson_create_formation_how_1_desc: A Formation is the collection of military units and a commander that you can control and direct to locations. Having multiple armies is nice for the flexibility of deploying the correct amount of [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] needed in a specific conflict.
lesson_create_formation_how_2_desc: Here in the Military Tab you can see your total number of [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')], the ability to mobilize all $concept_units$, and your current Formations along with their $concept_units$ and Commander.\n\nAt the bottom of the tab you can see the Create Army button.
lesson_create_formation_how_3_desc: Now you can click on the [concept_strategic_region] that you would like this army to form in. Forming an Army in this $concept_strategic_region$ does not limit you to exclusively recruiting units in said $concept_strategic_region$.\n\nNote that you relocate this army to another $concept_strategic_region$ after it has been created.
lesson_create_formation_how_3_continue: Select a $concept_strategic_region$ to Form Army in
lesson_create_formation_how_4_desc: Congratulations, you have raised a new Army!\n\nFollowing entries will give you more information on how to recruit [Concept('concept_unit','$concept_units$')] and organize your new Army.
je_tutorial_create_formation_complete_tr: Follow the steps and create a new [concept_army]
je_tutorial_establish_company_reason: With extensive and [Concept('concept_productivity', '$concept_productive$')] [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')], we can look to increase their [concept_throughput]. Chartering a $concept_company$ to help manage our industries will help to improve their effectiveness. These $concept_companies$ will improve all their affected $concept_buildings$.
lesson_establish_company_how_1_desc: Companies are a way to increase the efficiency of a group of [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] that are associated with it. The rewards for forming a [concept_company] are immediate and will increase the [concept_throughput] and construction efficiency on all the company associated buildings.\n\nMaintaining a productive buildings will also allow for additional bonuses to be unlocked via [concept_prosperity] bonuses.
lesson_establish_company_how_2_desc:
In this tab, you can see all your Available, Attainable and Potential [Concept('concept_company','$concept_companies$')].
- #b Available Companies#! are the Companies that you can establish at this moment.
- #b Attainable Companies#! are Companies that are achievable with some effort, but are missing additional requirements.
- #b Potential Companies#! are all other companies that you may be able to establish. Some of these will require significant efforts like conquering another [concept_state].

Take a look at the requirements for a Company that interests you and fulfill them. Then establish the Company.
lesson_establish_company_how_3_desc: Your [concept_company] is now established and bonuses are applied to their associated [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')]. Be sure to come back to the Companies screen to check on the [concept_prosperity] of your Companies to achieve additional bonuses.
je_subject_liberty_reason: Your [concept_subject] [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetCountry.GetNameNoFlag] is about to reach a dangerous level of $concept_liberty_desire$. When it reaches the final level they may attempt to increase their [concept_autonomy] or even try and become independent. We risk losing control of them if this progresses.
lesson_subject_liberty_how_1_desc: An overview of your [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')] can be found in the #b $concept_subjects$ tab#! on the #b Diplomacy panel#!.
lesson_subject_liberty_how_1_continue: Open the #b $concept_subjects$ tab#! on the #b Diplomacy panel#!
lesson_subject_liberty_how_2_desc: Here you can see your different [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')], their [concept_liberty_desire], and your available [Concept('concept_overlord_action', '$concept_overlord_actions$')].\n\nUnderneath the name of your $concept_subject$ and the [concept_subject_type], there is the $concept_liberty_desire$ bar. This bar shows you their current $concept_liberty_desire$ level. You can hover each part of the bar to see the effects of each level. They range from #g Positive#! - None - #r Negative#! effects on the generation of [Concept('concept_radical','$concept_radicals$')] and [Concept('concept_loyalist','$concept_loyalists$')] in the $concept_subject$ [concept_country].
lesson_subject_liberty_how_2_back: Close the #b Subjects tab#! to backtrack
lesson_subject_liberty_how_3_desc: To the right, you find a button to open and see your available [Concept('concept_overlord_action', '$concept_overlord_actions$')]. They can be used to fine tailor and set expectations for your [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')]. However, if you hover each actions and check the effects, note that many of these actions affect the $concept_subject_possessive$ [concept_liberty_desire] either directly by giving a set amount, or indirectly by increasing or decreasing the weekly gain/loss.
lesson_subject_liberty_how_4_desc:
[Concept('concept_overlord_action', '$concept_overlord_actions$')] are not the only way to change the [concept_liberty_desire] of a [concept_subject].

$concept_liberty_desire$ is also affected by the following:
 - [concept_relations]: Boosting relations between $concept_subject$ and $concept_overlord$
 - [concept_economic_dependence]: The impact on their economy.
 - [concept_prestige]: The difference in $concept_prestige$, higher difference means lower $concept_liberty_desire$ for the $concept_subject$.
 - $concept_subject$ [Concept('concept_political_lobby', '$concept_political_lobbies_short$')]: Towards their [concept_overlord].

It is always important to keep an eye on your $concept_subjects$ and their $concept_liberty_desire$.
lesson_subject_liberty_how_5_desc: When the [concept_liberty_desire] gets high or low enough for one of your [Concept('concept_subject', '$concept_subjects$')], you have the opportunity to [GetDiplomaticActionType('da_decrease_autonomy').GetName] or [GetDiplomaticActionType('da_increase_autonomy_of_subject').GetName] with the buttons on either side of the bar, which will either lower or increase the amount of control you have over the $concept_subject$. You can see what each [concept_subject_type] leads to when increasing or decreasing autonomy in the #b Subject Types Table#!.\n\nThis can be helpful if you can sacrifice [concept_autonomy] for a lower $concept_liberty_desire$, or if you wish to take steps towards annexing a $concept_subject$.
lesson_subject_liberty_why_1_desc: The largest risk to high levels of [concept_liberty_desire] is the chance that your [concept_subject] may attempt to start a [concept_diplomatic_play] for Independence and rebel against you.\n\nA $concept_subject$ may attempt a $concept_diplomatic_play$ for Independence if $concept_liberty_desire$ is #bold High#! and they have had their request for increased [concept_autonomy] rejected by their [concept_overlord].
lesson_subject_liberty_why_1_continue: Open the #b $concept_subjects$ tab#! on the #b Diplomacy panel#!
lesson_subject_liberty_why_2_desc: Additionally a $concept_subject$ with high [concept_liberty_desire] will unlock options to increase their [concept_autonomy]. A $concept_subject$ with increased $concept_autonomy$ will pay less tribute to their [concept_overlord].\n\nBe careful when declining $concept_autonomy$ requests as it usually is the first step towards an [GetDiplomaticPlayType('dp_independence').GetName] [concept_diplomatic_play].
lesson_subject_liberty_why_2_back: Close the #b Subjects tab#! to backtrack
lesson_subject_liberty_why_3_desc: [Concept('concept_subject','$concept_subjects$')] with a high level of [concept_liberty_desire] can potentially block certain [Concept('concept_overlord_action', '$concept_overlord_actions$')] that would normally be available if $concept_liberty_desire$ was lower.
je_tutorial_form_power_bloc_reason: As a Great Power we must show strength. Other Great Powers are [Concept('concept_power_bloc_leader','$concept_power_bloc_leaders$')]. We should look to creating our own Sphere of Influence if we hope to compete with the others. Creating a $concept_power_bloc$ will allow us to keep a closer grip on [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] that we may wish to keep influence over.
lesson_form_power_bloc_how_1_desc: Forming a [concept_power_bloc] allows you to create a group of [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] that can work together in bettering their situation.\n\nYou can see details about all the already existing $concept_power_blocs$ on the #b $concept_power_bloc$ panel#!. Here is also where you can form your own.
lesson_form_power_bloc_how_1_continue: Open the #b $concept_power_bloc$ panel#! and click the #b '$FORM_POWER_BLOC$'#! button at the bottom of the panel
lesson_form_power_bloc_how_2_desc:
Here you can customize your own [concept_power_bloc].

Mandatory things to select:
 - A name for your $concept_power_bloc$
 - A [concept_power_bloc_identity]
 - A [concept_power_bloc_principle] from a [concept_power_bloc_primary_principle_group]

The $concept_power_bloc_identity$ is the main guide for how your $concept_power_bloc$ will operate, but $concept_power_bloc_principles$ are what will define your $concept_power_bloc$ over time as you gain [Concept('concept_power_bloc_mandate','$concept_power_bloc_mandates$')] for new and upgraded versions of them.

If you are happy with your $concept_power_bloc$ name and $concept_power_bloc_identity$, then all you have left to do is to select your starting $concept_power_bloc_principle$.
lesson_form_power_bloc_how_2_continue: Click #bold $ADD_NEW_PRINCIPLE$#! to open the #b Principle Selection window#!
lesson_form_power_bloc_how_2_back: Close the #b Power Bloc Formation panel#! to backtrack.
lesson_form_power_bloc_how_3_desc: $concept_power_bloc_principles$ are your way to tailor your [concept_power_bloc] into its own unique entity. However, when starting a $concept_power_bloc$ you have to select a [concept_power_bloc_principle] from a [concept_power_bloc_primary_principle_group]. The $concept_power_bloc_primary_principle_group$ is dependent on the [concept_power_bloc_identity] of your Bloc.\n\nTo get more principles you will need [Concept('concept_power_bloc_mandate','$concept_power_bloc_mandates$')]. $concept_power_bloc_mandates$ are accumulated over time, and you can generally acquire them faster by inviting more members to your Power Bloc.
lesson_form_power_bloc_how_3_continue: Pick any of the available $concept_power_bloc_principles$ and then #b $PRINCIPLE_SELECTION_SUBMIT_BUTTON_LABEL$#!
lesson_form_power_bloc_how_3_back: Close the #b Principle Selection window#! to backtrack.
lesson_form_power_bloc_how_4_desc: All that is left now is to click the #b $FORM_POWER_BLOC$#! button and your [concept_power_bloc] will be formed! Be sure to invite more [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] to your newly formed $concept_power_bloc$ when you have enough [concept_power_bloc_leverage_advantage] over them.
lesson_form_power_bloc_why_1_desc: Forming a [concept_power_bloc] allows you to have access to an extra avenue of interactions with other [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] that you might have an interest in, be it for [Concept('concept_alliance','$concept_alliances$')] or just keeping them close for later. Forming a $concept_power_bloc$ and aquiring [Concept('concept_power_bloc_mandate','$concept_power_bloc_mandates$')] can be used to unlock additional bonuses for the [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')].
lesson_form_power_bloc_why_2_desc: Forming a [concept_power_bloc] will open access to the [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle','$concept_power_bloc_principles$')]. $concept_power_bloc_principles$ are a way for a [concept_country] to tailor their Bloc to become more what a group of $concept_countries$ might need, or what they might wish to try and accomplish.\n\n$concept_power_bloc_principles$ are divided up into [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle_group','$concept_power_bloc_principle_groups$')] and a group has three levels. Each level provides a new effect, but will cost an additional $concept_power_bloc_mandate$ when increasing the level of the $concept_power_bloc_principle_group$.
lesson_form_power_bloc_why_3_desc: Having other [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] inside of your [concept_power_bloc] can allow for some level of control over them. [Concept('concept_power_bloc_member','$concept_power_bloc_members_short$')] can be integrated into a [concept_customs_union] that will allow for a more open access to goods.\n\nIf you do not wish to have all $concept_power_bloc_members_short$ in a $concept_customs_union$, you can allow one or multiple $concept_power_bloc_members_short$ to maintain their own market while still remaining within the $concept_power_bloc_short$. This can be helpful if they are not directly connected to your $concept_country$, and you do not have the required [GetGoods('merchant_marine').GetName] to maintain $concept_trade$.
lesson_form_power_bloc_why_4_desc: The main argument for having a [concept_power_bloc] is the ability to secure [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] that you might not have the diplomatic [concept_influence] to maintain relations with otherwise, while also keeping those $concept_countries$ away from other $concept_power_blocs$.\n\nAdding more $concept_countries$ to your $concept_power_bloc$ will require [concept_power_bloc_leverage] and will decrease your $concept_power_bloc_possessive$ [concept_power_bloc_cohesion].
je_tutorial_foreign_investment_reason: The nation of [JournalEntry.GetTarget.GetCountry.GetName] currently allows for us to build in their [concept_country]. We should take advantage of this by expanding [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] that can bolster both $concept_countries_possessive$ economies.
lesson_foreign_investmen_why_1_desc: Having the ability to expand [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] in another [concept_country] can be extremely helpful in regards to bettering your economic situation. An example of this is that you can build in a $concept_country$ that has access to [Concept('concept_good', '$concept_goods$')] currently unavailable to you. Additionally, you can help industrialize $concept_countries$ that might have many [GetPopType('peasants').GetName] but no construction capabilities to take advantage of these large number of [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')].
lesson_foreign_investmen_why_2_desc: The potential to expand [Concept('concept_building','$concept_buildings$')] in other [Concept('concept_country','$concept_countries$')] can reduce your reliance on other $concept_countries$ that might not be aligned with you in the future. Being able to effectively build up your [concept_trade_capacity] can allow for an expansion of the industry in your home lands.
lesson_foreign_investmen_why_3_desc: Another reason to invest in another [concept_country], might be because that $concept_country$ is incapable of rapidly expanding on its own. This $concept_country$ might not have the ability to build up their economy due to a lack of [GetBuildingType('building_construction_sector').GetName] [Concept('concept_building', '$concept_buildings$')]. Doing this would not only allow for the potential inclusion of their resources into your market, but also the development of their economy, and the utilization of their [Concept('concept_pop','$concept_pops$')]. In a [concept_subject] this will allow for a stronger [concept_army], an increase in tribute, and an increased potential for private investment by your $concept_pops$.
je_tutorial_lobbies_reason: One of our [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] has started a $concept_political_lobby$ targeting [SCOPE.sPL('target').GetTargetCountry.GetName]. $concept_political_lobby_appeasing$ our $concept_interest_groups$ will give them more [concept_approval] to use in the enacting of new [Concept('concept_law', '$concept_laws$')] and potentially unlock more [Concept('concept_interest_group_trait', '$concept_interest_group_traits$')].
lesson_lobbies_how_1_desc: [Concept('concept_political_lobby','$concept_political_lobbies$')] are a way for your [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] to express their opinion on the diplomatic [concept_relations] of your [concept_country]. You can see a list of active $concept_political_lobbies_short$ in the outliner on the right side of the screen and in the #b $POLITICS$#! panel.
lesson_lobbies_how_2_desc: Here you can see a list of active [Concept('concept_political_lobby','$concept_political_lobbies_short$')] and the [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] that support them. The current level of $concept_political_lobby_appeasement$ is also visible.
lesson_lobbies_how_3_desc:
This is the [concept_political_lobby] panel. Here you can see all the details of who is supporting the $concept_political_lobby_short$ and how to influence it further.
At the top you can see the [concept_political_lobby_appeasement] Bar, the [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] that support this $concept_political_lobby_short$, and the combined [concept_clout] of the $concept_interest_groups$.

The $concept_political_lobby_appeasement$ Bar shows the $concept_political_lobby_appeasement$ level from complying with your $concept_interest_groups$' requests. The more you increase $concept_political_lobby_appeasement$ the more [concept_approval] the supporting $concept_interest_groups$ will receive.
lesson_lobbies_how_3_back: Close the panel for the [GetTutorialJournalEntry.GetTarget.GetPoliticalLobby.GetName] [concept_political_lobby] to backtrack.
lesson_lobbies_how_4_desc: Below that you have the supporting [Concept('concept_interest_group','$concept_interest_groups$')] of the [Concept('concept_political_lobby','$concept_political_lobby_short$')], and the [concept_clout] of the $concept_political_lobby_short$. The $concept_political_lobby_short_possessive$ $concept_clout$ is determined from the combined $concept_clout$ value of all supporting $concept_interest_groups$. This $concept_clout$ value impacts the [concept_influence] costs of [Concept('concept_diplomatic_pact','$concept_diplomatic_pacts$')] with the target [concept_country] of the $concept_political_lobby$.
lesson_lobbies_5_how_desc: Lastly at the bottom of the tab are ways of increasing or decreasing [concept_political_lobby_appeasement]. Fulfilling any of the conditions in the increase category below will bolster $concept_political_lobby_appeasement$, and increase [concept_interest_group] [concept_approval], while anything in the bottom category will decrease $concept_political_lobby_appeasement$.
